ART-MU8S4B0A-NZWH.title: U Rwanda rurashaka ubwumvikane bwa Afurika ku bikorwa by’ikirere mbere y’inama mpuzamahanga zikomeye
ART-MU8S4B0A-NZWH.subtitle: Mbere ya MOP38, COP31 n’izindi nama, u Rwanda rurashyira imbere kwihanganira ingaruka z’ihindagurika ry’ikirere, imari, amasoko ya karuboni n’uruhare rw’urubyiruko mu mishyikirano.
ART-MU8S4B0A-NZWH.summary: U Rwanda rurashaka ubwumvikane bwagutse muri Afurika ku itangazo rizahuza iby’ingenzi bizaganirwaho mu nama mpuzamahanga ku mihindagurikire y’ikirere n’ibidukikije. Guverinoma ishyira imbere kwihanganira ibiza biterwa n’ikirere, imicungire y’imyanda, uruhare rw’urubyiruko n’inkunga ikenewe kugira ngo hashyirwe mu bikorwa gahunda z’ikirere zibarirwa muri miliyari 12 z’amadolari kugeza mu 2035. U Rwanda kandi rurashaka ko Afurika ibona inyungu nyinshi mu masoko ya karuboni binyuze mu mategeko akomeye, igenzura ryizewe n’inguzanyo za karuboni zifite agaciro kanini.
ART-MU8S4B0A-NZWH.body:
U Rwanda rurimo kwitegura kwakira no kwitabira uruhererekane rw’inama mpuzamahanga zikomeye, ari na ko rushaka ubwumvikane bwagutse muri Afurika ku itangazo rwifuza ko ryagira uruhare mu cyiciro gikurikira cy’ibikorwa by’isi ku bibazo by’ihindagurika ry’ikirere n’ibidukikije.

Minisitiri w’Ibidukikije, Dr Bernadette Arakwiye, yavuze ko iryo tangazo, ryamaze gushyigikirwa n’Itsinda rya Afurika ry’abashyikirana, rigamije gufasha ibihugu guhuza ibyihutirwa, cyane cyane ku bibazo bireba ibihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere. Yavuze ko u Rwanda rushaka ubwumvikane bwagutse ku byo ibihugu bizibandaho mu gihe kiri imbere.

Iryo tangazo riri mu myiteguro y’Inama ya 38 y’Abagize Amasezerano ya Montreal, MOP38, Kigali izakira kuva ku wa 2 kugeza ku wa 6 Ugushyingo, hamwe na COP31 ya UNFCCC izabera Antalya n’izindi nama mpuzamahanga z’ibidukikije. MOP38 izaba ibaye nyuma y’imyaka icumi ibihugu byemereye i Kigali kugabanya buhoro buhoro hydrofluorocarbons, imyuka ihumanya ikirere ikoreshwa cyane mu byuma bikonjesha.

Arakwiye yavuze ko u Rwanda rwifuza ko izi nama zitanga ibisubizo bifatika aho kuba indi mikorere y’amasezerano n’amatangazo atagira ishyirwa mu bikorwa. Yashimangiye ko inama zikwiye gushingira ku masomo u Rwanda rwakuye mu gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda z’ibidukikije.

U Rwanda rukomeje kwibasirwa n’ibiza bijyanye n’ihindagurika ry’ikirere, birimo imyuzure n’inkangu. Arakwiye yatanze urugero rw’ibiza byo mu 2023, ubwo u Rwanda rwagombaga gushaka amafaranga agera kuri miliyoni 400 z’amadolari kugira ngo ruhangane n’ingaruka z’imyuzure n’inkangu, avuga ko gutabara bitinze bituma ikiguzi cyo gusana ibyangiritse kirushaho kuzamuka.

Kubera iyo mpamvu, kwihanganira ihindagurika ry’ikirere no kongera ubushobozi bwo guhangana naryo bizaba ku isonga ry’ibiganiro. Guverinoma izashyigikira ibikorwa bifasha abaturage bugarijwe cyane n’ingaruka z’ikirere kumenyera ibihe bihinduka, ikanateza imbere imicungire y’imyanda n’uruhare rw’urubyiruko mu mishyikirano mpuzamahanga.

Minisitiri yavuze ko abashyikirana b’urubyiruko b’u Rwanda bamaze kugira ubunararibonye buhagije bwo gutanga umusanzu ku myanya ya Afurika, bityo igihugu kikabasha kugira ijambo mu biganiro birenze inyungu zacyo bwite.

Ikibazo cy’imari kiracyari gikomeye. Gahunda nshya y’u Rwanda y’uruhare rw’igihugu mu kugabanya ihindagurika ry’ikirere, NDC 3.0, igaragaza ko gushyira mu bikorwa ibikorwa biteganyijwe kugeza mu 2035 bizakenera hafi miliyari 12 z’amadolari, muri zo hafi miliyari 7 zikajya mu kwihanganira ingaruka naho miliyari 5 zikajya mu kugabanya imyuka ihumanya.

Teddy Mugabo Mpinganzima, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigega cy’u Rwanda cy’Ibidukikije, yavuze ko hafi miliyari 5 z’amadolari zamaze kuboneka, bityo hakaba hasigaye gushakwa izindi miliyari 7. Ikigega kirateganya gushaka ayo mafaranga kugeza mu 2035, kitibanda gusa ku nkunga zisanzwe z’iterambere ahubwo no ku bashoramari bo mu gihugu, impapuro z’agaciro n’ubundi buryo bw’imari.

U Rwanda kandi rurimo kwitegura kwakira Carbon Markets Africa Summit, aho rushaka kwagura ikiganiro ku buryo amasoko ya karuboni yaha ibihugu bya Afurika agaciro n’inyungu nyinshi, aho umugabane kutaba gusa isoko ry’inguzanyo za karuboni.

Igihugu gishyira imbere inguzanyo za karuboni zifite agaciro kanini, zirengera inyungu z’abaturage n’ibinyabuzima kandi zigakurikiranwa mu buryo bwizewe. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cyo Kubungabunga Ibidukikije (REMA) cyashyizeho ishami ryihariye ry’amasoko ya karuboni rikurikirana ibikorwa no nyuma y’uko inguzanyo zagurishijwe.

Umuyobozi Mukuru wa REMA, Juliet Kabera, yavuze ko Afurika ikeneye uburyo bukomeye kugira ngo ibashe gukurura no kugumana amafaranga ava ku masoko ya karuboni, harimo urubuga rwiza rw’ubucuruzi n’amategeko aboneye. U Rwanda kandi rwamuritse ikirango cya MOP38.

Mu nama zose ziri imbere, u Rwanda ruzibanda ku guhindura amasezerano mpuzamahanga amafaranga, ibikorwa remezo n’ibisubizo bipimika ku rwego rw’abaturage. Ubutumwa bwarwo buzibanda ku guhuza Afurika, ibisubizo bifatika n’imari ishobora guhindura amasezerano mpuzamahanga ibikorwa byo guhangana n’ingaruka z’ikirere mu gihugu no ku rwego rw’isi.

ART-MU8S4BN2-FSAE.title: Wadagni yasuye u Rwanda ku mugaragaro bwa mbere ari Perezida wa Benin
ART-MU8S4BN2-FSAE.subtitle: Urugendo rw’iminsi ibiri n’ibiganiro na Perezida Paul Kagame byibanda ku kwagura ubufatanye mu mutekano, ubucuruzi, ishoramari, ikoranabuhanga, ubwikorezi n’ubukerarugendo.
ART-MU8S4BN2-FSAE.summary: Perezida wa Benin Romuald Wadagni yasuye u Rwanda ku mugaragaro bwa mbere kuva yatangira imirimo muri Gicurasi, agirana ibiganiro na Perezida Paul Kagame ku kwagura umubano w’ibihugu byombi. U Rwanda na Benin byubatse urwego rwagutse rw’ubufatanye kuva Inama ya mbere y’Ubuhahirane n’Ubufatanye mu 2017 no ku masezerano menshi yasinywe mu 2023 mu mutekano, ubucuruzi, ikoranabuhanga, ubwikorezi n’ubukerarugendo. Uru rugendo rutanga umwanya wo gusuzuma ibyagezweho no gushaka andi mahirwe y’ubukungu n’ingamba, harimo guhuza u Rwanda n’amasoko ya Afurika y’Iburengerazuba no kongera ubufatanye bw’inzego za Leta.
ART-MU8S4BN2-FSAE.body:
KIGALI — Perezida wa Benin, Romuald Wadagni, yasuye u Rwanda ku mugaragaro bwa mbere kuva yatangira imirimo muri Gicurasi, ageze i Kigali mu rugendo rw’iminsi ibiri rugamije kurushaho gushimangira umubano n’u Rwanda binyuze mu biganiro na Perezida Paul Kagame.

Kagame yakiriye Wadagni muri Village Urugwiro, aho Perezida wa Benin yabanje gusuzuma umutwe w’ingabo wamuhaye icyubahiro mbere y’uko abayobozi bombi bagirana ibiganiro byihariye ku mubano w’ibihugu byombi n’ibindi bibazo bahuriyeho. Uru rugendo rubaye mu gihe u Rwanda na Benin bishaka kubakira ku bufatanye bugenda bwaguka mu mutekano, ubucuruzi, ishoramari, ikoranabuhanga, ubwikorezi n’ubukerarugendo.

Ni ubwa mbere Wadagni aje mu Rwanda ari Umukuru w’Igihugu, nubwo yahasuye mu 2023 ari Minisitiri w’Ubukungu n’Imari wa Benin akaba n’intumwa yihariye ya Perezida Patrice Talon wari ku butegetsi icyo gihe. Kagame na we yasuye Benin mu 2023, agirana ibiganiro na Talon ku gushimangira umubano w’ibihugu byombi.

Uru rugendo ruha Kigali na Cotonou umwanya wo gusuzuma ubufatanye busanzwe no gushaka izindi nzego z’ubukungu n’ingamba zo gukorana. Mu myaka icumi ishize, umubano waragutse uva ku rwego rwa dipolomasi ujya no mu buhinzi, ikoranabuhanga, ishoramari, umutekano n’ubufatanye bw’inzego za Leta.

Ibihugu byombi byateranye Inama ya mbere ya Komisiyo Ihuriweho y’Ubufatanye i Rubavu muri Nzeri 2017, bisinya amasezerano ku ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho, serivisi z’ubutaka, kurengera ibidukikije n’iterambere rirambye. Ubufatanye bwarushijeho gukomera mu ruzinduko rwa Kagame muri Benin mu 2023, ubwo hasinywaga amasezerano ku kwirinda gusoresha kabiri, ubuhinzi, iterambere rya digitale, imiyoborere y’inzego z’ibanze, iterambere rirambye, ubufatanye mu bya gisirikare, ubucuruzi n’inganda, ubukerarugendo no guteza imbere ishoramari.

Ubwikorezi bwo mu kirere na bwo bwagiye buganirwaho, kuko guhuza Kigali na Cotonou byoroshya urujya n’uruza rw’abantu, abashoramari n’ibicuruzwa hagati y’amasoko yombi. Urugendo rwa Wadagni rubaye mu gihe ibihugu byombi bimaze kugira urwego rw’amasezerano rwashingirwaho mu kwagura ubufatanye.

Ku Rwanda, Benin itanga amahirwe yo kugera ku isoko rinini rya Afurika y’Iburengerazuba no gukoresha icyambu cya Cotonou nk’irembo ry’ubucuruzi. Benin ifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare hafi 112,600 n’abaturage bagera kuri miliyoni 15. Ubukungu bwayo bwari bushingiye cyane ku buhinzi, cyane cyane ipamba n’amamesa, ariko serivisi, ubwubatsi n’inganda na byo bigenda birushaho kugira uruhare runini.

Banki y’Isi igereranya ko ubukungu bwa Benin bwazamutseho 8.1% mu 2025, GDP igera hafi kuri miliyari 24.6 z’amadolari. Icyambu cya Cotonou gikomeje kuba ingenzi mu migambi y’ubucuruzi y’igihugu, gifasha ubucuruzi n’ibihugu bituranye kandi kigahuza Benin n’isoko rigari rya Afurika y’Iburengerazuba. Ibi bitanga amahirwe mu ishoramari, serivisi za digitale, ubwikorezi bw’ibicuruzwa no guhanahana ubumenyi, uretse ubucuruzi busanzwe hagati y’ibihugu byombi.

Umutekano na wo ni igice cy’ingenzi cy’umubano. Mu ruzinduko rwa Kagame mu 2023, abayobozi baganiriye ku kurwanya iterabwoba n’umutekano wo mu karere, kandi ibihugu byombi byasinyanye amasezerano y’ubufatanye mu mutekano no mu bya gisirikare. Bifite inyungu imwe yo kongera ibisubizo biyobowe n’Abanyafurika ku bibazo by’umutekano mu gihe intambara n’iterabwoba bikomeje kugaragara mu bice bitandukanye by’umugabane.

Mu mpera za Kanama 2026, abayobozi bo mu rwego rwa Benin rugenzura imari basuye Urwego rw’Umugenzuzi Mukuru w’Imari ya Leta mu Rwanda kugira ngo bahanahane ubumenyi n’ubunararibonye. Ibi bigaragaza ko umubano urimo kurenga inama z’abakuru b’ibihugu ukagera no ku bufatanye bw’inzego za Leta.

Mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka, Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Rwanda Justin Nsengiyumva yagiye muri Benin ahagarariye Kagame mu muhango wo kurahira kwa Wadagni. Yanahuye n’Abanyarwanda baba muri Benin ku ruhare bashobora kugira mu kongera ishoramari n’izindi sano hagati y’ibihugu byombi.

Ubukerarugendo ni urundi rwego rw’ubufatanye. Mu majyaruguru ya Benin, Pariki y’Igihugu ya Pendjari izwiho inzovu, intare, imvubu n’izindi nyamaswa kandi iri mu gace kanini ka Pendjari-W. Mu majyepfo, Ouidah izwi ku muco wa Vodun n’amateka y’ubucuruzi bw’abacakara bwambukiranyaga Atlantika, harimo Route of the Enslaved na Door of No Return. Ganvié, umudugudu umaze ibinyejana wubatse ku Kiyaga cya Nokoué, na wo ni ahantu hihariye h’ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku buzima bwo ku mazi.

U Rwanda na rwo rwateje imbere ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku nyamaswa, kubungabunga ibidukikije n’umuco, bityo ibihugu byombi bikagira amahirwe yo kurushaho gukorana muri uru rwego.

Kugera kwa Wadagni i Kigali gukurikira imyaka y’imikoranire yiyongera hagati y’abayobozi bakuru. U Rwanda kandi rwakomeje gushimangira uruhagararizi rwa dipolomasi muri Benin; Ambasaderi Rosemary Mbabazi yashyikirije Perezida Patrice Talon impapuro zimwemerera guhagararira u Rwanda, anagaragaza ubushake bwo gushaka amahirwe mashya y’ubufatanye.

U Rwanda ruzana ubunararibonye mu ikoranabuhanga rya digitale, imiyoborere n’iterambere ry’inzego za Leta, naho Benin igatanga ihuriro ry’ubukungu rigana muri Afurika y’Iburengerazuba n’amahirwe mu bucuruzi, ishoramari, umutekano n’ubukerarugendo. Ibiganiro bya Wadagni na Kagame biteganyijwe kwibanda ku buryo amasezerano ya politiki yahinduka urujya n’uruza runini rw’abantu, ishoramari, ubucuruzi n’ubumenyi.

Mu mpera za Kanama 2026, abayobozi bo mu rwego rwa Benin rugenzura imari basuye Urwego rw’Umugenzuzi Mukuru w’Imari ya Leta mu Rwanda kugira ngo bahanahane ubumenyi n’ubunararibonye. Ibi bigaragaza ko umubano urimo kurenga inama z’abakuru b’ibihugu ukagera no ku bufatanye bw’inzego za Leta.

Mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka, Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Rwanda Justin Nsengiyumva yagiye muri Benin ahagarariye Kagame mu muhango wo kurahira kwa Wadagni. Yanahuye n’Abanyarwanda baba muri Benin ku ruhare bashobora kugira mu kongera ishoramari n’izindi sano hagati y’ibihugu byombi.

Ubukerarugendo ni urundi rwego rw’ubufatanye. Mu majyaruguru ya Benin, Pariki y’Igihugu ya Pendjari izwiho inzovu, intare, imvubu n’izindi nyamaswa kandi iri mu gace kanini ka Pendjari-W. Mu majyepfo, Ouidah izwi ku muco wa Vodun n’amateka y’ubucuruzi bw’abacakara bwambukiranyaga Atlantika, harimo Route of the Enslaved na Door of No Return. Ganvié, umudugudu umaze ibinyejana wubatse ku Kiyaga cya Nokoué, na wo ni ahantu hihariye h’ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku buzima bwo ku mazi.
U Rwanda na rwo rwateje imbere ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku nyamaswa, kubungabunga ibidukikije n’umuco, bityo ibihugu byombi bikagira amahirwe yo kurushaho gukorana muri uru rwego.

Kugera kwa Wadagni i Kigali gukurikira imyaka y’imikoranire yiyongera hagati y’abayobozi bakuru. U Rwanda kandi rwakomeje gushimangira uruhagararizi rwa dipolomasi muri Benin; Ambasaderi Rosemary Mbabazi yashyikirije Perezida Patrice Talon impapuro zimwemerera guhagararira u Rwanda, anagaragaza ubushake bwo gushaka amahirwe mashya y’ubufatanye.

U Rwanda ruzana ubunararibonye mu ikoranabuhanga rya digitale, imiyoborere n’iterambere ry’inzego za Leta, naho Benin igatanga ihuriro ry’ubukungu rigana muri Afurika y’Iburengerazuba n’amahirwe mu bucuruzi, ishoramari, umutekano n’ubukerarugendo. Ibiganiro bya Wadagni na Kagame biteganyijwe kwibanda ku buryo amasezerano ya politiki yahinduka urujya n’uruza runini rw’abantu, ishoramari, ubucuruzi n’ubumenyi.

ART-MU8S4C9L-J7BO.title: Inganda zatumye ubukungu bw’u Rwanda buzamukaho 9.4%
ART-MU8S4C9L-J7BO.subtitle: Urwego rw’inganda rwazamutseho 18% mu gihembwe cya kabiri, ruyobowe n’ubwubatsi, ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro n’inganda, mu gihe ubuhinzi bwazamutseho 4% gusa.
ART-MU8S4C9L-J7BO.summary: Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ibarurishamibare (NISR) cyatangaje ko ubukungu bw’u Rwanda bwazamutseho 9.4% mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya 2026, inganda zikazamukaho 18% bitewe ahanini n’ubwubatsi, ubucukuzi n’inganda zitunganya. Ibicuruzwa by’ibyuma, imashini n’ibikoresho byayoboye izamuka ry’inganda, mu gihe Guverinoma yavuze ko ubucuruzi n’inganda byakomeje kwihagararaho nubwo ibiciro by’ibicuruzwa byazamutse n’amakimbirane ya politiki ku isi. Ubuhinzi bwazamutseho 4% gusa, naho igabanuka ry’umusaruro wa kawa, indwara z’amatungo n’izamuka ry’ibiciro bya lisansi bikomeza gushyira igitutu ku biciro ku baturage.
ART-MU8S4C9L-J7BO.body:
KIGALI — Imibare mishya y’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ibarurishamibare (NISR) igaragaza ko urwego rw’inganda rurimo kuba moteri ikomeye y’izamuka ry’ubukungu bw’u Rwanda, rukagira uruhare mu kuzamura ubukungu ku kigero cya 9.4% mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya 2026.

Inganda zazamutseho 18% muri icyo gihembwe, zirenga inshuro ebyiri umuvuduko wa serivisi kandi zikaba zirenga inshuro enye izamuka ry’ubuhinzi. Ubwubatsi, ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro n’inganda zitunganya ni byo byayoboye iri zamuka, bikomeza inzira y’imyaka ishize aho inganda zigenda zongera uruhare mu bukungu.

Mu myaka icumi ishize, inganda zari zifite 17% bya GDP y’u Rwanda. Mu 2024, uruhare rwazo rwari rumaze kugera kuri 21% nk’uko NISR ibigaragaza. Muri icyo gihe, inganda zitunganya zazamutse ziva kuri 7% zigera kuri 9%, naho ubwubatsi buva kuri 7% bugera kuri 9%.

Imibare ya vuba igaragaza ko uwo muvuduko ukomeje. Ubukungu bwageze kuri miliyari 7,174 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda mu gihembwe cya kabiri, buvuye kuri miliyari 5,799 mu gihe nk’icyo cy’umwaka ushize.

Mu nganda zitunganya, ibicuruzwa by’ibyuma, imashini n’ibikoresho byagize umusaruro ukomeye kurusha ibindi, byiyongeraho 51%. Ibicuruzwa bikozwe mu mabuye n’ibindi bidafite ibyuma byiyongereyeho 22%, naho imyenda, ibikoresho byo kwambara n’impu byiyongeraho 13%.

Ibi byubakiye ku izamuka ryari risanzwe rigaragara mbere y’iki gihembwe. Inganda zazamutseho 11% mu 2025, zifashijwe n’umusaruro wiyongereye w’ibikoresho by’ubwubatsi. Uko u Rwanda rwagura ibikorwa remezo kandi rugashaka gukora mu gihugu ibikoresho byinshi by’ubwubatsi, ni ko ubwubatsi n’inganda zitunganya bigenda birushaho gufashanya gukura.

Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi, Yusuf Murangwa, yavuze ko imikorere myiza y’ubucuruzi n’inganda igaragaza ko ibikorwa by’ubukungu bikomeje kwihagararaho nubwo hari igitutu cy’ibiciro by’ibicuruzwa n’amakimbirane ya politiki ku isi. Yavuze ko imibare y’ubucuruzi n’inganda igaragaza ko ubushobozi bwo kugura ku baturage bukomeje kuba bwiza.

Murangwa yavuze ko ubucuruzi bwari gushobora kuzamuka kurushaho iyo ibiciro by’ibicuruzwa bitazamuka, kandi ko izamuka rigenda riba buhoro buhoro ryerekana ko ubukungu bushobora gukomeza kwaguka mu gihe kirekire. Guverinoma kandi ivuga ko ingamba zafashwe kugira ngo hagabanywe ingaruka z’intambara yo mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati zafashije ubukungu kugumana umuvuduko.

Ubuhinzi bwo bukomeje kuba igice gifite intege nke. Buzamutseho 4% gusa nubwo bugize 21% bya GDP. Murangwa yavuze ko iki gipimo kidahagije kugira ngo igihugu kigere ku mutekano wifuza, ariko ko bidashatse kuvuga ko umusaruro w’ubuhinzi wagabanutse; Guverinoma irashaka ko ubuhinzi bwazamuka hafi 10% cyangwa hejuru yayo.

Umusaruro w’ibihingwa by’ibiribwa wazamutseho 5%, ariko ibihingwa byoherezwa mu mahanga bigabanukaho 20%, ahanini kubera ko umusaruro wa kawa wagabanutseho 33%. Umusaruro w’icyayi wazamutseho 18%, ugabanya igihombo ku rugero runaka.

Izamuka rito ry’ubuhinzi rinafitanye isano n’igitutu cy’ibiciro ku ngo. Umuyobozi Mukuru Wungirije wa NISR, Jean Claude Mwizerwa, yavuze ko bimwe mu byazamuye ibiciro byatewe n’ibibazo byihariye birimo indwara z’amatungo, atanga urugero rw’izamuka ry’ibiciro by’inyama ryatewe na Rift Valley fever, atari gusa kugabanuka k’umusaruro.

Ibiciro by’ubwikorezi na byo byazamutse bitewe n’izamuka ry’ibiciro bya lisansi rijyanye n’amakimbirane yo mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati. Mwizerwa yavuze ko izamuka rya lisansi ryatumye igiciro cy’ubwikorezi bwo mu gihugu kizamuka cyane.

Imibare y’igihembwe cya kabiri igaragaza ubukungu bukura cyane, ariko ikanerekana ko izamuka ry’inganda, ubwubatsi n’ubucuruzi rigomba kujyana n’umusaruro mwinshi w’ibiribwa kugira ngo igitutu ku baguzi kigabanuke.

ART-MU8S4CVX-IEBS.title: U Rwanda rwagura uruhare mu ruhererekane rwa tungsten ikoreshwa mu ngabo no mu by’indege muri Amerika
ART-MU8S4CVX-IEBS.subtitle: Guverinoma yabonye imigabane 25% mu mushinga mushya ifatanyijemo na Almonty Industries, ishaka kuva ku bucukuzi gusa ikagera ku gutunganya amabuye, kuyakurikirana no kongera agaciro.
ART-MU8S4CVX-IEBS.summary: Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yabonye 25% by’imigabane mu mushinga mushya wa tungsten ifatanyijemo na Almonty Industries yanditse ku isoko ry’imari muri Amerika, itanga uburenganzira bwo gushakisha tungsten i Shyorongi n’uruhushya rwo gutunganya amabuye. Mu gihe tungsten yo mu kirombe cya Nyakabingo isanzwe igera ku isoko rya Amerika, ubufatanye bushaka gukusanya no gutunganya umusaruro w’abacukuzi bato no kubaka ubushobozi bwo gutunganya tungsten mu Rwanda mu ruhererekane ruturuka hanze y’u Bushinwa kandi rukurikiranwa. U Rwanda rushaka kongera agaciro kaboneka kuri uyu mutungo binyuze mu bikorwa remezo byo gutunganya, amahame mpuzamahanga y’imiyoborere y’ibidukikije n’imibereho no guhugura abakozi.
ART-MU8S4CVX-IEBS.body:
KIGALI — U Rwanda rurimo kwagura umwanya warwo mu ruhererekane rw’itangwa rya tungsten, imwe mu myunyu ngugu ifite akamaro kanini mu ngamba z’isi, nyuma y’uko Guverinoma ibonye 25% by’imigabane mu mushinga mushya ifatanyijemo na Almonty Industries yanditse ku isoko ry’imari muri Amerika.

Mu masezerano yasinywe ku wa 14 Nzeri, u Rwanda ruzatanga uburenganzira bwo gushakisha tungsten i Shyorongi mu Karere ka Rulindo n’uruhushya rwo gutunganya amabuye y’agaciro, rubone 25% muri Almonty Rwanda. Almonty izagira 75% bisigaye.

Ubu bufatanye bubaye mu gihe ibihugu byo mu Burengerazuba bishaka andi masoko atari u Bushinwa, bugira hafi 82% by’umusaruro wa tungsten ucukurwa ku isi kandi bukaba bugifite uruhare runini cyane mu ruhererekane rwayo.

Tungsten ifite ubukana, uburemere n’ubushobozi bwo kwihanganira ubushyuhe bukabije, kandi ikoreshwa mu bikoresho bya gisirikare, mu by’indege n’isanzure, mu bikoresho bya elegitoroniki no mu mashini z’inganda. Agaciro kayo mu ngamba karushijeho kwiyongera nyuma y’uko u Bushinwa bushyizeho amabwiriza agabanya iyoherezwa ry’ibikoresho n’ikoranabuhanga bimwe bifitanye isano na tungsten.

Ubufatanye bushya bwubakira ku isano y’ubucuruzi isanzwe yaragejeje tungsten y’u Rwanda ku isoko rya Amerika. Mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka, tungsten ivuye mu kirombe cya Nyakabingo cya Trinity Metals yatangiye kugera muri Global Tungsten & Powders (GTP) muri Pennsylvania.

Trinity Metals ivuga ko kugeza muri Kamena hari hamaze koherezwa muri GTP toni zirenga 320 za tungsten nziza ivuye i Nyakabingo. Izo nganda ziyitunganya zikayigira ifu ya tungsten ikoreshwa n’abakiriya bo mu ngabo no mu nganda za Amerika, kandi Trinity yavuze ko ayo matoni ashobora kuba yaragize kugeza kuri 20% bya tungsten y’ibanze ikoreshwa muri Amerika.

Ibi byahaye u Rwanda umwanya udasanzwe ku isoko aho Amerika idafite tungsten icukurwa imbere mu gihugu kandi aho isoko ryayo rishingiye cyane ku Bushinwa. Amasezerano na Almonty ashaka kwagura uruhare rw’u Rwanda kurenga kohereza umusaruro w’ikirombe kimwe.

Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Almonty, Lewis Black, yavuze ko amahirwe yihuse ari mu musaruro usanzwe ukorwa n’abafite impushya z’ubucukuzi buto mu Rwanda, harimo amabuye, pre-concentrate n’ibisigazwa byo mu gutoranya amabuye. Yasobanuye ko amasezerano azatuma uwo musaruro ukusanywa, wongererwa ubwiza kandi woherezwa mu gihe hubakwa uruganda rwo gukusanya no gutunganya.

Black yavuze ko intego ari ugufasha kugabanya icyuho cya tungsten kigenda cyiyongera mu masoko yo mu Burengerazuba, bahuza umusaruro usanzwe n’uburyo bugezweho bwo gutunganya, gukurikirana inkomoko n’ubushakashatsi bwa Almonty, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda na yo ikaba umufatanyabikorwa ufite imigabane.

Almonty Rwanda izashobora kugura amabuye, pre-concentrate n’ibisigazwa by’ubucukuzi ku bafite impushya mu Rwanda. Mu ntangiriro, ibyo bikoresho bishobora koherezwa hanze cyangwa bigatunganyirizwa mu zindi nganda za Almonty mu gihe uruganda rwo mu Rwanda rukiri kubakwa.

Hateganyijwe n’uruganda ruto rwimukanwa ruzakorera by’agateganyo hafi y’ibigega by’ibisigazwa by’ubucukuzi, kugira ngo tungsten y’inyongera ibashe kugarurwa mbere y’uko uruganda runini rwo hagati rwuzura. Mu gihe kirekire, intego ni ukubaka mu Rwanda uruganda rwo gukusanya no gutunganya no gukora ubushakashatsi ku gace ka Shyorongi kangana na kilometero kare hafi 32.

Amasezerano aha u Rwanda imigabane itaziguye mu mushinga aho kuba gusa gutanga uburenganzira cyangwa kugenzura umushoramari w’amahanga. Ibi biha Guverinoma amahirwe yo kubona agaciro kanini ku mutungo u Rwanda rusanzwe rufiteho umwanya ukomeye ku isi.

Ikigo cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika gishinzwe ubushakashatsi ku butaka, USGS, cyashyize u Rwanda ku mwanya wa gatandatu ku isi mu bihugu byacukuraga tungsten nyinshi mu 2024, rufite hafi 1.6% by’umusaruro w’isi. U Rwanda kandi rwari ku mwanya wa gatatu ku isi mu musaruro wa tantalum.

Ariko igice kinini cya tungsten y’u Rwanda gikorwa n’abacukuzi bato, bityo gukusanya umusaruro, kuwugarura neza, gukurikirana inkomoko no gutunganya bikaba ingenzi mu kwagura uru rwego. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Mine, Alice Uwase, yavuze ko ishoramari rizafasha ubucukuzi kurenga ku gukuramo amabuye gusa, rikazana ibikorwa remezo byo gutunganya ku rwego mpuzamahanga, amahame y’ibidukikije n’imibereho ndetse na gahunda yo guhugura Abanyarwanda.

Ubu bufatanye bwahujwe binyuze muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ya Amerika kandi bujyanye na gahunda ya 2025 ya Amerika n’u Rwanda yiswe Framework for Shared Economic Prosperity. Bityo uri mu mugambi mugari wo kubaka uruhererekane rw’amabuye y’agaciro y’ingenzi hagati y’u Rwanda n’amasoko yo mu Burengerazuba.

Kuva ku wa 1 Mutarama 2027, amabwiriza y’Amerika yo kugura ibikoresho bya gisirikare azagura imipaka ku bikoresho bimwe bya tungsten bituruka mu bihugu birebwa n’ayo mabwiriza, agere no ku cyiciro cyo gucukura cyangwa gukora amabuye n’ibikoresho by’ibanze. Ibi bizatuma uruhererekane rukurikiranwa kandi rutava mu Bushinwa rurushaho kugira akamaro.

Ku Rwanda, amahirwe ararenze kugurisha undi mutungo kamere. Igihugu kirashaka kuba ihuriro ry’ingenzi hagati y’umusaruro w’amabuye y’agaciro muri Afurika n’inganda zo mu Burengerazuba zikora ibikoresho bya gisirikare n’ikoranabuhanga rihanitse, no kuba isoko ryizewe kandi rishyize hamwe ry’amabuye y’agaciro ku masoko ashaka kugabanya kwishingikiriza ku Bushinwa.

Ibi byahaye u Rwanda umwanya udasanzwe ku isoko aho Amerika idafite tungsten icukurwa imbere mu gihugu kandi aho isoko ryayo rishingiye cyane ku Bushinwa. Amasezerano na Almonty ashaka kwagura uruhare rw’u Rwanda kurenga kohereza umusaruro w’ikirombe kimwe.

Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Almonty, Lewis Black, yavuze ko amahirwe yihuse ari mu musaruro usanzwe ukorwa n’abafite impushya z’ubucukuzi buto mu Rwanda, harimo amabuye, pre-concentrate n’ibisigazwa byo mu gutoranya amabuye. Yasobanuye ko amasezerano azatuma uwo musaruro ukusanywa, wongererwa ubwiza kandi woherezwa mu gihe hubakwa uruganda rwo gukusanya no gutunganya.

Black yavuze ko intego ari ugufasha kugabanya icyuho cya tungsten kigenda cyiyongera mu masoko yo mu Burengerazuba, bahuza umusaruro usanzwe n’uburyo bugezweho bwo gutunganya, gukurikirana inkomoko n’ubushakashatsi bwa Almonty, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda na yo ikaba umufatanyabikorwa ufite imigabane.

Almonty Rwanda izashobora kugura amabuye, pre-concentrate n’ibisigazwa by’ubucukuzi ku bafite impushya mu Rwanda. Mu ntangiriro, ibyo bikoresho bishobora koherezwa hanze cyangwa bigatunganyirizwa mu zindi nganda za Almonty mu gihe uruganda rwo mu Rwanda rukiri kubakwa.

Hateganyijwe n’uruganda ruto rwimukanwa ruzakorera by’agateganyo hafi y’ibigega by’ibisigazwa by’ubucukuzi, kugira ngo tungsten y’inyongera ibashe kugarurwa mbere y’uko uruganda runini rwo hagati rwuzura. Mu gihe kirekire, intego ni ukubaka mu Rwanda uruganda rwo gukusanya no gutunganya no gukora ubushakashatsi ku gace ka Shyorongi kangana na kilometero kare hafi 32.

Amasezerano aha u Rwanda imigabane itaziguye mu mushinga aho kuba gusa gutanga uburenganzira cyangwa kugenzura umushoramari w’amahanga. Ibi biha Guverinoma amahirwe yo kubona agaciro kanini ku mutungo u Rwanda rusanzwe rufiteho umwanya ukomeye ku isi.

Ikigo cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika gishinzwe ubushakashatsi ku butaka, USGS, cyashyize u Rwanda ku mwanya wa gatandatu ku isi mu bihugu byacukuraga tungsten nyinshi mu 2024, rufite hafi 1.6% by’umusaruro w’isi. U Rwanda kandi rwari ku mwanya wa gatatu ku isi mu musaruro wa tantalum.

Ariko igice kinini cya tungsten y’u Rwanda gikorwa n’abacukuzi bato, bityo gukusanya umusaruro, kuwugarura neza, gukurikirana inkomoko no gutunganya bikaba ingenzi mu kwagura uru rwego. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Mine, Alice Uwase, yavuze ko ishoramari rizafasha ubucukuzi kurenga ku gukuramo amabuye gusa, rikazana ibikorwa remezo byo gutunganya ku rwego mpuzamahanga, amahame y’ibidukikije n’imibereho ndetse na gahunda yo guhugura Abanyarwanda.

Ubu bufatanye bwahujwe binyuze muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ya Amerika kandi bujyanye na gahunda ya 2025 ya Amerika n’u Rwanda yiswe Framework for Shared Economic Prosperity. Bityo uri mu mugambi mugari wo kubaka uruhererekane rw’amabuye y’agaciro y’ingenzi hagati y’u Rwanda n’amasoko yo mu Burengerazuba.

Kuva ku wa 1 Mutarama 2027, amabwiriza y’Amerika yo kugura ibikoresho bya gisirikare azagura imipaka ku bikoresho bimwe bya tungsten bituruka mu bihugu birebwa n’ayo mabwiriza, agere no ku cyiciro cyo gucukura cyangwa gukora amabuye n’ibikoresho by’ibanze. Ibi bizatuma uruhererekane rukurikiranwa kandi rutava mu Bushinwa rurushaho kugira akamaro.

Ku Rwanda, amahirwe ararenze kugurisha undi mutungo kamere. Igihugu kirashaka kuba ihuriro ry’ingenzi hagati y’umusaruro w’amabuye y’agaciro muri Afurika n’inganda zo mu Burengerazuba zikora ibikoresho bya gisirikare n’ikoranabuhanga rihanitse, no kuba isoko ryizewe kandi rishyize hamwe ry’amabuye y’agaciro ku masoko ashaka kugabanya kwishingikiriza ku Bushinwa.

ART-MU8S4DIC-HRMT.title: Uruganda rwa Dangote rutunganya peteroli rwafunguriye abashoramari b’Abanyarwanda
ART-MU8S4DIC-HRMT.subtitle: Abashoramari bato bashobora gutangira ku migabane 10, mu gihe u Rwanda na rwo ruri kuganira ku ishoramari rishoboka mu ruganda runini ruteganywa i Lamu muri Kenya.
ART-MU8S4DIC-HRMT.summary: Abashoramari b’Abanyarwanda, baba abantu ku giti cyabo cyangwa ibigo, bashobora kwitabira IPO ya Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals ifite agaciro ka miliyari 1.63 z’amadolari, yatangiye ku wa 14 Nzeri ikazafungwa ku wa 13 Ukwakira. Ubu buryo bubaha amahirwe yo kugira imigabane mu kigo gifite uruganda rwa Lagos rutunganya ibihumbi 650 bya barrele za peteroli ku munsi, kandi umuntu ashobora gutangirira ku migabane 10. Ku rundi ruhande, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda irimo kuganira ku buryo ishobora kugira imigabane mu ruganda rwa miliyari 16 z’amadolari ruteganywa i Lamu muri Kenya.
ART-MU8S4DIC-HRMT.body:
KIGALI — Abashoramari bo mu Rwanda ubu bashobora gushora imari mu bucuruzi bw’uruganda rwa peteroli rwa Dangote, mu gihe Guverinoma y’u Rwanda na yo irimo gusuzuma ishoramari rishobora kuba rinini cyane mu wundi mushinga w’inganda muri Afurika.

IPO ya Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals yafunguriwe abashoramari bo mu Rwanda ku wa 14 Nzeri kandi izafungwa ku wa 13 Ukwakira. Umushoramari ku giti cye ashobora kwitabira iri soko rya miliyari 1.63 z’amadolari, hafi miliyari 2,400 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda, atangiriye ku migabane 10 gusa, naho ibigo bikaba byashora binyuze muri United Capital Group.

Uruganda rwa Dangote ruri i Lagos ni rumwe mu nganda nini ku isi zitunganya peteroli ku murongo umwe, rukaba rushobora gutunganya barrele 650,000 z’amavuta ya peteroli ku munsi. Rutunganya ibikomoka kuri peteroli n’ibindi bikoresho bya petrochemical nka polypropylene, bityo rukaba umutungo ukomeye w’inganda n’ibyoherezwa mu mahanga.

United Capital ivuga ko iyi IPO ari yo nini kurusha izindi mu mateka y’amasoko y’imari muri Afurika. Umugabane umwe ugura amafaranga y’u Rwanda 589, hafi amadolari 0.40, kandi umubare muto wo kugura ni imigabane 10. Ibi bituma atari ibigo binini n’ibigega by’ishoramari gusa bishobora kwitabira, ahubwo n’abantu ku giti cyabo.

Ejikeme Okoli, Umuyobozi wa United Capital ushinzwe Afurika, yavuze ko iki gikorwa giha abashoramari ku giti cyabo n’ibigo byo mu Rwanda amahirwe yo kugira imigabane itaziguye mu mutungo w’ingufu wo muri Afurika ufite igipimo mpuzamahanga. Ku isoko ry’imari ry’u Rwanda rigikura, ni amahirwe yo gushora mu kigo gikomeye cya Afurika batagombye kwishyiriraho uburyo bwihariye bwo gushora hanze.

Ku rundi ruhande, Perezida Paul Kagame aherutse kwemeza ko u Rwanda ruri kuganira ku buryo rushobora kugira imigabane mu rundi ruganda rwa Dangote ruteganywa i Lamu ku nkombe zo mu majyaruguru ya Kenya, ruzatwara miliyari 16 z’amadolari. Urwo ruganda ruteganywa kuzajya rutunganya barrele zigera ku 700,000 z’amavuta ya peteroli ku munsi, rukaruta gato uruganda rwa Dangote rusanzwe ruri muri Nigeria.

Amakuru yagiye atangazwa avuga ko Dangote ishaka abafatanyabikorwa bo mu karere kandi ko u Rwanda na Uganda bishobora gufatanya kugira 30% by’imigabane. Ingano y’amafaranga u Rwanda rwashora n’amabwiriza y’ayo masezerano ntibiratangazwa.

Kagame yavuze ko u Rwanda rwishimira kuba rwagira uruhare muri iryo shoramari, ariko ko hakiri kare kuvuga ku bisobanuro birambuye kuko ibiganiro n’igenamigambi bikiri gukorwa.

Umushinga wa Lamu ushobora kugira akamaro kanini muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, ahantu hakomeje kwishingikiriza cyane ku bicuruzwa bya peteroli bitumizwa mu mahanga. Uruganda rwa Kenya rwa Mombasa rwahagaritse gutunganya peteroli mbisi mu 2013, naho Uganda irimo kubaka uruganda rwa barrele 60,000 ku munsi i Hoima.

Nirwubakwa, uruganda rwa Lamu ruzongera cyane ubushobozi bwo gutunganya peteroli mu karere kandi rushobora kuba ihuriro rikomeye ry’itangwa ry’ibikomoka kuri peteroli muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Mu gihe Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ikiri gusuzuma uruhare muri uwo mushinga w’ejo hazaza, abashoramari b’Abanyarwanda ku giti cyabo bo batangiye guhabwa amahirwe yo kugira imigabane mu ruganda rusanzwe rukorera muri Nigeria.

ART-MU8S4E4U-SVCC.title: Iyo ibihumbi by’abantu basize imodoka, imihanda ya Kigali ihinduka ahantu ho guteza imbere ubuzima
ART-MU8S4E4U-SVCC.subtitle: Kabiri mu kwezi, imihanda igabanyirizwamo imodoka ihuza siporo, isuzuma ry’ubuzima ku buntu n’ubukangurambaga ku mwuka mwiza.
ART-MU8S4E4U-SVCC.summary: Car Free Day ya Kigali iba kabiri mu kwezi ihindura imihanda minini ahantu ho kugenda n’amaguru, kwiruka, gutwara amagare no gukora imyitozo, kandi igenda iba urubuga rugaragara rw’ubuzima rusange. Abayitabira bahabwa kandi isuzuma ry’indwara zitandura ku bushake kandi ku buntu, hamwe n’inama ku mibereho myiza, bigahuza imyitozo no gukumira indwara. U Rwanda ruri no kwagura igenzura ry’ubuziranenge bw’umwuka, gupima imyuka y’ibinyabiziga no guteza imbere ubwikorezi budahumanya, bigatuma iki gikorwa kigira uruhare mu buzima bwiza no mu mijyi ifite umwuka mwiza.
ART-MU8S4E4U-SVCC.body:
KIGALI — Mu gitondo cyo ku Cyumweru, imwe mu mihanda ya Kigali isanzwe iba irimo urujya n’uruza rwinshi ihindura isura. Imodoka ziragabanuka, imihanda ikuzura abantu biruka, abatwara amagare, imiryango, urubyiruko n’amatsinda akora aerobics n’indi myitozo.

Ibi biterwa na Car Free Day ya Kigali iba kabiri mu kwezi, igikorwa cya siporo rusange kigenda kiba rumwe mu mbuga zigaragara cyane z’ubuzima rusange mu mujyi. Umuhanda usanzwe ukoreshwa gusa mu kugera ahandi uhinduka ahantu ho guhurira ku myitozo, gukumira indwara n’ubusabane bw’abaturage.

Abaturage bo mu turere dutatu twa Kigali bitabira ari benshi, bagakora ibikorwa birimo kugenda n’amaguru, kwiruka, gutwara amagare, aerobics na gymnastics. Muri Kicukiro, Minisitiri wa Siporo Nelly Mukazayire yifatanyije n’urubyiruko n’abandi baturage mu myitozo rusange yatangiriye Sonatube ikarangirira kuri IPRC-Kigali.

Mukazayire yakomeje kugaragaza ko siporo idakwiye gufatwa gusa nk’amarushanwa cyangwa imyidagaduro, ahubwo ikwiye kuba kimwe mu byubakirwaho umuryango ufite ubuzima bwiza. Mu butumwa yabanje gutanga, yavuze ko siporo irenze imyitozo kandi ko ari igikoresho gikomeye cyo kubaka igisekuru gifite ubuzima bwiza, gikora kandi gitanga umusaruro.

Ubu buryo bwo kubibona butuma Car Free Day itaba gusa amasaha make yo kwimura abaturage, ahubwo ikagira intego yo kugira imyitozo igice cy’imibereho ya buri munsi.

Uretse kwiruka, gutwara amagare n’imyitozo y’amatsinda, abaturage bahabwa isuzuma ry’indwara zitandura ku bushake kandi ku buntu, ndetse n’inama ku ngeso nziza za buri munsi. Ibi bituma imihanda iba nk’iyaguwe ry’agateganyo rya serivisi z’ubuzima rusange.

Umuntu ashobora kuza kugenda mu gitondo, maze mbere yo gusubira mu rugo akabona amakuru ku buzima bwe n’ibyo yakora kugira ngo agabanye ibyago byo kurwara. Ibi bifite akamaro mu gihe u Rwanda rushaka guteza imbere imibereho myiza no gukumira indwara zifitanye isano no kudakora imyitozo n’izindi mpamvu z’ibyago.

John Peter Niyigena, umwe mu bitabiriye, yavuze ko igikorwa gitera imbaraga kandi ko cyakomeza mu turere twose Abanyarwanda barushaho kugira ubuzima bwiza. Ibyo bigaragaza kimwe mu byiza bya Car Free Day: ntabwo ari iy’abakinnyi gusa, kuko buri wese ashobora kuyitabira ku muvuduko we, agenda n’inshuti, atwara igare, yiruka cyangwa yifatanya n’imyitozo y’amatsinda.

Car Free Day ifite n’uruhande rw’imibanire. Imihanda ya Kigali isanzwe ihuza abantu n’akazi, amashuri, ubucuruzi n’ingo zabo, ariko kuri uyu munsi iba ahantu hahurira abantu. Imiryango igendana, urubyiruko rugakora imyitozo iruhande rw’abantu bakuru, naho abatwara amagare bagasangira umuhanda n’abiruka.

Umujyi wa Kigali umaze igihe ugaragaza Car Free Day nk’uburyo bwo guhuza imyitozo n’imiryango ifite ubuzima bwiza. Iki gikorwa kandi gifitanye isano no kugabanuka kw’imyuka iva mu binyabiziga mu masaha imodoka ziba zagabanyijwe, kandi ubushakashatsi bwa vuba bwaragisesenguye nk’ingamba zo mu mujyi zishobora kugabanya ihumana ry’umwuka rituruka ku muhanda.

Igitekerezo cy’ubuzima bwiza kirenga imyitozo. Mu gihe Kigali ishishikariza kugenda n’amaguru, amagare no gukoresha ubwikorezi rusange, inakemura ikibazo cy’ubuziranenge bw’umwuka abaturage bahumeka.

Mu kwizihiza Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w’Umwuka Mwiza n’Ijuru ry’Ubururu ku wa 11 Nzeri, Fidèle Bingwa, Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije, yavuze ko ubuziranenge bw’umwuka bushobora gukenera kuzamuka inshuro eshatu cyangwa enye kugira ngo bugere ku rwego rwifuzwa. Yavuze ko umwuka mwiza atari ikinezeza cy’umujyi ugezweho ahubwo ari ikintu cy’ibanze ku bantu bafite ubuzima bwiza no ku bukungu buzima.

U Rwanda rurimo kwagura igenzura ry’ubuziranenge bw’umwuka, gupima imyuka y’ibinyabiziga, guteza imbere ubwikorezi budahumanya, kugenzura inganda no guteza imbere uburyo bwo guteka budahumanya. Ubu igihugu gifite sitasiyo 23 zipima imyuka irimo PM2.5 na PM10.

Bingwa yavuze ko amaherezo umwuka mwiza uzaterwa no guhindura amahitamo ya buri munsi, kuva ku buryo abantu bagenda kugeza ku mikorere y’inganda. Ni yo mpamvu Car Free Day irenze kuba umunsi wa siporo: iyo imihanda ya Kigali yuzuyemo abanyamaguru n’abatwara amagare aho kuba imodoka, umujyi uba werekana ko kugenda mu buryo buzira umuze bishobora no gufasha kugira ibidukikije byo mu mujyi bisukuye.

Impinduka ziza buhoro ariko zifite icyerekezo. Kigali igaragaza iyo nzira ku Cyumweru kimwe cya Car Free, ku mahitamo amwe y’ubuzima bwiza no ku mwuka umwe usukuye. U Rwanda rwizihije Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w’Umwuka Mwiza n’Ijuru ry’Ubururu wa 2026 ku wa 11 Nzeri.

Iki gikorwa kandi gifitanye isano no kugabanuka kw’imyuka iva mu binyabiziga mu masaha imodoka ziba zagabanyijwe, kandi ubushakashatsi bwa vuba bwaragisesenguye nk’ingamba zo mu mujyi zishobora kugabanya ihumana ry’umwuka rituruka ku muhanda.
Igitekerezo cy’ubuzima bwiza kirenga imyitozo. Mu gihe Kigali ishishikariza kugenda n’amaguru, amagare no gukoresha ubwikorezi rusange, inakemura ikibazo cy’ubuziranenge bw’umwuka abaturage bahumeka.

Mu kwizihiza Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w’Umwuka Mwiza n’Ijuru ry’Ubururu ku wa 11 Nzeri, Fidèle Bingwa, Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije, yavuze ko ubuziranenge bw’umwuka bushobora gukenera kuzamuka inshuro eshatu cyangwa enye kugira ngo bugere ku rwego rwifuzwa. Yavuze ko umwuka mwiza atari ikinezeza cy’umujyi ugezweho ahubwo ari ikintu cy’ibanze ku bantu bafite ubuzima bwiza no ku bukungu buzima.

U Rwanda rurimo kwagura igenzura ry’ubuziranenge bw’umwuka, gupima imyuka y’ibinyabiziga, guteza imbere ubwikorezi budahumanya, kugenzura inganda no guteza imbere uburyo bwo guteka budahumanya. Ubu igihugu gifite sitasiyo 23 zipima imyuka irimo PM2.5 na PM10.

Bingwa yavuze ko amaherezo umwuka mwiza uzaterwa no guhindura amahitamo ya buri munsi, kuva ku buryo abantu bagenda kugeza ku mikorere y’inganda. Ni yo mpamvu Car Free Day irenze kuba umunsi wa siporo: iyo imihanda ya Kigali yuzuyemo abanyamaguru n’abatwara amagare aho kuba imodoka, umujyi uba werekana ko kugenda mu buryo buzira umuze bishobora no gufasha kugira ibidukikije byo mu mujyi bisukuye.

Impinduka ziza buhoro ariko zifite icyerekezo. Kigali igaragaza iyo nzira ku Cyumweru kimwe cya Car Free, ku mahitamo amwe y’ubuzima bwiza no ku mwuka umwe usukuye. U Rwanda rwizihije Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w’Umwuka Mwiza n’Ijuru ry’Ubururu wa 2026 ku wa 11 Nzeri.

ART-MU8S4ER5-N1D3.title: Minisiteri y’Uburezi yabujije abanyeshuri 1,097 bafashwe bakopera kongera gukora ibizamini
ART-MU8S4ER5-N1D3.subtitle: Amanota y’ibizamini bya 2025/2026 yagaragaje ko 94.33% batsinze, ariko Minisiteri yafashe umurongo ukomeye wo kurwanya uburiganya mu bizamini.
ART-MU8S4ER5-N1D3.summary: Minisiteri y’Uburezi yatangaje ko abanyeshuri 1,097 bo mu turere 27 bafashwe bakopera mu bizamini bisoza amashuri yisumbuye bya 2025/2026 batazahabwa amahirwe yo kongera kubikora. Abakandida hafi 108,405 bakoze ibizamini, 94.33% baratsinda, bavuye kuri 89.1% umwaka wabanje, nubwo abahungu batsinze ku gipimo kiruta icy’abakobwa. Guverinoma irakaza igenzura ishyiraho abakurikirana ibizamini babiri baturuka ahantu hatandukanye muri buri cyumba kandi ikongera gahunda zo gufasha abanyeshuri mu masomo kugira ngo igabanye impamvu zibatera uburiganya.
ART-MU8S4ER5-N1D3.body:
KIGALI — Guverinoma yafashe umurongo ukomeye ku buriganya mu bizamini, itangaza ko abanyeshuri 1,097 bo mu turere 27 bafashwe bakopera mu bizamini bisoza amashuri yisumbuye bya Senior Six bya 2025/2026 batazahabwa andi mahirwe yo kongera gukora ibizamini.

Icyemezo cyatangajwe ku wa 11 Nzeri ubwo Minisiteri y’Uburezi yashyiraga ahagaragara amanota y’ibizamini bya Leta bisoza amashuri yisumbuye, agaragaza ko 94.33% batsinze, izamuka rikomeye ugereranyije na 89.1% by’umwaka wabanje.

Minisitiri w’Uburezi Joseph Nsengimana yavuze ko abanyeshuri bakoze uburiganya bagomba kubibazwa. Yatandukanyije ikibazo cyabo n’icy’abanyeshuri bo mu mashuri abanza bemerewe kongera gukora ibizamini nyuma y’uko iperereza rigaragaje ko abantu bakuru, harimo abarimu, bari bagize uruhare mu buriganya.

Nsengimana yavuze ko Guverinoma idashaka ko haba umuco wo gukopera cyangwa gufasha undi gukopera umuntu yizeye ko azongera guhabwa ikindi kizamini. Yavuze ko abanyeshuri barangiza amashuri yisumbuye bakuze bihagije kugira ngo bamenye ibyo bakora n’ingaruka zabyo.

Uwo murongo utandukanye n’icyakozwe nyuma y’uburiganya bwagutse bwagaragaye mu bizamini bisoza amashuri abanza bya 2025/2026. Abanyeshuri barenga 7,000 bahawe amahirwe ya kabiri nyuma y’uko iperereza rigaragaje ko abantu bakuru bari bagize uruhare mu gukopera kwabereye mu byumba 254 by’ibizamini.

Nubwo habaye ikibazo cy’uburiganya, amanota rusange y’ibizamini byo mu mashuri yisumbuye yarazamutse cyane. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa NESA, Dr Bernard Bahati, yavuze ko abakandida 108,732 biyandikishije, abakobwa bakaba 55.5% naho abahungu 44.95%.

Muri abo biyandikishije, hafi 108,405 bakoze ibizamini kandi abarenga 102,000 baratsinda. Igipimo cya 94.33% bivuze ko hafi abanyeshuri 19 muri 20 bakoze ibizamini babonye nibura 50% bisabwa kugira ngo batsinde.

Ibi ni iterambere rikomeye ugereranyije n’umwaka wabanje, ubwo 89.1% by’abakandida 106,078 bakoze ibizamini batsinze. Minisiteri yavuze ko yakajije gahunda zo gufasha abanyeshuri kuzuza icyuho cy’imyigire, harimo gufasha abafite ingorane mu masomo amwe.

Icyakora, haracyari itandukaniro hagati y’abahungu n’abakobwa. Abahungu batsinze ku kigero cya 95.9%, naho abakobwa batsinda 93%, nubwo abakobwa ari bo bari benshi mu biyandikishije.

NESA yavuze ko izamuka rusange ry’amanota ryatewe n’imbaraga zo gufasha abanyeshuri binyuze muri gahunda zitandukanye mu mwaka w’amashuri. Guverinoma kandi yashyizeho izindi ngamba zo gukaza igenzura ry’ibizamini.

Mu buryo bushya, buri cyumba cy’ibizamini kizajya kigenerwa abakurikirana ibizamini babiri baturuka ahantu hatandukanye. Intego ni ukugabanya amahirwe yo gufatanya mu buriganya no kongera uburyozwe mu bizamini bya Leta.

Guverinoma kandi irashingira kuri gahunda zo gufasha abanyeshuri mu masomo batumva neza, kuko kutumva isomo bishobora kuba imwe mu mpamvu zituma bamwe bashaka gukopera. Nsengimana yasabye ababyeyi n’abarimu kumenya hakiri kare abanyeshuri bakeneye ubufasha bw’inyongera no kubashyira muri gahunda zibafasha kunoza imyigire.

Ibizamini by’uyu mwaka byanagaragaje abanyeshuri batsinze neza cyane. Manzi Nshuti Kabanda Brave wize Imibare, Ubutabire n’Ibinyabuzima muri Petit Séminaire Saint Aloys mu Karere ka Rusizi yabaye uwa mbere n’amanota 98.40%.

Umwali Deborah wize Amateka, Ubuvanganzo n’Ubushakashatsi bw’Isi muri Cornerstone Leadership Academy i Rwamagana yamukurikiye n’amanota 97.52%. Abatsinze neza ntibahise bahabwa ibihembo ku munsi wo gutangaza amanota.

Minisiteri y’Uburezi izategura undi muhango aho abanyeshuri b’indashyikirwa bazakirwa hamwe n’ababyeyi babo n’abayobozi b’amashuri, bagahabwa ibihembo birimo ibikoresho by’uburezi bisanzwe bigenerwa abatsinze neza.

Ibisubizo bya 2025/2026 bigaragaza ishusho ivanze ariko ikomeye: amanota rusange yarazamutse cyane, ariko Minisiteri ishimangira ko ikizamini cya Leta kitareba ubumenyi gusa ahubwo kinareba ubunyangamugayo, kandi ko gukopera bidakwiye kuba inzira yo kubona andi mahirwe.

ART-MU8S4FDP-8H2L.title: U Rwanda rwafunguye uruganda rw’ibyuma rugamije kugabanya miliyoni 150 z’amadolari akoreshwa ku byo rutumiza hanze
ART-MU8S4FDP-8H2L.subtitle: Uruganda A1 Iron & Steel Rwanda ruteganya ubushobozi bwa toni hafi 250,000 ku mwaka kandi ruzakora ibyuma by’ubwubatsi, imisumari, imiyoboro n’ibindi bikoresho.
ART-MU8S4FDP-8H2L.summary: U Rwanda rwafunguye ku mugaragaro uruganda A1 Iron & Steel Rwanda i Musanze nyuma yo gutumiza hanze ibicuruzwa by’ibyuma birenga miliyoni 150 z’amadolari mu 2025. Uruganda rwatangiye gukora muri Mata 2026 kandi ruteganya gukora toni hafi 250,000 ku mwaka, rutunganya ubutare bwo mu Rwanda rukabugira ibicuruzwa byuzuye, rutanga imirimo igera ku 1,000 kandi rukubaka ubumenyi bw’inganda. Guverinoma n’ikigo bashaka ko uruganda rukora ku bushobozi bwo hejuru, rugakomeza amasoko yo mu gihugu no guhererekanya ikoranabuhanga, mu gihe intego y’igihe kirekire ari ukugurisha mu karere munsi y’icyerekezo “Made in Rwanda, for Africa.”
ART-MU8S4FDP-8H2L.body:
MUSANZE — Mu 2025, u Rwanda rwatumije hanze ibicuruzwa by’ibyuma bifite agaciro karenga miliyoni 150 z’amadolari. Ifungurwa rya A1 Iron & Steel Rwanda Limited i Musanze rigamije gutuma igice kinini cy’ayo mafaranga gisigara mu bukungu bw’igihugu.

Uruganda rwatangiye umusaruro muri Mata 2026 kandi ruteganya ubushobozi bwa toni hafi 250,000 z’ibyuma ku mwaka. Rukora ibyuma bishimangira inyubako, imisumari, imiyoboro n’ibindi bicuruzwa bikoreshwa mu bwubatsi no mu bikorwa remezo.

Minisitiri w’Intebe Justin Nsengiyumva, wafunguye uruganda ku mugaragaro mu Murenge wa Kimonyi, yavuze ko iri shoramari rikwiye gufasha u Rwanda kugabanya kwishingikiriza ku byuma bitumizwa hanze no kubona agaciro kanini ku bikoresho fatizo byarwo. Yavuze ko gutunganya ubutare bwo mu Rwanda bukavamo ibicuruzwa by’ibyuma byuzuye bituma igihugu kizamuka mu ruhererekane rw’agaciro.

Nsengiyumva yavuze ko kubaka uruganda ari intambwe ya mbere gusa, kandi ko gahunda y’inganda igomba kwibanda ku gutuma inganda zikora ku bushobozi bwazo bwose kandi zikazana inyungu z’ubukungu zitezwe. Yibukije ko hari inganda zigeze gukora munsi y’ubushobozi bwateganyijwe, bigatuma igihugu gitakaza umusaruro, imirimo n’agaciro, avuga ko A1 izasabwa urwego ruri hejuru.

Guverinoma iteganya ko ikigo kizagira igipimo kinini cy’imikoreshereze y’uruganda, kongera umusaruro, guha akazi no guhugura Abanyarwanda, guhererekanya ikoranabuhanga no gukorana n’abatanga ibikoresho bo mu gihugu. Inateganya ko uruganda ruzahangana no ku masoko yo hanze y’igihugu.

Guverinoma izafasha ishoramari binyuze mu bikorwa remezo, ingufu, ubumenyi n’amabwiriza, ariko itegereje ko A1 itanga imirimo kandi ikagira uruhare mu iterambere rya Musanze n’ubukungu bw’igihugu muri rusange.

Umuyobozi wa A1 Iron & Steel, Himanshu Tiwari, yavuze ko uruganda rutagamije gusa gusimbuza ibicuruzwa bitumizwa hanze, ahubwo no kuba igice cy’ishingiro ry’inganda rizafasha icyiciro gikurikira cy’iterambere ry’ubukungu bw’u Rwanda. Yavuze ko ibyuma atari ibicuruzwa bisanzwe ahubwo ari inkingi y’iterambere ry’inganda, kandi ko uruganda ruzafasha no gukemura icyuho cy’ubumenyi bwihariye mu nganda.

Ikigo cyubatse uruganda rwuzuye rutunganya ibikoresho birimo ubutare bw’icyuma hifashishijwe uburyo bwa direct reduced iron, hanyuma bigashongeshwa, bigakorwamo billets n’ibindi bicuruzwa bya nyuma.

Ibyuma bikenerwa mu mihanda, ibiraro, inyubako, inganda, ibikorwa remezo by’amashanyarazi n’amazi, ubuhinzi n’amazu. Uko u Rwanda rukomeza gushora imari muri ibi bikorwa, gukora ibyuma mu gihugu bizagabanya kwishingikiriza ku bitumizwa hanze kandi bikomeze uruhererekane rw’inganda zo mu gihugu.

A1 iteganya ko umushinga uzatanga imirimo itaziguye igera ku 1,000, hiyongereyeho imirimo itaziguye mu bucukuzi, ubwikorezi, logistics, gusana, serivisi n’ibindi bikorwa bifasha inganda. Ikigo kandi kirashaka guhugura urubyiruko rw’u Rwanda gukoresha ibikoresho bihanitse, gucunga uburyo bugezweho bw’umusaruro no gukoresha automation.

Ubumenyi buzava muri ibyo bikorwa buzaba inyungu y’igihe kirekire. Kwaguka kw’inganda mu Rwanda kurimo kongera icyifuzo cy’abakozi bafite ubumenyi bwa tekiniki bwari buke mbere, kandi inganda nka A1 zishobora kuba amashuri y’imyuga ku gisekuru gishya cy’abakozi b’inganda.

Tiwari yavuze ko ikigo kizagenda gitangira gukora ibicuruzwa u Rwanda rutumiza hanze, hanyuma kikagura amasoko mu bihugu bituranye. Icyerekezo cyacyo ntikigarukira kuri “Made in Rwanda,” ahubwo ni ukubaka ikirango cy’akarere cya “Made in Rwanda, for Africa.”

Ibi biha uruganda rwa Musanze uruhare muri gahunda yagutse y’u Rwanda yo kongera inganda n’ibyoherezwa mu mahanga aho gukomeza kwishingikiriza ku bicuruzwa by’inganda bitumizwa hanze.

Guverineri w’Intara y’Amajyaruguru, Maurice Mugabowagahunde, yavuze ko uruganda ruzafasha ubukungu bw’aho binyuze mu mirimo, ubumenyi, guhererekanya ikoranabuhanga n’amahirwe y’ubucuruzi ku bigo bito n’ibiciriritse. Yanavuze ko Amajyaruguru afite amateka maremare yo gukora ibyuma, kandi ko bimwe mu bikoresho by’ubucuzi gakondo bibitswe mu nzu ndangamurage iri i Rulindo.

Uruganda rushya rukora ku gipimo gitandukanye cyane n’ubucuzi bwa kera, ariko ruhuza ayo mateka n’inganda zigezweho zigenewe isoko rikura. U Rwanda ubu rufite uruganda rukomeye rw’imbere mu gihugu mu isoko ry’ibyuma rikura; igikurikiraho ni ukugenzura ko ishoramari rikoreshwa neza rikabyara imirimo, ubumenyi, agaciro kongerewe n’ubushobozi bwo guhangana mu karere.

Ubumenyi buzava muri ibyo bikorwa buzaba inyungu y’igihe kirekire. Kwaguka kw’inganda mu Rwanda kurimo kongera icyifuzo cy’abakozi bafite ubumenyi bwa tekiniki bwari buke mbere, kandi inganda nka A1 zishobora kuba amashuri y’imyuga ku gisekuru gishya cy’abakozi b’inganda.

Tiwari yavuze ko ikigo kizagenda gitangira gukora ibicuruzwa u Rwanda rutumiza hanze, hanyuma kikagura amasoko mu bihugu bituranye. Icyerekezo cyacyo ntikigarukira kuri “Made in Rwanda,” ahubwo ni ukubaka ikirango cy’akarere cya “Made in Rwanda, for Africa.”
Ibi biha uruganda rwa Musanze uruhare muri gahunda yagutse y’u Rwanda yo kongera inganda n’ibyoherezwa mu mahanga aho gukomeza kwishingikiriza ku bicuruzwa by’inganda bitumizwa hanze.

Guverineri w’Intara y’Amajyaruguru, Maurice Mugabowagahunde, yavuze ko uruganda ruzafasha ubukungu bw’aho binyuze mu mirimo, ubumenyi, guhererekanya ikoranabuhanga n’amahirwe y’ubucuruzi ku bigo bito n’ibiciriritse. Yanavuze ko Amajyaruguru afite amateka maremare yo gukora ibyuma, kandi ko bimwe mu bikoresho by’ubucuzi gakondo bibitswe mu nzu ndangamurage iri i Rulindo.

Uruganda rushya rukora ku gipimo gitandukanye cyane n’ubucuzi bwa kera, ariko ruhuza ayo mateka n’inganda zigezweho zigenewe isoko rikura. U Rwanda ubu rufite uruganda rukomeye rw’imbere mu gihugu mu isoko ry’ibyuma rikura; igikurikiraho ni ukugenzura ko ishoramari rikoreshwa neza rikabyara imirimo, ubumenyi, agaciro kongerewe n’ubushobozi bwo guhangana mu karere.

ART-MU8S4G09-VVDX.title: U Rwanda rurashaka kugabanya kwishingikiriza ku mashanyarazi y’amazi kuko imigezi yarwo ari mito
ART-MU8S4G09-VVDX.subtitle: Kugabanuka kw’amazi mu mpeshyi kurimo gutuma igihugu cyagura amashanyarazi akomoka ku zuba, methane yo mu Kivu n’andi masoko.
ART-MU8S4G09-VVDX.summary: U Rwanda rurashaka kugabanya kwishingikiriza ku mashanyarazi akomoka ku mazi nyuma y’uko amazi agabanuka mu gihe cy’impeshyi bigabanya umusaruro, rukagura izuba, methane yo mu Kiyaga cya Kivu n’andi masoko. Abayobozi ba REG babwiye Inteko ko imigezi mito n’imiterere y’ubutaka bw’u Rwanda bigabanya ubushobozi bwo kubaka ingomero nini, mu gihe amashanyarazi y’amazi atanga hafi 40% by’amashanyarazi y’igihugu. Guverinoma irateganya kuzamura ubushobozi bwashyizweho buva kuri MW 472 bugera kuri MW 615 muri NST2, ikomeza imishinga ya Nyabarongo II, Rusizi III na IV, methane n’imishinga ihuza amazi n’izuba.
ART-MU8S4G09-VVDX.body:
KIGALI — U Rwanda rurashaka kugabanya kwishingikiriza ku mashanyarazi akomoka ku mazi, rukagura amashanyarazi akomoka ku zuba, methane n’andi masoko, mu gihe kugabanuka kw’amazi gukomeza kugira ingaruka ku musaruro w’amashanyarazi mu gihe cy’impeshyi.

Iki kibazo cyagejejwe mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko ku wa 10 Nzeri, ubwo abasenateri babazaga abayobozi ba Rwanda Energy Group (REG) ku ibura ry’amashanyarazi rikorwa kenshi n’ingaruka rishobora kugira kuri gahunda y’igihugu yo guteza imbere inganda.

Senateri Fulgence Nsengiyumva yavuze ko kwishingikiriza cyane ku mashanyarazi y’amazi bituma sisitemu y’igihugu iba mu kaga iyo amazi agabanutse. Yagarutse ku kuba mu mpeshyi umusaruro waragabanutse ukagera hagati ya MW 200 na 235, abaza niba ibyo bitabangamira gahunda yo gukurura abashoramari bubaka inganda.

Nsengiyumva yashyigikiye impungenge za Senateri Frank Habineza na Penina Uwimbabazi, asaba ko Guverinoma yakoresha cyane izuba, peat na methane kugira ngo amasoko y’ingufu arusheho gutandukana.

Claver Gakwavu, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Energy Utility Corporation Limited (EUCL), ishami rya REG rishinzwe gukwirakwiza amashanyarazi, yavuze ko ihindagurika ry’ikirere n’amapfa bigira uruhare mu kugabanuka kw’amazi no mu kugabanuka k’umusaruro w’amashanyarazi akomoka ku mazi.

Yavuze ko ubushakashatsi bugaragaza ko imigezi y’u Rwanda muri rusange ari mito ku buryo idashobora gutanga amashanyarazi menshi nk’imigezi yo mu bihugu nka Ethiopia, Kenya cyangwa Uganda. Imiterere y’ubutaka na yo igabanya aho ingomero nini zubakwa kubera ingaruka zishobora guterwa ku bidukikije no ku mazi.

Uruzi rwa Rusizi ni rwo rufatwa nk’uruhafite amahirwe menshi yo kongera amashanyarazi y’amazi. Ariko ibibazo byo mu karere byadindije imishinga ihuriweho n’ibihugu bisangiye uru ruzi.

U Rwanda rufite ingomero 37 z’amashanyarazi y’amazi ziri ku muyoboro mugari n’imiyoboro 11 mito itari kuri uwo muyoboro. Byose hamwe bitanga hafi 40% by’amashanyarazi y’igihugu, harimo ingomero nto zishingiye ku mazi atemba n’ingomero nini nka Rusumo ifite MW 80, aho u Rwanda ruhabwa MW 27, na Nyabarongo I ifite MW 28.

Igihugu kirimo no gushora mu kongera ubushobozi bw’amashanyarazi y’amazi. Urugomero rwa Nyabarongo II rufite MW 43.5 rumaze kubakwa hafi 75% kandi ruteganyijwe gutangira gukora mu Kuboza 2027. Uyu mushinga uzanashyiraho ikiyaga gihimbano cya kilometero 67 kizakoreshwa mu kuhira.

Indi mishinga yo mu karere irimo Rusizi III iteganywa kugira MW 147, aho u Rwanda ruzahabwa hafi MW 49, na Rusizi IV ifite MW 287, aho umugabane w’u Rwanda uteganywa kuba hafi MW 95.

REG irashaka kongera amashanyarazi akomoka ku zuba, nubwo imishinga minini ikenera ubutaka bwinshi. Gakwavu yavuze ko gukora MW imwe y’amashanyarazi y’izuba bikenera paneli zifata hafi hegitari imwe.

Methane yo mu Kiyaga cya Kivu na yo iteganywa kugira uruhare runini mu mashanyarazi y’u Rwanda. Igihugu ubu gifite ubushobozi bwashyizweho bwa MW 472, kandi Guverinoma irashaka kubugeza kuri MW 615 mu gihe cy’Icyiciro cya Kabiri cya Gahunda y’Igihugu yo Kwihutisha Iterambere, NST2.

Abaturage bafite amashanyarazi bageze kuri 88.3%, kandi Guverinoma igamije ko bose bayageraho NST2 irangiye. Ariko umusaruro nyakuri uragabanuka mu mpeshyi iyo amashanyarazi y’amazi agabanutse.

Umushinga w’amashanyarazi ukoresha methane yo mu Kiyaga cya Kivu wari uteganyijwe gutanga MW 165 mu mpera za 2029. REG ubu iteganya ko uzatangira gutanga amashanyarazi mu ntangiriro za 2030.

Indi mishinga iteganywa irimo urugomero rwa Muvumba rwa MW 50 mu Karere ka Nyagatare n’umushinga wo ku Nyabarongo uzahuza amashanyarazi y’amazi n’ay’izuba, ukazagira ubushobozi bwa MW 165.

Uku gutandukanya amasoko y’ingufu ni igice cy’umugambi mugari wo kugabanya intege nke z’amashanyarazi ziterwa n’impinduka z’amazi no gukomeza kwagura amashanyarazi yizewe ku ngo no ku nganda.

ART-MU8S4GMN-SSZU.title: Minisitiri w’Ubuzima yatangiye urugendo mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo rwo gusuzuma serivisi z’ubuzima n’imibereho myiza y’urubyiruko
ART-MU8S4GMN-SSZU.subtitle: Yasuye ibigo n’amavuriro byo muri Nyanza, aganira n’abajyanama b’ubuzima kandi asaba abanyeshuri gukora imyitozo no kwirinda ibiyobyabwenge n’ibindi byangiza ubuzima.
ART-MU8S4GMN-SSZU.summary: Minisitiri w’Ubuzima Dr Sabin Nsanzimana yatangiye urugendo rw’iminsi ibiri mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo rwo gusuzuma ubuziranenge bwa serivisi z’ubuzima ku rwego rw’ibanze n’urwa kabiri. Muri Nyanza yasuye ibigo by’ubuzima n’abajyanama b’ubuzima, ashimangira ko serivisi zegerejwe abaturage zagabanyije ingendo kugera ku minota 45 kandi zigakemura kugeza kuri 95% by’ubuvuzi bukenewe. Yanahuye n’abanyeshuri batangiye umwaka mushya w’amashuri, abasaba gukora imyitozo, kwirinda ibiyobyabwenge, itabi, vape n’inzoga no kudakurikira igitutu kibi cy’urungano.
ART-MU8S4GMN-SSZU.body:
Minisitiri w’Ubuzima, Dr Sabin Nsanzimana, yatangiye urugendo rw’akazi rw’iminsi ibiri mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo rugamije gusuzuma ibigo bitanga serivisi z’ubuzima ku rwego rw’ibanze n’urwa kabiri.

Mu Karere ka Nyanza, yasuye Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Nyamiyaga, Poste de Santé za Gati na Gasoro, ndetse n’Ibitaro by’Akarere ka Nyanza. Ibi bigo bifasha abaturage kubona serivisi kuva ku buvuzi bw’ibanze kugeza ku buvuzi bwihariye.

Abajyanama b’ubuzima, Poste de Santé n’ibigo nderabuzima byagize uruhare runini mu kwegereza abaturage serivisi, bigabanya igihe cy’urugendo kugera ku minota 45 kandi bigakemura kugeza kuri 95% by’ubuvuzi bukenewe.

Nsanzimana yavuze ko uruzinduko ari umwanya w’ingenzi wo gusuzuma ubuziranenge bwa serivisi no kuganira n’abakozi bo ku murongo wa mbere, by’umwihariko Abajyanama b’Ubuzima. Yabise inkingi y’ubuzima mu Rwanda, ashimangira ko ubuvuzi bwiza bwegerejwe abaturage bukomeza kuba ku isonga ry’ibyihutirwa.

Muri Nyanza, Minisitiri yanahuye n’abanyeshuri bo mu mashuri atandukanye bizihizaga intangiriro y’umwaka mushya w’amashuri. Nyuma y’umukino wa volleyball wa gicuti, yasabye urubyiruko kurinda ubuzima rukora imyitozo kandi rukirinda ibiyobyabwenge, itabi, vape n’inzoga.

Yibukije abanyeshuri ko ibyo bintu bishobora kubangamira imikurire y’ubwonko no gutera indwara zidakira. Yababwiye ko bafite umubiri umwe gusa, abasaba kwanga igitutu kibi cy’urungano no gufata amahitamo ari ishoramari ry’igihe kirekire kuri bo, imiryango yabo n’igihugu.

Abahanzi DJ Ira, Nel Ngabo na Tom Close na bo bitabiriye igikorwa, baririmbira abanyeshuri kandi bashimangira ubutumwa bwo kwirinda ibiyobyabwenge n’inzoga no kwibanda ku masomo.

Urugendo rwa Minisitiri Nsanzimana mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo ruzakomeza bukeye mu Karere ka Huye.

ART-MU8S4H91-4K5G.title: Kagame ari mu Bufaransa mu Nama Mpuzamahanga ya mbere ku Isanzure
ART-MU8S4H91-4K5G.subtitle: Inama ibera i Paris iraganira ku mutekano n’imikoreshereze irambye y’isanzure, ubukungu bwo mu isanzure, amategeko n’ubushakashatsi bwa siyansi.
ART-MU8S4H91-4K5G.summary: Perezida Paul Kagame ari i Paris mu Nama Mpuzamahanga ya mbere ku Isanzure ibera muri Grand Palais ku wa 9–10 Nzeri. Intumwa z’amahanga hafi 120 n’abantu bagera ku 2,000 biteganyijwe kuganira ku mutekano mu isanzure, ubukungu bwo mu isanzure, amategeko n’imiyoborere, n’ubushakashatsi kuva hafi y’Isi kugera ku Kwezi na Mars, kandi hateganyijwe amatangazo ya politiki n’ay’ubucuruzi. U Rwanda rwaguriye ibikorwa byarwo byo mu isanzure kuva rwashingira Rwanda Space Agency mu 2020 no kwinjira mu masezerano ya Artemis mu 2022, mu gihe Kagame yanahuye n’Umuyobozi Mukuru wa UNESCO ku bufatanye mu burezi, siyansi, umurage n’ububiko bw’amateka.
ART-MU8S4H91-4K5G.body:
PARIS — Perezida Paul Kagame ari i Paris mu Nama Mpuzamahanga ya mbere ku Isanzure yakiriwe na Perezida w’u Bufaransa Emmanuel Macron, mu gihe ibihugu bishaka amategeko mashya n’ubufatanye mu bukungu bwo mu isanzure bugenda burushaho kugira akamaro.

Inama y’iminsi ibiri ibera muri Grand Palais ku wa 9–10 Nzeri yahuje intumwa z’amahanga hafi 120, harimo abakuru b’ibihugu na za guverinoma, ba minisitiri, abayobozi b’ibigo by’isanzure, abahanga, abagenzi bo mu isanzure, abasirikare, ibigo byigenga n’imiryango mpuzamahanga. Hateganyijwe abantu hafi 2,000.

Ibiganiro byibanda ku ngingo enye: umutekano n’imikoreshereze irambye y’inzira zo mu isanzure, ubukungu bwo mu isanzure bugenda bwiyongera, amategeko n’imiyoborere, n’ubushakashatsi bwa siyansi kuva hafi y’Isi kugera ku Kwezi na Mars.

U Bufaransa burimo gukoresha iyi nama mu guteza imbere ibiganiro bya politiki n’ubufatanye mu by’isanzure. Biteganyijwe ko hazavamo amatangazo ya politiki n’ay’ubucuruzi, aho kuba amasezerano mpuzamahanga ategeka ibihugu kuyubahiriza.

Kagame ari mu bayobozi ba Afurika bitabiriye, kandi Perezida wa Repubulika ya Congo Denis Sassou-Nguesso na we ateganyijwe kwitabira.

U Rwanda rwashinze Rwanda Space Agency mu 2020 kandi rwinjira mu masezerano ya Artemis mu 2022. Rwanakoranye n’akanama ka Loni gashinzwe Imikoreshereze y’Amahoro y’Isanzure.

Igihugu kigenda kirushaho kwibanda ku gukoresha ikoranabuhanga ryo mu isanzure mu iterambere rifatika. Ikoranabuhanga rishingiye ku byogajuru rirakoreshwa cyangwa ririmo kwigwa mu buhinzi, itumanaho, uburezi, ubuzima no gutabara mu biza.

U Rwanda kandi rufite satellite teleport i Rwamagana, iri mu bikorwa byo kubaka ubushobozi mu nzego zikura z’isanzure n’ikoranabuhanga rya digitale.

Mbere yo kwitabira inama, Kagame yahuye ku wa Gatatu nyuma ya saa sita i Paris n’Umuyobozi Mukuru wa UNESCO, Khaled El-Enany. Baganiriye ku bufatanye bw’u Rwanda na UNESCO mu burezi, siyansi n’ikoranabuhanga, umurage w’umuco no kubungabunga urwibutso.

Ubufatanye n’UNESCO burenga uburezi na siyansi. U Rwanda rufite ahantu habiri ku rutonde rw’Umurage w’Isi wa UNESCO, hombi hashyizweho mu 2023: Pariki y’Igihugu ya Nyungwe n’ahantu ho kwibuka Jenoside i Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero.

UNESCO kandi ikorana n’u Rwanda na Aegis Trust mu kongera uruhare rw’uburezi rw’inzibutso za Jenoside. Gahunda ikubiyemo guhugura abarimu n’abayobora inzibutso, gukora ibikoresho by’uburezi no kunoza imurikagurisha, kandi igamije guteza imbere ibiganiro hagati y’ibisekuru no kubungabunga izo nyubako ku bazazikurikira.

Ibiganiro na UNESCO byabaye mu gihe u Bufaransa bushaka kongera uruhare rw’u Burayi mu isanzure hagati y’ihangana rikomeye rya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’u Bushinwa. U Budage bufatanya kwakira inama nubwo Chancelier Friedrich Merz atitabiriye, naho Perezida wa Komisiyo y’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi Ursula von der Leyen ateganyijwe kwitabira ku wa Kane.

Ibigo bikomeye byigenga byo mu isanzure birimo SpaceX na Blue Origin byavuye mu nama, mu gihe u Bushinwa buteganyijwe guhagararirwa.

Ibiganiro byibanda ku ngingo enye: umutekano n’imikoreshereze irambye y’inzira zo mu isanzure, ubukungu bwo mu isanzure bugenda bwiyongera, amategeko n’imiyoborere, n’ubushakashatsi bwa siyansi kuva hafi y’Isi kugera ku Kwezi na Mars.

U Bufaransa burimo gukoresha iyi nama mu guteza imbere ibiganiro bya politiki n’ubufatanye mu by’isanzure. Biteganyijwe ko hazavamo amatangazo ya politiki n’ay’ubucuruzi, aho kuba amasezerano mpuzamahanga ategeka ibihugu kuyubahiriza.
Kagame ari mu bayobozi ba Afurika bitabiriye, kandi Perezida wa Repubulika ya Congo Denis Sassou-Nguesso na we ateganyijwe kwitabira.
U Rwanda rwashinze Rwanda Space Agency mu 2020 kandi rwinjira mu masezerano ya Artemis mu 2022. Rwanakoranye n’akanama ka Loni gashinzwe Imikoreshereze y’Amahoro y’Isanzure.

Igihugu kigenda kirushaho kwibanda ku gukoresha ikoranabuhanga ryo mu isanzure mu iterambere rifatika. Ikoranabuhanga rishingiye ku byogajuru rirakoreshwa cyangwa ririmo kwigwa mu buhinzi, itumanaho, uburezi, ubuzima no gutabara mu biza.
U Rwanda kandi rufite satellite teleport i Rwamagana, iri mu bikorwa byo kubaka ubushobozi mu nzego zikura z’isanzure n’ikoranabuhanga rya digitale.

Mbere yo kwitabira inama, Kagame yahuye ku wa Gatatu nyuma ya saa sita i Paris n’Umuyobozi Mukuru wa UNESCO, Khaled El-Enany. Baganiriye ku bufatanye bw’u Rwanda na UNESCO mu burezi, siyansi n’ikoranabuhanga, umurage w’umuco no kubungabunga urwibutso.

Ubufatanye n’UNESCO burenga uburezi na siyansi. U Rwanda rufite ahantu habiri ku rutonde rw’Umurage w’Isi wa UNESCO, hombi hashyizweho mu 2023: Pariki y’Igihugu ya Nyungwe n’ahantu ho kwibuka Jenoside i Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero.

UNESCO kandi ikorana n’u Rwanda na Aegis Trust mu kongera uruhare rw’uburezi rw’inzibutso za Jenoside. Gahunda ikubiyemo guhugura abarimu n’abayobora inzibutso, gukora ibikoresho by’uburezi no kunoza imurikagurisha, kandi igamije guteza imbere ibiganiro hagati y’ibisekuru no kubungabunga izo nyubako ku bazazikurikira.

Ibiganiro na UNESCO byabaye mu gihe u Bufaransa bushaka kongera uruhare rw’u Burayi mu isanzure hagati y’ihangana rikomeye rya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’u Bushinwa. U Budage bufatanya kwakira inama nubwo Chancelier Friedrich Merz atitabiriye, naho Perezida wa Komisiyo y’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi Ursula von der Leyen ateganyijwe kwitabira ku wa Kane.
Ibigo bikomeye byigenga byo mu isanzure birimo SpaceX na Blue Origin byavuye mu nama, mu gihe u Bushinwa buteganyijwe guhagararirwa.

ART-MU8S4HVD-OPYJ.title: U Rwanda rwashyikirije Gabon umudepite nyuma y’ikirego cy’ihohoterwa ku mukozi wa RwandAir ku kibuga cy’indege
ART-MU8S4HVD-OPYJ.subtitle: Augustin Lobelle Yembi yashyikirijwe Gabon nyuma y’ibiganiro bya dipolomasi, kandi urubanza ruzakomeza gukurikiranwa n’inzego z’ubutabera za Gabon.
ART-MU8S4HVD-OPYJ.summary: U Rwanda rwashyikirije Gabon umudepite Augustin Lobelle Yembi wari warafatiwe ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege cya Kigali akekwaho guhohotera umukozi mukuru wa RwandAir. Yembi yafashwe ku wa 3 Nzeri, yemererwa kuva mu Rwanda ku wa 6 Nzeri, maze ageze muri Gabon na ho ashyirwa mu maboko ya polisi kugira ngo ikibazo gikomeze gukurikiranwa. Guverinoma zombi zagaragaje ko iyoherezwa rye ryabaye mu rwego rw’umubano mwiza hagati y’ibihugu byombi, mu gihe Inteko ya Gabon itegereje inyandiko y’ubutabera mbere yo gufata umwanzuro ku budahangarwa bwe nk’umudepite.
ART-MU8S4HVD-OPYJ.body:
KIGALI — U Rwanda rwashyikirije Guverinoma ya Gabon umudepite w’icyo gihugu wari warafatiwe ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege cya Kigali akekwaho guhohotera umukozi mukuru wa RwandAir.

Augustin Lobelle Yembi yafashwe ku wa 3 Nzeri ubwo yari anyura i Kigali. Yashinjwaga gukorera urugomo umukozi mukuru wa RwandAir ku kibuga cy’indege, ashyirwa mu maboko ya polisi ategereje kuburanishwa mu nkiko z’u Rwanda.

Nyuma y’iminsi mike afunzwe, u Rwanda rwamwemereye kuva mu gihugu ku wa 6 Nzeri maze rumushyikiriza inzego za Gabon. Ikibazo kizakomeza gukurikiranwa muri Gabon.

Perezida w’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Gabon, Michel Régis Onanga Ndiaye, yatangaje iyoherezwa rya Yembi mu nama y’ubuyobozi bw’Inteko yabereye muri Palais Léon Mba i Libreville. Yavuze ko ibiganiro bya dipolomasi hagati y’ibihugu byombi ari byo byatumye haboneka icyo gisubizo.

Abayobozi ba Gabon bavuze ko umubano wa hafi hagati ya Perezida Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema na Perezida Paul Kagame wagize uruhare muri icyo cyemezo. Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga wa Gabon, Marie-Édith Tassyla-Ye-Doumbeneny, na we yavuze ku wa 7 Nzeri ko u Rwanda rwemereye Yembi kugenda kubera ubucuti n’umubano mwiza w’ibihugu byombi.

Iki kibazo nticyahindutse amakimbirane ya dipolomasi mu ruhame. Ahubwo guverinoma zombi zahisemo igisubizo cya dipolomasi cyimuye ikibazo kiva mu Rwanda kijya muri Gabon.

Ibisobanuro birambuye ku byabereye ku kibuga cy’indege biracyari bike. Abayobozi ba Gabon bemeje ko Yembi akekwaho urugomo ku mukozi mukuru wa RwandAir, ariko nta bisobanuro birambuye byatangajwe ku cyateye amakimbirane cyangwa niba uwo mukozi yarakomeretse.

Amashusho yakwirakwijwe kuri internet asa n’agaragaza Yembi ahanganye n’umukozi wa RwandAir, ariko uko ikibazo cyatangiye n’ibyari bikikije ntibirasobanuka. Ibisobanuro bya Yembi ubwe na byo ntibyatangajwe cyane.

Gusubira muri Gabon ntibisobanura ko yabaye umwere cyangwa ngo ahite arekurwa. Amakuru ava i Libreville avuga ko nyuma yo kuhagera ku wa Kabiri tariki 8 Nzeri yahise ashyirwa mu maboko ya polisi, kandi ubu ikibazo kiri mu bubasha bw’inzego za Gabon.

Inteko Ishinga Amategeko na yo irimo gusuzuma uko umwanya we nk’umudepite ushobora kugira ingaruka ku rubanza. Yembi yatorewe mu 2025 nk’umudepite wigenga uhagarariye Lolo-Bouenguidi mu Ntara ya Ogooué-Lolo.

Amategeko y’Inteko ya Gabon aha abadepite ubudahangarwa bumwe mu manza nshinjabyaha. Inteko itegereje inyandiko yemewe y’inzego z’ubutabera mbere yo gufata umwanzuro niba hari igikwiye gukorwa ku budahangarwa bwe.

Bityo ikibazo kiracyafunguye; icyahindutse ni igihugu kizagikurikirana.

Iyoherezwa rya Yembi rinagaragaza umubano ugenda urushaho kuba hafi hagati ya Kigali na Libreville. Gabon yafunguye ambasade mu Rwanda mu 2024, kandi abakuru b’ibihugu byombi bahuriye i Kigali muri Gicurasi 2026 ku ruhande rw’inama ya Africa CEO Forum.

Abayobozi ba Gabon bakunze kuvuga ko umubano n’u Rwanda ukomeye, kandi uwo mubano ni wo watanze umuyoboro wa dipolomasi wo gukemura ikibazo cyabereye ku kibuga cy’indege. Nta kimenyetso mu nkuru kigaragaza ko ikibazo cyangije umubano w’ibihugu byombi; ahubwo guverinoma zombi zashimangiye imbaraga z’uwo mubano.

Igisubizo kandi cyirinze ikibazo kidasanzwe aho umudepite uri ku mirimo wo muri Afurika yari kuburanishirizwa mu kindi gihugu cya Afurika kubera ikibazo gifitanye isano n’ikompanyi y’indege y’igihugu.

Ku Rwanda, ikirego cy’ihohoterwa ntikizongera gukurikiranwa ku butaka bwarwo. Ku Gabon, ubutabera bw’icyo gihugu ni bwo bugomba gufata umwanzuro ku bizakurikiraho. Dipolomasi yarangije ikibazo cy’amategeko cya Yembi mu Rwanda, ariko urubanza ntirwarangiye; ubu ari muri Gabon mu maboko y’abayobozi b’icyo gihugu.

ART-MU8S4IHZ-ZG31.title: Perezida Kagame yageze muri Oman mu ruzinduko rw’iminsi ibiri
ART-MU8S4IHZ-ZG31.subtitle: Mu ruzinduko rwe rwa mbere muri Oman, Kagame araganira na Sultan Haitham bin Tariq ku kwagura ubufatanye mu bucuruzi, ishoramari, ingufu, ubwikorezi bwo mu kirere, logistics n’ikoranabuhanga.
ART-MU8S4IHZ-ZG31.summary: Perezida Paul Kagame yageze i Salalah ku wa 7 Nzeri mu ruzinduko rw’iminsi ibiri no mu biganiro na Sultan Haitham bin Tariq, bikaba ari ubwa mbere asuye Oman. Ibihugu byombi biherutse kwagura ubufatanye mu guteza imbere ibibuga by’indege, logistics, data centres, cloud computing na AI, kandi u Rwanda rutangiye kugura lisansi mu buryo butaziguye na OQ Trading ya Oman ndetse hari n’indege za Muscat-Kigali. Urugendo ruteganyijwemo amasezerano mashya n’ibiganiro ku ngufu, ingufu zisubira, ubucukuzi, amahoteli n’ubukerarugendo, ubuzima, uburezi n’ibibazo byo mu karere no ku isi.
ART-MU8S4IHZ-ZG31.body:
Perezida Paul Kagame yageze muri Oman mu ruzinduko rwe rwa mbere muri icyo gihugu cyo mu Kigobe, atangira ibiganiro by’iminsi ibiri na Sultan Haitham bin Tariq mu gihe u Rwanda rushaka gushimangira umubano ugenda wubakira ku bucuruzi, ishoramari, umutekano w’ingufu no guhuza ibihugu.

Kagame yageze i Salalah ku wa Mbere, tariki 7 Nzeri 2026, yakirwa na Sultan Haitham muri Al Hosn Palace mu muhango wemewe. Urugendo ruzarangira ku wa Kabiri kandi hateganyijwe gusinywa amasezerano mashya y’ubufatanye.

Nubwo ibihugu byombi byashyizeho umubano wa dipolomasi mu 1982, imikoranire yarushijeho kwihuta mu myaka ya vuba, guverinoma zombi zishaka ubufatanye bufatika mu by’indege, logistics, ikoranabuhanga, ibikorwa remezo n’ingufu.

Urugendo rwa Perezida rukurikira urwa Mutarama rwa Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga n’Ubutwererane, Olivier Nduhungirehe, wayoboye intumwa nkuru y’u Rwanda muri Oman. Ibiganiro byavuyemo ibikorwa byo gukorana mu guteza imbere ibibuga by’indege, logistics n’ibyambu byo ku butaka, data centres, cloud computing n’ubwenge buhangano.

Rimwe mu masezerano ryahuje Rwanda Development Board na Oman Airports Management Company kugira ngo bishake amahirwe y’ishoramari n’ubufatanye mu bikorwa remezo by’indege.

Umubano warushijeho kugira agaciro mu ngamba binyuze mu bufatanye ku ngufu. U Rwanda rwatangiye kujya ku buryo bwo kugura lisansi mu buryo bwa guverinoma ku yindi guverinoma muri OQ Trading ya Oman, kandi imizigo minini ya mbere iri kugera mu gihugu inyuze ku Cyambu cya Tanga muri Tanzania.

Ubu buryo bugamije kongera umutekano w’itangwa rya lisansi no kunoza logistics, ihiganwa n’ituze ry’ibiciro. Umuzigo wa mbere uteganyijwe kuba hafi toni 40,000, hanyuma hakajya habaho gutanga lisansi buri gihe.

Ku Rwanda, ubufatanye na Oman burenze gukurura ishoramari; bunafasha kubona umuyoboro wizewe mu ruhererekane rw’ingenzi cyane rw’ibikomoka kuri peteroli.

Guhuza ibihugu na byo byarushijeho kuba byiza. Muri Nyakanga, SalamAir yatangije indege zitaziguye Muscat-Kigali kabiri mu cyumweru, biteganyijwe ko zizoroshya urujya n’uruza rw’abashoramari, abacuruzi na ba mukerarugendo hagati ya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba n’akarere k’Ikigobe.

Izo ndege zakurikiye amasezerano ya Air Services Agreement yasinywe mu 2023 agatangira gukurikizwa muri Mutarama 2026.

Uretse indege, ikoranabuhanga na lisansi, u Rwanda na Oman birimo gushaka amahirwe mu ngufu, ingufu zisubira, ubucukuzi, logistics, amahoteli n’ubukerarugendo, ubuzima n’uburezi.

Mu 2020, ibigo byo muri Oman birenga 80 byitabiriye imurikagurisha ry’ibicuruzwa bya Oman i Kigali, aho hasinywe amasezerano abiri y’ubucuruzi, harimo ayo kwamamaza ibicuruzwa by’inganda bya Oman mu Rwanda.

Intumwa ya Kagame irimo Nduhungirehe, Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi Yusuf Murangwa, Minisitiri w’Ubucuruzi n’Inganda Antoine Kajangwe n’abandi bayobozi bakuru.

Ku Rwanda, umubano ukomeye na Oman utanga indi nzira igana ku masoko yo mu Kigobe no mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati. Ku Oman, u Rwanda rutanga umuryango winjira mu bukungu bwa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba bwishyize ku mwanya w’ihuriro ry’ubucuruzi, logistics n’ishoramari.

Imikoranire ya politiki na yo yakomeje kwiyongera. Muri Nyakanga, Kagame yakiriye Ambasaderi mushya wa Oman mu Rwanda Nasra Salim Al Hashmi, naho muri Kanama Sultan Haitham yoherereza Kagame ubutumwa ku mubano w’ibihugu byombi.

Abayobozi bombi biteganyijwe no kungurana ibitekerezo ku bibazo byo mu karere no ku isi, harimo ibireba Ikigobe, Afurika n’umutekano mpuzamahanga.

Mu gihe cy’urugendo, Kagame ateganyijwe gusura Land of Frankincense Museum na Razat Royal Farm muri Dhofar. Sultan Haitham azakira Perezida w’u Rwanda n’intumwa ze ku ifunguro rya nimugoroba, kandi amwakire ukwe ku ifunguro rya saa sita muri Al-Mamurah Palace.

Mu gihe indege zitaziguye zihuza Kigali na Muscat, amasezerano mashya y’ubukungu akomeje kwiyongera kandi Oman ikaba isoko rya lisansi y’u Rwanda, umubano uri kwinjira mu cyiciro aho agaciro kawo kazagenda gapimwa cyane n’ibisubizo bifatika.
