Abayobozi bombi biteganyijwe no kungurana ibitekerezo ku bibazo byo mu karere no ku isi, harimo ibireba Ikigobe, Afurika n’umutekano mpuzamahanga.

Mu gihe cy’urugendo, Kagame ateganyijwe gusura Land of Frankincense Museum na Razat Royal Farm muri Dhofar. Sultan Haitham azakira Perezida w’u Rwanda n’intumwa ze ku ifunguro rya nimugoroba, kandi amwakire ukwe ku ifunguro rya saa sita muri Al-Mamurah Palace.

Mu gihe indege zitaziguye zihuza Kigali na Muscat, amasezerano mashya y’ubukungu akomeje kwiyongera kandi Oman ikaba isoko rya lisansi y’u Rwanda, umubano uri kwinjira mu cyiciro aho agaciro kawo kazagenda gapimwa cyane n’ibisubizo bifatika.

ART-MU8S4J4I-UDQP.title: One Acre Fund ishyira umuhinzi ku isonga rya gahunda nshya yo guteza imbere ubuhinzi mu Rwanda
ART-MU8S4J4I-UDQP.subtitle: Gahunda ihuza imbuto, ifumbire ku nguzanyo, ubwishingizi, ubujyanama n’isoko kugira ngo umusaruro mwinshi uhinduke amafaranga arambye ku bahinzi.
ART-MU8S4J4I-UDQP.summary: One Acre Fund irashaka kugabanya imbogamizi abahinzi bo mu Rwanda bahura na zo iyo bagomba gushaka imbuto, ifumbire, inguzanyo n’isoko ahantu hatandukanye, ikabahuza muri gahunda imwe. Igerageza ryakorewe i Kirehe hamwe na Rwanda Agriculture Board ryazamuye umusaruro w’ibigori uva kuri toni hafi 1.1 ukagera hejuru ya toni 2.6 kuri hegitari, ariko muri hegitari miliyoni 1.3 z’ubutaka buhingwa mu Rwanda, hafi 75,000 gusa ni zo zibona ubu buryo bwuzuye. Abitabiriye Africa Food Systems Forum bavuze ko ubuzima bw’ubutaka, serivisi z’imashini ziyobowe n’abikorera, imari irambye n’amasoko yizewe bigomba gukorana kugira ngo umusaruro mwinshi uhinduke inyungu irambye ku bahinzi n’ibikoresho byizewe ku nganda.
ART-MU8S4J4I-UDQP.body:
KIGALI — Abahinzi bo mu Rwanda bamaze igihe bakorera muri sisitemu itatanye: imbuto z’indobanure zikava ahantu hamwe, ifumbire ahandi, inguzanyo na yo ahandi. Ku muhinzi, izi mbogamizi akenshi ntiziza ukwazo; ziza zose icyarimwe.

Nubwo umuhinzi yabona imbuto nziza, kutabona ifumbire ihendutse cyangwa isoko ryizewe bishobora kumubuza kubona inyungu. One Acre Fund irashaka kugabanya izo mbogamizi ishyira mu bikorwa uburyo buhuza serivisi zitandukanye mu murongo umwe.

Mu kiganiro cyabereye ku ruhande rwa Africa Food Systems Forum i Kigali, Raïssa Muhaturukundo, Chief of Staff wa One Acre Fund Rwanda, yavuze ko abahinzi ari ba rwiyemezamirimo bakora mu bihe by’ubuhinzi bigengwa n’igihe. Yavuze ko gushakisha ibikoresho, inama za tekiniki n’amasezerano yo kugurisha umusaruro ahantu hatandukanye bitera gutinda n’ibindi bibazo, mu gihe serivisi zihuriwe hamwe zibafasha kwibanda ku kubaka ubuhinzi bubaha inyungu.

Uburyo bwa One Acre Fund buhuza imbuto z’indobanure, ifumbire ku nguzanyo, ubwishingizi bw’imyaka, ubujyanama mu buhinzi n’isoko. Intego ni ugufasha umuhinzi mu byiciro byose by’umusaruro aho gukemura ikibazo kimwe gusa.

Muhaturukundo yavuze ko intego nini ari gufasha abahinzi kubona ubuhinzi atari gusa uburyo bwo kubona ibiribwa, ahubwo nk’igikorwa cy’ubukungu gishobora kubaha amafaranga arambye.

Yatanze urugero rw’igerageza ryakorewe mu Karere ka Kirehe ku bufatanye na Rwanda Agriculture Board. Abahinzi bahawe ibikoresho by’indobanure, amahugurwa ngiro, ubujyanama bwa tekiniki n’uburyo bwo kugera ku masoko, maze umusaruro w’ibigori uzamuka uva kuri toni hafi 1.1 ukagera hejuru ya toni 2.6 kuri hegitari.

Muhaturukundo yavuze ko ibyo byerekana akamaro ko guhuza ibikorwa, Leta n’abandi bakora mu buhinzi bagashyira hamwe imbaraga zabo kugira ngo bahabwe igisubizo cyuzuye. Igerageza rya Kirehe ryerekanye ibishoboka iyo ubufatanye bukora neza, ariko kugera ku rwego runini ni indi mbogamizi.

U Rwanda rufite hegitari miliyoni 1.3 z’ubutaka bushobora guhingwa, ariko hafi hegitari 75,000 gusa ni zo ubu zibona ubu buryo bwuzuye bwo gukora. Mu Gihembwe A cya 2024, ubuhinzi bwahawe 6% gusa by’inguzanyo z’ubucuruzi, hasi y’intego ya Guverinoma ya 10% mu 2029.

Iyi mibare igaragaza ko gutanga ibikoresho byinshi ku bahinzi gusa bitaba bihagije. Dr Sunita Piamber, Chief Operating Officer wa Oath Africa, yavuze ko ibikorwa byo kongera umusaruro bigomba no kujyana n’imiterere y’umurima, cyane cyane ubuzima bw’ubutaka.

Yavuze ko umusaruro ari icyihutirwa gikomeye ku muhinzi ariko ugikomeje kuba ikibazo, kandi ko hakenewe uburyo buhuza ibintu byose bugashyira ubuzima bw’ubutaka ku isonga ry’imikorere y’ubuhinzi.

Esperance Mukarugwiza, Signature Program Technical Lead muri Heifer International, yavuze ko imishinga yo hambere rimwe na rimwe yagize ingorane kuko hatangwaga imashini ariko nta bikorwa remezo byo gukomeza kuzikoresha.

Uburyo bushya bushyira serivisi z’imashini mu maboko y’abikorera, zigashyigikirwa n’uburyo bwo kuzigenera igihe n’ibigo bya mechanization bitanga ibice byo gusimbuza, gusana n’uburyo abahinzi babona serivisi.

CARE Rwanda ipima intsinzi ireba niba sisitemu ishobora gukomeza gukora yigenga nyuma y’uko umuryango wayishyigikiraga uvuyeho. Betty Bushabe, uhagarariye CARE Rwanda, yavuze ko gahunda zigomba gutegurwa zitekereza ku iherezo kuva mu ntangiriro, harimo n’uzazitera inkunga n’uzazikoresha mu gihe kizaza.

Icyo kibazo kigaragaza n’imbogamizi y’ihinduka ry’ubuhinzi mu Rwanda. Gahunda ya Gatanu y’Igihugu yo Kuvugurura Ubuhinzi ikeneye amafaranga y’u Rwanda agera kuri tiriyari 6.62 hagati ya 2024 na 2029, kandi abikorera bateganyijwe gutanga hafi 44.2%.

Ibi bisobanura ko imbuto, ifumbire, ubujyanama, imari, ikoranabuhanga, kurinda ingaruka n’isoko riri ku mpera y’uruhererekane rw’umusaruro bigomba gukorana nk’igice kimwe.

Christopher Bazivamo, Umuyobozi Wungirije wa RPF, yavuze ko ikibazo kirenze umurima umwe kuko ubuhinzi ari inkingi y’ubukungu n’imwe mu moteri z’ubucuruzi ku mugabane. Yavuze ko intambwe ikurikira ari uguhindura umusaruro mwinshi ukaba ingano ihoraho, ubuziranenge bwiza n’igihombo gito; hatabayeho ibikoresho fatizo byizewe n’amasoko akora neza, inganda zikora munsi y’ubushobozi kandi abahinzi bagatakaza agaciro nyuma y’isarura.

ART-MU8S4JR3-YKCY.title: Jeannette Kagame yasabye abayobozi b’urubyiruko kutagurana umuryango n’intsinzi y’akazi
ART-MU8S4JR3-YKCY.subtitle: Mu isengesho ry’abayobozi bato, yashimangiye kubaka imiryango mu buryo bugambiriwe bushingiye ku kwizera, inshingano no kuganira.
ART-MU8S4JR3-YKCY.summary: Madamu Jeannette Kagame yabwiye abayobozi b’urubyiruko ko kubaka imiryango ikomeye bikwiye guhabwa uburemere nk’ubwo baha akazi, kuyobora inzego n’iterambere ry’igihugu. Ubuhamya bw’abashakanye Eric na Bonita Munyemana bamaze imyaka 28, hamwe n’ibitekerezo by’Ikigo cy’Igihugu Gishinzwe Imikurire y’Abana, byerekanye akamaro ko kuganira, kwizera, uburere n’ubufasha ku miryango hakiri kare. Kagame yavuze ko imiryango myiza yubakwa n’amahitamo ya buri munsi agambiriwe, aho gutegereza ko ibihe byose biba byiza.
ART-MU8S4JR3-YKCY.body:
KIGALI — Madamu Jeannette Kagame yabwiye abayobozi b’urubyiruko rw’u Rwanda ko igisekuru gishobora kubaka akazi keza, kuyobora inzego no guteza imbere intego z’igihugu, ariko kigatsindwa n’inshingano ikomeye yo kubaka imiryango ikomeye ishingiye ku ndangagaciro.

Yabivugiye ku Cyumweru mu isengesho ry’abayobozi bato ryari rifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti “Instilling Godly Values in Leadership.” Yifashishije Zaburi 127:1, asaba abitabiriye kutareba gusa ibyo bagezeho mu kazi ahubwo no gusuzuma umusingi w’ubuzima bwabo, imibanire n’imiryango.

Kagame yavuze ko iki gisekuru cyizera cyane imbaraga, igenamigambi n’akazi gakomeye, ariko ko Ibyanditswe byibutsa ko imirimo idafite umusingi w’Imana ishobora kuba impfabusa. Yavuze ko “inzu” atari inyubako gusa cyangwa ikigo, ahubwo ari umuryango, hanyuma umuryango ukagira uruhare mu kubaka sosiyete n’igihugu.

Yaburiye ko imiryango iri guhura n’igitutu gisaba abantu kugira umugambi n’ubushake birushijeho gukomera, cyane cyane uko imyumvire ku gushyingirwa, kwiyemeza no kurera ihinduka. Yavuze ko bamwe basubika kwiyemeza kugeza bageze ku zindi ntego, naho abandi bakifuza ibigaragara by’ubuzima bw’umuryango batemera neza inshingano zibigendana.

Yavuze ko bamwe bashobora kwifuza abana ariko ntibifuze akazi ka buri munsi ko kubarera, cyangwa bakifuza umunsi w’ubukwe, imyambaro n’ibirori kuruta ubuzima bw’urugo ubukwe bugomba gutangiza. Yanibukije abashakanye ko umubano akenshi udasenywa n’ikintu kimwe gikomeye, ahubwo ugenda ucika intege kubera kunenga, uburakari, kwikuramo no guceceka bisubirwamo.

Kagame yavuze ko imibanire ikeneye umutekano hagati y’abashakanye kuruta gukomeza kugenzurana, kandi ko kubaka umuryango bisaba imbaraga zigambiriwe nk’izo abayobozi bashyira mu kazi no mu nshingano rusange. Yavuze ko kubaka urugo rwiza atari igikorwa cyo gutegereza, kandi ko abantu badakwiye gutegereza ibihe byiza cyangwa ko ibibazo bishira.

Ubuzima bwa Eric na Bonita Munyemana, bamaze imyaka 28 bashakanye kandi bafite abana bane, bwatanzwe nk’urugero. Bavuze ko umuryango wabo wubatswe n’amahitamo yo kwiga, kuganira no gukurana hamwe.

Eric Munyemana yavuze ko bakuze babona imiryango ifite ibibazo kandi bagafata icyemezo cyo kutazabisubiramo, nubwo nabo banyuze mu bihe bikomeye. Igihe imico yabo yagonganaga, yabonye ko agomba kwemera intege nke ze, maze aho kureka ikibazo kigasenya umubano, bashaka ubujyanama kandi batangira kwiga kumvikana neza.

Bashatse inama ku bandi bashakanye, mu matorero no mu miryango itandukanye, basoma ibitabo kandi biga imico yabo itandukanye. Ukwizera kwabaye indi nkingi, basengera hamwe, basoma Bibiliya kandi biga gusaba imbabazi iyo bakoze nabi.

Bafashe n’ibyemezo bikomeye ku burere. Igihe akazi kagabanyaga umwanya wo kubana n’abana, Bonita yaje kureka akazi nubwo byagize ingaruka ku mafaranga, kugira ngo arusheho kuba hafi y’abana.

Umuryango washyizeho ibihe bihoraho byo kuganira no gukina hamwe, kandi ababyeyi bagaragaza mu bikorwa indangagaciro bifuzaga ko abana biga. Eric yavuze ko abana iyo bumva bakunzwe bibongerera kwigirira icyizere kandi bikabafasha kwanga ibibi.

Monique Mukamana, ushinzwe Kurengera Uburenganzira bw’Abana na gahunda ya OVC mu Kigo cy’Igihugu Gishinzwe Imikurire y’Abana, yavuze ko ibibazo by’imiryango bigira ingaruka ku bana no kuri sosiyete. Yavuze ko serivisi nka Early Childhood Development zifasha gutabara hakiri kare, gushyigikira imiryango no gutegura abana gukura, kwiga no gutera imbere.

Kagame yavuze ko inshingano zisangiwe n’imiryango, abaturage, amatorero, inzego n’abayobozi. U Rwanda rwahaye urubyiruko imyanya myinshi y’inshingano, ariko yavuze ko amashuri n’intsinzi mu kazi bidahagije kugira ngo umuntu yitegure neza inshingano z’ubuyobozi n’iz’umuryango.

Yavuze ko uburezi bufasha umuntu mu kazi ariko ko kubaka umuryango ukomeye bisaba n’izindi ndangagaciro, kandi ko urubyiruko rugomba gufata ubuzima bw’umuryango nk’uko rufata akazi n’intego z’iterambere ry’igihugu.

Yifashishije imvugo y’Igifaransa “le bonheur se crée,” isobanura ko ibyishimo byubakwa, avuga ko imiryango myiza isaba amahitamo ya buri munsi aho gutegereza ibihe bitunganye. Inyandiko y’umwimerere irangirira hagati mu nteruro ye ya nyuma, nyuma yo kuvuga ko mbere yo kubaka inzego, akazi n’ubukungu bw’igihugu tugomba kubanza kwita ku “...”.

Kagame yavuze ko inshingano zisangiwe n’imiryango, abaturage, amatorero, inzego n’abayobozi. U Rwanda rwahaye urubyiruko imyanya myinshi y’inshingano, ariko yavuze ko amashuri n’intsinzi mu kazi bidahagije kugira ngo umuntu yitegure neza inshingano z’ubuyobozi n’iz’umuryango.

Yavuze ko uburezi bufasha umuntu mu kazi ariko ko kubaka umuryango ukomeye bisaba n’izindi ndangagaciro, kandi ko urubyiruko rugomba gufata ubuzima bw’umuryango nk’uko rufata akazi n’intego z’iterambere ry’igihugu.

Yifashishije imvugo y’Igifaransa “le bonheur se crée,” isobanura ko ibyishimo byubakwa, avuga ko imiryango myiza isaba amahitamo ya buri munsi aho gutegereza ibihe bitunganye. Inyandiko y’umwimerere irangirira hagati mu nteruro ye ya nyuma, nyuma yo kuvuga ko mbere yo kubaka inzego, akazi n’ubukungu bw’igihugu tugomba kubanza kwita ku “...”.

ART-MU8S4KDE-VZ39.title: Rotary Club of Kigali Virunga yafashije abana 5,000 bo mu miryango itishoboye ibikoresho by’imibereho
ART-MU8S4KDE-VZ39.subtitle: Abana bafite imyaka 6–12 bo mu turere dutanu bahawe matela, ibiringiti, amashuka, inzitiramubu, ibitabo, amakaramu, inkweto n’ibindi bikoresho.
ART-MU8S4KDE-VZ39.summary: Rotary Club of Kigali Virunga ifatanyije n’umuryango w’abagiraneza wo muri Canada yarangije gahunda yo guha abana 5,000 bo mu miryango itishoboye ibikoresho by’imibereho n’iby’ishuri mu turere dutanu. Abana 1,000 bafashijwe muri Kicukiro naho abandi 4,000 bafashwa muri Rulindo, Burera, Rwamagana na Ngoma, bahabwa matela, ibiringiti, amashuka, inzitiramubu, ibitabo, amakaramu n’inkweto. Abateguye gahunda n’abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze bavuze ko gusinzira neza n’imibereho iboneye bifasha umwana kwiga, basaba imiryango kutagurisha ibikoresho ahubwo ikabikoresha mu mibereho n’uburezi bw’abana.
ART-MU8S4KDE-VZ39.body:
KIGALI — Rotary Club of Kigali Virunga yarangije gahunda yabereye mu turere dutanu, yatanze ibikoresho by’ibanze ku bana 5,000 bo mu miryango itishoboye kugira ngo imibereho yabo irusheho kuba myiza kandi bafashwe mu masomo.

Igikorwa cyakozwe ku bufatanye n’umuryango w’abagiraneza wo muri Canada cyasojwe muri Kicukiro ku wa 5 Nzeri, aho abana 1,000 bahawe ibikoresho byo kuryamaho n’iby’ishuri. Abandi bana 4,000 bari barafashijwe muri Rulindo, Burera, Rwamagana na Ngoma kuva ku wa 26 Kanama.

Buri mwana yahawe ipaki irimo matela, ikiringiti, amashuka, inzitiramubu, ibitabo, amakaramu, inkweto n’ibindi bikoresho by’ibanze. Ku miryango imwe, ubu bufasha bwakemuye ikibazo cy’ibanze cyari kimaze igihe kigoye gukemura.

Jeanette Mukasine, umubyeyi wo mu Gatenga ufite abana babiri bahawe ubufasha, yavuze ko abana be bane bari basanzwe bagabana matela kubera ko zitari zihagije. Yishimiye ko ubu bazajya baryama neza kandi bakagira n’ibikoresho by’ishuri bibafasha kwiga.

Gahunda yibanze ku bana bafite imyaka hagati ya 6 na 12 kandi ishingiye ku gitekerezo cy’uko gusinzira bihagije n’imibereho iboneye bishobora kugira uruhare mu bushobozi bw’umwana bwo kwiga.

Alex Ndibwami, Perezida wa Rotary Club of Kigali Virunga, yavuze ko igitekerezo kirenze gutanga ibikoresho byo mu rugo. Yavuze ko iyo umwana asinziriye neza ashobora kubyuka ashaka kujya ku ishuri no kwiga.

Yasobanuye ko iki gikorwa kijyanye n’intego yagutse ya club yo gukora imishinga ikemura ibibazo bifatika by’abaturage kandi kikagaragaza ubushobozi bwo gukusanya abafatanyabikorwa n’umutungo ku mishinga igira ingaruka nziza ku baturage benshi.

Kigali Virunga yakoranye n’inzego z’ibanze mu kumenya abagenerwabikorwa, kandi gutegura no gukwirakwiza ibikoresho byafashe amezi. Ndibwami yavuze ko club ikomeje imishinga ishingiye ku bikorwa yatangije mu myaka 25 ishize.

Mu Karere ka Kicukiro, abana 1,000 batoranyijwe mu miryango 3,500 iri muri gahunda y’imyaka ibiri igamije gufasha ingo kuva mu bukene.

Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere, Antoine Mutsinzi, yasabye abagenerwabikorwa kubungabunga ibikoresho bahawe aho kubigurisha. Yavuze ko bigenewe kunoza imibereho y’imiryango, cyane cyane abana bakiri mu mashuri.

Marie Chantal Tuyizere, undi mubyeyi wo mu Gatenga ufite umwana wahawe ubufasha, yavuze ko iki gikorwa kigaragaza ko imiryango itishoboye ishobora kubona ubufasha bufatika iyo imiryango n’abaturage bakorana, kandi ko ibikoresho bizafasha umwana we kubaho no kwiga neza.

Umurungi Diana wo muri Rotaract Club of Kigali SFB, witabiriye igikorwa cyo gukwirakwiza ibikoresho, yavuze ko gukora ibikorwa bigirira abandi akamaro bimwubaka kandi bikamwibutsa ko gufasha abatishoboye ari inshingano ya buri wese.

ART-MU8S4KZP-WE8B.title: Kigali Today n’Inama y’Igihugu y’Abagore bafatanyije mu kugeza amakuru y’amatora ku bagore n’urubyiruko
ART-MU8S4KZP-WE8B.subtitle: Ubukangurambaga buzatangira ku wa 21 Nzeri, bukoreshe radiyo, imbuga za internet, amashusho n’imbuga nkoranyambaga mu kwagura amakuru ku burenganzira n’uruhare mu matora.
ART-MU8S4KZP-WE8B.summary: Inama y’Igihugu y’Abagore (NWC) na Kigali Today Ltd basinyanye ubufatanye bwo kugeza ku bagore n’urubyiruko amakuru ajyanye n’uburere mboneragihugu n’amatora. Guhera ku wa 21 Nzeri, ubutumwa buzatambuka kuri radiyo no ku mbuga za Kigali Today mu Kinyarwanda n’Icyongereza, mu mashusho no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, busobanure uruhare mu matora no mu nzego zifata ibyemezo. Abafatanyabikorwa bavuga ko bashaka ko amakuru atagera ku baturage binyuze mu nama n’amatangazo gusa, ahubwo anabageraho mu buryo bw’itumanaho bakoresha buri munsi.
ART-MU8S4KZP-WE8B.body:
KIGALI — Inama y’Igihugu y’Abagore (NWC) yafatanije n’itangazamakuru kugira ngo amakuru ajyanye n’uburere mboneragihugu n’amatora agere ku bagore n’urubyiruko benshi mbere y’ibikorwa by’amatora bizakurikiraho mu Rwanda. Ubutumwa bw’ingenzi buzibanda ku kwitabira amatora, gutora no gutekereza ku nshingano z’ubuyobozi.

NWC yasinyanye ubu bufatanye na Kigali Today Ltd, kimwe mu bigo by’itangazamakuru bikoresha uburyo bwinshi bwo kugeza amakuru ku baturage. Intego ni ugufasha abagore n’urubyiruko kubona mu buryo bworoshye amakuru ajyanye n’uruhare rw’umuturage n’amatora. Amasezerano yasinyiwe i Kigali na Dan Ngabonziza, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Kigali Today, na Belancille Nyiramajyambere, Perezida wa NWC.

Ubukangurambaga buzatangira ku wa 21 Nzeri. Buzakoresha radiyo ya Kigali Today, imbuga zayo z’ikoranabuhanga zitanga amakuru mu Kinyarwanda no mu Cyongereza, amashusho n’imbuga nkoranyambaga. Abafatanyabikorwa bashaka ko uburere mboneragihugu butagarukira mu nama no mu matangazo y’inzego, ahubwo bukagera no kuri telefone, ku mbuga nkoranyambaga no kuri radiyo.

Nyiramajyambere yavuze ko abagore n’urubyiruko ari igice kinini cy’abaturage b’u Rwanda, bityo ko ari ngombwa kugira uruhare rugaragara mu matora no mu gufata ibyemezo. Yavuze ko NWC ishaka ko bagira uruhare mu iterambere ry’igihugu kandi bagatekereza no ku myanya yo mu nzego zifata ibyemezo. Yongeyeho ko ubufatanye na Kigali Today buzafasha ubutumwa kugera ku bantu benshi kandi vuba.

Kigali Today isanzwe ifite abayikurikira benshi kuri radiyo, ku mbuga z’amakuru, mu mashusho no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Ngabonziza yavuze ko ubu bufatanye bugamije gushyigikira ihame ry’uburinganire n’uruhare rw’abagore mu iterambere ry’igihugu, kandi ko ibitangazamakuru by’ikigo bizakoreshwa mu kugeza ubutumwa ku baturage.

Ubukangurambaga buzifashisha kandi abantu bazwi n’abandi bafite ijambo rigera kuri benshi. Ntibuzibanda ku gutora gusa. Buzanasobanura icyo kwitabira ibikorwa by’amatora bisobanura no kugeza amakuru ku bagore n’urubyiruko ku buryo bashobora gutekereza ku nshingano z’ubuyobozi no mu zindi nzego zifata ibyemezo.

Abafatanyabikorwa babona iki gikorwa nk’ikirenze ubukangurambaga busanzwe bw’amatora, kuko kireba n’uruhare rw’abaturage mu byemezo rusange. Itangazamakuru rishobora kugeza amakuru ahantu henshi vuba kandi mu buryo bumwe, mu gihe imbuga z’ikoranabuhanga zifasha kugera cyane cyane ku rubyiruko.

NWC izana urusobe rw’abayihagarariye mu gihugu n’ubumenyi ku bibazo bireba abagore n’imiryango, Kigali Today ikazana ubushobozi bwo gukora no gukwirakwiza ibikubiye mu butumwa. Ibyavuye mu bukangurambaga bizareberwa ku rwego abagore n’urubyiruko basobanukiwe amahitamo yabo, bitabiriye ibikorwa by’amatora kandi batekereje ku myanya yo mu nzego zifata ibyemezo.

Kigali Today Ltd ni yo ibarizwamo KT Press, Kigalitoday.com, KT Radio 96.7FM na Kigali Today TV, hamwe n’imiyoboro yayo ya YouTube n’imbuga nkoranyambaga.

ART-MU8S4LM5-ATCX.title: BPR Bank Rwanda yatangije gahunda y’imyaka itandatu y’ubufasha bwo kwiga ku banyeshuri 50
ART-MU8S4LM5-ATCX.subtitle: Abakobwa 25 n’abahungu 25 bazafashwa ibikenerwa ku ishuri kandi bahabwe ubujyanama kuva mu mwaka wa mbere kugeza mu wa gatandatu w’amashuri yisumbuye.
ART-MU8S4LM5-ATCX.summary: BPR Bank Rwanda yatangije gahunda y’imyaka itandatu yo gufasha abanyeshuri 50 bakomoka mu miryango ifite ubushobozi buke kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye. Abatoranyijwe ku bufatanye na Minisiteri y’Uburezi bazafashwa ibikenerwa ku ishuri kandi bahabwe ubujyanama ku kwishyiriraho intego, ubumenyi bw’imibereho, kwigirira icyizere no gutegura umwuga. Banki ivuga ko iyi gahunda ari ishoramari ry’igihe kirekire rigamije gufasha abanyeshuri kuguma mu ishuri no kwitegura gukomeza amashuri cyangwa kwinjira ku isoko ry’umurimo.
ART-MU8S4LM5-ATCX.body:
KIGALI — BPR Bank Rwanda yatangije gahunda y’imyaka itandatu yo gufasha abanyeshuri 50 bakomoka mu miryango ifite ubushobozi buke kugira ngo barangize icyiciro cyose cy’amashuri yisumbuye.

Gahunda yiswe BPR Scholars Program yatangijwe ku wa Gatanu, tariki ya 4 Nzeri, ikazafasha abakobwa 25 n’abahungu 25 batoranyijwe mu turere dutandukanye tw’u Rwanda. BPR Bank Foundation izishyura ibikenerwa by’ingenzi ku ishuri kuva mu mwaka wa mbere kugeza mu wa gatandatu w’amashuri yisumbuye, kugira ngo abo banyeshuri bakomeze amasomo kandi bayarangize.

Abagenerwabikorwa batoranyijwe ku bufatanye na Minisiteri y’Uburezi. Ubu bufatanye bugamije kumenya abanyeshuri bakeneye ubufasha no guhuza gahunda n’ibyihutirwa mu burezi bw’igihugu. Gahunda yibanda ku kugabanya imbogamizi z’amikoro n’iz’imibereho zishobora kubuza abanyeshuri bafite ubushobozi gukomeza amashuri uko bikwiye.

Ubufasha ntibuzagarukira ku bikenerwa ku ishuri. Abanyeshuri bazahabwa ubujyanama buteguye neza bwo kubafasha mu masomo no mu mikurire yabo bwite. Buzaba bukubiyemo kwishyiriraho intego, ubumenyi bw’imibereho, kwigirira icyizere no gutegura umwuga, kugira ngo bitegure gukomeza amashuri cyangwa kubona akazi nyuma y’amashuri yisumbuye.

Vincent Ngirikiringo, Umuyobozi Mukuru ushinzwe Imari muri BPR Bank Rwanda, yavuze ko iyi gahunda ari ubwitange bw’igihe kirekire aho kuba ubufasha bw’igihe gito. Yasobanuye ko buri mwana akwiye amahirwe yo guteza imbere ubushobozi bwe kandi ko inkunga y’amafaranga ikwiye kujyana n’ubujyanama bumufasha gutera imbere.

Banki yiteze ko iyi gahunda izateza imbere uburezi budaheza n’amahirwe angana. Kuba ubufasha buzamara imyaka itandatu bigamije kugabanya ibyago by’uko abagenerwabikorwa bata ishuri batararangiza icyiciro cy’amashuri yisumbuye.

BPR Bank Foundation ivuga ko intego yayo y’igihe kirekire ari uko aba banyeshuri bakura bafite ubumenyi, icyizere n’inshingano, bakazagira uruhare mu iterambere ry’imiryango yabo, abaturage n’u Rwanda. Fondasiyo yibanda cyane ku burezi no guteza imbere imishinga.

BPR Bank Rwanda ni umwe mu bagize KCB Group.

BPR Bank Foundation ivuga ko intego yayo y’igihe kirekire ari uko aba banyeshuri bakura bafite ubumenyi, icyizere n’inshingano, bakazagira uruhare mu iterambere ry’imiryango yabo, abaturage n’u Rwanda. Fondasiyo yibanda cyane ku burezi no guteza imbere imishinga.
BPR Bank Rwanda ni umwe mu bagize KCB Group.

ART-MU8S4M8I-N9FY.title: Ubucamanza bw’u Rwanda bwagabanyije igihe cyo kurangiza urubanza kiva ku mezi atandatu kigera kuri ane
ART-MU8S4M8I-N9FY.subtitle: Mu mwaka w’ubucamanza wa 2025/26 inkiko zarangije imanza 123,027, mu gihe izakemuwe n’ubuhuza n’ubundi buryo butari ukuburana zisanzwe ziyongereyeho 32.4%.
ART-MU8S4M8I-N9FY.summary: Ubucamanza bw’u Rwanda bwatangaje ko igihe impuzandengo urubanza rumara ngo rurangire cyagabanutse kiva ku mezi atandatu kigera kuri ane, bityo intego y’umwaka w’ubucamanza wa 2025/26 ikagerwaho. Mu manza 163,695 zarebwe muri uwo mwaka, inkiko zarangije 123,027, zirimo 19,888 zakemuwe n’ubuhuza n’ubundi buryo bwo gukemura amakimbirane butari ukuburana mu nkiko. Abayobozi b’Ubucamanza bavuga ko kwiyongera kw’ikoreshwa rya ADR kwafashije kugabanya ubukererwe n’ibirarane by’imanza nubwo umubare w’imanza n’igitutu ku bakozi bikiri byinshi.
ART-MU8S4M8I-N9FY.body:
KIGALI — Ubucamanza bw’u Rwanda bwagabanyije amezi abiri ku gihe impuzandengo urubanza rumara ngo rukemurwe, kiva ku mezi atandatu kigera kuri ane. Ibi byatumye intego yari yashyizweho mu mwaka w’ubucamanza wa 2025/26 igerwaho.

Domitilla Mukantaganzwa, Perezida w’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga akaba na Perezida w’Inama Nkuru y’Ubucamanza, yatangaje iyo mibare ku wa Gatanu, tariki ya 4 Nzeri 2026, mu muhango wo gutangiza umwaka w’ubucamanza wa 2026/27.

Mu mwaka wa 2025/26, inkiko zakiriye cyangwa zakomeje gukurikirana imanza 163,695. Muri zo, 54,278 zari zarasigaye mu mwaka wabanje, naho 109,417 zari imanza nshya. Muri uwo mwaka inkiko zarangije imanza 123,027.

Mu manza zarangiye, 103,139, zingana hafi na 84%, zakemuwe mu buryo busanzwe bwo kuburana mu nkiko. Izindi 19,888, zingana hafi na 16%, zakemuwe hifashishijwe ubuhuza n’ubundi buryo bwo gukemura amakimbirane butari ukuburana mu nkiko, buzwi nka ADR.

Mukantaganzwa yashishikarije gukomeza gukoresha ADR kugira ngo ubutabera butangwe vuba kandi mu buryo bunoze. Imanza zakemuwe muri ubu buryo ziyongereye ziva ku 15,012 mu mwaka wabanje zigera ku 19,888, ni ukuvuga iziyongereyeho 4,876 cyangwa 32.4%.

Ubucamanza buvuga ko uko kwiyongera kwafashije kugabanya umutwaro w’imanza ziba zigomba kujya mu nkiko no kugabanya ubukererwe. Iyo amakimbirane adasaba kuburanishwa mu buryo bwuzuye, ubuhuza cyangwa ubundi buryo bushobora gufasha impande zombi kubona igisubizo vuba.

Inkiko z’Ibanze zarangije imanza 74,348, naho Inkiko Zisumbuye zirangiza 33,144. Izindi manza zarangijwe n’Urukiko Rukuru, Urukiko rw’Ubucuruzi n’izindi nkiko.

Nubwo hari iri terambere, Ubucamanza buracyahanganye n’ikibazo cy’imanza zikomeza kwiyongera ugereranyije n’abakozi n’ubushobozi bihari. Gucunga imanza nshya no gukomeza kugabanya igihe imanza zisanzwe zimara ni kimwe mu bibazo by’ingenzi byo gukemura.

Umwaka w’ubucamanza warangiye hasigaye imanza 41,831 zitararangira. Uyu mubare uri munsi y’imanza 54,278 zari zatangiranye n’umwaka. Imibare igaragaza ko umutwaro w’imanza ukiri munini, ariko ikoreshwa ryagutse rya ADR n’umuvuduko mu kurangiza imanza biri gufasha kugabanya ibirarane.

ART-MU8S4MUX-6PHN.title: Minisitiri w’Intebe arasaba Afurika gufata ubuhinzi nk’imbaraga z’ubukungu, atari uguhinga gusa
ART-MU8S4MUX-6PHN.subtitle: Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr.
ART-MU8S4MUX-6PHN.summary: Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr. Justin Nsengiyumva, afungura Ihuriro Nyafurika ry’Ubuhinzi n’Imirire rya 2026, yavuze ko ubukungu bushingiye ku biribwa muri Afurika bukwiye gufatwa nk’amahirwe akomeye y’ishoramari, imirimo n’udushya, aho kubonwa gusa nk’uburyo bwo guhinga ibiribwa. Yagaragaje ko Afurika ifite ubutaka burumbuka, amazi, izuba n’urubyiruko rwinshi, ariko abantu benshi ku mugabane bagikomeje guhura n’inzara n’ibura ry’ibiribwa.
ART-MU8S4MUX-6PHN.body:
Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr. Justin Nsengiyumva, afungura Ihuriro Nyafurika ry’Ubuhinzi n’Imirire rya 2026, yavuze ko ubukungu bushingiye ku biribwa muri Afurika bukwiye gufatwa nk’amahirwe akomeye y’ishoramari, imirimo n’udushya, aho kubonwa gusa nk’uburyo bwo guhinga ibiribwa. Yagaragaje ko Afurika ifite ubutaka burumbuka, amazi, izuba n’urubyiruko rwinshi, ariko abantu benshi ku mugabane bagikomeje guhura n’inzara n’ibura ry’ibiribwa. Yasabye ko ubuhinzi bubonwa nk’urwego rugezweho rushobora gutanga amafaranga meza, kwihangira imirimo, udushya n’iterambere.

Imibare yatanzwe muri iri huriro igaragaza ko mu 2025 Abanyafurika bagera kuri miliyoni 309 bahuye n’inzara, naho hafi 57% bakagira ibura ry’ibiribwa riri ku rwego ruciriritse cyangwa rukomeye. Nsengiyumva yavuze ko kugabanya icyo cyuho bisaba ko abikorera bareka kubona ubuhinzi nk’urwego ruto cyangwa rufite ibyago byinshi, ahubwo bagahindura ubushobozi Afurika isanzwe ifite bukavamo umusaruro n’iterambere. Yavuze ko amahirwe atari mu buhinzi bwonyine, ahubwo ari mu nyongeramusaruro, ububiko, ubwikorezi, gutunganya umusaruro, ubucuruzi, kuhira, ingufu, imashini, serivisi z’ikoranabuhanga n’ubwishingizi.

Minisitiri w’Intebe yasobanuye ko umurima utanga umusaruro udashobora gutera imbere udafite imihanda, ingufu, kuhira, ububiko, imari, ubwikorezi, inganda zitunganya umusaruro n’amasoko yizewe. Yasabye abafatanyabikorwa kureba urunigi rwose rw’agaciro aho gushora imari mu gice kimwe gusa, kandi inyungu zikagera ku bahinzi bato, abagore n’urubyiruko. Minisitiri w’Ubuhinzi Dr. Telesphore Ndabamenye na we yavuze ko Afurika idafite ikibazo cy’ibitekerezo n’udushya, ahubwo ikibazo ari ukuva ku mishinga y’icyitegererezo n’amasezerano hakajya ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa n’ishoramari.

Ihuriro rya 2026 ryitabiriwe n’abantu barenga 5,000 baturutse mu bihugu birenga 50, rikaba ryizihiza imyaka 20 kuva iki gikorwa gitangiye. Icyatangiye nk’urubuga rwo kuganira cyahindutse urubuga ruhuza za guverinoma, abahinzi, ba rwiyemezamirimo, abashoramari, abashakashatsi, abagore n’urubyiruko. Amath Pathe Sene uyobora Africa Food Systems Forum yavuze ko imyaka 20 ishize yagaragaje ubushobozi bwa Afurika bwo guhuriza abantu hamwe, ariko imyaka 20 iri imbere igomba kugaragaza ubushobozi bwo gutanga ibisubizo bifatika.

Icyiciro gikurikira ni uguhindura amasezerano akaba gahunda zizewe kandi zishobora gushorwamo imari, gushimangira urwego rwose rw’ibiribwa no gutera inkunga udushya dushobora kwagurwa. Abayobozi bavuga ko amahirwe nyayo ari ukubaka ubukungu bw’ibiribwa buhuza ubuhinzi n’imari, ikoranabuhanga, ingufu, ibikorwa remezo, gutunganya umusaruro n’amasoko, kugira ngo umutungo Afurika isanzwe ifite uhinduke umusaruro, ishoramari n’iterambere.

ART-MU8S4NH8-60UG.title: Guverinoma: U Rwanda rukeneye kongera ubushobozi bwo kubika amazi inshuro zirenga umunani mbere ya 2034
ART-MU8S4NH8-60UG.subtitle: U Rwanda rukeneye kongera ubushobozi bwo kubika amazi inshuro zirenga umunani mu myaka umunani iri imbere kugira ngo rubone amazi ahagije yo kuhira ateganyijwe gukenerwa mu 2034.
ART-MU8S4NH8-60UG.summary: U Rwanda rukeneye kongera ubushobozi bwo kubika amazi inshuro zirenga umunani mu myaka umunani iri imbere kugira ngo rubone amazi ahagije yo kuhira ateganyijwe gukenerwa mu 2034. Davis Bugingo uyobora ishami rishinzwe kurwanya imyuzure no guteza imbere ububiko bw’amazi mu Kigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Umutungo Kamere w’Amazi yavuze ko hazakenerwa nibura metero kibe miliyoni 693.7 z’amazi. Ubu igihugu gifite ubushobozi bwo kubika hafi metero kibe miliyoni 83.5 mu ngomero zirenga 50, bivuze ko hakenewe kongerwaho hafi miliyoni 610.
ART-MU8S4NH8-60UG.body:
U Rwanda rukeneye kongera ubushobozi bwo kubika amazi inshuro zirenga umunani mu myaka umunani iri imbere kugira ngo rubone amazi ahagije yo kuhira ateganyijwe gukenerwa mu 2034. Davis Bugingo uyobora ishami rishinzwe kurwanya imyuzure no guteza imbere ububiko bw’amazi mu Kigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Umutungo Kamere w’Amazi yavuze ko hazakenerwa nibura metero kibe miliyoni 693.7 z’amazi. Ubu igihugu gifite ubushobozi bwo kubika hafi metero kibe miliyoni 83.5 mu ngomero zirenga 50, bivuze ko hakenewe kongerwaho hafi miliyoni 610.

Iki kibazo kirakomeye kuko ubuhinzi bw’u Rwanda bugishingira cyane ku mvura. Imiterere y’igihugu cy’imisozi ituma kigira imvura nyinshi, ariko amazi ntabe ahari igihe abahinzi bayakeneye; imvura nyinshi ishobora guteza imyuzure n’isuri, nyuma y’amezi make hakabaho ibura ry’amazi. Kubika amazi bigamije guhuza ibyo bihe no gutuma ubuhinzi budashingira gusa ku gihe imvura igwamo.

Mu mishinga minini iri muri gahunda za Guverinoma harimo urugomero rwa Muvumba mu Burasirazuba, rugenewe kuhira no gutanga amazi, umushinga wa Nyabarongo II uhuza amashanyarazi n’imicungire y’amazi, ndetse n’urugomero rwa Akanyaru ruteganyijwe ku mupaka n’u Burundi. Ariko kugira ngo intego ya 2034 igerweho, ingomero nini ntizihagije; hazakenerwa n’ibigega bito, ibidendezi byo ku mirima, uburyo bwo gufata amazi y’imvura n’imiyoboro yo kuhira ikoresha amazi neza. Kuhira bishobora kugabanya ibyago byo gutakaza igihembwe cy’ihinga kubera imvura itinze, ihagarara kare cyangwa igwa mu buryo bwangiza.

Guverinoma igomba rero kubika amazi ahagije yo gukoresha mu gihe cy’izuba kandi igacunga amazi menshi mu gihe cy’imvura nyinshi. Ibyo bisaba ingomero, imiyoboro, amapompe n’imiyoboro yo gukwirakwiza amazi, ariko kandi bigasaba ubutaka, imari n’imicungire myiza y’inzuzi n’ibibaya byazo. Icyuho kiri hagati ya miliyoni 83.5 z’ubushobozi buhari n’agera kuri miliyoni 694 zifuzwa mu 2034 ni amahirwe manini y’ishoramari mu bikorwa remezo.

Intego yo kongera ububiko bw’amazi rero irenze kubaka ingomero. Igamije gutuma umusaruro w’ibiribwa udahungabanywa cyane n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, guha abahinzi amazi yizewe no kugabanya igihombo giterwa n’imyuzure n’amapfa; ariko u Rwanda ruracyafite icyuho kinini cyo kuziba mu gihe kiri munsi y’imyaka icumi.

ART-MU8S4O3I-TI5Y.title: Ibiciro by’ababikora byazamutse 20.8%, ibiciro mu bucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro bizamuka 77.1%
ART-MU8S4O3I-TI5Y.subtitle: Ibiciro abatunganya n’abakora ibicuruzwa mu Rwanda bahabwa byazamutseho 20.8% muri Nyakanga ugereranyije n’umwaka ushize, mu gihe ibiciro mu bucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro byiyongereye 77.1% naho iby’amashanyarazi bikazamuka 34.8%.
ART-MU8S4O3I-TI5Y.summary: Ibiciro abatunganya n’abakora ibicuruzwa mu Rwanda bahabwa byazamutseho 20.8% muri Nyakanga ugereranyije n’umwaka ushize, mu gihe ibiciro mu bucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro byiyongereye 77.1% naho iby’amashanyarazi bikazamuka 34.8%. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ibarurishamibare kivuga ko ibiciro mu nganda byazamutse 17.8%, mu gihe ugereranyije Kamena na Nyakanga igipimo rusange cyiyongereye 0.5%. Abatanze ibiganiro bareberaga ikibazo mu mpande zitandukanye, ariko bose basanga ikibazo gikomeye atari umusaruro gusa, ahubwo ari ukudahuza neza umurima, ububiko, ubwikorezi, isoko n’umuguzi. Bavuze ko ubuhinzi, ubushakashatsi, imari, ubuzima n’imiyoborere bigomba gukora nk’urwego rumwe.
ART-MU8S4OQ6-V6HM.body:
Mu biganiro byabanjirije Africa Food Systems Forum byabereye i Kigali, impuguke zagarutse ku rujijo rukomeye: Afurika ifite ubutaka, abahinzi, ibihingwa n’ubumenyi bw’ubuhinzi bishobora gutanga ibiribwa byinshi, ariko miliyoni z’abantu ziracyugarijwe n’ibura ry’ibiribwa. Abatanze ibiganiro bareberaga ikibazo mu mpande zitandukanye, ariko bose basanga ikibazo gikomeye atari umusaruro gusa, ahubwo ari ukudahuza neza umurima, ububiko, ubwikorezi, isoko n’umuguzi. Bavuze ko ubuhinzi, ubushakashatsi, imari, ubuzima n’imiyoborere bigomba gukora nk’urwego rumwe.

Dr. Agnes Kalibata washinze kandi uyobora C4Impact Advisory Group yavuze ko COVID-19, intambara y’u Burusiya na Ukraine, imihindagurikire y’ibihe, amakimbirane n’ibibazo by’ingufu byakomeje kwerekana intege nke z’imikorere y’ibiribwa muri Afurika. Mu gihe cya COVID, hari aho ibiribwa byari bihari ariko ububiko n’ubwikorezi bidahagije bigatuma bitagera aho bikenewe; yavuze ko icyo cyari ikibazo cyo kudahuza inzego, atari ukubura umusaruro. Yaburiye ko gukomeza gukoresha amafaranga mu nkunga zihutirwa ku ifumbire n’ibiribwa bitabanje guhindura imiterere y’urwego ari ugucunga ibibazo aho gukora impinduka zirambye.

Jean Claude Rubyogo uyobora Pan-Africa Bean Research Alliance (PABRA) yatanze urugero rw’uko ubushakashatsi bushobora kugera ku murima no ku isoko. Abahinzi bato bagera kuri miliyoni imwe mu Rwanda bahinga amoko y’ibishyimbo byavuguruwe, kandi amwe mu moko yatejwe imbere mu Rwanda yamaze kugera muri Uganda, Tanzania, Burundi na Cameroon. Hari n’ibishyimbo bishya bitekwa mu gihe kiri munsi y’isaha aho amasanzwe ashobora gufata amasaha abiri cyangwa atatu, bigabanya inkwi n’igihe abagore bamara bateka; PABRA kandi ikorana n’inzego z’uburezi n’ubuhinzi mu kwagura ibishyimbo bikungahaye ku butare mu mafunguro yo ku mashuri.

Pascal Murasira uyobora Africa Food Fellowship yavuze ko ubushakashatsi bwiza n’amasoko bikora neza bidahagije hatabayeho abayobozi bashobora guhuza abantu n’inzego zitandukanye. Yagaragaje ko ikibazo cy’imirire mibi y’abana gishobora kuba gifitanye isano n’ibiribwa bihari, ubushobozi bw’urugo, amasoko, imyitwarire, uburezi n’ubuzima, ku buryo kidafite nyiracyo umwe cyangwa umuti umwe. Icyiciro cya gatanu cy’iyi gahunda cyarangije abantu 27, bituma urusobe rw’abayobozi bakorera ku guhindura imikorere y’ibiribwa muri Afurika rugera ku 129.

Afurika rero ntikeneye gusa kongera ibiribwa ihinga. Ikeneye kubibika, kubitwara, kubicuruza, kubigira ku giciro abaturage bashobora kwishyura, guhuza abahinzi n’amasoko no gutuma ubushakashatsi busubiza ibyo abaguzi, amashuri n’izindi nzego bakeneye. Impuguke zavuze ko guhuza ibyo bice ari byo bizahindura ubushobozi bunini bw’ubuhinzi bwa Afurika bukavamo umutekano w’ibiribwa ufatika.

ART-MU8S4PCK-QF39.title: Yiswe CEPGL kuko “yanywaga nk’abakire”, inzoga ziza kumugeza hafi yo gupfa
ART-MU8S4PCK-QF39.subtitle: Augustin Habimana wo mu Karere ka Rubavu yamaze imyaka azwi ku izina rya CEPGL, kubera ko abantu bavugaga ko yanywaga inzoga akazigurira abandi nk’abakozi ba CEPGL bo hambere bazwiho kuba bari bafite amafaranga.
ART-MU8S4PCK-QF39.summary: Augustin Habimana wo mu Karere ka Rubavu yamaze imyaka azwi ku izina rya CEPGL, kubera ko abantu bavugaga ko yanywaga inzoga akazigurira abandi nk’abakozi ba CEPGL bo hambere bazwiho kuba bari bafite amafaranga. Iryo zina ryaje gukurikirana umugabo watwawe n’inzoga n’ibiyobyabwenge kugeza avuye mu ishuri, atakaza ubuzima bw’umuryango, yiba ibiribwa, asabiriza inzoga, agerageza kwiyahura kandi akabazwe kenshi kugira ngo arokoke. Mu muganda rusange yabwiye abaturage uko yajyaga atwara amajerekani y’inzoga kugira ngo ahabwe akayoga gato.
ART-MU8S4PCK-QF39.body:
Augustin Habimana wo mu Karere ka Rubavu yamaze imyaka azwi ku izina rya CEPGL, kubera ko abantu bavugaga ko yanywaga inzoga akazigurira abandi nk’abakozi ba CEPGL bo hambere bazwiho kuba bari bafite amafaranga. Iryo zina ryaje gukurikirana umugabo watwawe n’inzoga n’ibiyobyabwenge kugeza avuye mu ishuri, atakaza ubuzima bw’umuryango, yiba ibiribwa, asabiriza inzoga, agerageza kwiyahura kandi akabazwe kenshi kugira ngo arokoke. Mu muganda rusange yabwiye abaturage uko yajyaga atwara amajerekani y’inzoga kugira ngo ahabwe akayoga gato.

Habimana wavukiye i Katanga muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo avuga ko yakuriye mu myemerere y’uko umwana muto ashobora guhabwa inzoga gakondo ngo zivure “inzoka zo mu nda”. Ageze mu mwaka wa kabiri w’amashuri yisumbuye yatangiye kunywa no kunywa urumogi kubera inshuti mbi, aza kuva mu ishuri agaruka mu Rwanda. Ababyeyi bagerageje kumusubiza mu ishuri ariko yari amaze kubatwa, kandi mu 1987 yarafunzwe kubera kunywa urumogi; nyuma yaho ubuzima bwe bwabaye gushaka inzoga, kwiba ibigori mu mirima, kubyotsa mu gihuru no kujya gusabiriza ahabaga hateguwe inzoga.

Nyuma y’amakimbirane na se, Habimana yigeze kumva ko yangwa, afata ibiyobyabwenge ajya ku Kivu ashaka kwiyahura ariko atinya imiraba aragaruka. Mu 1995 yinjiye mu rusengero, abantu bamuha imyenda n’ibiribwa kandi bamufasha kureka inzoga n’itabi; nyuma y’igihe yashoboye kubireka, arashaka kandi yubaka umuryango. Icyakora yaje kongera kunywa kubera amakuru atari yo yavugaga ko inzoga nshya zishobora gufasha abafite umuvuduko w’amaraso, diyabete cyangwa ikibazo cy’ibiro, maze yongeye kubatwa kugeza agwa mu isoko yasinze.

Avuga ko umugore we yapfuye mu 2013 nyuma yo kugira agahinda gakabije no kugorwa n’imyitwarire ye, naho abana be bakava mu ishuri hakiri kare kubera ipfunwe. We ubwe yagize ibibazo by’igifu, ibisebe n’umwijima, ava ku Bitaro bya Gisenyi ajyanwa muri CHUK aho igifu cye cyaturitse kandi akabazwa inshuro nyinshi. Hagati ya 2013 na 2016 yamaze hafi imyaka itatu mu bitaro, kandi igihe yari amerewe nabi cyane yapimaga ibiro 39.

Uyu munsi Habimana ashaka ko urubyiruko rubona ubuzima bwe nk’ikimenyetso cy’ibyo ibiyobyabwenge n’inzoga zitujuje ubuziranenge bishobora gukora ku muntu no ku muryango. Minisitiri w’Ubuzima Dr. Sabin Nsanzimana yavuze mu Muganda i Rubavu ko kurwanya ibyo bintu ari ikibazo cy’umutekano w’ubuzima kandi abantu badakwiye gutegereza ko Leta ibanza kubafatira icyemezo. Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu Dominique Habimana na we yaburiye abaturage bo ku mipaka kudakoresha umupaka nk’inzira yo kwinjiza Kanyanga n’izindi nzoga mbi.

Ku wahoze yitwa CEPGL kubera kunywa “nk’umukire”, ubutumwa ntabwo ari inyigisho yo mu magambo gusa. Yanyuze mu kubura, ipfunwe n’uburwayi bukomeye, ariko ubu akoresha inkuru ye kwereka abandi ko umuntu ashobora kugera hafi yo gutakaza byose kandi akabona n’inzira yo kongera kubaka ubuzima.

ART-MU8S4PYW-J9BL.title: Kagame yasabye ko inzitizi ku kohereza ikoranabuhanga muri Afurika zigabanywa kandi Afurika ikagira ijambo ku mategeko yo mu isanzure
ART-MU8S4PYW-J9BL.subtitle: Perezida Paul Kagame, mu Nama ya mbere Mpuzamahanga y’Ibijyanye n’Isanzure yabereye i Paris, yaburiye ko ibihugu bya Afurika bishobora gutakaza amahirwe yo kubona imyanya y’icyogajuru n’imirongo ya radiyo ari umutungo muke uko urwego rw’isanzure rukura.
ART-MU8S4PYW-J9BL.summary: Perezida Paul Kagame, mu Nama ya mbere Mpuzamahanga y’Ibijyanye n’Isanzure yabereye i Paris, yaburiye ko ibihugu bya Afurika bishobora gutakaza amahirwe yo kubona imyanya y’icyogajuru n’imirongo ya radiyo ari umutungo muke uko urwego rw’isanzure rukura. Kagame yasabye ko amategeko mashya agenga ikoranabuhanga ry’isanzure ashyirwaho mu buryo burimo ibihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere kandi bigahabwa ijambo rifatika. Yavuze ko inzitizi ku kohereza ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga zikomeje kugabanya amahirwe yo kubigeraho, asaba ihererekanya ry’ikoranabuhanga n’ubufatanye bwongera ubushakashatsi n’ubushobozi bw’imbere mu gihugu. Yatanze E-Space, ikorana n’ibihugu bya Afurika mu guteza imbere no gukoresha ibisubizo bishingiye ku byogajuru, nk’urugero rw’ubufatanye bushobora kwegera amasoko n’abaturage.

Ubutumwa bwe nyamukuru ni uko Afurika idakwiye gutegereza kugeza amategeko n’umutungo by’ubukungu bushya bw’isanzure bimaze kugabanywa, ahubwo ikwiye kugira ubushobozi bwo kwitabira, kuganira no kugira uruhare mu byemezo bizakurikiraho.

ART-MU8S4QL9-MPOE.title: BK Group igabanya amashami yayo, ikibanda kuri banki n’ishoramari
ART-MU8S4QL9-MPOE.subtitle: BK Group PLC iri kugabanya umubare w’ibigo ikoresha kugira ngo yibande ku nkingi ebyiri: banki y’ubucuruzi n’ishoramari.

Ibi bihindura icyerekezo cy’itsinda ryari rimaze imyaka ryagura ibikorwa mu mabanki, ubwishingizi n’ikoranabuhanga; BK Group yamaze kugurisha imigabane yayo yose muri BK General Insurance kuri RSSB kuri miliyari 31.7 Frw, kandi yinjiza BK Techouse muri Bank of Kigali aho gukomeza kuyigira ikigo cyihariye.
ART-MU8S4QL9-MPOE.body:
BK Group PLC iri kugabanya umubare w’ibigo ikoresha kugira ngo yibande ku nkingi ebyiri: banki y’ubucuruzi n’ishoramari. Bank of Kigali izakomeza kuba ishingiro rya serivisi za banki, naho BK Capital ibe urubuga nyamukuru rw’ishoramari n’amasoko y’imari. Ibi bihindura icyerekezo cy’itsinda ryari rimaze imyaka ryagura ibikorwa mu mabanki, ubwishingizi n’ikoranabuhanga; BK Group yamaze kugurisha imigabane yayo yose muri BK General Insurance kuri RSSB kuri miliyari 31.7 Frw, kandi yinjiza BK Techouse muri Bank of Kigali aho gukomeza kuyigira ikigo cyihariye.

Umuyobozi Mukuru wa BK Group Dr. Uzziel Ndagijimana yavuze ko kugira ibigo byinshi atari byo bisobanura guhanga imirimo itandukanye, ahubwo ko itsinda rishaka gutanga serivisi nyinshi imbere mu bikorwa byaryo by’ingenzi. Ubu BK Group igizwe na Bank of Kigali, BK Capital na BK Foundation, iyo ya nyuma ikaba ishinzwe ibikorwa by’ubugiraneza. Bank of Kigali na BK Capital biteganyijwe ko bizakorana cyane mu micungire y’umutungo, ibicuruzwa by’ishoramari n’izindi serivisi z’imari.

Ivugurura rikorwa mu gihe BK Group ikomeje kubona inyungu. Mu mezi atandatu yarangiye ku wa 30 Kamena, yungutse miliyari 56.4 Frw, yiyongereyeho 8.6% ugereranyije n’umwaka wabanje; inyungu ku nguzanyo yazamutse 14.8% naho izindi nyungu zitari iz’inguzanyo ziyongera 28.5%. Umutungo wose wageze hafi kuri tiriyari 2.98 Frw, naho imari y’abanyamigabane izamuka 6.9% igera kuri miliyari 543.4 Frw. Ibi byabaye mu gihe ubukungu bw’u Rwanda bwari bwazamutse 10% mu gihembwe cya mbere ariko izamuka ry’ibiciro rikagera kuri 14.5% muri Nyakanga.

Bank of Kigali na yo iri guhindura uburyo ibona inyungu. Amafaranga yinjiza mbere yo gukuramo igihombo ku nguzanyo yazamutse 15.6% nubwo inguzanyo zose zagabanutse 1.3%, bigaragaza ko banki iri kubona amafaranga menshi mu bikorwa bitandukanye aho kwishingikiriza gusa ku kongera inguzanyo. Amafaranga y’abakiliya yabitswe muri banki yazamutse 11.8% agera kuri tiriyari 2.12 Frw, kandi kwibanda ku konti zihendutse zo kubitsa no kuzigama byagabanyije ikiguzi cy’amafaranga ava kuri 2.7% kigera kuri 2.3%. Inyungu ku nyungu yageze kuri miliyari 124 Frw, naho amafaranga ava kuri serivisi na komisiyo yiyongera 29.1% agera kuri miliyari 12.6 Frw kubera kwiyongera kw’ubucuruzi bwa digital.

Kwinjiza BK Techouse muri banki bivuze ko ikoranabuhanga rigiye kuba ubushobozi bw’imbere muri banki aho kuba ishami ryihariye. BK kandi iri kugerageza ubucuruzi bushya nka BKGO EV, itanga inguzanyo igera kuri 100% y’igiciro cy’imodoka z’amashanyarazi; mu mezi make portfolio yayo yari igeze hafi kuri miliyari 5 Frw. Banki ibona imodoka z’amashanyarazi nk’amahirwe mashya mu gihe ibiciro bya lisansi biri hejuru kandi u Rwanda rushyigikira ubwikorezi butangiza ibidukikije.

Ikibazo gikomeye mu mibare ni inguzanyo zitishyurwa neza. Igipimo cyazo cyazamutse kiva kuri 4.8% ku mpera z’igihembwe cya mbere kigera kuri 6.5%, naho amafaranga yagenewe igihombo ku nguzanyo yiyongera 65.8% agera kuri miliyari 18.5 Frw. Ubuyobozi buvuga ko ikibazo cyibanda ku nguzanyo nke z’ibigo, cyane cyane mu bwubatsi, kandi ko hari inguzanyo y’ikigo kinini cy’inganda yamaze kongera gukora neza nyuma yo kugurwa; banki yizeye ko igipimo cy’inguzanyo mbi kizasubira munsi ya 5% mu gihembwe cya gatatu.

Banki irateganya kugabanya kwishingikiriza ku nguzanyo z’ibigo binini, igashyira imbaraga mu bakiliya ku giti cyabo, MSMEs n’ubuhinzi. Ubufatanye na Rwanda Premier League n’amakipe nka Rayon Sports buri no gukoreshwa mu kugera ku baturage batari basanzwe bakoresha serivisi za banki. Intego ya BK Group ubu si ukongera umubare w’ibigo ifite, ahubwo ni ukwagura no guhuza neza banki n’ishoramari byafashwe nk’ibikorwa by’ingenzi kugira ngo birusheho kunguka.

ART-MU8S4R7I-KZLJ.body:
Perezida Paul Kagame yasabye Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Iterambere (RDB) kwibanda cyane ku musaruro ugaragara, aho kumva ko kubona abashoramari ubwabyo ari iherezo ry’akazi. Yitabiriye inama y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi ya RDB ku biro byayo i Kigali, aho basuzumye ibyihutirwa bigamije kwihutisha iterambere rishingiye ku bikorera. Ubutumwa bwe bwari uko u Rwanda rugomba korohereza ibigo gukora, kwaguka no gutanga umusaruro, hamwe no gukomeza kubazwa inshingano no kunoza ibidukikije by’ubucuruzi.

U Rwanda ruri gushaka ko abikorera bagira uruhare runini kurushaho mu kwagura ubukungu. Guverinoma yashoye imari mu bikorwa remezo, serivisi za digital n’ivugurura ry’amategeko y’ubucuruzi, kandi ikomeza gushyira Kigali ku ishusho nk’ahantu h’ishoramari na serivisi ku rwego rw’akarere. Ikibazo ubu ni uguhindura ibyo bikorwa bikavamo ishoramari ry’abikorera rinini, ibicuruzwa byinshi byoherezwa hanze, ubukerarugendo n’akazi.

RDB iri hagati muri iyo gahunda kuko ishinzwe gukurura no korohereza ishoramari, guteza imbere ibicuruzwa byoherezwa hanze no kwamamaza ubukerarugendo. Nubwo u Rwanda ruzwiho ubuyobozi bwa Leta bukora vuba n’amategeko yorohereza ubucuruzi, amarushanwa yo gukurura imari mpuzamahanga muri Afurika aragenda yiyongera. Guverinoma irashaka ishoramari mu nganda, ikoranabuhanga, ubukerarugendo, ibikorwa remezo, serivisi z’imari n’izindi nzego zitanga akazi n’ibicuruzwa byoherezwa hanze.

Kagame yasobanuye ko intsinzi ya RDB idakwiye gupimwa gusa n’umubare w’abashoramari cyangwa imishinga yanditswe. Ikizamini nyacyo ni ukureba niba ibigo bitangira gukora, bikongera umusaruro, bigatanga akazi kandi bikongera ibyoherezwa hanze. Ibi ni ingenzi cyane ku Rwanda, igihugu kidakora ku nyanja kandi gifite isoko ry’imbere ritari rinini, bityo iterambere rirambye rigashingira ku musaruro, ishoramari no kugera ku masoko y’akarere n’isi.

Perezida yasabye Inama y’Ubuyobozi gukomeza kwibanda ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa no kunoza buri gihe uburyo abashoramari n’ibigo bakoreramo. Intego ni uguhindura ishusho nziza y’u Rwanda mu ishoramari rikora, imirimo n’inyungu zituruka ku bicuruzwa na serivisi bigurishwa hanze.

Yitabiriye inama y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi ya RDB ku biro byayo i Kigali, aho basuzumye ibyihutirwa bigamije kwihutisha iterambere rishingiye ku bikorera. Ubutumwa bwe bwari uko u Rwanda rugomba korohereza ibigo gukora, kwaguka no gutanga umusaruro, hamwe no gukomeza kubazwa inshingano no kunoza ibidukikije by’ubucuruzi.

U Rwanda ruri gushaka ko abikorera bagira uruhare runini kurushaho mu kwagura ubukungu. Guverinoma yashoye imari mu bikorwa remezo, serivisi za digital n’ivugurura ry’amategeko y’ubucuruzi, kandi ikomeza gushyira Kigali ku ishusho nk’ahantu h’ishoramari na serivisi ku rwego rw’akarere. ART-MU8S4RU1-FLIV.body:
Urwego rw’Ubwiteganyirize mu Rwanda (RSSB) rwabaye nyir’ibigo bitatu bikomeye mu gutunganya ibiribwa, ibikoresho by’ubwubatsi n’ubwishingizi nyuma y’ubuguzi bwabaye mu minsi itanu. RSSB yaguze imigabane yari isigaye muri Inyange Industries na Ruliba Clays, mbere yo kugura BK General Insurance (BKGI) kuri miliyari 31.7 Frw, hafi miliyoni 22 z’amadolari ku gaciro k’ivunjisha kariho. RSSB yari isanzwe ifite 40% bya Inyange na 50% bya Ruliba, igura imigabane yari isigaye ya 60% na 50% kuri Crystal Ventures Limited.

Umutungo RSSB icunga ugeze kuri tiriyari 3.9 Frw, hafi kabiri uwari uhari mu myaka itanu ishize. Umuyobozi Mukuru Regis Rugemanshuro yavuze ko ubu buguzi buri muri gahunda nshya y’imyaka itanu igamije kubona inyungu zirambye, z’igihe kirekire kandi zigenzura ibyago ku banyamuryango ba pansiyo. Intego si ukugira ibigo byinshi gusa, ahubwo ni uko ibyo bigo bitanga inyungu kandi agaciro kabyo kakazamuka bigakomeza portfolio ya pansiyo.

Inyange, uruganda runini rw’ibiribwa n’ibinyobwa mu Rwanda, rwongereye amafaranga yinjiza ava kuri miliyari 28 Frw mu 2021 agera kuri miliyari 68.9 Frw mu 2025, kandi rwunguka miliyari 1.35 Frw nyuma y’imisoro umwaka ushize. Rwashoye miliyoni 54 z’amadolari mu ruganda rw’ifu y’amata i Nyagatare rushobora kwakira litiro 650,000 z’amata ku munsi, harimo litiro 500,000 zikoreshwa mu gukora ifu y’amata. Agaciro k’umutungo usigaye wa Inyange kagereranijwe na miliyari 61.2 Frw.

Ruliba Clays, ikora ibikoresho by’ubwubatsi, yarangije uruganda rwa kabiri rwikubye kabiri ubushobozi bw’umusaruro, kandi agaciro k’umutungo wayo kagereranijwe na miliyari 40 Frw. BKGI yo yungutse nyuma y’imisoro miliyari 4.7 Frw mu 2025, ivuye kuri miliyari 2.7 Frw mu 2021. RSSB irateganya kuyihuza n’inyungu isanzwe ifite muri SONARWA General Insurance na SONARWA Life Assurance.

RSSB ivuga ko ishobora mu gihe kizaza kwinjiza abashoramari b’inzobere cyangwa kugurisha igice cy’imigabane binyuze ku Isoko ry’Imari n’Imigabane ry’u Rwanda cyangwa irya Nairobi. Ibi byatuma abandi bashoramari, harimo Abanyarwanda, bagira imigabane mu bigo ubu bigenzurwa n’ikigega cya pansiyo. Byerekana ko RSSB iri kuva ku nshingano yo kubika no gushora mu mpapuro z’agaciro gusa, ikajya no kuba umushoramari w’igihe kirekire mu nganda, ubuhinzi, ubwubatsi na serivisi z’imari.

Ikizamini gikomeye ni ukureba niba gukoresha ubwizigame bw’abakozi mu kugura ibigo bikora bizatanga inyungu ihagije. RSSB yahaye iyi gahunda imyaka itanu kugira ngo ibigo birusheho gukora neza, byunguke, bitange dividends kandi agaciro k’imigabane kiyongere, bityo pansiyo z’abanyamuryango zirusheho kugira umutekano.

ART-MU8S4SGH-PZLX.title: Bank of Kigali yatangije Employee Banking Solution ihuriza hamwe serivisi z’imari z’abakozi
ART-MU8S4SGH-PZLX.subtitle: Bank of Kigali (BK) yatangije “Employee Banking Solution”, serivisi ihuriza hamwe uburyo bwo kwishyura imishahara, kuzigama, inguzanyo, ishoramari na banki ya digital kugira ngo abakozi babone serivisi z’imari mu buryo bworoshye kandi bwihuse.
ART-MU8S4SGH-PZLX.summary: Bank of Kigali (BK) yatangije “Employee Banking Solution”, serivisi ihuriza hamwe uburyo bwo kwishyura imishahara, kuzigama, inguzanyo, ishoramari na banki ya digital kugira ngo abakozi babone serivisi z’imari mu buryo bworoshye kandi bwihuse. Yatangijwe ku wa 27 Kanama mu nama y’abayobozi bashinzwe abakozi yabereye muri Serena Hotel i Kigali, yitabiriwe n’abayobozi ba HR barenga 120 baturutse mu bigo bikomeye. BK ivuga ko iyi gahunda inagamije gushimangira ubufatanye n’abakoresha.
ART-MU8S4SGH-PZLX.body:
Bank of Kigali (BK) yatangije “Employee Banking Solution”, serivisi ihuriza hamwe uburyo bwo kwishyura imishahara, kuzigama, inguzanyo, ishoramari na banki ya digital kugira ngo abakozi babone serivisi z’imari mu buryo bworoshye kandi bwihuse. Yatangijwe ku wa 27 Kanama mu nama y’abayobozi bashinzwe abakozi yabereye muri Serena Hotel i Kigali, yitabiriwe n’abayobozi ba HR barenga 120 baturutse mu bigo bikomeye. BK ivuga ko iyi gahunda inagamije gushimangira ubufatanye n’abakoresha.

Désiré Rumanyika, Chief Digital and Retail Officer muri BK, yavuze ko banki yibanze ku bayobozi ba HR kuko ari bo bahuza banki n’abakozi b’ibigo. Inama yari igamije kubereka serivisi no kumva neza ibyo abakozi bakeneye mu bijyanye n’imari. BK kandi iri kugerageza koroshya imyumvire no kugera kuri serivisi z’imari mu gihe serivisi za banki zirushaho kujya kuri digital.

Employee Banking Solution ihuriza hamwe salary processing na payroll, uburyo bwo kuzigama, inguzanyo, amahirwe y’ishoramari, serivisi za digital, Open API n’izindi serivisi z’imari. Yubakiye ku bice bine: korohereza umukoresha, imibereho myiza y’imari y’umukozi, kwigenga mu bukungu n’ubumenyi mu by’imari. Banki yari imaze igihe itangiza ibice bitandukanye by’izi serivisi, ariko yahisemo kubishyira hamwe kugira ngo umukoresha n’umukozi babone urutonde rwuzuye rw’ibisubizo.

Rumanyika yavuze ko intego irenze gukoresha konti mu kohereza no kwakira amafaranga. Abakozi bakeneye uburyo bwo kuzigama no gushora imari kugira ngo bagire umutekano w’amafaranga mu gihe kiri imbere. BK irashishikariza abakiliya gukoresha telefoni mu bikorwa bisanzwe bya banki aho kujya ku mashami, kuko ibyo bishobora kubika igihe no kugabanya ikiguzi cya serivisi.

Banki kandi irashaka ko umubano n’abakoresha uba uwo guhana amakuru mu mpande zombi. Abayobozi ba HR bazajya bavuga ibyo abakozi bakeneye, banki na yo ihindure inzira n’ibicuruzwa kugira ngo bihuze n’ibyo bakeneye, aho kuba banki izana serivisi yamaze gufata umwanzuro. BK yanasezeranyije gukomeza kunoza serivisi z’abakiliya.

Rose Ngabire, Chief Operating Officer muri Bank of Kigali, yemeje ko banki izakomeza umubano n’abayobozi ba HR no kunoza uburyo abakozi bakoresha serivisi z’imari. Yasabye abashinzwe abakozi gukoresha iyi gahunda no gufasha abakozi kumenya serivisi ziboneka.

ART-MU8S4T2S-G7X5.title: Amabuye y’agaciro yazamuye ibyoherezwa hanze 51%
ART-MU8S4T2S-G7X5.subtitle: Ibyoherezwa hanze by’u Rwanda byazamutse 51% mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya 2026, bifashijwe n’amabuye y’agaciro, ibicuruzwa bitari bisanzwe byoherezwa hanze n’ibicuruzwa byongera koherezwa, nk’uko Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda yabigaragaje nyuma y’inama ya Komite ya Politiki y’Ifaranga yo ku wa 26 Kanama.

Muri iyo nama BNR yanazamuye urwunguko fatizo ho amanota 0.5 rugera kuri 8.75% mu rwego rwo kugabanya igitutu cy’izamuka ry’ibiciro. Amabuye y’agaciro y’u Rwanda aragenda arushaho kugira akamaro mu ruhererekane mpuzamahanga rw’amabuye y’ingenzi.
ART-MU8S4T2S-G7X5.body:
Ibyoherezwa hanze by’u Rwanda byazamutse 51% mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya 2026, bifashijwe n’amabuye y’agaciro, ibicuruzwa bitari bisanzwe byoherezwa hanze n’ibicuruzwa byongera koherezwa, nk’uko Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda yabigaragaje nyuma y’inama ya Komite ya Politiki y’Ifaranga yo ku wa 26 Kanama. Muri iyo nama BNR yanazamuye urwunguko fatizo ho amanota 0.5 rugera kuri 8.75% mu rwego rwo kugabanya igitutu cy’izamuka ry’ibiciro. Amabuye y’agaciro y’u Rwanda aragenda arushaho kugira akamaro mu ruhererekane mpuzamahanga rw’amabuye y’ingenzi.

Tungsten yo mu kirombe cya Nyakabingo iri kugenda iba isoko rikomeye ku isoko rya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho amakuru avuga ko ishobora kuba igera kuri 20% bya tungsten concentrate y’ibanze ikoreshwa muri icyo gihugu. U Bushinwa na bwo ni isoko rinini ry’amabuye y’agaciro y’u Rwanda, kandi kuva ku wa 1 Gicurasi 2026 amabuye y’agaciro, ikawa n’amavuta y’ibimera y’u Rwanda yemerewe kwinjira mu Bushinwa nta misoro ya gasutamo. Ibi bishyira amabuye y’u Rwanda hagati mu marushanwa ya Amerika n’u Bushinwa yo kubona amabuye y’ingenzi.

Nubwo ibyoherezwa hanze byiyongereye cyane, ibitumizwa hanze na byo byazamutse 28% mu gihembwe cya kabiri, bituma icyuho cy’ubucuruzi kigera kuri miliyoni 821.9 z’amadolari. Ubukungu bw’u Rwanda bwazamutse 10% mu gihembwe cya mbere cya 2026, ariko izamuka ry’ibiciro riva kuri 9.1% mu gihembwe cya mbere rigera kuri 13.2% mu cya kabiri no kuri 14.5% muri Nyakanga. Kuva mu Gushyingo 2025, BNR imaze kuzamura urwunguko fatizo ku gipimo cya 1.75%.

Ibiciro by’ibiribwa n’ingufu bikomeje kuba isoko rikomeye ry’igitutu. Izamuka ry’ibiciro by’ingufu ryageze kuri 45.7% mu gihembwe cya kabiri, naho core inflation iba 12.3%. BNR iteganya ko inflation izakomeza kuba hejuru y’intego yayo ya 2%–8% mu gice kinini cya 2026, nyuma ikagenda igabanuka ikagera hafi kuri 7.9% mu 2027.

Banki kandi yaburiye ku ngaruka zishobora guterwa na El Niño ku biciro by’ibiribwa no ku makimbirane yo mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati ashobora gukomeza kuzamura ibiciro by’ibicuruzwa ku masoko mpuzamahanga. Bityo, izamuka ry’ibyoherezwa hanze ni ikimenyetso cyiza ku bukungu, ariko ibitumizwa hanze n’izamuka ry’ibiciro bikomeje gusaba politiki yitondewe.

BNR iteganya ko inflation izakomeza kuba hejuru y’intego yayo ya 2%–8% mu gice kinini cya 2026, nyuma ikagenda igabanuka ikagera hafi kuri 7.9% mu 2027.

Banki kandi yaburiye ku ngaruka zishobora guterwa na El Niño ku biciro by’ibiribwa no ku makimbirane yo mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati ashobora gukomeza kuzamura ibiciro by’ibicuruzwa ku masoko mpuzamahanga. Bityo, izamuka ry’ibyoherezwa hanze ni ikimenyetso cyiza ku bukungu, ariko ibitumizwa hanze n’izamuka ry’ibiciro bikomeje gusaba politiki yitondewe.

Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda yazamuye urwunguko fatizo ho amanota 0.5 ruvuye kuri 8.25% rugera kuri 8.75% nyuma y’inama ya Komite ya Politiki y’Ifaranga yo ku wa 26 Kanama. Icyemezo cyafashwe mu gihe izamuka ry’ibiciro ku baguzi ryageze kuri 14.5% muri Nyakanga, hejuru cyane y’intego ya banki. Ni gukomeza gukaza politiki y’ifaranga yatangiye mu mpera za 2025.

BNR ivuga ko inflation rusange yazamutse iva kuri 9.1% mu gihembwe cya mbere cya 2026 igera kuri 13.2% mu cya kabiri, mbere yo kugera kuri 14.5% muri Nyakanga. Inflation y’umwaka wa 2026 iteganyijwe kuba impuzandengo ya 13.1%, munsi gato y’icyari cyateganyijwe mbere cya 13.9%, ariko iracyari hejuru y’intego ya 2%–8%. Core inflation yageze kuri 12.3% mu gihembwe cya kabiri, iy’ibiribwa bishya 7.3%, naho iy’ingufu igera kuri 45.7%.

Banki yasobanuye ko ibiciro by’ibicanwa bikomeye n’ibisukika hamwe na gaz yo guteka byagize uruhare mu kuzamuka kw’ibiciro by’ingufu. Iteganya ko inflation izakomeza kuba hejuru y’intego mu 2026, igasubira mu rugero rwifuzwa mu gice cya kabiri cya 2027; inflation ya 2027 iteganyijwe kuri 7.9%. El Niño ishobora kongera ibiciro by’ibiribwa, kandi amakimbirane yo mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati ashobora gukomeza kuzamura ibiciro ku masoko mpuzamahanga.

Nubwo ibiciro biri hejuru, ubukungu bw’u Rwanda bwazamutse 10% mu gihembwe cya mbere cya 2026. Ibyoherezwa hanze byiyongereye 51% mu gihembwe cya kabiri kubera amabuye y’agaciro n’ibindi bicuruzwa, ariko ibitumizwa hanze bizamuka 28%, bityo icyuho cy’ubucuruzi kiyongera 13.8% kiva kuri miliyoni 722.3 z’amadolari kigera kuri miliyoni 821.9.

Komite yavuze ko kuzamura urwunguko bigamije gutuma abantu n’ibigo batitega ko ibiciro bizakomeza kuzamuka cyane, kugabanya ingaruka z’izamuka ry’ibiciro ku bindi bice by’ubukungu no gufasha inflation gusubira mu ntego mu gice cya kabiri cya 2027. Kuva mu Gushyingo 2025, urwunguko fatizo rumaze kuzamurwa ku gipimo cya 1.75%.

ART-MU8S4U3V-I15A.title: U Rwanda rwafashe uburyo bushya bwo kubona amafaranga ahendutse yo guteza imbere igihugu
ART-MU8S4U3V-I15A.subtitle: U Rwanda ruri kwagura uburyo bwo kubona amafaranga y’iterambere ku batanga inguzanyo z’ubucuruzi hifashishijwe ingwate ya Banki y’Isi, kugira ngo igiciro cy’inguzanyo n’uburyo bwo kuyishyura bibe byoroshye.
ART-MU8S4U3V-I15A.summary: U Rwanda ruri kwagura uburyo bwo kubona amafaranga y’iterambere ku batanga inguzanyo z’ubucuruzi hifashishijwe ingwate ya Banki y’Isi, kugira ngo igiciro cy’inguzanyo n’uburyo bwo kuyishyura bibe byoroshye. Mu masezerano mashya, u Rwanda ruzabona miliyoni 82 z’amayero, hafi miliyari 141 Frw, hamwe na miliyari 15 z’amayeni y’u Buyapani. Izo miliyari 15 z’amayeni zari zingana hafi na miliyoni 94 z’amadolari cyangwa miliyari 139 Frw ku gaciro k’ivunjisha kariho.
ART-MU8S4U3V-I15A.body:
U Rwanda ruri kwagura uburyo bwo kubona amafaranga y’iterambere ku batanga inguzanyo z’ubucuruzi hifashishijwe ingwate ya Banki y’Isi, kugira ngo igiciro cy’inguzanyo n’uburyo bwo kuyishyura bibe byoroshye. Mu masezerano mashya, u Rwanda ruzabona miliyoni 82 z’amayero, hafi miliyari 141 Frw, hamwe na miliyari 15 z’amayeni y’u Buyapani. Izo miliyari 15 z’amayeni zari zingana hafi na miliyoni 94 z’amadolari cyangwa miliyari 139 Frw ku gaciro k’ivunjisha kariho.

Minisiteri y’Imari ivuga ko amafaranga azishyurwa mu myaka 15, harimo imyaka itandatu y’ikiruhuko mbere yo gutangira kwishyura igice cy’inguzanyo nyirizina. Ikintu cy’ingenzi ni uko Banki y’Isi itanga ingwate igabanya ibyago ku bigo by’imari by’ubucuruzi, bigatuma bigirira u Rwanda icyizere kandi bigashobora kuruguriza ku buryo bwiza kurushaho. Mu buryo bworoshye, Banki y’Isi ifasha u Rwanda kugaragara nk’uwizewe kurushaho ku batanga inguzanyo.

Inguzanyo igabanyijwe mu mayero no mu mayeni aho kwishingikiriza ku ifaranga rimwe ry’amahanga. Ibi biri muri gahunda yo gutandukanya inkomoko y’amafaranga y’iterambere; u Rwanda rwari rwarakoresheje uburyo nk’ubu mbere, rukabona miliyoni 213 z’amayero zishingiwe na Banki y’Isi. Amafaranga mashya azafasha gahunda za Leta mu bikorwa remezo, ubuzima, uburezi, ubuhinzi, imibereho myiza n’inganda.

Ku baturage, akamaro ntabwo kari ku mubare w’amafaranga gusa, ahubwo no kuba igihugu gishobora kuyabona ku kiguzi gito kandi kikabona igihe kirekire cyo kuyishyura. Imyaka itandatu y’ikiruhuko ituma Leta ibanza gukoresha ayo mafaranga mu mishinga mbere yo gutangira kwishyura igice kinini cy’inguzanyo. Ariko kuko ari umwenda, uko imishinga izatanga inyungu n’ubushobozi bw’igihugu bwo kwishyura biracyari ingenzi.

Impinduka nini rero ni uburyo u Rwanda ruri gushaka guhindura uburyo rutera inkunga iterambere: gukoresha ingwate ya Banki y’Isi kugira ngo rubone amafaranga y’abikorera, gutandukanya amafaranga y’amahanga rufataho inguzanyo no kubona igihe kirekire cyo kwishyura.

ART-MU8S4UQA-9PCI.subtitle: Perezida Paul Kagame yemeye ko ibiciro by’amazu n’imitungo itimukanwa i Kigali byahenze ku Banyarwanda benshi, cyane cyane urubyiruko, ariko avuga ko ibyo bidakwiye gusobanurwa nk’aho inyungu z’iterambere ry’ubukungu zigerwaho n’abantu bake gusa.

Perezida Paul Kagame yemeye ko ibiciro by’amazu n’imitungo itimukanwa i Kigali byahenze ku Banyarwanda benshi, cyane cyane urubyiruko, ariko avuga ko ibyo bidakwiye gusobanurwa nk’aho inyungu z’iterambere ry’ubukungu zigerwaho n’abantu bake gusa. Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru cyo ku wa 24 Kanama, yabajijwe niba Kigali ishobora kuba umujyi utagishoborwa n’Abanyarwanda benshi, asubiza ko Leta iri gushaka ibisubizo ariko idashobora gusezeranya ko ibibazo byose bizaba byarangiye mu gihe gito. Yasobanuye ko umujyi, abaturage n’ibikenewe byose bikomeje kwiyongera.

Kagame yavuze ko ikibazo cy’amazu gikwiye kureberwa hamwe n’iterambere ry’imibereho ryabaye mu gihugu mu myaka hafi 15 ishize. Yavuze ko iterambere ritibanze i Kigali cyangwa ku itsinda rito ry’abantu, ahubwo ko mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu hagaragara impinduka ku mibereho y’abaturage basanzwe. Yanavuze ko, mu myumvire ye, iterambere ry’u Rwanda risaranganywa ku buryo buringaniye kurusha ahandi henshi, nubwo yemeye ko hakiri ibibazo byinshi by’ubukungu n’imibereho.

Perezida ntiyahakanye ko amazu n’imitungo itimukanwa bihenze ku Banyarwanda benshi. Ahubwo yavuze ko Guverinoma yateye intambwe mu mibereho y’abaturage mu gihugu hose kandi ko igitutu ku mazu i Kigali gifitanye isano n’iterambere ryihuse ry’umujyi, kwiyongera kw’abaturage n’ibikenewe. Mu buryo bwe, ikibazo ni ugukomeza guteza imbere igihugu no gukemura ibibazo bishya biterwa n’iryo terambere.

Inzu 688 zubatswe muri gahunda ya Mpazi Rehousing Model mu Murenge wa Gitega, Akarere ka Nyarugenge, ni rumwe mu ngero za gahunda za Leta zo kuvugurura ahatuwe hatateguwe neza. Kagame yavuze ko atari ukuri gusezeranya ko umujyi ukura vuba uzagera aho udafite ikibazo na kimwe. Yashimangiye ko igikwiye ari kwemera ibibazo bihari, kubikemura no gukomeza urugendo rw’iterambere.

ART-MU8S4VCN-6Q4A.title: Bank of Kigali iri kwagura serivisi ku bigo by’Abashinwa uko ubucuruzi bw’u Rwanda n’u Bushinwa bwiyongera
ART-MU8S4VCN-6Q4A.subtitle: Bank of Kigali iri kwishyira ku mwanya wo kubona igice kinini cya serivisi z’imari zikenewe n’ibigo by’Abashinwa bikorera mu Rwanda, cyane cyane kwishyurana ku mipaka, trade finance n’ishoramari.
ART-MU8S4VCN-6Q4A.summary: Bank of Kigali iri kwishyira ku mwanya wo kubona igice kinini cya serivisi z’imari zikenewe n’ibigo by’Abashinwa bikorera mu Rwanda, cyane cyane kwishyurana ku mipaka, trade finance n’ishoramari. Ku wa 21 Kanama, banki yakiriye abagize umuryango w’abacuruzi b’Abashinwa muri M Hotel i Kigali binyuze muri BK Business Club, ihuza abacuruzi, abayobozi ba BK n’abafatanyabikorwa ngo baganire ku mabanki, ubucuruzi n’ishoramari hagati y’amasoko yombi. Imibare yatanzwe muri icyo gikorwa yavugaga ko mu 2024 mu Rwanda hari Abashinwa barenga 1,500, benshi bakora ubucuruzi kandi basanzwe bakoresha BK.
ART-MU8S4VCN-6Q4A.body:
Bank of Kigali iri kwishyira ku mwanya wo kubona igice kinini cya serivisi z’imari zikenewe n’ibigo by’Abashinwa bikorera mu Rwanda, cyane cyane kwishyurana ku mipaka, trade finance n’ishoramari. Ku wa 21 Kanama, banki yakiriye abagize umuryango w’abacuruzi b’Abashinwa muri M Hotel i Kigali binyuze muri BK Business Club, ihuza abacuruzi, abayobozi ba BK n’abafatanyabikorwa ngo baganire ku mabanki, ubucuruzi n’ishoramari hagati y’amasoko yombi. Imibare yatanzwe muri icyo gikorwa yavugaga ko mu 2024 mu Rwanda hari Abashinwa barenga 1,500, benshi bakora ubucuruzi kandi basanzwe bakoresha BK.

Ibigo byinshi by’Abashinwa bikorera mu Rwanda bigumana umubano ukomeye n’isoko ry’u Bushinwa, bigura ibikoresho n’ibicuruzwa, byishyura abatanga ibikoresho, byohereza inyungu cyangwa amafaranga yo gukoresha. BK iri kubaka serivisi zijyanye n’ayo mafaranga, harimo konti z’ibigo, working capital, Letters of Credit, inguzanyo z’ibikoresho n’ishoramari, project finance, trade finance ndetse n’ingwate zo mu masoko n’amasezerano. Intego ntabwo ari kwishyura gusa, ahubwo no gutera inkunga ubucuruzi ubwabwo.

Kwambukiranya imipaka mu kwishyurana ni kimwe mu byo banki yibanzeho. BK yatangije kohereza amafaranga kuri Alipay mu 2022, kandi ivuga ko hafi miliyoni 2 z’amadolari yoherejwe ava mu Rwanda ajya mu Bushinwa muri 2023. Ubu irashaka ko amafaranga na yo ava mu Bushinwa ajya mu Rwanda mu buryo butaziguye kandi iri gusuzuma konti zibikwa mu mafaranga y’u Bushinwa RMB, kugira ngo abakiliya batagomba kubanza kuyavunjamo amafaranga y’u Rwanda cyangwa amadolari.

Banki kandi irashaka kuba ikigo cya mbere mu Rwanda cyinjira mu buryo butaziguye muri CIPS, urubuga rw’u Bushinwa rwo kwishyurana ku mipaka mu mafaranga ya renminbi. Muri Kamena 2026, CIPS yari ifite abanyamuryango 210 b’ako kanya n’abandi 1,619 banyuramo ku buryo butaziguye, harimo 103 muri Afurika. Ambasaderi w’u Bushinwa mu Rwanda Gao Wenqi yavuze ko gahunda ya CIPS ishobora gutuma kwishyurana hagati y’ibihugu byombi biba byoroshye, byihuse kandi bidahenze.

Umuyobozi wa BK Dr. Diane Karusisi yavuze ko Abashinwa bakorera mu bwubatsi, amahoteli n’izindi nzego bakeneye serivisi zihoraho hagati y’u Rwanda n’u Bushinwa. BK ubu ikorana na Bank of Communications, China Construction Bank na Bank of China, kandi ishaka ko izaba ikorana na banki esheshatu z’Abashinwa mbere y’uko 2026 irangira. Ubucuruzi bw’ibihugu byombi bwageze hafi kuri miliyari 1.76 z’amadolari mu 2024, kandi ibicuruzwa byinshi u Rwanda rugura mu Bushinwa bituma imiyoboro myiza yo kwishyurana iba ingenzi.

Gahunda ya CIPS, ubufatanye na banki z’Abashinwa no kwagura Alipay ni igice cy’umugambi wa BK wo kuba umuhuza w’imari hagati y’amasoko yombi. Ikizamini kizaba niba izi serivisi zigabanya koko igiciro n’igihe byo kohereza amafaranga kandi niba banki ishobora guhindura ubucuruzi bw’u Rwanda n’u Bushinwa bukura bukavamo inyungu nyinshi.

content_blocks.text: Bank of Kigali iri kwishyira ku mwanya wo kubona igice kinini cya serivisi z’imari zikenewe n’ibigo by’Abashinwa bikorera mu Rwanda, cyane cyane kwishyurana ku mipaka, trade finance n’ishoramari. Ku wa 21 Kanama, banki yakiriye abagize umuryango w’abacuruzi b’Abashinwa muri M Hotel i Kigali binyuze muri BK Business Club, ihuza abacuruzi, abayobozi ba BK n’abafatanyabikorwa ngo baganire ku mabanki, ubucuruzi n’ishoramari hagati y’amasoko yombi. Imibare yatanzwe muri icyo gikorwa yavugaga ko mu 2024 mu Rwanda hari Abashinwa barenga 1,500, benshi bakora ubucuruzi kandi basanzwe bakoresha BK.

Ibigo byinshi by’Abashinwa bikorera mu Rwanda bigumana umubano ukomeye n’isoko ry’u Bushinwa, bigura ibikoresho n’ibicuruzwa, byishyura abatanga ibikoresho, byohereza inyungu cyangwa amafaranga yo gukoresha. BK iri kubaka serivisi zijyanye n’ayo mafaranga, harimo konti z’ibigo, working capital, Letters of Credit, inguzanyo z’ibikoresho n’ishoramari, project finance, trade finance ndetse n’ingwate zo mu masoko n’amasezerano. Intego ntabwo ari kwishyura gusa, ahubwo no gutera inkunga ubucuruzi ubwabwo.

Kwambukiranya imipaka mu kwishyurana ni kimwe mu byo banki yibanzeho. BK yatangije kohereza amafaranga kuri Alipay mu 2022, kandi ivuga ko hafi miliyoni 2 z’amadolari yoherejwe ava mu Rwanda ajya mu Bushinwa muri 2023. ART-MU8S4VV6-718K.subtitle: Banki Nyafurika Itsura Amajyambere (AfDB) irateganya gushora miliyoni 400 z’amadolari zirenga mu buhinzi bw’u Rwanda mu myaka itatu iri imbere, igabanya gato uburemere bw’ishoramari ryayo ryari ryibanda cyane ku bikorwa remezo.

Gahunda iri muri raporo ya 2025 Rwanda Country Portfolio Performance Review, isuzuma imishinga ya banki mu Rwanda kandi ikagaragaza ibyihutirwa mu myaka iri imbere. ART-MU8S4VV6-718K.body:
Banki Nyafurika Itsura Amajyambere (AfDB) irateganya gushora miliyoni 400 z’amadolari zirenga mu buhinzi bw’u Rwanda mu myaka itatu iri imbere, igabanya gato uburemere bw’ishoramari ryayo ryari ryibanda cyane ku bikorwa remezo. Gahunda iri muri raporo ya 2025 Rwanda Country Portfolio Performance Review, isuzuma imishinga ya banki mu Rwanda kandi ikagaragaza ibyihutirwa mu myaka iri imbere. Intego ni kongera amafaranga ajya mu nzego zitanga umusaruro.

Muri Ugushyingo 2025, agaciro k’imishinga AfDB yari ifite mu Rwanda kari hafi miliyari 2.6 z’amadolari, kiyongereye 71% ugereranyije na Ugushyingo 2023. Uyu ni umutungo w’imishinga ikomeje, si amafaranga banki itanga mu mwaka umwe. Kuva AfDB itangiye gukorana n’u Rwanda mu 1974, inguzanyo zose imaze gutanga zigeze hafi miliyari 3.8 z’amadolari.

Icyakora portfolio iriho yibanda cyane ku bikorwa remezo: amazi n’isuku bifite 34%, ingufu 30%, mu gihe ubuhinzi bufite igice gito. Banki ivuga ko kwibanda cyane kuri ibyo bice bishobora gutera ibyago kandi bikagabanya impamvu yo gukomeza gutera inkunga imishinga y’ibikorwa remezo yihariye, bityo ishaka kongera ubuhinzi n’izindi nzego zitanga umusaruro. Mu bice nka Bugesera n’Iburasirazuba muri rusange, amafaranga yo guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe arakenewe kugira ngo ubuhinzi burusheho gutanga umusaruro.

Raporo inagaragaza ikibazo cy’umuvuduko wo gushyira imishinga mu bikorwa. Imishinga iri mu bibazo yavuye kuri 13% mu 2023 igera kuri 26%, hagaragaramo gutinda kw’amasoko, inzira ndende zo kwemeza, guhindagurika kw’abakozi n’intege nke mu micungire y’amasezerano. Banki ivuga ko 36% gusa by’amafaranga yemejwe ari yo yari amaze gukoreshwa, bivuze ko igice kinini cyari kitaragezwa mu mishinga.

AfDB irashaka gukoresha uburyo bwa “readiness-first”, aho umushinga uba ugomba kuba ufite abakozi b’ingenzi, gahunda y’amasoko n’ibindi bisabwa mbere yo gutangira. Ku buhinzi, ikizamini kizaba niba amafaranga ateganyijwe ashobora guhinduka umusaruro mwinshi, akazi n’amafaranga yinjira mu miryango aho kongera gutinda mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa. Ubutumwa bwa raporo ni uko AfDB itagabanya uruhare rwayo mu Rwanda, ahubwo ishaka guhindura imiterere y’ishoramari ryayo.

Pipeline iriho irimo ibikorwa bikomeye bifite agaciro hafi miliyari 1.39 z’amadolari. Banki izakomeza kuba umufatanyabikorwa ukomeye w’u Rwanda, ariko igamije gutandukanya portfolio yari yiganjemo ibikorwa remezo ikayihuza n’inzego zitanga umusaruro.

ART-MU8S4WDS-U4V8.title: Kagame yagaragaje ibyihutirwa bitatu kugira ngo AI igirire akamaro buri wese
ART-MU8S4WDS-U4V8.subtitle: Perezida Paul Kagame, mu nama AI for Good Global Summit 2026 yabereye i Genève, yasabye kongera ishoramari mu bikorwa remezo bya digital, ubumenyi n’amahugurwa, hamwe n’imiyoborere ya AI.
ART-MU8S4WDS-U4V8.summary: Perezida Paul Kagame, mu nama AI for Good Global Summit 2026 yabereye i Genève, yasabye kongera ishoramari mu bikorwa remezo bya digital, ubumenyi n’amahugurwa, hamwe n’imiyoborere ya AI. Yavuze ko Afurika igomba kuva ku kuba umuguzi w’ikoranabuhanga gusa ikaba n’umuhimbyi n’umukoresha waryo ku rwego runini kugira ngo yungukire ku bukungu bwa digital. Yaburiye kandi ko amarushanwa ya geopolitiki ashobora kwimura ibitekerezo ku iterambere no kudindiza inyungu z’ikoranabuhanga.
ART-MU8S4WDS-U4V8.body:
Perezida Paul Kagame, mu nama AI for Good Global Summit 2026 yabereye i Genève, yasabye kongera ishoramari mu bikorwa remezo bya digital, ubumenyi n’amahugurwa, hamwe n’imiyoborere ya AI. Yavuze ko Afurika igomba kuva ku kuba umuguzi w’ikoranabuhanga gusa ikaba n’umuhimbyi n’umukoresha waryo ku rwego runini kugira ngo yungukire ku bukungu bwa digital. Yaburiye kandi ko amarushanwa ya geopolitiki ashobora kwimura ibitekerezo ku iterambere no kudindiza inyungu z’ikoranabuhanga.

Icyihutirwa cya mbere ni ibikorwa remezo: ubushobozi bwo kubara amakuru, internet yizewe n’ingufu zihagije. Icya kabiri ni uburezi n’ubumenyi, aho Kagame yavuze ko impano ziri hose ariko amahirwe yo kuzikoresha atari hose, asaba za kaminuza n’ibigo by’amahugurwa guhora bivugurura amasomo kugira ngo ahuze n’ikoranabuhanga rishya. Icya gatatu ni imiyoborere yubaka kubazwa inshingano n’icyizere cy’abaturage; yavuze ko ubwoba bw’impinduka za AI budakwiye kubuza ibihugu kuyikoresha.

U Rwanda rwatanzweho urugero rw’uko AI ishobora gukoreshwa mu buzima, binyuze muri Health Intelligence Center isesengura amakuru ako kanya kugira ngo ifashe gutahura hakiri kare indwara zishobora gukwirakwira no gufata ibyemezo vuba. Kagame yasabye ubufatanye bwa Leta n’abikorera mu kwagura ubushobozi bwo kubara amakuru, internet n’ingufu, ari byo shingiro ry’iterambere rya AI. Yanashimangiye ko ibihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere bidakwiye gusigara inyuma mu mategeko n’umutekano bya AI.

Perezida yavuze ko urubyiruko rwa Afurika ari amahirwe y’igihe kirekire, kuko mu 2050 umugabane uteganyijwe kugira abakozi benshi kandi bakura vuba kurusha ahandi ku isi. Yasabye kubashoramo imari, avuga ko inyungu zabyo zagirira akamaro Afurika n’isi. Smart Africa Alliance ayoboye yashyizeho Africa AI Council umwaka ushize kugira ngo ifashe gutegura icyerekezo cy’umugabane kuri AI.

Ku ruhande rw’inama, Kagame yifatanyije na Doreen Bogdan-Martin wa ITU na Marc Benioff wa Salesforce mu gutangiza AI for Good Global Commission, igamije ubufatanye mpuzamahanga ku iterambere no gukoresha AI mu buryo buboneye. Inama yabaye kuva ku wa 7 kugeza ku wa 10 Nyakanga, ihuza abakuru b’ibihugu, abayobozi ba UN, ibigo by’ikoranabuhanga n’abashakashatsi ku gukoresha AI mu iterambere rirambye no gukemura ibibazo by’umutekano, imiyoborere no kugera kuri AI ku buryo bungana.

ART-MU8S4X04-B3SH.title: Mastercard Foundation yashyigikiye startups umunani za EdTech mu Rwanda, zigamije kugera ku banyeshuri 40,000
ART-MU8S4X04-B3SH.subtitle: Mastercard Foundation EdTech Fellowship Rwanda yatangijwe mu Rwanda, igiye gufasha ibigo umunani by’ikoranabuhanga mu burezi.
ART-MU8S4X04-B3SH.summary: Mastercard Foundation EdTech Fellowship Rwanda yatangijwe mu Rwanda, igiye gufasha ibigo umunani by’ikoranabuhanga mu burezi. Biteganyijwe ko mu mezi 18 bizagera nibura ku banyeshuri 40,000, kandi buri kigo gishobora kubona inkunga igera ku madolari 50,000 hamwe n’ubujyanama, ubufasha mu kwagura ubucuruzi no kwitegura ishoramari. Ni gahunda ije mu gihe uburezi bw’u Rwanda bugenda buva ku kwibanda gusa ku kubona ishuri, bukibanda no ku ireme ry’ibyo abanyeshuri biga n’ubumenyi bazakenera mu gihe kiri imbere.
ART-MU8S4X04-B3SH.body:
Mastercard Foundation EdTech Fellowship Rwanda yatangijwe mu Rwanda, igiye gufasha ibigo umunani by’ikoranabuhanga mu burezi. Biteganyijwe ko mu mezi 18 bizagera nibura ku banyeshuri 40,000, kandi buri kigo gishobora kubona inkunga igera ku madolari 50,000 hamwe n’ubujyanama, ubufasha mu kwagura ubucuruzi no kwitegura ishoramari. Ni gahunda ije mu gihe uburezi bw’u Rwanda bugenda buva ku kwibanda gusa ku kubona ishuri, bukibanda no ku ireme ry’ibyo abanyeshuri biga n’ubumenyi bazakenera mu gihe kiri imbere.

Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Uburezi Claudette Irere yavuze ko ikoranabuhanga rishobora kongera uburyo bwo kugera ku burezi, ireme n’uburinganire, ariko ko udushya tugomba gushingira ku bibazo nyabyo by’u Rwanda no ku bimenyetso. Yavuze ko ibisubizo bigomba gutegurwa hashingiwe ku byo abanyeshuri, abarimu, amashuri n’urwego rw’uburezi bakeneye. Guhuza abahanga mu ikoranabuhanga n’abashinzwe politiki n’uburezi bishobora kandi gufasha kwihangira imirimo no guteza imbere gahunda ya digital y’igihugu.

Alex Ntale uyobora Rwanda ICT Chamber yavuze ko nubwo EdTech mu Rwanda iri gukura, startups nyinshi zigorwa no kugera mu mashuri, kubona imari no kubona ubufasha bwo kwaguka. Fellowship izakorana na Carnegie Mellon University Africa kugira ngo ibigo byinjize learning science mu bicuruzwa byabyo. Ibi ni ingenzi kuko benshi mu bashinze EdTech baba baturuka mu ikoranabuhanga ariko batari inzobere mu myigire, kandi ibicuruzwa bigomba kugaragaza ko bizana umusaruro w’ukuri mu kwiga.

Rodwell Mangisi wa Mastercard Foundation yavuze ko intego ya nyuma atari gufasha ibigo gusa, ahubwo ari kongera amahirwe y’abiga, cyane cyane abari mu bice bitagerwaho na serivisi. Fellowship ikorera mu bihugu 12 bya Afurika kandi imaze gufasha ba rwiyemezamirimo 249, udushya twabo tukagera ku banyeshuri barenga miliyoni eshanu. Mu Rwanda, gahunda ishaka guteza imbere ibisubizo by’imbere mu gihugu bishobora gukemura ibibazo by’uburezi kandi bikagira uruhare mu kwaguka kwa EdTech muri Afurika.

Zora Robotics, imwe mu startups umunani zatoranyijwe, irateganya kugeza robotics, coding na AI mu baturage bo mu cyaro, ikubaka centres z’abaturage kandi igatoza abarimu n’abatoza bo mu turere. Intego ni uko abana n’urubyiruko batari basanzwe bafite amahirwe yo kubona iri koranabuhanga babona amahirwe asa n’ay’abo mu mijyi. Umusaruro wa fellowship uzapimwa cyane n’umubare w’abanyeshuri bahinduriwe amahirwe n’ibisubizo byakozwe mu Rwanda, aho kuba umubare wa startups gusa.

Mu Rwanda, gahunda ishaka guteza imbere ibisubizo by’imbere mu gihugu bishobora gukemura ibibazo by’uburezi kandi bikagira uruhare mu kwaguka kwa EdTech muri Afurika.

Zora Robotics, imwe mu startups umunani zatoranyijwe, irateganya kugeza robotics, coding na AI mu baturage bo mu cyaro, ikubaka centres z’abaturage kandi igatoza abarimu n’abatoza bo mu turere. Intego ni uko abana n’urubyiruko batari basanzwe bafite amahirwe yo kubona iri koranabuhanga babona amahirwe asa n’ay’abo mu mijyi. Umusaruro wa fellowship uzapimwa cyane n’umubare w’abanyeshuri bahinduriwe amahirwe n’ibisubizo byakozwe mu Rwanda, aho kuba umubare wa startups gusa.
