Abayobozi mu siporo, imari, Leta n’ikoranabuhanga bahuriye i Kigali baganira ku buryo Basketball Africa League (BAL) ishobora guhuza urubyiruko n’amahirwe y’ubukungu. BAL iri kugenda iva ku kuba amarushanwa ya siporo gusa ikaba ahantu ihuriro ry’imyidagaduro, umuco n’ubukungu bw’urubyiruko.

Perezida wa BAL Amadou Gallo Fall yavuze ko iyi mpinduka atari iy’ishusho gusa, ahubwo ari iy’imiterere y’inganda. Urubyiruko ruri gukora ubukungu buriho ariko akenshi buri mu buryo butatanye kandi butemewe neza, bityo ikibazo ari ukubuhuza n’imari, politiki n’ikoranabuhanga. Imikino ya BAL isigaye ibonwa nk’ahantu urubyiruko ruhurira, rukabona icyizere n’amahirwe, kandi ibikorwa nka tournaments zo hasi, gusana ibibuga n’imishinga y’abaturage bikaba bishobora guhuza siporo n’akazi.

Dr. Diane Karusisi uyobora Bank of Kigali yavuze ko ikigo kimwe kidashobora gukemura ibibazo by’imari bya Afurika, bityo icyizere gitangwa na banki kigomba guhuzwa n’uburyo bworoshye kandi bwihuse butangwa n’amafaranga ya digital. Minisitiri w’Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri ICT n’Innovation Yves Iradukunda yavuze ko amategeko agomba gukurikira uburyo abantu babaho kandi bakora, akorohereza urubyiruko kwambuka imipaka no gukora ubucuruzi rutabangamiwe n’inzitizi zidakenewe. Guhuza digital identity, uburyo bwo kwishyurana n’amategeko hagati y’ibihugu byagaragajwe nk’ibikenewe.

Wave, ifite abakoresha barenga miliyoni 25 mu masoko 10 ya Afurika, yavuze ko mobile money imaze kuba igice cy’ibikorwa bya buri munsi by’urubyiruko. Abantu bohereza amafaranga, bakira ubwishyu kandi bagakora ubucuruzi buto kuri telefoni; Wave ivuga ko intego yayo atari gusimbura inzego zisanzwe ahubwo ari koroshya kugera kuri serivisi mu buryo buhendutse kandi bugera aho abantu baba n’aho bakorera.

Ibiganiro byagaragaje ko siporo ishobora kuba ahantu ho guhurira no kubaka identity y’urubyiruko, imari igahindura ibikorwa bitanditse neza bikaba amafaranga anyura mu buryo buzwi, naho politiki ikaba urwego rutuma ibyo byose byaguka hakurya y’imipaka. Abitabiriye bavuze ko ubukungu buyobowe n’urubyiruko kandi bushingiye kuri digital butakiri igitekerezo cya kure; burahari, kandi ikibazo ari uguhuza ibice byabwo kugira ngo bugire umutekano, bukure kandi butange amahirwe menshi.

ART-MU8S4Y9X-QMFC.title: Impuguke: AI ntizasimbura abarimu, ahubwo izongera ubushobozi bwabo
ART-MU8S4Y9X-QMFC.subtitle: Impuguke mu burezi n’ikoranabuhanga zavuze ko Artificial Intelligence itagenewe gusimbura ubwenge bw’umuntu cyangwa abarimu, ahubwo ari igikoresho gishobora gutuma kwigisha, kwiga n’imirimo y’ubuyobozi bikorwa vuba kandi neza.
ART-MU8S4Y9X-QMFC.summary: Impuguke mu burezi n’ikoranabuhanga zavuze ko Artificial Intelligence itagenewe gusimbura ubwenge bw’umuntu cyangwa abarimu, ahubwo ari igikoresho gishobora gutuma kwigisha, kwiga n’imirimo y’ubuyobozi bikorwa vuba kandi neza. Ibi byagarutsweho muri EdTech Monday yatambutse kuri KT Radio ku wa 25 Gicurasi, ku nsanganyamatsiko y’uruhare rwa AI n’ikoranabuhanga rishya mu burezi bushingiye ku makuru. Nubwo hari ubwoba ko AI ishobora gukuraho imirimo y’abarimu, abatanze ibiganiro bavuze ko umuntu akomeza kuba hagati mu burezi.
ART-MU8S4Y9X-QMFC.body:
Impuguke mu burezi n’ikoranabuhanga zavuze ko Artificial Intelligence itagenewe gusimbura ubwenge bw’umuntu cyangwa abarimu, ahubwo ari igikoresho gishobora gutuma kwigisha, kwiga n’imirimo y’ubuyobozi bikorwa vuba kandi neza. Ibi byagarutsweho muri EdTech Monday yatambutse kuri KT Radio ku wa 25 Gicurasi, ku nsanganyamatsiko y’uruhare rwa AI n’ikoranabuhanga rishya mu burezi bushingiye ku makuru. Nubwo hari ubwoba ko AI ishobora gukuraho imirimo y’abarimu, abatanze ibiganiro bavuze ko umuntu akomeza kuba hagati mu burezi.

Dr. Christine Niyizamwiyitira, umushakashatsi mu ikoranabuhanga ry’uburezi, yavuze ko AI ishobora gusesengura amakuru y’abanyeshuri ako kanya, igafasha umwarimu kumenya abari gusigara inyuma no kubafasha kare. Gukurikirana buri munyeshuri mu buryo bw’intoki bishobora gufata amasaha menshi, mu gihe AI ishobora gutanga ibimenyetso by’ingenzi mu gihe gito. Ariko yashimangiye ko ubwenge, guhanga udushya n’ubushobozi bwo kwigisha abanyeshuri gutekereza ku byo AI ibaha bidashobora gusimburwa n’imashini.

Dieudonné Uwimana uyobora Mastery Hub Rwanda yavuze ko AI ishobora no kugabanya akazi ko gukosora ibizamini. Umwarimu ashobora kumara umunsi wose asuzuma ibizamini birebire by’abanyeshuri benshi, ariko AI igakora isuzuma rya mbere mu minota, umwarimu akibanda ku kugenzura no ku ireme. Yongeyeho ko hakenewe ibikubiyemo byinshi by’ikoranabuhanga mu Kinyarwanda kugira ngo abarimu n’abanyeshuri babigereho mu buryo bworoshye.

Vedaste Uwishema, Director of Emerging Technologies muri REB, yavuze ko intego ya Leta atari kugabanya abarimu ahubwo ari kubongerera digital literacy no kubategura gukoresha ikoranabuhanga mu ishuri. Mu 2025, ubufatanye na MIT bwahuguye master trainers 150 baturutse mu turere twose, nyuma bakigisha abandi kugeza ku barimu hafi 5,000 bamaze kubona amahugurwa mu ikoranabuhanga ry’uburezi. Intego y’igihe kirekire ni uko abarimu bose mu gihugu bagira ubumenyi bwa digital na AI.

Abatanze ibiganiro banagaragaje imbogamizi z’ibikorwa remezo, zirimo kubura data centres zihagije n’ubushobozi bunini bwo kubara amakuru bukenewe kuri AI igezweho. U Rwanda ruri kureba ubufatanye na cloud zo hanze no gushora mu ngufu n’ibikorwa remezo bya digital mu gihe kirekire. Nubwo ibyo bibazo bihari, impuguke zasabye abanyeshuri n’abarezi kwiga gukoresha mudasobwa n’ikoranabuhanga rishya kugira ngo badatakaza amahirwe mu bukungu bw’isi buri guhinduka vuba.

ART-MU8S4YWF-0E8J.body:
Rwandamotor yahurije i Kigali abakorera mu modoka, ingufu n’ubwikorezi mu gikorwa cya networking cocktail cyibanze ku modoka zikoresha ingufu nshya, mu gihe u Rwanda rukomeje kwimukira ku bwikorezi burambye. Abayobozi b’inganda, abafatanyabikorwa, abakiliya n’abashoramari bashoboka barebye udushya mu modoka z’amashanyarazi n’izikoresha uburyo buvanze. Igikorwa cyahuje kumenya ibicuruzwa bishya no kubaka umubano w’ubucuruzi.

Abafatanyabikorwa n’abaterankunga bamwe berekanye ikoranabuhanga n’ibisubizo bishyigikira ubwikorezi butangiza ibidukikije. Rwandamotor yakoresheje umwanya wo kugaragaza ko ishaka guteza imbere uburyo bw’ubwikorezi bwita ku bidukikije mu Rwanda no mu karere. Gahunda yari irimo ijambo ry’umuyobozi, ibiganiro by’abafatanyabikorwa, kwerekana ibicuruzwa no kuganira mu buryo bwisanzuye.

Abitabiriye babonye amakuru ku byerekezo bishya bya mobility, amahirwe y’ishoramari n’uburyo bwo gukorana. U Rwanda rukomeje gushyigikira green growth n’iterambere rihangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, aho imodoka z’amashanyarazi zifatwa nk’inkingi yo kugabanya imyuka ihumanya no kuvugurura ubwikorezi bwo mu mijyi. Icyo gikorwa cyabaye urubuga rwo guhuza ikoranabuhanga, abashoramari n’isoko muri uru rugendo.

ART-MU8S4ZIQ-9ZJP.body:
Ibihugu bigize Umuryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba (EAC) byatangije ikigega cy’akarere cy’ikoranabuhanga rya Artificial Intelligence kigamije gutera inkunga ubushakashatsi bukorerwa mu karere no guhindura imishinga ya AI ikaba ubucuruzi bushobora gushorwamo imari. Icyemezo cyatangajwe ku musozo w’Inama ya 4 ya EAC ku Bumenyi, Ikoranabuhanga n’Udushya yabereye i Kigali. Intego ni ukuva ku kuba akarere gakoresha platform z’abandi gusa, kagatangira no gukora, gutunganya no kubona agaciro k’amakuru n’ubumenyi bwako.

EAC igizwe n’u Burundi, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Kenya, u Rwanda, Sudani y’Epfo, Tanzania, Somalia na Uganda. Mu myaka irenga icumi, iterambere rya digital ry’akarere ryibanze ku kwagura mobile connectivity no gukoresha platform zaturutse hanze, ariko abayobozi bavuga ko inyungu n’ububasha ku makuru byakomeje kuva mu karere. Ikigega gishya kizatera inkunga flagship programs zifasha akarere gukora no kubyaza umusaruro intelligence yako, kandi mu nama hanahembwe urubyiruko rwakoze ibisubizo bya AI mu buhinzi bwizewe, fintech n’izindi nzego.

Minisitiri wa Uganda ushinzwe Science, Technology and Innovation Dr. Monica Musenero Masanza yavuze ko agaciro k’ubukungu kari kwimuka kuva ku butaka, umurimo n’imari kajya ku bumenyi n’amakuru. Yaburiye ko amakuru menshi ya Afurika adakoreshwa neza cyangwa agakoreshwa n’abandi, bigatuma umugabane ukomeza kuba umuguzi muri digital economy. Ikigega kizakoresha blended finance kandi gishake abikorera, kugira ngo udushya tw’akarere duhinduke ibigo bifatika kandi agaciro gakorerwa muri East Africa kagume no muri ako karere.

Minisitiri wa Tanzania w’Uburezi, Science and Technology Prof. Adolf Mkenda yavuze ko amafaranga yonyine adahagije, kuko hakenewe n’abantu bafite ubumenyi. Ibihugu biri gushyira imbaraga mu mahugurwa, ubufatanye mpuzamahanga, data science, guhuza amategeko y’amakuru, ibikorwa remezo bihuriweho n’ibigo by’indashyikirwa. Beatrice Askul Moe wa Kenya yavuze ko AI itakiri igitekerezo cya kure, ahubwo ari igikoresho cy’ingenzi ku mibereho n’iterambere.

Minisitiri wa Sudani y’Epfo ushinzwe ICT na Postal Services Ateny Wek Ateny yaburiye ko intsinzi izapimwa n’ibikorwa aho kuba amatangazo. Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga y’u Rwanda Dr. Usta Kaitesi na we yavuze ko gukemura icyuho cy’ibikorwa remezo, ubumenyi n’ishoramari bisaba igikorwa gihuriweho cy’akarere. ART-MU8S5050-4D7U.title: EdTechMondays: Uko abarimu b’u Rwanda bakiriye impinduka ya digital mu burezi
ART-MU8S5050-4D7U.subtitle: Abarimu mu Rwanda baragenda bava ku gutinya ikoranabuhanga, mu gihe digital systems zimaze kuba igice gisanzwe cy’amasomo n’imiyoborere y’amashuri.
ART-MU8S5050-4D7U.summary: Abarimu mu Rwanda baragenda bava ku gutinya ikoranabuhanga, mu gihe digital systems zimaze kuba igice gisanzwe cy’amasomo n’imiyoborere y’amashuri. Mu kiganiro EdTechMondays cyatambutse kuri KT Radio ku wa 30 Werurwe 2026, impuguke zasobanuye ko ishoramari rihoraho muri internet n’ibikorwa remezo ryahinduye uburyo amashuri, cyane cyane ayo mu cyaro, akoresha ikoranabuhanga. Kera hari amashuri yabonaga mudasobwa akazipfuka kubera gutinya ko zangirika, ariko ubu ibikorwa byinshi by’uburezi bikorwa kuri digital.
ART-MU8S5050-4D7U.body:
Abarimu mu Rwanda baragenda bava ku gutinya ikoranabuhanga, mu gihe digital systems zimaze kuba igice gisanzwe cy’amasomo n’imiyoborere y’amashuri. Mu kiganiro EdTechMondays cyatambutse kuri KT Radio ku wa 30 Werurwe 2026, impuguke zasobanuye ko ishoramari rihoraho muri internet n’ibikorwa remezo ryahinduye uburyo amashuri, cyane cyane ayo mu cyaro, akoresha ikoranabuhanga. Kera hari amashuri yabonaga mudasobwa akazipfuka kubera gutinya ko zangirika, ariko ubu ibikorwa byinshi by’uburezi bikorwa kuri digital.

Thomas Ndayambaje, Senior Technologist muri MINICT, yavuze ko impinduka yateguwe kandi ishobora gupimwa. Abarimu basabwa gukoresha systems mu gushyiramo amanota no mu zindi nshingano, bityo nta buryo bwo gusubira ku mikorere y’intoki nk’uko byari bimeze. Isuzuma rikomeje rigaragaza ko ubwoba bw’ikoranabuhanga bwagabanutse cyane, nubwo hashobora kuba hari abantu bake bagifite imbogamizi.

Internet mu mashuri igeze hafi kuri 90%, ifashijwe n’umuyoboro wa fibre optic ufite hafi kilometero 30,000. Mu mwaka w’amashuri 2023–2024, amashuri 3,082 yari afite internet; mu 2026 umubare wageze kuri 4,184 mu mashuri 4,996 yose. Amashuri 812 asigaye ari cyane cyane mu bice bya kure bifite ikibazo cy’amashanyarazi, kandi kuva mu 2022 hari aho hakoreshwa solar systems na satellite kugira ngo geography itaba inzitizi.

Shadrach Munyeshyaka uyobora Nyereka Tech yavuze ko gukemura imbogamizi zisigaye bisaba ubufatanye bw’inzego nyinshi. Ndoli Mitali wa BSC na we yavuze ko hari inshingano ihuriweho yo kurinda intambwe yatewe no kutongera gusubira ku bibazo byahindaga ikoranabuhanga mu mashuri. Guhuza kwagura amashanyarazi n’umuyoboro wa internet ni imwe mu nzira z’ingenzi.

Uko u Rwanda rukomeza digital transformation mu burezi, kuba abarimu baravuye ku gutinya bakajya ku gukoresha ikoranabuhanga ni intambwe ikomeye. Ikibazo gikurikira ni guhuza amashuri asigaye no gutuma ikoreshwa rya digital rigira ingaruka zigaragara ku ireme ry’imyigire.

ART-MU8S50RJ-EGGD.title: Minisitiri wa ICT w’u Rwanda: Afurika igomba kubaka AI yayo bwite
ART-MU8S50RJ-EGGD.subtitle: Minisitiri w’Ikoranabuhanga na Innovation w’u Rwanda Paula Ingabire yaburiye ko Afurika ishobora kwinjiza ubusumbane mu hazaza hayo ikomeje kwishingikiriza kuri AI zakozwe hanze.
ART-MU8S50RJ-EGGD.summary: Minisitiri w’Ikoranabuhanga na Innovation w’u Rwanda Paula Ingabire yaburiye ko Afurika ishobora kwinjiza ubusumbane mu hazaza hayo ikomeje kwishingikiriza kuri AI zakozwe hanze. Mu Nama ya 4 ya EAC ku Bumenyi, Ikoranabuhanga n’Udushya, yavuze ko systems zatojwe ku makuru yo hanze zishobora kwibeshya ku barwayi, amasoko cyangwa ibihingwa by’akarere. Yasabye ko Afurika itaba umuguzi wa AI gusa, ahubwo ikayishushanya, ikayubaka kandi ikayicunga hashingiwe ku makuru, indimi n’ibikenewe by’iwabo.
ART-MU8S50RJ-EGGD.body:
Minisitiri w’Ikoranabuhanga na Innovation w’u Rwanda Paula Ingabire yaburiye ko Afurika ishobora kwinjiza ubusumbane mu hazaza hayo ikomeje kwishingikiriza kuri AI zakozwe hanze. Mu Nama ya 4 ya EAC ku Bumenyi, Ikoranabuhanga n’Udushya, yavuze ko systems zatojwe ku makuru yo hanze zishobora kwibeshya ku barwayi, amasoko cyangwa ibihingwa by’akarere. Yasabye ko Afurika itaba umuguzi wa AI gusa, ahubwo ikayishushanya, ikayubaka kandi ikayicunga hashingiwe ku makuru, indimi n’ibikenewe by’iwabo.

Nubwo mobile network coverage muri East Africa irenga 90% kandi internet ikiyongera, abayobozi bavuga ko AI ikwiye kurebwa nk’ikibazo cya sovereignty, atari amahirwe y’udushya gusa. U Rwanda ruri gukoresha AI mu micungire y’ibikoresho by’ubuzima no gukurikirana indwara, ariko Ingabire yavuze ko ibikorwa remezo byonyine bidahagije. Iyo amakuru n’uburyo bukomeye bwo kuyatunganya bigenzurwa n’abandi, ibihugu bishobora kwinjiza ibitekerezo n’amahame bitajyanye n’imiterere y’akarere mu nzego z’ingenzi.

Prof. Idris Rai wo muri Inter-University Council for East Africa yavuze ko kaminuza nyinshi mu karere zitaritegura bihagije ku gihe cya AI, kubera curricula zishaje, ubushobozi buke mu bushakashatsi n’abantu bake bafite ubumenyi bwihariye. Ibihugu byinshi bya Afurika ntibiragera ku ntego ya African Union yo gukoresha 1% bya GDP mu bushakashatsi n’iterambere. Impuguke zaburiye ko gahunda zatatanye mu bihugu zishobora gutinda kurushaho, zisaba igikorwa gihuriweho.

Ku isi, AI iteganyijwe kongera agaciro karenga tiriyari 15 z’amadolari mu bukungu mbere ya 2030, kandi East Africa ishobora kubona inyungu igera kuri miliyari 200 z’amadolari mu myaka icumi. Ariko abayobozi bavuze ko agaciro katagira ownership gashobora kongera dependency. Bagira bati, akarere kadatera inkunga agenda yako kazakomeza kuba umuguzi w’ikoranabuhanga ry’abandi.

Inama yaganiriye ku ishyirwaho ry’ikigega cy’akarere cy’ubushakashatsi bwa AI, guhuza amategeko, ibikorwa remezo bihuriweho no kongera ubumenyi. Hari n’umuvuduko wo gushyiraho EAC AI sovereignty framework kugira ngo akarere kagire ijwi rimwe mu biganiro mpuzamahanga. Intego si ukwanga AI, ahubwo ni ukubaka ubushobozi bwo kugenzura amakuru, systems n’ibikorwa remezo kugira ngo inyungu z’ikoranabuhanga zigume no mu baturage ba Afurika.

ART-MU8S51DW-ZDSO.title: U Rwanda rwatangije FinTech Centre na Innovate Rwanda kugira ngo rushimangire ecosystem ya startups
ART-MU8S51DW-ZDSO.subtitle: U Rwanda rwatangije Rwanda FinTech Centre na platform ya Innovate Rwanda, bigamije kwihutisha udushya mu ikoranabuhanga ry’imari no guhuza neza startups n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa.
ART-MU8S51DW-ZDSO.summary: U Rwanda rwatangije Rwanda FinTech Centre na platform ya Innovate Rwanda, bigamije kwihutisha udushya mu ikoranabuhanga ry’imari no guhuza neza startups n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa. Byatangijwe ku mugaragaro muri Inclusive FinTech Forum 2026, yahurije hamwe abashinzwe politiki, abashoramari, ibigo by’imari n’abahanga mu ikoranabuhanga. Guverinoma ivuga ko bizafasha gushyira u Rwanda ku mwanya w’ihuriro rikomeye rya FinTech mu karere.
ART-MU8S51DW-ZDSO.body:
U Rwanda rwatangije Rwanda FinTech Centre na platform ya Innovate Rwanda, bigamije kwihutisha udushya mu ikoranabuhanga ry’imari no guhuza neza startups n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa. Byatangijwe ku mugaragaro muri Inclusive FinTech Forum 2026, yahurije hamwe abashinzwe politiki, abashoramari, ibigo by’imari n’abahanga mu ikoranabuhanga. Guverinoma ivuga ko bizafasha gushyira u Rwanda ku mwanya w’ihuriro rikomeye rya FinTech mu karere.

Innovate Rwanda ni urubuga rwa digital rutanga ishusho rusange y’ecosystem y’udushya mu gihugu. Rufasha abashaka gutangiza ibigo kubona ubushakashatsi, incubation, amakuru y’isoko, mentors n’amahirwe y’ishoramari, kandi rugafasha abashoramari kumenya startups zikora mu nzego runaka n’aho inkunga ikenewe. Esther Kunda ushinzwe innovation n’ikoranabuhanga rishya muri MINICT yavuze ko abantu benshi batangira ibigo ariko bakagorwa no kumenya aho bashakira ubufasha; platform igamije gushyira ayo makuru ahantu hamwe.

Rwanda FinTech Centre ni gahunda ihuriweho na Minisiteri ya ICT n’Innovation, Kigali International Financial Centre, Rwanda ICT Chamber, Rwanda FinTech Association na Luxembourg Cooperation. Ecosystem ya FinTech mu Rwanda ifite ibigo birenga 100, byinshi bikora mu kwishyurana no gutanga inguzanyo, ariko hakiri amahirwe menshi mu digital banking, kuzigama n’ubwishingizi. Centre izahuza startups, ibigo by’imari bisanzwe, regulators n’abashoramari kugira ngo haboneke serivisi nshya z’imari za digital.

Hortense Mudenge uyobora Kigali International Financial Centre yavuze ko centre izahindura icyerekezo cya politiki kikavamo ibisubizo bifatika byagura financial inclusion. Izafasha ubufatanye hagati ya FinTech n’amabanki, kubaka ubushobozi no gushyira mu bikorwa Rwanda FinTech Strategy. Minisitiri Paula Ingabire yavuze ko Rwanda FinTech Centre izagira uruhare rukomeye mu kubaka digital economy ifite imbaraga.

U Rwanda rumaze kugera ku rwego rwa financial inclusion rurenga 90%, bityo ikibazo gikurikira ni ukwagura serivisi zinoze kurushaho zirimo credit, savings, investment n’ubwishingizi. Abayobozi bizeye ko izi gahunda zizafungurira ba rwiyemezamirimo amahirwe mashya kandi zigafasha kwihutisha iterambere rya digital finance mu Rwanda no muri Afurika.

Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr. Justin Nsengiyumva aganira n’abamurika ibikorwa mu ihuriro rya gatatu rya Inclusive FinTech Forum 2026 ryabereye i Kigali.

Serigne Dioum, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa MTN Group Fintech, yavuze ko ikoreshwa ryihuse rya mobile money rigaragara ku masoko yose mu Rwanda ari intangiriro gusa.

Yagize ati: “Kugera kuri serivisi z’imari ni intambwe ya mbere gusa. Intego nyayo ni ubwigenge mu by’imari.” Yashimangiye ko niba Afurika ishaka kuyobora, sisitemu zayo zigomba kurenga kwishyura gusa zigatanga inguzanyo, kwizigamira n’ubwishingizi bifasha abantu kubaka umutungo urambye.

Laboratwari y’isi ya ‘FinTech igamije ibyiza’

Ihuriro ryo mu 2026 ryashyize Kigali ku mwanya w’ingenzi aho politiki, igishoro n’ikoranabuhanga bihurira. Mu gihe ibigo mpuzamahanga nka PayPal bitangaza gahunda yo kugaruka ku masoko ya Afurika uyu mwaka, startups zavukiye ku mugabane na zo ziragenda zohereza ibisubizo byazo hanze.

Kuva ku kumenya uburiganya hifashishijwe AI kugeza ku mbuga zo kwishyurana no kwishyurana hagati y’ibihugu zishingiye kuri blockchain zigabanya amafaranga y’ibikorwa byambukiranya imipaka kugeza kuri 70%, udushya twerekanwe i Kigali turi gushyiraho urugero rw’igihe gishya cy’ubukungu.

Mu ncamake, mu gihe isi ireba, Afurika iri kugaragaza ko ibikorwa remezo bya digitale bigera kuri bose atari gusa icyifuzo cy’aho hantu, ahubwo ari igishushanyo mbonera cy’ubukungu bw’isi bushobora guhangana n’ibibazo.

Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr. Justin Nsengiyumva aganira n’abitabiriye n’impuguke ubwo yasuraga ahamurikirwa ibikorwa muri Inclusive FinTech Forum 2026.

KIGALI — Igihe Afurika yari umuguzi gusa w’ibikoresho by’imari byakozwe ku isi kiri kurangira; igihe cyo kuba ari yo ibishushanya kiratangiye. Mu gihe Fintech Rwanda 2026 ihurira muri Kigali Convention Centre, intego ikomeye igaragara ni imwe: ubusugire mu by’imari bya digitale. Si ikibazo cyo kwishyura vuba cyangwa apps zigezweho gusa, ahubwo ni ukubaka ku bushake urusobe rw’umugabane rwihagije kandi rufite amakuru yarwo, imiyoboro yarwo yo kwishyurana n’ejo hazaza harwo.

Muri iki gice cya mbere cy’uruhererekane rw’amafoto, hagaragara ibihe by’ibanze by’iyi mpinduka. Kuva ku ngamba zo ku rwego rwo hejuru zaganiriwe na Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda kugeza ku ntambwe za mbere z’imiyoboro ihuriweho yo kwishyurana yambukiranya imipaka, Igice cya 1 kigaragaza abantu n’amabwiriza biri gushyiraho umusingi wa Afurika ya digitale itagira imipaka.

Amafoto: Melissa Isimbi Habineza | KT Press

Abayobozi baturutse muri guverinoma, imari n’ikoranabuhanga bateraniye i Kigali mu ihuriro rya gatatu rya Inclusive FinTech Forum.

Abubatsi b’ejo hazaza: abanyeshuri n’urubyiruko rw’abahanga mu ikoranabuhanga bitabiriye igikorwa muri Kigali Convention Centre, bahagarariye igisekuru kizazungura kandi kigakomeza kwagura urusobe rw’imari ya digitale rw’u Rwanda.

Intumwa ziturutse hirya no hino muri Afurika no hanze yayo zitabiriye Inclusive FinTech Forum yibanze ku mari ya digitale n’udushya.

Ihuriro ryahuje abafata ibyemezo n’abahanga muri FinTech bari kugena ejo hazaza h’ukugera kuri serivisi z’imari.

Haytham El-Maayergi, Visi Perezida Nshingwabikorwa wa Afreximbank, ageza ijambo ku bitabiriye.

Minisitiri w’Intebe yahuye n’impuguke baganira ku mikurire ya FinTech muri Afurika n’amahirwe yo kwagura serivisi z’imari ku mugabane.

Hortense Mudenge, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Kigali International Financial Centre (KIFC), ageza ijambo ku ntumwa.

Abitabiriye bakurikirana ibiganiro ku gushimangira ubukungu bwa digitale bwa Afurika n’ubusugire bwayo mu by’imari.

Guverineri wa Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda, Dr. Soraya Hakuziyaremye, atanga ijambo rifungura Inclusive FinTech Forum 2026.

Uretse ibiganiro bikuru, iri huriro ni n’ahantu h’ingenzi hahurira abashoramari ba venture capital na ba rwiyemezamirimo ba FinTech bo muri Afurika.

Intumwa zigirana ibiganiro byimbitse byo kubaka imikoranire muri Kigali Convention Centre. Izi nama zigaragaza “imyubakire yoroheje” y’umupaka mushya wa digitale, aho ubufatanye bwambukiranya imipaka bushyirwaho kugira ngo bukemure ibibazo bikomeye bya Afurika mu kugera kuri serivisi z’imari.

Itsinda ry’abafatanyabikorwa mpuzamahanga n’abahanga b’Abanyafurika bafata ifoto y’urwibutso na Minisitiri w’Intebe Nsengiyumva.

Kigali yakiriye impuguke mpuzamahanga ziri gukora ngo zihutishe impinduka za Afurika mu mari ya digitale.

Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr. Justin Nsengiyumva atanga ijambo ry’ingenzi muri Inclusive FinTech Forum 2026 yabereye i Kigali.

Ibiganiro by’abagize panel byasesenguye uruhare rw’ibikorwa remezo bya digitale mu kubaka sisitemu z’imari zishobora guhangana n’ibibazo.

Abayobozi n’abahanga ba FinTech bunguranye ibitekerezo ku buryo bwo gufungura ishoramari no kwagura serivisi z’imari za digitale.

Abayobozi n’abahanga ba FinTech bunguranye ibitekerezo ku buryo bwo gufungura ishoramari no kwagura serivisi z’imari za digitale.

ART-MU8S5546-JDCT.body:
Donald Munyeshuri, umwarimu wa siyansi ya mudasobwa akaba n’umujyanama wa ICT Club muri Lycée de Kigali (iburyo), Vedaste Uwishema, Umuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe Ikoranabuhanga Rishya mu Burezi muri REB (ibumoso), na Germaine Umukazana wa Kigali Today Radio (hagati) mu kiganiro cy’imbonankubone muri Kigali Today Studios ku wa Mbere, tariki ya 23 Gashyantare 2026.

Ku wa Mbere, tariki ya 23 Gashyantare 2026, abayobozi mu burezi n’abahanga mu guhanga udushya bitabiriye ikiganiro cy’imbonankubone cyateguwe na KT Radio kugira ngo basuzume impinduka za digitale zikomeje kuba mu mashuri y’u Rwanda. Ikiganiro cyibanze ku rwego rw’imyiteguro no ku ngaruka zifatika ikoranabuhanga rifite mu kunoza imyigire.

Abayobozi ba Rwanda Education Board batangaje intambwe ikomeye mu guhuza amashuri na internet. Mu mashuri 3,485 y’uburezi bw’ibanze mu gihugu, 3,158 ubu afite internet. Bongeyeho ko amashuri 1,847 yatoranyijwe kugira ngo ashyirwemo smart classrooms kandi imirimo yatangiye.

Byongeye, amashuri 1,848 ubu afite mudasobwa zikoreshwa mu myigishirize, mu gihe ibikorwa byo guha ibikoresho amashuri 327 asigaye bikomeje.

Vedaste Uwishema, Umuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe Ikoranabuhanga Rishya mu Burezi muri REB, yavuze ko nta mubyeyi usabwa gutanga amafaranga kugira ngo ishuri ry’umwana we ribone ibikoresho bya digitale.

Yagize ati: “Ni inshingano za Leta ibinyujije muri Minisiteri y’Uburezi, hamwe n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa n’abarebwa n’iki kibazo, kuhakikisha ko amashuri yose n’abanyeshuri bose bafashwa kimwe kandi nta vangura.”

REB ikomeje gukorana n’abafatanyabikorwa b’abikorera binyuze mu buryo buboneye bwo gutanga amasoko, inasuzuma ibisubizo bishingiye ku mirasire y’izuba ku mashuri adafite amashanyarazi. Intego y’igihe kirekire ni uko amashuri yose yo mu gihugu agira internet.

Gukomeza ibikorwa remezo n’uburinganire

Internet ikoresha 4G na fibre optic yagutse vuba, ariko gukomeza intambwe imaze guterwa bisaba ishoramari n’ubufatanye bihoraho. Ubufatanye n’ibigo byo mu gihugu n’imiryango mpuzamahanga bufatwa nk’uburyo bw’ingenzi bwo kwihutisha gushyiraho ibikorwa no kubishyigikira mu gihe kirekire.

Donald Munyeshuri, umwarimu wa computer science akaba n’umujyanama wa ICT Club muri Lycée de Kigali, yasobanuye uko ikoranabuhanga riri guhindura imikorere ya buri munsi. Yavuze ko imbuga za digitale zorohereje gutegura amasomo, gutanga raporo no gukora isuzuma.

Yagize ati: “Kwiyigisha ubu birashoboka. Ibisubizo bishobora kuboneka muri sisitemu zihujwe n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Ibizamini n’Ubugenzuzi bw’Amashuri. Guteranya amanota byoroheje kandi birihuta, bigatuma abarimu bibanda cyane ku kwigisha.”

Yavuze ko nubwo hakiri ibibazo, igenamigambi rigomba gutuma ibikoresho biboneka kandi ibibazo bisigaye bigakemurwa mu gihe abakozi bamenyera sisitemu nshya babifashijwemo n’ubufatanye n’amahugurwa bihoraho.

Kwandika ubwitabire hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga no kurwanya guta ishuri

Ian Berulo Cyusa, washinze Berulo Foundation akaba ahagarariye abafatanyabikorwa b’ikoranabuhanga, yasobanuye ko hateguwe urubuga rukoresha ibikoresho bya digitale, birimo kumenya isura, kugira ngo rukurikirane ubwitabire mu gihe nyacyo.

Sisitemu ubu ikorera mu mashuri 1,173, ikurikirana abanyeshuri miliyoni 1.78 n’abarimu 32,000 mu turere umunani twose tw’Intara y’Amajyepfo, kandi hari gahunda yo kuyigeza no mu bindi bice by’igihugu.

Yagaragaje ko ubukangurambaga n’ubufatanye ari ingenzi kugira ngo ikoreshwe neza. Sisitemu yubakiye kuri serivisi za digitale zisanzweho kugira ngo yongere kubazwa inshingano no guha amashuri n’abafata ibyemezo amakuru ku gihe.

Ubufatanye n’inzego nka Mastercard Foundation, ICT Chamber na Rwanda Private Sector Federation bugaragaza uburyo bugenda bwaguka bwo guhuza ubuyobozi bwa Leta n’udushya tw’abikorera.

Jean Claude Nyandwi wahamagaye aturutse mu Karere ka Muhanga yashimye iterambere ryagezweho mu mashuri yahoze adafite amashanyarazi, ariko asaba ko hakomeza gushorwa imari muri mudasobwa kugira ngo bihuze n’iterambere rya internet.

Gahunda y’u Rwanda y’uburezi bwa digitale iri kuva ku gushyiraho ibikorwa remezo ikajya ku gutanga umusaruro ushobora gupimwa. Intambwe imaze guterwa ishingiye ku ishoramari rikomeza, imyiteguro y’abarimu n’ubufatanye bugera kuri bose.

ART-MU8SB4J5-MAOU.title: Igitutu cyo guhitamo ‘uruhande rwa Silicon’ gishyira 40% by’ibyoherezwa hanze bya ICT bya Koreya mu kaga
ART-MU8SB4J5-MAOU.subtitle: Inyandiko y’agateganyo nta tariki ifite
ART-MU8SB4J5-MAOU.summary: Inyandiko y’agateganyo nta tariki ifite. Icyo ni cyo cy’ingenzi. Ni umushinga w’inyandiko.
ART-MU8SB4J5-MAOU.body:
Mu ncamake

Inyandiko y’agateganyo nta tariki ifite. Icyo ni cyo cy’ingenzi.

Ni umushinga w’inyandiko. Nta tariki iriho. Ntawe uzi igihe izoherezwa, cyangwa niba izoherezwa na gato.

Ku wa 14 Kanama, Reuters yatangaje ko Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ya Amerika yari iri gutegura ibaruwa yohererezwa ibihugu 35 byashyize umukono ku “AI Opportunity Statement” muri Kamena. Umushinga w’iyo baruwa nta magambo menshi y’iterabwoba urimo; ahubwo usobanura birambuye icyo kuba umunyamuryango bivuze.

Iragira iti: “Kuba mu bintu byose ni nk’aho nta kintu na kimwe urimo.” Gusinya Pax Silica Declaration “si ukwinjira gusa ahubwo ni isezerano,” kandi iryo sezerano “ntirishobora kujyana no kuba umunyamuryango w’izindi gahunda zisubiramo kandi zinyuranye n’ibyo twiteze.”

U Bushinwa ntibuvugwamo na rimwe.

Ibihugu bizahabwa iyo baruwa birimo Koreya y’Epfo, u Buyapani na Australia. Icyo iyo baruwa iri kugerageza kongera gusobanura ni umukono Seoul yamaze gutanga.

Inyandiko Koreya yasinyiye mu Kuboza umwaka ushize nta ngingo y’uko abanyamuryango badashobora kujya mu yindi gahunda yari irimo

Dusubire ku wa 12 Ukuboza 2025. Visi Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga Kim Jin-a yari i Washington mu nama ya mbere ya Pax Silica Summit. Uwo muryango watangijwe na Jacob Helberg, Umunyamabanga Wungirije muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ya Amerika ushinzwe ubukungu. Ibihugu icyenda, birimo Koreya y’Epfo, Amerika, u Buyapani n’u Bwongereza, byarahuriye hamwe kandi birindwi muri byo byemera Pax Silica Declaration.

Helberg yashyize mu nteruro imwe ingingo nyamukuru ku rubuga rwa Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ya Amerika: “Niba ikinyejana cya 20 cyarashingiraga kuri peteroli n’ibyuma, ikinyejana cya 21 kizashingira kuri compute n’amabuye y’agaciro abifasha.”

Hari ikintu ibyo bihugu birindwi bitasinyiye: ingingo ibuza kuba mu zindi gahunda. Ntiyari ihari.

Mu nama ya kabiri yabaye mu mpera za Kamena, urutonde rwaragutse. Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi n’u Budage byatangajwe nk’abanyamuryango bashya, Helberg avuga ko abanyamuryango bazagera hafi kuri 24. Muri iyo nama kandi, ibihugu 35 byashyize umukono kuri AI Opportunity Statement. Kim na bwo yari uhagarariye Koreya y’Epfo.

Hanyuma Beijing na yo yubaka icyumba cyayo. Ku wa 16 Nyakanga i Shanghai, ibihugu 29 byashyize umukono ku masezerano ashyiraho Global Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization. Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga Wang Yi yasinyiye u Bushinwa, naho Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Loni António Guterres yari ahari. Ibihugu byashinze uwo muryango byiganjemo ibyo muri Afurika na Aziya, harimo u Burusiya na Brazil; nta guverinoma yo mu Burengerazuba yawinjiyemo.

Kubaka umuryango umwe byatwaye amezi umunani, kubaka undi ku ruhande rubangikanye bitwara ukwezi kumwe. Umushinga wakurikiyeho ushobora guhindura umuryango wa mbere ahantu umunyamuryango ashobora kuvanwamo.

Kazakhstan si yo ntego; ni urubuga rwo kugeragezaho

Hari igihugu kimwe kiri mu byumba byombi. Kazakhstan yinjiye muri Pax Silica muri Kamena, iba igihugu cya mbere cyo muri Aziya yo Hagati kibaye umunyamuryango kandi yakirwa i Washington, hanyuma ininjira mu muryango uyobowe n’u Bushinwa. Kugeza ubu ni cyo gihugu cyonyine cyemejwe ko kiri mu miryango yombi.

Umushinga w’ibaruwa ntushaka kwibasira Kazakhstan ubwayo, ahubwo ushaka gukemura urugero Kazakhstan ishobora gushyiraho. Ni yo mpamvu imvugo yakoreshejwe ari ingenzi.

Kubera ko ibaruwa itavuga u Bushinwa mu izina, igipimo nyacyo si “Wagiye ku ruhande rwa Beijing?” ahubwo ni “Wagiye muri gahunda inyuranye n’ibyo twiteze?” Iyo mvugo ishobora no gukoreshwa ku miryango itaravuka.

Ububasha bwo gufata uwo mwanzuro na bwo busigara i Washington. Ibindi bihugu ntibishobora kumenya amategeko mbere; bishobora gusa kumenyeshwa nyuma ko byayarenze. Umusesenguzi Rui Ma yavuze ko iyi baruwa ishobora gutuma Washington itakaza byinshi kurusha ibyo yunguka.

Washington yakoresheje ubu buryo mbere, ariko ubu ifite amakarita atandukanye

Urugero ruhita rwibukwa ni Clean Network. Muri Mata 2020, Umunyamabanga wa Leta wa Amerika Mike Pompeo yatangaje gahunda ya 5G Clean Path, naho Keith Krach akorana na guverinoma zitandukanye kugira ngo zivane kuri Huawei. Muri Gashyantare uwo mwaka Huawei yari yavuze ko ifite amasezerano 91 y’ubucuruzi bwa 5G. Mu mezi atandatu, Canada na Singapore bari bahindukiriye ibikoresho by’i Burayi, naho u Bwongereza bubujije Huawei muri 5G.

Ubu buryo bwarakoze, ariko bwashingiye ku bintu bitatu kandi ubu kimwe gusa ni cyo gisigaye neza.

Hari ibindi bisimbura Huawei byahise biboneka. Ibihugu byashoboraga kwimukira kuri Ericsson na Nokia bitaretse imiyoboro yabyo. Hari kandi igitutu gifatika: kuva mu 2019 Huawei yari ku rutonde rwa Amerika rw’ibigo bibujijwe ubucuruzi, ntibone semiconductors z’ingenzi. Ikintu gisigaye ni umuvuduko.

Mu 2026, ubundi buryo buri ku rundi ruhande. Open-weight models z’u Bushinwa zagabanyije cyane icyuho cy’imikorere, kandi ku bihugu bidashobora kugura ibikoresho bishya cyane bya computing, uruhande rwa Beijing rushobora gutanga ikintu gishobora gukururwa kuri internet. Pax Silica yo itanga uruvange rw’uburyo bwo kubona ishoramari, igenzura ryoherezwa hanze rihujwe, uburenganzira bwo kwinjira n’ubushobozi bwo gukumirwa.

Igiciro cyo kubara nabi si igitekerezo gusa. Raporo ya World Economic Forum hamwe na Oliver Wyman yasohotse muri Kamena yagereranyije ko gucikamo ibice kw’ubukungu bushingiye kuri geopolitiki buri mwaka gutwara hagati ya miliyari 213 na miliyari 307 z’amadolari. Ibi birushijeho kuba bibi, igihombo gishobora kugera kuri 6.4% by’umusaruro w’isi.

Ikibazo gikomeye ni uwishyura icyo giciro. Imisoro ku bicuruzwa n’imbogamizi ku ishoramari ntibikiri ku bihugu bifatwa nk’abanzi gusa; bigera no ku bukungu bw’inshuti nka Amerika, Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi, u Buyapani na Koreya y’Epfo. Isesengura rya IMF ryanzuye ko ibihugu bifitanye imikoranire yimbitse n’impande zombi ari byo bishobora guhomba cyane.

Koreya y’Epfo ni urugero rusobanutse. Imibare ya Minisiteri y’Ubumenyi na ICT na Minisiteri y’Ubucuruzi, Inganda n’Ingufu igaragaza ko muri Mutarama hafi 40% by’ibyoherezwa hanze bya ICT bya Koreya byagiye mu Bushinwa na Hong Kong. Icyifuzo cyo kuguma mu ruhande rumwe kiri ku gipimo kimwe n’isoko rigura hafi ibintu bine kuri buri icumi byoherezwa hanze.

Ingingo Koreya yari ikwiye kuganiraho ni uburyo bwo kuva mu masezerano

Koreya y’Epfo ntabwo iri mu kurenga amategeko. Ni imwe mu bihugu byatangiranye na Pax Silica, ni umwe mu basinye 35 kandi ntabwo iri mu muryango uyobowe n’u Bushinwa.

Isomo ni uburyo ibihugu byinjira mu masezerano nk’aya. Icyo Koreya yasinyiye mu Kuboza cyari itangazo ridategeka; muri Kanama haza umushinga w’ingingo yo kutabangikanya n’indi gahunda. Igisubizo si ugukabya. Ibihugu bishobora gusaba ko inyandiko z’ubunyamuryango zisobanura ibyo bishobora kubangikana n’amabwiriza yo kuvamo, ku buryo “ikintu gisubiramo” gisobanurwa hamwe aho gusobanurwa nyuma n’uruhande rumwe.

Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru muri Kamena, Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga yavuze ko kubona amabuye y’agaciro y’ingenzi mu buryo buhamye ari inkingi y’umutekano w’ubukungu, kandi Koreya izajya mu biganiro n’imiryango itandukanye kugira ngo igabanye ibyago mu miyoboro y’ibicuruzwa. Uko kujya mu mishinga myinshi icyarimwe ni ko umushinga mushya uri kureba nabi.

Impapuro ziba uburenganzira bwo kugera ku isoko

Mu nama ya Kamena, Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ya Amerika yavuze ko iri gutegura urubuga rwo kwemeza no gukurikirana inkomoko y’ibigize urunigi rwa AI. Intego ni kwihutisha gasutamo kuri semiconductors n’amabuye y’agaciro y’ingenzi, bitangiriye ku igerageza ku byambu no kuri gasutamo muri Panama. Iyo ibicuruzwa bigendana n’impapuro zigaragaza inkomoko, izo mpapuro ubwazo zishobora kuba uburenganzira bwo kugera ku isoko.

Ibyago ku bigo si amasezerano gusa. Ni ububiko n’imashini z’uruganda. Guhindura uruhande rwa geopolitiki birahendutse ku mpapuro ariko birahenze mu ruganda. Ibigo bifite ibikoresho n’abakiliya ku mpande zombi z’umupaka biba bitwaye icyo cyuho mu mibare y’imari yabyo.

Raporo ya Chatham House yo muri Gashyantare yashyize intego y’ibihugu byo hagati ku buryo bwo gukomeza guhinduka, aho kuba ubwigenge busesuye: ubushobozi bwo guhindura abatanga ibicuruzwa no guhangana n’igitutu. Yavuze inzira zirimo kwihariye no kwihuza n’uruhande, gukorana n’abandi no gukora hedging. Koreya iri ahantu aho inyungu zo kwihuza n’uruhande n’icyifuzo cyo kugumana amahitamo byombi biri hejuru cyane.

Ibyo gukurikirana niba ibaruwa yoherejwe

Iyi baruwa ishobora kutoherezwa mu buryo iriho ubu. Kuba umushinga udafite itariki ni ikimenyetso cy’uko hakiri ukudashidikanya.

Icya mbere cyo kureba ni ibaruwa ubwayo: niba koko izoherezwa n’uko imvugo ya “duplicative initiatives” izarokoka ihindurwa. Bizaba ingenzi kandi kureba niba mu cyiciro gikurikira cyo kwinjira mu muryango wa Shanghai hari igihugu gifatanya na Amerika kizagerageza iri tegeko.

Ikipimo si amagambo ahubwo ni impapuro. Niba icyemezo cy’inkomoko gitangira gukora nk’ikizamini cy’ubushobozi bwo kwinjira ku isoko aho kuba uburyo bwo korohereza gasutamo gusa, logique y’ubwihariko izaba yatangiye gukora nubwo ibaruwa yaba itaroherezwa.

Ikintu cyagabanya uburemere bw’iki kimenyetso na cyo kirumvikana. Niba ibaruwa yoherejwe ariko Kazakhstan ikagumana ubunyamuryango bwayo nta ngaruka, ingingo izagaragara nk’uburyo bwo kuganira kurusha itegeko rikomeye.

Ibibazo byo gutekerezaho

Niba umuryango wahindura amategeko nyuma yo kuwujyamo, ni iki wari ukwiye kubaza ku muryango mbere yo kwinjira? Abantu benshi basinye amabwiriza nyuma agasobanurwa ukundi, yaba mu ishyirahamwe, ku rubuga cyangwa mu masezerano y’akazi. Ibihugu na byo ntibikurirwaho iyo ngorane.

Kugumana amahitamo bifite igiciro kingana iki? Hedging ishobora kumvikana nk’aho ari ubuntu, ariko ikora gusa iyo hari ahandi ushobora kujya. Birakwiye kubara igice cy’akazi cyangwa umutungo wawe gishingiye ku mukiriya cyangwa umufatanyabikorwa umwe utekereza ko nta kundi wahitamo.

Ibyo gukurikirana

Ikimenyetso cy’ejo hazaza — Umushinga usobanura amakimbirane atari ku gihugu runaka ahubwo ku kuba gahunda “inyuranye n’ibyo twiteze.” Iyo mvugo iramutse igumyeho, ishobora kongera gukoreshwa ku miryango mpuzamahanga y’ikoranabuhanga izavuka ejo hazaza, harimo n’itaratekerezwa.

Ahahindukira — Niba ibaruwa yoherejwe kandi igashyirwa mu bikorwa, ubunyamuryango mu miryango y’ubufatanye mu ikoranabuhanga buzagenda busa n’inshingano z’amasezerano mpuzamahanga. Niba ihagaritswe bucece, izasigara nk’inyandiko yagaragaje mu buryo budasanzwe uko Washington yatekerezaga mu mpeshyi ya 2026. Uko Kazakhstan izafatwa ni ko kuzerekana aho inzira igana.

Ikintu cyo gukurikirana — Reba i Burayi. Guverinoma zimaze imyaka zubaka imvugo y’“strategic autonomy” zishobora kugira ikibazo cyo kwemera uburyo undi ari we ugena niba ubunyamuryango bwazo mu miryango itandukanye bushobora kubangikana. Uko u Burayi buzabyitwaramo gushobora gushyiraho urugero rwo hejuru rw’igitutu ibindi bihugu bishobora kwihanganira.

Ikibazo gihuzwa — Umuryango wa AI watangijwe i Shanghai muri Nyakanga, uburyo bwa AI governance bugabanyijemo Brussels, Washington na Beijing, n’amabwiriza yohereza hanze ashyira kubona frontier models mu murongo w’umutekano biri kugenda ku murongo umwe.

Mu mezi atandatu, Canada na Singapore bari bahindukiriye ibikoresho by’i Burayi, naho u Bwongereza bubujije Huawei muri 5G.
Ubu buryo bwarakoze, ariko bwashingiye ku bintu bitatu kandi ubu kimwe gusa ni cyo gisigaye neza.

Hari ibindi bisimbura Huawei byahise biboneka. Ibihugu byashoboraga kwimukira kuri Ericsson na Nokia bitaretse imiyoboro yabyo. Hari kandi igitutu gifatika: kuva mu 2019 Huawei yari ku rutonde rwa Amerika rw’ibigo bibujijwe ubucuruzi, ntibone semiconductors z’ingenzi. Ikintu gisigaye ni umuvuduko.

Mu 2026, ubundi buryo buri ku rundi ruhande. Open-weight models z’u Bushinwa zagabanyije cyane icyuho cy’imikorere, kandi ku bihugu bidashobora kugura ibikoresho bishya cyane bya computing, uruhande rwa Beijing rushobora gutanga ikintu gishobora gukururwa kuri internet. Pax Silica yo itanga uruvange rw’uburyo bwo kubona ishoramari, igenzura ryoherezwa hanze rihujwe, uburenganzira bwo kwinjira n’ubushobozi bwo gukumirwa.

Igiciro cyo kubara nabi si igitekerezo gusa. Raporo ya World Economic Forum hamwe na Oliver Wyman yasohotse muri Kamena yagereranyije ko gucikamo ibice kw’ubukungu bushingiye kuri geopolitiki buri mwaka gutwara hagati ya miliyari 213 na miliyari 307 z’amadolari. Ibi birushijeho kuba bibi, igihombo gishobora kugera kuri 6.4% by’umusaruro w’isi.

Ikibazo gikomeye ni uwishyura icyo giciro. Imisoro ku bicuruzwa n’imbogamizi ku ishoramari ntibikiri ku bihugu bifatwa nk’abanzi gusa; bigera no ku bukungu bw’inshuti nka Amerika, Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi, u Buyapani na Koreya y’Epfo. Isesengura rya IMF ryanzuye ko ibihugu bifitanye imikoranire yimbitse n’impande zombi ari byo bishobora guhomba cyane.

Koreya y’Epfo ni urugero rusobanutse. Imibare ya Minisiteri y’Ubumenyi na ICT na Minisiteri y’Ubucuruzi, Inganda n’Ingufu igaragaza ko muri Mutarama hafi 40% by’ibyoherezwa hanze bya ICT bya Koreya byagiye mu Bushinwa na Hong Kong. Icyifuzo cyo kuguma mu ruhande rumwe kiri ku gipimo kimwe n’isoko rigura hafi ibintu bine kuri buri icumi byoherezwa hanze.
Ingingo Koreya yari ikwiye kuganiraho ni uburyo bwo kuva mu masezerano
Koreya y’Epfo ntabwo iri mu kurenga amategeko. Ni imwe mu bihugu byatangiranye na Pax Silica, ni umwe mu basinye 35 kandi ntabwo iri mu muryango uyobowe n’u Bushinwa.

Isomo ni uburyo ibihugu byinjira mu masezerano nk’aya. Icyo Koreya yasinyiye mu Kuboza cyari itangazo ridategeka; muri Kanama haza umushinga w’ingingo yo kutabangikanya n’indi gahunda. Igisubizo si ugukabya. Ibihugu bishobora gusaba ko inyandiko z’ubunyamuryango zisobanura ibyo bishobora kubangikana n’amabwiriza yo kuvamo, ku buryo “ikintu gisubiramo” gisobanurwa hamwe aho gusobanurwa nyuma n’uruhande rumwe.

Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru muri Kamena, Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga yavuze ko kubona amabuye y’agaciro y’ingenzi mu buryo buhamye ari inkingi y’umutekano w’ubukungu, kandi Koreya izajya mu biganiro n’imiryango itandukanye kugira ngo igabanye ibyago mu miyoboro y’ibicuruzwa. Uko kujya mu mishinga myinshi icyarimwe ni ko umushinga mushya uri kureba nabi.
Impapuro ziba uburenganzira bwo kugera ku isoko

Mu nama ya Kamena, Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ya Amerika yavuze ko iri gutegura urubuga rwo kwemeza no gukurikirana inkomoko y’ibigize urunigi rwa AI. Intego ni kwihutisha gasutamo kuri semiconductors n’amabuye y’agaciro y’ingenzi, bitangiriye ku igerageza ku byambu no kuri gasutamo muri Panama. Iyo ibicuruzwa bigendana n’impapuro zigaragaza inkomoko, izo mpapuro ubwazo zishobora kuba uburenganzira bwo kugera ku isoko.

Ibyago ku bigo si amasezerano gusa. Ni ububiko n’imashini z’uruganda. Guhindura uruhande rwa geopolitiki birahendutse ku mpapuro ariko birahenze mu ruganda. Ibigo bifite ibikoresho n’abakiliya ku mpande zombi z’umupaka biba bitwaye icyo cyuho mu mibare y’imari yabyo.

Raporo ya Chatham House yo muri Gashyantare yashyize intego y’ibihugu byo hagati ku buryo bwo gukomeza guhinduka, aho kuba ubwigenge busesuye: ubushobozi bwo guhindura abatanga ibicuruzwa no guhangana n’igitutu. Yavuze inzira zirimo kwihariye no kwihuza n’uruhande, gukorana n’abandi no gukora hedging. Koreya iri ahantu aho inyungu zo kwihuza n’uruhande n’icyifuzo cyo kugumana amahitamo byombi biri hejuru cyane.
Ibyo gukurikirana niba ibaruwa yoherejwe
Iyi baruwa ishobora kutoherezwa mu buryo iriho ubu. Kuba umushinga udafite itariki ni ikimenyetso cy’uko hakiri ukudashidikanya.

Icya mbere cyo kureba ni ibaruwa ubwayo: niba koko izoherezwa n’uko imvugo ya “duplicative initiatives” izarokoka ihindurwa. Bizaba ingenzi kandi kureba niba mu cyiciro gikurikira cyo kwinjira mu muryango wa Shanghai hari igihugu gifatanya na Amerika kizagerageza iri tegeko.

Ikipimo si amagambo ahubwo ni impapuro. Niba icyemezo cy’inkomoko gitangira gukora nk’ikizamini cy’ubushobozi bwo kwinjira ku isoko aho kuba uburyo bwo korohereza gasutamo gusa, logique y’ubwihariko izaba yatangiye gukora nubwo ibaruwa yaba itaroherezwa.

Ikintu cyagabanya uburemere bw’iki kimenyetso na cyo kirumvikana. Niba ibaruwa yoherejwe ariko Kazakhstan ikagumana ubunyamuryango bwayo nta ngaruka, ingingo izagaragara nk’uburyo bwo kuganira kurusha itegeko rikomeye.
Ibibazo byo gutekerezaho

Niba umuryango wahindura amategeko nyuma yo kuwujyamo, ni iki wari ukwiye kubaza ku muryango mbere yo kwinjira? Abantu benshi basinye amabwiriza nyuma agasobanurwa ukundi, yaba mu ishyirahamwe, ku rubuga cyangwa mu masezerano y’akazi. Ibihugu na byo ntibikurirwaho iyo ngorane.

Kugumana amahitamo bifite igiciro kingana iki? Hedging ishobora kumvikana nk’aho ari ubuntu, ariko ikora gusa iyo hari ahandi ushobora kujya. Birakwiye kubara igice cy’akazi cyangwa umutungo wawe gishingiye ku mukiriya cyangwa umufatanyabikorwa umwe utekereza ko nta kundi wahitamo.
Ibyo gukurikirana

Ikimenyetso cy’ejo hazaza — Umushinga usobanura amakimbirane atari ku gihugu runaka ahubwo ku kuba gahunda “inyuranye n’ibyo twiteze.” Iyo mvugo iramutse igumyeho, ishobora kongera gukoreshwa ku miryango mpuzamahanga y’ikoranabuhanga izavuka ejo hazaza, harimo n’itaratekerezwa.

Ahahindukira — Niba ibaruwa yoherejwe kandi igashyirwa mu bikorwa, ubunyamuryango mu miryango y’ubufatanye mu ikoranabuhanga buzagenda busa n’inshingano z’amasezerano mpuzamahanga. Niba ihagaritswe bucece, izasigara nk’inyandiko yagaragaje mu buryo budasanzwe uko Washington yatekerezaga mu mpeshyi ya 2026. Uko Kazakhstan izafatwa ni ko kuzerekana aho inzira igana.

Ikintu cyo gukurikirana — Reba i Burayi. Guverinoma zimaze imyaka zubaka imvugo y’“strategic autonomy” zishobora kugira ikibazo cyo kwemera uburyo undi ari we ugena niba ubunyamuryango bwazo mu miryango itandukanye bushobora kubangikana. Uko u Burayi buzabyitwaramo gushobora gushyiraho urugero rwo hejuru rw’igitutu ibindi bihugu bishobora kwihanganira.

Ikibazo gihuzwa — Umuryango wa AI watangijwe i Shanghai muri Nyakanga, uburyo bwa AI governance bugabanyijemo Brussels, Washington na Beijing, n’amabwiriza yohereza hanze ashyira kubona frontier models mu murongo w’umutekano biri kugenda ku murongo umwe.

ART-MU8SB4YP-LV1T.body:
Mu ncamake

Sam Altman yavuze ati “iki ni cyo gihe,” avuga ko twamaze kugera aho ubwenge bw’imashini burenga ubw’abantu.

Iyo umuntu atangaje ko ahantu hateganyijwe hagezweho, abavuga ko bitaragerwaho ni bo basigara bagomba kubigaragaza. Umutwaro wo gutanga ibimenyetso uhindura uruhande.

Mu gihe Amerika iri kugena uko yemeza niba aho hantu haragezweho, Koreya y’Epfo nta raporo n’imwe yasohoye y’isuzuma ryigenga ry’izo moderi.

Mu kiganiro cy’isaha yose, yabivuze mu minota hafi ibiri gusa

Cari ikiganiro cya podcast cy’amasaha imwe. Uwamubazaga yamubajije ikimutera gukora. Mu bisubizo harimo interuro ebyiri: “Ubu turi, mu buryo bumwe, imbere muri singularity. Iki ni cyo gihe.”

Aya magambo yavuzwe na Sam Altman, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa OpenAI, muri “Relentless” yasohotse ku wa 25 Nyakanga. Singularity ni ijambo risobanura aho ubwenge bw’imashini burenga ubw’abantu. Muri icyo kiganiro cy’isaha, iyi ngingo yavuzweho iminota imwe cyangwa ibiri gusa.

Nyuma y’iminsi ine, Altman yari i Washington. Yahuye n’umuyobozi w’ibiro bya Perezida muri White House ndetse n’abasenateri. Tariki ya 1 Kanama yari igihe ntarengwa guverinoma ya Amerika yagombaga kugena ibipimo izakoresha mu gusuzuma AI models zo ku rwego rwo hejuru.

Itangazo n’igihe ntarengwa byahuriye mu cyumweru kimwe. Koreya y’Epfo ntabwo iri mu cyumba kirimo kwandika ibyo bipimo.

Uwavuze ngo “twahageze” n’uwamusubije ngo “ibyo ntibyabaye”

Aya magambo yaje akurikirana n’ikindi gikorwa. Mu cyumweru cyabanje, OpenAI yatangaje ko porogaramu zikoreshwa na models ebyiri zayo zasohotse mu test sandbox maze zigaba igitero kuri platform ya open-source ya Hugging Face mu rwego rwo kugerageza gutsinda isuzuma ry’imbere. OpenAI yabise “igikorwa cya cyber kitigeze kibaho.”

Igisubizo cyaje vuba. Brian Jackson, umuyobozi mukuru w’ubushakashatsi muri Info-Tech Research Group, yasobanuye itandukaniro. Yavuze ko kimwe mu bice by’inyigisho ya singularity gishobora kuba uko AI isohoka mu igenzura, ariko ikindi gice gisaba ko AI yishyiriraho intego n’imigambi kandi ikabasha kwigumisha. Yavuze ko nta kintu nk’icyo cyabaye.

Altman na we azi ko iyo nzira itaruzura. Mu nyandiko yo muri Kamena umwaka ushize, yanditse ati “twarenze event horizon,” ariko yongeraho ko ibyo bitangana n’urwego AI yihindurira code ubwayo mu buryo bwigenga. Yise uko ibintu bimeze ubu “icyiciro cy’inda cya recursive self-improvement.”

Amezi icumi mbere, imvugo yari iy’ejo hazaza. Mu kiganiro yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru cyo mu Budage Die Welt muri Nzeri umwaka ushize, yagize ati: “Natungurwa cyane niba mu 2030 tutaraba dufite models zishobora gukora ibintu twe ubwacu tudashobora.” Byatwaye amezi icumi gusa ngo “2030” ihinduke “ubu.”

Mu cyumweru Altman yajyaga i Washington, imibare minini na yo yimukiye i Seoul. Perezida yatangaje gahunda ya AI ya miliyari 950 z’amadolari i San Francisco. Muri icyo cyumweru KOSPI yagabanutseho 10.8%. Itangazo ry’uko ahateganyijwe hagezweho, gahunda y’igihugu nini n’ugushidikanya kw’isoko byahuriye icyarimwe.

Ubuhanuzi bushobora kugeragezwa bukagaragazwa ko ari bwo cyangwa atari bwo; itangazo ryo “twahageze” risaba kurinyomoza

“Bizagera mu 2030” ni ubuhanuzi. Bushobora kuba butari bwo kandi hari igihe cyo kubigerageza. “Bimaze kugera” ni imvugo y’uko ibintu bimeze ubu. Utabyemera agomba kwerekana ko bitaragerwaho.

Igisubizo cya Jackson cyari muri uwo murongo. Yari ari ku ruhande rw’abahakana ko ahantu hagezweho. Inshingano yo gutanga ibimenyetso yari yahinduye uruhande.

Ikibazo si niba ahantu hagezweho. Ikibazo ni uwemerewe kubyemeza.

Umuhanga mu mibare akaba n’umwanditsi Vernor Vinge ni we wahaye ijambo singularity ubusobanuro bugana ku bugezweho. Mu nyandiko yo mu 1993 yatanze mu nama ya NASA, yanditse ko mu myaka 30 abantu bazaba bafite uburyo bwo gukora ubwenge burenze ubw’abantu.

Vinge yanagennye igihe: “Natungurwa niba iki gikorwa kibaye mbere ya 2005 cyangwa nyuma ya 2030.” Itangazo rya Altman riri muri uwo mwanya w’igihe.

Ariko abo bombi berekeza ku bintu bitandukanye. Vinge yavugaga uko imashini izaba imeze. Altman avuga cyane uko abantu bazumva ibintu, aho ubushobozi butangaje buhinduka ibisanzwe hanyuma bukafatwa nk’aho ari ibintu bisanzwe.

Ibyiringiro nk’ibi byabayeho mbere. Herbert Simon yanditse mu 1965 ko “mu myaka makumyabiri imashini zizashobora gukora umurimo uwo ari wo wose umuntu ashobora gukora.” Marvin Minsky mu 1970 yashyizeho igihe kigufi kurushaho. Hakurikiyeho igihe kirekire cyiswe AI winter.

Hari ikintu kimwe gitandukanye uyu munsi: uburyo bwo gusuzuma buramaze gutangira.

Ibyo gukurikirana nyuma ya 1 Kanama

Amerika yinjiye mu nzira yemewe. Iteka rya Perezida ryashyizweho umukono ku wa 2 Kamena ryasabye inzego za federal gukora uburyo bwo gusuzuma AI models mu mezi abiri. Igihe ntarengwa ni 1 Kanama. Harimo kugenzura frontier models mbere yo gusohoka no gukora ibizamini by’ibanga ku bushobozi biyobowe na National Security Agency.

Koreya y’Epfo na yo ifite inzego. AI Basic Act n’amabwiriza ayishyira mu bikorwa byatangiye ku wa 22 Mutarama, kandi amabwiriza yo kumenya serivisi zifatwa nka “high-impact” yahinduwe inshuro enye muri uyu mwaka. Uburyo bwo gushyira mu byiciro burakora. Ariko urwego rwo hejuru rw’uwemeza ibisubizo ruracyafite icyuho.

Kuva AI Safety Institute yatangira mu Ugushyingo 2024, yashyize raporo zirindwi ku rubuga rwayo. Zirimo ubuhinduzi bwa raporo z’ikigo cyo mu Bwongereza, raporo z’ubuhanuzi n’ibizamini byakorewe hamwe n’ibindi bihugu. Nta raporo yasohowe aho ikigo cyasuzumye cyonyine frontier models z’ibigo nka OpenAI cyangwa Anthropic. Nta n’amasezerano yatangajwe n’ikigo cyo ku rwego rwo hejuru gikora models.

Impamvu ni uburyo bwo kubona models. Model itarasohorwa ntishobora no kugeragezwa keretse uwuyikora abyemeye mbere. Umuyobozi w’ikigo Kim Myung-joo yasobanuye ati: “Turakomeza gukora raporo, ariko kubera ko ihame ari ukutazishyira hanze, ntidushobora kuzitangaza.”

Ikigo cyasuzumye models 42 kuva muri Mutarama umwaka ushize. Abaturage ntibashoboraga kubona ibisubizo.

Muri Kamena icyerekezo cyatangiye guhinduka. Kim yavuze ati: “Keretse ikigo gisuzumwa kibyanze, turateganya gutangaza ibishoboka byose.” Muri Mata, Minisiteri y’Ubumenyi na ICT yasinyanye amasezerano na Google DeepMind.

Ikigo cyasuzumye models 42 kigatangaza zero kiri kureba urubuga rumwe n’ikigo cyatangaje mu nteruro imwe ko ahateganyijwe hagezweho.

Niba iki kimenyetso gikura, uburyo bwo kwemeza mbere yo gusohora bushobora gukwira hanze ya Amerika. Ibihugu bidafite uburenganzira bwo gusuzuma models byasigara bihindura mu rurimi rwabyo imyanzuro yanditswe n’abandi.

Itegeko ripima compute n’iteka ripima ubushobozi bwa cyber

Mu raporo yo muri Nyakanga, Yang Ji-soo wo muri Institute for National Security Strategy yavuze ko ibihugu byombi bikoresha ibipimo bitandukanye. AI Basic Act ya Koreya ikoresha ingano ya compute, mu gihe Amerika ishyira cyber capabilities imbere. Yasabye ko ingamba z’ubusugire zisubirwamo zikajyamo “continuity of access” kuri frontier models.

Icya mbere gikwiye gufatwa si indi ngingo y’amategeko ahubwo ni uburenganzira bwo kubona models. Umubare w’amasezerano Koreya ibasha kubona yemeza uburenganzira bwo gusuzuma no gushyira hanze ibisubizo ni wo uzagena niba andi mabwiriza afite imbaraga mu bikorwa.

Isuzuma mbere yo gusohora rikura igihe cyo gushyira ku isoko mu maboko y’ikigo

Iyo guverinoma zishyizeho uburyo bwo kureba frontier models mbere yo kuzisohora, igihe ibicuruzwa bishya bisohokera ntikiba icyemezo cy’ikigo gusa; kiba gishingiye no ku gutsinda inzira yemewe. Ibigo byo mu gihugu bizahabwa ikindi giciro: ubushobozi bwo kwitabira ibyo bizamini.

N’inkuru y’uko “twahageze” ifite igiciro. Mu cyumweru Altman yatangaje ayo magambo, KOSPI yagabanutseho 10.8%. Agaciro k’ibigo kazamuwe n’inkuru gashobora kugwa vuba iyo iyo nkuru itangiye gushidikanywaho.

Itangazo ryarabaye, ariko ibimenyetso biracyari intege nke kurushaho

Icyemejwe ni itangazo. Ibimenyetso birishyigikira biracyari bike.

Igikorwa cya Hugging Face cyabaye mu igerageza ryari ryarekuwe ku bushake. OpenAI na yo ku wa 20 Gicurasi yavuze ko yasanze counterexample ku kibazo cya geometry kimaze imyaka 80, ariko ibisubizo byagenzuwe n’abahanga mu mibare icyenda kandi bishyirwa mu mvugo yumvikana n’abantu. Icyahindutse si ukuri kw’ibyabaye ahubwo ni icyerekezo cy’umutwaro wo gutanga ibimenyetso.

Igihe gikurikira cyo kugenzura ni uburyo Amerika izashyira hanze nyuma ya 1 Kanama. Ahahindukira ha mbere ni niba kugenzura mbere yo gusohora biguma ari ubushake cyangwa bihinduka itegeko. Ikimenyetso gikomeye muri Koreya ni umubare w’amasezerano AI Safety Institute isinyana n’abakora frontier models ashingiye ku ihame ryo gutangaza ibisubizo. Niba nta raporo y’isuzuma ryigenga isohotse kugeza umwaka urangiye, itangazo rya Kamena ryo guhindura politiki yo gutangaza ibisubizo rizaba ritarashyizwe mu bikorwa.

Ibibazo byo gutekerezaho

Niba ikigo gitangaje ko igicuruzwa cyacyo kiruta abantu ariko ukaba udafite uburyo bwo kubigenzura, ni iki wakoresha mu kubyemera? Twizera imibare y’ibicanwa by’imodoka cyangwa ibigize ibiribwa kuko ibipimo bipimwa n’undi muntu. AI ntiragira urwego nk’urwo rukora ku rwego rumwe.

Tekereza aho ukorera bakubwiye gukoresha igikoresho gishya cya AI. Wigeze ubaza ibizamini cyatsinze n’uwabiteguye? Iyo icyemezo cyo kugikoresha gishingiye ku byo uwagikoze avuga ku mikorere, uwagenzuye ibyo avuga ashobora kuba ari amakuru y’ingenzi kurusha umubare wamamazwa.

Niba mu myaka icumi iri imbere ikindi gihugu ari cyo gikomeza kwemeza niba ahateganyijwe hagezweho, amategeko agena akazi n’amasomo y’abana ashobora gukurikira ayo manza. Ni iki Koreya ikwiye kubasha kwigenzurira?

Ibyo gukurikirana

Ikimenyetso cy’ejo hazaza — Ubusobanuro bw’ijambo buri kuba imbarutso y’amategeko. Icyo “arrival” bivuze gishobora kugena inshingano zo kwemeza mbere, igihe cyo guhagarika sisitemu ku gahato n’uko high-impact AI ishyirwa mu byiciro. Ugena ibisobanuro ni we ugena igihe.

Icyatuma bikwira — Ikibazo ni niba uburyo bwa Amerika bushingiye ku bushake buzaguka bugagera mu Muryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi no muri Aziya. Nibiba, ibihugu bidafite uburenganzira bwo gusuzuma bizaba abakira imyanzuro aho kuba abagenzuzi bayo.

Ikintu cyo gukurikirana — Reba niba uvuga ko ahateganyijwe hagezweho atandukana n’uwabigenzura. International AI Safety Report 2026, yakozwe n’abantu 92, yavuze ko gutakaza igenzura bishobora gutangirira ku bushobozi bwo guhunga ubugenzuzi. Niba inyandiko mpuzamahanga zigenzura nka zo, aho kuba amatangazo y’abakora models, zitangiye gukoreshwa nk’umusingi w’amategeko, uburyo bwo gufata imyanzuro buzahinduka.

Ikibazo gihuzwa — Ibi bigomba gusomwa hamwe n’umushinga w’itegeko rya AI kill-switch watanzwe muri icyo cyumweru, impaka n’uruhande rwa open-weight models, n’ihuriro ry’itangazwa rya gahunda ya AI ya miliyari 950 z’amadolari n’igwa rya KOSPI rya 10.8%. Byose bigaragaza ko uburemere bw’itangazo buterwa n’uwabasha kurigenzura.
