ART-MU8SJMC4-IV0B.body:
Aya masezerano agamije korohereza imiryango y’abahinzi kubona serivisi z’imari, bityo bikazamura umusaruro, ubushobozi bwo guhangana n’ingaruka zitandukanye ndetse n’iterambere rirambye kandi ridaheza mu rwego rw’ubuhinzi.

Biteganyijwe ko iyi gahunda izafasha gukomeza ubushobozi bw’imiryango y’abahinzi igera kuri 215, imyinshi muri yo ikazahabwa inkunga y’imari, ndetse ikagirira akamaro abahinzi bato barenga 35,000, cyane cyane abagore n’urubyiruko.

Kugeza ubu ubuhinzi butunze abarenga 70 ku ijana by’abaturage b’u Rwanda, ndetse bukagira uruhare rungana hafi 25 ku ijana by’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu (GDP).

Nubwo ubuhinzi bufite uruhare rukomeye mu mibereho y’abaturage no mu iterambere ry’ubukungu, kubona imari bikomeje kuba imbogamizi ikomeye, kuko inguzanyo zihabwa ubuhinzi zikiri ku kigero gito ugereranyije n’izindi nguzanyo zitangwa mu gihugu.

Umubare w’imiryango y’abahinzi mu Rwanda wakomeje kwiyongera mu myaka ishize. Ariko kandi, hafi 70 ku ijana by’ibikenewe mu bijyanye n’imari ntibiraboneka.

Visi Perezida w’Ikigega Mpuzamahanga gishinzwe Iterambere ry’Ubuhinzi, IFAD Dr. Gérardine Mukeshimana, yavuze ko iyi nguzanyo igamije gufasha Banki ya Kigali kongerera ubushobozi amakoperative y’abahinzi.

Mukeshimana yavuze ko Banki ya Kigali yiyemeje guteza imbere ubuhinzi, bityo nabo bajemo nk’abafatanyabikorwa ba Guverinoma y’u Rwanda, ndetse banatangiye uburyo bwo gushora imari mu bikorera nk’ibigo by’imari n'ibigo bikora ibijyanye n’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, bityo aya mafaranga akazafasha abahinzi bato.

Yagize ati’’ Ni amafaranga azafasha abahinzi kubona inyongereramusaruro, icyo rero bigamije ni ugushora imari mu bahinzi bato n'ubundi bari mu buhinzi n’ubworozi ariko batabasha kugerwaho n’imari isanzwe y’ibigo by’imari. Nk’uko musanzwe mubizi biragoye ko umuhinzi muto abyuka akajya muri banki akabona inguzanyo."

Ni yo mpamvu yongeyeho ati "aha rero dushyizemo ubufatanye na BK ninayo mpamvu harimo ubwishingizi ndetse no kongerera ubushobozi. Muzi ko amakoperative y’abahinzi n’aborozi ndetse n’ibigo bito akenshi biba bidafite imikoranire ihamye n’amabanki. Ikigamijwe rero mu rwego rugari ni ukongera umusaruro w’ibiribwa mu gihugu ndetse n’ishoramari rikaboneka."

Ku ruhande rwe, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Banki ya Kigali, Dr. Diane Karusisi yavuze ko aya masezerano agamije gushyigikira amakoperative y’abahinzi arenga 200 bagiye gukorana ndetse no kubaha inguzanyo zo guteza imbere ibikorwa byabo.

Ni amafaranga azabafasha gutanga inguzanyo iciriritse kandi y’igihe kirekire, ikazishyurwa mu gihe cy’imyaka 7 ku nyungu ya 14%.

Dr. Karusisi yagize ati’’ aya mafaranga araza yunganira ibikorwa twagiranaga n’amakoperative. Azatuma dushobora gutanga inguzanyo iciriritse kandi y’igihe kirekire, kugira ngo bashore imari mu bikoresho, biteze ubuhinzi imbere. Icyiza cy’ubufatanye ni uko hajemo n’imfashanyo yo guha amakoperative kugira ngo akomeze kwiyubaka cyane cyane mu bijyanye n’imiyoborere."

International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) ni ikigo mpuzamahanga cy’imari cyihariye mu guteza imbere no guhindura ubukungu bw’icyaro.

IFAD ishora imari mu baturage bo mu cyaro no mu miryango yabo, igateza imbere uruhererekane nyongeragaciro rw’ibikomoka ku buhinzi, umutekano w’ibiribwa, iterambere risangiwe n’umutekano.

Kugeza ubu, IFAD n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo bafite hafi miliyari 23 z’amadolari zashowe muri gahunda zikomeje gushyigikira ihinduka ry’ubukungu bw’icyaro.

Wanditse

Manzi Gato Felicien

Umunyamakuru

Mukeshimana yavuze ko Banki ya Kigali yiyemeje guteza imbere ubuhinzi, bityo nabo bajemo nk’abafatanyabikorwa ba Guverinoma y’u Rwanda, ndetse banatangiye uburyo bwo gushora imari mu bikorera nk’ibigo by’imari n'ibigo bikora ibijyanye n’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, bityo aya mafaranga akazafasha abahinzi bato.

Yagize ati’’ Ni amafaranga azafasha abahinzi kubona inyongereramusaruro, icyo rero bigamije ni ugushora imari mu bahinzi bato n'ubundi bari mu buhinzi n’ubworozi ariko batabasha kugerwaho n’imari isanzwe y’ibigo by’imari. Nk’uko musanzwe mubizi biragoye ko umuhinzi muto abyuka akajya muri banki akabona inguzanyo."

Ni yo mpamvu yongeyeho ati "aha rero dushyizemo ubufatanye na BK ninayo mpamvu harimo ubwishingizi ndetse no kongerera ubushobozi. Muzi ko amakoperative y’abahinzi n’aborozi ndetse n’ibigo bito akenshi biba bidafite imikoranire ihamye n’amabanki. Ikigamijwe rero mu rwego rugari ni ukongera umusaruro w’ibiribwa mu gihugu ndetse n’ishoramari rikaboneka."

Ku ruhande rwe, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Banki ya Kigali, Dr. Diane Karusisi yavuze ko aya masezerano agamije gushyigikira amakoperative y’abahinzi arenga 200 bagiye gukorana ndetse no kubaha inguzanyo zo guteza imbere ibikorwa byabo.
Ni amafaranga azabafasha gutanga inguzanyo iciriritse kandi y’igihe kirekire, ikazishyurwa mu gihe cy’imyaka 7 ku nyungu ya 14%.

Dr. Karusisi yagize ati’’ aya mafaranga araza yunganira ibikorwa twagiranaga n’amakoperative. Azatuma dushobora gutanga inguzanyo iciriritse kandi y’igihe kirekire, kugira ngo bashore imari mu bikoresho, biteze ubuhinzi imbere. Icyiza cy’ubufatanye ni uko hajemo n’imfashanyo yo guha amakoperative kugira ngo akomeze kwiyubaka cyane cyane mu bijyanye n’imiyoborere."
International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) ni ikigo mpuzamahanga cy’imari cyihariye mu guteza imbere no guhindura ubukungu bw’icyaro.
IFAD ishora imari mu baturage bo mu cyaro no mu miryango yabo, igateza imbere uruhererekane nyongeragaciro rw’ibikomoka ku buhinzi, umutekano w’ibiribwa, iterambere risangiwe n’umutekano.
Kugeza ubu, IFAD n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo bafite hafi miliyari 23 z’amadolari zashowe muri gahunda zikomeje gushyigikira ihinduka ry’ubukungu bw’icyaro.
Wanditse
Manzi Gato Felicien
Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8SJMVD-ONNL.title: Afurika itakaza hafi miliyari 90 z’amadolari buri mwaka kubera amafaranga atemewe
ART-MU8SJMVD-ONNL.subtitle: Perezida wa Sena y’u Rwanda, Dr.
ART-MU8SJMVD-ONNL.summary: Perezida wa Sena y’u Rwanda, Dr. François-Xavier Kalinda, yasabye ibihugu bya Afurika kuva ku kubahiriza amategeko n’amabwiriza gusa, ahubwo bigashyira imbere umusaruro ugaragara mu kurwanya kunyereza no guhisha inkomoko y’amafaranga (iyezandonke), gutera inkunga ibikorwa by’iterabwoba n’ikwirakwizwa ry’intwaro zangiza imbaga. Yabivugiye i Kigali ubwo yafunguraga ku mugaragaro inama ya 26 y’Inama y’Abaminisitiri y’Itsinda ry’Ibihugu byo muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba n’Amajyepfo rishinzwe kurwanya kunyereza no guhisha inkomoko y’amafaranga, (Eastern and Southern Africa Anti-Money Laundering Group/ ESAAMLG), ihuje ibihugu 22 byo muri aka Karere.
ART-MU8SJMVD-ONNL.body:
Perezida wa Sena y’u Rwanda, Dr. François-Xavier Kalinda, yasabye ibihugu bya Afurika kuva ku kubahiriza amategeko n’amabwiriza gusa, ahubwo bigashyira imbere umusaruro ugaragara mu kurwanya kunyereza no guhisha inkomoko y’amafaranga (iyezandonke), gutera inkunga ibikorwa by’iterabwoba n’ikwirakwizwa ry’intwaro zangiza imbaga.

Yabivugiye i Kigali ubwo yafunguraga ku mugaragaro inama ya 26 y’Inama y’Abaminisitiri y’Itsinda ry’Ibihugu byo muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba n’Amajyepfo rishinzwe kurwanya kunyereza no guhisha inkomoko y’amafaranga, (Eastern and Southern Africa Anti-Money Laundering Group/ ESAAMLG), ihuje ibihugu 22 byo muri aka Karere.

Ni inama irimo kubera i Kigali guhera ku wa 4 Nzeri kugeza ku wa 5 Nzeri 2026, ikaba ihurije hamwe abayobozi bakuru n’inzobere mu kurwanya ibyaha by’imari, mu rwego rwo gushimangira ubufatanye bw’ibihugu mu guhangana n’ikorwa ry’amafaranga n’ibindi byaha bifitanye isano na byo.

Atangiza ku mugaragaro iyi nama Dr. Kalinda yavuze ko nubwo ubukungu bw’Ibihugu byo mu Karere bukomeje kwaguka, serivisi z’imari zigenda ziba iz’ikoranabuhanga kandi ubucuruzi bwambukiranya imipaka bukiyongera, ibi byose bikaba bituma habaho ibyago byo gutuma abanyabyaha bashaka guhisha cyangwa kwimura amafaranga akomoka ku bikorwa bitemewe.

Yagaragaje ko ikibazo cy’amafaranga atemewe n’amategeko atari icy’imari gusa, ahubwo kigira n’ingaruka ku iterambere ry’Ibihugu.

Yagize ati “Afurika itakaza hafi miliyari 88 kugeza kuri miliyari 90 z’amadolari buri mwaka kubera urujya n’uruza rw’amafaranga atemewe n’amategeko.”

Perezida wa Sena yavuze ko amafaranga nk’ayo iyo atabuze mu bukungu bw’Ibihugu, yakoreshwa mu bikorwa by’ingenzi birimo kubaka amashuri n’ibitaro, guteza imbere ibikorwa remezo, guhanga imirimo no kuzamura imibereho y’abaturage.

Yashimangiye ko ari yo mpamvu kurwanya imigendekere y’amafaranga atemewe n’amategeko bigomba gufatwa nk’igice cy’ingenzi cy’ingamba z’iterambere rirambye.

Dr. Kalinda yavuze ko kuba Igihugu gifite amategeko, amabwiriza n’inzego zishinzwe kurwanya ibyaha by’imari bidahagije, ahubwo hakwiye kurebwa niba ibyo byose bitanga umusaruro ugaragara.

Agaragaza ko intsinzi idakwiye gupimirwa ku mubare w’amategeko yashyizweho cyangwa ku mubare w’inzego zashyizweho, ahubwo ikwiye gupimirwa ku bushobozi bw’izo nzego bwo gutahura ibyaha, gukora iperereza, gukurikirana ababikora, kugaruza umutungo ukomoka ku byaha no guhagarika imiyoboro ikoreshwa mu kwimura amafaranga atemewe.

Perezida wa Sena kandi yibukije ko ingamba zo kurwanya ibyaha by’imari zitagomba gutuma ibikorwa byemewe n’amategeko bigorana, cyangwa ngo zitume abantu benshi batagera kuri serivisi z’imari, asaba ko ingamba zishyirwaho zishingira ku byago bishobora kubaho, zikaba zikwiriye, zigamije ikibazo runaka kandi zishingiye ku bimenyetso.

Yanavuze ko ikoranabuhanga rishya, isesengura ry’amakuru n’ubwenge buhangano (AI) bishobora gufasha ibihugu gutahura hakiri kare imigendekere y’amafaranga akemangwa no gukurikirana imiyoboro y’abanyabyaha.

Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi w’u Rwanda akaba n’umuyobozi ucuye igihe w’Inama y’Abaminisitiri ya ESAAMLG, Yusuf Murangwa, yavuze ko u Rwanda rwateye intambwe mu gushyiraho amategeko, amabwiriza n’inzego zifasha mu kurwanya kunyereza no guhisha inkomoko y’amafaranga, gutera inkunga ibikorwa by’terabwoba n’ikwirakwizwa ry’intwaro zangiza imbaga.

Yavuze ko nubwo hari intambwe imaze guterwa, hakiri imbogamizi zisaba ko ibihugu bikomeza kunoza imikorere yabyo, agaragaza akamaro ka gahunda isuzuma uburyo ibihugu byubahiriza amahame mpuzamahanga yo kurwanya ibyaha by’imari ndetse n’ubushobozi bwabyo bwo gushyira ayo mahame mu bikorwa.

Agira ati “Iri suzuma ntirikwiye kurangirira ku kumenya ibyuho biri mu mategeko cyangwa mu mikorere y’inzego, ahubwo rigomba gufasha Igihugu kubikosora no kugera ku mpinduka zifatika.”

Umuyobozi ucuye igihe w’Itsinda ry’abayobozi bakuru ba ESAAMLG (Task Force of Senior Officials), Jeanne Pauline Gashumba, yavuze ko kuba ibihugu byubahiriza ibisabwa mu mategeko bidahagije.

Agira ati “Ikibazo gikomeye ni ukureba niba ubwo buryo bwo kurwanya ibyaha by’imari bushobora gutanga ibisubizo bifatika kandi bigaragara.”

Mu bindi bigomba kwigirwa muri harimo iterambere ry’amahame ya FATF, gahunda zo gukosora ibyuho byagaragajwe mu isuzuma, ubwinjirize bw’abantu muri serivisi z’imari, ikoranabuhanga mu by’imari, amafaranga atemewe n’amategeko ajyanye n’ubucakara bugezweho n’ubucuruzi butemewe bw’inyamaswa.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8SJNEW-BN9U.title: Hakenewe miliyari 100 z’amadolari yafasha ishoramari mu buhinzi kugera ku bahinzi bato
ART-MU8SJNEW-BN9U.subtitle: Ibi byagarutsweho kuri uyu wa Kabiri, ku munsi wa mbere w’Inama Nyafurika yiga ku kwihaza mu biribwa, AFS Forum 2026, mu biganiro byahuje abahanga, abafite aho bahuriye na serivisi z'imari n'iterambere, abashoramari, ibigo by’imari n’abakora muri gahunda z’ubuhinzi, bagaragaje ko kubona imari ari imwe mu mbogamizi zikomeye zikomeje kubangamira ubuhinzi muri Afurika.
ART-MU8SJNEW-BN9U.summary: Ibi byagarutsweho kuri uyu wa Kabiri, ku munsi wa mbere w’Inama Nyafurika yiga ku kwihaza mu biribwa, AFS Forum 2026, mu biganiro byahuje abahanga, abafite aho bahuriye na serivisi z'imari n'iterambere, abashoramari, ibigo by’imari n’abakora muri gahunda z’ubuhinzi, bagaragaje ko kubona imari ari imwe mu mbogamizi zikomeye zikomeje kubangamira ubuhinzi muri Afurika. Ubuyobozi bw'Ikigega Mpuzamahanga gishinzwe Iterambere ry’Ubuhinzi (IFAD), bwagaragaje ko ikibazo atari ukubona amafaranga gusa, kuko hakenewe n’izindi ngamba zirimo kunoza uburyo bwo gushora imari, kongera umusaruro n’ubwiza bw’ibicuruzwa, serivisi n’ibikorwa remezo. Bwavuze ko imari ivanze (blended finance) ishobora kuba igikoresho cyunganira izindi ngamba, kigafasha kugabanya ibyago abashoramari babona muri uru rwego no gukurura imari y’abikorera.
ART-MU8SJNEW-BN9U.body:
Ibi byagarutsweho kuri uyu wa Kabiri, ku munsi wa mbere w’Inama Nyafurika yiga ku kwihaza mu biribwa, AFS Forum 2026, mu biganiro byahuje abahanga, abafite aho bahuriye na serivisi z'imari n'iterambere, abashoramari, ibigo by’imari n’abakora muri gahunda z’ubuhinzi, bagaragaje ko kubona imari ari imwe mu mbogamizi zikomeye zikomeje kubangamira ubuhinzi muri Afurika.

Ubuyobozi bw'Ikigega Mpuzamahanga gishinzwe Iterambere ry’Ubuhinzi (IFAD), bwagaragaje ko ikibazo atari ukubona amafaranga gusa, kuko hakenewe n’izindi ngamba zirimo kunoza uburyo bwo gushora imari, kongera umusaruro n’ubwiza bw’ibicuruzwa, serivisi n’ibikorwa remezo.

Bwavuze ko imari ivanze (blended finance) ishobora kuba igikoresho cyunganira izindi ngamba, kigafasha kugabanya ibyago abashoramari babona muri uru rwego no gukurura imari y’abikorera.

IFAD ivuga ko imaze imyaka ikoresha imari mu iterambere ryo gushyigikira abahinzi bato, abaturage bo mu cyaro, ibikorwa remezo na serivisi, ariko ko mu myaka ishize yanongereye inkunga igera ku bikorera binyuze muri gahunda yayo yihariye yo gutera inkunga abikorera.

Muri iyo gahunda barashaka gutanga hafi miliyoni 500 z’amadolari y’ishoramari ry’abikorera, agatangwa mu bigo bito n’ibiciriritse, abahinzi bato n’ibigo by’imari bikorera cyane cyane ku rwego rw’ibanze rw’umusaruro.

Raporo ya Boston Consulting Group yo mu 2025, yagaragaje ko Afurika ikenera hafi miliyari 49 z’amadolari buri mwaka mu rwego rwa gahunda z’ibiribwa, mu gihe amafaranga akenewe yose abarirwa muri miliyari 200 z’amadolari.

Ibi bituma ku mugabane habaho icyuho cy’imari kingana na miliyari 100 z’amadolari buri mwaka, nubwo ikigereranyo gishobora guhinduka bitewe n’impamvu zirimo amafaranga akenewe mu guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere.

Abitabiriye ibiganiro bashimangiye ko Afurika itagomba kwibanda gusa ku cyuho cy’imari, kuko uru rwego rufite amahirwe y’isoko ashobora kugera kuri tiriyoni y’amadolari.

Ibyo bisaba ko amafaranga ya Leta n’ay’abikorera akoreshwa mu buryo bushobora gukurura abashoramari benshi.

Alexander Mazzucano uhagarariye Ikigega cy’Umuryango w’Abibumbye gishinzwe Iterambere ry’Imari (UNCDF), yavuze ko ibigo by’ubuhinzi bitandukanye mu bunini n’ubushobozi, bityo bikaba bitagomba guhabwa serivisi z’imari zimwe.

Yagize ati"Ibigo bito cyane bishobora gukenera inkunga, ibiciriritse n’ibinini bigakenera ingwate zo kugabanya ibyago, mu gihe ibigo bimaze gukura bishobora guhabwa imari isanzwe y’ubucuruzi."

Yashimangiye ko imari ivanze itagamije gusimbura amafaranga y’abikorera, ahubwo igamije gukora ku buryo abashoramari mu bucuruzi batinyuka gushora imari mu buhinzi.

Uhagarariye Ikigega Mpuzamahanga gishinzwe Ingamba zo Kurengera Ibidukikije n’Imihindagurikire y’Ibihe (Green Climate Fund (GCF), Forchi, yavuze ko urwego rw’ubuhinzi muri Afurika rugizwe n’abakora ibikorwa ku rugero rutandukanye cyane, bigatuma kugera ku rwego runini bigorana.

Yagize ati "Hakenewe uburyo bwo guhuza abahinzi n’ibigo byinshi, kugira ngo ikiguzi cyo gutanga serivisi z’imari kigabanuke, serivisi zisanzwe kandi amafaranga abahinzi babona abe ku giciro bashobora kwishyura."

Yasabye ko habaho ubufatanye bukomeye n’ibigo by’imari byo mu gihugu, cyane cyane amabanki, kubera ko ari byo byegereye abahinzi n’abacuruzi kandi bikaba bishobora gufasha guhuza abakiriya benshi.

Yatanze urugero rw’umushinga wakorewe muri Tanzania, aho ubufasha mu bya tekiniki bwahujwe n’umurongo w’inguzanyo, ingwate yo kugabanya ibyago n’ubwishingizi bushingiye ku bipimo by’ikirere. Ibi byatanze uburyo bw’imari bushobora kwaguka bugera kuri miliyoni 200 z’amadolari, bukaba bwaratanze inguzanyo zirenga 1,000 ku babikeneye.

Umwe mu rubyiruko rukora ubucuruzi bw’ubuhinzi n’ibiribwa, yagaragaje ko kubona imari iboneye ari imwe mu mbogamizi zikomeye urubyiruko ruhura na zo.

Avuga ko ingwate zisabwa n’ibigo by’imari zikunze kuba nyinshi ku mishinga ikiri mito, mu gihe uburyo bwo kwishyura inguzanyo butajya bujyana n’imiterere y’ubuhinzi.

Yatanze urugero rw’umushinga ushobora gutangira uyu munsi ariko ukabona amafaranga hashize igihe kinini, cyane cyane igihe inyungu iboneka nyuma y’isarura. Ibi bishobora gutuma kwishyura buri kwezi bigora umucuruzi ukiri muto.

Yanagaragaje ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y'ibihe, kubura umusaruro, ubumenyi buke, kutabona amasoko, ubujyanama n’ibikorwa remezo nk’izindi mbogamizi zikomeye.

Yavuze ko bakeneye imari ibonekera ku gihe, ariko ikajyana no kubona amasoko, ubumenyi n’ubushobozi bwo guhangana n’ibyago.

Minisitiri w’Ubuhinzi n’Ubworozi, Dr. Telesphore Ndabamenye, yavuze ko imicungire myiza y’ubutaka ari ingenzi ku iterambere ry’ubukungu, kuko ituma umusaruro w’ubuhinzi wiyongera, igafasha kurinda umutungo kamere, kongera ubushobozi bwo guhangana n’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, ndetse no kuzamura imibereho y’abatuye mu bice by’icyaro.

Minisitiri Dr. Ndabamenye, yasabye ko ubufatanye bwarushaho kwaguka kugira ngo ingamba u Rwanda rwashyizeho n’amahirwe y’ishoramari yagaragajwe bibashe gushyirwa mu bikorwa ku buryo butanga umusaruro ugaragara.

Muri rusange, muri ibi biganiro bagaragaje ko guteza imbere ubuhinzi muri Afurika bidashobora kugerwaho hakoreshejwe amafaranga gusa, kuko hakenewe imari ihuje n’imiterere y’abahinzi n’ibigo, ubufasha mu bya tekiniki, ingwate zo kugabanya ibyago, ibikorwa remezo n’amasoko.

Ubuyobozi bw'Ikigega Mpuzamahanga gishinzwe Iterambere ry’Ubuhinzi (IFAD), bwagaragaje ko ikibazo atari ukubona amafaranga gusa, kuko hakenewe n’izindi ngamba zirimo kunoza uburyo bwo gushora imari, kongera umusaruro n’ubwiza bw’ibicuruzwa, serivisi n’ibikorwa remezo.
Bwavuze ko imari ivanze (blended finance) ishobora kuba igikoresho cyunganira izindi ngamba, kigafasha kugabanya ibyago abashoramari babona muri uru rwego no gukurura imari y’abikorera.

IFAD ivuga ko imaze imyaka ikoresha imari mu iterambere ryo gushyigikira abahinzi bato, abaturage bo mu cyaro, ibikorwa remezo na serivisi, ariko ko mu myaka ishize yanongereye inkunga igera ku bikorera binyuze muri gahunda yayo yihariye yo gutera inkunga abikorera.

Muri iyo gahunda barashaka gutanga hafi miliyoni 500 z’amadolari y’ishoramari ry’abikorera, agatangwa mu bigo bito n’ibiciriritse, abahinzi bato n’ibigo by’imari bikorera cyane cyane ku rwego rw’ibanze rw’umusaruro.

Raporo ya Boston Consulting Group yo mu 2025, yagaragaje ko Afurika ikenera hafi miliyari 49 z’amadolari buri mwaka mu rwego rwa gahunda z’ibiribwa, mu gihe amafaranga akenewe yose abarirwa muri miliyari 200 z’amadolari.

Ibi bituma ku mugabane habaho icyuho cy’imari kingana na miliyari 100 z’amadolari buri mwaka, nubwo ikigereranyo gishobora guhinduka bitewe n’impamvu zirimo amafaranga akenewe mu guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere.
Abitabiriye ibiganiro bashimangiye ko Afurika itagomba kwibanda gusa ku cyuho cy’imari, kuko uru rwego rufite amahirwe y’isoko ashobora kugera kuri tiriyoni y’amadolari.
Ibyo bisaba ko amafaranga ya Leta n’ay’abikorera akoreshwa mu buryo bushobora gukurura abashoramari benshi.

Alexander Mazzucano uhagarariye Ikigega cy’Umuryango w’Abibumbye gishinzwe Iterambere ry’Imari (UNCDF), yavuze ko ibigo by’ubuhinzi bitandukanye mu bunini n’ubushobozi, bityo bikaba bitagomba guhabwa serivisi z’imari zimwe.
Yagize ati"Ibigo bito cyane bishobora gukenera inkunga, ibiciriritse n’ibinini bigakenera ingwate zo kugabanya ibyago, mu gihe ibigo bimaze gukura bishobora guhabwa imari isanzwe y’ubucuruzi."
Yashimangiye ko imari ivanze itagamije gusimbura amafaranga y’abikorera, ahubwo igamije gukora ku buryo abashoramari mu bucuruzi batinyuka gushora imari mu buhinzi.

Uhagarariye Ikigega Mpuzamahanga gishinzwe Ingamba zo Kurengera Ibidukikije n’Imihindagurikire y’Ibihe (Green Climate Fund (GCF), Forchi, yavuze ko urwego rw’ubuhinzi muri Afurika rugizwe n’abakora ibikorwa ku rugero rutandukanye cyane, bigatuma kugera ku rwego runini bigorana.

Yagize ati "Hakenewe uburyo bwo guhuza abahinzi n’ibigo byinshi, kugira ngo ikiguzi cyo gutanga serivisi z’imari kigabanuke, serivisi zisanzwe kandi amafaranga abahinzi babona abe ku giciro bashobora kwishyura."
Yasabye ko habaho ubufatanye bukomeye n’ibigo by’imari byo mu gihugu, cyane cyane amabanki, kubera ko ari byo byegereye abahinzi n’abacuruzi kandi bikaba bishobora gufasha guhuza abakiriya benshi.

Yatanze urugero rw’umushinga wakorewe muri Tanzania, aho ubufasha mu bya tekiniki bwahujwe n’umurongo w’inguzanyo, ingwate yo kugabanya ibyago n’ubwishingizi bushingiye ku bipimo by’ikirere. Ibi byatanze uburyo bw’imari bushobora kwaguka bugera kuri miliyoni 200 z’amadolari, bukaba bwaratanze inguzanyo zirenga 1,000 ku babikeneye.
Umwe mu rubyiruko rukora ubucuruzi bw’ubuhinzi n’ibiribwa, yagaragaje ko kubona imari iboneye ari imwe mu mbogamizi zikomeye urubyiruko ruhura na zo.
Avuga ko ingwate zisabwa n’ibigo by’imari zikunze kuba nyinshi ku mishinga ikiri mito, mu gihe uburyo bwo kwishyura inguzanyo butajya bujyana n’imiterere y’ubuhinzi.

Yatanze urugero rw’umushinga ushobora gutangira uyu munsi ariko ukabona amafaranga hashize igihe kinini, cyane cyane igihe inyungu iboneka nyuma y’isarura. Ibi bishobora gutuma kwishyura buri kwezi bigora umucuruzi ukiri muto.
Yanagaragaje ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y'ibihe, kubura umusaruro, ubumenyi buke, kutabona amasoko, ubujyanama n’ibikorwa remezo nk’izindi mbogamizi zikomeye.
Yavuze ko bakeneye imari ibonekera ku gihe, ariko ikajyana no kubona amasoko, ubumenyi n’ubushobozi bwo guhangana n’ibyago.

ART-MU8SJNYC-XMJE.body:
Ubushinwa bwagaragaje uburyo u Rwanda rushobora kuva ku gukoresha gusa ubwenge buhangano (AI) bwakozwe n’abandi, rukagera ku kubaka ikoranabuhanga ryarwo rushingiye ku makuru y’u Rwanda, abahanga barwo n’ibikorwaremezo byarwo.

Iki gitekerezo cyatangiwe i Kigali kuri uyu wa 17 Nzeri 2026, ubwo hatangazwaga raporo ya mbere y’ibikorwa by’ubufatanye n’abaturage (CSR) by’ibigo by’Abashinwa bikorera mu Rwanda, hanatangizwa icyiciro cya mbere cy’abiga AI muri Luban Workshop.

Dr. Bello Moussa, Umuyobozi ushinzwe ibisubizo by’ikoranabuhanga ku nzego za Leta n’abikorera muri Huawei Southern Africa, yagaragaje zimwe mu ngero z’uburyo AI irimo gukoreshwa mu Bushinwa mu burezi, ubuzima, imijyi, imiyoborere n’ubucuruzi.

Moussa yavuze ko igihugu gishaka kubaka icyo yise “AI yizewe kandi yigenga” kigomba kubanza kugira modeli yacyo y’ibanze, yubakiye ku makuru yacyo kandi ikorwa n’abahanga bacyo.

Yagize ati “Modeli y’ibanze y’igihugu ni modeli tugomba guteza imbere hano iwacu, dukoresheje amakuru yacu kandi ikorwa n’abahanga bacu. Iyo uyifite, ushobora kubakaho modeli zikoreshwa mu nzego zitandukanye.”

Yasobanuye ko iyo modeli ishobora kwifashishwa mu gukora izindi zihariye mu nzego nk’ubuzima n’uburezi, mbere yo kuzikoramo porogaramu zifasha abaturage, ibigo n’inzego za Leta.

Mu ngero yatanze, yavuze ko mu Bushinwa hari amashuri akoresha kamera n’ibyuma bifasha gukurikirana uko abanyeshuri bitabira amasomo, bigaha abarimu amakuru abafasha kunoza imyigire.

Mu buvuzi, AI ikoreshwa mu gusesengura amashusho y’ubuvuzi no gufasha abaganga gusuzuma indwara.

Mu mijyi, yavuze ko Shenzhen ifite ikigo gikoresha ikoranabuhanga mu gukurikirana urujya n’uruza rw’ibinyabiziga n’ibikorwaremezo.

Moussa kandi yagaragaje amahirwe yo gukoresha AI mu buhinzi no mu bigo bito n’ibiciriritse.

Agira ati “Tekereza gusa uko byamera hano mu Rwanda. Niba ari ubuhinzi cyangwa umusaruro w’ibigo bito n’ibiciriritse, ushobora kubikoresha AI kugira ngo ibikorwa bimwe na bimwe byikore.”

Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Urugaga rw’Abikorera mu Rwanda (PSF), Callixte Kanamugire, yavuze ko iterambere rya AI rigomba kujyana no kongera ubumenyi bw’urubyiruko kugira ngo rushobore guhangana n’impinduka ku isoko ry’umurimo.

Ambasaderi w’u Bushinwa mu Rwanda, Gao Wenqi, yavuze ko ibigo by’Abashinwa bikorera mu Rwanda bikwiye gukorana n’Abanyarwanda, kubahiriza amategeko no guteza imbere imikorere myiza mu byerekeye abaturage n’ibidukikije.

Ibiganiro kuri AI bibaye mu gihe u Rwanda n’u Bushinwa bizihiza imyaka 55 y’umubano wa dipolomasi, ndetse umubano w’ibihugu byombi wazamuwe mu 2024 ukagera ku rwego rw’ubufatanye bwuzuye.

Ku Rwanda, icyifuzo cyatanzwe ni uko AI itarangirira ku gukoresha porogaramu zakozwe ahandi, ahubwo igihugu kikubaka ubushobozi bwo gukora no guhuza AI n’ibikenewe n’Abanyarwanda.

Wanditse

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

ART-MU8SJOHK-ACR0.body:
Umuntu ugeze mu zabukuru, cyane cyane uri hagati y’imyaka 60 na 90 kandi udafite ubundi burwayi bumusaba imirire yihariye, asabwa kugira indyo itandukanye kandi yuzuye, irimo imboga, imbuto, ibinyampeke, ibinyamisogwe, ibikomoka ku matungo ndetse n’amavuta meza, mu rugero rukwiye.

Ndikubwayo Innocent, inzobere mu by’imirire ku Kigo Nderabuzima cya Burehe mu Karere ka Rulindo, avuga ko umuntu ugeze mu zabukuru adakwiye kureba gusa ingano y’ibyo arya, ahubwo akwiye no kwita ku bwiza bw’ibyo kurya ndetse n’uko bigabanyijemo intungamubiri zitandukanye.

Avuga ko indyo y’umuntu ukuze ikwiye kuba irimo poroteyine, kuko ari ingenzi mu kubungabunga imikaya no gufasha umubiri gukomeza kugira imbaraga.

Muri izi poroteyine harimo ibinyamisogwe nk’ibishyimbo, amashaza y’urunyogwe, amashaza yumye ni bindi binyamisogwe, ndetse n’amagi, amafi, inyama zitagira ibinure byinshi n’amata cyangwa ibiyakomokaho.

Ku muntu ugeze mu zabukuru, imboga n’imbuto na byo ni ingenzi kuko bitanga vitamine, imyunyu ngugu n’izindi ntungamubiri umubiri ukenera.

Ndikubwayo avuga ko imboga zitandukanye, nk’isombe, dodo, karoti, amashu n’izindi, zikwiye kuba mu mafunguro ya buri munsi, mu gihe imbuto na zo zishobora kuribwa hagati y’amafunguro cyangwa zigashyirwa mu mafunguro bitewe n’uburyo umuntu azikunda.

Ibinyampeke n’ibiribwa bitanga imbaraga

Umuntu ukuze kandi akenera ibiribwa bitanga imbaraga, birimo ibinyampeke nk’amasaka, ibigori, umuceri, ingano n’ibirayi, ariko bigakenerwa kuribwa mu rugero rujyanye n’ibyo umubiri ukenera.

Guhitamo ibinyampeke bitunganyijwe ku buryo butagabanya cyane intungamubiri zabyo na byo bishobora gufasha mu kubona ‘fibre’, zifasha imikorere myiza y’igogora.

Amazi na yo ni ingenzi

Kunywa amazi ahagije ni ikindi kintu umuntu ugeze mu zabukuru adakwiye kwirengagiza. Nubwo uko umuntu akura ashobora kutumva inyota cyane nk’uko byagenda ku muntu ukiri muto, amazi aracyakenewe kugira ngo umubiri ukomeze gukora neza.

Ati “Ni yo mpamvu umuntu ukuze akwiye kugira umuco wo kunywa amazi buri gihe, aho gutegereza ko inyota imufata”.

Ndikubwayo avuga ko mu rwego rwo gukomeza ubuzima bwiza, umuntu ugeze mu zabukuru akwiye kandi kwirinda kurya umunyu mwinshi, isukari nyinshi n’ibiribwa birimo amavuta menshi.

Ibiribwa bikaranze cyane cyangwa birimo isukari nyinshi bishobora gutuma indyo iba ituzuye iyo bifashwe kenshi, bityo bikwiye kuribwa mu rugero.

Ndikubwayo Innocent ashimangira ko indyo iboneye atari ugukuraho burundu ubwoko runaka bw’ibiribwa, ahubwo ari ukumenya guhitamo ibiribwa bitandukanye no kubirya mu rugero rukwiye.

Ifunguro ry’umuntu ukuze ku munsi rigomba kuba riteye rite?

Iyi nzobere mu by’imirire ivuga ko ku munsi umwe, umuntu ugeze mu zabukuru ashobora kugira ifunguro rigizwe n’ibinyampeke cyangwa ibindi biribwa bitanga imbaraga, agashyiraho imboga nyinshi, akongeraho ibifite poroteyine nk’ibishyimbo, amafi, amagi cyangwa inyama zitagira ibinure byinshi.

Ati “Icy’ingenzi ni ukwirinda ko amafunguro ye aba ashingiye ku bwoko bumwe bw’ibiribwa, ahubwo akagira indyo itandukanye itanga intungamubiri umubiri ukenera”.

Umuntu ugeze mu zabukuru kandi akwiye gukomeza kugira ibikorwa byoroheje bijyanye n’ubushobozi bwe. Ni ukuvuga uturimo tutamuvuna ariko dufasha umubiriwe kunyeganyega kuko imirire myiza ikorana n’imibereho myiza muri rusange mu gufasha umuntu gukomeza kugira ubuzima bwiza.

Ku muntu ufite ubundi burwayi cyangwa ufata imiti ihoraho, indyo ye ishobora gukenera guhinduka bitewe n’uburwayi afite, bityo akaba akwiye kugisha inama umuganga cyangwa inzobere mu mirire.

Wanditse

Ernestine Musanabera

Umunyamakuru

Ibinyampeke n’ibiribwa bitanga imbaraga
Umuntu ukuze kandi akenera ibiribwa bitanga imbaraga, birimo ibinyampeke nk’amasaka, ibigori, umuceri, ingano n’ibirayi, ariko bigakenerwa kuribwa mu rugero rujyanye n’ibyo umubiri ukenera.
Guhitamo ibinyampeke bitunganyijwe ku buryo butagabanya cyane intungamubiri zabyo na byo bishobora gufasha mu kubona ‘fibre’, zifasha imikorere myiza y’igogora.
Amazi na yo ni ingenzi

Kunywa amazi ahagije ni ikindi kintu umuntu ugeze mu zabukuru adakwiye kwirengagiza. Nubwo uko umuntu akura ashobora kutumva inyota cyane nk’uko byagenda ku muntu ukiri muto, amazi aracyakenewe kugira ngo umubiri ukomeze gukora neza.
Ati “Ni yo mpamvu umuntu ukuze akwiye kugira umuco wo kunywa amazi buri gihe, aho gutegereza ko inyota imufata”.
Ndikubwayo avuga ko mu rwego rwo gukomeza ubuzima bwiza, umuntu ugeze mu zabukuru akwiye kandi kwirinda kurya umunyu mwinshi, isukari nyinshi n’ibiribwa birimo amavuta menshi.
Ibiribwa bikaranze cyane cyangwa birimo isukari nyinshi bishobora gutuma indyo iba ituzuye iyo bifashwe kenshi, bityo bikwiye kuribwa mu rugero.
Ndikubwayo Innocent ashimangira ko indyo iboneye atari ugukuraho burundu ubwoko runaka bw’ibiribwa, ahubwo ari ukumenya guhitamo ibiribwa bitandukanye no kubirya mu rugero rukwiye.
Ifunguro ry’umuntu ukuze ku munsi rigomba kuba riteye rite?

Iyi nzobere mu by’imirire ivuga ko ku munsi umwe, umuntu ugeze mu zabukuru ashobora kugira ifunguro rigizwe n’ibinyampeke cyangwa ibindi biribwa bitanga imbaraga, agashyiraho imboga nyinshi, akongeraho ibifite poroteyine nk’ibishyimbo, amafi, amagi cyangwa inyama zitagira ibinure byinshi.
Ati “Icy’ingenzi ni ukwirinda ko amafunguro ye aba ashingiye ku bwoko bumwe bw’ibiribwa, ahubwo akagira indyo itandukanye itanga intungamubiri umubiri ukenera”.

Umuntu ugeze mu zabukuru kandi akwiye gukomeza kugira ibikorwa byoroheje bijyanye n’ubushobozi bwe. Ni ukuvuga uturimo tutamuvuna ariko dufasha umubiriwe kunyeganyega kuko imirire myiza ikorana n’imibereho myiza muri rusange mu gufasha umuntu gukomeza kugira ubuzima bwiza.
Ku muntu ufite ubundi burwayi cyangwa ufata imiti ihoraho, indyo ye ishobora gukenera guhinduka bitewe n’uburwayi afite, bityo akaba akwiye kugisha inama umuganga cyangwa inzobere mu mirire.

Ernestine Musanabera
Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8SJP03-RJG0.body:
Nitabiriye inama ya ‘Africa Mindset Reset Forum’, ndetse n'inama ya ‘Nuclear Energy Innovation Summit for Africa’, ndetse vuba aha muri ‘Africa Food Systems Forum 2026.’ Ikibazo kimwe cyakomeje kugaruka mu bitekerezo byanjye, "Kuki Kigali?”

Igisubizo kiri mu ruhurirane rw’ibintu bitandukanye birimo ibikorwa remezo byo ku rwego mpuzamahanga, umutekano, koroherezwa kugera kuri serivisi nziza kandi zitangwa kinyamwuga, ndetse n’ubushobozi bumaze kwigaragaza bwo kwakira no gutunganya inama n’ibikorwa mpuzamahanga bikomeye bibera mu Rwanda.

Mu myaka isaga icumi ishize, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yashyizeho ingamba zihamye zo gushyira Kigali ku mwanya w’imijyi ya mbere muri Afurika mu bijyanye no kwakira Inama, ibikorwa byo gushimangira imikoranire, amahuriro n’imurikabikorwa (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions ‘MICE’).

Nk’uko bitangazwa n’ikigo mpuzamahanga cya ‘International Congress and Convention Association (ICCA)’, Kigali imaze imyaka ibiri ikurikirana iri ku mwanya wa kabiri muri Afurika mu bijyanye no kwakira neza inama mpuzamahanga z’amashyirahamwe, ikaza ikurikira Cape Town, ariko iri imbere y’indi mijyi minini kandi imaze igihe izwi cyane muri urwo rwego.

Imibare na yo ivuga inkuru isa n’iyi. Urwego rwa MICE mu Rwanda rwakiriye abantu barenga 65,000 bitabiriye ibikorwa n’inama zitandukanye mu 2023, rwinjiza amafaranga agera kuri Miliyoni 95 z’Amadolari y’Amerika.

Nubwo habaye igabanuka mu 2024, bitewe n’icyorezo cya virusi ya Marburg, urwo rwego rwakomeje kwihagararaho, rwakira abantu barenga 52,000 kandi rwinjiza hafi Miliyoni 84.8 z’Amadolari. Ingamba z’u Rwanda mu rwego rw’igihugu zigamije kugera kuri Miliyoni 224 z’Amadolari y’Amerika yinjizwa na MICE mu mwaka wa 2029.

None se, ni iki gituma Kigali ikomeza guhagarara neza muri uru rwego?

Ibikorwa remezo ni ingenzi muri urwo rwgo nta gushidikanya. Mu bikorwaremezo byakira izo nama mpuzamahanga ‘MICE’ muri Kigali harimo Kigali Convention Centre izwi cyane, ikunganirwa n’ibibuga n’ahandi hantu hakorerwa ibikorwa byakira abantu benshi nka BK Arena, Intare Conference Arena, Kigali Cultural and Exhibition Village, ndetse na Amahoro Stadium iherutse kuvugururwa kandi ikongererwa ubushobozi.

U Rwanda rworoheje kandi uburyo bwo gutembera no kwinjira mu gihugu, harimo kuba abafite pasiporo z’Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe (AU) bashobora kwinjira nta visa, ndetse n’uburyo bwo kubona visa bageze ku mupaka cyangwa ku kibuga cy’indege ku bantu benshi baturuka mu bindi bihugu.

Ibi byose byunganirwa n’umuco wo kwakira abashyitsi neza, byose bikajyana n’ibikorwa remezo by’Umujyi wa Kigali byagenewe kwakira inama n’ibikorwa mpuzamahanga bitandukanye. Abitabira inama bashobora kandi guhuza akazi n’ibikorwa byo kwidagadura, birimo gusura ingagi no kujya gusura ahantu nyaburanga, gusura ahantu ndangamuco ndetse no kwishimira ibyokurya bitandukanye muri Kigali.

Hari kandi kuba inama n’ibikorwa mpuzamahanga byabereye mu Rwanda mu bihe byashize, byaragenze neza, bigatuma abantu bagira icyizere. Kuva ‘Rwanda Convention Bureau’ yashyirwaho mu 2014, u Rwanda rwakiriye inama n’ibikorwa mpuzamahanga bibarirwa mu magana mu nzego zitandukanye, zirimo ubucuruzi, ubuzima, ikoranabuhanga, ubuhinzi, siporo na dipolomasi.

Ikigo cya ‘Rwanda Convention Bureau’ gifasha abategura inama n’ibikorwa mpuzamahanga bitandukanye harimo kubafasha gushaka aho inama n’ibikorwa bitegurwa bizabera, gufasha mu gusura ahazabera inama, ndetse no kubona ubundi bufasha bufatika. Hagati aho, gahunda ya Visit Rwanda ikomeje kuzamura izina ry’u Rwanda ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

Birashoboka ko igisubizo cy’ikibazo ngo “Kuki ari Kigali?” atari ikintu kimwe gusa, ahubwo ari impurirane y’ibyo byose. Ku mashyirahamwe mpuzamahanga, ibigo by’ubucuruzi n’abategura inama n’ibikorwa mpuzamahanga muri bireba Afurika, Kigali ntikiri Umujyi urimo kuzamuka gusa, ahubwo ni umujyi urimo guhatanira kwakira zimwe mu nama zikomeye ku isi kandi, uko iminsi igenda, ukomeje no kuzegukana.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8SJPI9-85FD.title: Mu Bugesera bahawe ikigo, bagira ngo ni icy'urubyiruko gusa...inkuru ya Imbuto Hub
ART-MU8SJPI9-85FD.subtitle: Mu kigo cya Imbuto Hub Bugesera, gikorerwamo ibikorwa bitandukanye harimo isomero rusange, kwiga imyuga, na siporo zinyuranye ku bana batoya n’urubyiruko, harimo imikino njyarugamba nka karate, umupira w’amaguru, kubyina imbyino gakondo, umukino w’amaboko (Volley Ball), n’ibindi.
ART-MU8SJPI9-85FD.summary: Mu kigo cya Imbuto Hub Bugesera, gikorerwamo ibikorwa bitandukanye harimo isomero rusange, kwiga imyuga, na siporo zinyuranye ku bana batoya n’urubyiruko, harimo imikino njyarugamba nka karate, umupira w’amaguru, kubyina imbyino gakondo, umukino w’amaboko (Volley Ball), n’ibindi. Iki kigo ariko, cyanageneye umwanya wihariye abakuze bari mu Muryango witwa ‘Nsindagiza tube Umwe’, aho bakorera imyitozo ngororamubiri, bijyanye n’imbaraga zabo, bakaganira, bakidagadura bakishima. Murekezi Eugene, umunyamuryango wa Nsindagiza tube Umwe, yavuze ko umuryango wabo washinzwe hagamijwe kwita ku buzima bwiza bw’abageze mu zabukuru, kugira ngo babone uko bajya bahura bagakora siporo bashoboye, bakidagadura, bakipimisha indwara zitandura ku bushake n’ibindi byinshi, ariko cyane cyane bagahura ntibigunge.
ART-MU8SJPI9-85FD.body:
Mu kigo cya Imbuto Hub Bugesera, gikorerwamo ibikorwa bitandukanye harimo isomero rusange, kwiga imyuga, na siporo zinyuranye ku bana batoya n’urubyiruko, harimo imikino njyarugamba nka karate, umupira w’amaguru, kubyina imbyino gakondo, umukino w’amaboko (Volley Ball), n’ibindi.

Iki kigo ariko, cyanageneye umwanya wihariye abakuze bari mu Muryango witwa ‘Nsindagiza tube Umwe’, aho bakorera imyitozo ngororamubiri, bijyanye n’imbaraga zabo, bakaganira, bakidagadura bakishima.

Murekezi Eugene, umunyamuryango wa Nsindagiza tube Umwe, yavuze ko umuryango wabo washinzwe hagamijwe kwita ku buzima bwiza bw’abageze mu zabukuru, kugira ngo babone uko bajya bahura bagakora siporo bashoboye, bakidagadura, bakipimisha indwara zitandura ku bushake n’ibindi byinshi, ariko cyane cyane bagahura ntibigunge.

Yagize ati,” Itsinda rya Nsindagiza rikorera hano i Nyamata, rikomoka kuri Nsindagiza, umuryango ukorera mu Rwanda wita ku burenganzira bw’abageze mu zabukuru. Nabonye ko abageze mu zabukuru duturanye bafite ikibazo cy’ubwigunge ngerageza kubegeranya. Ubu tugiye kuzuza umwaka dutangiye. Twagize amahirwe, nyuma yo kumara amezi atanu dukorera mu rugo iwanjye, tubona iyi nzu (Imbuto Hub), baratubwira bati namwe ntimuhejwe, baduha aho gukorera ndetse n’ibikoresho byose bikenewe. Ubu duhurira ahangaha ku wa kabiri no ku wa gatanu nyuma ya saa sita, tukidagadura nk’abageze mu zabukuru, tugakora siporo, ndetse byaba ngombwa, abakeneye kwipimisha indwara zitandura, bakipimisha kuko hano hari abaganga. Turishimye”.

“Ubu turarenga abanyamuryango 80, kuko baza buri munsi biyongera. Umunyamuryango mukuru ni umusaza ufite imyaka 93,ariko hari n’abandi bamwungirije aho ngaho bari muri 90, abatoya nabo barimo bari muri 50. Abo bo ni ukugira ngo basindagize abandi, bakaza tugafatanya siporo, bikabashimisha bikabafasha. Bitanga umusaruro cyane kuko iyo ndebye nk’abo twatangiranye,no kugera mu rugo hafi, hatarimo na metero 200, wabonaga bibagora, ariko ubungubu, barizana kandi harimo abaturuka mu Mirenge ya Mayange na Ntarama bakaza hano”.

Nyirabahakwa Valeria, ufite imyaka 84, avuga uko mbere yo gutangira kujya ahura na bagenzi be muri Nsindagiza, yabaga yumva ari wenyine, akumva umubiri we utamerewe neza ariko ubu ngo aba yumva byarahindutse, ku buryo iminsi y’iyo gahunda yo guhura na bagenzi be ijya kugera yarambiwe.

Agira ati “Nsindagiza ni nziza, ndayikunda,…mba numva mpagaritse gukora siporo namugara burundu. Uyu mubyeyi Jeannette Kagame waduhaye inzu dukoreramo ntacyo namunganya. Naramubwiye nti iyaba nari mfite inka, mba nyiguhaye.Twarabyinanye ndamubwira nti ubonye ngo turabura icyo tugufungurira! Ati icyo mumfunguriye kirahagije. Twamubyiniye ya mbyino ivuga ngo ‘abakobwa b’iwacu’…”.

Sebahizi Paulin, afite imyaka 91, akaba ari umunyamuryango wa Nsindagiza avuga ko iyo ari kumwe n’abandi bahuriyemo, aba yiyumva nk’uri mu muryango kandi mwiza, aho bafatanya muri byose kandi bakumva barimo basaza neza.

Yagize ati, “ Mbere numvaga mbabara amaguru, nkumva ndihinahinnye, ariko ubu byarashize rwose. Nasanze ari byiza rwose twarashimye. Ukuntu byabaye byiza kurushaho, twagiye kubona tubona Madamu Jeannette Kagame araje, aje aratuganiriza, aradukinira, turamukinira biraryoha kuva icyo gihe, …”

Nteziyaremye Pierre Celestin, w'imyaka 71, na we avuga ko nyuma yo gutangira gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri muri Imbuto Hub, yatangiye kumva aguwe neza mu mubiri, nyamara ngo yari atangiye kumva amavi agenda amera nabi.

Yagize ati,”Umuturanyi ni we wambwiye gahunda ya Nsindagiza, yarabibonaga ko narwaye mbyimba amaguru aba umukara nkaguma mu rugo gusa,maze arantumira …hano turaza tukishima, tukabyina. Hano turarutana mu myaka, ariko iyo duhuye, usanga twese twabaye urungano”.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

Bitanga umusaruro cyane kuko iyo ndebye nk’abo twatangiranye,no kugera mu rugo hafi, hatarimo na metero 200, wabonaga bibagora, ariko ubungubu, barizana kandi harimo abaturuka mu Mirenge ya Mayange na Ntarama bakaza hano”.

Nyirabahakwa Valeria, ufite imyaka 84, avuga uko mbere yo gutangira kujya ahura na bagenzi be muri Nsindagiza, yabaga yumva ari wenyine, akumva umubiri we utamerewe neza ariko ubu ngo aba yumva byarahindutse, ku buryo iminsi y’iyo gahunda yo guhura na bagenzi be ijya kugera yarambiwe.

Agira ati “Nsindagiza ni nziza, ndayikunda,…mba numva mpagaritse gukora siporo namugara burundu. Uyu mubyeyi Jeannette Kagame waduhaye inzu dukoreramo ntacyo namunganya. Naramubwiye nti iyaba nari mfite inka, mba nyiguhaye.Twarabyinanye ndamubwira nti ubonye ngo turabura icyo tugufungurira! Ati icyo mumfunguriye kirahagije. Twamubyiniye ya mbyino ivuga ngo ‘abakobwa b’iwacu’…”.

Sebahizi Paulin, afite imyaka 91, akaba ari umunyamuryango wa Nsindagiza avuga ko iyo ari kumwe n’abandi bahuriyemo, aba yiyumva nk’uri mu muryango kandi mwiza, aho bafatanya muri byose kandi bakumva barimo basaza neza.

Yagize ati, “ Mbere numvaga mbabara amaguru, nkumva ndihinahinnye, ariko ubu byarashize rwose. Nasanze ari byiza rwose twarashimye. Ukuntu byabaye byiza kurushaho, twagiye kubona tubona Madamu Jeannette Kagame araje, aje aratuganiriza, aradukinira, turamukinira biraryoha kuva icyo gihe, …”

Nteziyaremye Pierre Celestin, w'imyaka 71, na we avuga ko nyuma yo gutangira gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri muri Imbuto Hub, yatangiye kumva aguwe neza mu mubiri, nyamara ngo yari atangiye kumva amavi agenda amera nabi.

Yagize ati,”Umuturanyi ni we wambwiye gahunda ya Nsindagiza, yarabibonaga ko narwaye mbyimba amaguru aba umukara nkaguma mu rugo gusa,maze arantumira …hano turaza tukishima, tukabyina. Hano turarutana mu myaka, ariko iyo duhuye, usanga twese twabaye urungano”.
Wanditse
Mediatrice Uwingabire
Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8SJQJ4-DRJS.body:
Impuguke n’Abayobozi mu by’Ubuhinzi barutse mu bihugu bya Afurika no hirya no hino ku isi, babigarutseho mu Ihuroro ryabo rirmo kwiga kwita no kongera ibiribwa muri Afurika mu kiswe “Africa Food Systems Forum, 2026” ririmo kubera i Kigali kuva ku wa 31Kanama-4 Nzeri, 2026.

Abitabiriye icyo kiganiro bagaragaje ko urwego rw’ibiribwa rutagomba kwibanda gusa ku guhinga, ahubwo ko hagomba no kwitabwa ku gutunganya umusaruro, kuwutwara, kuwongerera agaciro no kuwugeza ku baturage, byose bikenera ingufu.

Bright Kanyonhore, Minisitiri Leta ushinzwe Ubworozi muri Uganda, yavuze ko igihugu cye cyabonye inyungu zikomeye mu gukoresha ingufu zisubira mu guteza imbere ubuhinzi bwita ku mihindagurikire y’ibihe.

Yagize ati “Gukoresha ingufu zisubira byazanye imikorere myiza muri gahunda zacu, bifasha kugabanya iyangirika ry’ubutaka ndetse bifasha abahinzi kongera amafaranga binjiza.”

Yavuze ko ingufu zisubira ari kimwe mu bice by’ingenzi by’ubuhinzi bwita ku mihindagurikire y’ibihe, ashimangira ko hakenewe politiki zishyigikira ubu buryo.

Kanyonhore yavuze ko hakenewe kandi guhugura abahinzi, bakamenya inyungu z’ubuhinzi bugezweho ndetse bakabona ikoranabuhanga ribafasha guhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe.

Mu byo yagaragaje nk’iby’ingenzi harimo kuhira imyaka, gukoresha imbuto zitanga umusaruro mwinshi kandi zihanganira ibihe bikomeye, gukoresha ifumbire ndetse no kongera serivisi z’ubujyanama ku bahinzi.

Yagize ati “Tugomba kureka kuvuga gusa, tugatangira gukora.”

Uyu muyobozi yavuze kandi ko kubona imari ku nyungu ihendutse ari imwe mu mbogamizi zikomeye zituma abahinzi batitabira ku buryo bworoshye ubuhinzi buhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe.

Yavuze ko Uganda yashyizeho uburyo bwo kugeza imari ku bahinzi ku nzego z’ibanze, ikanabafasha kubona imbuto n’ibikoresho byiza, mu gihe abajyanama b’ubuhinzi bakurikirana ibikorwa byabo kugira ngo ibyo bakora bitange umusaruro.

Ati “Twashyizeho uburyo bwo kugeza imari ku baturage ku rwego rw’ibanze, tubaha imbuto n’ibikoresho byiza, tunashyiraho abajyanama bakurikirana ibikorwa byabo.”

Kanyonhore yavuze ko ubu buryo bwafashije Uganda kongera umusaruro haba mu bihingwa ndetse no mu bworozi.

Abitabiriye ikiganiro bahurije ku kuba ingufu zigomba gufatwa nk’igice cy’ingenzi cy’urwego rw’ibiribwa, kuko usibye guhinga, umusaruro ugomba gutunganywa, ukongerwa agaciro kandi ukagezwa ku masoko.

Wanditse

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

ART-MU8SJR2U-HGOY.body:
Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu, Habimana Dominique, yasabye abaturage bo mu Murenge wa Rwimiyaga mu Karere ka Nyagatare, gucika burundu ku nzoga ya Kanyanga n’izindi nzoga zitujuje ubuziranenge, kuko zangiza ubuzima bw’abazinywa kandi zikagira uruhare mu guhungabanya umutekano.

Minisitiri Habimana yabigarutseho kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 29 Kanama 2026, ubwo yifatanyaga n’abaturage ba Rwimiyaga mu muganda usoza ukwezi kwa Kanama.

Yagize ati: “Kuba muturiye umupaka ntibibaha uburenganzira bwo kwinjiza Kanyanga mu gihugu. Mwibuke ko n’izindi nzoga zose zitujuje ubuziranenge zangiza ubuzima bw’abazinywa.”

Minisitiri Habimana kandi yasabye urubyiruko kwirinda ubusambanyi no gutwara inda zitateganyijwe. Yashimangiye kandi ko ababyeyi bafite uruhare rukomeye mu burere bw’abana babo, abasaba kubakurikirana no kubatoza indangagaciro nziza, kugira ngo birinde ingeso mbi zirimo kunywa ibiyobyabwenge, ubusinzi n’ubujura.

Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Polisi Wungirije ushinzwe ibikorwa, Vincent Sano, yavuze ko kunywa inzoga zitujuje ubuziranenge biri mu bishobora guhungabanya umutekano, kuko ubusinzi bushobora gutuma abazinywa bakora urugomo.

Ati: “Uretse kwangiza ubuzima bw’uzinywa, zinatuma habaho umutekano muke mu muryango nyarwanda.”

Nshimiyimana Musa, umwe mu batanze ubuhamya, yavuze ko yari yarabaswe n’inzoga z’inkorano, bikamuviramo gukora urugomo no gufungwa inshuro nyinshi.

Yagize ati: “Namaze imyaka irenga ine nzira kunywa urumojyi n’ubusinzi, ndetse nagiye no Iwawa. Nyuma naje guhinduka ntandukana nabyo burundu.”

Muri uyu muganda, abaturage bo mu Murenge wa Rwimiyaga banahanzwe umuhanda mushya w’ibirometero bibiri, uzafasha abanyeshuri n’abarezi batuye muri uyu murenge kugera ku ishuri rya GS Mayange.

Abaturage kandi basabwe kwitegura igihembwe cy’ihinga, kuko biteganyijwe ko imvura y’umuhindo izaba nyinshi kandi ikazaba irimo inkuba n’umuyaga.

Mu rwego rwo kwitegura izi mpinduka z’ikirere, abaturage bitabiriye umuganda banaziritse ibisenge by’amazu, mu rwego rwo kubikumira ko byatwarwa n’umuyaga.

Wanditse

Ernestine Musanabera

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8SJRM6-PB0X.body:
Ikiganiro EdTechMondays gitambuka kuri KT Radio kuri uyu wa mbere Tariki 31 Kanama 2026 kiragaruka ku buryo ikoranabuhanga rishobora gufasha abacikirije amashuri gukomeza kwiyungura ubumenyi.

Iki kiganiro kizatambuka guhera saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba kugeza saa moya kuri KT Radio, ndetse kinanyuzwe imbonankubone ku mbuga nkoranyambaga za Kigali Today no ku muyoboro wa YouTube.

Ni ikiganiro kizagaruka ku buryo ibigo by’uburezi, inzego za Leta, abahanga mu ikoranabuhanga n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa bashobora gukorera hamwe, kugira ngo ikoranabuhanga rirusheho kugira uruhare mu gutanga uburezi bugera kuri bose.

Nubwo u Rwanda rwateye intambwe ishimishije mu kongera amahirwe yo kubona uburezi, hari urubyiruko rwinshi mu Rwanda no muri Afurika muri rusange rutari mu mashuri asanzwe.

Impamvu zituma bamwe batiga zirimo ubukene, inshingano zo mu muryango, ubumuga, kwimuka, gutwita bakiri bato ndetse n’izindi mbogamizi zishingiye ku mibereho n’ubukungu.

Muri icyi gihe, iterambere ryihuse ry’ikoranabuhanga riratanga amahirwe mashya yo kwiga mu buryo butandukanye n’ubusanzwe. Ikoranabuhanga rishobora gutuma umuntu yigira aho ari, ku gihe ashoboye kandi hakurikijwe ubushobozi n’ibyo akeneye, bitabaye ngombwa ko buri gihe aba yicaye mu ishuri risanzwe.

Iki kiganiro kizagaragagaza uburyo umuntu ashobora kwiga yifashishije imbuga zifashishwa mu kwiga, amasomo atambutswa kuri radiyo na televiziyo, ibigo bihanga udushya bikorera mu baturage, porogaramu zo kwigira kuri telefoni ndetse n’amahugurwa yibanda ku myuga n’ubumenyi ngiro, biri guha amahirwe n’uburyo bwo kwiga ku rubyiruko rutari mu mashuri.

Ubu buryo bushobora gufasha urubyiruko kongera kubona amahirwe yo kwiga, kurwongerera ubumenyi bw’ibanze n’ubwo gukoresha ikoranabuhanga, ndetse no kurufasha kubona ubumenyi rukenera ku isoko ry’umurimo.

Ikoranabuhanga kandi rishobora gufasha urubyiruko kwitegura kwihangira imirimo, gukora imirimo y’ubumenyi ngiro ndetse no gukomeza kwiga mu buzima busanzwe. Imibare igaragaza uburemere bw’ikibazo

U Rwanda rumaze gushyira imbaraga mu guteza imbere ibikorwa remezo by’ikoranabuhanga no guhindura uburyo uburezi butangwa, ku buryo igihugu kiri mu biri kuzamuka mu bukungu bushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga muri Afurika.

Icyakora, kugira ngo aya mahirwe agere kuri buri rubyiruko, birasaba ubufatanye bukomeye hagati y’inzego za Leta, ibigo by’uburezi, itangazamakuru, ibigo by’udushya ndetse n’abatanga serivisi z’ikoranabuhanga, kugira ngo hashyirweho uburyo bwo kwiga bugera no ku baturage batagerwaho n’uburezi busanzwe.

Imibare ya Minisiteri y’Uburezi mu mwaka wa 2024/2025 igaragaza ko urubyiruko 1,071,766 ruri hagati y’imyaka 18 na 22, bingana na 71.4% by’abari muri icyo kigero, rutari mu mashuri.

Iyo mibare kandi igaragaza ko abana 468,741 bafite hagati y’imyaka 3 na 5, bangana na 46%, batari mu mashuri y’inshuke.

Iyi mibare igaragaza ko hakenewe ubundi buryo bwo kwiga bwifashisha ikoranabuhanga, kugira ngo uburezi bugere ku bantu benshi, urubyiruko ruhabwe ubumenyi bujyanye n’ibikenewe ku isoko ry’umurimo ndetse n’abavuye mu mashuri babone uburyo bwo kongera kuyasubiramo cyangwa kwinjira mu kazi.

Ni muri urwo rwego EdTech Mondays Rwanda yo kuri uyu wa mbere izibanda ku buryo ikoranabuhanga ryafasha kwagura amahirwe yo kubona uburezi, guteza imbere ubumenyi ngiro no gushyiraho inzira zafasha urubyiruko rutari mu mashuri gusubira mu burezi cyangwa kwinjira mu mirimo ibyara umusaruro.

Ikiganiro kizagaruka kuri gahunda n’ibisubizo biri gushyirwa mu bikorwa n’inzego zirimo Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Uburezi (REB), Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe guteza imbere imyuga n’ubumenyi ngiro (RTB), ndetse n’ibigo biteza imbere udushya mu ikoranabuhanga nka FabLab Rwanda.

Hazaganirwa kandi ku buryo inzego zitandukanye zakongera ubufatanye mu guteza imbere uburezi budaheza no kongerera urubyiruko ubushobozi bwo kwiteza imbere.

Mu gihe u Rwanda rukomeje intego yo kubaka ubukungu bushingiye ku bumenyi, kugira ngo ntihagire urubyiruko rusigara inyuma bizasaba uburyo bushya bwo kwiga burenga imipaka y’ishuri risanzwe.

Gukoresha ikoranabuhanga, guhuza imbaraga z’inzego zitandukanye no guteza imbere udushya dushingiye ku bibazo by’abaturage bishobora gufungurira amahirwe ibihumbi by’urubyiruko rutari mu mashuri, bikarufasha kubona ubumenyi, kwihangira imirimo cyangwa kubona akazi.

Ibi kandi bishobora kugira uruhare mu kubaka abakozi bafite ubumenyi, bashoboye guhangana n’impinduka kandi bafite ubushobozi bwo kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’igihugu.

Ernestine Musanabera

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8SJS5Y-DLE9.subtitle: Ni ibitaro byakiriwe n’ubuyobozi bukuru bwa Ministeri y’Ubuzima kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 28 Kanama 2026, ku bufatanya na Ambasade y’u Bushinwa mu Rwanda.
ART-MU8SJS5Y-DLE9.summary: Ni ibitaro byakiriwe n’ubuyobozi bukuru bwa Ministeri y’Ubuzima kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 28 Kanama 2026, ku bufatanya na Ambasade y’u Bushinwa mu Rwanda. Biri ku rwego mpuzamahanga bikaba ari byo bibaye ibitaro bya mbere binini mu Rwanda, aho biteganyijwe ko bizimukiramo ibitaro bikuru bya Kaminuza bya Kigali (CHUK) bitarenze muri uyu mwaka, ubusanzwe byakira abarwayi bari hagati ya 400-500 bavurwaga baba mu bitaro. ART-MU8SJS5Y-DLE9.body:
Ni ibitaro byakiriwe n’ubuyobozi bukuru bwa Ministeri y’Ubuzima kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 28 Kanama 2026, ku bufatanya na Ambasade y’u Bushinwa mu Rwanda.

Biri ku rwego mpuzamahanga bikaba ari byo bibaye ibitaro bya mbere binini mu Rwanda, aho biteganyijwe ko bizimukiramo ibitaro bikuru bya Kaminuza bya Kigali (CHUK) bitarenze muri uyu mwaka, ubusanzwe byakira abarwayi bari hagati ya 400-500 bavurwaga baba mu bitaro.

Ni umwe mu mishinga minini u Rwanda rwakoranye n’u Bushinwa hagamijwe kuvugurura no kwagura ibitaro bya Masaka, ukaba ugeze ku musozo nyuma y’imyaka irenga ine imirimo yo kuyubaka itangiye.

Byaraguwe binubakwa mu buryo budasanzwe kubera ko byavuye ku buso bwa metero kare 6,398 byari byubatseho mbere aho ibitaro bya Masaka byakoreraga bigera kuri metero kare 56,957 hamwe n’umubare w’ibitanda bishobora kwakirirwaho abarwayi wiyongereye ukagera ku bitanda 837 uvuye ku 127, mu gihe bifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abarwayi bivuza bataha bagera 2,000 ku munsi.

Ibitaro bishya bigizwe n’inyubako 13, zirimo iyakirirwamo abarwayi n’abakeneye ubutabazi bwihuse, inyubako y’ibikoresho n’ikoranabuhanga by’ubuvuzi, ibyumba biryamywamo abarwayi, inyubako y’ubuyobozi ndetse n’ahagenewe kajugujugu, bikagira n’ibyumba 22 bikorerwamo ibikorwa byo kubaga abarwayi, bikazagira uruhare mu kongera ubushobozi bw’u Rwanda bwo gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi bw’inzobere.

Nyuma yo kwerekwa inyubako zose zigize ibi bitaro Minisitiri w’Ubuzima, Dr Sabin Nsanzimana, yavuze ko ikigiye gukurikiraho ari ugutegura uburyo abarwayi batangira kuhivuriza kubera ko ari ho ibitaro bya CHUK bigomba kwimukira.

Yagize ati “Aho byari biri mu Mujyi, ubu tuvugana birimo gukora, ntabwo kwimura ibitaro ari nkuko wakwimura igikarito ukagiterura ukagitereka ahandi hantu, bikorwa mu buryo butuma serivisi idakomwa mu nkokora. Tuzajya twimuka mu byiciro, ishami rimwe rize, irindi rikurikire, ku buryo hari igihe twihaye bizaba byarangiye, ni nabyo bigiye gukurikiraho guhera uyu munsi.”

Yungamo ati “Hari imirimo mike iri bubanze gukorwa, sisiteme bavuriramo ziri bubanze guhuzwa, ibikoresho bimwe na bimwe biri buze kwimukiramo aha, hari n’ibyatumijwe biza gufungurwa kugira ngo ibitaro bikorwe. Ibyo ntitwari kubikora tutarashyikirizwa inyubako. Turizera ko uyu mwaka turimo, urangira serivisi z’ingenzi wasangaga ziniganira hariya CHUK, usanga binagorana kubona umwanya ku barwayi, ziza kubona umwanya wisanzuye aha ngaha, niyo gahunda dufite.”

Minisitiri Dr. Nsanzimana, avuga ko hazajya hanatangirwa izindi serivisi zitatangirwaga muri CHUK ziri ku cyiciro cyisumbuye, zirimo gusimburizwa ngingo z’umubiri, zibigira ibitaro byo ku rwego rw'Akarere.

Ati “Hari ibyo gusimbuza impyiko twatangiye muri Faisal, aha ngaha naho turashaka ko hazakorerwa ibindi bisa nabyo ku zindi ngingo. Hari izindi ngingo ushobora gusimbuza nk’umwijima, ubushobozi bwo kubaga bitashoboraga gukorerwa aha, gusimbura umusokora w’amagufa n’ibindi. Ibyo rero hari za serivisi zizaba zirimo aha zibishinzwe. Dufite umwanya twaziteganyirije, hari byinshi cyane mpuzamahanga, dutekereza ko ibi bitaro bizatuma Abanyafurika bajyaga bajya ku migabane ya kure, bashobora kuza kwivuriza hano i Masaka.”

Ambasaderi w’u Bushinwa mu Rwanda, Gao Wenqi, yavuze ko icyiciro cya mbere cy’umushinga cyarangiye, ubu barimo kureba ku cyiciro cya kabiri cyawo kuko ari cyo cy’ingenzi.

Yagize ati “Tuzatanga andi mafaranga n’ubundi bufasha, burimo gushyiraho ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gihuriweho, gutanga andi mahugurwa, kongera buruse ku banyeshuri bajya kwiga mu Bushinwa, gutanga ibikoresho by’ubuvuzi ndetse no kongera ubufatanye no kungurana ubumenyi hagati y’abakozi b’ubuzima b’ibihugu byombi.”

Yanavuze ko uyu mwaka ari umwihariko kuko hizihizwa imyaka 55 ishize u Rwanda n’u Bushinwa bitangije umubano w’ububanyi n’amahanga.

Muri rusange uyu mushinga watangiye gushyirwa mu bikorwa muri Nyakanga 2022, naho gutangiza ku mugaragaro imirimo yo kubaka wabaye ku wa 30 Werurwe 2023.

Abanyarwanda barenga 1,000 bungukiye mu mirimo yo kubaka ibitaro bya Masaka aho babonyemo akazi gatandukanye, mu gihe abaganga b’Abashinwa bamaze kuvura abarwayi barenga 720,000 mu Rwanda, banatanze serivisi zo kubaga zirenga 40,000.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8SJSPT-0Y2B.body:
Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda (BNR) yatangaje ko urwego rw’imari rw’u Rwanda rukomeje kugira umutekano n’ubudahangarwa, nubwo ruhura n’ibibazo bishobora kugira ingaruka ku bukungu, birimo izamuka ry’ibiciro ku isoko mpuzamahanga, umutekano muke ukomeje mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati n’izamuka ry’ifaranga.

Ibi byatangajwe na Komite ishinzwe Ubutajegajega bw’Urwego rw’Imari, nyuma yo gusuzuma uko uru rwego ruhagaze mu mpera za Kamena 2026.

Raporo y’iyi komite igaragaza ko umutungo w’ibigo by’imari wageze kuri Tiriyari 17.5 Frw, wiyongereyeho 23% ugereranyije n’igihe nk’iki mu 2025. Ugereranyije n’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu (GDP), umutungo w’urwego rw’imari wageze kuri 68%, uvuye kuri 66%.

Inguzanyo zazamutseho 22%

Inguzanyo zatanzwe n’amabanki n’ibigo by’imari iciriritse na zo zakomeje kwiyongera. Mu gice cya mbere cya 2026, zageze kuri Tiriyari 7 Frw, ziyongereyeho 22% ugereranyije n’umwaka ushize.

Amabanki yari afite izisaga Tiriyari 6 Frw, mu gihe ibigo by’imari iciriritse byo byari bifite hafi Miliyari 834 Frw, ziyongereyeho 27%.

Ubwubatsi ni bwo bwakomeje kuza ku isonga mu kubona inguzanyo, aho uruhare rwabwo rwazamutse ruva kuri 19% rugera kuri 23%.

Hari kandi izamuka rikomeye ry’inguzanyo zahawe ubuhinzi. Inguzanyo nshya zatanzwe muri uru rwego zazamutseho 177%, zigera kuri Miliyari 57 Frw, bituma uruhare rw’ubuhinzi mu nguzanyo rusange ruzamuka rva kuri 2% rugera kuri 5%.

BNR yavuze ko ibipimo by’inguzanyo zitishyurwa ku gihe bikomeje kuba munsi y’urugero ntarengwa rwa 5%. Mu mabanki, izitari kwishyurwa neza zari kuri 3%, naho mu bigo by’imari iciriritse ziba 2.3%.

Nubwo bimeze bityo, Komite yagaragaje ko hakenewe gukomeza gukurikiranwa ikibazo cy’uko 88% by’amafaranga abitswa ari ay’igihe gito. Ibi bishobora gutera ikibazo mu gihe ayo mafaranga y’igihe gito akoreshwa mu gutanga inguzanyo z’igihe kirekire.

Muri rusange, BNR yemeje ko urwego rw’imari rw’u Rwanda rukomeye kandi rufite ubushobozi bwo guhangana n’ibihungabanya ubukungu, ariko ko hakenewe gukomeza kuba maso ku bibazo bishobora kuvuka.

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

ART-MU8SJT9P-I5OE.body:
Banki Nkuru y'u Rwanda (BNR) yazamuye urwunguko rwayo ruva ku 8,25% rwari rwashyizweho mu mezi atatu ashize (Gicurasi uyu mwaka), irushyira ku 8,75% mu rwego rwo guhangana n’izamuka ry’ibiciro ku masoko rikomeje kwiyongera no kurinda agaciro k’ifaranga.

Muri Gicurasi uyu mwaka, urwunguko rwa BNR rwari rwashyizwe ku 8,25% kugira ngo ibashe guhangana n’izamuka ry’ibiciro ku masoko.

Iri zamuka ry’urwunguko fatizo rwa Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda, ni icyemezo cyafashwe na Komite ya Politiki y’Ifaranga (Monetary Policy Committee) nyuma yo gusuzuma imigendekere y’ubukungu n’izamuka ry’ibiciro mu gihembwe cya kabiri cy’umwaka wa 2026.

BNR ivuga ko ubukungu bw’u Rwanda bukomeje kugaragaza ubudahangarwa, ariko ko Igihugu gikomeje guhura n’izamuka rikomeye ry’ibiciro, cyane cyane bitewe n’izamuka ry’ibiciro by’ingufu ku isoko mpuzamahanga.

Mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya 2026, izamuka rusange ry’ibiciro ryageze kuri 13.2%, rivuye kuri 9.8% ryari ryagaragaye mu gihembwe cya mbere cy’umwaka. Muri Nyakanga 2026, iryo zamuka ry’ibiciro ryakomeje kwihuta, rigera kuri 14.5%.

BNR igaragaza ko izamuka ry’ibiciro ryagaragaye mu byiciro hafi ya byose, birimo ibiribwa bishya, ibicuruzwa n’imitungo itagira ingufu, ndetse n’ingufu. Mu gihembwe cya kabiri, izamuka ry’ibiciro by’ingufu ryageze kuri 45%, mu gihe ibiciro by’ibiribwa bishya byazamutse ku kigero cya 7.3%.

Muri Nyakanga, ibiciro by’ibiribwa bishya byazamutse ku kigero cya 16%, mu gihe izamuka ry’ibiciro by’ingufu ryari kuri 44.8%.

BNR yavuze ko ibi bipimo biri hejuru y’urugero rw’izamuka ry’ibiciro igihugu cyihaye, aho intego ari ukugumana izamuka rusange ry’ibiciro hagati ya 2% na 8%, ndetse mu gihe giciriritse rikagera kuri 5%.

Komite ya Politiki y’Ifaranga yasuzumye kandi ingaruka z’ihungabana ry’itangwa ry’ibicuruzwa ku isoko mpuzamahanga, cyane cyane nyuma y’ifungwa ry’Umuhora wa Hormuz (Strait of Hormuz).

BNR yavuze ko nubwo habayeho agahenge hagati muri Kamena no mu cyumweru cya mbere cya Nyakanga 2026, bigatuma ubwikorezi bw’ibicuruzwa busubukurwa, uko gusubukura kwabaye kugufi kuko nyuma habayeho kongera guhungabana kw’ubwikorezi muri uwo muhanda.

Ibi byatumye ibiciro byo gutumiza, gutunganya no gukwirakwiza ibicuruzwa ku rwego mpuzamahanga bikomeza kuzamuka, bikagira n’ingaruka ku biciro ku isoko ry’imbere mu gihugu.

Mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru kuri uyu wa Kane, Guverineri wa Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda, Soraya Hakuziyaremye, yavuze ko izamuka ry’urwunguko rwayo, nta ngaruka bishobora kugira ku nguzanyo zitangwa n’ibigo by’imari.

Yagize ati “Tumaze kuzamura uru rwunguko no muri Gicurasi, inguzanyo ntabwo zagabanutse, ahubwo zazamutseho birenze 22% mu mezi atandatu y’uyu mwaka (Mutarama-Kamena). Ntabwo bivuga ko iyo Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda izamuye urwunguko, inguzanyo mu baturage zigabanuka, ahubwo icyo tuba dushaka kwerekana nka BNR, ni uko umuvuduko w’izamuka ry’ibiciro, urimo kuzamuka cyane kurenga za mbago za hagati ya 2% na 8%, tuba twifuza kugira ngo tugire iterambere ry’ubukungu rirambye.”

Yungamo ati “Aho rero tugomba kuzamura urwunguko, kugira ngo dushobore kugabanya uwo muvuduko w’izamuka ry’ibiciro, ubu tuzi ko watewe no kuzamuka cyane cyane kw’ibiciro by’ibikomoka kuri peteroli bitewe n’intambara iri muri Iran no gufunga ku uyu Muhora, uzakomeza kuzamuka bitewe n’abantu benshi barimo gusaba inguzanyo, bakazamura gushaka ibicuruzwa byinshi, kuko iyo abifuza ibicuruzwa batangiye kuruta ibicuruzwa, ibiciro birazamuka.”

Guverineri Hakuziyaremye, avuga ko mu nzego zitandukanye z’ubukungu by’umwihariko izikenewe cyane n’Igihugu kugira ngo kigire iterambere rirambye, zihabwa umwihariko wo kubona inguzanyo ziri hejuru kuko nk’uw’ubuhinzi rwari rusanzwe rubona inguzanyo ya 2%, ubu ziyongera zikagera kuri 5%.

Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda ivuga ko Politiki y’ifaranga ishingiye ku kugira ngo bagabanye umuvuduko w’izamuka ry’ibiciro kuko iyo urenze imbago za 8%, bigira ingaruka zikomeye ku bukungu no ku bushobozi bw’umuguzi kandi ari byo bashinzwe kurengera.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8SJTU3-15AY.summary: Umunyamakuru akaba n’umusesenguzi wo muri Uganda, Andrew Mwenda, yavuze ko Afurika ikwiye guhindura imyumvire yayo ku mutungo kamere wayo, kuko ikibazo cy’umugabane atari ukubura amabuye y’agaciro menshi ahubwo ari uko udafite ubushobozi buhagije bwo kuyabyazamo ibicuruzwa bifite agaciro kanini. Mu kiganiro cyari gifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti “What if all you have been told on Africa’s minerals is wrong?” (Byagenda bite niba ibyo wabwiwe byose ku mabuye y’agaciro ya Afurika atari ukuri?), Mwenda yavuze ko Afurika ikwiye kureka kwibanda ku bwinshi bw’amabuye y’agaciro iri munsi y’ubutaka, ahubwo igashaka uburyo bwo kuyabyazamo umusaruro ufite agaciro kanini.
ART-MU8SJTU3-15AY.body:
Umunyamakuru akaba n’umusesenguzi wo muri Uganda, Andrew Mwenda, yavuze ko Afurika ikwiye guhindura imyumvire yayo ku mutungo kamere wayo, kuko ikibazo cy’umugabane atari ukubura amabuye y’agaciro menshi ahubwo ari uko udafite ubushobozi buhagije bwo kuyabyazamo ibicuruzwa bifite agaciro kanini.

Mwenda yabigarutseho kuri uyu wa 26 Kanama 2026, i Kigali, mu nama ya Africa Mindset Reset Forum, iri kubera kuva ku wa 25 kugeza ku wa 26 Kanama, yateguwe n’Ishuri Nyafurika ry’Imiyoborere (ASG).

Mu kiganiro cyari gifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti “What if all you have been told on Africa’s minerals is wrong?” (Byagenda bite niba ibyo wabwiwe byose ku mabuye y’agaciro ya Afurika atari ukuri?), Mwenda yavuze ko Afurika ikwiye kureka kwibanda ku bwinshi bw’amabuye y’agaciro iri munsi y’ubutaka, ahubwo igashaka uburyo bwo kuyabyazamo umusaruro ufite agaciro kanini.

Yasobanuye ko iterambere rikorwa mu rwego rw’ubucuruzi mpuzamahanga, aho ibihugu bitandukanye bigira imyanya itandukanye mu ruhererekane rw’agaciro.

Yatanze urugero rwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo icukura coltan, mu gihe ibindi bihugu bikora ‘microchips’ cyangwa bigakora telefoni. Yavuze ko amafaranga igihugu cyinjiza aturuka ku mwanya gifite muri urwo ruhererekane rw’agaciro.

Mwenda yavuze ko ikibazo Afurika ifite atari ukuba cyangwa kutaba ifite amabuye y’agaciro, ahubwo ari kubura igishoro cy’abantu bafite ubumenyi (human capital) n’ikoranabuhanga byo kuyahinduramo ibicuruzwa bifite agaciro gakomeye.

Yagize ati: “Ibirombe byacu byacu bikomeye kurusha ibndi ntabwo biri mu zahabu; ahubwo mu bantu bafite ubumenyi.”

Yavuze ko ibihugu nka Koreya y’Epfo n’u Buyapani biri mu bihugu byateye imbere cyane mu nganda n’ikoranabuhanga, nubwo bidafite amabuye menshi y’agaciro ugereranyije n’Afurika.

Afurika iracyafite byinshi itazi ku butaka bwayo

Mwenda yavuze kandi ko Afurika ari wo mugabane utarakorwamo ubushakashatsi buhagije ku bijyanye n’amabuye y’agaciro.

Yagaragaje ko amakuru menshi Afurika ikoresha mu kumenya amabuye ari munsi y’ubutaka bwayo akomoka ku bushakashatsi n’amakarita yakozwe mu gihe cy’ubukoloni, kandi ko ibihugu byinshi bitaravugurura ayo makuru hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga rigezweho.

Ati “Turwanira ikintu tutazi.”

Yavuze ko usibye ibihugu nka Afurika y’Epfo na Maroc, ndetse n’ibindi bike biri gutera intambwe, ibihugu byinshi bya Afurika bitaramenya neza ubutunzi bwihishe munsi y’ubutaka bwabyo.

Afurika ibona igice gito cyane cy’agaciro k’amabuye icukura

Mwenda yagaragaje ko amafaranga yose ava mu bucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro muri Afurika agera hafi kuri miliyari 500 z’amadolari ku mwaka, ariko ko imisoro n’amahoro y’ubucukuzi ibihugu by’Afurika bibona ari hafi miliyari 20 z’amadolari gusa.

Yavuze ko kimwe mu bitera iki kibazo ari uko ubushakashatsi, ubucukuzi, gutunganya amabuye n’ibindi bikorwa biri muri uru ruhererekane ahanini bitagenzurwa n’Afurika.

Yakomeje agira ati “Tugomba kwigarurira ubuyobozi bw’ubutunzi bwacu.”

Yagereranyije ibi n’uko bikorwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho amabuye y’agaciro make acukurwa ashobora kuvamo agaciro gakomeye cyane iyo atunganyijwe agakoreshwa mu nganda z’ikoranabuhanga rihanitse, iz’indege n’izindi.

Mwenda yavuze ko ari yo nzira Afurika ikwiye kuganiraho: uko yahindura ubutunzi buke icukura ikabubyazamo agaciro gakomeye mu bukungu.

Mwenda yakoresheje urugero rwa telefoni ya iPhone yari afite mu ntoki mu gusobanura uko agaciro k’ibicuruzwa kagabanywa mu ruhererekane rwabyo.

Yavuze ko igice kinini cy’agaciro ka iPhone gituruka ku kuyishushanya, kuyimenyekanisha no kuyicuruza, mu gihe ibindi bikorwa bishobora gukorwa ahandi.

Yavuze ko Afurika ishobora gucukura amabuye, ikayatunganya ndetse ikayagurisha, ariko igihe cyose itari ku rwego rwo hejuru rw’uruhererekane rw’agaciro, inyungu nini izakomeza kujya ahandi.

Ibigo mpuzamahanga by’ubucuruzi “Multinational companies” ntibizana ikoranabuhanga ryose muri Afurika

Mwenda yanenze imyumvire ivuga ko ishoramari mpuzamahanga ari ryo rizahindura Afurika. Yavuze ko ibigo mpuzamahanga akenshi bitimura ibikorwa byabyo bifite agaciro kanini kurusha ibindi bikabijyana mu mashami yabyo ari mu bindi bihugu.

Yatanze urugero rwa Apple, avuga ko ishobora gukora igiteranyo cya telefoni mu Bushinwa, ariko ibikorwa bifite agaciro gakomeye nk’igishushanyo cy’igicuruzwa, ikoranabuhanga no kugicuruza bikaguma muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.

Ati “Ibyo twita ibigo mpuzamahanga, mu by’ukuri ni ibigo by’ibihugu bifite ibikorwa mpuzamahanga.”

Ku bwe, Afurika ikwiye rero kwibaza niba ishoramari ry’amahanga rihagije mu guhindura imiterere y’ubukungu bwayo, aho kwibanda gusa ku mubare w’ibigo by’amahanga byaje gucukura umutungo wayo.

Mu gusoza, Mwenda yavuze ko Afurika iri kurwanira ikibazo kitari cyo iyo yibaza gusa ku bwinshi bw’amabuye y’agaciro ifite.

Yashimangiye ko ikibazo nyamukuru ari ukumenya icyo Afurika yakora n’amabuye y’agaciro ifite, ikifashisha ubumenyi bw’abaturage bayo, ikoranabuhanga n’ubushobozi bwo gukora ibicuruzwa bifite agaciro kanini.

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

content_blocks.text: Umunyamakuru akaba n’umusesenguzi wo muri Uganda, Andrew Mwenda, yavuze ko Afurika ikwiye guhindura imyumvire yayo ku mutungo kamere wayo, kuko ikibazo cy’umugabane atari ukubura amabuye y’agaciro menshi ahubwo ari uko udafite ubushobozi buhagije bwo kuyabyazamo ibicuruzwa bifite agaciro kanini.
Mwenda yabigarutseho kuri uyu wa 26 Kanama 2026, i Kigali, mu nama ya Africa Mindset Reset Forum, iri kubera kuva ku wa 25 kugeza ku wa 26 Kanama, yateguwe n’Ishuri Nyafurika ry’Imiyoborere (ASG).

Mu kiganiro cyari gifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti “What if all you have been told on Africa’s minerals is wrong?” (Byagenda bite niba ibyo wabwiwe byose ku mabuye y’agaciro ya Afurika atari ukuri?), Mwenda yavuze ko Afurika ikwiye kureka kwibanda ku bwinshi bw’amabuye y’agaciro iri munsi y’ubutaka, ahubwo igashaka uburyo bwo kuyabyazamo umusaruro ufite agaciro kanini.

ART-MU8SJUD6-DEPO.summary: Akamanzi yabigarutseho mu kiganiro yatanze muri Africa Mindset Reset Forum irimo kubera i Kigali kuva tariki 25-26 Kanama, agaragaza ko siporo ishobora gutanga akazi, guteza imbere ubukerarugendo, ubwikorezi, itangazamakuru, kwakira abantu n’ibindi bikorwa by’ubucuruzi. Yatanze urugero rwa Basketball Africa League (BAL), avuga ko mu myaka ine ya mbere ikorera muri Afurika, ryagize uruhare mu gutanga akazi 37,000 no kongera umusaruro mbumbe w’ibihugu bine ryakiniyemo ho miliyoni 250 z’amadolari. Akamanzi yagize ati “Siporo itanga amahirwe atarangirira ku bakinnyi gusa, kuko ikenera abatoza, abasifuzi, abaganga b’imikino, abavura imvune, abanyamakuru, abakora ibijyanye n’ibitangazamakuru n’ikoranabuhanga, kwamamaza ndetse n’abashinzwe ubucuruzi.” Akamanzi yavuze ko mu gihe BAL yakwagura ibikorwa ikagera mu bihugu 20, inyungu z’ubukungu zishobora kugera kuri miliyari z’amadolari.
ART-MU8SJUD6-DEPO.body:
Akamanzi yabigarutseho mu kiganiro yatanze muri Africa Mindset Reset Forum irimo kubera i Kigali kuva tariki 25-26 Kanama, agaragaza ko siporo ishobora gutanga akazi, guteza imbere ubukerarugendo, ubwikorezi, itangazamakuru, kwakira abantu n’ibindi bikorwa by’ubucuruzi.

Yatanze urugero rwa Basketball Africa League (BAL), avuga ko mu myaka ine ya mbere ikorera muri Afurika, ryagize uruhare mu gutanga akazi 37,000 no kongera umusaruro mbumbe w’ibihugu bine ryakiniyemo ho miliyoni 250 z’amadolari.

Akamanzi yagize ati “Siporo itanga amahirwe atarangirira ku bakinnyi gusa, kuko ikenera abatoza, abasifuzi, abaganga b’imikino, abavura imvune, abanyamakuru, abakora ibijyanye n’ibitangazamakuru n’ikoranabuhanga, kwamamaza ndetse n’abashinzwe ubucuruzi.”

Akamanzi yavuze ko mu gihe BAL yakwagura ibikorwa ikagera mu bihugu 20, inyungu z’ubukungu zishobora kugera kuri miliyari z’amadolari. Yatangaje kandi ko mu myaka icumi iri imbere hateganywa ko BAL ishobora gutanga imirimo igera ku 650,000 ndetse ikagira uruhare muri GDP ya Afurika ingana na miliyari eshanu z’amadolari.

Yavuze ko impinduka ikomeye ikenewe ari ugushyira siporo mu ngamba z’iterambere ry’ibihugu. Yasabye ko siporo ijya ibarwa mu igenamigambi ry’ubukungu nk’uko bikorwa ku mihanda, amashanyarazi n’ibindi bikorwa remezo.

Akamanzi kandi yasabye ababyeyi kudatandukanya siporo n’uburezi, kuko siporo yigisha abana ubuyobozi, gukorera hamwe, disipuline, kwihangana no kwakira gutsindwa no gutsinda.

Yagaragaje kandi ko Afurika idakwiye gukomeza kohereza hanze impano zayo, kuko iyo impano ijya hanze, n’agaciro k’ubukungu iba ifite kajyana na yo. Yavuze ko intego ikwiye kuba ukubaka urwego rwa siporo rushobora gutuma impano z’Abanyafurika zibona amahirwe yo kwigaragaza no kubyaza umusaruro impano zabo bari ku mugabane.

Akamanzi yashimangiye ko siporo ikwiye gufatwa nk’“umutungo w’ingenzi w’iterambere” rya Afurika.

Wanditse

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

ART-MU8SJUWJ-VW60.body:
Leta y’u Rwanda yakiriye Abanyarwanda barenga 400 baturutse mu Burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC), biganjemo abagore n’abana, n’abandi bakuze bamazeyo imyaka irenga 30.

Bakiriwe kuri uyu wa Gatatu, tariki 26 Kanama 2026, banyuze ku mupaka uhuza u Rwanda na RDC unyuze mu Karere ka Rubavu (La Corniche), bose hamwe bakaba ari 406 bari mu miryango 125.

Ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda bakiriwe n’ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Rubavu hamwe n’abakozi b’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Mpunzi (UNHCR), aho bava berekeza mu nkambi y’agateganyo ya Nyarushishi iherere mu Karere ka Rusizi, aho bafashwa kubona ibyangombwa nkenerwa bakabona gusubizwa mu buzima busanzwe.

Bavuga ko bari bamaze kurambirwa kusiragizwa yitwaje intaro ikorera mu Burasirazuba bwa RDC, aho abayigize babakoreraga ihohotera rikabije, Leta irebera ntihagire icyo ibikoraho.

Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Rubavu, bwabasabye gufatanya n’Abanyarwanda basanze mu gihugu, guteza imbere imibereho yabo n’Igihugu muri rusange.

Aba batahutse basanga bagenzi babo baheruka guhata mu ntangiriro z’uku kwezi ( tariki 5 Kanama 2026) 302, barimo 285, banyuze ku mupaka wa La Corniche mu gihe ku mupaka wa Rusizi I, uhuza Akarere ka Rusizi n'Umujyi wa Bukavu hanyuze 17.

Muri rusange imibare igaragaza ko kuva muri Mutarama 2025, umubare w'Abanyarwanda bamaze gutaha bavuye muri RDC urenga 8.900, aho benshi muri bo bavuga ko bari barahejejwe mu mashyamba y’icyo gihugu n'umutwe w'iterabwoba wa FDLR, wari warabagize ingwate mu bice bitandukanye byo mu Burasirazuba bwa RDC.

Abamaze gutaha icyo bahuriraho bose, ni uko bavuga ko ubuzima bari babayemo mu mashyamba bwari bugoye, kubera kubura amafunguro, uburwayi, umutekano muke no kubaho mu bwigunge. Hari n'abagaragaza ko bafashwe ku ngufu cyangwa bakagumishwa muri ayo mashyamba batabishaka n'imitwe yitwaje intwaro irimo FDLR.

Guverinoma y'u Rwanda isaba Abanyarwanda bakiri mu mashyamba ya RDC kudatinya gutaha, ibizeza ko bazakirwa neza, bagafashwa kongera kubaka ubuzima bwabo no kwiteza imbere nk'abandi Banyarwanda.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

Aya mafaranga azahabwa Leta n’intara byareze iki kigo, ndetse akazakoreshwa mu bikorwa bigamije guteza imbere umutekano w’abana kuri interineti.
ART-MU8SJVH2-9OQ8.body:
Mu masezerano y’urubanza, Meta yemeye kwishyura kugeza kuri miliyari 16.7 z’amadolari.

Ni ukuvuga hafi miliyari 24,549 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda.

Aya mafaranga azahabwa Leta n’intara byareze iki kigo, ndetse akazakoreshwa mu bikorwa bigamije guteza imbere umutekano w’abana kuri interineti.

Meta yanemeye impinduka zikomeye ku bana n’urubyiruko bari munsi y’imyaka 18.

Muri izo mpinduka harimo kubashyiriraho amasaha abujijwe gukoresha imbuga hagati ya saa sita z’ijoro na saa kumi n’ebyiri za mu gitondo, igihe ntarengwa cy’amasaha abiri ku munsi, guhagarika amatangazo mu masaha y’ishuri no kubibutsa kuruhuka nyuma ya buri minota 15 bamaze bakoresha urubuga.

Ibirego byibanze ku kuba Meta yarashinjwaga gutegura serivisi zayo ku buryo zishobora gutuma abana bazikoresha mu buryo bukabije, ndetse no kudaha agaciro bihagije ingaruka zishobora kubageraho.

Usibye ayo mafaranga, Meta izishyura miliyoni 459 z’amadolari ku birego bijyanye n’amakuru y’abakoresha muri gahunda ya Cambridge Analytica. Hari kandi miliyari 1 y’Amadolari izishyurwa muri Texas ku rundi rubanza.

Nubwo Meta yemeye aya masezerano ariko yakomeje guhakana ko yakoze amakosa.

Wanditse

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

Gatare yavuze ko yashimye by’umwihariko ibikorwa Dangote akorera muri gahunda ya Africa Renaissance Group, yasobanuye nk’igitekerezo cya Dangote ku giti cye cyo guhuza abanyabwenge n’abafite ubushobozi bukomeye muri Afurika, kugira ngo batekereze ku buryo uyu mugabane wateza imbere ubuyobozi n’ubukungu byawo.
ART-MU8SJW09-ZUYB.body:
Gatare yabigarutseho mu Ihuriro ry’Iminsi 2 ryiga ku mpinduka Afurika ikwiye gukora kugira ngo ishobore gutera imbere (Africa Mindset Reset Forum) ririmo kubera i Kigali kuva ejo tariki 25-26 Kanama, aho yavuze ko Dangote n’Umuryango we bagira uruhare mu gukusanya abayobozi n’abanyabwenge bakomeye bo muri Afurika kugira ngo baganire ku bibazo byugarije uyu mugabane n’ibisubizo byabyo.

Yavuze ko nubwo Dangote atabashije kwitabira iyo nama, yari yifuje kuyigiramo uruhare, ndetse akaba yarohereje abamuhagarariye.

Gatare yavuze ko yashimye by’umwihariko ibikorwa Dangote akorera muri gahunda ya Africa Renaissance Group, yasobanuye nk’igitekerezo cya Dangote ku giti cye cyo guhuza abanyabwenge n’abafite ubushobozi bukomeye muri Afurika, kugira ngo batekereze ku buryo uyu mugabane wateza imbere ubuyobozi n’ubukungu byawo.

Yagize ati “Dangote, usanzwe ari umwe mu bashoramari bakomeye muri Afurika, asi umuntu wibanda ku ishoramari gusa, ahubwo anagerageza kugira uruhare mu gushakira umuti ibibazo by’imiyoborere bikomeje kubangamira iterambere ry’umugabane.”

Gatare yavuze ko ibikorwa bya Dangote bihuye cyane n’intego z’Ishuri Nyafurika ry’Imiyoborere (ASG) ndetse n’ubutumwa bwari bugamijwe muri Africa Mindset Reset Forum, bwibanda ku guhindura imyumvire y’Abanyafurika no gushaka ibisubizo by’ibibazo by’umugabane bishingiye ku bushobozi bwawo.

Yasabye abari bahagarariye Dangote kugeza ubutumwa bwo kumushimira ku bikorwa bye, avuga ko Afurika ikeneye abantu bafite ubushobozi bwo kuyobora ibitekerezo no guhuriza hamwe abafite ubushake bwo kuyihindura.

Ati “Ibikorwa bya Dangote bigaragaza umuntu ‘wita ku mugabane wa Afurika’, kandi ko kuba yarakoresheje ubushobozi afite mu guhuriza hamwe abantu baganira ku bibazo by’Afurika ari umusanzu ukwiye kumenyekana no gushimwa.”

Gatare yavuze ko ASG izakomeza gushyigikira ibiganiro n’ibikorwa biharanira guteza imbere imiyoborere myiza, kuzamura ubushobozi bw’Abanyafurika no kubaka Afurika ishobora kwishakira ibisubizo by’ibibazo byayo.

Iri shuri ryashinzwe hagamijwe gutanga umusanzu mu guteza imbere abayobozi n’abayobozi b’ejo hazaza bafite ubumenyi n’imyumvire bikenewe kugira ngo Afurika ibashe guhindura amahirwe ifite umusaruro uhamye.

Umunyemari Aliko Dangote yeguriye ibikorwa byo guhindura imitekerereze n’imyumvire ya Afurika 25% by’umutungo we, nk’umusanzu wo kugira ngo Afurika ishobore gutera imbere no kwigira.

Wanditse

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

ART-MU8SJWJW-IBFU.title: Iterambere ry'u Rwanda rigomba kujyana n'iry'Akarere kose - Perezida Kagame
ART-MU8SJWJW-IBFU.subtitle: Perezida Paul Kagame yavuze ko iterambere ry’u Rwanda ritagira igisobanuro gihagije mu gihe ibindi bihugu byo mu karere no ku mugabane wa Afurika bitarimo gutera imbere, ashimangira ko u Rwanda rutagomba kwibona nk’Igihugu cyigenga ku zindi mpinduka za Afurika.
