ART-MU8TP4T5-CJML.summary: Inyandiko igaragaza Francis Bacon nk’umwe mu bantu b’ingenzi mu kwimuka kuva ku bitekerezo bya scholasticism ujya ku kwitegereza no kugerageza. Ishimangira 'Idols' ze enye nk’amasoko y’amakosa y’imitekerereze n’uburyo bwa induction nk’umusingi wa evidence-based management, siyansi ya none na R&D iteguye. Isesengura rihuza umuhate wa Bacon wo kugenzura ibimenyetso n’impungenge z’iki gihe ku makuru asa n’ukuri ariko atari ko atangwa na generative AI.

Ihuza ibyo bibazo n’impaka z’iki gihe ku automation, universal basic income n’uburumbuke.

ART-MU8TP5OP-AQO5.summary: Inyandiko igaragaza Dubai Future Foundation yashinzwe mu 2016 mu mugambi wa Dubai wo kujya imbere y’indi mijyi binyuze mu magerageza na politiki z’ejo hazaza. Igaruka kuri Dubai 10X na Museum of the Future, ivuga ko DFF ikora nk’urubuga rwo kugeragereza systems nshya ku rwego rw’umujyi kurusha think tank isanzwe. ART-MU8TP64K-MRB1.title: Centre for Strategic Futures ya Singapore: Kuyobora igihugu hifashishijwe foresight
ART-MU8TP64K-MRB1.subtitle: CSF ishyira scenario planning no gutekereza igihe kirekire muri leta ya Singapore kugira ngo irwanye kwirara kandi yitegure strategic surprises.
ART-MU8TP64K-MRB1.summary: Inyandiko ikurikirana uko Singapore yakoresheje strategic foresight kuva ku ntege nke zayo nyuma y’ubwigenge, ikagera ku kwakira scenario planning no gushinga Centre for Strategic Futures mu 2009. CSF iri muri system ya leta kandi igaragazwa nk’urwego rw’imbere rutegura scenarios zitoroshye no gushakisha black swans. Isesengura rifata model ya Singapore nk’urugero rwo gushyira futures thinking mu miyoborere y’igihugu aho kuyisigira ibigo by’ubushakashatsi byo hanze.

ART-MU8TP702-ZP8I.summary: Inyandiko ikurikirana Institute for the Future kuva yashinzwe mu 1968 n’abashakashatsi bari bafite inkomoko muri RAND kugeza ku ruhare rwayo mu bushakashatsi bw’ejo hazaza bw’abaturage. Igaruka ku mirimo ya kare kuri ARPANET n’itumanaho rya electronic kandi igasobanura uburyo IFTF yibanda kuri signals, ingaruka ku mibereho n’ibibazo bishingiye ku muntu. Isesengura riyifata nk’ijwi ribaza icyerekezo n’ingaruka z’ikoranabuhanga muri Silicon Valley, aho kwibanda ku muvuduko gusa.

ART-MU8TP7G7-QMAI.title: RAND Corporation: Umurage w’Intambara y’Ubutita mu gutegura igihe cy’ukudashidikanya
ART-MU8TP7G7-QMAI.subtitle: Amateka ya RAND agaragaza uko quantitative analysis, scenario methods na systems thinking byakoreshejwe mu mutekano no mu bibazo rusange bya politiki.
ART-MU8TP7G7-QMAI.summary: Inyandiko isubira ku nkomoko ya RAND Corporation muri Project RAND nyuma y’Intambara ya Kabiri y’Isi no ku kwigenga kwayo mu 1948 nk’umuryango udaharanira inyungu. Igaruka ku bikorwa bifitanye isano na game theory, Delphi method, packet switching na systems analysis, inavuga kunengwa kwayo kubera imikoranire n’ingamba za gisirikare. Isesengura rihuza uwo murage n’ibibazo bishya nka AI risk, disinformation na 'truth decay,' rishimangira gutekereza mu buryo butunganijwe mu gihe cy’ukudashidikanya.

ART-MU8TS4VP-DYBH.title: Inama y’Abaminisitiri yemeje politiki nshya y’iterambere rya Rwanda kugeza mu 2050

ART-MU8TS6KJ-3ZFH.title: Imijyi ya Afurika irenga ku kwemeza politiki ikareba uko yubaka ubuzima bwiza mu mijyi
ART-MU8TS6KJ-3ZFH.subtitle: Abahagarariye imijyi 13 bahuriye i Kigali basangira uko politiki zo kurwanya indwara zitandura n’impanuka zahinduka impinduka abaturage bumva mu buzima bwa buri munsi.
ART-MU8TS6KJ-3ZFH.summary: Abahagarariye imijyi 13 ya Afurika bahuriye mu nama ya Partnership for Healthy Cities i Kigali kugira ngo baganire ku gukumira non-communicable diseases. Kigali yagaragaje car-free days, Lusaka ibikorwa by’imihanda bifasha abanyamaguru n’amagare, naho Kampala ishimangira air-quality monitoring. Ibiganiro byibanda ku buryo systems za buri munsi—transport, public space n’ibidukikije—zishobora guhindura ubuzima kurusha kwemeza politiki ku mpapuro gusa.

Inavuga ku birego ko zimwe mu nkuru zirwanya Rwanda zakozwe na AI no ku kunengwa Abanyarwanda bazisubiza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Ni opinion piece ishyigikira communication ya leta ya Rwanda nk’igikorwa gisanzwe cya leta, bityo ibyo ivuga bigomba gusomwa nk’ibitekerezo by’umwanditsi.

ART-MU8TS7U5-C9A8.subtitle: Uruzinduko rwa Perezida Kagame muri Oman rwatumye ibihugu byombi byongera gahunda zo kwagura ubucuruzi, ishoramari, logistics n’imikoranire ya politiki.
ART-MU8TS7U5-C9A8.summary: Mu ruzinduko rw’iminsi ibiri rwa Perezida Paul Kagame i Muscat, Rwanda na Oman byagaragaje umugambi wo gushimangira umubano uhuza Afurika y’Iburasirazuba n’ibihugu bya Gulf. ART-MU8TS8H3-AV7R.title: Rwanda n’Ubushinwa batangiye umuhanda munini wa Kigali bafite intego yo kuwurangiza mu mezi atarenze 20

ART-MU8TS8H3-AV7R.summary: Leta ya Rwanda n’umufatanyabikorwa w’Umushinwa batangiye kubaka umuhanda wa km 10.3 uhuza Prince House, Giporoso na Masaka. Nubwo contract iteganya amezi 30, Umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe ibikorwa remezo Col. Claudien Bizimungu yasabye contractor n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa gushaka uko barangiza mu gihe kitageze ku mezi 20 kubera akamaro n’ubwihutirwe bw’umuhanda. Umushinga ugamije kunoza kugera mu mujyi no koroshya urujya n’uruza.

ART-MU8TS93Y-BZOI.title: Bamwe muri DR Congo na Burundi bavuga ko Rwanda iri inyuma y’ikorwa rya Kenya ryo gufunga ubucuruzi bw’abanyamahanga, ariko nta bimenyetso byatanzwe
ART-MU8TS93Y-BZOI.subtitle: Abantu bamwe bo muri politiki ya DR Congo na Burundi bahuje ingamba za Kenya ku bacuruzi b’abanyamahanga na Rwanda, nyamara inkuru ivuga ko nta bimenyetso byatanzwe.
ART-MU8TS93Y-BZOI.summary: Mu gihe Kenya yatangije ibikorwa byo kugabanya ubucuruzi buto bukorwa n’abanyamahanga, bamwe mu bayobozi n’abanyapolitiki bo muri DR Congo na Burundi bavuze ko Rwanda ibifitemo uruhare. Nk’uko inkuru ibivuga, nta bimenyetso byatanzwe kuri icyo kirego, kandi leta ya Kenya yavuze ko ari igisubizo ku bibazo by’abacuruzi bato b’Abanyakenya ku misoro n’irushanwa. Perezida William Ruto yatanze amabwiriza nyuma y’inama yo ku wa 2 Nzeri, ibikorwa bigatangira ku wa 7 Nzeri.

ART-MU8TS9QU-XT10.title: Rwanda na Oman birateganya indi dry port yo ku butaka
ART-MU8TS9QU-XT10.subtitle: Mu ruzinduko rwa Perezida Kagame muri Oman, ibihugu byombi byasinyanye amasezerano na MoUs byo kwagura ubucuruzi, logistics n’ishoramari.
ART-MU8TS9QU-XT10.summary: Rwanda na Oman birakomeza gahunda yo guteza imbere indi inland dry port mu rwego rwo gushimangira ubucuruzi na logistics. ART-MU8TSADK-4PFX.subtitle: Mu nama yabereye i Kigali, abayobozi b’amashuri makuru bavuze ko quality assurance igomba guhinduka uko AI n’isoko ry’umurimo bihindura ubumenyi n’akazi.
ART-MU8TSADK-4PFX.summary: Inama ya 15 ya East African Higher Education Quality Assurance Network yabereye i Kigali yaganiriye niba degrees z’uyu munsi zitegura abarangiza amashuri imirimo y’ejo mu gihe AI ihindura uko ubumenyi bukorwa, bwigishwa kandi bukoreshwa. Minisitiri w’Uburezi Joseph Nsengimana yavuze ko akarere kagomba gusubiramo uko gasobanura kandi kagenzura quality mu mashuri makuru. Inama yahuje abayobozi ba kaminuza, abahanga muri quality assurance, policymakers n’abarimu bo mu karere.

ART-MU8TSB0D-MAW4.title: Perezida Kagame ategerejwe muri Oman mu ruzinduko rw’akazi

Eric Rutabana, Commercial Director wa Equity Bank Rwanda, yavuze ko subsidiaries na security agents bifasha gucunga collateral mu jurisdictions zitandukanye. Ubu buryo bugamije koroshya kubona imari ku bigo bishaka kwagura ibikorwa muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba no Hagati.

ART-MU8TSDKP-BAI6.title: Ahacukurwa lithium hashya hagaragaye hafi ya Rubaya igenzurwa na M23, kongera agaciro k’amabuye y’agaciro ya Congo

Amashusho yo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yerekana abacukuzi benshi, trucks n’amabuye avanwa mu rwobo, kandi inkuru ivuga ko imizigo ya mbere yatangiye kujyanwa mu cyerekezo cy’umupaka w’u Rwanda. Rubaya isanzwe ari isoko rikomeye rya tantalum, bityo lithium nshya ikongera strategic mineral stakes muri ako karere.

ART-MU8TSG7T-NSZX.title: Impungenge ko miliyoni $450 z’amafaranga yo kurwanya Ebola muri DR Congo zishobora kunyerezwa
ART-MU8TSG7T-NSZX.subtitle: Mu gihe amafaranga agera kuri miliyoni $700 amaze gukusanywa, Africa CDC ivuga ko miliyoni $452 zamaze gutangwa, ariko haracyari impungenge ku micungire n’ubunyangamugayo.

Jean Kaseya wa Africa CDC yavuze ko miliyoni $452 zamaze guhabwa implementing partners, naho Amerika ikaba yaratangaje izindi miliyoni $242 ku wa 5 Kanama. Inkuru ishimangira ko transparency n’ubugenzuzi ari ingenzi kugira ngo amafaranga agere aho agenewe.

ART-MU8TSLAL-FUSK.subtitle: Forum ya 15 y’urubyiruko ku mahoro yateguwe na Diyosezi Gatolika ya Goma yabaye ku wa 19–21 Nyakanga muri North Kivu.
ART-MU8TSLAL-FUSK.summary: Urubyiruko rusaga 12,000 rwo mu burasirazuba bwa DR Congo no mu Rwanda rwitabiriye Regional Youth Forum for Peace muri North Kivu. Diyosezi ya Goma yayiteguye ku wa 19–21 Nyakanga, ikakira abantu baturutse i Goma, Bukavu, Nyundo, Byumba n’ahandi, ndetse ibikorwa bikagera muri Rutshuru na Masisi. Intego yari uguteza imbere reconciliation, coexistence n’imikoranire y’urubyiruko mu karere kamaze igihe kugarijwe n’intambara.

Umubare wa hafi 40,000 w’ingabo zose uvugwa mu nkuru ushingiye ku makuru yatanzwe na AFC-M23 n’igereranya, bityo si official count yigenga yemejwe.

Abaturage ba Kenya, Uganda na DR Congo na bo bazishyura $50, Abarundi n’Abanyasomalia $100, mu gihe Abatanzania n’Abanyamisiri bakomeza kwinjira nta visa mu bihe byateganyijwe. Icyemezo cyateje ibibazo ku buryo gihura n’amasezerano ya EAC yo koroshya free movement y’abantu.

Icyemezo kije mu gihe umutekano mu burasirazuba bw’igihugu ukomeje kuba mubi kandi pressure ya politiki i Kinshasa yiyongera. Leta yavuze ko roadmap y’uburyo ibiganiro bizakorwa izategurwa, ariko igihe n’abazabigiramo uruhare biracyasaba kuganirwaho.

ART-MU8TSNTM-MHGA.summary: Leta y’Ubwongereza yavuze ku mugaragaro ko izi amakuru y’ibihe bikomeye Abanyamulenge bahura na byo muri Minembwe na High Plateau muri South Kivu. Mu ibaruwa yo ku wa 25 Kamena, Baroness Chapman yavuze ko Ubwongereza buzi reports zihari kandi bukamagana human-rights abuses n’ihohoterwa rigamije abasivile. Ibi byari igisubizo cya leta ku mpungenge zari zatanzwe n’umuturage wo mu Bwongereza.

ART-MU8TSOG6-V96V.title: Abahagarariye Kinshasa bagarutse i Goma bwa mbere mu mezi arenga 18 mu rwego rwo kugenzura ceasefire
ART-MU8TSOG6-V96V.subtitle: Abasirikare batatu ba FARDC bageze mu mujyi ugenzurwa na AFC/M23 kugira ngo bitabire EJVM+ yashyizweho muri Qatar-mediated peace process.
ART-MU8TSOG6-V96V.summary: Abahagarariye leta ya DR Congo bagarutse i Goma mu kazi kemewe bwa mbere kuva AFC/M23 yafata umujyi muri Mutarama 2025. Officers batatu ba FARDC bageze i Goma ku wa 12 Nyakanga kugira ngo bitabire Expanded Joint Verification Mechanism Plus (EJVM+), urwego rwo kugenzura ceasefire rwashyizweho mu nzira y’amahoro ya Qatar. Ibi bigaragaza kugaruka kw’imikoranire ya tekiniki hagati y’impande zirwana mu rwego rwo kugenzura agahenge.

ART-MU8TSP2P-7EP2.summary: Komite ya UN Security Council ishinzwe sanctions za DR Congo yemeje ku wa 14 Nyakanga kandi itangaza ku wa 16 Nyakanga sanctions ku bayobozi babiri bakuru ba FDLR. Icyemezo kigamije kongera pressure mpuzamahanga ku mutwe uvugwaho guhungabanya umutekano mu burasirazuba bwa DR Congo.

ART-MU8TSPP9-PF11.title: Audit yo muri DR Congo yabonye records z’abapolisi 'ghost' hafi 63,000, zishobora gutwara $233m ku mwaka
ART-MU8TSPP9-PF11.subtitle: Preliminary audit yagaragaje records nyinshi z’abakozi ba police batabonetse ku mubiri, bituma hiyongera ibisabwa byo kuvugurura payroll.
ART-MU8TSPP9-PF11.summary: Internal government audit muri DR Congo yabonye records z’abapolisi hafi 63,000 ziteye amakenga, harimo abantu bafite amazina n’ibindi bisobanuro ariko bataboneka ku mubiri. Inkuru ivuga ko ibyo bishobora kuba bitwara leta hagati ya miliyoni $100 na $233 ku mwaka mu mishahara. Ibyavuye mu igenzura biracyari preliminary, ariko byongereye ibisabwa byo gusukura payroll no kunoza personnel management.

ART-MU8TSQC4-J9O4.title: WikiLeaks: Ndayishimiye na CNDD-FDD mu isesengura ry’imiterere y’ubutegetsi bw’Uburundi
ART-MU8TSQC4-J9O4.subtitle: Inyandiko ikoresha cable y’ibanga ya Ambasade ya Amerika yo mu 2007 n’andi makuru mu gutanga isesengura rinenga uburyo ubutegetsi bwa CNDD-FDD bwagiye bushingira ku bantu bake.
ART-MU8TSQC4-J9O4.summary: Inkuru itangirira kuri cable ya Ambasade ya Amerika yo mu 2007 yasohowe na WikiLeaks, yari yaravuze abayobozi bane bakomeye hafi ya Perezida Pierre Nkurunziza, harimo Évariste Ndayishimiye. Ivuga ko nyuma y’imyaka hafi 20 Ndayishimiye ari we usigaye hagati mu butegetsi, kandi ikifashisha cables n’ibitekerezo by’abanenga CNDD-FDD mu kuvuga ku centralization y’ishyaka. Ijambo 'mafia state' ni characterization y’inkuru n’abanenga ubutegetsi, ntabwo ari legal finding yigenga.

ART-MU8TSQYO-65XN.title: Abavoka bo muri Katanga bagejeje ikirego kuri ICC barega Perezida Tshisekedi n’abandi bayobozi ba DR Congo
ART-MU8TSQYO-65XN.subtitle: Abavoka bo mu mashyirahamwe ya civil society bavuga ko hari crimes against humanity n’ihohoterwa rikomeye ryabereye mu duce twinshi twa Katanga.
ART-MU8TSQYO-65XN.summary: Itsinda ry’abavoka bo muri civil society ya Katanga ryagejeje ikirego ku bashinjacyaha ba ICC i The Hague, rirega Perezida Félix Tshisekedi n’abandi bayobozi ba leta crimes against humanity n’ihohoterwa rikomeye. ART-MU8TSSKL-4E29.title: Abayobozi ba AFC/M23 bakoresheje Independence Day ya DR Congo basaba abasirikare n’abapolisi kuva ku ruhande rwa leta
ART-MU8TSSKL-4E29.subtitle: Corneille Nangaa yavugiye i Goma asaba FARDC na police kureka gushyigikira ubutegetsi bwa Tshisekedi.
ART-MU8TSSKL-4E29.summary: Abayobozi ba AFC/M23 bakoresheje isabukuru ya 66 y’ubwigenge bwa DR Congo mu kongera political campaign yabo irwanya leta ya Félix Tshisekedi. Mu ijambo yavugiye i Goma igenzurwa n’uwo mutwe, Corneille Nangaa yasabye abasirikare ba FARDC n’abapolisi kuva ku ruhande rwa leta. ART-MU8TSUL1-CHG5.title: IFAD na Equity Group batangije uburyo bwa miliyoni $200 bwo kugeza climate adaptation finance ku bahinzi ba Afurika y’Iburasirazuba
ART-MU8TSUL1-CHG5.subtitle: ARCAFIM igizwe na miliyoni $180 zo kuguriza n’agera kuri miliyoni $20 y’ubufasha bwa tekiniki kugira ngo ifashe abahinzi bato n’ubucuruzi bwo mu cyaro.
ART-MU8TSUL1-CHG5.summary: IFAD na Equity Group batangije Africa Rural Climate Adaptation Finance Mechanism (ARCAFIM) ya miliyoni $200 muri Africa Food Systems Forum 2026 i Kigali. Ubu buryo bw’imyaka 12 bugizwe na miliyoni $180 za lending capital izunguruka n’agera kuri miliyoni $20 ya technical assistance, bugamije kugeza climate adaptation finance ku bahinzi bato n’ibigo byo mu cyaro muri East Africa. Green Climate Fund, Finland, Nordic Development Fund, Denmark na EU biri mu bafatanyabikorwa b’imari.

ART-MU8TSV7V-118D.title: Isomo Rwanda ishaka kuvana muri Korea: gutuma imyanda na yo ibyara agaciro

ART-MU8TSV7V-118D.summary: Itsinda ry’u Rwanda n’iry’World Bank ryasuye Hyundai Motor complex na Ulsan Eco-Industrial Park muri Korea, rireba industrial symbiosis aho energy, steam n’ibisigazwa by’uruganda rumwe bikoreshwa n’urundi. Uburyo bugabanya imyanda n’ikiguzi kandi bukunganirwa na logistics infrastructure ikomeye. Rwanda iri gusuzuma uko aya masomo yakoreshwa mu industrial parks zayo kugira ngo yongere resource efficiency, productivity n’ubushobozi bwo kohereza ibicuruzwa hanze.

ART-MU8TSVUF-I0JT.title: Icyumweru cyari gihuze muri Deal Room ya Africa Food Systems Forum i Kigali
ART-MU8TSVUF-I0JT.subtitle: Deal Room yahuje projects z’ubuhinzi, investors, financial institutions na governments kugira ngo ambitions za food systems zihinduke financing n’amasezerano afatika.
ART-MU8TSVUF-I0JT.summary: Mu minsi itanu ya Africa Food Systems Forum 2026 i Kigali, Deal Room yahuje imishinga y’ubuhinzi n’abashoramari, amabanki, leta n’abafatanyabikorwa b’iterambere. African Union ifite intego yo gukusanya miliyari $100 z’ishoramari rya public na private muri food systems kugeza 2035 munsi ya CAADP 2026–2035. Inkuru igaragaza Deal Room nk’ahantu hatumye ibiganiro bya politiki bihuzwa na financing, technology, project preparation n’amasezerano.

ART-MU8TSWH7-BVP8.title: Rwanda yakiriye abasaga 3,000 b’impunzi n’abasaba ubuhungiro bavanywe muri Libya kuva 2019
ART-MU8TSWH7-BVP8.subtitle: Emergency Transit Mechanism ikomeje no mu 2026, ikura abantu bari mu byago n’ifungwa muri Libya ikabazana mu Rwanda by’agateganyo.
ART-MU8TSWH7-BVP8.summary: Rwanda imaze kwakira impunzi n’abasaba ubuhungiro basaga 3,000 bavanywe muri Libya kuva 2019. Muri Kamena 2026 hageze abantu 173 baturutse cyane muri Sudan, Eritrea, South Sudan, Ethiopia na Somalia, naho muri Kanama haza abandi 177. Gahunda ibaha umutekano by’agateganyo mu Rwanda mu gihe hashakwa resettlement, voluntary return cyangwa indi durable solution.

ART-MU8TSX3T-XJPU.title: Rwanda yabwiye AU ko ikibazo cy’amahoro muri Afurika ari n’ikibazo cy’amafaranga

ART-MU8TSX3T-XJPU.summary: Mu Nama ya 21 idasanzwe ya AU i Luanda, Minisitiri w’Intebe Justin Nsengiyumva yavuze ko kurangiza amakimbirane muri Afurika bidaterwa na diplomacy cyangwa political will gusa, ahubwo bisaba imari ihamye. Ahagarariye Perezida Kagame, yasabye ibihugu gushyira African resources zateganyijwe inyuma y’ibyemezo by’amahoro n’umutekano. Ibyo byavugiwe mu biganiro ku AU Peace Fund no kugabanya dependence ku nkunga yo hanze.

ART-MU8TSXQF-Z0FN.subtitle: Francis Gatare wa ASG avuga ko institutions n’abahanga byonyine bidakemura governance crisis niba character, values na accountability by’abayobozi bidahindutse.
ART-MU8TSXQF-Z0FN.summary: Perezida wa African School of Governance Francis Gatare yavuze ko Afurika idafite ikibazo cyo kubura universities, leadership programmes cyangwa professionals, ahubwo ko accountability, policy implementation na corruption bigaruka ku bantu bayobora institutions. Yavuze ko gukomeza institutions bigomba kugendana no guhindura character, values n’imitekerereze y’abayobozi. Aya magambo asobanura philosophy ya ASG ku myigishirize y’ubuyobozi.

ART-MU8TSYZS-O7EG.subtitle: Mu kiganiro kirekire n’abanyamakuru, Perezida yavuze ko umwanya wa minister udakwiye kuba ingabo yo kwirinda ibibazo n’ukunengwa n’itangazamakuru.
ART-MU8TSYZS-O7EG.summary: Perezida Paul Kagame yamaze iminota irenga 30 mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru i Kigali avuga ku mpaka hagati y’umunyamakuru Scovia Umutesi na Minisitiri Olivier Nduhungirehe. Intego ni gushyira mu buryo buhoraho imikoranire hagati y’inzego za polisi z’ibihugu byombi.

ART-MU8TT09N-PZ6O.title: Think tank yo mu Buhinde ivuga ko Rwanda ikwiye kwemeza ko ijya muri Lobito Corridor
ART-MU8TT09N-PZ6O.subtitle: Observer Research Foundation yasabye Rwanda gukoresha strategic location, minerals n’inganda zayo kugira ngo ihuze n’umushinga wa Lobito urimo kwaguka.
ART-MU8TT09N-PZ6O.summary: Observer Research Foundation (ORF) yo mu Buhinde yasabye Rwanda gukora ku buryo iba mu gice cya Lobito Corridor iri kwaguka. Ibi ni recommendation ya ORF; ntabwo ari itangazo ko Rwanda yamaze kwemererwa cyangwa kwinjira mu mushinga.

ART-MU8TT0WF-MHFJ.subtitle: Abitabiriye ISCA i Kigali bavuze ko autonomous capability ishingira kuri data, computing, technical talent n’institutions, atari kugura machines gusa.
ART-MU8TT0WF-MHFJ.summary: Muri International Security Conference on Africa i Kigali, delegates bavuze ko kugura drone cyangwa equipment ikomeye bitahita biha igihugu ubushobozi bwo kuyiteza imbere no kuyigenzura. ART-MU8TT25U-YAWV.title: Ubutaliyani buvuga ko buri mu biganiro na Rwanda ku kwakira migrant return hub
ART-MU8TT25U-YAWV.subtitle: Rwanda, Uganda na Ghana biri mu bihugu Ubutaliyani buvuga ko biri mu biganiro bya mbere ku centres zifasha kwihutisha gusubiza irregular migrants.
ART-MU8TT25U-YAWV.summary: Leta y’Ubutaliyani yatangaje ko yatangiye ibiganiro na Rwanda ku gitekerezo cyo gushyiraho migrant return hub mu mugambi mushya w’u Burayi wo kwihutisha gusubiza irregular migrants. Rwanda iri kumwe na Uganda na Ghana mu bihugu bivugwa ko ibiganiro bya preliminary birimo gukorwa ku pilot centres zishobora gucungwa n’ibihugu by’i Burayi. Ibi biracyari negotiations; nta final agreement cyangwa centre yamaze kwemezwa.

ART-MU8TT83P-SFPO.title: Government spending yagabanutse, household consumption ifata 74% bya GDP y’u Rwanda
ART-MU8TT83P-SFPO.subtitle: Mu Q2 2026, real household consumption yazamutse 13% year-on-year mu gihe government final consumption yagabanutse 6%.
ART-MU8TT83P-SFPO.summary: Data ya NISR igaragaza ko household final consumption expenditure yari 74% bya GDP y’u Rwanda mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya 2026. Mu real terms, household consumption yiyongereye 13% ugereranyije n’umwaka wabanje, mu gihe government final consumption yagabanutse 6%. Imibare yerekana ko spending y’ingo yabaye driver ikomeye y’ibikorwa by’ubukungu muri icyo gihe, nubwo itavuga yonyine impamvu zose z’iyo mpinduka.

ART-MU8TT8QG-7VGQ.title: Ibiruhuko no gusura inshuti n’umuryango byinjije u Rwanda amafaranga menshi y’ingendo mpuzamahanga
ART-MU8TT8QG-7VGQ.subtitle: Abashyitsi bo hanze bakoresheje miliyoni $161.8 muri Q2 2026; holidays zinjiza $57.6m, gusura inshuti n’imiryango $45.5m.
ART-MU8TT8QG-7VGQ.summary: Raporo ya NISR Travel Expenditure Survey 2026 Semester 1 ivuga ko abashyitsi bo hanze bakoresheje miliyoni $161.8 mu Rwanda mu gihembwe cya kabiri. Holiday travel yinjije miliyoni $57.6 cyangwa 36.9%, visits to friends and relatives miliyoni $45.5 cyangwa 28.1%, naho business travel miliyoni $40.2. Ibi byerekana ko leisure n’imibanire y’imiryango ari drivers zikomeye z’amafaranga ava mu ngendo mpuzamahanga.

ART-MU8TT9DL-A8HU.summary: National Bank of Rwanda yatangije national campaign yo gushishikariza consumers na businesses gukoresha digital payments aho gukoresha cash. ART-MU8TTD5A-0F3F.title: World Bank: Rwanda yakoresha public spending kubaka local AI industry
ART-MU8TTD5A-0F3F.subtitle: PPI framework ireka leta igaragaza ikibazo aho gutoranya technology, maze companies zigapiganwa ku bisubizo kandi zigakomeza IP rights.
ART-MU8TTD5A-0F3F.summary: World Bank yavuze ko Public Procurement for Innovation (PPI) ya Rwanda ishobora gufasha kubaka local AI ecosystem. Government agencies zigaragaza ikibazo rusange aho gushyiraho technology runaka, hanyuma firms zigapiganwa zitanga solutions mu byiciro kandi zigumana intellectual property. Ubu buryo bushobora gufasha startups kubona first market no kongera local innovation capacity.

ART-MU8TTDRQ-BW3J.title: Ikirombe cya tungsten mu Rwanda cyabaye supplier ukomeye w’amabuye y’agaciro y’ingenzi muri Amerika
ART-MU8TTDRQ-BW3J.subtitle: Trinity Metals ivuga ko Nyakabingo mine ishobora gutanga kugeza kuri 20% bya U.S. primary tungsten concentrate consumption.
ART-MU8TTDRQ-BW3J.summary: Nyakabingo tungsten mine ya Trinity Metals mu Rwanda irimo kubona umwanya ukomeye muri U.S. critical minerals supply chain. Company ivuga ko ari mine ya mbere kandi yonyine muri Afurika itanga tungsten concentrate directly muri Amerika kandi ishobora gutanga kugeza kuri 20% by’ibyo Amerika ikoresha. Chairman Shawn McCormick yagaragaje ubu bushobozi mu nama y’inganda z’ubucukuzi i Washington.

ART-MU8TTFNZ-IS3H.title: Rwanda irenga plastic ban ikategura green packaging plan

ART-MU8TTFNZ-IS3H.summary: Rwanda iri gutegura policy yo guteza imbere biodegradable packaging nk’intambwe ikurikira nyuma yo kugabanya plastics zisanzwe. Intego ni kugabanya plastics, kongera recycling no guteza imbere green economy.

ART-MU8TTY2P-WV9B.summary: Leta y’u Rwanda iri kuzana investor mushya kugira ngo Gisagara peat-fired power plant ikore ku bushobozi bwayo. ART-MU8TUWFA-R6LH.title: U Rwanda rwongereye gukoresha Kenya mu gutumiza ibikomoka kuri peteroli

ART-MU8TZZHH-20M9.body:
Inkomoko ya Magic Hand: Abakiriya bumvise uko Vanessa akora Massage, baravuga ngo afite ikiganza kidasanzwe

Icyo gihe, yagiye kwiga ibijyanye no kubungabunga ubwiza bw'abagore, harimo gusuka, kudefiriza, gukora inzara, ibijyanye n'ubwiza bwo mu maso, massage n'ibindi.

Kubera umwete yari afite, yarangije ishuri ry'imyuga ahita ajya mu nzu itunganya imisatsi, salon de coifure, maze akajya yunganira mu mirimo yo gusuka, koza mu mutwe n'ibindi, ariko aho ntiyahatinze kuko yabonaga intego ye yo kwaguka itazagerwaho.

Agira ati "Nahise mbona akazi, ariko nsanga karimo amafaranga macye cyane. Muri ziriya servise z'imisatsi uhembwa macye cyane kandi urakora cyane."

Aha rero, yahise atekereza ikindi gice cy'ibyo yize, kirimo gukora ubwiza bwo mu maso(facial), kurandura imisatsi cyangw ubwoya udakeneye ku mubiri (waxing) ndetse na massage, "aho ukora akazi utavunitse cyane, kandi igihembo kikaba cyiza kurushaho."

Icyo gihe, hari mu 2018, aho yatangiye akazi gashya, maze umushahara yahembwaga wikuba inshuro icumi.

Agira ati " Nafashe Miliyoni eshatu nazigamye, ngura udukoresho tumwe na tumwe, nza hano muri Tropical Plazza ndatangira. Ubwo narakoze, gahoro gahoro ngenda naguka, mbona icyumba cya kabiri, ndetse ngaba amashami mfungura ikindi cyumba, ndetse ngaba n'amashami mu yandi mahoteri."

Uyu munsi, Mukeshimana afite icyumba atangiriramo serivise za SPA muri Tropical Plazza mu Mujyi aho afite ibyumba bibiri, hakiyongeraho n'icyumba afite muri Select Boutique Hotel ya Kimihurura- Nyarutarama ndetse n'Inganzo Boutique Hotel i Gaculiro.

Mukeshimana atangira iyi business, yari ataramenya neza izina yayiha, ariko Abakiriya bamugannye agitangira, nibo bamuhaye igitekerezo.

Yagize ati "Abakiriya banjye nibo bampaye izina rya Company yanjye. Nabahaga Serivise, bakavuga ngo 'you have a magic hand, nuko izina riva aho, company nyita Magic Hand."

Serivise atanga

Mukeshimana avuga ko Serivise ze zikunze kwitabirwa cyane, akaba amaze kugira abakiriya bahoraho.

Muri massage, aba afite serivise zitandukanye, aho ashobora gukora iyitwa hot stone massage ikoresha ibuye rishyushye, deep tissue massage na sport massage zishobora guhabwa abakinnyi n'abandi bakeneye massage ikomeye, hakaba ndetse na relax massage y'umuntu ushaka gukira amavunane akiruhukira neza ninjoro.

Muri izi massage kandi, bahangana n'ibinure byo mu mubiri, kugira ngo bidahinduka ikibazo. Uretse kunanura imitsi n'ibindi, bafasha kandi abakora siporo kugira umubiri woroshye, aho kugira ngo babe abantu bumagaye cyangwa bakanyaraye kubera imyitozo.

Muri waxing naho, avuga ko hari abantu bagira nk'ubwoya badashaka, haba mu mazuru, mu matwi, mu kwaha, mu gatuza(impwempwe), ku myanya y'ibanga ndetse n'ahandi, bakaba bakeneye kuburandura, akabibafashamo, akoresheje ibikoresho byabugenewe.

Ku byiyongera kuri waxing, hari n'indi serivise ifasha abagore bafite impumuro mbi mu myanya y'ibanga, akabakorera steam ituma ivanamo umwuka mubi.

Ku bijyanye no gutunganya isura - facial works, muri Magic Hand nabwo bakuraho ibintu bibangamira abakiriya, haba amasununu, haba ibiheri ndetse n'ibindi byose bishobora kuba byarangije uruhu.

Mukeshimana avuga ko bidahagije kwisiga amavuta, ahubwo umuntu agomba no kumenya amavuta amubereye, kuko hari igihe umuntu yisiga ibimwangiriza uruhu.

Agira ati "Hari igihe ureba mu maso y'umuntu ukabona yarashaje ariko byaratewe n'amahitamo mabi y'amavuta. Ibyo na byo turabikosora."

Imbogamizi: Hari abagabo bashaka gukoresha abakora massage ishimishamubiri

Akazi Mukeshimana akora ntikabuzemo imbogamizi, ariko ahanini ziterwa n'uburyo sosiyete Nyarwanda ibumva, ndetse n'uburyo ifata abagakora.

Ikibazo bahura nacyo ahanini, ni bamwe mu bakiriya bumva ko ugiye muri massage ashobora no gufata umuha serivise nk'igikoresho cyo gushimisha umubiri we.

Gusa, si Abanyarwanda babagora gusa, n'abanyamahanga barimo abafite imyumvire ko utanga serivise ya massage ashobora no gusaba gukoreshwa imibonano mpuzabitsina.

Mukeshimana yibuka umukiriya wigeze kuza agana Magic Hand, maze amuha umukozi we ngo amukorere massage.

Agira ati "Twamuhaye ibikoresho by'isuku ngo yitegure gukorerwa massage, maze mu gihe umukozi yari agiye kumufasha, asanga yiyambuye, maze aramubwira ati nawe kuramo imyenda. Umukozi yamubwiye ko ibyo bitashoboka, maze arambara asohoka arakaye mubaza ibibaye, aravuga ngo: uyu mukobwa simushaka."

Icyo gihe, ngo yahise asaba Mukeshimana ko yaba ari we umufasha, ariko bageze mu cyumba, na we ashaka kumusaba ko baryamana, aramwangira.

Mukeshimana yagize ati "Yahise arakara cyane aravuga ngo bishoboka bite ko munyangira kandi Kacyiru ho banyemerera?"

Aha rero, Mukeshimana agira ati "imyitwarire nk'iyi ni yo ituvangira mu mwuga, nyamara serivise dutnga ubwayo ni ingirakamaro, ariko iyo umuntu yumva ko yakoresha amafaranga akagukoresha ishimishamubiri kuko muri kumwe muri babiri, ntabwo ari byo. Twebwe iyo serivise ntituyitanga."

Akazi gahemba neza

Mukeshimana avuga ko aka kazi bakora kajyanye na SPA, ari akazi katunga umuntu akagira ubuzima bwiza, aho atanga urugero yerekana ko bishoboka ko umukozi ashobora guhembwa umushahara guhera ku mafaranga ibihumbi 200 Frw, ndetse ngo hari n'abageza muri Miliyoni Frw y'umushahara ku kwezi.

Mukeshimana ntashishikajwe no kuvuga amafaranga yinjiza cyangwa ibyo yagezeho bifatika, ahubwo ikimushimishije ni abakozi batanu akoresha muri Magic Hand ubwayo, abo yagiye atoza, ubu na bo bakaba barabonye akazi, cyangwa se nabo barihangiye imirimo.

Icyakora, inzozi ze ni ugukomeza kwigisha benshi, ari na yo mpamvu ubu yatangije ishuri rifasha ababifashaka kwiga umwuga ubajyana ku isoko ry'umurimo vuba, bagasezera ku bukene.

Wanditse

Jean de la Croix Tabaro

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U001F-FD6L.body:
Indege ishobora kwitwara? Cyane rwose

Uyu munsi indege nyinshi nini zitwara abagenzi zifite Sisitemu yikoresha yo kugenzura no kuyobora indege izwi nka ‘Automatic Flight Control System (AFCS)’, irimo sisitemu yikoresha iyobora indege (autopilot) n’izindi sisitemu zifasha abapilote kugenzura indege. Ni sisitemu zishobora gufasha indege gukomeza icyerekezo, ubutumburuke (altitude), umuvuduko ndetse no gukurikira inzira yagenwe.

Iyo indege imaze guhaguruka, nyuma y’igihe runaka bitewe n’ubwoko bwayo n’amabwiriza ayigenga, abapilote bashobora kuyishyira mu buryo bwo kwitwara, ari byo bita autopilot.

Aha rero, sisitemu ishobora gukomeza gukoresha indege mu nzira yateganyijwe, mu gihe abapilote bakomeza gukurikirana uko yitwara.

Indege nka Airbus A350 cyangwa Boeing 787, ishobora kuba iri ku butumburuke bwo hejuru mu rugendo rurerure, bungana na metero 10,700 hejuru y’inyanja.

Icyo gihe umupilote (Pilot), ashobora kuba yarashyize muri Sisitemu y’imicungire y’urugendo rw’indege (Flight Management System/FMS) inzira igomba gukurikira, ubutumburuke, umuvuduko n’ibindi bipimo, autopilot igafasha gukomeza urugendo rw’indenge (flight path) mu buryo bwikora.

Impuguke mu Micungire y’Indege n’Ibibuga byazo (Expert in Airline and Airport Management), Emmy Arsonval Maniriho, avuga ko ubwo buryo nubwo buhari ariko budakuraho umupilote.

Ati “Icy’ingenzi ni uko autopilot idakuraho umupilote. Abapilote baba bakiri mu cyumba kiyoborerwamo indege (Cockpit), bakurikirana ibikoresho by’indege, ikirere, itumanaho, abagenzuzi b’ingendo z’indege, urujya n’uruza rw’indege ndetse n’imikorere yayo. Iyo bibaye ngombwa, bashobora guhita bakuraho autopilot bagakomeza kuyobora indege mu buryo bwo gukoresha amaboko (manual).”

Si mu kirere gusa indege ishobora kwitwara kuko hari n’ubundi bushobora kuyifasha ku butaka.

Maniriho ati “Hari n’ubundi buryo bukomeye buzwi nka sisitemu yikoresha imanura indege (Autoland). Aha ho, indege ishobora gukoresha imikorere yikoresha (Automation) mu gice cya nyuma cy’urugendo, cyane cyane mu gihe cyo kwegera ikibuga no kumanuka (landing).”

Yungamo ati “Autoland, ishobora gukoresha amakuru atangwa na sisitemu zifasha kumenya no gukurikira inzira y’indege (Navigation systems), cyane cyane, sisitemu yifashishwa mu kuyobora indege igihe imanuka (Instrument Landing System/ILS), kugira ngo indege ikurikire inzira ijya ku muhanda w’indege (runway) mu buryo bwikora.”

Autoland ishobora kuba ingenzi cyane mu bihe ubushobozi bwo kureba kure ari buke (visibility). Ariko ntabwo bivuze ko igihe cyose hari igihu cyangwa ubushobozi bwo kureba kure ari buke, indege ihita ikoresha autoland.

Gukoresha ubu buryo bisaba ko indege ubwayo ibifitiye ubushobozi kandi umuhanda w’indege (runway) n’ibikoresho byayo bikaba byujuje ibisabwa, uburyo bukurikizwa kugira ngo indege yegere kandi imanuke ku kibuga (Approach procedure) bukaba bubereye, ikirere bukaba buri mu mbibi (limits) zemewe, ndetse n’abapilote bakaba bafite impamyabushobozi n’amahugurwa akenewe.

Maniriho ati “Ni yo mpamvu bidakwiye kuvugwa ko indege ishobora kwitwara ubwayo ahantu hose. Automation ikorera mu mbibi zisobanutse kandi zemejwe n’abayikora ndetse n’inzego zishinzwe umutekano w’indege.”

Hari kandi ikoranabuhanga ridasanzwe mu ndege rifite sisitemu yikoresha y’ubutabazi imanura indege (Emergency Autoland), ishobora gufasha kuyimanura mu gihe abapilote batagishoboye kuyiyobora. Iri ritandukanye na autopilot isanzwe, kuko ryagenewe ibihe bidasanzwe cyane, nk’igihe abapilote batagishoboye gukomeza kuyobora indege.

Mu ndege zimwe zifite ubu bushobozi (Emergency Autoland) bushobora gutangizwa mu buryo bwabugenewe, hanyuma sisitemu igafasha indege kuguma itekanye, ikamenya aho iri, igahitamo ikibuga cy’indege (airport) kibereye kumanuka kw’indege mu gihe cy’ubutabazi (Emergency landing), ikegera kandi ikagerageza kumanuka mu buryo bwikora.

Icyakora, ubu bushobozi ntabwo busanzwe ku ndege zose zitwara abagenzi. Hari indege nto n’iz'ubucuruzi zimwe zibufite, ariko kuba indege ifite autopilot ntabwo bihita bivuga ko ifite ubwo bushobozi.

Ku ndege nini zitwara abagenzi nka Airbus A320 family, A330, A350 cyangwa Boeing 737, 777 na 787, automation ikoreshwa cyane mu byiciro bitandukanye by’urugendo. Ariko ubushobozi nyabwo bw’iyi sisitemu buratandukana bitewe n’ubwoko bw’indege, ikoranabuhanga rya elegituronike (Avionics) ryashyizwemo, icyemezo cyemewe cy’ubuziranenge, ibikorwa remezo by’ikibuga cy’indege hamwe n’amabwiriza y’umukoresha.

Nta gihe runaka cyagenwe indege ishobora kumara yitwara (automatic mode), kuko autopilot ishobora gukoreshwa mu gihe gito cyangwa ikamara igice kinini cy’urugendo, cyane cyane ku ngendo ndende. Ku rundi ruhande, autoland yo ikoreshwa cyane mu gice cya nyuma cy’urugendo, kuva indege yegera ikibuga kugeza igeze ku butaka, iyo ibisabwa byose byujujwe.

Maniriho ati “Indege z’iki gihe ntabwo ari robo (robot) zitagira umuntu uzigenzura, ahubwo ni imashini zifite imikorere yikoresha (Automation) ikomeye, ifasha abapilote gukora akazi kabo neza kandi mu mutekano. Umupilote aracyafata ibyemezo by’ingenzi, akagenzura sisitemu kandi akaba yiteguye kugenzura indege igihe cyose bikenewe.”

Aha ngo ikoranabuhanga ryo kugenzura indege mu buryo bwikora rikwiye kumvikana nk’igikoresho gifasha umupilote, aho kuba ikoranabuhanga rimusimbura. Kandi iyo bigeze kuri Emergency Autoland, ho ari uburyo bwihariye bugenewe cyane cyane gufasha mu gihe cyihutirwa, aho sisitemu ishobora gufasha indege kugera ku kibuga no kugerageza kugwa mu gihe umupilote atagishoboye gukora inshingano ze.

Kuvuga ko indege z’ubu zikoresha cyane automation, ntabwo bivuze ko indege za mbere zitigeze zigira uburyo bwo kwifashisha ikoranabuhanga, kuko bitandukaniye gusa ku kuba indege za mbere zari zishingiye cyane ku bushobozi bw’umupilote mu gihe indege z’ubu zifite sisitemu nyinshi zifasha cyangwa zikagenzura igice cy’imirimo yari isanzwe ikorwa n’umuntu.

Indege zakoreshwaga mbere zari zifite uburyo bw’ibanze bwo kuyobora indege. Umpilote yagombaga kugenzura kugira ngo ayobore indege mu cyerekezo runaka, ayizamure cyangwa ayimanure, ndetse agenzure umuvuduko n’uko indege ihagaze mu kirere. Uburyo bufasha kumenya no gukurikiza inzira bwayo bwari bworoshye ugereranyije n’iy’ubu, kandi abapilote bishyingikirizaga cyane ku kureba ibimenyetso biri hanze, amakarita, hamwe n’ibindi bikoresho by’ibanze.

Autopilot ya mbere y’indege, yaje gukorwa cyane cyane mu ntangiriro z’ikinyejana cya 20. Mu 1912, Lawrence Sperry yerekanye gyroscopic autopilot yafashaga indege gukomeza ubutumburuke bwayo. Ibi byari intambwe ikomeye kuko byatangiye gufasha umupilote kutagomba gukomeza kwishyingikiriza buri kantu gatoya mu kugenzura indege igihe cyose.

Ikoranabuhanga ryarushijeho gutera imbere, haza uburyo bwo kuyobora indege hakoreshejwe amaradiyo, ibikoresho byayo hamwe n’abayobora indege. Autopilot ziteye imbere, zirimo Flight Management Systems n’izindi sisiteme z’ikoranabuhanga rigezweho. Ni yo mpamvu uyu munsi indege ishobora gukora ibintu byinshi mu buryo bwikora kurusha indege zo hambere.

Nubwo ubu buryo bwizewe cyane ariko ngo ntabwo ari 100%.

Maniriho avuga ko indege z’ubucuruzi zigezweho zikora mu buryo sisitemu zazo ziba zifite uburyo bwinshi bwo kugenzura no kwirinda ko ikibazo kimwe gihita gitera impanuka. Hari sisitemu ziba zifite izisimbura izindi igihe zibayeho ikibazo (redundancy), bivuze ko iyo igice kimwe kigize sisitemu kigize ikibazo, haba hari ikindi gishobora gukomeza gukora cyangwa gufasha.

Ati “Ku ndege nini, hari sisitemu nyinshi zishobora gukoresha ibikoresho bitahura bikanamenya (sensors) byinshi n'amasoko atandukanye y'amakuru. Iyo sisitemu imwe itanze amakuru adahuye n'andi, indege ishobora kubimenyesha ubapilote, kandi bagafata icyemezo gikwiye. Ni na yo mpamvu umutekano w’indege udashingiye kuri autopilot yonyine.”

Uyu mutekano w’indege ngo ushingiye ku guhuriza hamwe ikoranabuhanga, imiterere n’imyubakire y’indege, kubungabunga indege, amahugurwa y’abapilote, amabwiriza n’uburyo bw’imikorere, igenzura ry’ingendo z’indege n’ibikorwa remezo by’ibibuga by’indege hamwe n’amabwiriza y’umutekano.

Automation ishobora guteza impanuka igihe sisitemu itanze amakuru atari yo, cyangwa umupilote akayishingikirizaho birenze urugero ntabashe kugenzurira ku gihe. Ikibazo gishobora kurushaho gukomera iyo abapilote batatojwe neza gukoresha cyangwa gukemura ibibazo bya sisitemu yikoresha.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

Wenda ijwi ryahindutseho gato, ariko urugwiro ni rwa rundi...abafana ba Celine Dion

Umuhanzi Celine Dion wari umaze igihe atagaragara mu ruhame ndetse adakora n’ibitaramo byo kuririmba kubera uburwayi, muri iki cyumweru yongeye kuririmbira abafana be bari bamutegereje cyane.

Uwo muhanzi w’Umunya-Canada, ariko wamamaye ku rwego rw’isi, yaririmbiye imbere y’abatumirwa b’icyubahiro ndetse n’abafana be 35.000, muri Sitade ya Plenitude Arena i Nanterre (Hauts-de-Seine) i Paris mu Bufaransa.

Icyo ni igitaramo cya kabiri, nyuma y’icyabaye tariki 12 Nzeri 2026, byombi bikaba biri mu bitaramo 16 biteganyijwe ko azakora kugeza ku itariki 17 Ukwakira uyu Mwaka, bibera aho muri Sitade ya Plenitude Arena i Nanterre (ahahoze hitwa Paris La Defense Arena).

Celine Dion, ubu ufite imyaka 58, yamaze amasaha arenga abiri ataramiye abafana be, aho yaririmbye indirimbo 25, zirimo izizwi cyane za cyera, nka “On ne change pas “, “ Pour que tu m’aimes encore “ , Because you Loved Me” ndetse na “My Heart Will Go On”.

Kugaruka kwa Celine kwazamuye cyane amarangamutima y’abakunzi be, bari bamaze imyaka itandatu batamubona aririmba. Yari amaze icyo gihe cyose ahanganye n’indwara yitwa ‘syndrome de la personne raide’ iyo ikaba ari indwara idakunze kubaho cyane (maladie rare), ifata imyakura yari yaratumye ahagarika umwuga we muri iyo myaka yose.

Igitaramo Celine yakoreye imbere y’abafana be basaga 35000, ni intangiriro y’uruhererekane rw’ibindi bitaramo biteganyijwe ko bizarangira mu mwaka utaha.

Kuko uretse ibyo bitaramo 16 byatangiye kuri 12 Nzeri bikazarangira tariki 17 Ukwakira 2026, hari n’ibindi bitaramo 10 bizatangira tariki 8 bikagera 29 Gicurasi 2027, bivuze ko muri rusange umuhanzi Ceine Dion ataganya gukora ibitaramo 26 mu gihe cy’amezi umunani (8) gusa.

Ari imbere y’abakunzi be, agaragaza imbaraga, ibyishimo ndetse no guhagarara akomeye nubwo yari yararwaye indwara ituma umubiri we ucika intege, yagize ati, “Meze neza”.

Bamwe mu bakunzi be, babinyujije ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nka Facebook bagize ubutumwa batanga. Hari uwanditse agira ati, “ Yaririmbye indirimbo ze zizwi cyane, ariko ukuntu yaziririmbye mu buryo bwihariye... wawuuu, mbega umuhanzi! Yatumye abantu bose bemera ubuhanga bwe kandi akwiye gushimirwa no gutangarirwa. Turamwishimiye cyane nyuma y’urugamba ntekereza ko rwari rukomeye cyane! Mbega ibintu byiza!” Undi yanditse agira ati, “ Kongera gusubira ku rubyiniro nyuma y’imyaka itandatu, nubwo yarwaye kandi akaba yaranyuze mu bigeragezo byinshi, bisaba ubutwari bukomeye cyane. Birashoboka ko ijwi rye ryahindutseho gato, kandi ibyo birumvikana, ariko impano ye, imbaraga ze, cyane cyane urukundo akunda abafana be, biracyahari cyane”.

Undi nawe yanditse agira ati,” Céline ni umugore ukorana umwete udasanzwe, urwana buri munsi kandi utigera acika intege. Bisaba imbaraga zidasanzwe kongera kuzamuka ku rubyiniro muri ibi bihe kandi agakomeza guha abafana be ibyishimo byinshi nk’uko yabikoze. Hejuru y’uko ari umuririmbyi w’igitangaza, njye mbona ari n’umugore wuje ubumuntu cyane, wegera abafana be kandi ushimira abantu bamukunze muri iyi myaka yose amaze ari umuhanzi. Imana ikomeze imuhe imbaraga nyinshi kandi imube hafi muri uru rugamba arimo. Akwiye kubahwa, gukundwa no gutangarirwa. Mbega ibyishimo byo kongera kumubona ku rubyiniro”!

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

Umuhanzi Celine Dion wari umaze igihe atagaragara mu ruhame ndetse adakora n’ibitaramo byo kuririmba kubera uburwayi, muri iki cyumweru yongeye kuririmbira abafana be bari bamutegereje cyane.

Uwo muhanzi w’Umunya-Canada, ariko wamamaye ku rwego rw’isi, yaririmbiye imbere y’abatumirwa b’icyubahiro ndetse n’abafana be 35.000, muri Sitade ya Plenitude Arena i Nanterre (Hauts-de-Seine) i Paris mu Bufaransa.

Icyo ni igitaramo cya kabiri, nyuma y’icyabaye tariki 12 Nzeri 2026, byombi bikaba biri mu bitaramo 16 biteganyijwe ko azakora kugeza ku itariki 17 Ukwakira uyu Mwaka, bibera aho muri Sitade ya Plenitude Arena i Nanterre (ahahoze hitwa Paris La Defense Arena).

Celine Dion, ubu ufite imyaka 58, yamaze amasaha arenga abiri ataramiye abafana be, aho yaririmbye indirimbo 25, zirimo izizwi cyane za cyera, nka “On ne change pas “, “ Pour que tu m’aimes encore “ , Because you Loved Me” ndetse na “My Heart Will Go On”.

Kugaruka kwa Celine kwazamuye cyane amarangamutima y’abakunzi be, bari bamaze imyaka itandatu batamubona aririmba. Yari amaze icyo gihe cyose ahanganye n’indwara yitwa ‘syndrome de la personne raide’ iyo ikaba ari indwara idakunze kubaho cyane (maladie rare), ifata imyakura yari yaratumye ahagarika umwuga we muri iyo myaka yose.
Igitaramo Celine yakoreye imbere y’abafana be basaga 35000, ni intangiriro y’uruhererekane rw’ibindi bitaramo biteganyijwe ko bizarangira mu mwaka utaha.

Kuko uretse ibyo bitaramo 16 byatangiye kuri 12 Nzeri bikazarangira tariki 17 Ukwakira 2026, hari n’ibindi bitaramo 10 bizatangira tariki 8 bikagera 29 Gicurasi 2027, bivuze ko muri rusange umuhanzi Ceine Dion ataganya gukora ibitaramo 26 mu gihe cy’amezi umunani (8) gusa.
Ari imbere y’abakunzi be, agaragaza imbaraga, ibyishimo ndetse no guhagarara akomeye nubwo yari yararwaye indwara ituma umubiri we ucika intege, yagize ati, “Meze neza”.

Bamwe mu bakunzi be, babinyujije ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nka Facebook bagize ubutumwa batanga. Hari uwanditse agira ati, “ Yaririmbye indirimbo ze zizwi cyane, ariko ukuntu yaziririmbye mu buryo bwihariye... wawuuu, mbega umuhanzi! Yatumye abantu bose bemera ubuhanga bwe kandi akwiye gushimirwa no gutangarirwa. Turamwishimiye cyane nyuma y’urugamba ntekereza ko rwari rukomeye cyane! Mbega ibintu byiza!” Undi yanditse agira ati, “ Kongera gusubira ku rubyiniro nyuma y’imyaka itandatu, nubwo yarwaye kandi akaba yaranyuze mu bigeragezo byinshi, bisaba ubutwari bukomeye cyane. Birashoboka ko ijwi rye ryahindutseho gato, kandi ibyo birumvikana, ariko impano ye, imbaraga ze, cyane cyane urukundo akunda abafana be, biracyahari cyane”.

Undi nawe yanditse agira ati,” Céline ni umugore ukorana umwete udasanzwe, urwana buri munsi kandi utigera acika intege. Bisaba imbaraga zidasanzwe kongera kuzamuka ku rubyiniro muri ibi bihe kandi agakomeza guha abafana be ibyishimo byinshi nk’uko yabikoze. Hejuru y’uko ari umuririmbyi w’igitangaza, njye mbona ari n’umugore wuje ubumuntu cyane, wegera abafana be kandi ushimira abantu bamukunze muri iyi myaka yose amaze ari umuhanzi. Imana ikomeze imuhe imbaraga nyinshi kandi imube hafi muri uru rugamba arimo. Akwiye kubahwa, gukundwa no gutangarirwa. Mbega ibyishimo byo kongera kumubona ku rubyiniro”!
Wanditse
Mediatrice Uwingabire
Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U015C-H10T.body:
Burya Inkotanyi ni ibimanuka, zoherejwe n'Imana - Ambasaderi Murashi Isaie

Ambasaderi Murashi avuga ko kubohora u Rwanda byari bikenewe, kuko Abakoloni bari baraboshye u Rwanda, bakarubohesha imbaraga z’urugomo, bakora ibyiswe itotezabatutsi, iyirukanabatutsi, n’itsembabatutsi. Gusa ngo itsembabatutsi ni cyo cyabaye indunduro y’ibyo byose. Icyabiteye nk’uko Amb. Murashi abivuga, ni uko bari bararuboshye bizeye ko bazarugumana burundu.

Yagize ati,“Nk’uko nakubwiye, mu bintu byose Imana izamo. Hashize imyaka 30 yose, iyirukanabatutsi ryarakozwe, kandi risa naho ryarangiye ku bari bafite ubutegetsi. Kayibanda na Habyarimana, bari bazi ko Abatutsi batakigira agaciro mu Rwanda, ndetse no mu Karere, kandi ko nibinyagambura gatoya bashaka kwirwanaho nk’uko Inyenzi zajyaga zitera, bazabamara. Jenoside tujya tuvuga, burya yari yanditse…rero byari ngombwa ko u Rwanda rubohorwa”.

Amb. Murashi avuga ko nubwo umuryango we wahunze mu gihe yari akiri muto, ariko mu bihugu byose babayemo, babaga babizi ko bazagaruka mu Rwanda kuko byari ihame. Bari babizi ko abarurimo bayoborwa n’abazungu bazatsindwa.

Yagize ati, “ Kubohora u Rwanda, byabaye mu gihe gito, imyaka ine burya ntabwo ari igihe kirekire cyane urebye. Ni intambara yari ngombwa kandi yaje irakubita, kuko Imana yari ibirimo. Hari ibintu bita mu Kilatini ngo’Deus ex machina’, ni ukuvuga Imana igoboka abantu mu gihe bibaye ngombwa. Uragorwa ukongera ukagorwa, wagira utya, ukabona ibintu birashize. Iyo ntambara rero yarabaye, Inkotanyi, zitwa Inkotanyi z’amarere, ntabwo ari izo ku isi. Burya Inkotanyi ni ibimanuka. Abantu bazati n’ibimanuka icyo bishatse kuvuga, ni abantu bohorejwe n’Imana, bo gukora umurio wayo mu gihe cya ngombwa. Inkotanyi ubundi ni Ibimanuka bya gatatu byaje bije kugarura umurage w’Imana mu Rwanda. Burya ni yo gahunda y’Inkotanyi…”.

Amb.Murashi yavuze ko abategetse u Rwanda barimo Kayibanda na Habyarimana, bari bafite umugambi wo kurimbura Abatutsi mu gihe bazaramuka bashatse kugaruka mu Rwanda barwana.

Yagize ati, “ Kayibanda yigeze kubivuga mu 1964, abwira Abatutsi, avuga ati Nyenzi muhora mutera, nimwibeshya ngo murafata Kigali, muzasanga benewanyu barashize. Urumva wari umugambi. Buriya rero Jenoside nta gitangaje kuba yarabaye,hari n’abantu benshi mbona batabyumva, bakavuga ngo Inkotanyi nizo zateye Jenoside. Biriya ni ubuswa, ni ukudatekereza, ni ukugira gusa ibyo bita amarangamutima no kwikunda.Jenoside yarabaye kuko yari gahunda. Yagobaga kuba kuko yari gahunda. Abo yagwiririye, nanjye yarangwiririye, kuko napfushije abana n’umugore, ariko mbona ko ari gahunda yabayeho kuko yari yateganijwe. Ibyago nagize, ntabwo mbishyira ku muntu uwo ari we wese, n’ababikora, baribeshya…”.

“ Noneho rero intambara Inkotanyi zirayitsinda kandi byari ngombwa, ni ko byagenze, hanyuma ba bandi bose barahunga. Babeshya n’abaturage barabajyana,kuko bari barabashyize iby’amoko mu mutwe. Kuko burya mu Rwanda ntabwo habaho amoko, habaho ubwoko n’imiryango.Ariko iby’amoko bya Hutu, Tutsi ntabyigeze bibaho mu Rwanda, uretse ibyo Ababiligi bashyizeho, bakabyandika mu ‘mabuku’, hanyuma Kayibanda akabishyira mu bikorwa, akabyandika mu bitabo by’indangamuntu. Kuko Amabuku ntabwo ari indangamuntu, indangamuntu ni iza Kayibanda”.

Ambasaderi Murashi, avuga ku bahunze nyuma yo gutsindwa urugamba, ubu bakaba bibumbiye mu mutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR hamwe n’abandi bakorana nayo bahorana umugambi wo gutsemba Abatutsi mu Rwanda no mu Karere, yavuze ko ibyo FDLR ikora muri iki gihe ari uguhanyanyaza, ariko bikazarangira itsinzwe n’abakorana nayo bose.

Yagize ati,” Na Kayibanda yari afite ingengabitekerezo itari iye, ari iy’abanyamahanga hanyuma aza gutsindwa. Na bariya bari bafite Leta, hanyuma barayita baragenda. Ubu rero, barahanyanyaza, ibyo bita mu Gifaransa ‘Combat d'arrière-garde’ ni igihe abantu batsinzwe, noneho abari inyuma, bagasigara bakingira abahunga, kugira ngo bashobore kugenda. Rero bariya niyo ntambara barimo barwana ubu. Barashutswe, ujya ubona n’abatahuka, bakaza bakongera bakaba Abanyarwanda, bakaza bakongera bakabana n’abandi. Ariko abashutswe baracyahari... Kubera ingengabiterezo yabo mbi, ntibashobora gutsinda. Ibyo ubyumve n’abandi banyumva babyumve, babyemere ni ko bimeze bariya ntibashobora gutsinda”.

Ku bafite umurongo mubi, wo kutumva neza amateka y’u Rwanda uko ari, ndetse bashyigikiye FDLR, bakirirwa batukana ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, Amb. Murashi yavuze ko babiterwa no kutamenya, kuko ntacyo baba bafite cyo kuvuga uretse gutukana.

Yagize ati,” Turababona ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, abatukana, bariya bose babiterwa no kutamenya. Ubundi burya amateka ni ibyabaye, ariko hakabaho n’ubumenyi bw’ibyabaye hambere. Ni yo bita amateka. Rero bariya, abenshi ubona ni abadafite ubumenyi buhagije ku mateka.

Bakaba barakuriye mu bintu, bituma badasobanukirwa. Abo rero nibo bagihuzagurika, nibo bari muri za ntambara nakubwiye za nyuma,zirimo zishira. Abo nk’umunyamateka, kandi nk’umuntu, inama nabagira, ni ukuva i buzimu bakajya ibuntu, ni ukuvuga ko batakaye bakajya ahantu hazabica. Niba bashaka kubaho neza nk’abandi bantu,bakwiye kuva muri biriya.

Uzareba niba hari abazabona iki kiganiro cyacu, harimo abazadutuka. Kudutuka, ibyo ni ibisanzwe kuri bo, kuko babura icyo bavuga, kubera ko nta bumenyi buhagije bafite bwo gusobanukirwa ibyabaye, n’ibyo barimo,n’ibizababaho. Bagomba kumenya ko ukuri ari ukuri igihe cyose, kandi ko ikinyoma kigaruka nyiracyo”.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U01PA-J5FC.body:
Urubyiruko ntirusaba gusimbura abakuze, rurasaba kumvwa - Louise Mushikiwabo

Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Umuryango Mpuzamahanga w’Ibihugu bikoresha Igifaransa (OIF), Louise Mushikiwabo, yavuze ko urubyiruko rw’Afurika rudashaka gusimbura abakuze mu nzego zifata ibyemezo, ahubwo ko rushaka ko ibitekerezo n’ibyifuzo byarwo byitabwaho ndetse rukagira uruhare mu igenamigambi ry’ejo hazaza.

Mushikiwabo yabigarutseho mu kiganiro cyasohowe n’umuyoboro wa ZOA kuri YouTube, kuri uyu Kane, aho yagarukaga ku ruhare rw’urubyiruko mu kubaka Afurika y’ubu n’iy’ejo.

Yavuze ko bidakwiye ko abakuru bakomeza kuvuga mu izina ry’urubyiruko kandi na rwo rushoboye kwivugira no kugaragaza ibyo rwifuza.

Ati “Ntabwo byanze bikunze urubyiruko rushaka gusimbura abakuru, ahubwo rurashaka ko barwumva, bakamenya ibyo rwifuza.”

Mushikiwabo yavuze ko bidashoboka ko buri kintu cyose urubyiruko rusaba gihita gishyirwa mu bikorwa, ariko ko icy’ingenzi ari ukumenya ko rushaka kugira uruhare mu iterambere.

Yagize ati “Byaba ari ukubeshya kuvuga ko ibyo urubyiruko ruvuga byose tuzabikora. Ntibishoboka. Ariko ni ngombwa kumenya ko rushaka kugira uruhare.”

Mushikiwabo yavuze ko kuva mu 2020, OIF yatangiye kugisha inama urubyiruko hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, kugira ngo imenye uko rureba ahazaza h’uyu muryango.

Yavuze ko muri izo nama, iby’ingenzi urubyiruko rwagaragaje birimo kubona akazi, uburezi bufite ireme no kubungabunga ibidukikije.

Ati “Icy’ingenzi kurusha ibindi ni akazi. Urubyiruko rushaka kugira icyo rukora no kwibeshaho. Icya kabiri ni uburezi, cyane cyane uburezi bufite ireme. Icya gatatu ni kubungabunga ibidukikije.”

Mushikiwabo kandi yashimye uruhare rw’urubyiruko mu guhanga udushya, avuga ko Afurika ifite urubyiruko rufite ibitekerezo byinshi bishobora kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’umugabane.

Yagaragaje ko mu bihugu byinshi bya Afurika hari politiki, icyerekezo n’imigambi y’iterambere, ariko ko hakenewe kurushaho gufata uburemere ibitekerezo n’ibisubizo bitangwa n’urubyiruko mu buzima bwa buri munsi.

Ku bwe, urubyiruko ntirukwiye gufatwa nk’abantu bategereje gusa kuzahabwa inshingano mu gihe kizaza, ahubwo rukwiye kugira uruhare mu byemezo bireba uyu munsi n’ejo hazaza h’umugabane.

Wanditse

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

content_blocks.text: Urubyiruko ntirusaba gusimbura abakuze, rurasaba kumvwa - Louise Mushikiwabo

Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Umuryango Mpuzamahanga w’Ibihugu bikoresha Igifaransa (OIF), Louise Mushikiwabo, yavuze ko urubyiruko rw’Afurika rudashaka gusimbura abakuze mu nzego zifata ibyemezo, ahubwo ko rushaka ko ibitekerezo n’ibyifuzo byarwo byitabwaho ndetse rukagira uruhare mu igenamigambi ry’ejo hazaza.
Mushikiwabo yabigarutseho mu kiganiro cyasohowe n’umuyoboro wa ZOA kuri YouTube, kuri uyu Kane, aho yagarukaga ku ruhare rw’urubyiruko mu kubaka Afurika y’ubu n’iy’ejo.
Yavuze ko bidakwiye ko abakuru bakomeza kuvuga mu izina ry’urubyiruko kandi na rwo rushoboye kwivugira no kugaragaza ibyo rwifuza.
Ati “Ntabwo byanze bikunze urubyiruko rushaka gusimbura abakuru, ahubwo rurashaka ko barwumva, bakamenya ibyo rwifuza.”
Mushikiwabo yavuze ko bidashoboka ko buri kintu cyose urubyiruko rusaba gihita gishyirwa mu bikorwa, ariko ko icy’ingenzi ari ukumenya ko rushaka kugira uruhare mu iterambere.
Yagize ati “Byaba ari ukubeshya kuvuga ko ibyo urubyiruko ruvuga byose tuzabikora. Ntibishoboka. Ariko ni ngombwa kumenya ko rushaka kugira uruhare.”
Mushikiwabo yavuze ko kuva mu 2020, OIF yatangiye kugisha inama urubyiruko hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, kugira ngo imenye uko rureba ahazaza h’uyu muryango.
Yavuze ko muri izo nama, iby’ingenzi urubyiruko rwagaragaje birimo kubona akazi, uburezi bufite ireme no kubungabunga ibidukikije.
Ati “Icy’ingenzi kurusha ibindi ni akazi. Urubyiruko rushaka kugira icyo rukora no kwibeshaho. Icya kabiri ni uburezi, cyane cyane uburezi bufite ireme. Icya gatatu ni kubungabunga ibidukikije.”
Mushikiwabo kandi yashimye uruhare rw’urubyiruko mu guhanga udushya, avuga ko Afurika ifite urubyiruko rufite ibitekerezo byinshi bishobora kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’umugabane.

Yagaragaje ko mu bihugu byinshi bya Afurika hari politiki, icyerekezo n’imigambi y’iterambere, ariko ko hakenewe kurushaho gufata uburemere ibitekerezo n’ibisubizo bitangwa n’urubyiruko mu buzima bwa buri munsi.
Ku bwe, urubyiruko ntirukwiye gufatwa nk’abantu bategereje gusa kuzahabwa inshingano mu gihe kizaza, ahubwo rukwiye kugira uruhare mu byemezo bireba uyu munsi n’ejo hazaza h’umugabane.
Wanditse
Oswald Niyonzima
Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

ART-MU8U0293-SQHQ.body:
Imihindagurikire y'ikirere mu byongera ubusambanyi

Ni ibigarukwaho na bamwe mu bahinzi baturuka hirya no hino harimo n’umugabo ugaragaza ko iyo ikirere gihindutse biteza kutumvikana mu miryango.

Umuturage wo mu karere ka Nyaruguru, Umurenge wa Munini agira ati: “Ihindagurika ry’ikirere rituma abagore bahazaharira cyane kuko nibo bavunika cyane iyo abagabo bagiye gushakisha. Nkanjye ndi umubumbyi. Hari igihe nabuze aho nkura ishinge yo gutwika inkoko kubera izuba ryinshi, bukeye umugore agiye gushakisha kubera kubura icyo kugaburira abana, baramubwira ngo baramuha amakara yo gucuruza babanje kuryamana. Yarabyemeye kugira ngo abone ibyo gutunga abana”.

Usibye i Nyaruguru mu Majyepfo y’u Rwanda, umubyeyi ukora ubuhinzi agacuruza n’ubuki mu karere ka Musanze, agaragaza ko abagore baho benshi bababaje kandi basambana batabiteguye.

Nyirabigirimana Marie Irenee ati: “Hari umugabo usuhuka agata umugore n’abana bagasigara birwariza. Iwacu hari ahantu bahonda amabuye bakaguha amafaranga 400, mu byukuri ukurikije ukuntu ibintu bihenze ayo mafaranga ntacyo yamara mu muryango, iyo ahuye n’ikirara cy’umugabo kikamwongerera bahita basambana kugira ngo agire udufaranga acyura”.

Bakomeza bashimangira ngo ibi binatera amakimbirane mu miryango bikagera ku bana aho usanga abangavu bahura n’abagabo babashuka kubera ibibazo biri iwabo bagahita bemera ariho haturuka inda zitateganyijwe.

Bamwe mu bagore kandi ngo bisanga mu icuruzwa ry’abantu nk’uko bishimangirwa na Jacques Ngarukiye Sekanyange, umuyobozi w’umuryango Ejo Twifuza, uharanira imibereho myiza n’uburenganzira bwa muntu.

Ati: “Imihindagurikire y’ibihe igira uruhare rukomeye mu icuruzwa ry’abantu, aho imvura itwara amazu, ubutaka, isenyuka ry’amazu, kwimurwa n’ibindi. Ibi bituma bakira amahirwe yose abagezeho batabanje kureba ingaruka, ndetse ibi bikongera imibare y’icuruzwa ry’abantu aho 80% ari igitsina gore baba bahunga inzara”.

Agira ati "Mu butayu bareza natwe rero twakweza kuko dufite ubutaka bwiza."

Ibi byatangarijwe mu nama ya 13, yateguwe na ACORD Rwanda, umuryango usanzwe ufasha abahinzi guhinga bitangiza ubutaka, umuyobozi wayo Munyentwali François, muri raporo bakoze yagarutse ku bikubiye ku ngamba zikwiye gufatwa mu gukemura iki kibazo.

Ati: “Leta yakora byinshi kandi ikora byinshi, niyo isinya amasezerano mpuzamahanga arengera ibidukikije, rero hakwiye isesengurwa neza aya masezerano. Ni gute abagore n’abahinzi muri rusange bakomeza kubyaza ibibatunga mu gukoresha umutungo kamere kandi batawangije, kandi nyamara leta n’amasezerano mpuzamahanga bisaba kurengera bidasanzwe umutungo kamere aho ahari ibishanga birimo kwitabwaho mu gukurura ba mukerarugendo, abaturiye ibiyaga bakajya muri metero 50, nyamara uwo muturage usanzwe uhakoresha ntahandi afite! aho niho hari ihurizo rikeneye ko Politike yemezwa yabanje gusesengurwa neza”.

Raporo yakozwe n’uyu muryango yemeza ko ihindagurika ry’ibihe ryibasira abagore kurusha abagabo hagendewe kandi no ku buhamya butangwa nabo byabayeho. Iyi raporo kandi igaragaza ko muri uku kwibasirwa cyane binakurura amakimbirane mu miryango, bityo ko umugore akwiye gushyirwa imbere niba hakenewe igisubizo kirambye mu ihangana n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe.

Mu ntangiriro za Kanama 2026, U Rwanda n'Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'u Burayi (EU) byashyize umukono ku masezerano y'inguzanyo ingana na miliyoni 40 z'Amayero (asaga miliyari 67 z’Amafaranga y’u Rwanda) azafasha mu bufatanye buzashyigikira ubuhinzi butangiza ikirere, imicungire inoze y'ubutaka, kuhira imyaka, no kongerera ubushobozi urwego rw'ubuhinzi mu guhangana n'ingaruka z'imihindagurikire y'ikirere.

Wanditse

Umukazana Germaine

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U02UN-UMKP.title: I Moscou izuba rirenga iyo ribishatse
ART-MU8U02UN-UMKP.subtitle: I Moscou izuba rirenga iyo ribishatse Ariko hari ikintu ntari niteze.
ART-MU8U02UN-UMKP.summary: I Moscou izuba rirenga iyo ribishatse Ariko hari ikintu ntari niteze. Ntabwo hari hakonje cyane nk’uko nabitekerezaga. Washoboraga gusohoka nijoro kandi ntiwumve ubukonje bukabije.
ART-MU8U02UN-UMKP.body:
I Moscou izuba rirenga iyo ribishatse

Ariko hari ikintu ntari niteze. Ntabwo hari hakonje cyane nk’uko nabitekerezaga. Washoboraga gusohoka nijoro kandi ntiwumve ubukonje bukabije.

Ariko ikintu cyantangaje cyane nk’Umunyarwanda ni urumuri rwo ku mugoroba. Umugoroba wanjye wa mbere i Moscou warantangaje.

Mu Rwanda, hafi y’umurongo ucamo isi kabiri (Equateur), iyo bigeze saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba buba butangiye kwira. Ntabwo bijya bigera saa kumi n’ebyiri n’igice izuba rikirimo kuva. I Moscou, narebaga ku isaha nkabona saa tatu z’ijoro izuba rigicanye. Ni ibintu bitangaje iyo ubibonye bwa mbere.

Kugera kuri Red Square

Red Square ni hamwe mu hantu hake nari nzi muri Moscou mbere yo kuhagera. Nari narahabonye muri filimi, amafoto no mu nkuru.

Birumvikana ko ari hamwe mu hantu ha mbere njye na bagenzi banjye baturutse muri Afurika twashakaga gusura. Ubwa mbere twagerageje kuhagera ariko biratunanira.

Twari tukirimo kwiga uburyo metro ikora; ni ukuvuga ko hari harimo no kuyobagurika. Twagerageje gushaka aho twinjirira, ahubwo twisanga twari bugwe mu biro bya perezida w’Uburusiya, dore ko biri hafi aho.

Ku nshuro ya kabiri twagiye twiteguye. Twifashishije umunyafurika usanzwe utuye i Moscou maze araduherekeza kugeza twinjiyeyo neza cyane.

Nk’umuntu wari usanzwe warumvise Red Square, narayibonye kenshi ku mafoto ariko ntarayigeraho, uko twagendaga tuyegera, ni nako amatsiko yarushagaho kwiyongera. Sinjye wabonye nkandagije ibirenge byanjye kuri Red Square.

Kuri njye byari ibintu bikomeye cyane. Numvaga ndi kugenda mu mateka. Numvaga ndimo kugenda ahantu hagenzwe n’abantu benshi bakomeye mu mateka y’Uburusiya n’isi. Nabonaga inyubako nari narabonye inshuro nyinshi muri filimi no ku mafoto. Ariko noneho zari imbere yanjye. Nabashaga kuzibona. Zari iz’ukuri!

Red Square ni ahantu hafite amateka maremare cyane kuko amateka yayo ahera mu kinyejana cya 16, mu myaka y’1500. Aha akaba ari ahantu hatangiye ari isoko ryahuriragamo abaturage b’umugi wa Moscou, ariko uko imyaka n’ibinyejana byagiye bisimburana, haje gutunganywa havamo Red Square tuzi uyu munsi.

Kuri ubu Red Square ifite uburebure bwa metero 330 n’ubugari bwa metero 70, ikaba ikikijwe n’inyubako nziza cyane ariko kandi zinamaze igihe kinini zirimo nka The Cathedral of the Annunciation yubatswe mu 1489, Saint Basil Cathedral yubatswe mu 1561, State Historical Museum yubatswe mu 1883, na GUM, inyubako y’ubucuruzi yubatswe mu 1893.

Iyi nyubako irimo amaduka menshi kandi amenshi yagenewe abantu bafite mu mufuka haremereye. Umunsi twahasuraga, umuyobozi wacu yagize ati: “Amaduka menshi hano ntabwo yerekana ibiciro by’ibicuruzwa. Niba ukeneye kubaza igiciro cy’ikintu bisobanuye ko n’ubundi udafite ubushobozi bwo kukigura!”

Red Square ni hamwe mu hantu hazwi kandi hasurwa cyane mu Burusiya. Buri mwaka abagera kuri miliyoni 20 baturutse ku isi hose baza kwirebera aho hantu hafite amateka akomeye. Iyo ugeze kuri Red Square uhura n’abantu bavuye imihanda yose barimo Abashinwa, Abarabu, Abanyaburayi, Abanyafurika; abantu b’amoko n’amabara atandukanye.

N’ubwo nari nagiye kuri Red Square mfite amatsiko yoo gusura ahantu nyaburanga, naje kwisanga nanjye nabaye kimwe mu byiza nyaburanga byari biri kuri Red Square!

Njye n’itsinda ry’abanyafurika twari twajyanye twageze kuri Red Square maze abantu batangira kudusaba kwifotozanya nabo! Wabaga urimo kugenda nawe ubwawe urimo gufata amafoto ukabona itsinda ry’abakerarugendo bavuye mu Bushinwa rirakwegereye, bakagusaba kwifotozanya nabo.

Undi munsi turimo gusubira kuri hotel, njye n’itsinda twari twarajyanye, twahuye n’abasore bari barimo kwizihiza isabukuru ya mugenzi wabo, batubonye baraduhagarika maze badusaba kuririmbira mugenzi wabo indirimo imwifuriza isabukuru nziza, turabikora maze bagenda bishimye cyane.

Nagiye mu Burusiya mfite ubwoba bw’uko Abarusiya bashobora kuba bagira ivanguraruhu, ndetse batihanganira abirabura habe na mba. Ahubwo nasanzeyo abantu bafite amatsiko yo kumenya uwo uri we, bakwereka ko bakwishimiye iyo uvuganye nabo, ariko ku rundi ruhande bibera mu isi yabo. Iyo ugenda mu nzira, muri metro n’ahandi, ubona ko buri wese yibereye mu bye ntawe uvugisha undi, ndetse ntawe ukwitayeho.

ABANTU NATINYE KUBONA

Ikintu nabonye mu Burusiya gikomeye kurusha ibindi byose ntabwo cyari inyubako. Ahubwo cyari abantu.

Nari niteze kubona abantu batishimira abanyamahanga. Nari niteze abantu batavuga. Abantu bahorana uburakari. Abantu batifuza kugirana imibanire n’abirabura. Bimwe tubona mu itangazamakuru. Ahubwo ni abantu biteguye kugufasha. Abantu bafite amatsiko. Abantu bamwe bagira ubugwaneza.

Umunsi umwe, njye na bagenzi banjye Timothy wo muri Uganda na Nario wo muri Mozambique twafashe gahunda yo kujya gutembera umujyi wa Moscou ariko by’umwihariko twashakaga kugera ahantu hitwa “Moscow City.”

Uyu niwo mutima w’ubucuruzi n’ishoramari ry’Uburusiya. Ibigo bikomeye byo mu Burusiya byose bifite, inyubako zabyo hano hantu. Ni agace karimo imiturirwa myinshi, miremire cyane, kandi yose yubatse yegeranye cyane ku buryo iyo uharebye wagira ngo uri mu ishyamba ry’inyubako z’ibirahuri. Twafashe gahunda yo kujya kureba aha hantu rero, maze twinjira muri metro. Yaba njye, yaba Timothy, yaba Nario, nta n’umwe muri twe wari uzi gukoresha ikarita yerekana inzira za metro.

Twageze munsi y’ubutaka maze dutangira kuyobagurika. Moscow City tukayibonera kure ariko twashaka kuyegera, imiryango ya metro ikatubwira uti: “Mube muretse gato, ntabwo mwishyuye.” Ni iki tutishyuye se?

Byarangiye dusubiye inyuma, maze dutangira urugendo rwo gutaha, kuko byari bimaze kuba saa sita z’ijoro. Mu gutaha nabwo turayoba! Tugeze kuri station imwe, umukobwa ukiri muto w’Umurusiyakazi yaratubonye, maze abona ko twayobye. Nubwo hari imbogamizi y’ururimi kandi Icyongereza cye atari cyinshi, yatubajije aho twashakaga kujya. Turahamubwira, maze adufasha gusubira kuri station yari budufashe gusubira kuri hotel.

Ntiyaduhaye gusa amabwiriza y’uburyo turi bubigenze, ahubwo yatubereye nk’umuyobozi, adufata ukuboko, araduherekeza kugeza kuri station twagombaga gufatiraho gari ya moshi idusubiza kuri hotel.

Ntabwo yari atuzi. Ntacyo yari kungukira mu kudufasha. Yabonye gusa abanyamahanga batatu bayobye, maze ahitamo kubafasha.

Hari n’abandi bantu batandukanye batwegeraga iyo babonaga ko twabuze icyerekezo. Rimwe twakoreshaga applications zo guhindura indimi, ubundi tukabona umuntu uvuga Icyongereza. Rimwe na rimwe, byabaga ngombwa gukoresha amarenga.

Abarusiya ni abantu bakomeye ku rurimu rwabo, ku buryo kubona ukoresha icyongereza ari ibintu bigoranye cyane.

Wanditse

Christophe Kivunge

Umunyamakuru · Reba inkuru zose

Red Square ni ahantu hafite amateka maremare cyane kuko amateka yayo ahera mu kinyejana cya 16, mu myaka y’1500. Aha akaba ari ahantu hatangiye ari isoko ryahuriragamo abaturage b’umugi wa Moscou, ariko uko imyaka n’ibinyejana byagiye bisimburana, haje gutunganywa havamo Red Square tuzi uyu munsi.

Kuri ubu Red Square ifite uburebure bwa metero 330 n’ubugari bwa metero 70, ikaba ikikijwe n’inyubako nziza cyane ariko kandi zinamaze igihe kinini zirimo nka The Cathedral of the Annunciation yubatswe mu 1489, Saint Basil Cathedral yubatswe mu 1561, State Historical Museum yubatswe mu 1883, na GUM, inyubako y’ubucuruzi yubatswe mu 1893.

Iyi nyubako irimo amaduka menshi kandi amenshi yagenewe abantu bafite mu mufuka haremereye. Umunsi twahasuraga, umuyobozi wacu yagize ati: “Amaduka menshi hano ntabwo yerekana ibiciro by’ibicuruzwa. Niba ukeneye kubaza igiciro cy’ikintu bisobanuye ko n’ubundi udafite ubushobozi bwo kukigura!”

Red Square ni hamwe mu hantu hazwi kandi hasurwa cyane mu Burusiya. Buri mwaka abagera kuri miliyoni 20 baturutse ku isi hose baza kwirebera aho hantu hafite amateka akomeye. Iyo ugeze kuri Red Square uhura n’abantu bavuye imihanda yose barimo Abashinwa, Abarabu, Abanyaburayi, Abanyafurika; abantu b’amoko n’amabara atandukanye.
N’ubwo nari nagiye kuri Red Square mfite amatsiko yoo gusura ahantu nyaburanga, naje kwisanga nanjye nabaye kimwe mu byiza nyaburanga byari biri kuri Red Square!

Njye n’itsinda ry’abanyafurika twari twajyanye twageze kuri Red Square maze abantu batangira kudusaba kwifotozanya nabo! Wabaga urimo kugenda nawe ubwawe urimo gufata amafoto ukabona itsinda ry’abakerarugendo bavuye mu Bushinwa rirakwegereye, bakagusaba kwifotozanya nabo.

Undi munsi turimo gusubira kuri hotel, njye n’itsinda twari twarajyanye, twahuye n’abasore bari barimo kwizihiza isabukuru ya mugenzi wabo, batubonye baraduhagarika maze badusaba kuririmbira mugenzi wabo indirimo imwifuriza isabukuru nziza, turabikora maze bagenda bishimye cyane.

Nagiye mu Burusiya mfite ubwoba bw’uko Abarusiya bashobora kuba bagira ivanguraruhu, ndetse batihanganira abirabura habe na mba. Ahubwo nasanzeyo abantu bafite amatsiko yo kumenya uwo uri we, bakwereka ko bakwishimiye iyo uvuganye nabo, ariko ku rundi ruhande bibera mu isi yabo. Iyo ugenda mu nzira, muri metro n’ahandi, ubona ko buri wese yibereye mu bye ntawe uvugisha undi, ndetse ntawe ukwitayeho.
ABANTU NATINYE KUBONA
Ikintu nabonye mu Burusiya gikomeye kurusha ibindi byose ntabwo cyari inyubako. Ahubwo cyari abantu.

Nari niteze kubona abantu batishimira abanyamahanga. Nari niteze abantu batavuga. Abantu bahorana uburakari. Abantu batifuza kugirana imibanire n’abirabura. Bimwe tubona mu itangazamakuru. Ahubwo ni abantu biteguye kugufasha. Abantu bafite amatsiko. Abantu bamwe bagira ubugwaneza.

Umunsi umwe, njye na bagenzi banjye Timothy wo muri Uganda na Nario wo muri Mozambique twafashe gahunda yo kujya gutembera umujyi wa Moscou ariko by’umwihariko twashakaga kugera ahantu hitwa “Moscow City.”

Uyu niwo mutima w’ubucuruzi n’ishoramari ry’Uburusiya. Ibigo bikomeye byo mu Burusiya byose bifite, inyubako zabyo hano hantu. Ni agace karimo imiturirwa myinshi, miremire cyane, kandi yose yubatse yegeranye cyane ku buryo iyo uharebye wagira ngo uri mu ishyamba ry’inyubako z’ibirahuri. Twafashe gahunda yo kujya kureba aha hantu rero, maze twinjira muri metro. Yaba njye, yaba Timothy, yaba Nario, nta n’umwe muri twe wari uzi gukoresha ikarita yerekana inzira za metro.

Twageze munsi y’ubutaka maze dutangira kuyobagurika. Moscow City tukayibonera kure ariko twashaka kuyegera, imiryango ya metro ikatubwira uti: “Mube muretse gato, ntabwo mwishyuye.” Ni iki tutishyuye se?

Byarangiye dusubiye inyuma, maze dutangira urugendo rwo gutaha, kuko byari bimaze kuba saa sita z’ijoro. Mu gutaha nabwo turayoba! Tugeze kuri station imwe, umukobwa ukiri muto w’Umurusiyakazi yaratubonye, maze abona ko twayobye. Nubwo hari imbogamizi y’ururimi kandi Icyongereza cye atari cyinshi, yatubajije aho twashakaga kujya. Turahamubwira, maze adufasha gusubira kuri station yari budufashe gusubira kuri hotel.
Ntiyaduhaye gusa amabwiriza y’uburyo turi bubigenze, ahubwo yatubereye nk’umuyobozi, adufata ukuboko, araduherekeza kugeza kuri station twagombaga gufatiraho gari ya moshi idusubiza kuri hotel.
Ntabwo yari atuzi. Ntacyo yari kungukira mu kudufasha. Yabonye gusa abanyamahanga batatu bayobye, maze ahitamo kubafasha.

Hari n’abandi bantu batandukanye batwegeraga iyo babonaga ko twabuze icyerekezo. Rimwe twakoreshaga applications zo guhindura indimi, ubundi tukabona umuntu uvuga Icyongereza. Rimwe na rimwe, byabaga ngombwa gukoresha amarenga.
Abarusiya ni abantu bakomeye ku rurimu rwabo, ku buryo kubona ukoresha icyongereza ari ibintu bigoranye cyane.
Wanditse
Christophe Kivunge
Umunyamakuru · Reba inkuru zose

ART-MU8U03GI-HJYN.body:
Ngutembereze Moscow batajya batubwira mu makuru

Nari niteze ubukonje, ivanguramoko n’igihugu kiri mu bibazo. Ariko nasanze umujyi ufite amateka, ikoranabuhanga, abaturage bagira umutima mwiza, n’ibintu byinshi bitandukanye n’ibyo yari yiteze.

Icyakora, icyari kinteye impungenge cyane si ubukonje, ahubwo nari narumvise n’ibindi byinshi ku Burusiya: ko Vodka ari kimwe mu by’ingenzi bigize umuco waho, kandi ko ubuzima bwaho bushobora kugorana ku munyamahanga.

Ariko ikintu cyari kinteye ubwoba cyane kurushaho cyari ikindi: Nari mfite ubwoba bwo kuba umwirabura mu Burusiya.

Mbere yo gufata umwanzuro wo kujyayo, nabanje gukora ubushakashatsi bunononsoye, ndeba videwo nyinshi z’abirabura baba cyangwa se bagenda mu Burusiya. Nashakaga kumenya uko bafatwa. Narebaga inkuru zabo nshaka kumenya niba ivanguramoko ari ikintu gishobora kuba kintegereje mu Burusiya.

Usibye kwikanga ivanguramoko, ntabwo wakwirengagiza nanone intambara yo muri Ukraine. Inkuru z’intambara Uburusiya burimo kurwanamo na Ukraine ziri hose. Nibazaga niba kujya mu Burusiya, igihugu kiri mu ntambara ari ikintu cyiza. Habuze gato ngo mfate umwanzuro wo kutagenda.

Uburusiya, mu by’ukuri, ntabwo bwari ku rutonde rw’ibihugu nifuzaga gusura.

Mbere y’uru rugendo, nta byinshi nari mbuziho uretse ibyo numvaga mu makuru, akenshi bijyanye n’intambara yo muri Ukraine.

Gusa ku rundi ruhande nari mfite ikintu kimwe kimpuza n’Uburusiya: mukuru wanjye wabaye muri icyo gihugu igihe kinini cyane, washakanye n’Umurusiyakazi kandi bafitanye abana. Ariko nubwo yari amaze imyaka myinshi aba muri icyo gihugu, ntabwo twigeze tuganira cyane ku rugendo rwanjye mbere y’uko njyayo.

Iyo umuntu aza kumbaza icyo nari nzi cyangwa nifuzaga kubona i Moscou, nari kumubwira ahantu hamwe gusa: Red Square.

Muri Nyakanga 2026, ninjiye mu ndege, maze nerekeza I Moscou mu Burusiya.

Uburusiya nari mfite mu mutwe

Nageze i Moscou ku itariki ya 6 Nyakanga 2026.

Nari nagiye mu Burusiya muri gahunda ya InteRussia Fellowship for Journalists from Sub-Saharan Africa.

Iyi gahunda itegurwa n’ikigo kitwa Gorchakov Fund ku bufatanye n’ibiro ntaramakuru by’Uburusiya Sputnik, yamaze ukwezi, ikaba yarahurije hamwe abanyamakuru baturutse mu bihugu bya Afurika yo munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara, bagiye kwihugura ku mikorere y’itangazamakuuru ryo mu Burusiya, ndetse no kumenya igihugu muri rusange.

Uko iminsi yagendaga ishira, nasanze uru rugendo rurenze kure cyane impamvu ya mbere yari yanzanye mu Burusiya. Nibwo natangiye urugendo rwo kuvumbura umugi wa Moscou ku giti cyanjye.

Akenshi iyo turebye televiziyo cyangwa se tugasoma ibitangazamakuru mpuzamahanga twumva ko Uburusiya ari igihugu cyashyiriweho ibihano byo mu rwego rwo hejuru, igihugu gifite ubukungu bujegajega, igihugu kiri mu ntambara, wenda kirimo no gusenyuka.

Turi mu ndege, mugenzi wanjye twajyanye ukomoka mu gihugu cya Cameroon, yarambwiye ati: ”Ibyo wabonye mu itangazamakuru byose, ntabwo ari ukuri. Uburusiya buzagutungura.” Yari azi ibyo avuga kuko we ntabwo bwari ubwa mbere agezeyo.

Ikintu cya mbere nabonye cyasaga n’aho cyemeza ibyo nari naratekereje cyangwa se nareretswe ku gihugu nakibonye ku kibuga cy’indege. Tukigera ku kibuga cy’indege cya Domodedovo, nabonye indege nyinshi ziparitse. Zimwe zasaga n’izimaze igihe zidakoreshwa.

Ndibuka ko nanditse muri telephone yanjye amazina ya kompanyi z’izo ndege nabonaga ari zo S7 Airlines na Red Wings. Nanditse ayo mazina muri telefoni kugira ngo nyuma nzashake amakuru menye impamvu hari indege nyinshi zasaga n’izidakoreshwa. Ariko mu mutwe wanjye icyo cyari ikimenyetso cy’uko Uburusiya bushobora kuba buri mu bibazo bikomeye.

Nari nzi igihugu kiri mu ntambara. Nari nzi ko cyafatiwe ibihano mpuzamahanga. Nari narabonye inkuru nyinshi zivuga ku ngaruka z’intambara ku bukungu bwacyo.

Urugendo ruva ku kibuga cy’indege rujya mu mujyi wa Moscou na rwo ntirwahise ruhindura ibyo nari naje ndimo gutekereza. Nabonaga imihanda migari cyane, kandi yubatse ariko nanone ku ruhande rwayo nkabona inyubako zimwe zisa nk’izishaje. Nari nkirimo kureba Uburusiya nkoresheje ishusho nari navanye mu Rwanda.

Moscou yanyeretse ko nibeshya

Uko iminsi yagenda yicuma, ndi mu mugi wa Moscou, ni ko byagendaga birushaho kunanira gukomeza kwizirika ku ishusho nari mfite.

Moscou ni umujyi mwiza. Icyo nicyo kintu cya mbere nabanje kwemera.

Moscou ni umujyi aho amateka n’iterambere rigezweho bisa nk’aho bituranye. Mu gace kamwe ushobora kubona inyubako za kera, zimaze imyaka amagana kandi zifite imyubakire idasanzwe, hanyuma hafi yazo ukabona inyubako ndende cyane zigezweho zizamuka mu kirere hafi yo kugihanantura. Moscou ni umujyi ushaka gutera imbere ariko kandi udashaka gusibanganya amateka yawo.

Moscou ni umugi ufite isuku. Iyo ugenda mu duce dutandukanye tw’umujyi no muri za sitasiyo za metro ikintu kigutangaza ni uburyo hafite isuku nyinshi ariko kandi ukanibaza uti: “Ni nde usukura aha, kandi basukura ryari?”

I Kigali, tumenyereye kubona abantu basukura ku nkengero z’imihanda. I Moscou ntabwo nigeze mbona abantu bakora uwo murimo. Nabonaga gusa umusaruro w’akazi bakoze.

Gutwara abantu muri Moscou ni ibintu byoroshye cyane kandi byihuta. Hari metro, bisi, tram, taxi-voiture n’utugare cyangwa scooters dukodeshwa. Ku muntu ushaka kugenda mu mujyi, hari uburyo bwinshi bwo kuva ahantu hamwe ujya ahandi, kandi bwihuta cyane. Metro ya Moscou yabaye kimwe mu bintu byantangaje kandi nakunze cyane.

Metro ni uburyo bwo gutwara abantu bwifashisha gari ya moshi ariko bunyura ahanini munsi y’ubutaka. Ubu buryo burahendutse cyane kandi burihuta cyane. Imwe mu migi ikomeye cyane ku isi usanga yarubatse zino nzira zo munsi y’ubutaka, zigakoreshwa n’amamiliyoni y’abantu buri munsi.

By’umwihariko umugi wa Moscou ufite imwe muri metro zimaze igihe kandi zubatse neza. Metro yo muri Moscou ikaba yaratangiye gukora guhera mu mwaka w’1935. Zimwe muri station (cyangwa se gare) za metro ya Moscou zubatse ku buryo iyo ugezemo ukeka ko winjiye nko mu nzu ndangamurage. Abategetsi b’abasoviyeti bazubatse bazitaga ko ari ingoro z’abaturage (The People’s Palace).

Umunsi umwe njye n’umwe muri bagenzi banjye waturutse muri Uganda, twigeze gufata gahunda yo kuzenguruka zimwe muri station zizwi cyane za metro ya Moscou. Ntabwo twari tugamije kugera ahantu runaka, ahubwo twari turimo kureba ubwiza bw’izo ngoro zubakiwe abaturage.

Kugenda muri metro ya Moscou ifite uburebure bwa kilometer zisaga 300, ni gahunda ishobora kumara umunsi wose kandi nabwo ntabwo ubasha kugera muri stations zose. Ariko bikwereka uburyo igihugu cyabashije kubaka icyo umuntu yakwita ko ari umugi ariko wubatse munsi y’ubutaka, aho ushobora kumara umunsi wose udakandagiye hanze ngo urebe izuba.

Usibye kuba metro ya Moscou yubakitse neza, ikindi kintu kiyiranga, ni ijwi ryo mu kirusiya ry’umuntu umenyesha abagenzi aho bageze.

“Astarozhna, dveri zakryvayutsya. Sledyushchaya stantsiya.”

Mu Kinyarwanda bishatse kuvuga: “Mwitonde, imiryango igiye kwifunga. Sitasiyo ikurikira ni...” Naryumvise inshuro nyinshi ku buryo ryaje kuba ijwi mpuza cyane na Moscou.

Wanditse

Christophe Kivunge

Umunyamakuru · Reba inkuru zose

Ariko bikwereka uburyo igihugu cyabashije kubaka icyo umuntu yakwita ko ari umugi ariko wubatse munsi y’ubutaka, aho ushobora kumara umunsi wose udakandagiye hanze ngo urebe izuba.
Usibye kuba metro ya Moscou yubakitse neza, ikindi kintu kiyiranga, ni ijwi ryo mu kirusiya ry’umuntu umenyesha abagenzi aho bageze.
“Astarozhna, dveri zakryvayutsya. Sledyushchaya stantsiya.”
Mu Kinyarwanda bishatse kuvuga: “Mwitonde, imiryango igiye kwifunga. Sitasiyo ikurikira ni...” Naryumvise inshuro nyinshi ku buryo ryaje kuba ijwi mpuza cyane na Moscou.

Christophe Kivunge
Umunyamakuru · Reba inkuru zose

ART-MU8U0426-YQ0Y.body:
Umunyarwenya Clapton Kibonge yaserutse neza mu Bufaransa

Kibonge ari i Paris, aho yagiye hamwe na Trésor Senga, Umuyobozi wa Mashariki African Film Festival, mu bikorwa bya Off-Courts Festival, iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ryibanda kuri filime ngufi ribera i Trouville-sur-Mer kuva ku wa 5 kugeza ku wa 11 Nzeri 2026.

Muri uru rugendo, Clapton Kibonge ntiyagarukiye ku kwitabira ibikorwa by’iserukiramuco, kuko yanagize uruhare mu gukora filime ‘Identity’, yakozwe ku bufatanye n’amatsinda y’abanyamwuga bo mu Bufaransa.

Kibonge yavuze ko uru rugendo rwari rugamije no kumufasha kunguka ubunararibonye no kumenya uburyo sinema ikorwa ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

Ati: “Ni filime twakoreye ijana ku ijana mu Bufaransa. Zakozwe n’amatsinda abizobereyemo hano, kandi kugeza ubu ni filime zarangiye twerekanye mu iserukiramuco rya ‘Off-Courts Festival’.”

Ku ruhande rwe, Trésor Senga na we yitabiriye Off-Courts Festival, aho yerekanye filime ye ‘I Wanna Go Back Home’, yakorewe i Paris.

Off-Courts Festival ni iserukiramuco ngarukamwaka rihuza abakora sinema, abakinnyi, abayobozi ba filime n’abandi banyamwuga bo mu nganda ndangamuco. Ritanga amahirwe yo guhuza abanyamwuga no guteza imbere imishinga mishya ya filime.

Kuri Clapton Kibonge, gukorera filime mu Bufaransa no kuyigeza muri iri serukiramuco ni amahirwe yo kurushaho kumenya uburyo imishinga ya sinema itegurwa kandi igakorwa mu buryo mpuzamahanga.

Kugeza ubu, ‘Identity’ ya Clapton Kibonge na ‘I Wanna Go Back Home’ ya Trésor Senga zamaze kwerekanwa muri Off-Courts Festival.

Kibonge yavuze ko nyuma yo gusubira mu Rwanda ari bwo azamenya niba ‘Identity’ izabona andi mahirwe yo kwerekanwa imbere y’abakunzi ba sinema mu Rwanda.

Wanditse

Agaba Julius Owens

Umunyamakuru
