ART-MU8U04LJ-B25C.title: Ese abakora mu nzego z'Uburezi bikanze iki?
ART-MU8U04LJ-B25C.subtitle: Ese abakora mu nzego z'Uburezi bikanze iki?
ART-MU8U04LJ-B25C.summary: Ese abakora mu nzego z'Uburezi bikanze iki? Umusanzu w’itangazamakuru mu mikorere myiza y’inzego zinyuranye za Leta, ugaragara no mu rwego rw’uburezi, rikagaragaza ibikorwa bisanzwe n’ibishya bigenda byiyongera mu ireme ry’uburezi. Ibyo gutangaza gahunda ziri mu burezi cyangwa iziteganyijwe bigenda neza iyo abayobozi cyangwa se abakozi bo mu nzego z’uburezi bemeye gutanga amakuru agendanye n'inshingano zabo.
ART-MU8U04LJ-B25C.body:
Ese abakora mu nzego z'Uburezi bikanze iki?

Umusanzu w’itangazamakuru mu mikorere myiza y’inzego zinyuranye za Leta, ugaragara no mu rwego rw’uburezi, rikagaragaza ibikorwa bisanzwe n’ibishya bigenda byiyongera mu ireme ry’uburezi.

Ibyo gutangaza gahunda ziri mu burezi cyangwa iziteganyijwe bigenda neza iyo abayobozi cyangwa se abakozi bo mu nzego z’uburezi bemeye gutanga amakuru agendanye n'inshingano zabo.

Ni koko nta munyamakuru watangaza ibyekereye gahunda z’uburezi atabisobanuriwe n’ubizi kandi ubishinzwe mu rwego rw’uburezi.

Gusa, muri iki gihe ubona hashobora kuba hari ikibazo gituma bamwe mu bakora mu rwego rw’uburezi, baseta ibirenge mu gutanga amakuru.

Mu minsi ishize, nashatse amakuru muri izi nzego, mvugana n’ushinzwe uburezi ku rwego rw’Akarere, ampa amakuru yari ayifite, ariko arambwira ati, "amakuru yuzuye kuri iyo gahunda urimo umbaza, wayahabwa n'ushinzwe imikoranire myiza hagati ya Minisiteri y’Uburezi n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo."

Nahamagaye uwo mukozi ndamwibwira, mubwira n’amakuru nifuzaga ko yampa maze agira ati "Amakuru mfite kuri iyo ngingo, ni kimwe n’ayo waba ufite, cyangwa se undi wese, nta makuru menshi cyane mfite kuri iyo gahunda, ariko ibyiza wabaza kanaka (ambwira amazina ye) ukora muri NESA, kuko ashinzwe ibijyanye n’amashuri muri rusange n’ubugenzuzi bwayo. Uwo yayaguha aherekejwe n’ingero zifatika kuko ari zo nshingano ze."

Hatarashira n’isaha nahamagaye uwo mukozi wa NESA bandangiye, ndamwibwira, antega amatwi aranyumva, ariko agiye kunsubiza ikibazo namubajije agira ati "ibyo wajya kubibaza kanaka wo muri Minisiteri y’Uburezi."

Aha namubwiye ko uwo anyoherezaho ari we tumaze kuvugana, mbese bangiraga nk'abahererekanya agatenesi.

Acyumva ibyo, yahise ahindura ingingo arambwira ati "ubu ndi mu rugendo rw’akazi mu ntara, nshobora kumarayo iminsi ibiri, ubwo twazavugana ngarutse, cyangwa se uze kumvugisha nageze aho ngiye natuje hanyuma ngufashe kubona ayo makuru ushaka."

Icyo cya kabiri nacyumvise bwangu, ngereranya igihe yaba yageze aho yajyaga nongera kumuhamagara, ndamwibutsa, ariko agiye kunsubiza arambwira ati, "ayo makuru wayashaka ku rubuga rwa interineti rwa NESA, utayabonaho ukambwira, nkagushakira umuntu uyaguha iwacu ku kazi."

Ubwo nagiye ku rubuga rwabo rwa interineti, ndayashaka sinayabona, hanyuma nongera guhamagara wa muyobozi mubwira nti "amakuru sinayabonyeho rwose, mwamfasha."

Muri ako kanya, yahise ambwira ko ubundi ayo makuru ahari rwose mu buryo bwanditse ndetse yoherejwe muri buri Karere k’u Rwanda, kugira ngo abantu bose bayamenye cyane cyane ababyeyi bafite abana biga, kuko ari bo afitiye akamaro cyane.

Ubwo nahise mubwira nti nta kibazo noneho reka mvugishe undi uhagarariye uburezi ku rwego rw’Akarere amfashe.

Gusa, uwo ushinzwe uburezi ku wego rw’Akarere yarampakaniye ati, “Nta makuru nk’ayo twigeze duhabwa na rimwe. Uwo muyobozi wo muri NESA yavuze ko bayatanze ryari se? Ntayo twigeze tubona pe agomba kuba yibeshye rwose”.

Ushinzwe uburezi ku rwego rw’Akarere amaze kumpakanira nahise nsubira ku wanyohereje, maze mubwiye uko byagenze, arambwira ati "Nta kibazo reka duhindure umuvuno. Andikira Umuyobozi mukuru wa NESA kuri ‘email’, nanjye umpe kopi, hanyuma ku mugoroba ndaza kugusubiza."

Ibyo nahise mbikora nandikira Umuyobozi mukuru wa NESA, n’uwo mukozi wa twavuganye muha kopi nk’uko yambwiye. Ariko uwo mugoroba warageze nta gisubizo nabonye.

Umunsi ukurikiyeho nongeye kumuhamagara ngo mwibutse, ati "ndabanza kureba ibyo umuyobozi mukuru yasubije hanyuma ndakubwira." Uwo munsi ukurikiyeho na wo warinze wira nta gisubizo.

Icyakora inzego z'Uburezi, mu minsi ishize, uhereye ku bihe by'itangazwa ry'amanota y'ibizamini bya Leta, zimaze iminsi zifite byinshi byo gusubiza.

Muri byo harimo iby'abanyeshuri bakopeye, ababifatiwemo, ndetse n'ibitekerezo binyuranye abantu bakomeje kubitangaho, bashyira ikibazo kuri aba cyangwa bariya, bashinja uburangare bwa bamwe cyangwa abandi.

Ibi ndetse byaje kuzamo ikibazo cy'umunyeshuri wabuze mu itangazwa ry'amanota no guhemba abahize abandi mu cyiciro rusange, maze ikosa rishyirwa kuri NESA, na Minisiteri y'Uburezi muri rusange.

Harya ubwo ibyo byatuma abantu bumva ko mbere yo gutanga amakuru ayo ari yo yose ajyanye n'uburezi bagomba kubanza gukaraga ururimi karindwi?

Ibyo ari byo byose, urwego rw'uburezi n'itangazamakuru biracyakeneye gukorana neza.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U055A-FF86.title: Ese koko imyanda yo mu bwiherero bw’indege imenwa mu kirere?
ART-MU8U055A-FF86.subtitle: Ese koko imyanda yo mu bwiherero bw’indege imenwa mu kirere?
ART-MU8U055A-FF86.summary: Ese koko imyanda yo mu bwiherero bw’indege imenwa mu kirere? Ni uko bamwe muri twe bakibaza bati ubwo byagenda bite icyo gikorwa kibaye uri muri iryo shyamba cyangwa mu bwato buri mu nyanja, ariko nta gisubizo gihamye jye na bagenzi banjye twigeze tubibonera. Kimwe mu bisubizo cyabyo naje kukibona ubwo ninjiraga mu ndege bwa mbere, icyo gihe nari nasabye abatanga amatike bampa umwanya wo ku idirisha kugira ngo nkurikirane akantu ku kandi kuko nari mfite amatsiko yo kumenya byinshi.
ART-MU8U055A-FF86.body:
Ese koko imyanda yo mu bwiherero bw’indege imenwa mu kirere?

Ni uko bamwe muri twe bakibaza bati ubwo byagenda bite icyo gikorwa kibaye uri muri iryo shyamba cyangwa mu bwato buri mu nyanja, ariko nta gisubizo gihamye jye na bagenzi banjye twigeze tubibonera.

Kimwe mu bisubizo cyabyo naje kukibona ubwo ninjiraga mu ndege bwa mbere, icyo gihe nari nasabye abatanga amatike bampa umwanya wo ku idirisha kugira ngo nkurikirane akantu ku kandi kuko nari mfite amatsiko yo kumenya byinshi.

Indege ikimara guhaguruka ifashe neza ikirere, narahagurutse ntuje njya mu bwiherero kugira ngo nshake igisubizo cy’ikibazo nari maranye igihe kitari gito.

Nkigeramo nakoze ibyari byanjyanye ndangije mfungura amazi (Flush) ariko mbona nta kintu kidasanzwe kibaye gitandukanye n’ubwiherero bwo mu nzu n’ahandi hari ubukoresha uburyo bwo kurekura amazi agatwara umwanda, ariko ndavuga nti wasanga turi mu kirere kitari hejuru y’ishyamba cyangwa inyanja.

Nasubiye mu byicaro ndategereza ko naza kubona aho iyo myanda ijugunywa n’uko bigenda, amaso ahera mu kirere dore ko ari nacyo nari ndimo. Icyo gihe nagarukanye igisubizo n’ikibazo gishya.

Igisubizo nagarukanye ni uko nari maze kuba umuhamya ko iyo myanda itajugunywa mu kirere igihe indege igeze hejuru y’ishyamba cyangwa inyanja, ariko nsigarana ikibazo cyo kumenya aho ijya.

Impuguke mu bijyanye n’imicungire y’indege n’ibibuga byazo (Expert in Airline and Airport Management), zigaragaza ko iyo umugenzi akoresheje ubwiherero bw’indege, imyanda itajugunywa hanze y’indege. Ahubwo ko mu ndege nyinshi z’iki gihe, ubwiherero bukoresha uburyo bwo gukurura imyanda hakoreshejwe umwuka (vacuum system).

Iyo umuntu afashe kuri buto (bouton) yo gusukura ubwiherero, imyanda irakururwa ikajya mu kigega cyabugenewe cyo kuyibikamo kiri mu cyo umuntu yakwita mu nda y’indege (waste/holding tank).

Iyo indege igeze ku kibuga cy’indege, abakozi bashinzwe serivisi zo ku butaka baza bafite imodoka yabugenewe yo gukuramo imyanda yo mu bwiherero bw’indege (lavatory service truck), rimwe na rimwe ikaba ari akagare kabugenewe.

Umuyoboro w’iyo modoka uhuzwa n’umuyoboro usohora imyanda uri ku ruhande rwo munsi y’indege. Hanyuma imyanda iva mu kigega cy’indege ikajya mu kigega cy’imodoka.

Nyuma yo kuyivana mu ndege, ikigega cy’indege kirasukurwa hakoreshejwe amazi n’umuti wabugenewe wo gusukura no kurwanya impumuro mbi. Muri serivisi zisanzwe, intambwe z’ingenzi ni ugukuramo imyanda, koza ikigega no kongeramo umuti wabugenewe kugira ngo sisitemu yitegure kwakira indi myanda mu rugendo rukurikira.

Nyuma yo kuyikura mu ndege, imyanda ibikwa mu kigega cy’imodoka yabugenewe, igahabwa uburyo bwo kuyitunganya no kuyijugunya hakurikijwe uburyo bwashyizweho n’ikibuga cy’indege n’amabwiriza y’isuku n’ibidukikije.

Emmy Arsonval Maniriho, Impuguke mu Micungire y’Indege n’Ibibuga byazo, avuga ko imyanda yo mu bwiherero bw’indege itarekurirwa mu kirere.

Agura ati “ Ikintu gishobora kuba cyarayobeje abantu, ni uko hari igihe amazi ava mu bwiherero cyangwa muri galley ashobora gusohoka binyuze muri drainage systems (uburyo bwo gutwara no kuvana amazi) zabugenewe, ariko ibyo si byo byatuma uvuga ko imyanda yo mu bwiherero imenwa mu kirere.”

Avuga ko bidashoboka kugira ngo iyo myanda imenwe hanze kuko bishobora kugira ingaruka ku bintu bitandukanye.

Ati “Mu by’indege, kugira ngo imyanda ijugunywe hanze uko bishakiye byaba ari ikibazo gikomeye cy’umutekano, isuku n’ibidukikije, kandi sisitemu z’indege zubakwa ku buryo imyanda yo mu bwiherero ibikwa mu kigega kugeza igeze hasi.”

Ingano y’ibigega bibika imyanda yo mu bwiherero bw’indege iterwa n'ubwoko bw'indege, kuko uko zirutanwa ari nako birutanwa mu bunini.

Aha urugero twatanga ni nk’indege ya Boeing 737 MAX ifite ikigega (waste tank0 gishobora kwakira hafi litiro 238 (63 US gallons / igipimo cy’ubwinshi bw’amazi cyangwa andi mazi gikoreshwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika).

Indege yo mu bwoko bwa Airbus A320, yo iifite ikigega gifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira imyanda ingana na litiro 177 (47 US gallons). Ikigega iyo cyuzuye, sisiteme ishobora guhagarika kurekura amazi (flush) kugira ngo imyanda idakomeza kwinjiramo.

Ntihategerezwa ko ikigega cy’indenge kijyamo imyanda yo mu bwiherero kibanza kuzura kugira ngo ikurwemo, kuko igihe cyose indege igeze ku kibuga, imodoka yabugenewe ihuzwa n’icyo kigega, hagakurwamo umwanda wo mu bwiherero ukajyanwa ahabugenewe.

Ni imirimo isanzwe ikorwa mu gihe indege imara ku kibuga mu gihe cyo kugwa no guhaguruka (turn around). Ku ndege nto nka ERJ-135, bishobora gukorwa mu gihe cy’iminota igera kuri 5, ariko ubundi igihe nyacyo gishobora kugenwa n'indege, ikibuga cy’indege n'ibikoresho bihari.

Buri wese hano ashobora kwibaza amazi akoreshwa mu bindi bikorwa bikorerwa mu ndege birimo n’ayo mu gikoni, ajya.

Maniriho avuga ko hari itandukaniro rikomeye ku myanda yo mu bwiherero hamwe n’andi akoreshwa mu bindi.

Agira ati “Imyanda yo mu bwiherero ijya mu kigega kandi ntigisukurirwa mu kirere. Ariko amazi ava muri lavatory sink na galley sinks (lavabo yo mu bwiherero no mu gikoni) yo ni amazi yanduye atava mu bwiherero (grey water), ayo ashobora gusohokera hanze y'indege anyuze mu miyoboro yo gusohora amazi yanduye ifite uburyo bwo kuyashyushya (heated drain masts), yabugenewe kugira ngo itazafunga kubera ubukonje.”

Burya ntabwo amazi abura za Kanombe na Busanza gusa, kuko no mu ndege ashobora kubura bitewe n’impamvu zitandukanye.

Maniriho, avuga ko indege igira ikigega cy’amazi cyayo, kandi ko amazi ashobora kuba make cyangwa agashira.

Agira ati “Urugero, natanga ni ku ndege ya A320, igira ikigega gifite ubushobozi bwo kubika litiro hafi 200 (53 US gallons). Iyo amazi ashize, ntabwo bivuze ko indege idashobora kuguruka, ariko services zimwe nka lavabo zo mu bwiherero n'izo mu gikoni cyangwa amazi yo mu bwiherero zishobora kugira imbogamizi cyangwa kudakora.”

Zimwe mu mpamvu zishobora gutuma amazi abura mu ndege, ni ukutagenzura ko amazi yuzuye mbere yo guhaguruka, gukoresha amazi menshi kurusha uko byari biteganyijwe, kuva kw’ikigega (leakage), cyangwa ikindi kibazo gishobora guterwa na sisiteme y’amazi (water system).

Ni yo mpamvu nyamukuru abakozi bashinzwe ibikorwa byo ku butaka n’abandi bakorera ku kibuga bakurikirana ingano y’amazi (water quantity) mbere no mu gihe cy'urugendo.

Uretse telefone n’imodoka tumeneyereye ko bigira bateri, ariko ngo n’indege ni uko, uretse ko iyayo yo ishize indege itazima cyangwa ngo ihagarare.

Maniriho avuga ko indege atari nk’imodoka kuko indege nini zifite inkomoko (sources) nyinshi z'amashanyarazi, kuko nka A320, ifite moteri z’amashanyarazi (generators) zituruka kuri moteri (engines), APU generator (moteri nto yo mu ndege ikora amashanyarazi) na bateri (Batteries).

Izo ziyongeraho moteri y’ubutabazi y’amashanyarazi (emergency generator) ikoreshejwe na turbine ikoreshwa n’umuyaga mu gihe cy’ibyihutirwa (RAT/ Ram Air Turbine). Mu gihe habaye ikibazo gikomeye cya moteri, bateri zifasha cyane mu gutanga umuriro kuri sisiteme za ngombwa no mu bihe byihutirwa, ariko ntabwo ari zo soko nyamukuru y'amashanyarazi igihe indege iri mu kirere.

Uburyo imyanda yo mu bwiherero bw’indege ibikwamo mu kigega, bufite aho buhuriye n’uko ubwo muri gariyamoshi bubikwa kuko nabwo bubikwa mu kigega aho kugira ngo burekurwe cyangwa bujugunywe igihe birimo kugenda.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

content_blocks.text: Ese koko imyanda yo mu bwiherero bw’indege imenwa mu kirere?
Ni uko bamwe muri twe bakibaza bati ubwo byagenda bite icyo gikorwa kibaye uri muri iryo shyamba cyangwa mu bwato buri mu nyanja, ariko nta gisubizo gihamye jye na bagenzi banjye twigeze tubibonera.

Kimwe mu bisubizo cyabyo naje kukibona ubwo ninjiraga mu ndege bwa mbere, icyo gihe nari nasabye abatanga amatike bampa umwanya wo ku idirisha kugira ngo nkurikirane akantu ku kandi kuko nari mfite amatsiko yo kumenya byinshi.
Indege ikimara guhaguruka ifashe neza ikirere, narahagurutse ntuje njya mu bwiherero kugira ngo nshake igisubizo cy’ikibazo nari maranye igihe kitari gito.

Nkigeramo nakoze ibyari byanjyanye ndangije mfungura amazi (Flush) ariko mbona nta kintu kidasanzwe kibaye gitandukanye n’ubwiherero bwo mu nzu n’ahandi hari ubukoresha uburyo bwo kurekura amazi agatwara umwanda, ariko ndavuga nti wasanga turi mu kirere kitari hejuru y’ishyamba cyangwa inyanja.

Igisubizo nagarukanye ni uko nari maze kuba umuhamya ko iyo myanda itajugunywa mu kirere igihe indege igeze hejuru y’ishyamba cyangwa inyanja, ariko nsigarana ikibazo cyo kumenya aho ijya.

ART-MU8U05P7-KD42.body:
Kubona umugore ugenda yandika umunani kubera ubusinzi si iby’i Rwanda-Minisitiri Consolee Uwimana

Minisitiri Uwimana yabivuze ubwo yatangizaga Inama Isanzwe ya 25 y’INteko Rusange y’Inama y’Igihugu y’Abagore, yagarutse ku nshingano abagore bafite mu kubaka imiryango n’Igihugu.

Yagaragaje ko nubwo u Rwanda rwateye intambwe mu guteza imbere umugore no kumuha uruhare mu nzego zifata ibyemezo, hakiri ibindi bibazo abagore n’abagize imiryango bagomba gukomeza kurwanya, birimo amakimbirane mu miryango, umwanda, abana baterwa inda, igwingira n’ubusinzi.

Minisitiri Uwimana kandi yasabye abagore n’abayobozi b’Inama y’Igihugu y’Abagore kugira uruhare rufatika mu kurwanya ubusinzi n’inzoga zitujuje ubuziranenge, by’umwihariko batanga amakuru ku hantu ibyo bikorwa bikigaragara.

Yavuze ko ubusinzi bukomeje kugira ingaruka ku muryango no ku rubyiruko by’umwihariko, bityo ko kurwanya iki kibazo bidakwiye kuba inshingano y’inzego za Leta gusa, ahubwo ko abagore na bo bafite uruhare rukomeye.

Umugore ntasabwa kuba umuyobozi gusa

Minisitiri Uwimana yavuze ko gahunda z’uburinganire zitagomba kugarukira ku kuba umugore ahagarariwe mu nzego z’imiyoborere, ahubwo ko hakenewe impinduka zigaragara mu buzima bwe, mu muryango no mu iterambere ry’Igihugu.

Ati: “Ibi bivuze ko tutagomba kunyurwa gusa no kubona umugore mu nzego z’imiyoborere runaka, ahubwo tugomba kubona impinduka zifatika mu buzima bwe, ubw’umuryango we n’ubw’Igihugu muri rusange.”

Yasobanuye ko ibyo bisaba kubaka ubushobozi n’icyizere by’umugore, kumufungurira amahirwe no kumufasha kugira uruhare rufatika mu kubaka Igihugu.

Ibi kandi bijyana no guhindura imyumvire ku buringanire n’ubwuzuzanye, ndetse no kubaka umuryango wemera ko umugore ashobora kwiga, kuyobora, kwihangira imirimo no kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’Igihugu, mu gihe abagabo n’abagore basangira inshingano zo kubaka umuryango.

Minisitiri yavuze ko abagore badakwiye gutegereza gusa umugabane wa 30% uteganywa n’amategeko mu myanya y’ubuyobozi, ahubwo ko uwo mugabane ukwiye kuba intangiriro aho kuba iherezo ry’uruhare rwabo.

Imibare yatangajwe na MINALOC muri 2024/2025 igaragaza ko abagore bangana na 23% by’Abayobozi b’Uturere, mu gihe Abayobozi Bungirije b’Uturere bashinzwe ubukungu ari 17%, naho Abayobozi b’Imidugudu bakaba 16%.

Minisitiri yavuze ko iyo mibare igaragaza ko hakiri urugendo, ariko ko itagomba gufatwa nk’ikimenyetso cy’uko abagore badashoboye.

Ati “Ibi si ubutumwa bw’uko abagore badashoboye; ni ubutumwa bw’uko tugomba kongera imbaraga mu kubategura, kububakira icyizere no kubashyigikira.”

Inama y’Igihugu y’Abagore kandi yasabwe gukomeza gufasha imiryango guhindura imibereho yayo, binyuze mu bikorwa birimo gukurikirana imihigo ya Mutimawurugo mu Midugudu yose no guherekeza imiryango itanu muri buri Mudugudu, muri yo ibiri ikaba igomba gutera intambwe igaragara mu gihe cy’imyaka itatu.

Yagaragaje ko intego ikwiye kuba iyo kugira Umunyarwandakazi ufite ubushobozi, icyizere, imyitwarire myiza kandi ushobora gukoresha amahirwe ahari kugira ngo ateze imbere ubuzima bwe, umuryango we n’Igihugu muri rusange.

Wanditse

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

ART-MU8U068N-281U.body:
'Igiti cy'ubuzima' cya Liberata Mukarurangirwa

Liberata Mukarurangirwa utuye i Bweya mu Karere ka Gisagara afite igiti cya avoka avuga ko cyonyine iyo cyeze kimwinjiriza amafaranga ibihumbi 500, atabariyemo izo aba yatangiye ubuntu.

Uyu mubyeyi w'imyaka 76, avuga ko mbere yari umukene ukabije, kandi muri ubwo bukene bwe hari n'igihe yari afite icyo giti, kuko akimaranye imyaka irenga 15. Avoka yezaga mbere yarazitangaga, izindi akarya.

Kumenya ko avoka ye yamufasha kwikura mu bukene yabikuye mu matsinda yo kubitsa no kugurizanya bashishikarijwe n'umuryango AEE.

Agira ati "Nagiteye ari igiti gisanzwe, kiba cyiza, kiragara, kikera cyane, kandi uko iminsi igenda yicuma kikarushaho. Mbere rero sinari nzi agaciro ka avoka. Kwari uguha abantu bakirira, aho ngiriye mu matsinda ndetse n'amahugurwa ya Hinduka Wigire twahawe na AEE, ni bwo nagize akenge ko gutangira kugurisha avoka zanjye."

Yungamo ati "Natangiye ntanga avoka enye ku mafaranga 100, bukeye haza abazishora i Kigali bakampa ebyiri ku ijana, none ubu bampa magana abiri kuri avoka eshatu, bagapakira imifuka bagatwara. Ntabaze izo twariye n'izo natangiye ubuntu cyangwa izo banyibye ndetse n'izo nagurishije n'abaturanyi, abazijyana i Kigali banyishyura ibihumbi 500."

Hamwe n'ubushobozi yagiye akura mu matsinda ndetse no mu bworozi bw'inkoko itsinda ryabo ryahawe n'umushinga wa AEE wo gushishikariza abiganjemo abagore kugira uruhare mu kurengera ibidukikije (REDAA: Reversing Environmental Degradation in Africa and Asia), yabashije kwikura mu bukene bukabije, ku buryo ubu yishimira intambwe amaze gutera.

Agira ati "Mbere nari umupfakazi utuye muri nyakatsi bene za zindi ziva amazi atukura utatinyuka kwinjizamo umuntu wambaye imyenda yera, ariko ubu amafaranga nagiye nkura muri ya avoka, mu matsinda, mu matungo nahawe n'ayo nagiye nigurira no mu ifumbire ngurisha yatumye mbasha kwiyubakira inzu y'amabati irimo sima inafite urubaraza rwiza ndetse n'inzu zo mu rugo."

Anavuga ko kubera ubukene atari yarigeze abasha kurera abana be uko abyifuza ku buryo ubu bamusigiye abuzukuru, ariko kuri ubu abo buzukuru bameze neza cyane.

Ati "Mbagaburira neza nkanabambika neza ku buryo ubabonye utamenya ko ari aba wa mukecuru wigeze kuba ari umukene bikabije, wumvaga nta gaciro afite."

Ku bw'amatsinda bibumbiyemo yo kurengera ibidukikije ubu yateye n'izindi avoka ariko noneho za kijyambere, ku buryo yizeye ko mu bihe biri imbere azarushaho kubona amafaranga menshi. Yateye n'ibindi biti harimo ibivangwa n'imyaka ndetse n'iby'imbuto.

Bagenzi be batitabira amatsinda abagira inama yo kuyagana kubera ko yasanze kuba kumwe n'abandi bituma umuntu yunguka ubwenge.

Ati "N'abatitabira gucukura imiringoti ndetse no gutera ibiti nabibashishikariza kuko bifasha muri byinshi. Nk'avoka zanjye zirengera ibidukikije, zikampa n'umusaruro umfasha mu mibereho. Ibiti nka kariyandara birengera ibidukikije, n'amatungo akabirya."

Akomeza agira ati "Igiti cyanjye cya avoka nakiguzemo umurima. Ndawuhinga nkezamo Ibishyimbo, ibirayi n'amateke. Igiti cyanjye cyangejeje ku kwambara neza kandi kinderera abuzukuru."

Wherny Namara, umukozi wa AEE ishimwe ibikorwa by'umushinga REDAA AEE iterwamo inkunga na Tearfund, avuga ko bakorera mu Mirenge ibiri yo mu Karere ka Gisagara n'ibiri yo mu Karere ka Huye.

Kuva muri 2024 uyu mushinga watangira, bamaze gutera ibiti bibarirwa mu bihumbi 600, kandi mu kwezi k'Ukwakira 2026 bazatera ibibarirwa mu bihumbi 300.

Umubare w'ibiti batera ugenda wiyongera kubera ko abaturage bakorana bagiye bigishwa kwikorera pepiniyeri, bakanigishwa kwitunganyiriza ingemwe za avoka zibanguriye, ku buryo nk'uyu mwaka bazaba bafite izibarirwa mu bihumbi 40, mu gihe mbere batangaga nk'ibihumbi bibiri babaga baguriye abagenerwabikorwa.

ART-MU8U06SE-XDQW.body:
U Rwanda rwahisemo kugirira icyizere urubyiruko ruhabwa inshingano mu nzego zitandukanye- Madamu Jeannette Kagame

Madamu Jeannette Kagame, yagaragaje ko u Rwanda rwahisemo kugirira icyizere urubyiruko rugahabwa inshingano mu nzego zitandukanye, ahanini bishingiye ku byo umuntu ashobora kugaragaza.

Ni bumwe mu butumwa bwari bukubiye mu ijambo yagejeje ku bitabiriye amasengesho yagenewe abayobozi bakiri bato azwi nka ‘Young Leaders Prayer Breakfast’, yateguwe n’umuryango wa Rwanda Leaders Fellowship, yaberaga i Kigali kuri iki cyumweru tariki 6 Nzeri 2026.

Madamu Jeannete Kagame, yabasabye kumva ko ibyo arimo kubabwira atari ugicira urubanza uwo ari we wese, ahubwo ko bikwiye gufatwa nk’inama n’umwanya wo kwiga no guhugurana, kuko kwiga ari uguhozaho.

Madamu Jeannette Kagame, yabajije niba ibyo byose hari icyuho bishobora kuba byarateye, hakaba haritawe gusa ku bwenge n’ubushobozi ariko nihitabwe ku mwanya wo kubafasha (urubyiruko) gukura mu mico, amarangamutima no mumibanire kandi nabyo bikenewe kugira ngo umuntu abashe kuba umuyobozi mwiza haba murugo cyangwa mu kazi kandi.

Ati “Kuba umuhanga byagufasha kuba indashyikirwa mu kazi ariko iyo bigeze murugo, imibanire yawe n’uwo mwashakanye, uburere uha abana bawe, kurinda ubumwe bw’umuryango mu gihe cy’ibibazo. Ntabwo kugira ubwenge gusa bihagije, hakenewe n’izindi ndangagaciro zubakiye ku Mana, yo mugenga wa byose.”

Madamu Jeannette Kagame, yagaragaje ko ikiragano cy’abayobozi bakiri bato cyagiriwe icyizere, ariko kinajyana n’inshingano zikomeye kurushaho.

Aho yagize ati “Murasabwa kugira imitekerereze, imyumvire n’imyitwarire isobanutse, kubaka no kunoza imibanire, ari nako muhangana n’impinduka zizanwa n’iterambere, ikoranabuhanga, ibibazo by’ubukungu n’ibindi. Niba umuryango uhamye ari wo musingi Igihugu cyubakiraho, inshingano z’iki kiragano, ni ugukomeza uwo musingi duhereye mu ngo zacu, kugira ngo ibyo tuzaraga abana bacu bitazaba ibikomere bazakomeza kwivura, ahubwo bibe urufatiro rukomeye bazubakiraho.”

Uyu muhango ngarukamwaka witabiriwe n’abayobozi batandukanye mu nzego zitadukanye, barimo ab’amadini n’amatorero, abo mu nzego za Leta, abikorera, basangijwe ubuhamya bwa bamwe mu bubatse ingo by’umwihariko izimaranye igihe kinini.

Ni ubuhamya bwatanzwe na Eric Munyemana na Bonita Munyemana bamaranye imyaka 28 mu rushako bakaba bafitanye abana bane n’umwuzukuru

ART-MU8U07DD-TTN9.body:
Tumaze gushakana, mama yaduhaye icyumba mu nzu ye turibanira - Ubuhamya bwa Eric na Bonita

Mu masengesho yagenewe abayobozi bakiri bato azwi nka ‘Young Leaders Prayer Breakfast’, yateguwe n’umuryango wa Rwanda Leaders Fellowship, yabaga kuri iki cyumweru tariki 6 Nzeri 2026, akitabirwa na Madamu Jeannette Kagame, bamwe mu bagize umuryango bagaragaje ko gushyingiranwa bidakwiye kuba ibyishimo gusa, ahubwo bikwiye kuganisha ku butagatifu.

Mu kiganiro cyagarukaga ku bibazo byugarije umuryango muri iki gihe, umuryango wa Eric Munyemana na Bonita Munyemana, bagaragaje kimwe mu bintu by’ingenzi bikwiye kubakirwaho umuryango uyu munsi ari uko abiyemeje kubana babanza kwigishwa neza bagasobanurirwa akamaro k’urugendo bateganya gutangira.

Eric Munyemana na Bonita Mukamana bafitanye abana bane, n’abuzukuru, bavuga ko mu myaka 28 bamaranye, nta kidasanzwe cyabafahije muri urwo rugendo uretse kuzuzanya no kwihanganirana, kuko bari baramaze gutegurwa bihagije.

Ati “Mbere y’uko dushakana amezi make mbere, hari itorero twagiyemo kuko twari twabonye bafitemo gahunda yo gutegura abagiye gushakana, amezi atandatu iyo utayujuje ntibagushyingira ujya gushaka ahandi. Baradutoje baratwigisha badukopeza ku rugendo rw’imbere, bakatubwira bati mu bijyanye n’ubukungu dore uko bigenda, bakaduha ingero zifatika.”

Yungamo ati “Batubwiraga uko dukwiye kwitwara ku bo mu miryango yacu kugira ngo bazatubere umugisha aho kugira ngo tujye tubipfa. Mu bice byose mu kazi, mu mabanga yo mu rugo, ugasanga bimwe ni bishya ntabyo twari tuzi, ariko byaraduteguye n’igihe twahuye nabyo ntabwo byadutunguye kuko bari baraduteguye.”

Abagize uyu muryango bavuga ko amasomo afasha imiryango kubana neza itekanye bidasaba amafaranga cyangwa ibindi bintu byinshi kuko ibyinshi ari ibibakikije, ahubwo ko ari ukubishakira umwanya bigashyirwa mu bikorwa.

Eric Munyemana ati “Kubera kumenya ikintu cy’ingenzi mu rushako, byatumye tudatinda gushakana, kuko tukimara guhugurwa tukabyumva, hari imigambi myinshi twari dufite, tuvuga tuti tuzabanze dushake inzu imeze itya, dushake urugero runaka rw’ubutunzi. Yarigaga nkavuga nti banza urangize kwiga, ariko tumaze kumva icy’ingenzi kijyanye no kubaka ibyo byose byabaye ubusa, ku buryo twakoze ibintu bimeze nk’ubusazi.”.

Yungamo ati “Mu kanya gato, twiyemeje ko tugiye gukora ubukwe kuko iby’ingenzi twabimenye, kandi ndagufite na we uramfite turategereza iki. Bya bindi byose tuzabishakira hamwe kuko babiri baruta umwe, zizaba ari imbaraga zihujwe. Twiyemeza gukora ubukwe, ntabwo twari twiteguye, ku buryo mutakwemera ko twashakanye tudafite inzu, dusaba mama wanjye ngo aducumbikire, twari no munzu na we ntiyari iye.”

Icyo gihe ubukwe bwararangiye bataha ku babyeyi b’umugabo baba ariho baba, bahabwa icyumba, bakomeza kubana n’abandi bagize umuryango, barahacumbikirwa kugeza igihe baboneye ubushobozi bwo kubona inzu yabo, bakimuka.

Ikindi uyu muryango usanga gikwiye gushyirwamo imbaraga ni uburyo bwo gutegura abagiye gushakana, ku buryo imbaraga zishyirwa mu gutegura umukobwa bikorwa no ku muhungu kuko baba bazabana nk’umugore n’umugabo.

Bonita Munyemana, avuga ko yize ko abagabo baremwe kugira ngo barinde umuryango.

Ati “Ni kenshi twahuraga nkamubwira ikintu cyambabaje, agahita ajya gushaka ibisubizo kugira ngo nishime. Ariko nkamubwira nti uretse gato tukabanza tukababarana kuko nababaye, tutarashaka ibisubizo reka na we wumva akababaro nagize. Tugenda tubyigiramo, akajya anyumva ntahite anshakira igisubizo uwo mwanya, ariko yabanje akumva akababaro kanjye.”

Yungamo ati “Uyu mugabo ni umugabo w’Imana nicyo nababwira, icyo mubwiye ahita yihindura akabikora, nanjye mfite amakosa yanjye, ariko ndashima Imana, ndasenga ngo haboneke abagabo bakunda Imana, bubaha Imana, kuko igihe umugabo yakunze Imana, yubaha umugore we, akubaha abana be, akanabarera neza.”

Muri rusange hagaragajwe ko imwe mu miryango ibanye nabi, kuko usanga abayigize batubahana, badashyigikirana, babeshyana ku buryo usanga babanye nk’abaturanyi kuko inshingano z’abagize umuryango ziba zitubahirizwa ngo zikorwe nkuko bikwiye.

Ingaruka zayo makimbirane ni kimwe mu biganisha ku butane busigaye bwugarije imiryango bugenda bwiyongera.

Raporo y’ubucamanza y’umwaka ushize (2025-2026), igaragaza ko mu manza z’imbonezamubano ibirego by’ubutane bikomeza kwiganza, kuko muri uwo mwaka ibirego 6,799 ari byo byagaragaye ku nzego zose z’urukiko, mu gihe ku rwego rwa mbere hari ibirego 5,980 by’imiryango yasabye ubutane.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

content_blocks.text: Tumaze gushakana, mama yaduhaye icyumba mu nzu ye turibanira - Ubuhamya bwa Eric na Bonita

Mu masengesho yagenewe abayobozi bakiri bato azwi nka ‘Young Leaders Prayer Breakfast’, yateguwe n’umuryango wa Rwanda Leaders Fellowship, yabaga kuri iki cyumweru tariki 6 Nzeri 2026, akitabirwa na Madamu Jeannette Kagame, bamwe mu bagize umuryango bagaragaje ko gushyingiranwa bidakwiye kuba ibyishimo gusa, ahubwo bikwiye kuganisha ku butagatifu.

Mu kiganiro cyagarukaga ku bibazo byugarije umuryango muri iki gihe, umuryango wa Eric Munyemana na Bonita Munyemana, bagaragaje kimwe mu bintu by’ingenzi bikwiye kubakirwaho umuryango uyu munsi ari uko abiyemeje kubana babanza kwigishwa neza bagasobanurirwa akamaro k’urugendo bateganya gutangira.

Eric Munyemana na Bonita Mukamana bafitanye abana bane, n’abuzukuru, bavuga ko mu myaka 28 bamaranye, nta kidasanzwe cyabafahije muri urwo rugendo uretse kuzuzanya no kwihanganirana, kuko bari baramaze gutegurwa bihagije.

Ati “Mbere y’uko dushakana amezi make mbere, hari itorero twagiyemo kuko twari twabonye bafitemo gahunda yo gutegura abagiye gushakana, amezi atandatu iyo utayujuje ntibagushyingira ujya gushaka ahandi. Baradutoje baratwigisha badukopeza ku rugendo rw’imbere, bakatubwira bati mu bijyanye n’ubukungu dore uko bigenda, bakaduha ingero zifatika.”

Yungamo ati “Batubwiraga uko dukwiye kwitwara ku bo mu miryango yacu kugira ngo bazatubere umugisha aho kugira ngo tujye tubipfa. Mu bice byose mu kazi, mu mabanga yo mu rugo, ugasanga bimwe ni bishya ntabyo twari tuzi, ariko byaraduteguye n’igihe twahuye nabyo ntabwo byadutunguye kuko bari baraduteguye.”

Abagize uyu muryango bavuga ko amasomo afasha imiryango kubana neza itekanye bidasaba amafaranga cyangwa ibindi bintu byinshi kuko ibyinshi ari ibibakikije, ahubwo ko ari ukubishakira umwanya bigashyirwa mu bikorwa.

Eric Munyemana ati “Kubera kumenya ikintu cy’ingenzi mu rushako, byatumye tudatinda gushakana, kuko tukimara guhugurwa tukabyumva, hari imigambi myinshi twari dufite, tuvuga tuti tuzabanze dushake inzu imeze itya, dushake urugero runaka rw’ubutunzi. Yarigaga nkavuga nti banza urangize kwiga, ariko tumaze kumva icy’ingenzi kijyanye no kubaka ibyo byose byabaye ubusa, ku buryo twakoze ibintu bimeze nk’ubusazi.”.

Yungamo ati “Mu kanya gato, twiyemeje ko tugiye gukora ubukwe kuko iby’ingenzi twabimenye, kandi ndagufite na we uramfite turategereza iki. Bya bindi byose tuzabishakira hamwe kuko babiri baruta umwe, zizaba ari imbaraga zihujwe. Twiyemeza gukora ubukwe, ntabwo twari twiteguye, ku buryo mutakwemera ko twashakanye tudafite inzu, dusaba mama wanjye ngo aducumbikire, twari no munzu na we ntiyari iye.”

Ikindi uyu muryango usanga gikwiye gushyirwamo imbaraga ni uburyo bwo gutegura abagiye gushakana, ku buryo imbaraga zishyirwa mu gutegura umukobwa bikorwa no ku muhungu kuko baba bazabana nk’umugore n’umugabo.
Bonita Munyemana, avuga ko yize ko abagabo baremwe kugira ngo barinde umuryango.

ART-MU8U08GN-2VWG.body:
Imirongo y'inkiko: N'iyo haba nta tegeko rihari uregwa yaburanishwa, agatsindwa, agafungwa

Ubusanzwe, imirongo y'inkiko yashyizweho cyera, ariko mu Rwanda yatangiye gushyirwamo imbaraga mu 2019.

Ubu buryo bwifashishwa aho urukiko mu gufata icyemezo rushobora kugena umurongo uzajya wifashishwa n’izindi nkiko mu gihe zihuye n’ikibazo gisa neza n’icyakiriwe.

Buri kwezi, itsinda rishinzwe gutangaza imirongo yatanzwe n’inkiko riba rifite inshingayo yo kuyikusanyiriza hamwe no kuyimenyekanisha, ariko buri gihembwe rikanamurika icyegeranyo kirimo imirongo yatoranyijwe kugira ngo ifashe abacamanza n’abagana inkiko kumenya uko ibibazo bimwe na bimwe bishobora gukemurwa hakurikijwe imirongo yatanzwe.

Uburyo bwo gukoresha imirongo ni uburyo busanzwe mu Muryango w’Ibihugu bikoresha Ururimi rw’Icyongereza (Commonwealth). Ubwo buryo bugamije gufasha abacamanza mu gukemura ibibazo bisa mu buryo bumwe.

Ubusanzwe umucamanza afite inshingano zo guca urubanza, haba hari itegeko cyangwa ridahari, ryaba ryumvikana cyangwa ritumvikana.

Hari ubwo umucamanza ajya guca urubanza, agasanga itegeko ritumvikana cyangwa ritanariho. Mu nshingano ze akora ubushakashatsi, akaba yashingira ku manza zaciwe n’inkiko zo hanze y’Igihugu, cyangwa ibitabo by’amategeko, noneho igitekerezo akuye mu bushakashatsi bwe, iyo agishyize mu rubanza kiba kibaye umurongo uzayobora izindi nkiko cyangwa se ibindi bibazo bizasuzumwa, bigasubizwa na cya gitekerezo cyangwa na wa murongo watanzwe.

Kubera iki imirongo yagiyeho?

Mu ntego nkuru y’Ubutegetsi bw’Ubucamanza harimo gutanga ubutabera bunoze kandi bwihuse. Kugira ngo iyo ntego igerweho, uburyo bwose bushoboka burakoreshwa. Ubundi mu micire y’imanza hasanzwe hakoreshwa amategeko; bityo, umucamanza mu guca imanza agakoresha itegeko ryanditse. Uburyo bw’imirongo bwaje bwunganira uburyo bwari busanzwe.

Imirongo ntabwo yaje gukuraho amategeko, ahubwo yaje kunganira uburyo bwari busanzwe buhari kugira ngo bifashe abagana inkiko kubona ubutabera bwihuse kandi bunoze.

Akamaro k’imirongo

Imirongo itangwa mu nkiko ifasha mu gutanga ubutabera bumwe ku bibazo bisa, kudahindagurika kw’ibyemezo by’inkiko no kugabanya ibirarane by’imanza (uko imirongo igenda iba myinshi).

Ababuranyi (abavoka n’abashinjacyaha), abacamanza n’abashakashatsi mu nkiko, basabwa kuyisoma no kuyifashisha kugira ngo mu mujyo umwe habeho guteza imbere no gushimangira umuco wo gutanga ibisubizo bimwe ku bibazo bisa.

Kuva imirongo y’inkiko yatangira gukoreshwa, hamaze gufatwa ibyemezo by’inkiko (Urukiko rw’Ikirenga, Urukiko rw’Ubujurire, Urukiko Rukuru n’Urukiko Rukuru rw’Ubucuruzbirenga) 3,300 byatanzwemo imirongo.

ART-MU8U09KP-VA2K.body:
Kwita izina: Dore ibirori bizanira Abanyarwanda ibyamamare bakunda

Kwita Izina bigitangira mu myaka ya mbere, nta byamamare ku rwego mpuzamahanga byari byagatangiye kwitabira, kuko uwo muhango wagombaga kubanza kwamamara ku rwego rw’igihugu, wamara kuba ubukombe inzego zibishinzwe zikabona kuwuratira amahanga, kandi byaje no kugerwaho.

Mu bucukumbuzi twakoze kuri murandasi, hari imyaka tutabashije kubonamo amazina y’abise izina, ariko twabonye imibare y’abana b’ingagi bahawe amazina.

Urugero muri 2005, Kwita Izina bibaye ku nshuro ya mbere abana b’ingagi 23 ni bo bahawe amazina, nk’uko bigaragara ku rubuga rwa murandasi rw’ikigo Volcanoes Rwanda, mu gihe muri 2006 habonetse abana 12.

Mu 2007 ni bwo umuhango watangiye kwitabirwa by’umwihariko n’abayobozi, abaturage baturiye inkengero za pariki y’igihugu y’ibirunga ndetse n’ibigo bikora mu mirimo yo kurengera ibidukikije.

Abayobozi bise abana b’ingagi amazina icyo gihe barimo Monique Nsanzabaganwa icyo gihe wari Umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe Imari n’Igenamigambi, yise umwana w’ingagi Garuka Kaneza, umuherwe mu by’amashyanyarazi Craig Julian n’umukobwa we bise ingagi Mushya, impuguke mu bucyerarugendo bwo muri Afurika Linda Friedman watanze izina Abashyitsi, n’ikigo gicuruza ibikomoka kuri peterori cya Kobil cyatanze izina rya Ntaribi.

Mu 2008, abana b’ingagi bahawe amazina ni 20, muri 2009, Jillian Miller wabaye Umuyobozi w’ikigo kita ku Ngagi (The Gorilla Organization), yise umwana w’ingagi izina rya Uzarama, nk’uko amakuru dukesha icyo kigo abigaragaza.

Muri 2010, umuhango wahuriranye n’Umwaka Mpuzamahanga wa LONI wo kwita ku Ngagi, ariko nta makuru afatika twabashije kubona ku byamamare byitabiriye umuhango. Ni na ko bimeze guhera mu 2011 kugeza mu 2013.

Muri 2014 ni bwo hatangiye kuza ibyamamare bitandukanye nubwo naho nta makuru ahagije ahari, usibye gusa ko mu bitabiriye harimo Umunyakenyakazi usiganwa ku maguru witwa Tegla Loroupe, nk’uko bigaragara ku rubuga rwa African Wildlife Foundation

Mu 2015 ingagi 24 ni zo ziswe amazina n’abayobozi b’ibigo by’ubukerarugendo no ku kurengera ibidukikije ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Bamwe muri bo ni Simon Naylor watanze izina Icyogere, Dr Allan Karlsson wayise Icyifuzo, na Dr Jurie Moolman wayise Urakoze.

Guhera mu 2016, Kwita Izina bigeze ku nshuro ya 11, ni bwo hatangiye kugaragaramo ibyamamare n’abayobozi batandukanye barimo Sir David Attenborough watanze izina Inshungu, izina yise umwana w’ingagi wavutse ku ngagi yari imaze gupfusha undi mwana. Hari na Mary Ann McDonald wise umwana w’ingagi Ntamupaka, Tony Adams wakiniye Arsenal aba na kapiteni w’ikipe y’Ubwongereza, yise umwana w’ingagi Sura’urwanda, mu gihe umuhanzi Ngabo Meddard (Meddy) yamwise izina Inkoramutima, mu gihe itsinda rya Urban Boys ryamwise Ukwiyunga.

Mu 2017, haje Dr Tara Stoinski ukuriye ikigega kitiriwe Dian Fossey, watanze izina rya Macibiri mu rwego rwo kunamira Umunyamerikakazi Dian Fossey Nyiramacibiri witangiye Ingagi zo mu Birunga ahagana mu 1980 akaza kwica na ba rushimusi.

Abandi bantu bakomeye baje Kwita Izina mu 2017 barimo Laurent Lamothe, wabaye Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Haiti, n’umukinnyi wa filimi wo muri Nigerika Patience Ozokwor.

Mu 2018, mu byamamare byaje harimo Laureano Bisan Etamé-Mayer (Lauren/Laureano), wigeze gukinira Arsenal. Umwana w’ingagi yamwise Ikipe. Andi mazina yatanzwe icyo gihe harimo Izahabu, Kunesha, Uburumbuke n’ayandi.

Kwita Izina mu 2018 habonetse abana b’ingagi 21 bahawe amazina n’abayobozi batandukanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga, abakora mu kurengera ibidukikije, abayobozi b’ibigo by’ubucuruzi, abakina imikino itandukanye, n’abanyamuzika barimo itsinda rya Mafikizolo.

Mu 2019, habonetse abana 25 biswe amazina ari nabwo haje abantu b’ibyamamare bo ku rwego rwo hejuru kurusha mu myaka yabanje.

Harimo umuhanzi Ne-Yo watanze izina Biracyaza, Dr Abdul Aziz, uzwi nka the Green Sheikh (Uwihebeye ibidukikije) watanze izina Zahabu. Strive Masiyiwa wise umwana w’ingagi Ishusho, Naomi Campbell wamwise Intarutwa.

Mu bindi byamamare byatanze amazina harimo Tony Adams, Louis van Gaal, na Sherrie Silver, abayobozi ku rwego mpuzamahanga barimo Amina Mohammed, Hailemariam Desalegn, Igikomangoma Basma bint Ali n’abayobozi mu byo kurengera ibidukikije ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

Sherry Silver, we by’umwihariko muri Kanama 2023 yagiye gusura ingagi yise Ibirori.

Mu 2020, icyorezo cya Covid-19 cyazanye impinduka mu Kwita Izina aho byakorwaga n’abakozi bo muri Parike y’Ibirunga, ariko abakinnyi ba Arsenal icyo gihe yari ifite amasezerano ya Visit Rwanda, nabo batanze amazina badahari hifashishijwe itumanaho ry’amashusho.

Harimo Héctor Bellerín watanze izina rya Iriza, Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang na Bernd Leno ariko bo ntabwo amazina batanze twabashije kuyabona.

Muri 2021 nabwo ni ko byagenze, aho Neymar na Kylian Mbappé bise umwana w’ingagi Ingeri. Abandi bana b’ingagi 24 bari bahawe amazina mbere n’abafatanyabikorwa mu mu kurengera ibidukikije, abarinzi ba parike, abakurikirana ubuzima bw’inyamaswa n’abandi.

Kwita Izina mu 2022 nabyo byitabiriwe n’abantu b’ibikomerezwa ku rwego mpuzamahanga, bise abana b’ingagi 20 n’umuryango mushya w’ingagi wari umaze kubaho muri mwaka. Mu bantu bakomeye bise amazina harimo Umukinnyi wa filimi Uzo Aduba wise Ingagi Imararungu, Igikomangoma Charles wa Wales watanze izina Ubwuzuzanye, Didier Drogba ari nawe wari umushyitsi mukuru umwana w’ingagi yamwise Ishami.

Mu bindi byamamare byise amazina mu 2022 harimo abaririmbyi, n’abakinnyi ba filimi bakurikira: Youssou N'Dour, Gilberto Silva, itsinda rya Sauti Sol, Naomi Schiff, na Juan Pablo Sorín.

Mu 2023, Kwita Izina byari bibaye ku nshuro ya 18. Abana b’ingagi bahawe amazina ni 23 mu muhango wagaragayemo ibyamamare byinshi nk’uko bigaragara ku rutonde rwashyizwe ahagaragara na RDB rwiganjemo abakinnyi ba filimi barimo Kevin Hart, Sol Campbell, Bernard Lama, Joakim Noah, Lais Ribeiro, Winston Duke, Idris Elba n’umugore we Sabrina Dhowre Elba batanze izina rya Narame.

Kwita Izina ku nshuro ya 19 mu 2024, abana b’ingagi 40 ni bo bahawe amazina ahari hahuriye ibyamamare birimo Michelle Yeoh Todtm umukinnyi wa filimi wo muri Malaysia watanze izina Rwogere risobanura intego y’u Rwanda yo gukomeza kugira uruhare nyamukuru mu kurengera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima.

content_blocks.text: Kwita izina: Dore ibirori bizanira Abanyarwanda ibyamamare bakunda

Kwita Izina bigitangira mu myaka ya mbere, nta byamamare ku rwego mpuzamahanga byari byagatangiye kwitabira, kuko uwo muhango wagombaga kubanza kwamamara ku rwego rw’igihugu, wamara kuba ubukombe inzego zibishinzwe zikabona kuwuratira amahanga, kandi byaje no kugerwaho.
Mu bucukumbuzi twakoze kuri murandasi, hari imyaka tutabashije kubonamo amazina y’abise izina, ariko twabonye imibare y’abana b’ingagi bahawe amazina.

content_blocks.text: Urugero muri 2005, Kwita Izina bibaye ku nshuro ya mbere abana b’ingagi 23 ni bo bahawe amazina, nk’uko bigaragara ku rubuga rwa murandasi rw’ikigo Volcanoes Rwanda, mu gihe muri 2006 habonetse abana 12.
Mu 2007 ni bwo umuhango watangiye kwitabirwa by’umwihariko n’abayobozi, abaturage baturiye inkengero za pariki y’igihugu y’ibirunga ndetse n’ibigo bikora mu mirimo yo kurengera ibidukikije.

Abayobozi bise abana b’ingagi amazina icyo gihe barimo Monique Nsanzabaganwa icyo gihe wari Umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe Imari n’Igenamigambi, yise umwana w’ingagi Garuka Kaneza, umuherwe mu by’amashyanyarazi Craig Julian n’umukobwa we bise ingagi Mushya, impuguke mu bucyerarugendo bwo muri Afurika Linda Friedman watanze izina Abashyitsi, n’ikigo gicuruza ibikomoka kuri peterori cya Kobil cyatanze izina rya Ntaribi.

Mu 2008, abana b’ingagi bahawe amazina ni 20, muri 2009, Jillian Miller wabaye Umuyobozi w’ikigo kita ku Ngagi (The Gorilla Organization), yise umwana w’ingagi izina rya Uzarama, nk’uko amakuru dukesha icyo kigo abigaragaza.

Muri 2010, umuhango wahuriranye n’Umwaka Mpuzamahanga wa LONI wo kwita ku Ngagi, ariko nta makuru afatika twabashije kubona ku byamamare byitabiriye umuhango. Ni na ko bimeze guhera mu 2011 kugeza mu 2013.

Muri 2014 ni bwo hatangiye kuza ibyamamare bitandukanye nubwo naho nta makuru ahagije ahari, usibye gusa ko mu bitabiriye harimo Umunyakenyakazi usiganwa ku maguru witwa Tegla Loroupe, nk’uko bigaragara ku rubuga rwa African Wildlife Foundation

Mu 2015 ingagi 24 ni zo ziswe amazina n’abayobozi b’ibigo by’ubukerarugendo no ku kurengera ibidukikije ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Bamwe muri bo ni Simon Naylor watanze izina Icyogere, Dr Allan Karlsson wayise Icyifuzo, na Dr Jurie Moolman wayise Urakoze.

ART-MU8U0A4O-PUJF.body:
Perezida Kagame yiteze ko Ishuri Nyafurika ry’Imiyoborere (ASG) rizatanga abayobozi bashoboye gukemura ibibazo by’Afurika

Perezida Paul Kagame yavuze ko yiteze ko Ishuri Nyafurika ry’Imiyoborere (African School of Governance–ASG) riri i Kigali rizagira uruhare mu gutegura abayobozi bafite ubushobozi bwo guhangana n’ibibazo by’Afurika no guteza imbere umugabane.

Kagame yabigarutseho ku wa Mbere tariki ya 24 Kanama 2026, mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru i Kigali, ubwo yabazwaga ku musaruro yiteze kuri iri shuri ryashinzwe kugira mu myaka 5 cyangwa 10 ngo ritange ubumenyi n’ubushobozi bikenewe mu miyoborere y’Afurika.

Perezida Kagame, uri mu bashinze ASG, yavuze ko “Afurika ikeneye abantu bafite ubushobozi bwo kuyobora ibihugu n’inzego zayo, ariko cyane cyane abayobozi bashobora guhindura imikorere bakava ku magambo bakagera ku bikorwa.”

Yagaragaje ko kimwe mu bibazo bikomeye Afurika ifite ari icy’imiyoborere n’ubushobozi buke bwo gushyira mu bikorwa ibyemezo, ashimangira ko ishuri nk’iri rikwiye kugira uruhare mu guhindura iyo miterere.

Yagize ati “ASG ntikwiye kuba ishuri ritanga impamyabumenyi gusa, ahubwo rikwiye kuba ahantu hategurirwa abantu bashobora gutekereza ku bibazo by’Afurika, kubisesengura no kubishakira ibisubizo bijyanye n’imiterere y’umugabane.”

Ni mu gihe iri shuri (ASG) rigiye kwakira kuva kuri uyu wa 25-26 Kanama 2026, i Kigali, ihuriro rya mbere rya “Africa Mindset Reset Forum”, ni ukuvuga inama izibanda ku miyoborere, ubuyobozi no guhindura imyumvire kugira ngo Afurika ibashe kwihitiramo inzira y’iterambere.

Kagame kandi asanga ubumenyi butangwa n’inzego nk’izi bugomba gufasha Afurika kugira abayobozi badategereza ko ibibazo by’umugabane bikemurwa n’abandi, ahubwo bagafata inshingano zo kubishakira ibisubizo.

ASG yatangiriye ibikorwa i Kigali mu rwego rwo kugira uruhare mu kubaka ubushobozi bw’abayobozi b’Afurika, mu gihe ikibazo cy’imiyoborere, imikorere y’inzego n’ubushobozi bwo gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda z’iterambere bikomeje kuba imwe mu ngingo z’ingenzi ku mugabane.

Perezida Kagame yavuze ko umusaruro w’iri shuri uzagaragarira cyane mu bantu rizatanga n’impinduka bazagira mu miyoborere y’ibihugu n’inzego bazakoramo.

Wanditse

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

ART-MU8U0AOB-9U4Z.body:
Inzoka zo mu nda zishobora gutera kanseri

Zimwe mu nzoka zo mu nda (parasites)zitera indwara z’umwijima zibasira abantu benshi ku isi, kandi zituruka ku isuku nkeya, zigahererekanwa mu buryo butagaragara, iyo hatari isuku mu byo abantu barya, ibyo bambara, uko baramukanya bahoberana ntibibuke gukaraba mu ntoki.

Ikibi cy’izo nzoka si indwara ihita ikubita umuntu hasi, ku buryo yahita amenya ko yazanduye nk’uko Dr Menelas Nkeshimana ushinzwe imyigishirize n’iterambere ry’abakozi bo kwa muganga muri Minisiteri y’Ubuzima abisobanura.

Yagize ati, “ Uko izo nzoka zitera indwara z’umwijima twabishyira mu bice bitandukanye. Hari ukubyimbirwa k’umwijima ntihazemo utubyimba (inflammation), hari ukugira utubyimba mu mwijima, inda zikamera nk’udufuka turimo amazi cyangwa kandi byose bitewe n’inzoka. Hari kandi kurwara umwijima bijyanye no kubyimbirwa kw’agasabo k’indurwe,kuko kaba neza munsi y’umwijima. Umwijima uba ufite imiyoboro ijya mu gasabo k’indurwe, aho indurwe igenda ikikusanya muri ako gasabo, hanyuma ikaza kuvamo ijya mu mara gufasha mu igogora, no kunyunyuza intungamubiri mu byo umuntu aba yariye”.

“ Inzoka zo mu nda rero zishobora gutuma ako gasabo k’indurwe nako kabyimbirwa, ntikabe kagikora umurimo wako. Iyo kabyimbiwe, indurwe ishobora kwireka, hanyuma igahindukamo utubuye, n’iyo mpamvu habaho abantu barwara utubuye two mu mwijima. Noneho hari n’impindura (Pancreas) nayo ikora ibintu bifasha mu igogora. Iyo umwijima wagize ikibazo, utubuye tuva muri ka gasabo k’indurwe tugahubuka tukaziba imiyoboro inyuramo ibyo impindura ikora, icyo gihe impindura nayo irabyimbirwa kuko izo zose ni inyama zegeranye. Kandi ibyo bibazo byose bishobora guterwa n’inzoka zo mu nda”.

Ikindi ni uko igogora ritaba rikigenda neza kuko indurwe n’ibindi bikorwa n’impindura bitaba bigishobora gukora akazi kabyo uko bikwiye.

Amatsinda ane y’inzoka zikunze kwangiza umwijima nk’uko Dr Nkeshimana yabisobanuye, harimo itsinda ry’inzoka ryitwa ‘Cestodes’ iryo rikaba ribonekamo inzoka yitwa ‘echinococcus granulosis’ ikunze gutera uburwayi bw’umwijima urimo ibibyimba.

Dr Nkeshimana ati, “ Indwara y’umwijima iterwa n’iyo nzoka, iboneka gacyeya, nkanjye mu myaka 42 maze kuyibonana abantu 3 gusa, harimo babiri mu Rwanda n’umwe mu Bushinwa. Ni indwara iboneka gacyeya ariko iyo itavuwe, 92% by’abayirwaye barapfa. Kwa muganga, ibyo bibyimba babivanamo ari uko babaze umurwayi, kandi bakitwararika cyane ku buryo babiteruramo neza, ntibimeneke, kuko iyo bishwanyutse, aho bishwanyukiye naho hamera ibibyimba. Ni ubuvuzi bukorwa n’abahanga, ntabwo ari buri wese wabukora.Iyo ndwara , iyo ivuwe neza irakira, ubundi hagakurikiraho kwita ku isuku cyane, gutandukanya abantu n’imbwa, kuko izo nzoka zikunze kuba mu mbwa. Abatunze imbwa bakazivuza inzoka uko bikwiye, zigakingirwa kugira ngo zidakomeza kwanduza ba nyirazo”.

Itsinda rya kabiri ry’inzoka zangiza umwijima ryitwa ‘Terematodes’ muri iryo tsinda harimo inzoka ebyiri zitwa ‘Clonorchis sinensis’ na ‘Schistosoma’, iyo nzoka ya Clonorchis ngo ni mbi cyane kuko yo ishobora gutera kanseri aho indurwe inyura, ni ukuvuga mu miyoboro y’udusabo tw’indurwe iva mu mwijima. Bitangira iteramo kubyimbirwa, hanyuma uko kubyimbirwa kukaba gushobora kuvamo kanseri.

Itsinda rya gatatu ry’izo nzoka ziteza ibibazo mu mwijima, ni izitwa ‘Nematodes’. Muri iryo tsinda harimo izitwa ‘Strongyloides stercolaris’ ndetse na ‘Ascaris Lumbricoides’. Izo ascaris ni inzoka zizwi cyane, cyangwa se zizwi na bose. Amagi y’izo ascaris ngo hari ubwo atemba ava mu mara, akaba yagera no mu miyoboro y’udusabo tw’indurwe.Ubwo inzoka ikagenda igakuriramo ikaba nini ikazibya ya nzira ya nzira y’indurwe. Nyamara izo nzoka za ‘ascaris’ ubusanzwe ngo ni indwara zivurwa zigakira, iyo zikiri nkeya, abantu bagahabwa imiti yazo, abana bagahabwa imiti yazo buri mezi atandatu, isuku y’ibyo kurya ikitwabo.

Dr Nkeshimana ati, “ Nabonye umurwayi cyera mu 2012-2013 ndi mu Bitaro bya CHUB, yari umukobwa wari ufite imyaka 18. Inzoka iragenda ijya ahongaho mu muyoboro w’agasabo k’indurwe, irahazibya. Umwana yahise agira ikibazo cy’umwijima, ararwara arapfa. Nta buryo bwari buhari bwo kuyivanamo, keretse iyo biza kuba amahirwe ikimanura ikivanamo, igasubira mu mara. Naho ubundi icyo gihe byasabaga ko indurwe ishakirwa indi nzira yanyuramo kuko iyo yafunze, kandi icyo gihe nta bushobozi bwari buhari. Ariko ubungubu hari iterambere mu buvuzi bw'u Rwanda,hari uburyo umurwayi wagira icyo kibazo yafashwa."

“ Ubwo hari uwo wapfuye. Hari n’undi mwana wari ufite imyaka irindwi, yaragiye agira ascaris zirakura, zirashisha, akada karabyimba, babyita ibintu bisanzwe, kuko urabona abana bo mu cyaro iyo bafite utuda, abantu bumva ari ibisanzwe, bakavuga bati’ ku musozi wose abana baradufite utuda ni twiza ntacyo dutwaye, kandi umwana arya neza nta kibazo. Icyo gihe inzoka zaragiye zifunga amara, bamuzana kwa muganga yagize ikibazo, bafunguye amara, bamukuyemo ibiro birenga batatu (3) by’inzoka zikiri nzima. Ibiro 3 by’inzoka ku mwana w’imyaka 7, biba bivuze ko ari isuku nkeya y’igihe kirekire, no kudafata imiti y’inzoka kandi ni uburangare bw’ababyeyi.Kandi iyo inzoka zabaye nyinshi zikagera aho, ntaho zitagera, bivuze ko no mu mwijima we zashoboraga kugeramo”.

Dr Nkeshimana avuga ko ikintu gikenewe cyane cyane, ari uko abantu bajya bakangukira kwivuza, umuntu akemenya niba afite inzoka mu nda akazivuza zigakira, ariko zaba zaranarengeranye, akajya ku ivuriro rifite ubushobozi bwo kumufasha. Yemeza ko ikibazo cyo kudatanga umusarani kwa muganga mu gihe umuntu yagiye kwivuza, gikunze kugirwa n’abantu bo mu mijyi, kuko bagenda bakagura ibinini batazi n’inzoka barwaye izo ari zo, mu gihe mu cyaro bo bemera gutanga umusarani kwa muganga bakivuza neza.

Itsinda rya kane ry’inzoka ziteza ibibazo umwijima, ni iryitwa ‘protozoan’, harimo inzoka abantu bose bazi yitwa ‘Entamoeba histolytica’ cyangwa se ‘amibe’, abantu benshi ngo bazi ko iba mu mara, igatera impiswi rimwe na rimwe irimo n’amaraso,ariko abenshi ngo ntibazi ko amibe nayo ishobora gutera ikibyimba cy’amashyira mu mwijima.

Dr Nkeshimana ati, “ Biraba amibe igatera ikibyimba cy’amashyira mu mwijima, bashobora kuvuza imiti yitwa ‘fragiles’ ariko yo mu mitsi kandi igakoreshwa igihe kirekire. Icyo kibyimba kiba gishobora kwikamura mu gihe umurwayi arimo aterwa imiti, ariko iyo bigaragara ko gishobora guturika, nabwo barakibaga”.

Mu nama Dr Nkeshimana, agira abantu mu rwego rwo kwirinda inzoka zo mu nda ndetse n’ibibazo zitera mu mwijima, ni ukwita ku isuku y’ibiribwa n’ibinyobwa, kwirinda kujya koga mu mazi y’ibiziba cyangwa ibiyaga.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0B7T-7DTU.body:
Ubonye FARDC aba abonye FDLR

Bavuga ko bitewe n’uburyo uwo mutwe w’iterabwoba wamaze kwivanga n’ingabo z’Igihugu (FARDC) hamwe na Wazalendo, atari kenshi bishoboka ko hari agace ushobora kubaburamo, cyane ko ari bo bafatwa nk’indwanyi kandi zifite igisirikare gikomeye ugereranyi na bagenzi babo (FARDC na Wazalendo).

Maj (Rtd), Anastase Makuza uzwi nka Mbaga muri FDLR, wari ushinzwe itumanaho rya gisirikare no gukwirakwiza ingengabitekerezo ishingiye kuri Jenoside n’ishingiye ku buhanuzi buhimbano. Ni umwe mu mu bafashe icyemezo cyo kwitandukanya n’uwo mutwe, agataha mu Rwanda kugira ngo afatanye n’abandi kurwubaka.

Avuga ko bigoye kuba umuntu yavuga agace runaka agahamya ko ari ko FDLR ibamo gusa.

Ati “Ubu ngubu hari abari za Masisi, za Walikale ahitwa Pinga, Pinga buriya hari n’ikibuga cy’indege zizana ibikoresho. Hari abari ahitwa za Rwibo, Lukweti, bari henshi. Ni ukuvuga ngo wumve neza ko aho FARDC iri, wumve ko FDLR ihari, Wazalendo nibavuga ngo iri hariya, uzamenye ko FDLR ihari."

Rumwe mu rugero Mbaga atanga, ni urw’abasirikare bagiye kwigishwa gukoresha utudege tutagira abapilote (Drones), i Kinshasa.

Ati “Buriya bagiye bayobowe n’umu-FDLR w’umusuriyotona (Sous-lieutenant), witwa Remy, ni jye wamwigishije, kuko nubwo nari nshinzwe iby’amaradiyo ariko najyaga kwigisha no muri SM. Naramwigishije ndamuzi, ni umwana ukiri muto. Ni we wagiye ayoboye iryo tsinda, n’abandi ba FDLR barimo.”

Yungamo ati “Mbere y’uko njya mu by’amaradiyo nabaye umwarimu muri SM ahitwa i Gikoma muri Masisi, ishuri rya SM, naryigishijemo. Buriya mu bize mu 2009 nigishijemo Abanyekongo bavuga i Gihutu 27, muri kwa kubiyegereza no gufatanya. Urumva ko byatangiye cyera ntabwo ari ubu gusa. Bose basohotse ari ba Ofisiye, bazanywe n’uwitwa Bigembe, ni umwami w’iyo ngiyo muri Masisi ahitwa za Gatoyi. Ku kubwira ngo FDLR Perezidanse iba hehe, batayo (Battalion) cyangwa inite (unity), biragoye.”

Lt Col (Rtd) Idrissa Bizimana wari uzwi nka Idrissa Kanzamuradadi muri FDLR, wayoboraga batayo ya 2 ikorera muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo, akaba yarigeze kuba umuyobozi ushinzwe icengezamatwara, Politike na Purotokole mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu, avuga ko uretse ko FDLR yaranywanye na Leta ya RDC ari n’iy’u Burundi ari uko kuko yagize uruhare rufatika kugira ngo abayobozi bariho bafate ubutegetsi.

Ati “U Burundi nyuma y’urupfu rwa Ndadaye, Abarundi bahungiye mu Rwanda benshi, icyo gihe hari abo twigishije igisirikare, noneho duhunze na bo turahungana, abandi baza gusubirayo bashinga icyama cya Nyangoma. Ni twe twagiye kubigisha, ya ngengabitekerezo abo ngabo twigishije ni bo bakomeje baba inyeshyamba ziza gufa Igihugu mu buryo bw’imishyikirano akaba ari zo ziri ku buyobozi. FDLR n’u Burundi uyu munsi ni cira aha nikubite. Ntabwo u Burundi bushobora kwitandukanya na FDLR nkuko RDC nayo bimeze.”

Aba n’abandi bagenzi babo bitandukanyije na FDLR, bavuga ko uwo mutwe w’iterabwoba ufite izindi mbaraga ukomora hirya no hino by’umwihariko mu bihugu bikikije RDC, bahora bakusanya inkunga yo kubohereza bitewe n’uko bahuzwa n’ingengabiterezo y’ivangura rishingiye ku bwoko.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

Lt Col (Rtd) Idrissa Bizimana wari uzwi nka Idrissa Kanzamuradadi muri FDLR, wayoboraga batayo ya 2 ikorera muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo, akaba yarigeze kuba umuyobozi ushinzwe icengezamatwara, Politike na Purotokole mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu, avuga ko uretse ko FDLR yaranywanye na Leta ya RDC ari n’iy’u Burundi ari uko kuko yagize uruhare rufatika kugira ngo abayobozi bariho bafate ubutegetsi.

Ati “U Burundi nyuma y’urupfu rwa Ndadaye, Abarundi bahungiye mu Rwanda benshi, icyo gihe hari abo twigishije igisirikare, noneho duhunze na bo turahungana, abandi baza gusubirayo bashinga icyama cya Nyangoma. Ni twe twagiye kubigisha, ya ngengabitekerezo abo ngabo twigishije ni bo bakomeje baba inyeshyamba ziza gufa Igihugu mu buryo bw’imishyikirano akaba ari zo ziri ku buyobozi. FDLR n’u Burundi uyu munsi ni cira aha nikubite. Ntabwo u Burundi bushobora kwitandukanya na FDLR nkuko RDC nayo bimeze.”

Aba n’abandi bagenzi babo bitandukanyije na FDLR, bavuga ko uwo mutwe w’iterabwoba ufite izindi mbaraga ukomora hirya no hino by’umwihariko mu bihugu bikikije RDC, bahora bakusanya inkunga yo kubohereza bitewe n’uko bahuzwa n’ingengabiterezo y’ivangura rishingiye ku bwoko.
Wanditse
Tarib Abdul
Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0CAK-3VQ3.body:
Bill Gates araburira isi ko AI ishobora gutuma abagizi ba nabi barushaho koreka imbaraga

Mu gihe isi yitegura inyungu z’ubwenge buhangano (AI), umunyemari Bill Gates avuga ko hakenewe no gutekerezwa ku ngaruka z’umutekano zishobora guterwa n’iri koranabuhanga. Ku bwe, AI ishobora guha abantu basanzwe bafite ubushobozi buke uburyo bwo gukora ibikorwa byangiza abantu ku rugero rutigeze rubaho.

Gates avuga ko mbere y’uko AI imenyekana cyane, amakuru ajyanye no gukora ibisasu, ibikoresho byangiza ndetse n’ibitero by’ikoranabuhanga yari asanzwe aboneka kuri internet. Ariko AI ishobora gutuma kubona ayo makuru no kuyashyira mu bikorwa birushaho kuba byoroshye.

Kimwe mu bibazo avuga ko abantu bazahura na byo cyane mu buzima bwa buri munsi ni uburiganya bukoresheje AI, amakuru y’ibinyoma, amashusho cyangwa amajwi y’impimbano, ndetse no gukurikiranwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga.

Agira ati "Abagizi ba nabi bashobora gukoresha AI kugira ngo bibasire abantu ku giti cyabo, ibigo ndetse na za guverinoma."

Gates kandi agaragaza impungenge zikomeye ku mutekano w’ikoranabuhanga.

Bill Gates ati "AI ishobora gufasha inzobere kubona amakosa ari muri porogaramu no kuyakosora, ariko ishobora no kuba uburyo bushobora gukoreshwa n’abagizi ba nabi kugira ngo babone intege nke za sisitemu kandi bazibasire."

Avuga ko ibigo bikomeye nka za banki, ibitaro, amashanyarazi, uburyo bwo gutanga amazi ndetse na serivisi za Leta bishobora kuba mu byibasirwa.

Ati "Iyo sisitemu nk’izi zibasiwe, ingaruka ntizigera ku bayobozi bazo gusa, ahubwo zigera ku barwayi, abakiriya n’abaturage bakeneye serivisi."

Gates anagaragaza impungenge ku ikoreshwa rya AI mu by’intwaro ndetse no mu bikorwa by’ubugizi bwa nabi bikomeye. Avuga ko uko AI igenda irushaho kugira ubushobozi, hakenewe amategeko n’ubufatanye mpuzamahanga byo gukumira ikoreshwa ryayo mu bikorwa byangiza abantu.

Ikindi kibazo avuga ni uko AI ishobora gutuma abantu batakaza ubushobozi bwo gutandukanya ukuri n’ibinyoma. Mu gihe amashusho, amajwi n’amakuru bishobora gukorwa mu buryo bwemeza abantu, ubushobozi bwo gutekereza no kugenzura amakuru buzaba ingenzi kurushaho.

Gates asanga nta gihugu kizashobora gukemura ibi bibazo cyonyine. Hakenewe uburyo bwo gufatanya ku rwego mpuzamahanga, gushyiraho amabwiriza no kwitegura mbere y’uko ibibazo bikomeye bitangira.

ART-MU8U0CTX-RVJB.body:
Ni cyo gitaramo cya mbere gikomeye tugiye gukora mu Rwanda – Ambassadors of Christ Choir

Korali Ambassadors of Christ iri mu zikunzwe cyane mu Rwanda no mu Karere, ikomeje imyiteguro y’igitaramo cyo kwizihiza imyaka 30 imaze mu murimo w’Imana.Iyi Korali irararikira abantu kuzitabira icyo gitaramo, kuko kizaba gitandukanye n’ibindi yakoreye hirya no hino mu Rwanda mu myaka yose imaze ibayeho.

Umuyobozi (Chairman) wa Ambassadors of Christ Choir, Muvunyi Reuben, yavuze ko iyi korali yatangiye umurimo w’Imana mu 1995, ubwo u Rwanda rwari ruvuye mu bihe bikomeye bya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ndetse na yo inyura mu bihe byayiciye intege birimo impanuka ebyiri zahitanye bamwe mu bayigize, ariko Imana ikomeza kubaba hafi mu murimo wayo.

Muvunyi yagize ati “Hari hakiri ibikomere byinshi, Igihugu cyari kidafite ibyiringiro, abantu bababaye cyane, insengero bari barazicitsemo kubera ibyazibereyemo. Rero twahisemo kuririmba kugira ngo bibe inzira yo kugera ku bantu batari bagisenga, batinyaga kujya mu nsengero kandi badafite ibyiringiro, kugira ngo bongere bagire ibyiringiro.”

Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru cyavugaga kuri iki gitaramo barimo gutegura cyo kwizihiza imyaka 30 bamaze mu murimo w’Imana, Muvunyi yakomeje asobanura icyo iyi myaka 30 ivuze kuri bo. Yagize ati “Ni urugendo rurerure cyane. Imyaka 30 ntabwo ari ikintu cyoroshye. Muri iyo myaka twagendanye n’Imana, twabonye ukuboko kw’Imana, twabonye ibitangaza by’Imana, twabonye abantu bakizwa bava mu byaha, twabonye Igihugu kiva mu icuraburindi, tukaba tugeze ahangaha turi Igihugu gifite ibyiringiro, Igihugu cyabaye icyitegererezo ku buryo n’amahanga yose aza kucyigiraho. Iyi myaka 30 twebwe nka Korali twayiboneyemo ibintu byinshi, ibibi n’ibyiza, ariko ikintu twishimira cyane ni uko Imana yabanye natwe, ikemera ko tuyikorera nubwo tutari beza, ariko idutera imbaraga idukoresha umurimo wayo.”

“Turimo gutegura igitaramo tariki 30/08/2026 kugira ngo tuzabamurikire ibyiza twagezeho muri iyi myaka 30, uburyo Imana yabanye natwe, uburyo Imana yabaye indahemuka, uburyo Imana yigaragaje mu murimo twakoranye na yo muri iyi myaka 30.”

“Ni cyo gitaramo cya mbere gikomeye tugiye gukora muri iki Gihugu. Twakoze ibitaramo byinshi cyane mu Rwanda no mu mahanga. Turashimira Imana n’Igihugu n’abantu beza badufashije muri uru rugendo, kugira ngo dushobore guhagarara neza mu murimo w’Imana, dushobore kugera ku mitima ya benshi, dushobore kuba korali ikunzwe kandi y’icyitegererezo.”

Manzi Nelson, Umuyobozi Wungirije wa Ambassadors of Christ Choir, agaragaza ko imyiteguro imeze neza, akizeza abazitabira iki gitaramo ko bazanyurwa n’imigendekere myiza yacyo.

Ssozi Joram usanzwe ari Umunya-Uganda ariko akaba ari we uhimba indirimbo zose za Ambassadors of Christ Choir kuva mu 1997, avuga ko nubwo ari we wandika indirimbo z’iyo korali kuva mu 1997, Imana ari yo ibimushoboza, ndetse bigahura n’intero y’Igitaramo cyabo igira iti “Uwiteka ni we wanditse amateka yacu.”

Iki gitaramo kizabera mu nyubako ya BK Arena mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ariko abari mu mahanga bakazabasha kugikurikira mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga. Ushaka kugura itike yo kwinjira muri iki gitaramo anyura kuri ticket.rw cyangwa kuri *513*1*1#.

ART-MU8U0DWT-ME1B.title: Umusore uhembwa Rwf 300,000? Ashatse kuzigamira ubukwe byamusaba imyaka icumi
ART-MU8U0DWT-ME1B.subtitle: Umusore uhembwa Rwf 300,000?
ART-MU8U0DWT-ME1B.summary: Umusore uhembwa Rwf 300,000? Ashatse kuzigamira ubukwe byamusaba imyaka icumi Iby’ingenzi byari gusaba, gukwa, guhuza imiryango no guha abageni umugisha. Inka ni yo yari ikimenyetso gikomeye cy’ubukwe kandi yari ingenzi mu gutanga inkwano, mu gihe mu Rwanda rw’ubu amafaranga ari yo ayoboye.
ART-MU8U0DWT-ME1B.body:
Umusore uhembwa Rwf 300,000? Ashatse kuzigamira ubukwe byamusaba imyaka icumi

Iby’ingenzi byari gusaba, gukwa, guhuza imiryango no guha abageni umugisha. Inka ni yo yari ikimenyetso gikomeye cy’ubukwe kandi yari ingenzi mu gutanga inkwano, mu gihe mu Rwanda rw’ubu amafaranga ari yo ayoboye.

Cyera kandi ibirori byinshi byaberega mu rugo, aho kugira ngo hakodeshwe Salle, Ubusitani cyangwa hotel. Habaga gusaba no gukwa, ubundi bakagira ibirori by’umuryango n’abaturanyi.

Imihango gakondo yagiye ihinduka uko imyaka yagiye ihita, nubwo gusaba no gukwa byakomeje kuba igice cy’ingenzi cy’umuco w’ubukwe bw’Abanyarwanda.

Muri iki gihe, ubukwe bwinshi bushobora kuba uruhererekane rw’ibikorwa birimo gusaba, gushyingirwa imbere y’amategeko, umuhango w’idini, kwakira abatumiwe no gutwikurura. Hari ababihuriza ku munsi umwe, abandi bakabigabanya mu minsi itandukanye.

Ikindi cyahindutse cyane ni aho ubukwe bubera, kuko mu gihe cyera imihango myinshi yaberaga mu rugo, uyu munsi abenshi bakodesha Salle, Hotel cyangwa ahandi hantu habugenewe. Ibi byongereye cyane amafaranga agenda mu bukwe.

Iyo urebye ubukwe busanzwe butegurwa i Kigali cyangwa mu mijyi minini y’u Rwanda, usanga ingengo y’imari ishobora gutandukana cyane bitewe n’umubare w’abatumirwa, aho ubukwe bubera, urugero rw’imitako, imyambaro n’ibindi.

Ariko akenshi usanga ikigero cy’ingengo y’imari ishobora kubarirwa hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni 8–15 mu bukwe buringaniye, mu gihe ubwitwa ko bworoheje bushobora gukoresha ingengo y’imari iri hagati ya miliyoni 3–6Frw.

Hamwe muho amafaranga menshi yo mu bukwe agenda harimo imihango yo gusaba no gukwa, aho amafaranga akoreshwa mu bijyanye n’ibyo imiryango yumvikanyeho, birimo impano, ibyo kurya n’ibinyobwa, gutwara abashyitsi n’ibindi bikorwa bijyana no gusaba. Ingengo y’imari y’iki gikorwa ishobora kubarirwa hafi 15–25% y’amafaranga yose akoreshwa mu bukwe, bitewe n’imiterere yabwo.

Salle cyangwa aho kwakirira abashyitsi, ni kimwe mu bintu bitwara amafaranga menshi. Harimo gukodesha salle, ameza, intebe, imyenda y’ameza, serivisi z’abakozi, isuku n’ibindi, aho nk’ubukwe bw’abantu 120 i Kigali, ibyo byose bishobora gutwara abarirwa muri miliyoni 5.4Frw kuri Salle, imitegurire yaho kwakirira abashyitsi (decoration) na serivisi zihatangirwa.

Ese umusore urangije Kaminuza cyangwa andi mashuri makuru ufite akazi kamuhemba amafaranga y’u Rwanda ari hagati y’ibihumbi 200 Frw na 300 Frw, ashobora kubona ubushobozi bumwemerera gushaka umugore akoze ubukwe?

Steven Byukusenge, uheruka gukora ubukwe buringaniye mu ntangiriro z’uku kwezi (Kanama 2026), yatubwiye ko bigoye kuba uwo musore ashobora kwishoboza gukora ubukwe bw’uyu munsi kubera ko buhenze cyane.

Yagize ati “Ubukwe burahenze bitewe n’ibintu bitandukanye biba bibugize, guhera ku myiteguro, gushaka aho bazakorera ubwo bukwe, ibyo kunywa, kurya, n’imyambaro, navuga ko umuntu uhembwa amafaranga nk’ayo akavuga ngo niteguye gukora ubukwe, adafite bimwe bavuga ngo ni umuryango, inshuti n’abavandimwe bashobora kubimufashamo, byagorana kuko ubukwe bw’uyu munsi burasaba kubufatira igihe kitari munsi nibura y’imyaka itatu, ubutegura kuko burahenze cyane muri iyi minsi.”

content_blocks.text: Umusore uhembwa Rwf 300,000? Ashatse kuzigamira ubukwe byamusaba imyaka icumi

Iby’ingenzi byari gusaba, gukwa, guhuza imiryango no guha abageni umugisha. Inka ni yo yari ikimenyetso gikomeye cy’ubukwe kandi yari ingenzi mu gutanga inkwano, mu gihe mu Rwanda rw’ubu amafaranga ari yo ayoboye.
Cyera kandi ibirori byinshi byaberega mu rugo, aho kugira ngo hakodeshwe Salle, Ubusitani cyangwa hotel. Habaga gusaba no gukwa, ubundi bakagira ibirori by’umuryango n’abaturanyi.
Imihango gakondo yagiye ihinduka uko imyaka yagiye ihita, nubwo gusaba no gukwa byakomeje kuba igice cy’ingenzi cy’umuco w’ubukwe bw’Abanyarwanda.

Muri iki gihe, ubukwe bwinshi bushobora kuba uruhererekane rw’ibikorwa birimo gusaba, gushyingirwa imbere y’amategeko, umuhango w’idini, kwakira abatumiwe no gutwikurura. Hari ababihuriza ku munsi umwe, abandi bakabigabanya mu minsi itandukanye.

Ikindi cyahindutse cyane ni aho ubukwe bubera, kuko mu gihe cyera imihango myinshi yaberaga mu rugo, uyu munsi abenshi bakodesha Salle, Hotel cyangwa ahandi hantu habugenewe. Ibi byongereye cyane amafaranga agenda mu bukwe.

ART-MU8U0EH7-V074.body:
Uburiganya mu kwishyurana hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga bwagabanutseho hafi 30%

Umubare w’imanza z’uburiganya bujyanye n’imikoreshereze y’ikoranabuhanga mu rwego rw’imari mu Rwanda wagabanutseho hafi 30% mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya 2026, nubwo ikoreshwa ry’ubwishyu bw’ikoranabuhanga rikomeje kwaguka.

Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru, kuri uyu wa 27 Kanama 2026, Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda (BNR), yagaragaje ko imanza z’uburiganya zagabanutse zikava ku manza 4,128 mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya 2025, zikagera ku manza 2,879 mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya 2026.

Ibi bivuze ko habayeho igabanuka ry’imanza 1,249, bingana hafi na 30.3% mu gihe cy’umwaka umwe.

BNR yavuze ko n’agaciro k’amafaranga yatakajwe muri ubwo buriganya kagabanutse, kava kuri miliyoni 637Frw mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya 2025, kagera kuri miliyoni 471Frw mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya 2026, ni ukuvuga igabanuka rya hafi 26%.

Iri gabanuka ry’uburiganya rije mu gihe Abanyarwanda n’ibigo bakomeje kwitabira uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga mu kwishyurana.

BNR yagaragaje ko agaciro k’ubwishyu bwo mu rwego rwo kwishyurana (mu bucuruzi) mu mezi atandatu ya mbere ya 2026 kageze kuri tiriyari 27.8 Frw, kavuye kuri tiriyari 20.4Frw mu gihe nk’iki cya 2025.

Muri icyo gihe kandi, agaciro k’ubwishyu bw’ikoranabuhanga ugereranyije n’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu (GDP) karazamutse kagera kuri 341% kavuye kuri 321% mu mezi atandatu ya mbere ya 2025.

BNR ivuga ko nubwo guhererekanya amafaranga mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga (digitalization) bikomeje kwaguka, uburiganya bukiri kimwe mu byago bikomeye bishobora guhungabanya ibikorwa by’ibigo by’imari.

Iri gabanuka ry’umubare w’imanza n’agaciro k’amafaranga yagiye muri ubwo buriganya rishobora kuba ikimenyetso cy’uburyo ingamba zo kurinda abakoresha serivisi z’imari n’ubwishyu bw’ikoranabuhanga zikomeje kugira akamaro.

BNR ariko ikomeza kwibutsa ko “kwaguka kw’ikoranabuhanga mu rwego rw’imari kugomba kujyana no gukomeza kongera umutekano w’ubwishyu, kurinda abakoresha serivisi no kubaka icyizere muri serivisi z’imari zishingiye ku ikoranabuhanga.”

Wanditse

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

ART-MU8U0F0Z-N433.body:
Kubona abana bigishwa iby'Ubwongereza kandi bazayobora Afurika---Prof Lumumba yarumiwe

Prof. Lumumba umunyamategeko ukomoka muri Kenya, akaba n’umuhanga mu mateka y’Afurika, wari mu kiganiro mu nama mpuzamahanga yateguwe n’ishuri Nyafurika ryigisha imiyoborere, yavuze ko atemeranya n’abavuga ko guhindura imyumvira ari byo byonyine bizagena uko Afurika izamera mu bihe biri imbere. Kuko we ngo areba Afurika nk’uko imeze uyu munsi.

Yagize ati,” Reka mbabwire nihuse uko Afurika ihagaze uyu munsi, ubu tuvugana hari intambara zitari munsi ya 16 hirya no hino muri Afurika, ubu ndimo mvuga, hafi 50% by’Abanyafurika barahura n’ikibazo cy’inzara, hazaba inama hano zivuga ku biribwa,havugwe ibintu byinshi byiza,ariko ntaho bizaba bihuriye n’ibibazo birimo kubera muri Sudani y’Epfo. Bizaba ari ibintu byo kuvuga gusa. Wenda bishobora kuzitwa ibyavuye mu nama ya Kigali,bisigare aho, hanyuma twongere duhure tugire ibyavuye mu nama ya Accra. Mwavuze ibya gahunda y’icyerekezo cya 2063, ntabwo ari ikintu gishya, ahubwo ni izina rishya ry’igenamigambi ryakorewe i Lagos mu 1980…”.

Prof Lumumba avuga ko guhindura imyumvire bijyana no kubanza kumenya ikibazo gihari, nubwo ibintu byihuta cyane ubu hakaba harimo kuvugwa iby’ubwenge buhangano n’ibindi byinshi. Mu 1957, Abanyafurika ngo bavugaga ko ikibazo gihari ari uburezi budahagije, ko ari ubujiji, ubukene, indwara. Ariko ubu ngo ibabizo bihari ni ibindi.

Yagarutse ku kibazo cy’uko havugwa ibyo kugira uburezi buhuriweho mu bihugu byose bigize umuryango wa Afurika y’u Burasirazuba ( Kenya, u Rwanda, Uganda, Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo, Somalia, u Burundi, Tanzania ndetse na Sudani y’Epfo) ariko wareba porogaramu zigishwa muri ibyo bihugu ugasanga zihabanye cyane nk’uko Amajyepfo aba atandukanye n’Amajyaruguru. Bivuze ko bikigoye cyane guhuza uburezi muri ibyo bihugu ubwabyo, kandi byarangira, ngo abantu bakavuga ko bashaka gukemura ibibazo by’Afurika.

Yakomeje avuga ko hari ikibazo kindi kigoye, cyo kuba hari urubyiruko rujya kwiga muri za porogaramu z’uburezi zateguwe n’Ubwongereza, abandi bakiga muri porogaramu zateguwe n’u Bufaransa, hanyuma bakazagaruka, bakaba abayobozi muri Afurika. Ikibazo kiba gihari, ngo ni uko bagaruka bafite amazu yabo muri za Paris n’ahandi, ndetse basigaye babona ko aho bize ari iwabo, bikarangira bakorera Afurika nk’ahantu ho gushakira umuhigo (hunting place) ariko bawubona bakisubirira mu ibyo bihugu bita iwabo. Yagize ati, “ Icyo cyerekezo muvuga cya 2063, icyo gihe ½ cy’abari hano bazaba barapfuye, abazaba bakiriho nabo bazaba bafite intege nkeya, ku buryo ntacyo bazaba bakimaze yaba kuri bo ubwabo cyangwa se ku Mugabane, ni yo mpamvu ari byiza guhereza inkoni abakiri bato, bigakorwa ubu”.

Prof. Lumumba yatanze icyifuzo cy’uko ibivugirwa mu nama nk’iyi ya ASG, habaho itsinda rishinzwe kubikurikirana no kubiha ibisobanuro na nyuma y’uko inama irangiye. Kuko ari bwo bigira akamaro.

Yagize ati, “ Ntimugasabe abantu kuba beza no gukora neza, ahubwo mwebwe ubwanyu nimube beza, mukore byiza. Hari ibigo bine bigenewe kwigisha Abanyafurika bakiri bato (Pan African Institute), harimo ikiri muri Nairobi(Kenya), Addis-Abeba( Ethiopia), muri Liberia, ndetse no muri Zambia. Mu yandi magambo, bivuze ko turimo tugerageza guhindura imyumvire y’abakiri bato. Kandi no gukosora Abayobozi b’ibihugu. Kandi njyewe njya nkosora abayobozi b’ibihugu ku bibazo bimwe na bimwe bikomeye”.

“Uko mbikora, mbandikira amabaruwa bose, bamwe bagasubiza, abandi ntibasubize, ariko baba bakebuwe uko bimeze kose, noneho bakagira ibyo bahindura, babikora mu buryo bwiza cyangwa se bubi. Hari uwigeze kumbaza ati ariko se bose baragusubiza? Noneho ndavuga nti niba uri umukrisitu, wabonye amabaruwa Paul (Intumwa) yandikiye Abakirinto, ariko se wigeze ubona aho Abakorinto banditse basubiza Paul?Nanjye amabaruwa yanjye kuri abo bayobora ibihugu ni ko ameze”.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0FKQ-M8FW.body:
'Igihutu': Dore uko FDLR yatangije ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside

Ibi aba bahoze muri uwo mutwe w’iterabwoba babitangarije mu kiganiro kidasanzwe kuri KT Radio mu cyumweru gishize, ubwo bagaragazaga ingaruka y’ingengabitekerezo n’amacakubiri bibibwa na FDLR mu Burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC).

Lt Col (Rtd) Idrissa Bizimana wari uzwi nka Idrissa Kanzamuradadi muri FDLR wayoboraga batayo ya 2 ikorera muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo, akaba yarigeze kuba umuyobozi ushinzwe icengezamatwara, Politike na Purotokole mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu muri uwo mutwe ibi yabisobanuye neza.

Avuga ko bamaze gutsindwa na FPR-Inkotanyi, bambutse bakubita agatoki ku kandi, bumvisha aho bari bahungiye muri Zaire (RDC y’ubu), ko nibatitonda Abatutsi babambuye Igihugu babakurikira bakabatwara n’icyabo.

Ati “Twagiye tubyitwaje tubabwira ko nibareba nabi badukurikira na bo bakahabaka. Icyo gihe barabyumvise, batangira kwirukana Abatutsi, bahungira mu Rwanda, twe dusigara turi bamwe.

Twatangiye dutyaza abasirikare twongeramo n’Interahamwe z’abasore, kugira ngo bwangu twisubize Igihugu, ari nayo mpamvu abahanzi nka Bikindi Simoni bahise bahimba indirimbo nka ‘Rwigere turwisubize’.”

Uyu wari ofisiye muto muri XFAR, avuga ko batangiye kugaba ibitero shuma ku Rwanda, kuko bari begereye imipaka, kugeza igihe ingabo z’u Rwanda zabatsinze burundu inkambi zigasenywa bagakwirwa imishwaro hirya no hino muri RDC abandi bakajya muri Congo Brazaville.

Abagumye muri RDC mu duce twa Masisi na Rutsuro bo bari baramaze gucengeza neza ingengabiterezo yabo aho bari batuye, ku buryo abaturage baho babiyumvagamo nka bene wabo.

Idrissa avuga nyuma baje kuva Congo Brazzaville bahakuwe na Laurent Desire Kabila wari Perezida wa RDC, ababwira ko abakeneyeho ubufasha bwo gutera u Rwanda. Yabohereje i Kisangani aho basanze amazina menshi yaho ajya gusa n’Amanyarwanda, batangira kubwira abaho ko ari bamwe, bose ari Abahutu baciwe mu gihugu.

Ati “Hari nk’umujyi witwa Kumbula, tukababwira tuti abawise Kumbula bari bakumbuye mu Rwanda, hari ahitwa Kangabo, Kamina, Kayumba, ukumva bagiye bagoreka ururimi, ariko tukabumvisha ko turi bamwe.”

Pasiteri Jean Damascene Niyonzima, wahoze ari umuyobozi w’Akarere wungirije mu cyahoze ari Komine Kinyami mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, muri FDLR akaba yari ashinzwe iperereza ry’imbere muri uwo mutwe nawe yagize uruhare muri iri cengezamatwara.

Avuga ko nyuma yo gukwirakwiza ingengabitekerezo mu Banyarwanda bari kumwe, batangiye kuyishyira no mu Banyekongo.

Ati “ Ni bwo twatangiye kubabwira tuti dore hano mu Bahutu mwavugaga Ikinyenduga, mukavuga Ikinyabwishi, ariko guhera uyu munsi kugira ngo tube umwe, ntabwo twakomeza kuvuga Ikinyarwanda kuko Abanyarwanda iyo tuvuze u Rwanda, ubu ngubu rufitwe n’Umututsi, twe turi Abahutu kandi twararuhunze turi muri RDC, duhuye na bene wacu b'Abahutu, tugomba kuvuga "Igihutu", ubwo ururimi rw’Igihutu tuba turwinjiyemo dutyo.”

Icyakora, uru rurimi rw'Igihutu ni igihuha, nta n'ijambo na rimwe bigeze bahimba, ku buryo wakumva umuntu avuze, ngo ugire uti "Uriya muntu ari kuvuga Igihutu."

Ahubwo, ni igisobanuro cy'ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside gusa.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru
