ART-MU8U0G4G-5SMR.body:
Indwara ya appendicite yavurwa igakira mu gihe yamenyekanye hakiri kare

Indwara zifata kuri ‘appendice’ cyangwa se agace ko mu mubiri w’umuntu kagereranywa n’agasendababoyi kajyamo imicanga, kaba hagati y’urura ruto n’urura runini, zishobora kuvurwa zigakira mu gihe zamenyekanye kare nk’uko byasobanuwe na Dr Gasakure Miguel, inzobere mu buvuzi bwo kubaga indwara zitandukanye.

Ubusanzwe appendice ikunze kugereranywa n’agasendababoyi k’inkoko, kubera ko ari agace k’urura runini gafata ku ruhande rw’i buryo, kakaba kajyamo utubuye twasigaye mu gihe imyanda iva mu rura ruto, ijya mu rura runini.

Yavuze ko kaba kameze nk’urutoki rw’akaregeya, kakaba gahora gafunguye, kari ahagana hasi, noneho mu gihe umwanda uhinduka, urimo ucayuka, utwo tubuye cyangwa umusarani cyangwa se utundi twanda tukagwamo. Bimwe muri ibyo bigwamo, birongera bikazamuka, cyangwa se bimwe byamanukiramo bikaziba. Iyo bizibye rero niho indwara ituruka.

Dr Gasakure yemeza ko 90% by’indwara zifata iyo ‘appendice’ zituruka kuri uko kuziba. Kuziba ngo bishobora guterwa n’utwo tubuye, ubundi bigaterwa n’ibyitwa amasazi cyangwa se uduturugunyu tuba ku mpande zako, tukabyimba, hanyuma bigafunga. Ibyo ngo bikunze kuba cyane cyane ku bana. Ikindi gishoboka ariko kibaho gacye, ni igihe kuri iyo ‘appendice’ haba hariho kanseri.

Yagize ati, “ Umuntu ashobora gafatwa na kanseri, igafata kuri ako gace ka ‘appendice’ gusa, atari ku mara, ariko nyuma ikaba ishobora gukura igafata no ku kindi gice cy’urura. Hari ubwo za mikorobe zijyamo kuko zitagatambuka neza, n’ibindi bintu by’imirenda yo mu mubiri bikirundamo, noneho ka gace ka ‘appendice’ kagatangira kubyimba, nawe ukabyumva kuko uba ubabara, kakagera n’igihe kagaturika kubera uko kubyimba kwako”.

Dr Gasakure avuga ko cyera biga, babwirwaga ko ako gace k’urura kameze nk’akaregeya, ntacyo kamaze, mbese ko ari akantu k’inyongera. Ariko nyuma ngo ubushakashatsi bwaje kugaragaza ko gafite akamaro gakomeye cyane cyane ku bana bato, mu bijyanye n’ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri wabo.

Yasobanuye ko mu by’ukuri nta mpamvu ihari ihamye wavuga ko ari yo itera indwara ya ‘appendicite’, ku buryo babwira abantu ngo birinde ibintu runaka, ariko iyo babaze ako gace karwaye, bakunze gusangamo utwo tubuye dutoya.

Yagize ati, “ Nta mpamvu igaragara wavuga, kuko dukunze kubibona ku bantu bato, bari mu myaka 20-30 cyangwa munsi gato. Ntabwo navuga ko rero hari impamvu ihamye, ariko buri gihe cyangwa se akenshi dusangamo utwo tubuye dutoya. Rero tukavuga tuti bishobora kuba bifitanye isano n’iyo ndwara. Ariko nta kintu wabwira umurwayi ngo abomba kwirinda. Hari benshi baza bakubaza ngo ese ni amabuye mba nariye mu muceri?cyangwa mu biryo? Ariko ntabwo ari byo”.

Ibimenyetso byabwira umuntu ko ashobora kuba yarwaye appendicite, birahari kandi ngo ni byiza kubyitaho, umuntu akaba yajya kwa muganga adatinze, kuko iyo atinze ari byo bituma kagera aho kagaturika.

Dr Gasakure yagize ati, “ Abantu benshi batinda kuza kwivuza kandi kagera aho ko kagaturika, kubera ko ntikameze nk’utundi duce two mu mubiri. Ibimenyetso ni uko, akenshi umuntu atangira kumva ahinduwe, agira umuriro,isesemi, ntabe akibasha kurya, agatangira kubabara mu nda hagati, akenshi yumva ababara mu mukondo, nyuma y’umunsi ubwo bubabare butangira kwimuka, akabwumva bumanuka mu nda yo hepfo,ariko ku ruhande rw’i buryo cyane cyane, noneho bikaguma aho, ubwo hakaza kuruka, cyangwa se guhitwa. Akenshi umuriro nawo ukomeza kuzamuka, n’ububabare bukiyongera...”.

Yakomeje avuga ko” Kwihutira kwa muganga biba byiza, kuko hagati y’amasaha 24-72 atangiye kumva ububabare, nibwo haba hari amahirwe yo kukabaga umurwayi ntazahare, iyo birenze kaba gashobora guturika, bigatera ikibazo kuko udukoko tuba turi mu mara turasohoka, bishobora no gutuma umuntu apfa cyangwa se akisanga ahakirirwa indembe adashobora kweguka…”.

Dr Gasakure avuga ko uje kwa muganga mbere y’ayo masaha 72, aba ashobora kugabwa hakoreshajwe za ‘cameras’ zijwizwa mu nda zinyujijwe mu twenge duto tuba twapfumuwe ku nda, bakabaga ako ka appendice bakagasohoramo banyujije muri kamwe muri utwo twenge, ariko iyo umurwayi yatinze, kagaturika, biba bibi, kuko kukabaga bisaba kubaga bagafungura inda, noneho kubera ko n’amaraso aba atakegeraho neza ngo kaba gasa n’akatangiye kubora, hari amashyira bigatuma umurwayi atinda gukira na nyuma yo kuvurwa, mu gihe uwavuwe hakiri kare we, atagira ibyo kuzahara.

Dr Gasakure ati,” Gupima ko ari appendice yarwaye, 80% duhera ku bimenyetso umurwayi avuga, hanyuma tugapimisha na ‘echographie’ inyuzwa kun da, kugira ngo turebe, uko kameze. Iyo tumaze kuhabaga, kuko biba ari nko guca akaregeya ku kiganza, hari agace gato gasigara, tukakadoda, cyangwa se tukagafungisha utuntu, ku buryo bimera ko gufunga ‘enveloppe’ hakoreshejwe ‘agrafeuse’. Harimo n’abahitamo kutabagwa, bagahabwa za ‘antibiotics’ zikabyimbura iyo bishoboka, ariko n’ubundi nyuma y’igihe gito karongera kakarwara. Uburyo bwiza bwo kukavura ni ukukabaga”.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0GOR-YAR2.body:
Ku mpera z'Isi bagerayo bate? Umwangavu Izere Louise yahagenze iminsi icumi

Kugera ku mpera z’Isi si ibintu Izere Louise yari yarigeze atekereza ko byashoboka kuri we. Uyu munyeshuri w’Umunyarwandakazi, usanzwe wiga ibijyanye no gukora porogaramu za mudasobwa (coding), yabonye amahirwe yo kwitabira urugendo mpuzamahanga rwa “Icebreaker of Knowledge”, gahunda ya siyansi n’uburezi y’ikigo cy’Uburusiya gikora mu by’ingufu za nikeleyeri kitwa ROSATOM, rumugeza ku mpera z’isi mu gace ka Arctique.

Ku itariki ya 13 Kanama 2026, nibwo urugendo rwa karindwi rw’iyi gahunda rwagarutse mu mugi wa Murmansk uri mu majyaruguru y’Uburusiya, nyuma y’iminsi 10 y’urugendo rwanyuze mu nzira imenyerewe cyane ya Murmansk – North Pole – Franz Josef Land – Murmansk. Urwo rugendo rwanabaye urwa 200 rw’ubwato bugendera hejuru y’amazi y’inyanja bwageze ku mpera z’isi.

Kuri Louise ariko, iyi si inkuru y’urugendo gusa. Ni inkuru y’uko amahirwe ashobora guturuka ahantu umuntu atayategereje.

Amarushanwa yamugejeje ku mpera z’isi

Louise avuga ko kugira ngo agere muri uru rugendo yabanje kunyura mu marushanwa ajyanye n’ingufu za nikeleyeri.

Ati: “Kugira ngo mbashe kugerayo habaye amarushanwa y’ingufu za nikeleyeri aho bakubazaga ibibazo ukabisubiza, ubundi ukanakora video ivuga ku ngufu za nikeleyeri.”

Mu buzima bwe busanzwe, ntabwo yari asanzwe azi byinshi ku bijyanye n’ingufu za kirimbuzi. Yari azi ko zibaho, ariko atari azi neza uko zikora cyangwa aho zishobora gukoreshwa. Uru rugendo rwahinduye iyo shusho.

Louise avuga ko amaze kubona uko izo ngufu zikora n’uburyo zishobora kugira uruhare runini mu gihe kizaza, yatangiye gutekereza ku buryo yazihuza n’ibyo asanzwe yiga ndetse ashaka gukora. Agira ati “Mu buzima busanzwe ntabwo nari nzi byinshi ku ngufu za nikeleyeri. Narazumvaga gusa.

Ariko, nyuma yo kubona ukuntu zikora na nyuma yo kubona ukuntu ari ingufu zikenewe mu gihe kizaza, byatumye nshaka kureba uburyo nahuza ibyo nsanzwe niga muri coding, nkabihuza n’ingufu za nikeleyeri. Ku buryo ntata umurongo w’ibyo nshaka gukora bijyanye na coding ariko nkashaka uburyo mbihuza nazo.”

Ibi bijyanye n’intego y’umushinga wa Icebreaker of Knowledge wo guteza imbere urubyiruko rufite impano muri siyansi n’ikoranabuhanga, ndetse no kurufasha gutekereza ku mwuga ruzakora mu gihe kizaza.

Abanyeshuri 68, baturutse hirya no hino ku Isi

Louise yari umwe mu banyeshuri bitabiriye uru rugendo. Amakuru atangazwa na ROSATOM avuga ko abanyeshuri bagera ku 5,000 baturutse mu bihugu 22 bahatanye mu irushanwa ryo gutoranyamo abazitabira uru rugendo. U Rwanda rwari muri ibyo bihugu, hamwe na Namibia, Misiri, Afurika y’Epfo, Ubuhinde, u Bushinwa, Brazil, Tanzania n’ibindi.

Louise avuga ko muri uru rugendo bari abanyeshuri 23 baturutse mu bihugu bitandukanye bitari u Burusiya, bakiyongeraho abanyeshuri 46 b’Abarusiya.

Icyo avuga ko bahuriyeho cyane ni inyota yo kwiga

Ati: “Ni abantu bafite ishyaka ryo kwiga ibintu bishya. Ni abantu batavuga ngo ‘ibyo nzi birahagije.’”

Yongeraho ko yasanze bafite umuco wo kuganira no gusangira ibitekerezo, aho buri wese aba yiteguye kumva undi.

Ubushakashatsi ku mpera z’isi

Uru rugendo ntirwari urwo gutembera gusa. Ku bwato bukoreshwa n’ingufu za kirimbuzi, abanyeshuri bari kumwe n’abahanga bakoze ibikorwa bya siyansi birimo kohereza “radiosonde” mu kirere, mu bushakashatsi bugamije koroshya itumanaho ahantu bigoye kurigeza, cyane cyane mu gice cy’impera z’isi (Arctique) no ku nzira y’amazi yerekeza mu mpera z’amajyaruguru y’isi Louise avuga ko ubwo bari mu rugendo hari ibice batabashaga kuvuganamo n’abantu bari hanze. Agira ati: “Ntabwo wabashaga kuvugana n’abantu bari hanze, ntabwo wabashaga guhamagara cyangwa se ngo ukoreshe internet.”

Ubushakashatsi bakoze bwabafashije kumva no gusesengura ibimenyetso bya radiyo muri ako gace.

Kuri Louise, kuba yarabonye ubushakashatsi bukorerwa ahantu hakonje kandi kure cyane byamuhinduye imyumvire ku byo siyansi ishobora kugeraho.

Ati: “Byanyeretse ko hari ibintu tuba dutekereza ko bidashoboka ariko ugasanga ari ibintu bishoboka dukoresheje siyansi, tukabikoraho ubushakashatsi. Icyo bisaba kubishyiramo ubushake.”

Icyamutangaje: kuba uhagaze hejuru y’amazi y’inyanja ariko ntugwemo

Nubwo Louise yari yiteze kubona ahantu hakonje, hari ibintu bimwe na bimwe byamutunguye kurenza uko yari yaratekereje. Kimwe muri byo ni ukubona abantu bahagaze hejuru y’urubura rutwikiriye inyanja, ariko ntibagwemo.

Ikindi cyamushimishije ni uko muri uru rugendo atigeze abona umwijima nk’uwo abantu basanzwe bamenyereye.

Agira ati: “Igihe cyose twari turiyo ntabwo nigeze mbona umwijima. Uko habaga hameze saa yine z’amanywa ni nako habaga hameze saa yine z’ijoro.”

Ariko urugendo ntirwose rwari rworoshye. Avuga ko ikintu cyamugoye cyane ari igihe ubwato bwahuraga n’imiraba yo mu nyanja ikabuzunguza, ibintu byamuteye isereri.

Kuri Louise, kimwe mu bihe bikomeye kurusha ibindi ni ukugerayo atwaye ibendera ry’u Rwanda. Avuga ko kuba ashobora kuba ari we munyarwanda wa mbere wabashije gukandagira hariya hantu ari ibintu atigeze atekereza ko byamubaho.

Ati: “Ni ibintu bishimisha cyane iyo mbitekereje, bikantangaza cyane, ndetse bikantera n’ishema ryo kuba naragejeje ibendera ry’igihugu cyanjye ku mpera z’Isi.”

Kuri we, kuba yarahagaze aho hantu ari kumwe n’ibendera ry’u Rwanda byari nk’inzozi zibaye impamo.

N’ubwo ingufu za nikeleyeri ari zo zamugejeje kuri uru rugendo, Louise avuga ko ibyo yigiye muri Arctique bitagarukiye kuri zo. Yize ku bijyanye n’ikirere, ibinyabuzima n’imikorere y’umubiri w’umuntu, ndetse anagira amahirwe yo kwiga izindi ndimi, harimo Igishinwa. Ati: “Nakuyeyo ibintu byinshi biri mu ngeri zitandukanye.”

Ku bijyanye n’ingufu za nikeleyeri, avuga ko yahavuye afite imyumvire mishya ku mbaraga zayo no ku buryo ubutare bwa uranium bushobora gukoreshwa mu gutanga ingufu.

Uru rugendo kandi rwabaye amahirwe yo kubona mu buryo bufatika ikoranabuhanga n’ubushakashatsi byari bisanzwe ari amasomo cyangwa ibitekerezo gusa.

Ubufatanye bwa Rwanda na ROSATOM

Urugendo rwa Louise rubaye mu gihe u Rwanda na ROSATOM bifitanye ubufatanye mu bijyanye no gutanga amasomo mu bijyanye n’ingufu za nikeleyeri no guhugura abakozi bafite ubumenyi muri uru rwego.

Ubwo bufatanye bwatangiye mu 2019, ubwo u Rwanda na ROSATOM basinyaga amasezerano agamije kongera ubushobozi bw’abahanga mu ngufu za nikeleyeri. Kugeza ubu, abanyeshuri 18 barangije amashuri makuru mu Burusiya mu masomo ajyanye n’ingufu za nikeleyeri, n’izindi nzego zijyanye nayo. Ni mu gihe mu mwaka wa 2025 abanyeshuri icyenda b’Abanyarwanda asoje amasomo muri National Research Nuclear University yo mu Burusiya.

Mu mwaka w’amashuri wa 2026/2027, ROSATOM kandi yateganyije imyanya 20 y’Abanyarwanda baziga mu mashuri makuru yo mu Burusiya mu masomo ajyanye n’ingufu za nikeleyeri n’ibindi bijyanye na zo.

Kuri Louise, uru rugendo rushobora kuba intangiriro y’urundi rugendo mu myigire ye, cyane cyane ko ubu yatangiye gutekereza ku buryo yakomatanya ibyo asanzwe yiga bya “coding” n’ingufu za nikeleyeri.

Yagarukanye amazi yo muri Arctique n’icyemezo

Uretse ibyo yize n’amafoto n’ubunararibonye, Louise yagarukanye ibintu bizajya bimwibutsa uru rugendo.

Abitabiriye urugendo bahawe uducupa duto turimo amazi yakuwe mu Nyanja ya Arctique, ndetse bahabwa n’impamyabumenyi zigaragaza uruhare rwabo muri gahunda.

Ariko impano ikomeye kurushaho, kuri Louise, ni icyizere gishya afite ku byo ashobora kugeraho. Avuga ko n’ubwo atari asanzwe azi iby’ingufu za nikeleyeri atigeze yiyima amahirwe ari naho ahera agira inama bagenzi be yo gutinyuka.

Agira ati: “Uko ikintu waba ubona kimeze kose cyangwa uko waba ubona utagishobora, uba ugomba kugerageza amahirwe yawe. Kuko nkanjye nk’umuntu wiga coding, nkibona irushanwa ku ngufu za nikeleyeri ni uguhita ntekereza chimie na phyisique, kandi ni ibintu ntasanzwe niga Nari guhita mvuga nti ‘ibi bintu ntabwo ari ibyanjye’, ariko naravuze nti ‘ntawe umenya aho umugisha w’umuntu uri, reka ngerageze, ndebe wenda ko hari icyavamo."

Akomeza agira ati: “Icyo nababwira ni uko utagomba kwitesha agaciro, ugomba gutinyuka, ntabwo ugomba kuvuga ngo iki ntabwo nagishobora, ibi ni iby’abandi, si ibyanjye, ahubwo uba ugomba kugerageza amahirwe yose ubonye, ukayakoresha neza, ukagerageza ibyo ushoboye, ukiga ibyo ukeneye kumenya.”

Kuri Izere Louise, urugendo rwo kugera ku mpera z’isi rwamwigishije ko isi ifite byinshi birenze ibyo umuntu abona buri munsi.

Kandi kimwe mu by’ingenzi yatahanye ni uko icyo umuntu atekereza ko kidashoboka uyu munsi gishobora kuba intangiriro y’inzozi nshya ejo.

Wanditse

Christophe Kivunge

Umunyamakuru · Reba inkuru zose

Ati: “Kugira ngo mbashe kugerayo habaye amarushanwa y’ingufu za nikeleyeri aho bakubazaga ibibazo ukabisubiza, ubundi ukanakora video ivuga ku ngufu za nikeleyeri.”

Mu buzima bwe busanzwe, ntabwo yari asanzwe azi byinshi ku bijyanye n’ingufu za kirimbuzi. Yari azi ko zibaho, ariko atari azi neza uko zikora cyangwa aho zishobora gukoreshwa. Uru rugendo rwahinduye iyo shusho.

Louise avuga ko amaze kubona uko izo ngufu zikora n’uburyo zishobora kugira uruhare runini mu gihe kizaza, yatangiye gutekereza ku buryo yazihuza n’ibyo asanzwe yiga ndetse ashaka gukora. Agira ati “Mu buzima busanzwe ntabwo nari nzi byinshi ku ngufu za nikeleyeri. Narazumvaga gusa.

Ariko, nyuma yo kubona ukuntu zikora na nyuma yo kubona ukuntu ari ingufu zikenewe mu gihe kizaza, byatumye nshaka kureba uburyo nahuza ibyo nsanzwe niga muri coding, nkabihuza n’ingufu za nikeleyeri. Ku buryo ntata umurongo w’ibyo nshaka gukora bijyanye na coding ariko nkashaka uburyo mbihuza nazo.”
Ibi bijyanye n’intego y’umushinga wa Icebreaker of Knowledge wo guteza imbere urubyiruko rufite impano muri siyansi n’ikoranabuhanga, ndetse no kurufasha gutekereza ku mwuga ruzakora mu gihe kizaza.
Abanyeshuri 68, baturutse hirya no hino ku Isi

Louise yari umwe mu banyeshuri bitabiriye uru rugendo. Amakuru atangazwa na ROSATOM avuga ko abanyeshuri bagera ku 5,000 baturutse mu bihugu 22 bahatanye mu irushanwa ryo gutoranyamo abazitabira uru rugendo. U Rwanda rwari muri ibyo bihugu, hamwe na Namibia, Misiri, Afurika y’Epfo, Ubuhinde, u Bushinwa, Brazil, Tanzania n’ibindi.
Louise avuga ko muri uru rugendo bari abanyeshuri 23 baturutse mu bihugu bitandukanye bitari u Burusiya, bakiyongeraho abanyeshuri 46 b’Abarusiya.
Icyo avuga ko bahuriyeho cyane ni inyota yo kwiga
Ati: “Ni abantu bafite ishyaka ryo kwiga ibintu bishya. Ni abantu batavuga ngo ‘ibyo nzi birahagije.’”
Yongeraho ko yasanze bafite umuco wo kuganira no gusangira ibitekerezo, aho buri wese aba yiteguye kumva undi.
Ubushakashatsi ku mpera z’isi

Uru rugendo ntirwari urwo gutembera gusa. Ku bwato bukoreshwa n’ingufu za kirimbuzi, abanyeshuri bari kumwe n’abahanga bakoze ibikorwa bya siyansi birimo kohereza “radiosonde” mu kirere, mu bushakashatsi bugamije koroshya itumanaho ahantu bigoye kurigeza, cyane cyane mu gice cy’impera z’isi (Arctique) no ku nzira y’amazi yerekeza mu mpera z’amajyaruguru y’isi Louise avuga ko ubwo bari mu rugendo hari ibice batabashaga kuvuganamo n’abantu bari hanze. Agira ati: “Ntabwo wabashaga kuvugana n’abantu bari hanze, ntabwo wabashaga guhamagara cyangwa se ngo ukoreshe internet.”
Ubushakashatsi bakoze bwabafashije kumva no gusesengura ibimenyetso bya radiyo muri ako gace.
Kuri Louise, kuba yarabonye ubushakashatsi bukorerwa ahantu hakonje kandi kure cyane byamuhinduye imyumvire ku byo siyansi ishobora kugeraho.
Ati: “Byanyeretse ko hari ibintu tuba dutekereza ko bidashoboka ariko ugasanga ari ibintu bishoboka dukoresheje siyansi, tukabikoraho ubushakashatsi. Icyo bisaba kubishyiramo ubushake.”
Icyamutangaje: kuba uhagaze hejuru y’amazi y’inyanja ariko ntugwemo

Nubwo Louise yari yiteze kubona ahantu hakonje, hari ibintu bimwe na bimwe byamutunguye kurenza uko yari yaratekereje. Kimwe muri byo ni ukubona abantu bahagaze hejuru y’urubura rutwikiriye inyanja, ariko ntibagwemo.
Ikindi cyamushimishije ni uko muri uru rugendo atigeze abona umwijima nk’uwo abantu basanzwe bamenyereye.
Agira ati: “Igihe cyose twari turiyo ntabwo nigeze mbona umwijima. Uko habaga hameze saa yine z’amanywa ni nako habaga hameze saa yine z’ijoro.”
Ariko urugendo ntirwose rwari rworoshye. Avuga ko ikintu cyamugoye cyane ari igihe ubwato bwahuraga n’imiraba yo mu nyanja ikabuzunguza, ibintu byamuteye isereri.

Kuri Louise, kimwe mu bihe bikomeye kurusha ibindi ni ukugerayo atwaye ibendera ry’u Rwanda. Avuga ko kuba ashobora kuba ari we munyarwanda wa mbere wabashije gukandagira hariya hantu ari ibintu atigeze atekereza ko byamubaho.
Ati: “Ni ibintu bishimisha cyane iyo mbitekereje, bikantangaza cyane, ndetse bikantera n’ishema ryo kuba naragejeje ibendera ry’igihugu cyanjye ku mpera z’Isi.”
Kuri we, kuba yarahagaze aho hantu ari kumwe n’ibendera ry’u Rwanda byari nk’inzozi zibaye impamo.

N’ubwo ingufu za nikeleyeri ari zo zamugejeje kuri uru rugendo, Louise avuga ko ibyo yigiye muri Arctique bitagarukiye kuri zo. Yize ku bijyanye n’ikirere, ibinyabuzima n’imikorere y’umubiri w’umuntu, ndetse anagira amahirwe yo kwiga izindi ndimi, harimo Igishinwa. Ati: “Nakuyeyo ibintu byinshi biri mu ngeri zitandukanye.”
Ku bijyanye n’ingufu za nikeleyeri, avuga ko yahavuye afite imyumvire mishya ku mbaraga zayo no ku buryo ubutare bwa uranium bushobora gukoreshwa mu gutanga ingufu.
Uru rugendo kandi rwabaye amahirwe yo kubona mu buryo bufatika ikoranabuhanga n’ubushakashatsi byari bisanzwe ari amasomo cyangwa ibitekerezo gusa.
Ubufatanye bwa Rwanda na ROSATOM
Urugendo rwa Louise rubaye mu gihe u Rwanda na ROSATOM bifitanye ubufatanye mu bijyanye no gutanga amasomo mu bijyanye n’ingufu za nikeleyeri no guhugura abakozi bafite ubumenyi muri uru rwego.

Ubwo bufatanye bwatangiye mu 2019, ubwo u Rwanda na ROSATOM basinyaga amasezerano agamije kongera ubushobozi bw’abahanga mu ngufu za nikeleyeri. Kugeza ubu, abanyeshuri 18 barangije amashuri makuru mu Burusiya mu masomo ajyanye n’ingufu za nikeleyeri, n’izindi nzego zijyanye nayo. Ni mu gihe mu mwaka wa 2025 abanyeshuri icyenda b’Abanyarwanda asoje amasomo muri National Research Nuclear University yo mu Burusiya.
Mu mwaka w’amashuri wa 2026/2027, ROSATOM kandi yateganyije imyanya 20 y’Abanyarwanda baziga mu mashuri makuru yo mu Burusiya mu masomo ajyanye n’ingufu za nikeleyeri n’ibindi bijyanye na zo.
Kuri Louise, uru rugendo rushobora kuba intangiriro y’urundi rugendo mu myigire ye, cyane cyane ko ubu yatangiye gutekereza ku buryo yakomatanya ibyo asanzwe yiga bya “coding” n’ingufu za nikeleyeri.
Yagarukanye amazi yo muri Arctique n’icyemezo
Uretse ibyo yize n’amafoto n’ubunararibonye, Louise yagarukanye ibintu bizajya bimwibutsa uru rugendo.
Abitabiriye urugendo bahawe uducupa duto turimo amazi yakuwe mu Nyanja ya Arctique, ndetse bahabwa n’impamyabumenyi zigaragaza uruhare rwabo muri gahunda.

Ariko impano ikomeye kurushaho, kuri Louise, ni icyizere gishya afite ku byo ashobora kugeraho. Avuga ko n’ubwo atari asanzwe azi iby’ingufu za nikeleyeri atigeze yiyima amahirwe ari naho ahera agira inama bagenzi be yo gutinyuka.

Agira ati: “Uko ikintu waba ubona kimeze kose cyangwa uko waba ubona utagishobora, uba ugomba kugerageza amahirwe yawe. Kuko nkanjye nk’umuntu wiga coding, nkibona irushanwa ku ngufu za nikeleyeri ni uguhita ntekereza chimie na phyisique, kandi ni ibintu ntasanzwe niga Nari guhita mvuga nti ‘ibi bintu ntabwo ari ibyanjye’, ariko naravuze nti ‘ntawe umenya aho umugisha w’umuntu uri, reka ngerageze, ndebe wenda ko hari icyavamo."

Akomeza agira ati: “Icyo nababwira ni uko utagomba kwitesha agaciro, ugomba gutinyuka, ntabwo ugomba kuvuga ngo iki ntabwo nagishobora, ibi ni iby’abandi, si ibyanjye, ahubwo uba ugomba kugerageza amahirwe yose ubonye, ukayakoresha neza, ukagerageza ibyo ushoboye, ukiga ibyo ukeneye kumenya.”
Kuri Izere Louise, urugendo rwo kugera ku mpera z’isi rwamwigishije ko isi ifite byinshi birenze ibyo umuntu abona buri munsi.
Kandi kimwe mu by’ingenzi yatahanye ni uko icyo umuntu atekereza ko kidashoboka uyu munsi gishobora kuba intangiriro y’inzozi nshya ejo.
Wanditse
Christophe Kivunge
Umunyamakuru · Reba inkuru zose

ART-MU8U0H7W-H6ZG.body:
Congo, igihugu cya mbere ku isi kirimo Perezidansi ebyiri: Iya FDLR n'iya Tshisekedi

Niho Perezida wa Repubulika Felix Antoine Thisekedi akorera, ndetse n'abamwungirije.

Muri iki gihugu n'ubundi, hari abandi bantu bafite Perezidansi, abo ni umutwe w'iterabwoba wa FDLR ukorera muri iki gihugu urimo abasize bakoze Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda.

Aha rerom bivugwa ko ngo uyu mutwe ufite n'ubuyobozi, bugenda bubangikanye n'ubwa Tshisekedi, cyane cyane mu nzego z'ibanze, aho uba mu bice by'Uburasirazuba bwa Congo.

Bamwe mu bahoze ari abarwanyi muri FDLR, bavuga ko uyu mutwe w’iterabwoba, wiyubatse mu nzego zose, ku buryo bafite na Perezidanse ikoreramo umuyobozi wabo n’abandi bakozi bamufasha.

Pasiteri Jean Damascene Niyonzima, wahoze ari umuyobozi w’Akarere wungirije mu cyahoze ari Komine Kinyami mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, muri FDLR akaba yari ashinzwe iperereza ry’imbere muri uwo mutwe, avuga ko Perezidanse ya FDLR, igizwe na Perezida n’abandi bakozi bakorana bya hafi.

Ati “Icyo bita Perezidanse, ni ukuvuga ngo hari Perezida, akaba afite aho akorera n'abakozi bakorana. Nta biro byubatse afite akorera aho atuye, bashyiraho uruganiriro rwo kugira ngo abe yakoreramo. Ariko afite n’Abakomiseri, twakwita nk’abaminisitiri mu gihugu. Barimo ushinzwe ububanyi n’amahanga, itangazamakuru, iperereza n'ibindi.”

Yungamo ati “Buri Komiseri na we aba afite abandi bakadire (Cadre/ umuntu ufite uruhare n’inshingano runaka mu buyobozi) ba banyepolitike bakorana, hari ababa hanze hakaba n’abandi baba aho mu biro, ariko buri wese ashyira ibiro aho atuye. Ni ibiro bigenda byimuka, kubera ko badafite ahantu hafatika bicaye.”

Nubwo hagiye hasinywa amasezerano atandukanye y’isenywa ry’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR, abahoze ari abarwanyi bawo bavuga ko bidashoboka kubera ko ushyigikiwe cyangwa kandi ukaba ukingirwa ikibaba na Leta ya RDC.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0HRY-D52Y.body:
Aramutse agiye mu gikoni - Dore uko Min Sabin Nsanzimana yategura ifunguro ribereye Umunyarwanda

Kugira ngo Umunyarwanda agire ubuzima bwiza, ifunguro rye rya buri munsi rikwiye kuba rigizwe n’ibiribwa bitandukanye kandi bifite intungamubiri.

Ibi ni byo bigaragara mu butumwa bwashyizwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga na Minisitiri w’Ubuzima, Dr Sabin Nsanzimana, aho yagaragaje urugero rw’“ifunguro ry’Umunyarwanda ryatuma agira ubuzima buzira umuze”.

Muri ubwo butumwa, Dr Sabin agaragaza ko hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy’isahani gikwiye kuba kigizwe n’isombe, dodo n’izindi mboga. Izi mboga zigomba kuba igice cy’ingenzi cy’imirire ya buri munsi kuko zitanga intungamubiri zitandukanye umubiri ukenera.

Ikindi gice, kingana na kimwe cya kane cy’isahani, Minisitiri avuga ko cyakwiye kuba kigizwe n’ibiribwa bikungahaye kuri poroteyine, birimo ibishyimbo, amafi, amagi, inkoko cyangwa inyama z’inka zidafite ibinure byinshi.

Kimwe cya kane gisigaye na cyo gishobora kuba kigizwe n’ibiribwa bitanga ingufu, nk'ibijumba, ibitoki cyangwa ibinyampeke bitatunganyijwe cyane.

Ku ruhande rw’ibindi biribwa byunganira indyo, Dr Sabin avuga ko hakwiye kubamo avoka cyangwa ubunyobwa ku rugero ruto, ndetse n’imbuto buri munsi.

Minisitiri Dr Nsanzimana anashishikariza abantu kunywa amazi ahagije, mu butumwa bwe akavuga urugero rwa litiro ebyiri z’amazi ku munsi.

Izi nama zinajyanye n’amahame rusange y'Umuryango Mpuzamahanga wita ku Buzima (WHO) avuga ko indyo yuzuye igomba kuba itandukanye, irimo imboga, imbuto, ibinyamisogwe nk’ibishyimbo, imbuto ndetse n’ibinyampeke byuzuye.

WHO kandi ivuga ko abantu bafite imyaka 10 kuzamura bagomba kurya nibura garama 400 z’imbuto n’imboga ku munsi, mu rwego rwo kugira indyo iboneye no kugabanya ibyago by’indwara zitandura.

Isombe, dodo, ibishyimbo, ibijumba, ibitoki, avoka, ubunyobwa, amagi n’izindi mbuto n’imboga biboneka mu gihugu bishobora kugira uruhare mu gutuma ifunguro rya buri munsi rirushaho kuba ryuzuye.

WHO ishimangira kandi akamaro ko kugabanya ibiribwa birimo umunyu, isukari n’amavuta menshi, no guhitamo ibiribwa bitatunganyijwe cyane.

Muri make, isahani yuzuye imboga nyinshi, igice cyayo kigizwe n’ibiribwa bikungahaye kuri poroteyine, ikindi kigizwe n’ibitanga ingufu, hakiyongeraho imbuto, avoka cyangwa ubunyobwa bijyana no kunywa amazi ahagije, ishobora kuba intambwe y’ingenzi mu guhitamo indyo iboneye.

Wanditse

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

ART-MU8U0IBF-8U02.body:
Ku bagore bibera mu kazi, 'mukibagirwa' ko mutwite, muganga yabasigiye ubutumwa

Ikigo cy'Igihugu gishinzwe Ibarurishamibare mu Rwanda (NISR) cyatangaje ko imibare y’abana bavuka badafite ibiro bikwiye cyangwa se bavuka bafite munsi ya 2.5kgs ikomeza kwiyongera, kandi ibyo bikaba ari ibintu bishyira ubuzima bwabo mu kaga.

Abana bavukana ibiro bicyeya biyongereye cyane mu mwaka ushize wa 2025, kurusha uko byari bimeze mu yindi myaka yabanje. Mu 2010, abana bavukanye ibiro bicye munsi ya 2.5 Kgs bari 6.2%, mu gihe mu 2025, umubare wiyongereye ukagera kuri 8.8%.

Dr Nkeshimana Menelas ushinzwe imyigishirize n’iterambere ry’abakozi bo kwa muganga muri Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, yasobanuye ko ubuzima abagore batwite babamo (lifestyle), ari kimwe mu bitera iyo mibare y’abana bavuka badafite ibiro bikwiye kuzamuka.

Yagize ati” Icyo navuga, ibyo bireze, ikibazo kirahari, abana basigaye bavuka batuzuye, ariko akenshi ugiye kureba usanga bifite aho bihurira n’ubuzima umubyeyi umutwite aba abamo (lifestyle). Nk’iyo umugore utwite ahora ari muri ‘shuguri’, ahora afite akazi kenshi, uzabibona kenshi mu Mijyi, nibo bagira ubuzima bumeze butyo,ari aha, ari hariya, ari muri ibi, ari muri biriya, ntarya, ntiyiyitaho, cyangwa se ugasanga aranywa itabi, aranywa inzoga se, agakoresha ibiyobyabwenge kandi atwite. Urumva ibyo ni uburyo bwo kubaho umuntu aba yikururiye, atari afite. Ariko hejuru y’ibyo hari n’ibindi ashobora kugira bitamuturutseho. Nk’urugero, ni ukugira umuvuduko w’amaraso ukabije”.

“ Ku muntu utwite,kugira umuvuduko w’amaraso, kugira ngo azabyare umwana ugejeje igihe, biragoye. Ubwo turavuga abavukana munsi ya 2.5kgs, hari n’abavukana amagarama 700, kubera uwo muvuduko w’amaraso. Kandi ni ikibazo gikomeye ku buryo iyo nta gikozwe vuba, n’umubyeyi utwite ubwe aba ashobora kuhatakariza ubuzima, kuko ni indwara ishobora kwica umubyeyi n’umwana bombi. Umubyeyi ugize uwo muvuko ukabije bamujyana mu bitaro kuko biba bigaragaye ko iyo nda itazageza ku mezi icyenda yo kuvuka. Ubwo bagerageza kuwugabanya, ariko banapanga gahunda yo kubyara mu buryo bwihuse…icyo gihe rero, umwana avukana ibiro bituzuye”.

“ Mu cyaro ni gacye wabona umugore utwite, ubura umwanya wo kwiyitaho, mu cyaro ubona ari abantu bakivuga ngo kanaka aratwite, ukabona baritwararika. Ariko nanone mu cyaro ntabwo bafite urukingo rubarinda izo ndwara, nk’umuvuduko w’amaraso, imirire mibi kuko niba umubyeyi afite imirire mibi bigira ingaruka ku mwana. Ubundi kugira ngo umwana amare amezi 9 mu nda ni uko aba yishimiye aho ari. Umubiri arimo uratekanye, umuvuduko w’amaraso ni mwiza, isukari ni nzima, imirire nta kibazo. Uwo mwana ashobora no kubaho akarenza ya mezi 9, ari mu nda igihe yishimiye aho ari, ahubwo bikazasaba kujya kwa muganga bakagira ibyo bakora kugira ngo avuke kuko yarengeje bikabije aba ashobora no gupfira mu nda”.

Dr Nkeshimana avuga ko umwana uri mu nda, ariko umubyeyi atameze neza, anywa inzoga, itabi n’ibindi, arwaye za ‘infections’ zinyuranye, atajya ategereza igihe nyacyo cyo kuvuka, kuko aba ataguwe neza aho ari, ibyo rero bigatuma avuka atujuje igihe, bikajyana no kuvuka adafite ibiro bishyitse.

Yagize ati, “ Ni gacye umwana yageza igihe cyo kuvuka atarageza ibiro bikwiye, kuko birajyana. Keretse ari umwana ufite ikibazo arwaye, cyangwa se ingombyi inyuramo amaraso amugaburira irwaye, cyangwa se abana bari mu nda bakaba ari impanga, imwe igacura indi, ugasanga hari ifite ibiro bikwiye, indi ntabyo”.

Dr Nkeshimana avuga ko bikwiye ko umubyeyi utwite, amenya ko hari ubundi buzima bw’umuntu uri mu nda, kandi agomba kumwitaho kugira ngo ashobore kubaho.

Yagize ati,” Niba utwite, ntabwo bikiri ubuzima bwawe bwonyine. Ubwo ni ubuzima bw’abantu babiri. Umwana we ubuzima bwe bushingira kuri wowe, kuko nta bushobozi afite bwo kwirwanaho. Ubuzima bwe bujyana n’uko umubyeyi abayeho. Nugenda uko ushatse ubuzima burabigiriramo akaga, ariko ugira akaga gakomeye ni umwana uri mu nda…, umuntu utwite aritwararika, ibyo arya, ibyo anywa,uko akora. Ikindi, utwite agomba gupimisha inda agahabwa ikinini kimufasha kubona intungamubiri zikenewe, kuko umubyeyi utwite iyo agwingiye n’umwana aragwingira akiri no mu nda”.

Dr Nkeshimana avuga ko mbere ababyeyi bapimishaga inda inshuro 4, ariko ubu ngo ni inshuro 8, kubera ibibazo bitandukanye bireba ababyeyi batwite, bigasaba rero ko baza kenshi kwa muganga kugira ngo akurikirane imikurire y’umwana mu nda. Icyo kinini abajya kwimisha inda bahabwa, kiri mu rwego rwa gahunda zatangiye mu 2024, zigamije kugabanya ibyago byo kubyara abana bafite ibiro bicyeya cyane. Aho ni ho Dr Nkeshimana ahera yemeza ko mu myaka iri imbere, iyo mibare y’abana bavukana ibiro bicyeya izagabanuka, nubwo ngo bisaba gukomeza kwigisha kuko ngo hari ababyeyi batemera no gupimisha inda, akajya kwa muganga agiye kubyara gusa.

Yagize ati, “ Abana b’abangavu baterwa inda, nabo bakunze kubyara abana batarageza igihe, kandi badafite n’ibiro bikwiye, kuko nta mwanya uhagije uhari mu nda kugira ngo umwana akuriremo abe yageza ku biro 3.5, kuko aba yatewe inda atarakura bihagije. Nicyo gituma habaho gahunda zihariye zo kwigisha abangavu, kuko iyo ubyaye umwana udashyitse rimwe, haba hari ibyago ko uzabyara n’uwa kabiri gutyo”.

Dr Nkeshimana avuga ko kugwingira k’umwana gushobora gutangira ari mu nda, bitewe n’umubyeyi utemera kurya bikwiye cyangwa se udashobora kubona ibyo kurya bigize intungamubiri akeneye.

Yagize ati,” Hari n’abandi batwita, bakanga kurya uko bikwiye, birinda ko bakwiyongera ibiro bagahinduka. Umugore umeze atyo aba mwiza pe, akaba ari aho nk’ishusho atwite, ariko uwo atwite nta kigenda.Turabibona bimeze bityo. Ubundi umubyeyi utwite, aba agomba kwiyongeraho ibiro, ukabona ni umugore utarimo kwibeshaho ubwe, ahubwo yibeshaho akabeshaho n’uwo atwite. Izo rero ni indwara z’Imijyi. Kandi nabo ubwabo baba babibona, kuko umuntu aba ari aho, akabyara umwana ufite ibibazo,udafite ibiro bihagije, akamara igihe kwa muganga nyuma yo kuvuka kuko batamurekura adafite ibihagije. Harimo n’abamara umwaka wose kwa muganga kubera ibiro by’umwana bitaragera ku rugero rushyitse”.

“Uwo mwana utaritaweho ari mu nda, imikurire ye nayo ubwo iba yahindutse, aziga ntafate, akanagwingira, ni yo mpamvu dusigaye guhitamo guha abatwite intungamubiri zikenewe binyuze muri icyo kinini bahabwa mu gihe cyo gupimisha inda”.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

Dore ibigo 20 bya Leta bifite igikundiro kurusha ibindi muri 2026

Imibare y’Ikigo cy’Igihugu Gishinzwe Ibizamini n’Ubugenzuzi bw’Amashuri (NESA) irerekana ibigo by’amashuri yisumbuye abanyeshuri basoje amashuri abanza muri uyu mwaka w’amashuri wa 2025/2026 bifuje kwigamo kurusha ibindi.

Uyu mwaka, umubare w’abanyeshuri bakoze ibizamini wabaye munini cyane kuko abana benshi bakererejwe n'icyorezo cya COVID-19 ubu ngo ari bwo bashoje abanza, kandi bakaba barahuye ari imyaka ibiri.

Uyu mwaka, abanyeshuri 243,958 batsinze ibizamini bya Leta bisoza amashuri abanza, maze 17,412 baba ari bo bahabwa imyanya mu mashuri y'abiga bacumbikiwe mu mwaka wa mbere w’amashuri yisumbuye (S1).

Abasigate 226,546 bo bashyizwe mu mashuri bigamo bataha (Day).

Hari amashuri makumyabiri yatowe cyane n'abanyeshuri, ariko imyanya iba micye ugereranyije n'abasabye.

Wanditse

Oswald Niyonzima

Umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today/KT Radio

ART-MU8U0JFC-PQVN.summary: Abakoze Jenoside mu Rwanda ni bo batorwamo abahanuzi ba FDLR Bamwe mu bahoze mu buyobozi bw’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR urimo abagize uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994, bavuze ko icengezamatwara no gukoresha ubuhanuzi bw’ubuhimbano cyangwa se bw’ibinyoma byabaye intwaro kugeza n]ubu. Major(Demob) Makuza Anastase witwaga Mbaga muri FDLR yari ashinzwe itumanaho no gukwirakwiza ubutumwa bujyanye n’ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside ndetse n’ingengabitekerezo ishingiye ku buhanuzi buhimbano, bwafashaga kugira ngo abasirikare n’abaturage bagire icyizere (morale). Mbaga yasobanuye ko mu gihe bari bageze muri Congo bigishije abo bari basanze ingengabiterezo yo kwanga Abatutsi no kubarwanya, kandi irafata, ariko mu gihe inkambi zari zimaze gusenywa mu 1996, abantu baratatanye, bamwe bajya mu mashyamba ya Congo abandi bajya mu bindi bihugu, haba ikibazo cy’uko bakongera guhurizwa hamwe ngo bashishikarizwe kujya ku rugamba, aho ni havutse gahunda yo kubinyuza mu masengesho n’u
ART-MU8U0JFC-PQVN.body:
Abakoze Jenoside mu Rwanda ni bo batorwamo abahanuzi ba FDLR

Bamwe mu bahoze mu buyobozi bw’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR urimo abagize uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994, bavuze ko icengezamatwara no gukoresha ubuhanuzi bw’ubuhimbano cyangwa se bw’ibinyoma byabaye intwaro kugeza n]ubu.

Major(Demob) Makuza Anastase witwaga Mbaga muri FDLR yari ashinzwe itumanaho no gukwirakwiza ubutumwa bujyanye n’ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside ndetse n’ingengabitekerezo ishingiye ku buhanuzi buhimbano, bwafashaga kugira ngo abasirikare n’abaturage bagire icyizere (morale).

Mbaga yasobanuye ko mu gihe bari bageze muri Congo bigishije abo bari basanze ingengabiterezo yo kwanga Abatutsi no kubarwanya, kandi irafata, ariko mu gihe inkambi zari zimaze gusenywa mu 1996, abantu baratatanye, bamwe bajya mu mashyamba ya Congo abandi bajya mu bindi bihugu, haba ikibazo cy’uko bakongera guhurizwa hamwe ngo bashishikarizwe kujya ku rugamba, aho ni havutse gahunda yo kubinyuza mu masengesho n’ubuhanuzi.

Yagize ati, “ …Amakambi amaze gusenyuka, nubwo iyo ngengabitekerezo twari tuyifite, byari bigoye kugira ngo wumvishe umuntu kuza gusubira mu ntambara, kandi abona uko abenshi twari twatatanye, bamwe baragiye za Brazzaville, abandi bakwirakwiye mu giturage."

Yongeraho ati "Ni cyo gituma, uretse iyo ngengabitekerezo twabashyizemo kandi buri wese yiyumvagamo, twaravuze tuti hagomba kugira ikintu cy’imbaturambaga, tubashyiramo bakumva ko bagomba kurwana. Ni cyo cyatumye tuzanamo ikintu cyo gusenga.Aho twari twarikusanyirije muri Masisi icyo gihe, hari umuhanuzi w’Umunye-Congo witwa Nyiraruvugo Tasiyana, wari usanzwe ari umuhanuzi umenyerewe muri ako gace”.

“Yari asanzwe ahanura bisanzwe nk’uko abahanuzi bakora, noneho tubonye ko ari umuntu abantu bemera, turavuga tuti natwe nitumuhamagara, akaza agahanurira abantu bacu, nabo barahita bumva ko ari Imana koko ivuze. Ubwo twamubwiye ibyo agomba guhanura avuga. Ibyo yahanuraga mbere byo ntitubizi. Twamubwiye ko agomba kubwira abantu ko Imana iduhaye igihugu, tugomba gutera, kandi tugatsinda. Kuko nta bikoresho twari dufite turamubwira tuti noneho, uvuge ko ibikoresho tuzajya tubikura mu ntambara turwana tuzagenda tubifata. Hanyuma ibyo dufashe akaba ari byo dukomeza kurwanisha”.

Uyu mugore ngo yamaze guhanura avuga ibyo ngibyo twamubwiye, ‘morale’ iraza, ku buryo mu gicengezi, abantu benshi bari bafite ibisongo by’imigano, akumva ko cya gisongo azaza akakirwanisha agafata imbunda.

Ubwo mu 1997 baraje bajya mu gicengezi, bigera mu 1998, ariko kuko ibikoresho byari bicyeya byarangiye bongeye gutsindwa, abenshi bagwa mu gihugu abandi basubira muri Congo.

Begezeyo, bahinduye imvugo, kugira ngo bagarure abantu, babwira umuhanuzi kubwira abantu ko atari ugutsindwa kuko Imana yivuguruje, ahubwo hari ibyo batubahirije, Imana ikaba yabahaniye ibicumuro byabo.

Uwo muhanuzi yagize ati "Mwitwaye nabi, mwarasambanye, mwarasinze, kandi ibyo bintu Imana ntibikunda. Iyo akaba ari yo mpamvu mugomba kwihana, hanyuma Imana igacururuka, noneho gahunda zanyu zigakomeza mugakomeza kurwana”.

Kugira ngo bigire imbaraga, ntabwo bakoresheje abahanuzi bo muri ya matsinda gusa, ahubwo bitabaje n’abandi bo mu Bakongomani.

Agira ati "Ushobora gufata umuhanuzi nubwo yaba ari we nyawe, ariko kuko hari inyungu zawe ufite,…kubera icyo umuhaye akora ibyo umusabye. Twasabye kuza bakabwira abantu ko Imana icururutse iduhaye amahoro kandi itwemereye ko koko urugamba tugomba kururwana, tukarukomeza kuko tuzatsinda. Ubwo abantu bamaze kumva ibyo, barihana, barongera muri gahunda buri wese yumva ko agomba kujya kurwana, yaba abari basigaye muri Congo bataracengeye n’abandi bose, ingengabitekerezo igenda ibajyamo…”.

Mbaga yakomeje avuga ko ikindi kintu gifasha abo bari muri FDLR, ari uko iyo hagize umuntu wakoze icyaha cya Jenoside uhunga akagerayo, adafatwa nk’uhunze, ahubwo afatwa nk’umuhanuzi, agatanga ubuhamya, akabeshya ibintu bibi ku Rwanda, ababyumva bakagira ngo ni ukuri bigatuma ngo ntawutekereza kugaruka mu gihugu.

Yagize ati,” Turamubwira tuti ntugomba kuvuga ko uhunze, ahubwo urabwira abantu ko ari Imana yakweretse, ugende uvuga n’ibitangaza wakoze mu nzira ko ku mupaka wahanyuze n’amaguru ntihagire ukubona cyangwa ngo aguhagarike, tugashaka n’imirongo muri Bibiliya ijyana nabyo…tukamubwira tuti ibyiza byo mu gihugu byose, ubigire bibi…ibyo avuze byose abantu babyemera vuba kuko baba bavuga bati yari abirimo, ibyo byose byakubitiraho bwa buhanuzi ko Imana yaduhaye igihugu bigatuma nta muntu utekereza gutaha”.

Mbaga akomeza asobanura ko mu nzeho FDLR harimo ababa bashinzwe ibijyanye n’iyobokamana no gusenga, ndetse no gutanga ubutumwa bujyanye n’amasengesho mu basirikare bazwi nka ba ‘aumôniers’, abo ngo bafasha abasirikare guhorana icyizere.

Yagize ati, “ Iyo hari ibigomba gusengerwa, abo nibo babitegurira amasengesho, bagategura na ba bantu bagomba guhanura, bakababwira ibyo bagomba guhanura, noneho bamara kubitanga, ubuhanuzi bwamara gutambuka bakaza kongera gutanga raporo, bavuga bati, bya bindi byatambutse, ubuhanuzi bwakwiye hose,…”.

Muri rusange, muri FDLR ngo hariyo gahunda y’uko ku wa Gatanu w’icyumweru, abasirikare bose ndetse n’abayobozi babo baba bagomba gusenga bakiyiriza ubusa, hanyuma ku wa Gatandatu hagasenga abaturage b’abasivili.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0JZ0-9KQ4.body:
Esther Dushimiteka si umubaji gusa, ahubwo arabarusha

Muri abo 22 barushanwe ku rwego rw’Igihugu, abakobwa ni babiri bonyine. Muri rusange no mu kazi aho bakorera ngo abakobwa n’abagore baracyari bacye, dore ko ububaji ari umurimo wakunze kwitabirwa n’abagabo.

Dushimiteka asanga abakobwa n’abagore bagitekereza ko ububaji bugenewe abagabo gusa bakwiriye guhindura imyumvire.

Agira ati “Baratinya bakumva ko ububaji ari umwuga w’abagabo, ariko usanga no muri sosiyete hari ababaca intege bakababwira ko batabishobora, n’ubyize akagira ubunebwe bwo kubikora kubera gucibwa intege, nyuma yo kubyiga ntabikore agashaka ibindi ajya gukora.”

Dushimiteka avuga ko agitangira kubyiga na we yahuye n’abamuca intege bakamubwira ko uyu mwuga atari uw’abakobwa. Icyakora we aho kumuca intege ahubwo byamuteye imbaraga, yiga ashyizeho umwete ndetse mu ishuri akanabitsinda, bimuhesha amahirwe yo kubona akazi muri kampani ikorera i Rubengera muri Karongi.

Asobanura uburyo aka kazi kamufitiye akamaro, yagize ati “Mbasha kwigurira ikintu cyose nkeneye. Nta kintu na kimwe nshobora gusaba ababyeyi cyangwa undi muntu, kandi mbasha no kwiyishyurira kaminuza kuko niga mu mpera z’icyumweru (Weekend) byose mbikesha amafaranga nkura aho nkorera. Nzi gukora ibikoresho byose byaba ibyo mu rugo nk’intebe, ameza, ibyo mu gikoni ndetse n’ibyo mu biro.”

Dushimiteka agira inama abagore n’abakobwa bumva ko ububaji ari umwuga w’abagabo, ati “Ikintu nababwira ni uko icya mbere bagomba kubikunda, bakirengagiza ababaca intege, ahubwo bakabereka ko na bo babishobora.”

Umusore witwa Ihirwe Christian ukorera ububaji i Karongi na we yemeza ko abakobwa bakiri bacye muri aka kazi, akabashishikariza gutinyuka kuko na bo bagashobora cyane ko ubu hari ibikoresho byorohereza ugakora ku buryo bidasaba imbaraga nyinshi. Atanga urugero rw’aho bakorera harimo abakobwa babiri mu gihe abahungu ari icumi.'

Ati “Si akazi gasaba imbaraga nyinshi kuko ahantu dukorera hari imashini, ntabwo bidusaba guterura ibintu biremereye. Ahubwo hari abakobwa bumva ko kwambara imyenda y’akazi ari ibintu bibasebya, ntibashake gusa nabi. Rero bakwiye guhindura imyumvire kuko aka kazi bagashobora kandi karimo amafaranga.”

Ihuriro ryitwa STECOMA (Syndicat des Travailleurs des Entreprises de Construction, Menuiserie, Artisanat) ry'abubatsi, ababaji n'abanyabukorikori mu Rwanda, rifasha abakozi mu kazi kabo, gukora ubuvugizi, no guteza imbere ubumenyi bwabo, rivuga ko mu Gihugu hose harabarurwa ababaji 1960 bakorana na ryo harimo na 530 bahawe kuri uyu wa Gatanu ibyemezo by’uko bafite ubumenyi muri uwo mwuga kandi bemerewe kuwukora kinyamwuga.

Habyarimana Evariste, Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa STECOMA, na we yemeza ko abagore n’abakobwa bakwiye guhindura imyumvire ntibite ku muco wo hambere n’imyumvire yari iriho yo kumva ko ububaji ari umwuga w’abagabo gusa.

Yagize ati “Abagore n’abakobwa na bo barashoboye. Ubu twatangiye kubashishikariza kwitabira ububaji, dushyiraho komite z’abagore n’abakobwa zikangurira bagenzi babo kuza muri uyu murimo kuko bashobora gukora n’ibiruta ibyo abagabo bakora. Imibare iracyari micyeya ariko turimo kugerageza ku buryo baza mu mwuga ari benshi. Mbere umuco ntiwemeraga ko abagore cyangwa abakobwa bajya muri iyi mirimo ariko muri iki gihe tugezemo ni ngombwa ko na bo badasigara inyuma kuko iyi mirimo ni yo irimo amafaranga.”

Mu rwego rwo kongera umubare w’abagore bitabira uyu mwuga ndetse no kuwubakundisha, ubwo kuri uyu wa Gatanu i Kigali hizihizwaga ku rwego rw’Igihugu Umunsi Mukuru w’Umubaji (Umubaji Day) wizihijwe ku nshuro ya gatatu, hatangijwe amahuriro y'abagore (clubs) atanu azakorera hirya no hino mu Gihugu mu rwego rwo gushishikariza abagore n’abakobwa ububaji.

Sendika ya STECOMA ishimira abafatanyabikorwa bagira uruhare mu gutuma yesa imihigo barimo RTB, CESTRAR, Minisiteri y’Abakozi ba Leta n’Umurimo, Ambasade y’u Budage, na proWOOD+ by’umwihariko nk’umufatanyabikorwa ukomeye mu bikorwa byo guteza imbere ububaji.

Sendika ya STECOMA ishimira abafatanyabikorwa bagira uruhare mu gutuma yesa imihigo barimo RTB, CESTRAR, Minisiteri y’Abakozi ba Leta n’Umurimo, Ambasade y’u Budage, na proWOOD+ by’umwihariko nk’umufatanyabikorwa ukomeye mu bikorwa byo guteza imbere ububaji.

ART-MU8U0KJ9-90F6.body:
Uko Perezida Tshisekedi yahaye FDLR ikaze mu ngabo ze

Ubwo bari mu Kiganiro kidasanzwe kuri KT Radio, kuri uyu wa 20 Kanama 2026, bamwe mu bahoze mu buyobozi bwa FDLR bagafata icyemezo cyo kwitandukanya nayo, bavuze ko kugeza ubu ingengabitekerezo ya FDLR muri RDC, utamenya aho uhera uyikura mu bantu, kubera ko yamaze kugera mu benegihugu (Abanyekongo), ku buryo ingabo za FRDC, Wazalendo na FDLR, ari abantu bamwe udashobora kuvangura.

Ibi ngo bishingiye ahanini mu icengezamatwara n’ingengabitekerezo FDLR yacengeje cyera mu bwoko bw’Abanyekongo bwitwa ‘Abatabwa’, hamwe n’abandi Banyarwanda bajyanywe cyera muri Katanga mu mirimo y’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro bagaherayo, ariko bakaba bakivuga Ikinyarwanda, banafite amazina y’Abanyarwanda.

Lt Col (Rtd) Idrissa Bizimana, wari uzwi nka Idrissa Kanzamuradadi muri FDLR, wayoboraga batayo ya 2 ikorera muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo, wanigeze kuba mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu umuyobozi ushinzwe icengezamatwara, Politike na Purotokole avuga ko bemeje abo Banyarwanda ko kugira ngo bazatahe kuri gakondo yabo, ari uko babohereza abana bakabigisha bakabashyira mu gisirikare.

Ati “Barabohereza turabigisha, bamwe baba aba ofisiye, ndetse n’abasirikare bato. Aho bihindukiye Isi itwikaragiyeho, nyuma y’amasezerano ya Sun City (yasinyiwe muri Afurika y’Epfo mu 2002 hagati ya RDC n’imitwe yitwaje intwaro), abo ngabo babonye ko nta cyerekezo, ko dutsinzwe nanone. Bahise bagenda, basanga Abanyekongo mu ngabo za RDC, barabakira, cyane ko babaga bazi ko umu FDLR ari umuntu uzi kurwana. Ubu ngubu ingengabitekerezo twabashyizemo bayinjiranye muri FARDC.”

Yungamo ati “Hari abandi bagiye bajya mu ba Mai Mai, ubu bamaze kuba Wazalendo, iyo ngengabitekerezo barayijyanye. Aho bigeze birazwi ko Tshisekedi (Perezida wa RDC), afasha FDLR ku mugaragaro yayigize abana be. Ubwo rero ntabwo iriya ngengabitekerezo ya FDLR, ntiteze kuranduka muri RDC, igihe cyose Tshisekedi, akibafata nk’abana be.”

Pasiteri Jean Damascene Niyonzima, wahoze ari umuyobozi w’Akarere wungirije mu cyahoze ari Komine Kinyami mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, muri FDLR akaba yari ashinzwe iperereza ry’imbere muri uwo mutwe avuga ko Perezida Tshisekedi, afasha FDLR mu buryo bwose, kuko yabanje ibyiciro by’Abanyekongo byatojwe bikigishwa na FDLR (Mai-Mai na Nyatura), akabagira umutwe umwe wa Wazalendo.

Ati “Ntiwatandukanya Wazalendo w’umunyekongo na FDLR kuko bose ni bamwe, iyo bari ku rugamba intambara bayirwana bari kumwe na FARDC (Ingabo za RDC), ntushobora kubavangura. Uko aba FARDC babaha ibikoresho, ni ko na ba FDLR babaha ibikoresho ndetse n’imishahara, uwo, uwo muri FARDC afata, niyo n’uwo muri FDLR afata. Ibikoresho ndetse n’uwakomeretse indege iyo zije gutwara uwakomeretse wo muri FARDC n’uwo muri FDLR bagendera hamwe kandi bakabavuriza ku bitaro bimwe. Ibyo byose ni Tshisekedi, wabikoze.”

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0L34-DJ5C.body:
Banyita Kanyamasanduku, kandi ndabikunda cyane - umucuruzi utanga serivise zo guherekeza abitabye Imana

Abacuruza ibintu bitandukanye baba bafuza ko abakiriya biyongera kugira ngo ubucuruzi bwabo bukomeze kugenda neza, ariko se abacuruza amasanduku ashyingurwamo abapfuye n’ibindi bijyana nayo, nk’imodoka zitwara imirambo ku irimbi, nabo baba bifuza ko abantu bapfa ari benshi kugira ngo babone abakiriya benshi, bityo bizinesi yabo igenda neza kurshaho? Icyo kibazo nicyo Niyishobora Milliam asubiza nk’umuntu umaze igihe atanga iyo serivisi.

Niyishobora Milliam bakunda kwita Mitego, ni umukobwa ufite imyaka 24 y’amavuko, ubu akora mu iduka ritanga serivisi zijyana no gushyingura abantu bapfuye, harimo kubaha isanduku, ndetse n’imodoka zizitwara zizwi cyane ku izina ‘korobiyari’(corbillard).

Gucuruza serivisi zijyana ngo gushyingura abapfuye, ni bizinesi y’umuryango wa Niyishobora, kuko ngo yakuze asanga ababyeyi be, ari yo bakora mu Mujyi wa Kigali kugeza nubu. Niyishobora akorera mu iduka ritanga izo serivisi, uwo muryango wafunguye mu Karere ka Bugesera mu rwego rwo kwagura bizinesi.

Niyishobora ati,” Nkigera hano i Nyamata nashakaga gukora ikintu cyatuma bamenya, bakamenya na serivisi ntanga. Ubu ahantu hose ntambuka,baravuga bati uriya ni Kanyamasanduku, nta kibazo bintera ngo ni uko ndi umukobwa bahamagara batyo, ahubwo mba numva ari byiza cyane. Kuko icyo biba bivuze ni uko uwo wabaza wese muri abo banyita uko, uti ni hehe nakura ibikoresho bijyanye na ‘serivisi za burundu’, bamwereka hano. Kuko twebwe dutanga serivisi za burundu. Kuko umuntu aba yagiye, atazagaruka, izo serivisi tumuha ni iza burundu, mu Cyongereza bo babyitwa ‘funeral services)”.

Niyishobora avuga ko mu myaka myinshi umuryango we umaze ukora iyo bizinesi yo gucuruza serivisi zijyana no gushyingura, babonye ko hari amezi y’umwaka babonamo abakiriya benshi kurusha andi. Ayo mezi ni ukwezi kwa Kane, ukwa Karindwi ndetse n’ukwa cumi n’abiri.

Yagize ati,” Ntabwo namenya gusobanura ikibitera, ariko mu kwezi kwa Kane, simbura abakiriya. Hashobora kuza umwe ku munsi, cyangwa se 2, hari n’ubwo ushobora kubona abagera kuri 6 ku munsi. Ntabwo umubare muri uko kwa Kane uzamurwa no kuba hari isanduku zigurwa zishyingurwamo imibiri y’abishwe muri Jenoside yabonetse, kuko iryo soko ntabwo turihabwa buri gihe. Kandi niba binaterwa n’ubukonje buba buhari simbizi, ariko muri uko kwezi kwa Kane, hakunze gupfa n’abana b’impinja benshi. Ariko mu yandi mezi hari nubwo mara iminsi itatu nta mukiriya uje. Byagera mu kwa Karindwi umubare w’abakiriya ukongera ukazamuka cyane. Nk’ubu turi mu kwa Munani, abakiriya baba ari bacyeya cyane, ntigushobora kumera nk’ukwezi kwa cumi n’abiri, niba ari uko umwaka uba urangiye, simbizi ariko usanga haba impanuka, abantu bagapfa cyane…”

Tugera ku iduka rya Niyishobora, twasanze arimo aganira na mugenzi we bakorana, amubwira ati "wa murwayi byarangiye".

Icyo kiganiro cyatumye tumubaza uko yiyumva iyo hari amakuru amenye y’umuntu wapfuye, niba abyumva nk’amahirwe y’ubucuruzi yiyongereye cyangwa se niba ababara nawe kuko hari umuryango ugize ibyago.

Asubiza icyo kibazo yagize ati,” ntakubeshye, simba mvuga ngo umuntu napfe mbone akazi, ariko nk’iyo tugiye gukura umuntu muri ‘morgue’ agiye gushyingurwa, kuko ari twe tujyana isanduku, maze nareba nkabona irizuye, ndatekereza nti uko byagenda kose, niba muri ‘morgue’ hajyamo imirambo y’abantu batandatu, sindi buburemo batatu nkorera, wenda abandi bagakorerwa n’abandi kuko turi nka batatu batanga izo serivisi muri kano gace. Ntangira akazi saa kumi n’ebyiri za mu gitondo,ngafunga saa tanu z’ijoro, kandi aha nkorera niho ndara , ku buryo iyo ku bitaro hagize ukenera isanduku n’ibindi bijyana nayo mba niteguye”.

“Nkanjye iyi ni bizinesi yanjye, urabona ko duturanye cyane n’ibitaro by’Akarere ka Bugesera, nshobora kuzamuka nkabaza abakora ku buruhukiro bw’ibitaro nti bimeze bite se, akazi karahari…?Nanashyize numero zanjye za telefoni ku muryango w’aho ku buruhukiro ku buryo ukeneye izi serivisi dutanga, aba ashobora kuduhamagara”.

Niyishobora yemeza ko ubu bizinesi ye igenda neza ariko bitaragera aho yifuza, kuko ubundi yifuza ko byazagera aho abantu bose babona ko ari we utanga izo serivisi neza, maze abazikeneye bose akaba ari we baza bashaka gusa.

Yagize ati,” Nk’ubu iyo numvise ko hari ahabaye impanuka hano hafi, igahitana nk’abantu batanu, mba numva bahita bampamagara bati kora amasanduku yabo bose, ariko ibyo ntibikunda kuko hari abo dusangiye isoko kandi simbyanze twese dukeneye kurya. Ariko njyewe ntabwo nifuza ko abantu bapfa, mba nifuza babandi nyine bamaze gupfa bagezeyo, mba nsaba Imana nti bariya bantu bose banyoboreho. Naho ngiye kwifuza gupfa, nanjye nagenda, na mama yagenda na barumuna banjye bagenda."

Niyishobora asobanura ko ubu abatanga izo serivisi za burundu nk’uko bazita, muri iki gihe biyongereye, kuko mbere ngo yatangwaga n’abantu bacye cyane abandi bakayitinya, none ubu ngo babifata nka bizinesi isanzwe nk’izindi.

Uko kuyijyamo ari benshi, byatumye ibiciro bihinduka cyane, biragabanuka ku buryo isanduku yaguraga nka 900.000Frw, ubu ngo ishobora kuboneka no kuri 700.000Frw, kuko hari abacuruzi benshi bahuriye ku isoko rimwe.

Yagize ati, “ Mbere abantu batinyaga kujya muri ubu bucuruzi kuko batinya amasanduku n’imisaraba …ariko njyewe sintinya isanduku, nzibona nk’ibisanzwe nanaziryamamo nta kibazo, ubu rero usanga abantu baza muri iyi bizinesi bariyongereye cyane, bigatuma ibiciro byarapfuye, ariko iracyari bizinesi ndota kuzakora ubuzima bwanjye bwose kuko ndayikunda”.

Isanduku ikorwa ite, babwirwa n'iki iyakwira nyakwigendera?

Niyishobora avuga ko mu gukora isanduku bagira ibintu byinshi bitaho harimo kumenya ibyiciro by’imyaka, indeshyo cyane cyane ku bana bitewe n’igikuriro n’ibindi.

Hanyuma guhera ku mezi atanu kugeza ku mwaka nabo ngo ziba zingana, …zigatandukanira ku mbaho zikozwemo n’agaciro kazo. Isanduku z’abana Niyishobora acuruza, zigurishwa hagati ya 50.000-150.000Frw, bitewe n’uko ikozwe, ibiyiriho niba ifite imikondo cyangwa se itayifite n’ibindi.

Ku bantu bakuru, isanduku zose afite ziba zipima metero ebyiri z’uburebure na santimetero 60 mu bugari, keretse rimwe na rimwe ngo nibwo bakora izihendutse cyane zipima metero imwe na santimetero 80, ariko zigakunda guteza ibibazo kuko hari ubwo umuntu ayigura bikarangira nyakwigendera adakwiriwemo bigasaba kuyisubiza.

Niyishobora ati,” Ubusanzwe dukora amasanduku menshi tukayazana hano hakaba huzuye. Ariko ntabwo dupima buri muntu cyangwa se umurambo wose, tugiye gukorera. Haba hari ibipimo wavuga ko bihuriweho n’abantu benshi, ku bantu bakuru, isanduku zose dukora ziba zifite metero ebyiri z’uburebure na santimetero 60 mu bugari, kandi izo abenshi bazikwirwamo. Ubu iyo nakwirwamo nawe wayikwirwamo, nubwo tutanganye ubunini, kandi tukaba tutareshya”.

“Icya ngombwa ni uko umutwe uba ugaragara mu kirahuri mu gihe cyo gusezera, nubwo umuntu yaba ari mugufi amaguru atagera hepfo ngo yuzuremo hose ntacyo biba bitwaye. Ariko iyo umuntu wapfuye arengeje ibiro 150 aho bisaba kumupima, kugiran ngo tumukorere isanduku yihariye akwirwamo, kuko uwo ntabwo akwirwa muri izi zifite ibipimo bisanzwe. Icyo gihe tumupima mu bitugu no mu gatuza, kuko iyo ibitugu bikwirwamo n’ibindi bice bijyamo”.

“ Isanduku tugurisha hano, ziba ziri mu byiciro bitewe n’uko zikozwe n’ibyo zikozwemo. Hari isanduku zikorwa muri ‘ribuyu’, izindi mu byitwa ‘muvura’ ndetse na ‘Emudiyefu’ (MDF). Izo tugurisha menshi ni 700.000 Frw, izindi zikagura 250.000Frw, ariko zijyana n’ibyo twita ‘package’, ni ukuvuga zirimo imibavu iterwa ku murambo (parfum), amashuka abiri mashya, umusego, ururabo rushyirwa ku isanduku, umusaraba ndetse na ka kantu kandikwaho amazina n’amatariki y’igihe cyo kuvuka no gupfa kwa nyakwigendera”.

“Hari kandi n’ikindi cyiciro cy’isanduku dukora twavuga ko ari iz’abafite amikoro macyeya ziba ziri hagati ya 60.000-100.000Frw, izo rero zikunze kuduteza ‘ingaru’ (kugarura icyaguzwe kuko hari ibitagenze neza), hari ubwo umuntu wapfushije uwe, aza hano akatubaza isanduku ihendutse dufite, tukamwereka, tukamubaza niba abona umuntu we yakwirwamo, akatubwira ko akwirwamo rwose akurikije uko abibona. Ariko yagerayo bamushyiramo bikanga. Icyo gihe ahita agaruka adutonganya, ariko ni ibintu tuzi ko bigomba kuba muri aka kazi kacu, nubwo yadukubita, tuba dusabwa kubyemera, kuko ntugomba kubwira nabi umuntu wabuze uwe, cyangwa se kumwakira nabi, kuko aba afite umujagararo ‘stress’ muri we, icyo gihe, tumwereka indi yatwara tukamusaba kongeraho amafaranga runaka. Isanduku yagaruwe nk’uko, tuyikuramo ibitambaro biba bidodewemo imbere, tukabijugunya, tugashyiramo ibindi bishya…”.

“ Ikindi ubona abantu bakunda kwitaho mu gihe bahitamo amasanduku, ni ibyo nakwita nk’imirimbo. Hari umuryango wigeze kuza hano ufite umubyeyi urembye, uhitamo isanduku tumubikira iyi iriho umusaraba ubambyeho Yezu, kuko ngo Nyina yarawukundaga. Abenshi rero, cyane cyane abakirisitu Gatolika, bakunda izi sanduku ziriho imisaraba. Iyo uwapfuye ari uwo mu Bahamya ba Yehova, badusaba gukuraho ibi byose, byanditseho ‘ruhukira mu mahoro’ (RIP), gukuraho indabo, yewe n’umusaraba ntawo watwara. Bo baba bashaka isanduku y’umweru gusa itariho ikindi kintu na kimwe”.

“ Ku Bayisilamu bo, nta sanduku bagura, na ya modoka itwara imirambo ntibayikodesha hano, kuko bagira iyabo iba ari umweru iriho ibirango byabo, ifite uko ikozwemo imbere bitandukanye n’izacu, iza ivuye i Kigali…”.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

content_blocks.text: Banyita Kanyamasanduku, kandi ndabikunda cyane - umucuruzi utanga serivise zo guherekeza abitabye Imana

Abacuruza ibintu bitandukanye baba bafuza ko abakiriya biyongera kugira ngo ubucuruzi bwabo bukomeze kugenda neza, ariko se abacuruza amasanduku ashyingurwamo abapfuye n’ibindi bijyana nayo, nk’imodoka zitwara imirambo ku irimbi, nabo baba bifuza ko abantu bapfa ari benshi kugira ngo babone abakiriya benshi, bityo bizinesi yabo igenda neza kurshaho? Icyo kibazo nicyo Niyishobora Milliam asubiza nk’umuntu umaze igihe atanga iyo serivisi.

Niyishobora Milliam bakunda kwita Mitego, ni umukobwa ufite imyaka 24 y’amavuko, ubu akora mu iduka ritanga serivisi zijyana no gushyingura abantu bapfuye, harimo kubaha isanduku, ndetse n’imodoka zizitwara zizwi cyane ku izina ‘korobiyari’(corbillard).

Gucuruza serivisi zijyana ngo gushyingura abapfuye, ni bizinesi y’umuryango wa Niyishobora, kuko ngo yakuze asanga ababyeyi be, ari yo bakora mu Mujyi wa Kigali kugeza nubu. Niyishobora akorera mu iduka ritanga izo serivisi, uwo muryango wafunguye mu Karere ka Bugesera mu rwego rwo kwagura bizinesi.

Niyishobora ati,” Nkigera hano i Nyamata nashakaga gukora ikintu cyatuma bamenya, bakamenya na serivisi ntanga. Ubu ahantu hose ntambuka,baravuga bati uriya ni Kanyamasanduku, nta kibazo bintera ngo ni uko ndi umukobwa bahamagara batyo, ahubwo mba numva ari byiza cyane. Kuko icyo biba bivuze ni uko uwo wabaza wese muri abo banyita uko, uti ni hehe nakura ibikoresho bijyanye na ‘serivisi za burundu’, bamwereka hano. Kuko twebwe dutanga serivisi za burundu. Kuko umuntu aba yagiye, atazagaruka, izo serivisi tumuha ni iza burundu, mu Cyongereza bo babyitwa ‘funeral services)”.

Niyishobora avuga ko mu myaka myinshi umuryango we umaze ukora iyo bizinesi yo gucuruza serivisi zijyana no gushyingura, babonye ko hari amezi y’umwaka babonamo abakiriya benshi kurusha andi. Ayo mezi ni ukwezi kwa Kane, ukwa Karindwi ndetse n’ukwa cumi n’abiri.

Yagize ati,” Ntabwo namenya gusobanura ikibitera, ariko mu kwezi kwa Kane, simbura abakiriya. Hashobora kuza umwe ku munsi, cyangwa se 2, hari n’ubwo ushobora kubona abagera kuri 6 ku munsi. Ntabwo umubare muri uko kwa Kane uzamurwa no kuba hari isanduku zigurwa zishyingurwamo imibiri y’abishwe muri Jenoside yabonetse, kuko iryo soko ntabwo turihabwa buri gihe. Kandi niba binaterwa n’ubukonje buba buhari simbizi, ariko muri uko kwezi kwa Kane, hakunze gupfa n’abana b’impinja benshi. Ariko mu yandi mezi hari nubwo mara iminsi itatu nta mukiriya uje. Byagera mu kwa Karindwi umubare w’abakiriya ukongera ukazamuka cyane. Nk’ubu turi mu kwa Munani, abakiriya baba ari bacyeya cyane, ntigushobora kumera nk’ukwezi kwa cumi n’abiri, niba ari uko umwaka uba urangiye, simbizi ariko usanga haba impanuka, abantu bagapfa cyane…”
Tugera ku iduka rya Niyishobora, twasanze arimo aganira na mugenzi we bakorana, amubwira ati "wa murwayi byarangiye".
Icyo kiganiro cyatumye tumubaza uko yiyumva iyo hari amakuru amenye y’umuntu wapfuye, niba abyumva nk’amahirwe y’ubucuruzi yiyongereye cyangwa se niba ababara nawe kuko hari umuryango ugize ibyago.

Asubiza icyo kibazo yagize ati,” ntakubeshye, simba mvuga ngo umuntu napfe mbone akazi, ariko nk’iyo tugiye gukura umuntu muri ‘morgue’ agiye gushyingurwa, kuko ari twe tujyana isanduku, maze nareba nkabona irizuye, ndatekereza nti uko byagenda kose, niba muri ‘morgue’ hajyamo imirambo y’abantu batandatu, sindi buburemo batatu nkorera, wenda abandi bagakorerwa n’abandi kuko turi nka batatu batanga izo serivisi muri kano gace. Ntangira akazi saa kumi n’ebyiri za mu gitondo,ngafunga saa tanu z’ijoro, kandi aha nkorera niho ndara , ku buryo iyo ku bitaro hagize ukenera isanduku n’ibindi bijyana nayo mba niteguye”.

“Nkanjye iyi ni bizinesi yanjye, urabona ko duturanye cyane n’ibitaro by’Akarere ka Bugesera, nshobora kuzamuka nkabaza abakora ku buruhukiro bw’ibitaro nti bimeze bite se, akazi karahari…?Nanashyize numero zanjye za telefoni ku muryango w’aho ku buruhukiro ku buryo ukeneye izi serivisi dutanga, aba ashobora kuduhamagara”.

Niyishobora yemeza ko ubu bizinesi ye igenda neza ariko bitaragera aho yifuza, kuko ubundi yifuza ko byazagera aho abantu bose babona ko ari we utanga izo serivisi neza, maze abazikeneye bose akaba ari we baza bashaka gusa.

Yagize ati,” Nk’ubu iyo numvise ko hari ahabaye impanuka hano hafi, igahitana nk’abantu batanu, mba numva bahita bampamagara bati kora amasanduku yabo bose, ariko ibyo ntibikunda kuko hari abo dusangiye isoko kandi simbyanze twese dukeneye kurya. Ariko njyewe ntabwo nifuza ko abantu bapfa, mba nifuza babandi nyine bamaze gupfa bagezeyo, mba nsaba Imana nti bariya bantu bose banyoboreho. Naho ngiye kwifuza gupfa, nanjye nagenda, na mama yagenda na barumuna banjye bagenda."

Niyishobora asobanura ko ubu abatanga izo serivisi za burundu nk’uko bazita, muri iki gihe biyongereye, kuko mbere ngo yatangwaga n’abantu bacye cyane abandi bakayitinya, none ubu ngo babifata nka bizinesi isanzwe nk’izindi.

Uko kuyijyamo ari benshi, byatumye ibiciro bihinduka cyane, biragabanuka ku buryo isanduku yaguraga nka 900.000Frw, ubu ngo ishobora kuboneka no kuri 700.000Frw, kuko hari abacuruzi benshi bahuriye ku isoko rimwe.

Yagize ati, “ Mbere abantu batinyaga kujya muri ubu bucuruzi kuko batinya amasanduku n’imisaraba …ariko njyewe sintinya isanduku, nzibona nk’ibisanzwe nanaziryamamo nta kibazo, ubu rero usanga abantu baza muri iyi bizinesi bariyongereye cyane, bigatuma ibiciro byarapfuye, ariko iracyari bizinesi ndota kuzakora ubuzima bwanjye bwose kuko ndayikunda”.
Isanduku ikorwa ite, babwirwa n'iki iyakwira nyakwigendera?
Niyishobora avuga ko mu gukora isanduku bagira ibintu byinshi bitaho harimo kumenya ibyiciro by’imyaka, indeshyo cyane cyane ku bana bitewe n’igikuriro n’ibindi.

Hanyuma guhera ku mezi atanu kugeza ku mwaka nabo ngo ziba zingana, …zigatandukanira ku mbaho zikozwemo n’agaciro kazo. Isanduku z’abana Niyishobora acuruza, zigurishwa hagati ya 50.000-150.000Frw, bitewe n’uko ikozwe, ibiyiriho niba ifite imikondo cyangwa se itayifite n’ibindi.

Ku bantu bakuru, isanduku zose afite ziba zipima metero ebyiri z’uburebure na santimetero 60 mu bugari, keretse rimwe na rimwe ngo nibwo bakora izihendutse cyane zipima metero imwe na santimetero 80, ariko zigakunda guteza ibibazo kuko hari ubwo umuntu ayigura bikarangira nyakwigendera adakwiriwemo bigasaba kuyisubiza.

Niyishobora ati,” Ubusanzwe dukora amasanduku menshi tukayazana hano hakaba huzuye. Ariko ntabwo dupima buri muntu cyangwa se umurambo wose, tugiye gukorera. Haba hari ibipimo wavuga ko bihuriweho n’abantu benshi, ku bantu bakuru, isanduku zose dukora ziba zifite metero ebyiri z’uburebure na santimetero 60 mu bugari, kandi izo abenshi bazikwirwamo. Ubu iyo nakwirwamo nawe wayikwirwamo, nubwo tutanganye ubunini, kandi tukaba tutareshya”.

“Icya ngombwa ni uko umutwe uba ugaragara mu kirahuri mu gihe cyo gusezera, nubwo umuntu yaba ari mugufi amaguru atagera hepfo ngo yuzuremo hose ntacyo biba bitwaye. Ariko iyo umuntu wapfuye arengeje ibiro 150 aho bisaba kumupima, kugiran ngo tumukorere isanduku yihariye akwirwamo, kuko uwo ntabwo akwirwa muri izi zifite ibipimo bisanzwe. Icyo gihe tumupima mu bitugu no mu gatuza, kuko iyo ibitugu bikwirwamo n’ibindi bice bijyamo”.

“ Isanduku tugurisha hano, ziba ziri mu byiciro bitewe n’uko zikozwe n’ibyo zikozwemo. Hari isanduku zikorwa muri ‘ribuyu’, izindi mu byitwa ‘muvura’ ndetse na ‘Emudiyefu’ (MDF). Izo tugurisha menshi ni 700.000 Frw, izindi zikagura 250.000Frw, ariko zijyana n’ibyo twita ‘package’, ni ukuvuga zirimo imibavu iterwa ku murambo (parfum), amashuka abiri mashya, umusego, ururabo rushyirwa ku isanduku, umusaraba ndetse na ka kantu kandikwaho amazina n’amatariki y’igihe cyo kuvuka no gupfa kwa nyakwigendera”.

“Hari kandi n’ikindi cyiciro cy’isanduku dukora twavuga ko ari iz’abafite amikoro macyeya ziba ziri hagati ya 60.000-100.000Frw, izo rero zikunze kuduteza ‘ingaru’ (kugarura icyaguzwe kuko hari ibitagenze neza), hari ubwo umuntu wapfushije uwe, aza hano akatubaza isanduku ihendutse dufite, tukamwereka, tukamubaza niba abona umuntu we yakwirwamo, akatubwira ko akwirwamo rwose akurikije uko abibona. Ariko yagerayo bamushyiramo bikanga. Icyo gihe ahita agaruka adutonganya, ariko ni ibintu tuzi ko bigomba kuba muri aka kazi kacu, nubwo yadukubita, tuba dusabwa kubyemera, kuko ntugomba kubwira nabi umuntu wabuze uwe, cyangwa se kumwakira nabi, kuko aba afite umujagararo ‘stress’ muri we, icyo gihe, tumwereka indi yatwara tukamusaba kongeraho amafaranga runaka. Isanduku yagaruwe nk’uko, tuyikuramo ibitambaro biba bidodewemo imbere, tukabijugunya, tugashyiramo ibindi bishya…”.

“ Ikindi ubona abantu bakunda kwitaho mu gihe bahitamo amasanduku, ni ibyo nakwita nk’imirimbo. Hari umuryango wigeze kuza hano ufite umubyeyi urembye, uhitamo isanduku tumubikira iyi iriho umusaraba ubambyeho Yezu, kuko ngo Nyina yarawukundaga. Abenshi rero, cyane cyane abakirisitu Gatolika, bakunda izi sanduku ziriho imisaraba. Iyo uwapfuye ari uwo mu Bahamya ba Yehova, badusaba gukuraho ibi byose, byanditseho ‘ruhukira mu mahoro’ (RIP), gukuraho indabo, yewe n’umusaraba ntawo watwara. Bo baba bashaka isanduku y’umweru gusa itariho ikindi kintu na kimwe”.

“ Ku Bayisilamu bo, nta sanduku bagura, na ya modoka itwara imirambo ntibayikodesha hano, kuko bagira iyabo iba ari umweru iriho ibirango byabo, ifite uko ikozwemo imbere bitandukanye n’izacu, iza ivuye i Kigali…”.
Wanditse
Mediatrice Uwingabire
Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0LMW-6LM0.title: Ku bibwiraga ko nta wakorera ubukwe muri Stade: Rwamushama D. na Kwizera S. barabatinyuye
ART-MU8U0LMW-6LM0.subtitle: Ku bibwiraga ko nta wakorera ubukwe muri Stade: Rwamushama D.
ART-MU8U0LMW-6LM0.summary: Ku bibwiraga ko nta wakorera ubukwe muri Stade: Rwamushama D. na Kwizera S. barabatinyuye Stade kandi zikorerwamo izindi gahunda nk’ibitaramo, ibiterane, amasengesho rusange n’ibindi birori byiganjemo iby’iminsi mikuru yizihizwa ku rwego rw’Igihugu, bigendanye n’inyungu rusange.
ART-MU8U0LMW-6LM0.body:
Ku bibwiraga ko nta wakorera ubukwe muri Stade: Rwamushama D. na Kwizera S. barabatinyuye

Stade kandi zikorerwamo izindi gahunda nk’ibitaramo, ibiterane, amasengesho rusange n’ibindi birori byiganjemo iby’iminsi mikuru yizihizwa ku rwego rw’Igihugu, bigendanye n’inyungu rusange.

Icyakora, ntibimenyerewe ko umuntu ashobora gutegura ibirori birimo ubukwe cyangwa isabukuru y’amavuko akabyizihiriza muri Stade.

Kuba bidakunze kubaho ntibivuze ko bidashoboka, kuko kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, tariki 15 Kanama 2026, Dominique Rwamushama azasezerana na Sandrine Kwizera mu birori bizabera muri Petit Stade i Remera mu Mujyi wa Kigali.

Kigali Today yaganiriye n'Umukwe, atubwira ko nta kidasanzwe bisaba, uretse kwegera ubuyobozi bushinzwe iyi stade mukaganira ku cyo wifuza kuhakorera, maze mukanemeranya ibiciro n'andi mabwiriza yose asabwa.

Yagize ati “Ntabwo Petit Stade yubakiwe imikino gusa. Ntabwo Perezida wa Repubulika ibikorwa remezo agenda atwubakira bifite icyo bitandukaniyeho, ari na yo mpamvu avuga ngo tubibyaze umusaruro. Ntabwo hariya ari ah’imipira gusa, iyo wegereye ubuyobozi bwa hariya kuri Stade, abashinzwe gukurikirana biriya bikorwa remezo Perezida wa Repubulika yatwubakiye, barabikwereka.”

Yungamo ati “Ibirori wakwifuza gukoreramo byose muri rusange barabyakira, hari abantu babishinzwe, urabasobanurira, na Stade nini (Amahoro), ubona ko ibiterane bigari bihabera, urugero ni icy’Abahamya ba Yehova giheruka kuhabera, hari Rwanda Shima Imana irimo gutegurwa, ibyo byose ntabwo ari umukino w’umupira w’amaguru cyangwa iyindi.Wenda hariya ni uko ari muri Stade nini, ariko n’iyi ntoya n’ibindi byose wabihakorera, mu gihe bakweretse uburyo byakorwamo bukakunyura.”

Ngo Umunyarwanda wese akwiye kubanza kumenya ko ibikorwa remezo byose ari we byubakiwe ndetse n’abanyamahanga baba babyifuza.

Ati “Uretse Petit Stade se, hari Umunyarwanda wari wajya muri Perezidanse ngo bamusubize inyuma.? Ibyo Perezida arimo kutwubakira ni iby’Abanyarwanda twese, kandi buri wese arabyemerewe, ahubwo ikiba gikenewe ni ukumenya ngo birakoreshwa ryari? Icyo gihe wegera ubuyobozi bwa buri gikorwa remezo bitewe na serivisi ushaka iyo ari yo, bukagusobanurira.”

Biteganyijwe ko imihango yo gusaba no gukwa muri ubu bukwe, izabera muri Petit Stade Amahoro guhera saa tatu za mu gitondo, hanyuma guhera saa cyenda hakazaba gusezerana imbere y’Imana muri Paruwasi ya Regina Pacis (Remera), nyuma y’iyo mihango abatumiwe bakazakirirwa muri Petit Stade Amahoro.

Mu bandi baheruka gukorera ubukwe mu gikorwa remezo kimenyerewe muri gahunda z’imikino harimo umunyamakuru w’imikino kuri Radio Rwanda, Nepo uzwi nka Mubicu wabukoreye muri ‘NPC Gymnasium’, iri iruhande rwa Petit Stade ku wa 14 Nyakanga 2019.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0M6Q-PJ74.summary: Ngo izuba ryabarembeje? ART-MU8U0M6Q-PJ74.body:
Ngo izuba ryabarembeje? Abanamba bo barifuza ko riva umwaka wose

Mu mpeshyi, imodoka zirandura cyane kubera ivumbi riba ryiyongereye mu mihanda, ibituma ba nyir'imodoka bazijyane kenshi gashoboka mu kinamba kugira ngo zozwe, ku buryo hari n’abashobora kubikora inshuro 3 kugera kuri 5 mu cyumweru, mu gihe mu itumba hari ubwo mu cyumweru imodoka ishobora kozwa rimwe gusa.

Kubera ko abakiliya biyongera mu mpeshyi, bituma n’amafaranga abanamba binjiza ku munsi yiyongera, kubera umubare w’imodoka boza, kuko hari abashobora koza imodoka ziri hejuru ya 10 ku munsi bitewe n’imikorere y’ikinamba, ariko mu itumba hakaboneka iziri munsi ya 5 cyangwa ntizerenge uwo mubare.

Mu gushaka kumenya amakuru yimbitse ku mibereho y’abanamba bo mu Mujyi wa Kigali no mu nkengero zawo, Kigali Today yaraganirije bayitangariza ko ibihe by’impeshyi aribyo baboneramo amafaranga menshi.

Eric Mutsinzi ni umunamba umaze igihe cy’umwaka akorera mu Kinamba cy’ahazwi nko mu Biryogo mu Karere ka Nyarugenge, avuga ko umunsi we w’akazi utangira saa kumi n’ebyiri za mu gitondo, kubera ko ari bwo aba atangiye koza imodoka ya mbere, akakarangiza saa moya z’umugoroba.

Ati “Muri iki gihe cy’impeshyi ntigeze nduhuka guhera mu gitondo, nshobora koza imodoka zigera umunani, kandi imodoka kugira ngo nyoneze neza atari bya bindi byo guhanagura imfata amasaha abiri n’igice byose bikaba bicyeye. Ariko hari na bo ushobora kogereza iminota itarenze icumi ari inyuma urenzaho gusa uhita uhanagura, bakaguha ibihumbi 5, ariko wa wundi ushaka kuyoza neza yose aguha nk’ibihumbi 15Frw cyangwa 20Frw.”

Muri icyo kinamba Mutsinzi akoramo, umunamba ni we wivuganira na nyiri modoka, amafaranga amukiye agakuramo 2500Frw yishyura ikinamba, ayisigaye akaba ay’umunamba.

Mutsinzi ati “Mu gihe cy’itumba nshobora kubona imodoka eshatu mu masaha ya mu gitondo ngahita ndekera aho ngaho, ariko mu gihe cy’impeshyi turoza paka, kuko imodoka ishobora kuva koga ikajya ahantu nko mu Cyumbati haba hari ivumbi ryinshi, icyo gihe ihita igaruka yabaye ivumbi, ryuzuye no muri moteri riba ryagiyemo, bigahita bisaba kongera kuyoza. Ariko iyo ifite icyondo icyo gihe umubosi aravuga ati ndayishyira muri kaburimbo iragenda ishibura ya mazi amapine abe aracyeye.”

Ngo mu gihe cy’impeshyi ku munsi muri icyo kinamba bashobora koza imodoka ziri hagati ya 70-80, mu gihe mu itumba babona iziri hagati ya 15-20.”

Constantin Muhirwa, ni undi munamba uvuga ko ibihe by’impeshyi byiba ari byiza ku banamba ugereranyije no mu Itumba kuko ari bwo bakora cyane.

Jean Paul Isiyande, ni umushoferi wa Banki ya Kigali, avuga ko kubera ingendo nyinshi bakora, bidashobora gukunda ko mu mpeshyi imodoka irara itoze, kuko ziba ziriho ivumbi ryinshi.

Nsengiyumva avuga ko iyo agereranyije amazi akoresha muri ibyo bihe byombi mu kazi ka buri munsi ko koza imodoka, mu gihe cy’impeshyi hakoreshwa menshi, kuko hari n’igihe asanzwe abura bakavomesha.

Tarib Abdul

ART-MU8U0MQJ-S8W1.body:
Nabonye aho abantu batemwa, nabonye aho ababyeyi batwikwa - Karara warokotse ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abanyamulenge mu Gatumba

Mu gikorwa cyo kwibuka ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abanyamulenge mu Gatumba mu Burundi mu 2004, cyabaye kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 13 Kanama 2026, Kalala umwe mu barokotse, yavuze uko batunguwe no kumva amasasu menshi n’amabombe aho bari bari mu nkambi, maze abenshi bo mu muryango we bakahasiga ubuzima akararokana na murumuna we umwe gusa.

Ari kumwe na bagenzi be, barokokanye aho mu Gatumba, Kalala yatangiye ubuhamya bwe, avuga ko mu gihe cyo guhunga bava Uvira muri Congo, baje ari itsinda rya nyuma, kubera byari inshuro ya kabiri bahunga, bibwiraga ko nk'uko byari byagenze mbere, bazongera bagahunguka amahoro.

Kalala avuga ko ahunga yari kumwe na murumuna we n’undi mubyeyi wari inyuma yabo, ariko bageze mu nzira bahunga, bahuye n’Abamayimayi, babambura ibyo bari bafite byose, ndetse bashaka no kubica, ariko umwe aravuga ngo nibabareke bagende.

Ni uko Kalala na bagenzi be bageze ku mupaka wa Congo n’u Burundi basanga ufunguye, barambuka bajya mu Nkambi ya Gatumba. Muri iyo Nkambi niho Kalala n’umuvandimwe we bongeye guhurira n’ababyeyi babo.

Mu ijoro ryo ku wa 13 Kanama 2004, Kalala avuga ko byari byiriwe ari umunsi usanzwe nk’indi, we kimwe n’abandi basore bari biriwe bakina umupira, bajya kuryama bananiwe.

Ariko Kalala mbere yo kuryama, ngo yabanje kujya mu bwiherero kuko bwari kure y’amahema babagamo, maze abona abasirikare benshi yibwira ko ari abarindaga inkambi, kuko n’ubundi habaga abasirikare b’Abarundi barinda iyo nkambi, hamwe n’indi y’impunzi z’Abarundi yari hafi aho. Gusa ngo yabonaga ko abasirikare ari benshi ugereranyije n’uko bisanzwe, ariko ntiyabyitaho ajya kuryama.

Ubusanzwe iyo bamaraga kuryama, ababyeyi bo ngo bajyaga gutarama, Ise wa Kalala we yari n’umucuranzi, rero mu gihe bari bagitaramye, nibwo batangiye kumva amasasu menshi. Kalala wari uryamanye n’abavandimwe be babiri, yakanguwe n’urwo rusaku rw’amasasu, ariko kuko yibwira ko ari ibisanzwe kuko muri iyo myaka, hari Abarundi bajyaga bibana inka muri ako gace ka Gatumba, ugasanga bararasana. Gusa bidatinze yumvise amasasu arimo kurushaho kwigira hafi kandi noneho avanze n’amabombe.

“Nagumye aho umwanya muto kugira ngo ndebe uko bica abantu. Nabonye aho ababyeyi batwikwa, nabonye aho abantu batemwa,abantu barishwe, bicwa urw’agashinyaguro. Abishi bose bavugaga indimi zose, Ikirundi, Ikinyarwanda n’Igiswahili. Bari bafite ingoma, barimo kuririmba, baririmbaga indirimbo z’Imana. Hanyuma ndavuga ngo maze kubona byinshi, reka ngende nanjye niruke. Ngira ngo ndi mu bantu bavuye aho bwa nyuma. Bambonye banyirutse inyuma bandasa, Imana yanjye ngwa mu cyobo, bagira ngo napfiriye muri icyo cyobo. Ni icyobo twakundaga kumenamo amazi n’imyanda, kandi hari nijoro. Nongeye guhaguruka, ndabyibuka nari nambaye agapira k’umweru kariho ibintu bishashagirana, barongera barambona,barongera banyirukaho, nibwo nageze hakurya mpasanga Abarundi n’abandi bari barokotse ari bamwe bakomeretse, hanyuma tujya aho abandi bari bari kwa muganga”.

Kalala asoza ubuhamya bwe, asaba ubutabera, nubwo iryo jambo rimaze imyaka rivugwa ariko abakoze ibyo byose, ngo baracyahari, kandi bahora bumva ubuhamya bw’abarokotse ubwo bwicanyi.

Icyo gihe mu Gatumba hapfuye Abanyamulenge 166, ariko harimo n’ababuriwe irengero kugeza nubu. Ashimangira ngo ubwicanyi bukorerwa Abanyamulenge butabaye aho mu Gatumba honyine, ahubwo ngo bwabaye no mu bice bitandukanye bya Congo, kandi nubu ngo buracyakomeje, asaba ko barenganurwa.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0NAG-H4CB.body:
Kugira ngo Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yemerwe ni uko FPR - Inkotanyi yashoboye gufata Igihugu- Tito Rutaremara

Ni bimwe mu byo yagarutseho ku mugoroba wo ku wa 13 Kanama 2026, ubwo umuryango w’Abanyamulenge baba mu Rwanda, wahuriraga mu gikorwa cyo Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 22 ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abanyamulenge bari barahungiye mu Nkambi ya Gatumba mu 2004.

Ni ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abanyamulenge 166 b’impunzi, bukorwa n’imitwe yitwaje intaro irimo FNL-PARIMEHUTU, mu ijoro rya tariki 13 Kanama 2004, babanje kubatandukanya n’abandi banyekongo bari baturanye, ubundi batwikirwa mu mahema bararagamo.

Mu kiganiro yatanze mu gikorwa cyo Kwibuka abo Banyamulenge ku nshuro ya 22, Tito Rutaremara, yihanganishije umuryango mugari w’Abanyamulenge baba mu Rwanda by’umwihariko abarokotse ubwicanyi bakorewe, ababwira ko ubutabera basaba atari bo gusa babwifuza, kuko n'u Rwanda rubukeneye kuri abo bicanyi bagize n’uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, ariko bakaba batarashyikirizwa ubutabera.

Yagize ati “Buriya Gatsibo hari Abarundi bakoze Jenoside, mu Bugesera hari Abarundi bakoze Jenoside, muri za Huye mu Majyepfo y’u Rwanda hari Abarundi bakoze Jenoside, n’ahangaha mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Natwe twarabubuze ubwo butabera, nta Murundi n’umwe turazana. Kugeza n’igihe hari Abarundi bahungiye hano, ngira ngo mujya mubyumva Perezida w’u Burundi abivuga, ko hari abo twabimye, basabye ko bataha.”

Yungamo ati “Hari n’ubwo twababwiye tuti nta n’icyo binatwaye, nimuze twandikirane tubabahe abantu ariko namwe muduhe abo tuzajya tubasaba. Uwabyanze ni umujenerali bafunze baheruka gufunga, yandika akandiko avuga ati Abanyarwanda nimubemerera ko na bo bazajya basaba abantu, ko bazatumara hano abari i Burundi twese. Kuko twajyaga kubasaba tugahera no kuri abo bo hejuru, kubera ko abenshi bakoze Jenoside mu Rwanda.”

Aha niho uyu muyobozi w’Urwego Ngishwanama rw’Inararibonye z’Igihugu mu Rwanda, yahereye avuga ko kugira ngo Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yemerwe ari ukubera ko FPR-Inkotanyi yabanje gutsinda urugamba.

Ati “Iyo dutsindwa ntabwo baba bavuga ko mu Rwanda hakozwe Jenoside. Ni uko FPR yatsinze, naho ubundi iyo Jenoside yo mu Rwanda ivugwa hose ntabwo iba yaravuzwe. Iyo bisa n’ibivugwa, mu 1959, 1962-64, hagiye haba Jenoside, ariko se hari uwigeze ayivuga. Buriya nayo kugira ngo ivugwe ni uko twatsinze, iyo tudatsinda ntabwo biba bivugwa.”

Ku kijyanye n’ubutabera, Rutaremara, avuga ko iyo hatabaho uburyo bwo kwishakamo ibisubizo ku Rwanda, ngo hatangizwe Inkiko Gacaca, nabwo butari kugerwaho nubwo bitaragera ku kigero cya 100%.

Ati “Iyo tudakora Gacaca ngo ducire imanza miliyoni ebyiri z’abari bakoze Jenoside, na bariya mujya mwumva umwe, babiri muri Amerika, batatu mu Bufaransa, bane muri Suwede n’ahandi, n’abongabo ntibaba baraciriwe n’izo manza. Ni uko twagize Leta, turatangira imanza turazica, noneho biga na bo kugenda bakuramo kamwe hirya no hino. Ni nacyo gituma muzabona, nko muri Afurika ntawuracirwa urubanza.”

Yanatanze urugero rw’Imiryango mpuzamahanga ko ntacyo ishobora gufasha Abanyafurika, igihe cyose atari bo ubwabo bafashe iya mbere ngo bishakemo ibisubizo, ubundi abandi bakaza nyuma.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0NTZ-U1S0.body:
Icyamamare Nia Long yahawe inyenyeri y’icyubahiro kuri Hollywood Walk of Fame

Mu ijoro ryo ku wa 16 Nzeri 2026, ni bwo yashyikirijwe ku mugaragaro inyenyeri ya 2857, mu muhango witabiriwe n’abagize umuryango we n’inshuti ze, barimo umuraperi Snoop Dogg.

Nia Long w’imyaka 56 y’amavuko yagaragaye muri filime nka Missing n’izindi zitandukanye. Yahawe iyi nyenyeri mu rwego rwo kumushimira umusanzu we mu ruganda rwa sinema.

Uyu muhango wabaye umwanya wo kwizihiza urugendo rurerure rwa Nia Long muri sinema, aho amaze imyaka irenga 30 agaragara muri filime n’ibindi bikorwa by’imyidagaduro. Uretse izo filime zamamaye cyane, yagiye anagaragara mu zindi zitandukanye zirimo The Best Man, Soul Food na The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air, bikamufasha kuba umwe mu bakinnyi b’abagore bamaze igihe bagaragara muri Hollywood.

Nyuma yo gushyikirizwa iyi nyenyeri, Nia Long yashimiye umuryango we, inshuti ndetse n’abafana bamushyigikiye mu rugendo rwe rw’umwuga. Inyenyeri ye yashyizwe ahantu kuri Hollywood Walk of Fame, ahamaze imyaka hashyirwa amazina y’abagize uruhare rukomeye mu ruganda rw’imyidagaduro.

Wanditse

Agaba Julius Owens

Umunyamakuru
