ART-MU8U0OX3-C7RB.body:
Ibyamamare Sally Field na Reba McEntire bunamiye Dolly Parton

Sally Field yagize ati: “Niba koko hari abamarayika ku Isi, uyu munsi twatakaje umwe -Dolly Parton.”

Amwibuka nk’umuntu wicishaga bugufi, wagiraga umutima mwiza, washyigikiraga abandi kandi wasetsaga cyane. Field yakoranye na Parton muri filime Steel Magnolia yo mu 1989.

Reba McEntire na we yaririmbye indirimbo ya Dolly Parton “Appalachian Memories”, asoza ubutumwa bwe agira ati: “Ndagukunda cyane, Dolly.”

Dolly Parton yitabye Imana ku wa 25 Kanama 2026, afite imyaka 80, nyuma yo kumara igihe arwaye kanseri.

Urupfu rwe rwasize icyuho gikomeye mu muziki wa Country, no muri sinema n’ibikorwa by’ubugiraneza.

Mu myaka isaga 60 yamaze mu muziki, Parton yasize indirimbo nyinshi zakunzwe ku Isi, zirimo “Jolene,” “9 to 5,” “I Will Always Love You,” “Coat of Many Colors” na “Here You Come Again.”

Hari kandi na “I Will Always Love You” yaje kumenyekana cyane ku Isi nyuma yo kuririmbwa na Whitney Houston, mu gihe “Jolene” na “9 to 5” bikomeje kuba mu ndirimbo zizwi cyane mu murage we wa muzika.

Ni icyubahiro cyuje amarangamutima ku mugore w’ikirangirire wakoze ku mitima ya benshi binyuze mu muziki we, ubuhanga bwe, ineza n’ibikorwa bye by’ubugiraneza.

Wanditse

Keza Kethia

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0Q0E-YIP3.body:
Umunyarwenya Eric Omondi yatawe muri yombi azizwa kugumura rubanda

Umunyarwenya wo muri Kenya, Eric Omondi, yatawe muri yombi mu Mujyi rwagati wa Nairobi, ubwo yakoraga igikorwa cyo gukusanya imikono ishyigikira igitekerezo cyo kugabanya umubare w’intara za Kenya.

Omondi yari ari gukusanya imikono y’abaturage kugira ngo ashyigikire icyifuzo cyo kuvugurura imiterere y’imiyoborere y’igihugu, by’umwihariko kugabanya umubare w’intara (counties).

Iyi gahunda yari ikomeje mu gace ka Nairobi Central Business District (CBD), mbere y’uko polisi imuta muri yombi.

Eric Omondi asanzwe azwi cyane muri Kenya no mu bindi bihugu bya Afurika kubera ibikorwa bye byo gusetsa, ariko kandi akunze kugaragara mu bikorwa byo kugaragaza ibitekerezo ku bibazo bireba Abanya-Kenya.

Wanditse

Agaba Julius Owens

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0QJR-NSTD.body:
Ibyamamare ku mbuga nkoranyambaga byatangije ubukangurambaga “Sober Ghee na Sober Chou” bwo kurwanya ubusinzi

Urubyiruko rukurikirwa cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga rwaturutse i Kigali rwifatanyije n’abaturage bo mu Karere ka Nyagatare, Umurenge wa Rwimiyaga, mu muganda usoza ukwezi kwa Kanama 2026, aho rwakanguriye bagenzi babo kwirinda ubusinzi bukabije, inzoga zitujuje ubuziranenge n’ibiyobyabwenge.

Muri ubu bukangurambaga, urubyiruko rwazanye ubutumwa bugira buti “Sober Ghee” na “Sober Chou”, amagambo akoreshwa mu gushishikariza abahungu n’abakobwa kuba beza birinda ibisindisha.

Uru rubyiruko rwari rwambaye imipira iriho ubu butumwa ndetse runafite ibyapa byanditseho “Sober Ghee” na “Sober Chou”, mu rwego rwo kugaragaza ko urubyiruko rushobora kwishimisha no kugira uruhare mu iterambere rw’igihugu rutanyoye inzoga.

Bamwe muri uru rubyiruko ni abakurikirwa cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ndetse bakagira uruhare mu kugira inama nziza no gutanga ibitekerezo by’ababakurikira.

Aba bose bakoresha izo mbuga mu kugeza ubutumwa ku rundi rubyiruko no kubakangurira kugira imyitwarire iboneye.

Tito Kimenyi, wari uhagarariye urubyiruko rw’abahungu, yari yambaye umupira wanditseho “Sober Ghee”. Yasobanuriye Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu, Habimana Dominique, ko ubu butumwa bugamije kugaragaza ko umuhungu mwiza ari uwirinda ubusinzi n’ibiyobyabwenge.

Ati: “Urubyiruko rwiza ni urutishora mu businzi, mu biyobyabwenge kandi ntirunywe inzoga zitujuje ubuziranenge, ndavuga izizwi nk’ibyuma.”

Esther Umulisa, wari uhagarariye urubyiruko rw’abakobwa kandi yambaye umupira wanditseho “Sober Chou”, na we yasobanuye ko ubu butumwa bugamije gukangurira abakobwa kwirinda ubusinzi no kugira imyitwarire ibafasha kubaka ahazaza habo.

Uru rubyiruko ruvuga ko intego atari ukwifata nk’abarwanya inzoga gusa, ahubwo ari ugukoresha imbaraga bafite ku mbuga nkoranyambaga mu guhindura imyumvire ya bagenzi babo no kubereka ko kuba umusore cyangwa umukobwa w’umunyamwete kandi ugamije kugira icyo ageraho bidakeneye ubusinzi.

Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu, Habimana Dominique, yashimye ubutumwa bw’uru rubyiruko, abasaba gukomeza gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga kugira ngo bugere kuri benshi.

Yabasabye kandi gukomeza gufatanya na Leta mu bukangurambaga bugamije kurwanya inzoga zitujuje ubuziranenge n’ibiyobyabwenge, avuga ko ibyo bishobora kugira uruhare mu gukurura urubyiruko mu bindi bikorwa bibangiriza ubuzima n’imibereho.

Ati: “Mukomeze dufatanye gukora ubukangurambaga kuko buzadufasha kurwanya inzoga zitujuje ubuziranenge ndetse n’ibiyobyabwenge, kuko ari yo ntandaro yo kubashora mu busambanyi.”

Minisitiri Habimana yibukije urubyiruko ko ari imbaraga n’icyizere cy’igihugu cy’ejo hazaza, bityo ko rukwiye kwirinda ibintu byose bishobora kubangiza ubuzima no kubatesha amahirwe yo kwiteza imbere.

Yaberetse ko bashobora gukoresha izo mbuga mu kugeza ubutumwa bwubaka ku rubyiruko bagenzi babo.

Mu gihe inzoga n’ibiyobyabwenge bishobora kugira ingaruka ku buzima, imibanire n’ahazaza h’urubyiruko, ubutumwa nka “Sober Ghee” na “Sober Chou” bugamije kubaka umuco wo gushishikariza urubyiruko kwirinda ubusinzi no guhitamo ubuzima buzira ibisindisha.

Wanditse

Ernestine Musanabera

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0R3B-JUCJ.summary: Umuhanzi Rema yahamagaye Abanyakigali ati Muze dutarame agati gaturike Iki gitaramo giteganyijwe ku wa 5 Nzeri 2026, aho Rema azafatanya n’abahanzi Nyarwanda barimo Kivumbi King, mu gihe abandi bazitabira iki gitaramo bazatangazwa nyuma. ART-MU8U0R3B-JUCJ.body:
Umuhanzi Rema yahamagaye Abanyakigali ati Muze dutarame agati gaturike

Iki gitaramo giteganyijwe ku wa 5 Nzeri 2026, aho Rema azafatanya n’abahanzi Nyarwanda barimo Kivumbi King, mu gihe abandi bazitabira iki gitaramo bazatangazwa nyuma.

Rema, amazina ye nyakuri akaba ari Divine Ikubor, yamenyekanye cyane mu ndirimbo zirimo Dumebi, Iron Man, Woman, Soundgasm, Charm na Calm Down. Indirimbo Calm Down yakoranye n’umuhanzikazi w’Umunyamerika Selena Gomez yageze ku mwanya wa gatatu ku rutonde rwa Billboard Hot 100 muri Amerika, iba imwe mu ndirimbo za Afrobeats zageze kure ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

Mu bihembo yegukanye harimo MTV Video Music Award for Best Afrobeats na Billboard Music Award for Top Afrobeats Song kubera Calm Down. Muri 2023, yegukanye kandi ibihembo bya Global African Artist na Song of the Year muri Trace Awards yabereye i Kigali.

Album ye HEIS yasohotse mu 2024 yamuhesheje kandidatire ya mbere mu bihembo bya Grammy Awards, bikomeza gushimangira umwanya afite mu muziki mpuzamahanga.

Umuyobozi ushinzwe Ubukerarugendo muri Rwanda Development Board (RDB), Irène Murerwa, yavuze ko Kwita Izina atari ibirori byo kubungabunga ibidukikije gusa, ahubwo binizihiza umuco, Abanyarwanda n’iterambere ry’igihugu.

Yavuze ko bishimiye kwakira Rema i Kigali, asaba Abanyarwanda, abashyitsi n’abakunzi b’umuziki bo mu karere kuzitabira igitaramo cyo ku wa 5 Nzeri.

Kwita Izina ni kimwe mu bikorwa bikomeye u Rwanda rwateguye mu rwego rwo kubungabunga ingagi zo mu misozi, guteza imbere ubukerarugendo no kugaragaza umusanzu w’abaturage baturiye Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga.

Amatike yo kwinjira muri iki gitaramo ari kugurishwa kuri ticqet.rw.

Wanditse

Agaba Julius Owens

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0RN9-DASF.body:
Theo Bosebabireba, Alicia & Germaine mu bukangurambaga bwo kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge

Abahanzi barimo Theo Bosebabireba, Hoziana Choir ya ADEPR Nyarugenge, n’abakobwa bavukana ari bo Alicia & Germaine bakunzwe muri iyi minsi mu muziki wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana, bagiye kugaragara mu bukangurambaga bwo kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge, ubusinzi bukabije, inda ziterwa abangavu, guta ishuri n’amakimbirane mu miryango, ndetse no kwita ku isuku n’isukura.

Ubwo bukangurambaga bumaze iminsi bubera mu Murenge wa Ngarama mu Karere ka Gatsibo, bwiswe “Ngarama Pentecost 26: Hitamo Ubuzima – Hitamo Yesu”, bufite intero igira iti “Hehe n’ibiyobyabwenge!” Biteganyijwe ko mu minsi itatu isoza ubu bukangurambaga hazaba hari abaririmbyi n'abahanzi b'ibyamamare.

Bwateguwe na Baho Global Mission (BGM) ku bufatanye na ADEPR-Ngarama, ndetse n'amatorero ya Gikristo akorera mu Karere ka Gatsibo by'umwihariko mu Mirenge ya Ngarama, Gatsibo na Nyagihanga.

Intego yabwo ni ugukangurira abaturage, cyane cyane urubyiruko, kwirinda ubusinzi n’ibiyobyabwenge, ahubwo bakagira ubuzima bufite intego kandi bushingiye ku mahitamo meza.

Ibikorwa by'ingenzi bigize ubu bukangurambaga bigamije kugera ku baturage mu buryo bunyuranye, birimo siporo, ibiganiro n’inyigisho ku miryango, ubutumwa bwo kwirinda ibiyobyabwenge, gupima indwara zitandura, gutangira abatishoboye umusanzu w’ubwisungane mu kwivuza, indirimbo z'abahanzi n'abaririmbyi, ndetse n’ibikorwa byo guteza imbere imibereho y’abaturage.

Kimwe mu bikorwa by’ingenzi byaranze iminsi ya mbere y'ubu bukangurambaga ni irushanwa ry’umupira w’amaguru ryahuje amakipe ahagarariye Ngarama, Gatsibo na Nyagihanga, haba mu cyiciro cy’abagore ndetse n’abagabo.

Iri rushanwa ryatangiye ku wa 22 Kanama 2026, rikaba ryarakoreshejwe nk’umuyoboro wo kwegera urubyiruko no kurugezaho ubutumwa bwo kwirinda ibiyobyabwenge, ubusinzi bukabije n’izindi ngeso zishobora kubangamira ubuzima n’ahazaza harwo.

Umuyobozi ushinzwe ibikorwa muri Baho Global Mission akaba n’umuhuzabikorwa w’iri rushanwa, Ev. Egide Ngombwa, yatangaje ko nyuma y’irushanwa ry’umupira w’amaguru, ibikorwa byo gusoza ubu bukangurambaga bizaba mu minsi itatu kuva ku wa 28 kugeza ku wa 30 Kanama 2026, ku kibuga cya ADEPR Ngarama kizwi nka Sahara.

Muri iyi minsi itatu, hazakomeza ubutumwa bugamije guhindura imyumvire y’abaturage no kubafasha gufata ibyemezo byiza ku buzima bwabo, imiryango yabo ndetse n’ejo hazaza h’urubyiruko.

Mu bikorwa biteganyijwe harimo gupima indwara zitandura (NCDs) ku bazitabira, ku bufatanye n’Ibitaro bya Ngarama, ndetse n’ibiganiro n’amahugurwa bigamije gufasha imiryango gukumira no gukemura amakimbirane yo mu ngo.

Hazatangwa kandi ubutumwa bwo kwirinda ibiyobyabwenge, ubusinzi bukabije, ubusambanyi, inda ziterwa abangavu, guta ishuri n’izindi ngeso mbi zishobora kwangiza ubuzima n’ahazaza h’urubyiruko.

Abazatanga ubu butumwa bazaba barimo abayobozi, abashumba, abakozi b’Imana, abahanzi, abaririmbyi ndetse n’abandi bashyitsi baturutse hirya no hino.

Mu byitezwe cyane mu gusoza ubu bukangurambaga harimo ubutumwa n’ibitaramo by’abahanzi batandukanye barimo Alicia &Germaine bamenyekanye mu ndirimbo zirimo "Uriyo", "Ibendera" na "Ibanga"; Pastor Kayiranga Innocent wamamaye mu ndirimbo "Ngarutse Imbere Yawe"; na Riberakurora Innocent uzwi nka Bivamuruyumwuga.

Mu bakozi b'Imana bazatanga ubutumwa harimo Rev. Baho Isaie, uyobora Baho Global Mission yateguye ubu bukangurambaga, Rev. Isaie Ndayizeye uyobora ADEPR ku rwego rw’Igihugu, Ev. David & Stephanie Herzog, Dr. Stephen Mutua na Pastor Ren Schuffman.

Uru ruhurirane rw’abayobozi b'amatorero, abahanzi n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa batandukanye rugamije gutuma ubutumwa bw’ubu bukangurambaga bugera ku bantu benshi kandi bukagira uruhare mu guhindura imibereho yabo.

Kimwe mu bikorwa byihariye biteganyijwe mu gusoza ubu bukangurambaga ni ugufasha abaturage batishoboye kubona ubwisungane mu kwivuza. Abaturage 625 batishoboye bazishyurirwa Ubwisungane mu Kwivuza (Mutuelle de Santé). Hazaba kandi igikorwa cyo gutombora ibikoresho bitandukanye, aho abaturage bazagira amahirwe yo gutwara ibihembo birimo igare, telefoni, radiyo na televiziyo (TV screen).

Ibi bikorwa bigaragaza ko ubukangurambaga butibanda gusa ku gutanga ubutumwa, ahubwo bunagamije kugira uruhare rufatika mu mibereho y’abaturage.

content_blocks.text: Theo Bosebabireba, Alicia & Germaine mu bukangurambaga bwo kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge

Abahanzi barimo Theo Bosebabireba, Hoziana Choir ya ADEPR Nyarugenge, n’abakobwa bavukana ari bo Alicia & Germaine bakunzwe muri iyi minsi mu muziki wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana, bagiye kugaragara mu bukangurambaga bwo kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge, ubusinzi bukabije, inda ziterwa abangavu, guta ishuri n’amakimbirane mu miryango, ndetse no kwita ku isuku n’isukura.

Ubwo bukangurambaga bumaze iminsi bubera mu Murenge wa Ngarama mu Karere ka Gatsibo, bwiswe “Ngarama Pentecost 26: Hitamo Ubuzima – Hitamo Yesu”, bufite intero igira iti “Hehe n’ibiyobyabwenge!” Biteganyijwe ko mu minsi itatu isoza ubu bukangurambaga hazaba hari abaririmbyi n'abahanzi b'ibyamamare.
Bwateguwe na Baho Global Mission (BGM) ku bufatanye na ADEPR-Ngarama, ndetse n'amatorero ya Gikristo akorera mu Karere ka Gatsibo by'umwihariko mu Mirenge ya Ngarama, Gatsibo na Nyagihanga.
Intego yabwo ni ugukangurira abaturage, cyane cyane urubyiruko, kwirinda ubusinzi n’ibiyobyabwenge, ahubwo bakagira ubuzima bufite intego kandi bushingiye ku mahitamo meza.

Ibikorwa by'ingenzi bigize ubu bukangurambaga bigamije kugera ku baturage mu buryo bunyuranye, birimo siporo, ibiganiro n’inyigisho ku miryango, ubutumwa bwo kwirinda ibiyobyabwenge, gupima indwara zitandura, gutangira abatishoboye umusanzu w’ubwisungane mu kwivuza, indirimbo z'abahanzi n'abaririmbyi, ndetse n’ibikorwa byo guteza imbere imibereho y’abaturage.

Kimwe mu bikorwa by’ingenzi byaranze iminsi ya mbere y'ubu bukangurambaga ni irushanwa ry’umupira w’amaguru ryahuje amakipe ahagarariye Ngarama, Gatsibo na Nyagihanga, haba mu cyiciro cy’abagore ndetse n’abagabo.

Iri rushanwa ryatangiye ku wa 22 Kanama 2026, rikaba ryarakoreshejwe nk’umuyoboro wo kwegera urubyiruko no kurugezaho ubutumwa bwo kwirinda ibiyobyabwenge, ubusinzi bukabije n’izindi ngeso zishobora kubangamira ubuzima n’ahazaza harwo.

Umuyobozi ushinzwe ibikorwa muri Baho Global Mission akaba n’umuhuzabikorwa w’iri rushanwa, Ev. ART-MU8U0S6Z-K884.body:
Umunyakenya ukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga yananiwe kwihangana asaba Perezida Kagame ifoto

Umunyakenya uzwi nka Krazy Kenna, ukora ibihangano byo gusetsa no kwidagadura ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, yagaragaje ibyishimo bidasanzwe ubwo yabonaga imbona nkubone Perezida Paul Kagame, kugeza ubwo amusabye ifoto y’urwibutso.

Krazy Kenna uri mu Rwanda, aho yaje nk’ukora ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ukunze gukoresha ibihangano bye mu kugaragaza ibintu biba mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Ni umwe mu bitabiriye ikiganiro Perezida Kagame yagiranye n’itangazamakuru kuri uyu wa 24 Kanama 2026.

Ubwo yahabwa ijambo Krazy Kenna, yabanje gumushimira umwanya yahawe avuga ko mu byo akora harimo kugaragariza abantu ibintu bibaho mu buzima busanzwe, akabikora mu buryo bushimisha no gusetsa abantu.

Yavuze ko mbere yo guhura na Perezida Kagame yari yakoze ubushakashatsi ku buryo Abanyarwanda babona umubano bafitanye n’Umukuru w’Igihugu, agaragaza ko ubwo yagendaga mu mujyi wa Kigali, yabajije abantu batandukanye uko babona Perezida Kagame, maze bamwe bakamubwira ko bamufata nka papa wabo.

Yagize ati: “Natekereje ko ari urwenya, kugeza uyu munsi ubwo niboneye uko mwakemuraga ikibazo hano, mukomeza kubaza muti ‘Yavuze iki? Yavuze iki?’”

Yavuze ko ibyo yabonye byatumye arushaho kwemera ko Abanyarwanda bakunda Perezida Kagame.

Agira ati: “Bwana Perezida, abaturage banyu barabakunda cyane.”

Nyuma yo gushimira Perezida Kagame, Krazy Kenna yahise amugezaho icyifuzo cye bwite, avuga ko hari icyo yashakaga kuzasubirana iwabo nyuma yo guhura n’Umukuru w’Igihugu.

Yavuze ko se ahora amubwira ko ibihangano bishobora gutuma umuntu agera kure, maze amusaba ko bafata ifoto kugira ngo azayimwereke nk’ikimenyetso cy’uko yahuye na Perezida w’u Rwanda.

Ati: “Njye icyo nsaba ni ugufata ifoto imwe, nkajya kumwereka ko nabonanye na Perezida w’u Rwanda.”

Perezida Kagame atazuyaje na we yahise amusubiza ko amwemereye amafoto abiri. Iyi myitwarire yashimishije Krazy Kenna, utabonye gusa umwanya wo kubaza Perezida Kagame, ahubwo wari ugeze ku ntego ye yo gutahana ifoto y’urwibutso yifotoje ari kumwe na Perezida Kagame.

Perezida Kagame yavuze mu buryo bwo gusetsa no gutebya ko na we “ari umusazi nka Krazy Kenna, amagambo yakoresheje mu kugaragaza ibyishimo n’ubwisanzure yumvaga muri uwo mwanya.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0SQV-K5FB.body:
Umuhanzi Rema agiye gususurutsa abanya Kigali mu gitaramo cyo Kwita Izina 2026

Iki gitaramo kizaba bukeye bw’umuhango wo Kwita Izina abana b’ingagi ku nshuro ya 21, uteganyijwe ku wa 4 Nzeri 2026 i Kinigi, mu Karere ka Musanze, ku nsanganyamatsiko igira iti “Conservation is Life: Sustaining the Future.”

Rema azafatanya n’abandi bahanzi barimo Kivumbi King wo mu Rwanda. Abandi bahanzi bazitabira iki gitaramo bazatangazwa nyuma.

Rema, amazina ye bwite akaba Divine Ikubor, ni umwe mu bahanzi bakomeye ba Afrobeats bamaze kumenyekana ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Yamamaye cyane binyuze mu ndirimbo zirimo “Dumebi,” “Iron Man,” “Woman,” “Soundgasm,” “Charm” na “Calm Down.”

Indirimbo “Calm Down” yakoranye na Selena Gomez ni imwe mu zamufashije kurushaho kumenyekana ku rwego mpuzamahanga, aho remix yayo yageze ku mwanya wa gatatu ku rutonde rwa Billboard Hot 100 muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.

Mu bihembo bikomeye Rema amaze gutwara harimo MTV Video Music Award ya Best Afrobeats ndetse na Billboard Music Award ya Top Afrobeats Song kubera “Calm Down.” Mu 2023, yahawe kandi ibihembo bya Global African Artist na Song of the Year muri Trace Awards zabereye i Kigali.

Album ye HEIS, yasohotse mu 2024, yamuhesheje nomination ya mbere muri Grammy Awards, bikomeza kumwongerera izina ku ruhando mpuzamahanga.

Igitaramo cyo Kwita Izina ni kimwe mu bikorwa bizasoza icyumweru cyahariwe Kwita Izina, igikorwa ngarukamwaka gihuza ibikorwa byo kurengera ingagi zo mu Birunga, guteza imbere ubukerarugendo, umuco n’imibereho y’abaturage.

Wanditse

Agaba Julius Owens

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0TA3-5UQU.body:
The Ben yaciye agahigo ka Meddy kuri YouTube abikesheje ‘Inshallah’

‘Inshallah’ yasohotse ku wa 15 Kanama 2026, ikaba yarakiriwe neza n’abakunzi b’umuziki kuva yasohoka. Mu masaha 48 ya mbere, amashusho yayo yari amaze kurenga miliyoni 1.1 y’abayarebye kuri YouTube.

Ibi byatumye The Ben akuraho agahigo kari gafitwe na Meddy binyuze mu ndirimbo ye ‘My Vow’, yasohotse muri 2021. Icyo gihe, ‘My Vow’ yari yabaye indirimbo y’umuhanzi nyarwanda ku giti cye igeze kuri miliyoni imwe y’abayirebye mu gihe gito, kuko yari yabigezeho mu masaha 48.

The Ben asubiranye agahigo kari kamaze imyaka itanu

Meddy yari amaze imyaka itanu ari we ufite aka gahigo, nyuma y’uko ‘My Vow’ igize umuvuduko ukomeye kuri YouTube. Indirimbo yakomeje gukundwa no mu minsi yakurikiyeho, ndetse nyuma y’iminsi itanu yari imaze kurenga miliyoni ebyiri z’abayirebye.

Ubu The Ben ni we wanditse amateka mashya, aho ‘Inshallah’ yarenze miliyoni 1.1 y’abayirebye mu minsi ibiri gusa.

‘Inshallah’ igaruka ku rukundo

Usibye kuba iri gukora amateka kuri YouTube, ‘Inshallah’ ni indirimbo yibanda ku rukundo no ku cyizere cyo kubaka ubuzima bw’ejo hazaza n’uwo ukunda.

Muri iyi ndirimbo, The Ben agaragaza umuntu akunda cyane ndetse yifuza ko bazabana nk'umugore we, amwizeza ko urukundo amufitiye ari urw’ukuri kandi ruzaramba.

Indirimbo yakozwe na Producer MadeBeat, mu gihe amashusho yayo yayobowe na Julien Bmjizzo afatanyije na Bright Ngabo. Muri ayo mashusho kandi hagaragaramo ababyinnyi ndetse n’ibindi byamamare, birimo MadeBeat.

Kuba ‘Inshallah’ yararenze miliyoni imwe y’abayirebye mu masaha 48, ni indi ntambwe ikomeye kuri The Ben no ku muziki nyarwanda muri rusange, cyane ko YouTube ikomeje kuba imwe mu mbuga zifasha abahanzi kugera ku bakunzi babo mu Rwanda no mu mahanga.

Wanditse

Agaba Julius Owens

Umunyamakuru

Indirimbo yakozwe na Producer MadeBeat, mu gihe amashusho yayo yayobowe na Julien Bmjizzo afatanyije na Bright Ngabo. Muri ayo mashusho kandi hagaragaramo ababyinnyi ndetse n’ibindi byamamare, birimo MadeBeat.

Kuba ‘Inshallah’ yararenze miliyoni imwe y’abayirebye mu masaha 48, ni indi ntambwe ikomeye kuri The Ben no ku muziki nyarwanda muri rusange, cyane ko YouTube ikomeje kuba imwe mu mbuga zifasha abahanzi kugera ku bakunzi babo mu Rwanda no mu mahanga.

ART-MU8U0UCI-PO6U.body:
Kubyara akiri muto byatumye Bazongere yiyemeza gufasha abangavu abinyujije muri Siporo

Urugendo rwa mbere yakoze ni urwa Kigali-Rubavu muri Werurwe 2025.

Nyuma yarwo yakoze urwa Kigali-Nyagatare, iminsi 100 y’ingendo zo kwiga amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi hamwe n’urundi yatumiwemo hagamijwe kurwanya no kwinda indwara za Kanseri.

Uretse kuba aba arimo gukora Siporo, ariko ingendo akora zose ziba zifite insanganyamatsiko ahanini ifite aho ihuriye no kwigisha ndetse no gufasha abana b’abakobwa, binyuze mu bukangurambaga bwo kwirinda inda zitateguwe, gukusanya imfashanyo yo kugurira abana bo mu byaro batishoboye impapuro z’isuku bifashisha mu gihe cy’imihango, kwita ku ubuzima bwo mu mutwe, ibidukikije n’ibindi.

Bazogere wabyaye afite imyaka 19 gusa, avuga ko ubuzima umwana w’umukobwa anyuramo kuva atwite kugera abyaye, buba bugoranye kuko bumugiraho ingaruka zitandukanye zirimo kuva mu ishuri, no kutagira ikindi ashobora, ku buryo bimwangiririza ahazaza, cyane ko abenshi mu baterwa izo nda, iwabo baba bafite amikoro adahagije.

Agendeye kuri ibyo bibazo, Bozogere asanga buri wese agomba kumva ko umwana w’umukobwa ari mu nshingano ze, adategereje Leta, umubyeyi we cyangwa Mwalimu umwigisha gusa.

Ati “Ahubwo nawe umunyuzeho mu muhanda ukabona arimo gukora ibibi, arimo gukosa, cyangwa hari urimo kumushuka, ugomba kuba ijisho rye, ukaba wamucyebura nk’umubyeyi. Jye rero ntabwo ncika intege, ni ikintu niyemeje kandi ngomba guharanira, kuko nabyaye nkiri muto, nzi uburyo bivuna, uburyo umwana w’umukobwa aca mu buzima bugoye muri icyo gihe. Kubyara inda atateganyije, kurera akiri umwana, kuba ababyeyi bamurera bamufatanyije n’uwo na we yabyaye, no kuba nta bushobozi wenda uwo mubyeyi aba afite.”

Yungamo ati “Usanga cyane mu bice byo mu cyaro ari ho haba umubare munini wa bo bangavu baterwa inda. Ugasanga umwana agiye kuzana umwana kandi na we ni umwana, n’iwabo nta bushobozi buhagije bwo kubarera buhari. Ugasanga ejo he hazaza ho kwiga hangirika, akitakariza icyizere bikaba byatuma asubira inyuma.

Urugendo Bazongere aheruka gukora n’amaguru, ni urwo yakoze muri Gashyantare uyu mwaka (2026), rwari urwa Kigali-Nyagatare. Avuga ko rwari rugamije gukora ubukangurambaga ku nda ziterwa abangavu hanakusanywa inkunga zo kugura ibikoresho byifashishwa mu isuku y’abana b’abakobwa igihe bagiye mu mihango (Pads/Cotex) ku bana bo mu cyaro badafite ubushobozi bwo kuzigurira.

Ati “Twaguriye abana barenga 400 Cotex, bo mu byaro ku mashuri, icyari gikomeye cyane kwari ugutanga ubutumwa kuri buri Munyarwanda uwo ari we wese. Navuga ko uru rugendo rwabaye rwiza kuko rwakurikiwe n’abantu benshi cyane kandi rumenywa na benshi kandi twari dukeneye ko ubutumwa bugera ku bantu benshi. Bakamenya ko ikibazo cy’inda ziterwa abangavu ari inshingano za buri wese kurwanya inda zitateguwe. Ni ubukangurambagga buzajya buba buri mwaka muri Gashyantare (ukwa kabiri).”

Ni urugendo yise ‘Imbaraga Gorilla Walk’, ateganya gukora kuva ku wa 2 kugeza ku wa 3 Nzeri 2026, rukazasorezwa i Musanze. Abazaba babashije kurusoza bazakomezanya na we ku wa 4 Nzeri 2026, berekeza mu Kinigi ahazabera ibirori byo Kwita Izina abana b’ingagi.

Kuri iyi nshuro, azaba akora ubukangurambaga buzibanda ku butumwa bwo gukangurira abantu kurinda ibidukikije mu rwego rwo kubaka ejo hazaza heza.

Bazongere n’ikipe bakorana siporo bakora buri cyumweru siporo n’ibindi bikorwa by’ibiganiro ku mibereho myiza n’iterambere by’umwihariko iry’umwana w’umukobwa.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0VFN-WRBK.body:
Jabana: Umunyeshuri yatereye ivi umukobwa mu birori byo gusoza amashuri y'imyuga

Uwo musore witwa Tuyisingize Ibrah w’imyaka 23 y’amavuko yambitse impeta y’urukundo Umwali Rosine na we ufite imyaka 23 y’amavuko.

Bavuga ko bamaze amezi ane bamenyaniye muri icyo kigo, dore ko umuhungu akomoka mu Karere ka Rwamagana mu Murenge wa Muyumbu mu Kagari ka Akinyambo, naho umukunzi we, Umwali Rosine, akaba atuye mu Karere ka Burera mu Murenge wa Kinyababa mu Kagari ka Kaganda.

Ubwo igihe cyo gutanga impano cyari kigeze, umukobwa ni we wabanje gufata ijambo akurikiranye n’abandi, avuga ko afite impano yageneye uwo muhungu bamenyaniye muri icyo kigo, akimara kuyimushyikiriza, umuhungu na we yafashe ijambo, avuga ko na we hari impano yageneye uwo mukobwa, ko yifuza ko azajya ayireba buri munsi uko abyutse n’uko agiye kuryama ikamwereka urukundo amukunda. Umusore mugenzi we yahise aza amuhereza impeta, undi arapfukama atungurana asaba uwo mukobwa ko yakwemera akayimwambika, umukobwa n’amarangamutima menshi, asa n’utunguwe, ariko arabyemera arayimwambika.

Umwali Rosine aganira n’itangazamakuru, yavuze ko byamutunguye. Yagize ati “Byantunguye sinari mbyiteze, gusa nyine ndamukunda kandi nzakomeza mukunde. Nubwo we asigaye ku ishuri nzakomeza musengere ndabizi na we amasomo azayasoza, kandi nzajya nza kumusura. Ni iby’agaciro, ndashima Imana, murabona ko ibyishimo ari byinshi.”

Tuyisingize Ibrah abajijwe ukuntu yisanze akundana n’uyu mukobwa mu gihe nyamara baje ku ishuri bazanywe no kwiga, yagize ati “Buriya rero urukundo rujya aho rushaka. Aha higamo abanyeshuri barimo n’abakobwa benshi, ariko umutima wanjye ni we wahisemo ndamukunda kandi nzakomeza mukunde ku buryo byazagera no ku yindi ntera akambera mama w’abana banjye nanjye nkaba papa w’abana be.”

Tuyisingize abajijwe icyo yakundiye Umwali, yagize ati “ni mwiza, agira umutima mwiza, kandi uko ateye n’uko asa ni byo umutima wanjye wifuza.”

Umwali na we abajijwe icyo yagendeyeho kugira ngo yemerere urukundo uwo musore, yagize ati “Akimbwira ko ankunda nabanje kugira ngo arambeshya, gusa ibikorwa bye byakomeje kunyereka ko ankunda, nanjye ndamubwira ngo ‘yego’.”

Nyuma y’uko Tuyisingize asabye Umwali ko amubera umukunzi akabimwemerera, bavuga ko bagiye gutegura n’izindi gahunda zizakurikiraho kuko bateganya kubana nk’umugabo n’umugore, ndetse bakifuza ko bazasazana.

Ishuri rya Jabana Parental VTC School riherereye mu Murenge wa Jabana mu Karere ka Gasabo ryigisha imyuga n’ubumenyingiro mu gihe gito cy’amezi atandatu ku buryo bifasha abiganjemo urubyiruko guhita rubona akazi vuba.

Abarangije amasomo yabo ku wa Gatandatu tariki 15 Kanama 2026, basabwe kubyaza umusaruro ubumenyi bahawe, bakiteza imbere ubwabo, imiryango yabo ndetse bagateza imbere n’Igihugu muri rusange.

Nsengiyumva Innocent, Umuyobozi w’ishuri ry’imyuga rya Jabana Parental VTC School, yagize ati “Icyo tubifuriza ni uko bajya hanze bagakoresha ubumenyi twabigishije. Barashoboye kandi barashobotse, bahindure Igihugu cyacu cyiza, bagere ku rwego rwiza rwo kwishobora, batere intambwe tuve mu bukene.”

Abarangije amasomo babarirwa muri 90 biganjemo abaturutse mu Karere ka Burera bize babifashijwemo n’Akarere kabishyuriye ibisabwa. Batoranyijwe mu miryango ifite amikoro macye, bishyurirwa kwiga imyuga muri icyo kigo, muri gahunda ya Leta yo gufasha urubyiruko rwo mu miryango ikennye kwiga imyuga no kwiteza imbere bakivana mu bukene.

Nubwo we asigaye ku ishuri nzakomeza musengere ndabizi na we amasomo azayasoza, kandi nzajya nza kumusura. Ni iby’agaciro, ndashima Imana, murabona ko ibyishimo ari byinshi.”

Tuyisingize Ibrah abajijwe ukuntu yisanze akundana n’uyu mukobwa mu gihe nyamara baje ku ishuri bazanywe no kwiga, yagize ati “Buriya rero urukundo rujya aho rushaka. Aha higamo abanyeshuri barimo n’abakobwa benshi, ariko umutima wanjye ni we wahisemo ndamukunda kandi nzakomeza mukunde ku buryo byazagera no ku yindi ntera akambera mama w’abana banjye nanjye nkaba papa w’abana be.”
Tuyisingize abajijwe icyo yakundiye Umwali, yagize ati “ni mwiza, agira umutima mwiza, kandi uko ateye n’uko asa ni byo umutima wanjye wifuza.”

Umwali na we abajijwe icyo yagendeyeho kugira ngo yemerere urukundo uwo musore, yagize ati “Akimbwira ko ankunda nabanje kugira ngo arambeshya, gusa ibikorwa bye byakomeje kunyereka ko ankunda, nanjye ndamubwira ngo ‘yego’.”

Nyuma y’uko Tuyisingize asabye Umwali ko amubera umukunzi akabimwemerera, bavuga ko bagiye gutegura n’izindi gahunda zizakurikiraho kuko bateganya kubana nk’umugabo n’umugore, ndetse bakifuza ko bazasazana.

Ishuri rya Jabana Parental VTC School riherereye mu Murenge wa Jabana mu Karere ka Gasabo ryigisha imyuga n’ubumenyingiro mu gihe gito cy’amezi atandatu ku buryo bifasha abiganjemo urubyiruko guhita rubona akazi vuba.
Abarangije amasomo yabo ku wa Gatandatu tariki 15 Kanama 2026, basabwe kubyaza umusaruro ubumenyi bahawe, bakiteza imbere ubwabo, imiryango yabo ndetse bagateza imbere n’Igihugu muri rusange.

Nsengiyumva Innocent, Umuyobozi w’ishuri ry’imyuga rya Jabana Parental VTC School, yagize ati “Icyo tubifuriza ni uko bajya hanze bagakoresha ubumenyi twabigishije. Barashoboye kandi barashobotse, bahindure Igihugu cyacu cyiza, bagere ku rwego rwiza rwo kwishobora, batere intambwe tuve mu bukene.”

Abarangije amasomo babarirwa muri 90 biganjemo abaturutse mu Karere ka Burera bize babifashijwemo n’Akarere kabishyuriye ibisabwa. Batoranyijwe mu miryango ifite amikoro macye, bishyurirwa kwiga imyuga muri icyo kigo, muri gahunda ya Leta yo gufasha urubyiruko rwo mu miryango ikennye kwiga imyuga no kwiteza imbere bakivana mu bukene.

Igiterane cya Rwanda Shima Imana kizaba kuri iki Cyumweru, tariki ya 16 Kanama 2026, kuri Stade Amahoro, kikazahuza amadini n’amatorero ndetse n’inzego z’ubuyobozi zitandukanye.
ART-MU8U0VZ7-4BLY.body:
Igiterane cya Rwanda Shima Imana kigira uruhare mu kubuka ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda – Senateri Dr Murigande

Senateri Dr. Murigande yabitangaje tariki ya 15 Kanama 2026, avuga ko kuba Imana yarahaye u Rwanda ubuyobozi bwiza byatumye rutera imbere kandi rukaba igihugu gitekanye.

Igiterane cya Rwanda Shima Imana kizaba kuri iki Cyumweru, tariki ya 16 Kanama 2026, kuri Stade Amahoro, kikazahuza amadini n’amatorero ndetse n’inzego z’ubuyobozi zitandukanye.

Senateri Dr. Murigande avuga ko iki gikorwa kigira uruhare mu gushimangira ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda, kuko gihuza amadini n’amatorero atandukanye, akabasha guhurira hamwe mu buryo bw’umwuka no kwegera Imana.

Ati: “Rwanda Shima Imana ni igikorwa cyiza kuko usanga cyahurije hamwe Abanyarwanda bari mu madini no mu matorero atandukanye, bagahurira ku isengesho rimwe, bagahuza imitima kandi bose bagasabira ibyiza u Rwanda.”

Senateri Dr. Murigande avuga ko uretse kuba amadini n’amatorero atandukanye, Rwanda Shima Imana ifasha Abanyarwanda kumva ko ari bamwe kandi bose bakiyumva nk’abana b’Imana. Avuga ko guhurira hamwe mu masengesho bituma biyumva nk’Abanyarwanda kuruta kumva ko batandukanijwe n’amadini.

Senateri Dr. Murigande avuga ko muri iki giterane kizitabirwa n’abantu benshi kandi batandukanye, urubyiruko rukwiye kumva ko ari rwo maboko y’u Rwanda kandi rukubaha amategeko y’Imana.

Ati: “Urubyiruko narubwira ko rukwiye kwitabira Rwanda Shima Imana rwumva ko rukwiye gukurikiza amategeko y’Imana, rwubaha umubiri, rwirinda kuwwangiza runywa ibisindisha n’ibiyobyabwenge, ndetse rukanazirikana ko umubiri Imana yabahaye, iyo batawukoresheje neza, bituma batagera ku mugambi w’icyo yabaremeye.”

Senateri Dr. Murigande avuga ko ikintu cyose gituma Abanyarwanda bahura bagashyira hamwe, bakamenya ko basangiye amateka amwe, igihugu kimwe, ubuzima n’ejo hazaza, gituma bose bumva ko bakwiriye gufatanya no guhuriza hamwe imbaraga zo kubaka igihugu cyabo.

Ati: “Icyo nasaba Abanyarwanda ni uko bazinduka tugahurira kuri Stade twese tugashima Imana yaduhaye igihugu gitekanye gifite amahoro. Imana ikaba yaragikuye ahantu hakomeye cyanyuze, harimo na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ubu Abanyarwanda bakaba barongeye kwiyubaka bakabana mu mahoro.”

Senateri Dr. Murigande yavuze ko ibyo gushima Imana ari byinshi, kuko mu myaka 32 ishize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ihagaritswe, hari ibihamya bigaragaza ko u Rwanda rufite Imana irukunda kandi yakomeje kubana n’Abanyarwanda.

Yasobanuye ko muri iki giterane hazaba umwanya mwiza wo gushimira Imana kuba yarahaye u Rwanda n’Abanyarwanda ubuyobozi bwiza bureberera abaturage kandi buhora buri ku isonga mu kubungabunga amahoro yabo.

Yatumiye Abakirisitu bose kuzinduka kare bakitabira igiterane Rwanda Shima Imana, kuko ari umwanya mwiza wo gusabira igihugu cy’u Rwanda ibyiza n’umugisha bituruka ku Mana.

Wanditse

Ernestine Musanabera

Umunyamakuru

Minisitiri w’Ubuzima mu Rwanda, Dr. Sabin Nsanzimana, avuga ko we ku giti cye akunda kumva umuziki kuko umufasha gutuma yishima iyo ababaye cyangwa kongera ibyishimo iyo yishimye.
ART-MU8U0WIJ-4LV6.body:
Umuziki, umwe mu miti yifashishwa n’abaganga

Inzego z’ubuvuzi, zigaragaza ko umuziki usigaye ushyirwa mu rutonde rw’imiti yifashishwa mu kuvura abarwayi, kubera ko uvura ku buryo no mu Rwanda wifashishwa ku ndwara zimwe na zimwe.

Minisitiri w’Ubuzima mu Rwanda, Dr. Sabin Nsanzimana, avuga ko we ku giti cye akunda kumva umuziki kuko umufasha gutuma yishima iyo ababaye cyangwa kongera ibyishimo iyo yishimye.

Ati “Nkunda kugenda jyenyine mu modoka, ariko umuziki uba urimo, duhuye ntabwo wamenya ko ari jye, ushobora kumva mu modoka mfunguye nk’ikirahure, ukagira ngo ni Bushali uyitwaye. Nkunda umuziki, uramfasha cyane pe.”

Urukundo Dr. Nsanzimana afitiye umuziki, ngo rwatumye awukoraho ubucukumbuzi kugira ngo amenye akamaro ufite ku buzima bw’abantu.

Ati “Umuziki uri ku mwanya wa mbere mu bintu byongera akanyamuneza mu bantu. Niwo wa mbere wongera ibyishimo by’abantu, kurusha siporo, meditasiyo (Meditation), kurusha ibikorwa bihuriza hamwe abantu byose, ni wo wa mbere. Wongera akanyamuneza ku kigero cya 2”

Yungamo ati “Abantu bafite ibibazo byo mu mutwe, tubavuza akaziki keza, dufite ibitaro aho tukuryamisha, bakagushyiriramo umuziki, hari umuti bagutera muke ako kaziki kakagusinziriza ukabyuka agahinda gakabije kashize. Umuziki uravura niba mutari mubizi, muri abaganga mwese abakora umuziki, kubera ko muravura pe.”

Inzego z’ubuvuzi zigaragaza ko umuziki ushobora gukoreshwa nk’igikoresho cyunganira ubuvuzi, ugafasha kugabanya stress n’amaganya (anxiety) no gutuma umurwayi arushaho gutuza.

Ushobora kandi kwifashishwa mu kugabanya umuvuduko w’umutima n’uw’amaraso ku bantu bamwe na bamwe, cyane cyane iyo bumvise umuziki utuje.

Unafasha umuntu gusinzira neza, cyane cyane ku bafite ibibazo byo kudasinzira. Ukaba wanafasha mu kugabanya ububabare, nko ku barwayi bari kubagwa cyangwa nyuma yo kubagwa, iyo ukoreshejwe hamwe n’ubundi buvuzi.

Wanakwifashishwa mu gufasha mu gusubiza abarwayi ubushobozi bwo kuvuga, kugenda cyangwa kwibuka ku barwayi bafite ibibazo by’imyakura, bitewe n’uburyo music therapy ikoreshejwe.

Umuziki kandi wifashishwa mu gufasha abarwayi kongera kwibuka, by'umwihariko abantu bafite uburwayi bwo kwibagirwa no kudindira kw’imikorere y’ubwonko (Dementia).

Ariko abahanga bashimangira ko music therapy ari uburyo bw’ubuvuzi bugomba gukorwa mu buryo bugengwa cyangwa bukagenwa n’inzobere, kandi ko butasimbura imiti cyangwa ubundi buvuzi.

Wanditse

Tarib Abdul

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0XLO-IX5J.body:
Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma Yolande Makolo yahishuye ko buri gihe iyo ari ku rugendo aba yumva indirimbo z'abahanzi bo mu Rwanda

Muri iki kiganiro, abahanzi Nyarwanda mu njyana zabo zose n'ubushobozi bwabo bamaze kubaka bwose, bahuriye hamwe, ndetse batumira n'inzego za Leta ngo baganire kuri iki kibazo, ndetse bavuge n'umusanzu bashaka gutanga.

Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma, yagaragarije abahanzi nyarwanda ko bari gukora umurimo mwiza cyane, mu ruganda rw'umuziki, ndetse ko n'umusanzu bategerejweho, nta kabuza bazawutanga neza.

Ahereye ku makuru aheruka y'Umuziki mu Rwanda, Makolo yavuze iby'igitaramo cyatambutse muri weekend ishize, cy'Umuhanzi King James wataramiye Abanyarwanda iminsi ibiri yikurikiranya muri BK Arena, yizihiza imyaka makumyabiri y'ubuhanzi.

Makolo yagize ati "Mu by'ukuri, uruganda rw'umuziki mu Rwanda ruri gukora ibintu bitangaje. Ejobundi twagize weekend yihariwe na King James. Nahoze mbwira Maurice ko hakenewe n'umunsi wa gatatu kuko sinabashije kubona tike yo kwitabira."

Icyakora, Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma yavuze ko n’ubwo yacitswe n’igitaramo, yakurikiye uko cyagenze ku mbuga nkoranya mbaga, akumva ni byiza cyane, akaba ategereje kuzumva igitaramo cyose kuri Netflix.

Yagize ati “Byari ibintu bishimishije kubona uko King James yatanze igitaramo cyiza. Ariko icyarushijeho kunshimisha ni ukubona uburyo abandi bahanzi bo mu gihugu bamushyigikiye kandi bafatanyije na we ku rubyiniro. Byaranshimishije cyane kubona ubumwe n'ubufatanye buri mu ruganda rw'umuziki. Mwarakoze cyane.”

Makolo kandi yashimiye uburyo abari mu ruhando rwa muziki batumiye Leta muri ibi biganiro by’ingirakamaro, Yagize ati “Turabibashimira cyane. Kandi ndashaka kubabwira ko mwebwe abakora umuziki mugize igice cy'ingenzi kandi cyiza cyane cy'amateka y'u Rwanda. Ni ko biri rwose.”

Yongeyeho ati “Reka mbahe urugero rwanjye bwite. Ntabwo nakuriye mu Rwanda. Ndetse no kuvuga Ikinyarwanda sindabimenya neza. Mu by'ukuri, nasobanukiwe byinshi byavugiwe muri iki kiganiro. Ariko Icyongereza nkizi kurusha Ikinyarwanda. N’ubwo bimeze gutyo ariko, umuziki nyarwanda mpora nywitwaje aho ndi hose.”

Yongeyeho ati “Mu bihugu byinshi aho njya, hafi ya buri rutonde rw'indirimbo numva (playlist) ruba rwuzuyemo indirimbo z'abahanzi nyarwanda. Ni ibyiza ko benshi muri mwe musigaye muri kuri Spotify. Mfite urutonde rurerure rw'indirimbo zirenga 150 mpora numva.”

Aha kandi Makolo yagize ati “Nta kintu kindyohera nko kugenda mu kibuga cy'indege wambaye utwuma tw'amatwi ukumva umuziki nyarwanda, aho waba uri hose ku isi. Waba uri muri Bénin, Botswana cyangwa Sri Lanka…mpora nitwaje umuziki nyarwanda aho njya hose.”

Ndetse kugira ngo abisobanure neza, yagize ati “Iyo ndi mu modoka, muri tagisi cyangwa mu modoka yindi turi kumwe n'intumwa z’ibihugu, buri gihe mbwira udutwaye nti: "Fungura Bluetooth maze dushyireho umuziki nyarwanda muri iyi modoka." Kandi barawukunda.”

Aha ndetse iyo bamaze kumva izo ndirimbo, abo mu mahanga y’ahandi baramubwira baramusaba bati: "Wanyoherereza urwo rutonde rw'indirimbo (playlist)?"

Kandi mwebwe mugize uruhare rukomeye cyane muri urwo rugendo.”

Jean de la Croix Tabaro

ART-MU8U0Y4W-F0F3.body:
Ku bikorwa by’ubuhanzi, bongeyeho umuryango ‘Ufitimana Foundation’ ufasha abatishoboye

Abo bahanzikazi bavuga ko gushinga uyu muryango byaturutse ku gusobanukirwa n’ijambo ry’Imana rivuga ko kwizera kudafite imirimo kuba gupfuye.

Umuryango ‘Ufitimana Foundation’ ufite intero igira iti “Ngira Nkugire”, ukazajya utegura ibikorwa byo gufasha abatishoboye no gukomeza kugaragaza urukundo mu bikorwa.

Ku bufatanye na ABA Music Team n’abagiraneza batandukanye, abo bahanzikazi basuye abarwayi bo mu Bitaro bya Gisenyi, barabasengera, babaha ihumure ndetse banabashyikiriza ubufasha burimo amata, isukari, isabune, ibisuguti n'ibindi bifasha abantu mu buzima bwa buri munsi.

Innocent Ufitimana, ushinzwe kureberera inyungu za Alicia na Germaine, akaba n'umubyeyi wabo, yavuze ko yakiriye neza cyane igitekerezo cy’aba bahanzikazi cyo gutangiza ibikorwa by’ubugiraneza, ashimangira ko ari intambwe igaragaza ko ubutumwa baririmba batangiye no kubushyira mu bikorwa.

Ibikorwa byabo by’ubugiraneza babitangirije i Rubavu ari na ho bakomoka, bakaba bateganya kubikomereza no mu tundi turere.

Barasaba n’abandi bantu bose bafite umutima wo gufasha kwifatanya na bo muri uyu murimo mushya, kugira ngo ibikorwa byabo birusheho kwaguka no kugera kuri benshi bakeneye ubufasha.

Bagize bati: “Ku bifuza kwifatanya natwe, amarembo arafunguye. ‘Ngira Nkugire’, maze turangwe n’ubuntu, ubupfura, ubukristo n’urukundo.” Abifuza gushyigikira cyangwa kwifatanya n’uyu muryango kandi bashobora kubahamagara kuri +250 788 945 200.

Alicia na Germaine ni abahanzikazi bakunzwe cyane mu ndirimbo zirimo ‘Ibendera’, ‘Uriyo’, ‘Ndahiriwe’, ‘Urufatiro’, na ‘Ibanga’ baherutse gushyira hanze.

ART-MU8U0YNZ-67FK.body:
Barack Obama yashyize hanze urutonde rw'indirimbo zamunyuze mu mpeshyi ya 2026

Buri mwaka, Barack Obama, ashyira hanze urutonde rw'indirimbo zamunyuze mu bihe by'impeshyi ndetse no mu mpera z'umwaka. Iki gikorwa kiba kigamije gusangiza abakunzi be umuziki w'injyana zitandukanye zamufashije kuryoherwa n'ibihe.

Mu butumwa yaherekeje kuri uru rutonde, Obama yavuze ko yatangiranye indirimbo “Song of Good Hope” ya Glen Hansard, imwe mu ndirimbo yavuze ko akunda cyane we n’umugore we Michelle Obama.

Yagize ati: “Natangiye uru rutonde n’indirimbo njye na Michelle dukunda ya Glen Hansard, umuhanzi w’ikirangirire witabye Imana mu buryo bubabaje muri iki cyumweru. Twihanganishije umuryango we.”

Glen Hansard yapfuye ku wa 29 Nyakanga 2026, afite imyaka 56, apfira i Strawberry Beds, Dublin muri Ireland.

Glen Hansard yari umuhanzi ukomeye cyane mu njyana zitandukanye, cyane cyane folk na rock, akaba yaramenyekanye cyane mu ndirimbo nka “Falling Slowly” yamuhesheje igihembo cya Oscar.

Urupfu rwe rufatwa nk'igihombo gikomeye ku bakunzi b’umuziki ku Isi yose, cyane cyane abamukurikiraga kubera ubuhanga bwe mu kwandika no kuririmba indirimbo zifite amarangamutima akomeye.

Uru rutonde ngarukamwaka rwa Barack Obama rugaragaraho indirimbo zitandukanye zirimo iza kera n’igezweho, z’abahanzi b’ingeri zinyuranye zirimo hip-hop, soul, jazz, rock n’izindi. Ni urutonde rugaragaraho umuhanzi umwe gusa wo ku Mugabane wa Afurika.

Ni umuhanzikazi Tayla ukomoka muri Afurika y'Epfo, mu ndirimbo She Did It Again yakoranye na Zara Larsson.

Wanditse

Ruzindana Janvier

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0Z75-DSHD.body:
King James yiteguye ibitaramo bibiri byo kwizihiza imyaka 20 amaze mu muziki.

Ibi bitaramo ni bimwe mu byanditse amateka mbere y'uko biba,kuko nyuma y'aho amatike y'igitaramo cya mbere yashiriye ku isoko mu minsi itatu gusa, bikagaragaza urukundo n'ubwitabire bukomeye abakunzi b’ umuziki we bamufitiye.

Kubera ubusabe bwinshi bw'abakunzi be, abategura iki gitaramo bahise batangaza umunsi wa kabiri uzaba ku wa 2 Kanama 2026, kugira ngo n'abandi babone amahirwe yo kwifatanya na we muri ibi bitaramo.

Mu butumwa King James yagiye ashyira ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ze mu minsi ishize, yakomeje gushimira abakunzi be ku rukundo bamugaragarije, avuga ko ibi bitaramo ari uburyo bwo kwizihizanya urugendo rw'imyaka 20 rwuzuyemo ibihe byiza, ibigeragezo n'intsinzi.

King James yatangiye urugendo rwe rwa muzika mu 2006, aza kwamamara cyane binyuze mu ndirimbo zirimo Naratomboye, Igitekerezo, Yantumye, Birandenga, Meze Neza, Nta Mahitamo n'izindi nyinshi zamugize umwe mu bahanzi bafite amateka akomeye mu muziki nyarwanda. Muri uru rugendo kandi yegukanye ibihembo bitandukanye, birimo irushanwa rya Primus Guma Guma Super Star mu 2012.

Biteganyijwe ko azaririmba indirimbo zo mu gihe gishize kuva yatangira umuziki, ndetse akazanatanga ibindi yateguye avuga ko bizatungura abakunzi be,bizatuma ibi bitaramo bisiga amateka mu muziki nyarwanda.

Wanditse

Marie France Boda

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U0ZQC-E2Y3.body:
Weekend ya nyuma y’ukwa karindwi muzajya muba muri kumwe natwe - Abaramyi René & Tracy

Babigarutseho ubwo basobanuraga byinshi ku gitaramo bise ‘In Christ Now Worship Experience’ kizaba ku wa Gatandatu tariki 25 Nyakanga 2026 kikazabera ahazwi nko muri Camp Kigali.

René Patrick Iradukunda avuga ko iyi gahunda biyemeje ko izajya iba ngarukamwaka irenze kuba ari igitaramo. Yagize ati “Ni ihuriro ryo kuramya no guhimbaza. Usibye kuba jye na madamu turi abahanzi ariko turi n’abaramyi. Rero si igitaramo gusa, ahubwo ni umugoroba udasanzwe wo kuramya Imana no gusabana na yo mu buryo bwimbitse.”

Bavuga ko iki gikorwa cyatangiye kuza mu bitekerezo byabo mu mwaka wa 2019 mu kwezi kwa gatandatu, kigenda gikura. Icyo gihe cyitwaga ‘In His Presence’ . Mu mwaka wa 2022 nibwo batangiye kucyita ‘In Christ Now’ noneho mu mwaka ushize biyemeza kucyagura no kukigira ibihe byo gusabana n’Imana no kumva ukubaho kwayo ariko no kuryoherwa n’ubuzima buri muri Kristo Yesu, nk’uko bakomeje babisobanura.

René Patrick ati “Ni igitaramo ngarukamwaka ariko harimo n’ibindi bikorwa birimo tuzagenda dutangaza byo kujyana iki gicaniro cyo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana mu mashuri yisumbuye, muri za Kaminuza, mu mahuriro atandukanye. Rero ntabwo ari concert gusa, ahubwo ni uruhurirane rw’ibikorwa byinshi (movement) yo kujyana iki gicaniro hirya no hino, gusabana no kumva ubuzima buri muri Kristo Yesu."

Kuri iyi nshuro, iki gitaramo kizitabirwa n’abahanzi barimo abo mu Rwanda no mu mahanga barimo Ben na Chance bo mu Rwanda, Zoravo wo muri Tanzania, Bella Kombo na we wo muri Tanzania, Ebuka Songs wo muri Nigeria, Kalisa Kenneth wo mu Rwanda n’itsinda ry’abaramyi ryitwa Rebirth risanzwe rikorana na René na Tracy mu kuramya no guhimbaza Imana.

Iki gitaramo biteganyijwe ko kizamara amasaha arindwi nta guhagarara, imiryango ikazaba ifunguye guhera saa cyenda z’igicamunsi.

Abantu 1000 bahawe amahirwe yo kubona amatike y’ubuntu yo kwinjira muri icyo gitaramo, ayo matike y’ubuntu akaba yaramaze gushira nk’uko ikoranabuhanga ribigaragaza, ariko n’abandi bakaba barashyiriweho uburyo bwo kugura amatike y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi 10 n’ibihumbi 25.

Intego nyamukuru ngo si ukwishyuza ahubwo ni ukubona ubuzima bw’abantu buhinduka biturutse muri ubwo busabane.

René Patrick na Tracy barateganya ko mu myaka iri imbere iki gitaramo ngarukamwaka kizajya kimara umunsi urenze umwe, ndetse kikabera ahantu hashobora kwakira abantu benshi.

Igitaramo ‘In Christ Now’ giheruka cyabaye tariki 10 Mutarama 2026 kibera ahantu hasaga n’aho ari hato, ubu bakaba baratekereje kugikorera muri Camp Kigali hagutse, ndetse ubutaha bakaba batekereza no kuzagikorera ahandi hisumbuyeho bakurikije uko abantu bazagenda bagaragaza inyota yo kucyitabira ari benshi.

Ubwo basobanuraga impamvu bise igitaramo ‘In Christ Now’, René Patrick yagize ati “Muri Kristo ni ho dukomora icyo turi cyo cyose mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Nta wundi waducunguye, nta wundi dukesha ubugingo buhoraho uretse Kristo Yesu. Uwo nitumumenya neza natwe tuzimenya neza, bidufashe mu buzima bwacu.”

Bahuza bate kubana nk’umugabo n’umugore no gukora umuziki, kuramya no guhimbaza?

Ku kibazo cy’amatsiko cy’uburyo babasha guhuza umuziki, kuramya no guhimbaza Imana ndetse n’inshingano z’urugo rimwe na rimwe zibamo ibituma abantu bagirana amakimbirane, basobanuye ko bazirikana isoko y’urugo bubatse bagahamya ko bahujwe n’Imana.

Bagize bati “Isano n’ubuhamya dufitanye n’Imana bidufasha kwiyunga byihuse. Mu babana mu rugo ntibihora ari byiza, ariko kwiyunga kwacu gushamikiye ku mateka dufite y’uko twahujwe n’Imana.”

ART-MU8U109S-SUEV.body:
Diane Nkusi yasohoye amashusho y’indirimbo “Santa Israel”

Iyi ndirimbo ifite amateka yihariye mu buzima bwe, kuko yayanditse mu 2012 mu gihe yari ari mu bihe bikomeye byamusabaga kwizera Imana kurusha ikindi gihe cyose. Nk’uko yabitangaje, icyo gihe ubuzima bwe bwari bwaramubereye urugamba, asigara yiringira uburinzi bw’Imana gusa.

Yagize ati: "Santa Israel ni indirimbo nakoze muri 2012. Icyo gihe ntabwo byari byoroshye, nacaga mu bihe nari nkeneye gusa uburinzi bw'Imana. Mu gusenga rero Imana inyibutsa ko nk'uko ikunda Israel ikayitoranya, nanjye ari ko yantoranije ku bw'impamvu yayo." Yavuze ko ayo magambo yamubereye isoko y'imbaraga ndetse amwibutsa ko n'ubwo ibihe byari bikomeye, atari wenyine kuko Imana yari kumwe na we. Asobanura ubutumwa buri muri iyi ndirimbo, Diane Nkusi yavuze ko ari indirimbo igaragaza urukundo afitiye Imana ndetse n'ukwizera ubushobozi bwayo.

Ati: "Ubutumwa burimo ni ubwerekana urukundo mfitiye Imana, nemera ko ishoboye byose kandi ari yo indinda ku manywa na nijoro." Nkusi yongeraho ko yifuza ko buri wese uzumva Santa Israel yamwibutswa ko Imana ikomeza kurinda abayizera buri munsi, bityo bakarushaho kuyiramya no kuyishimira ineza ibagirira. Ati: "Ni ukwibutsa abantu ko ari Imana iturinda buri munsi kandi ko guhora tuyiramya ku bw'ineza itugirira ari ku nyungu ya buri wese."

Yongeyeho ko mu gihe cy’amasengesho, yumvise Imana imwibutsa ko nk’uko yakunze Israel ikayitoranya, na we yamutoranyije ku bw’impamvu yayo.

Indirimbo “Santa Israel” yakozwe mu buryo bw’amajwi na Ben Rugo, ikaba ari imwe mu ndirimbo Nkusi afata nk’ifite agaciro gakomeye, kuko ari ubuhamya bw’urugendo rwe n’Imana mu myaka myinshi ishize.

URUGENDO RWE MU MUZIKI WA GOSPEL

Nubwo “Santa Israel” ari bwo imaze gusohoka, Diane Nkusi amaze igihe kinini mu muziki wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana kuko mu 2010 yasohoye album ye ya mbere yise “Ndaguhaye Icyubahiro”, ndetse anakora igitaramo cyo kuyimurika.

Muri uwo mwaka kandi yashyize hanze indirimbo “Igitambo”, imwe mu zamumenyekanishije cyane mu muziki wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana. Ubu akaba ari gutegura album ye ya kabiri, anateganya gusohora indi ndirimbo nshya yise “Samuel the Prophet” mu minsi iri imbere.

Uretse umuziki, Diane Nkusi asobanura ko afite umuhamagaro mu buryo bwagutse bwo gukorera Imana. Ni we washinze umuryango wa gikristo Rebekah Global Ministries, ugamije gufasha abantu gukura mu buryo bw’umwuka no kubwiriza ubutumwa bwiza.

Avuga ko ibikorwa bye bishingiye ku nkingi eshatu zirimo umuziki, inyigisho binyuze mu bitabo ari gutegura, ndetse n’ivugabutumwa akorera muri uwo muryango.

DIANE NKUSI NI MUNTU KI?

Diane Nkusi yavukiye i Goma muri Repubulika Iharanira Demukarasi ya Congo mu 1985, ubu akaba atuye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya Kabiri mu mategeko, ndetse mu 2024 yasoje icyiciro cya Gatatu cya Kaminuza mu bijyanye n’Ubuzima Rusange (Public Health).

Avuga ko kwakira Kristo mu 2004 ari byo byahinduye ubuzima bwe, bituma afata icyemezo cyo gukorera Imana no gusangira n’abandi ubutumwa yizera. Diane Nkusi yashakanye na Edmond Nahimana, bafitanye umwana umwe w’umuhungu witwa Jayden Edmond.

Wanditse

Ruzindana Janvier

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U1DQ4-XXNL.body:
Umusore yiciye ikirenge nk’inzira izatuma aba umuganga

Kimwe n’urundi rubyiruko rwinshi rw’aho mu Buhinde, Suraj Bhaskar w’imyaka 20, ukomoka muri Uttar Pradesh, yarotaga kuzaba umuganga mu rwego rwo gushimisha umuryango we no kuwuhesha ishema. Icyakora, inzozi ze kuzigeraho byajemo ingorane, kuko yatsinzwe kabiri ikizamini cya ‘NEET’ cyo kwinjira mu ishuri ry’ubuvuzi. Ariko ntiyigeze acika intege, ahubwo yakomeje gushakisha indi nzira yashoboka.

Bikekwa ko Suraj yafashe icyemezo giteye ubwoba cyo kwikata ikirenge akagica, kugira ngo yemererwe kwinjira muri shuri ry’ubuvuzi. Polisi yatangaje ko yabikoze agamije kugira ngo bigaragare nk’aho yagabweho igitero cy’urugomo, agakomeretswa n’abagizi ba nabi, bityo azemererwe kujya kwiga muri iryo shuri nk’umwe mu bafite ubumuga.

Mu Buhinde, amategeko ateganya ko 5% by’imyanya mu mashuri makuru ya Leta n’aterwa inkunga na Leta, harimo n’ayigisha ubuvuzi, bigenerwa abafite ubumuga.

Amakuru y’uko yitemye ubwe, yamenyekanye nyuma y’uko mukuru we, Akash Bhaskar, amenyesheje Polisi ko abantu batazwi bagabye igitero kuri murumuna we mu Mudugudu wa Khalilpur, bakamusiga yataye ubwenge kandi yaciwe ikirenge.

Ubwo hahise hafungurwa dosiye, Polisi itangira iperereza ryaje kuvumbura ko hari ibintu byinshi bitari bihuye mu buhamya bwa Suraj.

Umuvugizi wa Polisi aganira n’itangazamakuru yagize ati, “Ukekwaho icyaha yagerageje kuyobya iperereza akoresheje inkuru mpimbano, ariko ibyo yavugaga ntibyashoboraga gusubiza ibibazo byinshi byerekeye isuzuma ry’ibimenyetso.”

Polisi kandi ngo yabonye agatabo ka Suraj yandikagamo gahunda ze za buri munsi, aho yanditse agira ati, “Nzaba umuganga …”. Polisi kandi ngo yanamenye ko uwo musore yari yaragerageje kubona ibyangombwa by’ abafite ubumuga amezi make mbere yo kwikomeretsa , ariko biramunanira.

Raporo y’abaganga igaragaza ko ikirenge cya Suraj cyaciwe mu buryo busukuye cyane, bishoboka ko hakoreshejwe imashini. Igikomere cyari gisukuye cyane ku buryo kidashobora kuba cyaratewe n’abamugabyeho igitero bakamutemesha icyuma nk’uko byavugagwa.

Hari kandi amacupa y’imiti n’inshinge byabonetse mu murima wari hafi y’aho bamusanze agaragaza ko ashobora kuba yarabanje kwitera ikinya (anesthésie) kugira ngo atumva ububabare mbere yo kwica ikirenge.

Umuvugizi wa Polisi yagize ati, “Uwo twita uwahohotewe yakomeje kugenda ahindagura ubuhamya bwe kandi agerageza kuyobya Polisi”.

Yongeraho ko Suraj Bhaskar yahise ajyanwa mu kigo cy’ubuvuzi cyita ku bahuye n’impanuka zikomeye kugira ngo yitabweho ku buryo bwisumbuyeho. Gusa ikirenge cye cyo ngo ntikiraboneka.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

Ubwo hahise hafungurwa dosiye, Polisi itangira iperereza ryaje kuvumbura ko hari ibintu byinshi bitari bihuye mu buhamya bwa Suraj.

Umuvugizi wa Polisi aganira n’itangazamakuru yagize ati, “Ukekwaho icyaha yagerageje kuyobya iperereza akoresheje inkuru mpimbano, ariko ibyo yavugaga ntibyashoboraga gusubiza ibibazo byinshi byerekeye isuzuma ry’ibimenyetso.”

Polisi kandi ngo yabonye agatabo ka Suraj yandikagamo gahunda ze za buri munsi, aho yanditse agira ati, “Nzaba umuganga …”. Polisi kandi ngo yanamenye ko uwo musore yari yaragerageje kubona ibyangombwa by’ abafite ubumuga amezi make mbere yo kwikomeretsa , ariko biramunanira.

Raporo y’abaganga igaragaza ko ikirenge cya Suraj cyaciwe mu buryo busukuye cyane, bishoboka ko hakoreshejwe imashini. Igikomere cyari gisukuye cyane ku buryo kidashobora kuba cyaratewe n’abamugabyeho igitero bakamutemesha icyuma nk’uko byavugagwa.

Hari kandi amacupa y’imiti n’inshinge byabonetse mu murima wari hafi y’aho bamusanze agaragaza ko ashobora kuba yarabanje kwitera ikinya (anesthésie) kugira ngo atumva ububabare mbere yo kwica ikirenge.
Umuvugizi wa Polisi yagize ati, “Uwo twita uwahohotewe yakomeje kugenda ahindagura ubuhamya bwe kandi agerageza kuyobya Polisi”.
Yongeraho ko Suraj Bhaskar yahise ajyanwa mu kigo cy’ubuvuzi cyita ku bahuye n’impanuka zikomeye kugira ngo yitabweho ku buryo bwisumbuyeho. Gusa ikirenge cye cyo ngo ntikiraboneka.

ART-MU8U1EA5-1OP3.body:
Basabye gatanya nyuma yo kunanirwa kumvikana ku izina ry’umwana wabo

Uwo mwana ubu nta burenganzira afite bwo kuba yahabwa icyemezo cy’amavuko ndetse ntashobora no gushyirwa ku rutonde rw’abana bahabwa inkingo, mu gihe ubu amaze umwaka urenga avutse, bitewe n’uko ababyeyi be bananiwe kumvikana ku izina rye.

Urukiko rwo mu Karere ka Pudong New Area muri Shanghai ruburanisha urubanza rwa gatanya rw’abo b bashakanye, rwagaragaje ko basezeranye mu 2023 nyuma bakaza kugira amahirwe yo kubyarana umwana w’umuhungu mu mpera za 2024.

Gusa ibyishimo byo kuba ababyeyi ntibyatinze, kuko ibintu byatangiye kuba bibi mu mubano wabo, bitewe n’uko bananiwe kumvikana ku izina ry’uwo mwana. Buri wese yashakaga ko umwana ahabwa izina yifuza, ariko biranga.

Ibimenyetso byatanzwe mu rukiko byagaragaje ko buri wese yagiye ku bitaro wenyine atabwiye mugenzi we, ajyanywe no kugerageza kwandikisha izina ashaka ku mwana batebyeranyaho, ariko nta n’umwe wigeze yemerwa kwandikisha izina ashaka aho ku bitaro, kubera ko ubwo buryo butari kuba bwujuje ibiteganywa n’amategeko.

Umucamanza uburanisha urwo rubanza yagize ati: “Umwana arengeje umwaka umwe avutse, ariko nta n’icyemezo cy’amavuko agira. Ntashobora kwandikishwa mu irangamimerere ry’umuryango, kandi no kubona inkingo biramugora.”

Urukiko rwashimangiye ko icyemezo cy’amavuko ari ingenzi cyane mu buvuzi no mu buzima bw’umwana muri rusange, kuko gifasha gutuma abona umwirondoro wemewe n’amategeko. Iyo ababyeyi batinze kucyaka bitewe n’amakimbirane yabo bwite, bigira ingaruka ku burenganzira bw’umwana muto, kandi ababyeyi bombi bagomba kubibazwa.

Rwibukije kandi ababyeyi ko badakwiye gukoresha abana babo nk’ibikoresho mu makimbirane n’amarangamutima yabo, cyangwa gukoresha ubwimvakane bucye bafitanye nk’urwitwazo rwo guhunga inshingano zabo zo kurera no kurinda abana.

Mu rwego rwo kurengera uburenganzira bw’ibanze bw’uwo mwana muto, urukiko rwasohoye itangazo ryihariye ryiswe “Itangazo ryo kwita ku bana bato,” risaba ababyeyi bombi kumvikana kugira ngo babone icyemezo cy’amavuko mu gihe cyagenwe.

Gusa,hahise havuka ikindi kibazo, batangira kongera guterana amagambo ku bijyanye n’ugomba kubika inyandiko z’umwimerere z’umwana. Nyuma y’imbaraga nyinshi zo kunga impande zombi, hafashwe umwanzuro w’uko icyemezo cy’amavuko cy’umwana cyabikwa by’agateganyo n’urukiko, hanyuma kikazahabwa umubyeyi w’umugore kugira ngo ashobore gukora ibiteganywa n’itegeko byo kwandikisha umwana mu irangamimerere.

Urwo rubanza rudasanzwe rwa gatanya rwakwirakwiye cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zo mu Bushinwa, bituma bamwe bavuga ko burya n’ikintu gito, gishobora gusenya urugo.

Umwe muri abo yanditse agira ati, “Abashakanye bameze nk’aba ntibakwiye kubyara abana.”

Undi na we yagize ati: “Ni indangare gusa. Izina ntiryagombye kuba ikibazo, barimo kudindiza ubuzima bw’umwana, ntibakwiye kuba ababyeyi”.

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U1ETN-EGYQ.body:
Kwamamaza resitora ari kumwe n'umugore w'abandi bimusenyeye urugo

Uwo mugabo wo mu gace kitwa Sicile yatanze ikirego mu rukiko, arega resitora yamugaragaje mu mashusho yo kwamamaza yo mu buryo bwa videwo yashyizwe kuri TikTok, kandi nta ruhushya yabitangiye.

Icyakora, urwo rubanza rwagize uburemere cyane, bitewe n’uko ayo mashusho yashyizwe kuri TikTok yabonwe n’umugore we maze bigatuma urugo rwabo rusenyuka.

Ayo mashusho ni yo ngo yakoreshejwe nk’ikimenyetso cy’uko yamucaga inyuma, kubera izo mpamvu, uwo mugabo akaba arega iyo resitora ayishinja kwivanga mu buzima bwe bwite no kubangamira uburenganzira bwe.

Ntabwo bizwi neza, niba uwo mugore wababajwe cyane no kumenya ko umugabo we amuca inyuma, ari we ubwe wiboneye ayo mashusho kuri TikTok ayaguyeho gutyo gusa, cyangwa se niba yarayeretswe n’undi waba yarayabonye mbere ye akayamwoherereza.

Gusa, icy’ingenzi kizwi, ni uko yamubonye ari kumwe n’undi mugore atazi aho muri resitora, nyamara yari yamubwiye ko yagiye mu gikorwa cyo gusangira na bagenzi be bakorana mu kazi.

Kubera kumva yasuzuguwe ndetse agahemukirwa n’umugabo ku mugaragaro, uwo mugore yafashe icyemezo cyo guhagarika iby’urukundo no kutazongera kubana mu rugo nk’umugore n’umugabo.

Mu gihe uwo mugabo yamenyaga ko umugore we yamuvumbuye kuri iyo myitwarire mibi, binyuze mu kureba amashusho yo kwamamaza resitora, yahise afata icyemezo cyo kugana inkiko, ashinja ba nyiri iyo resitora ko bahutaje uburenganzira bwe bwo kubaho mu buzima bwite.

‘Codacons’, umuryango wo mu Butaliyani uharanira uburenganzira bw’abaguzi ni wo uhagarariye uwo mugabo mu rubanza.

Francesco Tanasi, umuvugizi wa Codacons, yagize ati: “Ntibyemewe na gato ko resitora ifata amashusho y’abakiriya bayo itabiherewe uruhushya rugaragara, hanyuma ikayatangaza, bigashyira abantu mu ngaruka zitateganyijwe. Nk’uko byagenze kuri uyu mugabo, hari ubwo, gutangaza amashusho bishobora kugira ingaruka zikomeye cyane ku buzima bwite bw’umuntu no ku mibanire y’umuryango we.”

Codacons irimo gusaba indishyi mu izina ry’umukiliya wayo, ariko kandi inashaka gutanga ikirego mu kigo cy’u Butaliyani gishinzwe kurengera amakuru yihariye y’abantu. Urwo rubanza rushobora kuzagira ingaruka zikomeye ku bijyanye no kubaha ubuzima bwite bw’abantu, cyane cyane mu byerekeye kwamamaza.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

Icyo gihe ukwezi kuba kwanyuze inyuma y’Isi kugakingirizwa na yo, bityo urumuri ruva ku zuba ntirugere ku kwezi nk’uko bikwiye, bigatuma kwaka ibice, kukagera igihe guhinduka umutuku ndetse hari n’ubwo kuba umukara kubera ko hari imirasire y’izuba iba igera ku kwezi ivuye ku Isi. Uko gutukura ni ho haturutse iryo zina ry’ubwirakabiri bw’ukwezi kw’amaraso (Blood moon eclipse).
ART-MU8U1GGC-KFSV.body:
Ese waba wabonye ubwirakabiri bw'ukwezi?

Icyo gihe ukwezi kuba kwanyuze inyuma y’Isi kugakingirizwa na yo, bityo urumuri ruva ku zuba ntirugere ku kwezi nk’uko bikwiye, bigatuma kwaka ibice, kukagera igihe guhinduka umutuku ndetse hari n’ubwo kuba umukara kubera ko hari imirasire y’izuba iba igera ku kwezi ivuye ku Isi.

Uko gutukura ni ho haturutse iryo zina ry’ubwirakabiri bw’ukwezi kw’amaraso (Blood moon eclipse).

Ibyo nubwo bidakunze kubaho, biba igihe Isi n’ukwezi biri ku murongo umwe cyangwa igihe byegeranye cyane ariko Isi ikaba ari yo iri hagati.

Ubwirakabiri bwuzuye bw'ukwezi bushobora kugaragara mu kirere kuva ku minota runaka kugera ku masaha hafi abiri. Igihe bumara gihindagurika bitewe n’aho Isi, Izuba n’ukwezi bigeze.

ART-MU8U1GZS-EP6F.body:
Yigize umuforomo afatwa amaze kuvura abasaga 4,000

Uwo mugore ukurikiranyweho uburiganya bwashoboraga no guteza urupfu, yitwa Autumn Bardisa w’imyaka 29, yafashwe n’inzego z’umutekano zimusanze iwe mu rugo, kubera ko yigize umuforomo ubifitiye impamyabumenyi. Muri rusange yatanze serivisi z’ubuvuzi ku barwayi bagera ku 4.486 hagati y’ukwezi kwa Kamena 2024 na Mutarama 2025, nk’uko byatangajwe n’ubuyobozi bwa Polisi aho muri Florida.

Ibyaha akurikiranyweho, byatangiye muri Nyakanga 2023, ubwo yahabwaga akazi mu bitaro bya ‘AdventHealth Palm Coast Parkway’ biherereye ahitwaa i Palm Coast nk’umuforomo wabyigiye, agatangira gukora avuga ko yarangije amahugurwa yose asabwa ku muforomo, ariko abeshya ko icyangombwa cye ari cyo asigaje kubona gusa, nk’uko bikubiye mu itangazo ryasohowe na polisi.

Muri uko guhabwa akazi, yaje kwemeza ko yakoze n’ikizamini gisabwa, ndetse atanga numero y’icyangombwa cy’umuntu bahuje izina (prénom), ariko badahuza izina ry’umuryango, asobanura ko impamvu ari uko aherutse guhinduza amazina. Nyuma yaho yasabwe kuzana icyangombwa cy’uko yashyingiwe (acte de marriage), ntiyigera agitanga.

Nubwo atigeze atanga iyo nyandiko yemeza ko yashyingiwe nk’uko yari yayisabwe, uwo mugore yazamuwe mu ntera muri Mutarama 2025, bituma abo bakorana batangira kumugiraho ibibazo by’amatsiko bitandukanye.

Mu kugenzura, umwe muri abo bakoranaga na we yaje kuvumbura ko uwo mugore nta cyangombwa afite kimwemerera gukora akazi arimo ko kuvura abantu, kubera ko yari afite ikimwemerera kuba umufasha w’umuforomo (assistante infirmière) gusa, kandi nacyo cyararengeje igihe.

Nyuma y’iperereza ry’imbere muri ibyo bitaro bya AdventHealth yakoreraga, byaje kugaragara ko hari ibyangombwa uwo mugore yasabwe ariko akaba atarabitanze.

Nyuma y’uko Autumn Bardisa, bimunaniye kwisobanura ku bibazo biri mu myirondoro ye, yahise yirukanwa mu kazi, ariko ikibazo cye kimenyeshwa inzego z’ubuyobozi, zihita zitangira kumukoraho iperereza ku byaha yakekwagaho.

Nyuma y’mezi arindwi (7) y’iperereza, abagenzacyaha bo mu ishami ry’ubuzima aho muri Leta ya Florida, bajyanye uwo mugore mu ibazwa ku byaha akekwaho, babaza na bagenzi be bakoranaga, biza kugaragara ko yibye umwirondoro w’undi muntu.

Iperereza ryaje kugaragaza ko uwo mugore ahuje izina rimwe n’undi muforomo ukorera mu bindi bitaro bya AdventHealth, bakaba barize ku ishuri rimwe nubwo bataziranye.

Ku wa kabiri tariki 5 Kanama 2025, nibwo hasohotse inyandiko zo kumuta muri yombi, akurikiranyweho ibyaha bitandukanye harimo gukora umwuga w’ubuvuzi mu buryo butemewe n’amategeko, uburiganya no gukoresha imyirondoro itari iye. Yahise atabwa muri yombi bamusanze iwe, ubu akaba afungiye by’agateganyo ahitwa muri centre Perry Hall.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U1HK8-KBCU.body:
U Bushinwa: Hari abonka za ‘tetine’ mu kwirwanyiriza umujagararo (stress)

Urubyiruko rw’aho mu Bushinwa, ruhura na byinshi birutera umujagararo, nk’ibibazo bijyanye n’akazi, amikoro nko kubona ingwate ku nguzanyo, kwishyura imyenda baba barafashe bagura imodoka n’ibindi, ndetse n’ibibazo bijyana n’imibanire yabo n’abandi.

Muri rusange, ubuzima bugezweho bukurura ibibazo byinshi by’umuhangayiko. Ariko se ni nde wigeze atekereza ko konka ‘tetine/pacifier’ byafasha mu kugabanya ibyo bibazo!

Ikigaragara, Abashinwa bo bamenye iryo banga, kuko tetine z’abantu bakuru zimaze kwamamara cyane muri icyo gihugu, aho usanga ibihumbi by’urubyiruko bakoresha ari hagati ya 10 na 500 by’Amayuan ni ukuvuga ($1.40 na $ 70) kuri izo ‘tetine’ za palasitiki.

Izo tetine zigurishwa nk’ibikoresho bifasha mu kurwanya umujagararo n’umuhangayiko, bigafasha abantu gusinzira mu gihe bagowe n’ibibazo by’ubuzima bwa buri munsi. Imbuga za interineti zikorerwaho ubucuruzi bwazo, zicuruza ibihumbi byinshi buri kwezi.

Abahanga mu by’imitekerereze mu Bushinwa bavuga ko igituma ikoreshwa rya tetine ririmo kwamamara cyane, bijyana n’icyitwa ‘regression phenomenon’, kivuga ko iyo abantu bahanganye n’ibibazo bibaremereye cyane, bisanga barimo gusubira inyuma mu myaka, bakagira imyitwarire nk’iy’abana.

Mu by’ukuri se, tetine z’abakuru zifasha mu kugabanya umujagararo? Ku rubuga rwa interineti rwo mu Bushinwa rwa Sohu, baherutse gusohora raporo igaragaza ibyo abakoresha imbuga nkoranyambanga ndetse n’abakoresha izo tetine bazivugaho.

Abenshi bemeza ko iyo bazinyunguta bari mu kazi, biyumva nta mujagararo mwinshi bafite, bagasinzira neza mu gihe cyo kuryama, kandi bakiyumva batuje nk’abana bato.

Gusa, inzobere zivuga ko gukoresha izo tetine igihe kirekire byagira ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima. Dr. Tang Caomin wo muri Kaminuza ya Sichuan University’s Huaxi College of Stomatology, yavuze ko imiterere yo mu kanwa ku bantu bakuru itandukanye cyane n’iy’abana.

Dr. Tang Caomin yavuze ko gukoresha ‘tetine’ z’abakuru igihe kirekire bitera ikibazo cyitwa ‘temporomandibular joint disorder’, kijyana no kubabara imisaya, kumva imisaya ikora amajwi (clicking sounds) no kubabara igihe umuntu afunga cyangwa afungura umunwa.

Yongeyeho ko bishobora guteza ikibazo ku ruhu rwo mu kanwa (oral mucosa).

Yagize ati “Ibyo izo tetine z’abakuru zikorwamo n’imiterere yazo, bishobora kutajyana n’ubuzima bwo mu kanwa bw’abantu bakuru, ku buryo byahangiza bikaba byanahatera ibisebe. Zanateza ibibazo by’umutekano w’ubuzima mu gihe umuntu azisinzirana mu kanwa, kuko zishobora kubangamira imihumekere ye, bikaba byanamuheza umwuka”.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U1I4I-I276.body:
U Buhinde: Yakoresheje uburyo budasanzwe mu kwikiza umugore we agamije gushaka undi

Uwo mugabo yahamijwe n’urukiko icyaha cyo kwica umugore we, binyuze mu gukodesha inzoka y’ubumara yo kumuruma, kugira ngo bigaragare ko ari impanuka yagize, bityo atware imirimbo ye y’agaciro, abone n’uko yishakira undi mugore.

Ni ikintu cyafashwe nk’ubwicanyi bukozwe mu buryo bugezweho, aho uwo mugabo wo mu gace kitwa Kollam muri Leta ya Kerala yahamijwe n’urukiko, kuba yarateguye akanashyira mu bikorwa umugambi wo kwica umugore we, yifashishije inzoka y’ubumara.

Uwo mugabo yakoze icyo cyaha mu buryo bugoye kwemeza ko yaba ari we koko, ku buryo byafashe umwaka wose, abagenzacyaha bakusanya ibimenyetso byo kukimuhamya. Mu by’ukuri yari kuba yidegembya na n’ubu, iyo bitaba umuhate w’ababyeyi b’umugore we, batanze ikirego mu rukiko bavuga ko yishe umuntu ariko agashaka amayeri atuma bitagaragara ko ari we wabikoze.

Abashinjacyaha babonye ibimenyetso bishinja uwo mugabo kuba ari we wazanye inzoka yarumye umugore we bwa mbere muri Werurwe umwaka ushize, akayizana ayikodesheje ku muntu ushinzwe kwita ku nzoka muri ako gace. Icyo gihe, yamurumye ari mu rugo rwabo aho babanaga, hamwe n’umwana wabo umwe bari bamaze kubyarana. Gusa, kuri iyo nshuro ya mbere yagize amahirwe ntiyahita apfa.

Muri Gicurasi umwaka ushize, mu gihe yarimo akira igisebe yatewe n’iyo nzoka yamurumye ku nshuro ya mbere, uwo mugore yongeye kurumwa n’indi nzoka bwa kabiri, ariko noneho ahita apfa. Abagenzacyaha, bashoboye kwerekana ukuntu uwo mugabo ari we wazanye mu rugo izo nzoka zarumye nyakwigendera.

Ubushinjacyaha bwatanze ibimenyetso byerekana ukuntu uwo mugabo yamaze amezi ashakisha kuri interineti uko umuntu yakwitwara mu gihe arumwe n’inzoka y’ubumara bwica, hanyuma ahita ashaka ubimufashamo utuye muri ako gace, usanzwe akora akazi ko kwita ku nzoka (snake handler).

Polisi yashoboye gukurikirana no gufata uwo muntu ukora umwuga wo kwita ku nzoka, yiyemerera ko ari we watoje uwo mugabo uburyo yakwitwara mu gihe afite inzoka y’ubumara izwi nka cobra, yiyemereye kandi ko ari we wamuhaye izo yajyanye iwe mu rugo ku nshuro ebyiri zitandukanye.

Bivugwa ko kuri iyo nshuro ya kabiri, uwo mugabo yashyize ibinini bisinziriza mu cyo kunywa cy’umugore we, hanyuma amaze gusinzira, ahita amurekuriraho iyo nzoka imuruma ahantu habiri hatandukanye. Nyuma y’aho, uwo mugabo ngo yamaze ijoro ryose akanuye yirinda ko na we iyo nzoka yaza kumuruma nk’uko yabyihamirije ubwe.

Bucyeye mu gitondo, uwo mugabo yitwaye nk’umuntu utunguwe cyane no kubona umurambo w’umugore we mu buriri, ariko ababyeyi ba nyakwigendera banga kwemera ibyo avuga, kuko bari bazi ko uwo mukwe wabo ndetse n’umuryango we, bari bamaze amezi menshi bamuhoza ku nkeke kubera ikibazo cy’inkwano, nubwo bari barahawe zahabu, n’amafaranga abarirwa mu 6.630 by’Amadolari ndetse n’imodoka ku munsi w’ubukwe. Kubera iyo mpamvu bahise batanga ikirego mu rukiko, barega uwo mugabo kuba ari we uri inyuma y’urupfu rw’umukobwa wabo.

Ibyo bikimara kuba, uwo mugabo n’umuryango we, bahise nabo batanga ikirego kigamije gusibanganya ibimenyetso, barega musaza w’umugore, kuba ari we wishe mushiki we kugira ngo azungure umutungo w’umuryango wose. Ariko polisi ije mu iperereza isanga bigaragara neza ko ntaho uwo warezwe yaba ahuriye n’icyo cyaha, ahubwo ivuga ko hari byinshi uwo mugabo wa nyakwigendera arimo ahisha.

Kuko nta mutangabuhamya wari uhari wundi, abashinjacyaha bifashishije inzobere mu by’ubuzima bw’inzoka n’abandi bakoresha n’ibimenyetso bya gihanga, byerekana itandukaniro riri hagati y’igikomere cy’umuntu warumwe n’inzoka ari impanuka, n’uwarumwe n’inzoka bayimushumurije. Umwe mu bagenzacyaha yabwiye ikinyamakuru Hindustan Times ko “iyo inzoka irumye umuntu by’impanuka, igikomere imutera kiba kiri hagati ya 1.7 -1.8 cm, ariko kuri uwo mugore, ibikomere bye byari binini kuruta ibyo, kimwe cyari 2.3 cm, ikindi ari 2.8 cm. Nyuma y’uko urukiko ruhamije uwo mugabo kuba ari we wishe umugore we, se yagize ati “Ndishimye kubera ko umukobwa wanjye ashyize akabona ubutabera. Twizeye ko ahanishwa igihano kinini gishoboka. Turimo turasenga ngo ntihazagire abandi babyeyi bahura n’ibihe nk’ibyo turimo kunyuramo n’ibyo twahuye nabyo”.

Uwo mugabo yahamijwe n’urukiko icyaha cyo kwica umugore we, binyuze mu gukodesha inzoka y’ubumara yo kumuruma, kugira ngo bigaragare ko ari impanuka yagize, bityo atware imirimbo ye y’agaciro, abone n’uko yishakira undi mugore.

ART-MU8U1INW-KKNT.body:
U Buhinde: Umugore yasamye inda, ijya mu mwijima we aho kujya muri nyababyeyi

Uwo mugore uri mu kigero cy’imyaka 30, ngo yari amaze iminsi afite ububabare bukabije mu nda, bikajyana no kuruka.

Bwa mbere ajya kureba abaganga ngo bamufashe, ngo bamunyujije mu cyuma, ariko ntibigera babona igitera ubwo bubabare. Nyuma yahise yoherezwa ku bindi bitaro byigenga kunyuzwa mu cyuma cya MRI mu gace kitwa Meerut.

Icyo kizamini cya MRI cyakozwe n’umuganga witwa Dr KK Gupta, inzobere mu bijyanye n’ibyo byuma bikoreshwa mu buvuzi byerekana amashusho (radiologie). Gusa, ibyo yabonye nyuma yo gukora icyo kizamini ngo byaramutunguye cyane.

Dr Gupta yagize ati, “ Ubwo nari mbonye icyo icyuma cyerekana amashusho y’imbere mu mubiri kigaragaje, numvise ntizeye niba amaso yanjye areba neza. Umwana uri mu nda, yaragiye ajya mu mwijima mu ruhande rw’iburyo, kandi umutima we utera neza ku buryo bugaragara”.

Yakomeje agira ati, “ Sinigeze na rimwe mbona ibintu bimeze bityo mu buzima bwanjye bw’umwuga w’ubuvuzi mazemo imyaka isaga 20, kandi bishobora kuba ari inshuro ya mbere bigaragaye mu Buhinde”.

Yasobanuye ko icyo cyuma gisuzuma, cyagaragaje ingobyi umwana akuriramo iri mu mwijima w’uwo mubyeyi, bigaragara ko uwo mwana uri mu nda amaze kugira ibyumweru 12, imitsi itembereza amaraso iyavana mu mwijima, ni yo yamugaburiraga. Nyababyeyi ye (uterus) yari irimo ubusa, ibyo bikemeza ko inda yari atwite, itari inda isanzwe.

Ikinyamakuru Times of India, cyatangaje ko Dr Gupta n’itsinda bari kumwe, bongeye bagakora icyo kizamini cya ‘MRI’ bahereye mu nguni zitandukanye, kugira ngo bizere neza ko ibyo barebaga byari ukuri.

Dr Gupta yagize ati, “ Bwa mbere nabanje kwibwira ko ari ukwibeshya, ariko dukoze ibindi bizamini byo gusuzuma biza byemeza ko ibyo twabonye mbere, ariko bimeze. Kuva ubwo twahise tumenya ko umubyeyi dufite imbere yacu atwite inda idasanzwe kandi ishyira ubuzima bwe mu kaga ku buryo bukomeye cyane”.

Ni yo mpamvu nyuma y'aya makuru, hahise hatangira ibiganiro byo mu rwego rw’ubuvuzi, biga uko bamufasha mu buryo bwiza bushoboka.

Icyo kibazo uwo mubyeyi afite, ngo cyagaragaye ku itariki 30 Nyakanga 2025, ariko kugeza ubu abaganga baracyakurikirana uko uwo mubyeyi ameze mbere yo kwanzura uburyo bakoresha mu kumuvura.

Inzobere mu by’ubuvuzi zivuga ko ikibazo yagize kizafasha mu gutuma abaganga barushaho gusobanukirwa byinshi biruseho ku bijyanye n’inda zidasanzwe n’ibibazo bijyana na zo ndetse no kurushaho kuvugurura uburyo bwo gusuzuma abagore batwite.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

ART-MU8U1J7W-YQY8.body:
Kurota inzozi mbi kenshi, byatera ibyago byo gupfa imburagihe

Iyo mibare iteye impungenge ni iyavuye mu bushakashatsi bune bwakozwe mu bihe bitandukanye, ariko bukamara igihe kirekire bukorerwa muri Amerika, bukorerwa ku bantu 4.000 bafite imyaka iri hagati ya 26 na 74.

Ku ntangiriro z’ubushakashatsi, abo babukorerwagaho, bavugaga umubare cyangwa inshuro inzozi mbi zacikirije ibitotsi byabo, bagakanguka batabimaze kubera kwikanga. Nyuma y’imyaka 18 ubushakashatsi butangiye, inzobere zarimo zibukora, zatangaje ko mu bantu barimo bakorerwaho ubushakashatsi, muri rusange abari bamaze gupfa, batarageza kuri ya myaka 75 bari 227.

Na nyuma yo kureba ku zindi mpamvu zitandukanye zishobora kuba impamvu y’urupfu rw’abantu, harimo izabukuru, umubyibuho ukabije, ibibazo by’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe,…abo bashakashatsi bavumbuye ko abantu barota inzozi mbi buri cyumweru, bafite ibyago byikubye gatatu byo gupfa imburagihe, mbese nk’uko bimeze ku bantu banywa itabi ryinshi.

Inzozi cyangwa se kurota, ubusanzwe ngo biza mu gihe umuntu aryamye asinziriye, mu gihe ubwonko buba burimo gukora akazi cyane, ariko indi mitsi yo ituje. Kwiyongera gutunguranye k’imisemburo ya adrenaline, cortisol, n’indi misemburo bigira ingaruka mbi ku buzima bw’umuntu kuko ari ibintu biba bimutunguye.

Uko gucikiza ibitotsi bitewe no kurota inzozi mbi, iyo biba kenshi ngo bigira ingaruka zirimo kunanirwa gutekereza neza, bikagira n’ingaruka ku mubiri, kwiyongera k’umuuduko w’amaraso ndetse no kugabanuka k’ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri ubwawo.

Uretse ibyo, gukangurwa n’inzozi mbi ku buryo butunguranye, birogoya ibitotsi byimbitse kandi ari ikintu cy’ingenzi umubiri ukenera kugira ngo ushobore kuruhuka uko bikwiye. Iyo ibyo bibazo byombi bihuye, harimo kunanirwa gutekereza neza, no kudasinzira neza, biba impamvu ikomeye ituma umubiri w’umuntu usaza imburagihe kandi ku muvuduko wihuse.

Ubundi bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko abantu bakuru bakunze kurota inzozi mbi buri cyumweru, baba bafite ibyago gufatwa n’indwara ihungabanya ubwenge bw’abantu izwi nka ‘Parkinson’, kandi ikaza hakiri kare, kuko ubasanzwe ngo ari indwara ikunze kwibasira abageze mu zabukuru. Ubwo bushakashatsi bwanerekanye ko igice cy’ubwonko kigenzura ibijyanye n’inzozi, nacyo ngo kigenda cyangizwa n’indwara z’ubwonko, biturutse kuri uko kurota inzozi ziteye ubwoba kenshi cyangwa se nibura buri cyumweru.

Inzozi ziteye ubwoba, zibaho kuko ubwo bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko nibura 5% by’abantu bakuru barota inzozi mbi ziteye ubwoba, nibura inshuro imwe mu cyumweru, mu gihe abagera kuri 12.5% bo barota inzozi ziteye ubwoba nibura inshuro imwe mu kwezi nk’uko byatangajwe n’ikinyamakuru BBC.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru

Ubwo bushakashatsi bwanerekanye ko igice cy’ubwonko kigenzura ibijyanye n’inzozi, nacyo ngo kigenda cyangizwa n’indwara z’ubwonko, biturutse kuri uko kurota inzozi ziteye ubwoba kenshi cyangwa se nibura buri cyumweru.

Inzozi ziteye ubwoba, zibaho kuko ubwo bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko nibura 5% by’abantu bakuru barota inzozi mbi ziteye ubwoba, nibura inshuro imwe mu cyumweru, mu gihe abagera kuri 12.5% bo barota inzozi ziteye ubwoba nibura inshuro imwe mu kwezi nk’uko byatangajwe n’ikinyamakuru BBC.

ART-MU8U1JRX-BFC6.body:
Nashakanye n’abagabo 12 biranga, ariko nizeye kuzabona ukwiye - Ubuhamya

Uwo mugore witwa Cynthia Achieng' Abok, avuga ko mu bagabo bose amaze gushaka byabaga bisa no kugonga urutare, bikarangira ubu asigaye ari wenyine yirerana abana batatu yabyaye muri izo nshako zitandukanye yanyuzemo.

Abok avuga ko ashaka umugabo wa mbere, yari akiri muto, ajya gushaka bitewe n’ibibazo by’ubuzima bubi yabonaga iwabo, akibwira ko gushaka umugabo, wenda byamufasha kubaho neza. Kimwe mu byatumaga ubuzima bugorana mu muryango we, ngo ni uko ababyeyi be batandukanye mu gihe yari akiri umwana, hanyuma nyina ajya gushaka undi mugabo, ariko uwo mugabo ntiyishimira kurera abo bana batari abe.

Yagize ati “Mama wanjye yashatse ahandi, ariko ubuzima bwo kubana n’uwo mugabo we kuri njye ntibyari byoroshye. Hari igihe cyageze abavandimwe banjye bandi barahava barigendera, njyewe nkomeza kugerageza kugumana na mama muri uwo muryango we mushya, ariko ntibyari byoroshye, rwose ntabwo byari ibyo kwihanganirwa”.

Nyuma y’igihe gito ashakanye n’umugabo wa mbere, ngo yamubwiye ko atakimukunda ndetse ahita azana undi mugore wa kabiri avuga ko ari uwo kumusimbura, ubwo batandukana batyo.

Yagize ati “Abenshi mu bagabo nashatse, babaga ari abanyabinyoma, bakambeshya ko bankunda by’ukuri, nanjye kuko nabaga nsa n’uwihebye nkabyemera. Bamwe bansezeranyije kunsubiza ku ishuri ndabyemera kuko numvaga kwiga ari ibintu nifuza cyane, bakansezeranya ubuzima bwiza n’ibindi byinshi, ariko twamara kubana mu mezi runaka cyangwa se umwaka, nkaza gusanga ibyo banyijeje byose byari ibinyoma. Nagiye mbana n’abagabo bikunda, batanyitayeho, nyamara bakansezeranya byinshi kandi bazi neza ko bambeshya”.

Abok avuga ko muri abo bagabo batandukanye yashatse, harimo uwari Pasiteri mu itorero runaka atifuje kuvuga, uwo Pasiteri akaba yari afite imyaka 77, ashaka Abok nk’umugore wa kabiri, ariko ajya kumutuza kure y’umugore we wa mbere, bagira amahirwe yo kubyarana umwana umwe muri batatu afite, ariko ikibazo kiza kuba ko uwo Pasiteri na we, atigeze yubahiriza ibyo yaseranyije uwo mugore, kuko mbere yo kumushaka, ngo yari yaramwizeje ko azamwitaho neza, akamufasha kumuzamura mu bukungu no kumuhindurira ubuzima, ariko ntiyabikora.

Yagize ati “Yari umugabo wari ufite undi mugore, ajya kuntuza kure y’umugore we mukuru. Yazaga iwanjye kenshi, ariko ibyo yansezeranyije mbere yo kunshaka ntiyigeze abyuzuza. Byaje kugera aho atangira kumpohotera bikabije, akanshyiraho n’iterabwoba, ubwo kubana kwacu bizamo ibibazo, kurusha uko ari ibyishimo, biza kurangira dutandukanye”.

Nyuma y’uko urwo rugo rwa 12 rusenyutse, Abok yisanze afite abana batatu yabyaye muri izo nshako zitandukanye yanyuzemo, ariko nta bushobozi afite kandi agomba kubarera wenyine.

Ubwo ngo yatangiye kujya akora imirimo y’amaboko ashakisha imibereho, nko kumesera abantu n’ibindi, ariko hakaba nubwo asaba ubufasha mu bantu kugira ngo abone ibyo atungisha abana be, nk’uko yabibwiye ikinyamakuru Tuko cyandikirwa aho muri Kenya.

Nubwo bimeze bityo ariko, Abok avuga ko nubwo yanyuze muri ibyo byose, atarahurwa ibijyanye n’ubuzima bw’urukundo, kuko yizera ko ashobora kuzabona umugabo mwiza ukwiye, bakazabana ubuziraherezo.

Yagize ati “Hari igihe Imana izanzanira umuntu mwiza. Na n’ubu ndacyashoboye kongera gukunda, wenda ubu nonaha siniteguye, ariko sinafunze imiryango yo gukundana”.

Wanditse

Mediatrice Uwingabire

Umunyamakuru
