ART-MU8U5WKP-QEMA.title: World Population Day: Hasabwe inkunga ikomeye ku bucuruzi n’akazi by’urubyiruko
ART-MU8U5WKP-QEMA.subtitle: Mu birori byabereye Nyagatare, abayobozi bavuze ko ubushomeri, inda ziterwa abangavu n’ibiyobyabwenge bigomba gukemurwa hamwe n’amahirwe y’ubukungu.
ART-MU8U5WKP-QEMA.summary: Ku wa 17 Nzeri, mu kwizihiza World Population Day i Nyagatare, abayobozi bavuze ko urubyiruko rwinshi rw’u Rwanda rukeneye guhuza n’amahirwe y’akazi n’ubucuruzi. Ubushomeri, inda ziterwa abangavu n’ibiyobyabwenge byagaragajwe nk’imbogamizi ku iterambere ry’urubyiruko. Hashimangiwe finance, skills training n’isoko ku mishinga y’urubyiruko.

ART-MU8U5X6A-P6UX.title: Abahinzi basaba itegeko rishya rikemura ikibazo cy’ubuziranenge bw’imbuto

Itegeko rishya rishobora gukomeza certification, gukurikirana aho imbuto zaturutse no kwakira ibirego by’abahinzi.

ART-MU8U5ZJG-SYIM.title: Amafoto: Uko Equity ifasha capital guhinduka akazi n’iterambere ry’ibigo mu Rwanda

ART-MU8U5ZJG-SYIM.summary: Inkuru yerekana ibigo byo mu Rwanda byahawe finance cyangwa investment na Equity Group. ART-MU8U655G-WQZL.title: Impanuka yo muri Karongi yahitanye abantu batandatu, abandi batandatu barakomereka
ART-MU8U655G-WQZL.subtitle: Ikamyo yagonganye na coaster muri Bwishyura, abagenzi batandatu bapfira aho abandi batandatu bajyanwa kwa muganga.
ART-MU8U655G-WQZL.summary: Ku wa 11 Nzeri, ikamyo na coaster zagonganye muri Bwishyura Sector, Karongi District, abantu batandatu barapfa abandi batandatu barakomereka. Polisi y’umuhanda yavuze ko ikamyo yageragezaga guca ku kindi kinyabiziga mu ikoni igahura na coaster yavaga Karongi, zombi zigwa hanze y’umuhanda. Abapfuye bose bari abagenzi ba coaster naho abakomeretse bajyanwa mu bitaro bya Kibuye.

ART-MU8U65R1-WCQO.title: IFAD: ejo hazaza h’ibiribwa muri Afurika hashingiye ku gutera inkunga abahinzi bato, urubyiruko n’abagore
ART-MU8U65R1-WCQO.subtitle: Kugira ngo Afurika yihaze mu biribwa, smallholders, ba rwiyemezamirimo bakiri bato n’ibigo biyobowe n’abagore bakeneye kubona imari yo gukura no guhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ikirere.
ART-MU8U65R1-WCQO.summary: Geraldine Mukeshimana, Vice President wa IFAD, yavuze ko Afurika ifite ubutaka, amazi n’abantu bashobora gutuma iba producer ukomeye w’ibiribwa, ariko icyuho cy’imari kigikoma mu nkokora abo ku ntangiriro y’urunigi rw’ibiribwa. Yabivugiye muri Africa Food Systems Forum yabereye i Kigali, asaba finance nyinshi ku bahinzi bato, urubyiruko n’abagore. IFAD yanashyize umukono ku masezerano agamije kugabanya risk y’ishoramari no gukurura private capital mu buhinzi.

ART-MU8U66BC-NM9Y.title: TENGAMARA na TVA: uko receipts za buri munsi zihinduka ibihembo
ART-MU8U66BC-NM9Y.subtitle: RRA ishishikariza abakiliya gusaba facture za EBM kugira ngo compliance ya TVA n’ubucuruzi buboneke neza, kandi abaturage babone inyungu.
ART-MU8U66BC-NM9Y.summary: Mu myaka yashize abakiliya benshi barangizaga kugura bakagenda badasabye facture ya EBM, ariko iyo myitwarire irimo guhinduka. Gahunda TENGAMARA na TVA ya Rwanda Revenue Authority igamije gutuma umuguzi asaba facture yemewe, akagira uruhare muri VAT compliance kandi akabona ibihembo. RRA ivuga ko ibi bituma businesses zikorera mu mucyo, Leta ikabona revenue kandi abaturage bakagira inyungu.

ART-MU8U66WJ-0HW9.title: U Rwanda na Oman bizafungura ambasade zihoraho i Kigali no i Muscat
ART-MU8U66WJ-0HW9.subtitle: Mu ruzinduko rwa Perezida Kagame muri Oman, ibihugu byombi byemeranyije kongera diplomatic presence no kwagura ubufatanye bw’ubukungu.
ART-MU8U66WJ-0HW9.summary: U Rwanda na Oman byemeranyije gufungura resident embassies i Kigali no i Muscat. Amasezerano yafashwe ubwo Perezida Paul Kagame yasuraga Oman ku wa 7 na 8 Nzeri akaganira na Sultan Haitham bin Tarik. Ibihugu byombi bizashyiraho joint committee na business council no kwagura ubufatanye mu ishoramari, transport, energy, mining, tourism na logistics.

ART-MU8U67HW-ITAW.title: Umusaruro w’inganda wazamutse 6.6% muri Nyakanga
ART-MU8U67HW-ITAW.subtitle: Mining, manufacturing, amashanyarazi n’amazi n’imicungire y’imyanda byafashije formal industrial output kuzamuka ugereranyije n’umwaka ushize.
ART-MU8U67HW-ITAW.summary: NISR yatangaje ko industrial output mu rwego rwemewe yazamutse 6.6% muri Nyakanga 2026 ugereranyije n’ukwezi kumwe kwa 2025. ART-MU8U682I-7K6T.title: Igipimo cy’abafite imirire idahagije cyagabanutse kigera kuri 29.9%
ART-MU8U682I-7K6T.subtitle: Imibare ya NISR igaragaza ko prevalence of undernourishment yavuye kuri 31.3% mu 2024 ikagera kuri 29.9% mu 2025.
ART-MU8U682I-7K6T.summary: Food Balance Sheet ya NISR igaragaza ko abantu bafite undernourishment bagabanutse kuva kuri 31.3% mu 2024 bajya kuri 29.9% mu 2025. ART-MU8U68NQ-6MF4.title: Kagame yihanganishije Perezida Suluhu nyuma y’urupfu rw’umugabo we

ART-MU8U6AYM-TSIF.subtitle: Impuguke ya RBC isaba gushora cyane mu gukumira no gusuzuma kare indwara nka cardiovascular diseases na cancer.
ART-MU8U6AYM-TSIF.summary: Dr. Theoneste Maniragaba wo muri RBC yavuze ko non-communicable diseases ubu ziri mu mpamvu zikomeye z’impfu kandi zikenera ubuvuzi buramba kandi buhenze. ART-MU8U6C4D-5NYW.title: Kuki Afurika ikeneye early warning systems n’amafaranga yo guhangana n’ibiza
ART-MU8U6C4D-5NYW.subtitle: ARC ivuga ko climate data yizewe n’amafaranga ateguwe mbere ari ingenzi mu kurinda smallholder farmers n’abandi bafite intege nke.
ART-MU8U6C4D-5NYW.summary: Jean-Chrysostome Ngabitsinze uyobora Africa Risk Capacity yavuze ko ibihugu bya Afurika bikwiye gushora cyane muri early warning systems na climate data. Yasabye kandi dedicated funds zikoreshwa mbere cyangwa vuba iyo drought, floods n’izindi shocks zibaye. Abahinzi bato n’abandi vulnerable groups ni bo bagira ingaruka nyinshi iyo preparation idahagije.

ART-MU8U6CPP-LZT2.title: U Rwanda rwongeye Japanese yen mu myenda yarwo ku nshuro ya mbere
ART-MU8U6CPP-LZT2.subtitle: Inguzanyo ya ¥15 billion ifite maturity y’imyaka 15 na grace period y’imyaka itandatu yaguwe mu rwego rwo gutandukanya currencies z’imyenda.
ART-MU8U6CPP-LZT2.summary: U Rwanda rwashyize Japanese yen muri external debt portfolio ku nshuro ya mbere, rubona ¥15 billion ku wa 25 Kanama. Transaction yanarimo €82 million kandi inguzanyo ifite imyaka 15 yo kwishyura n’imyaka itandatu ya grace period. World Bank Group irayishyigikira binyuze muri policy-based guarantee, bigafasha gutandukanya sources na currencies z’imyenda.

ART-MU8U6DAS-DZ8D.title: Ku bahanzi b’Abanyasudani baba mu Rwanda, “iwacu” ntihakiri ahantu hamwe gusa
ART-MU8U6DAS-DZ8D.subtitle: Abahanzi bahunze intambara barimo kubaka community nshya i Kigali kandi bakongera gusobanura icyo home ibasobanurira.
ART-MU8U6DAS-DZ8D.summary: Elbashir Abdalla, filmmaker wo muri Sudan uba mu Rwanda kuva 2024, avuga ko amaze kuva Khartoum ari bwo yarushijeho kumva agaciro k’abaturanyi n’imibanire ya buri munsi. I Kigali yagombaga kumenyera ahantu hashya no kubaka relationships nshya. Inkuru yerekana uko creatives b’Abanyasudani bahunze intambara babona umutekano n’umwanya wo gukora, ariko home ikaba igenda iba ahantu henshi.

ART-MU8U6F1I-R8GS.subtitle: Judiciary y’u Rwanda izongera alternative dispute resolution, services za digital justice no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abakoze ibyaha, naho RBA igafasha lawyers cyane cyane abagore.
ART-MU8U6F1I-R8GS.summary: Mu mwaka w’ubutabera wa 2026/27, Judiciary izakomeza gushishikariza abantu gukoresha restorative na alternative dispute resolution mbere yo kujya mu rukiko. Digital justice services, emerging crimes na rehabilitation y’abahamwe n’ibyaha nabyo biri mu by’ingenzi. Rwanda Bar Association irategura gahunda zo gufasha wellbeing ya lawyers no kugumana abagore mu mwuga, harimo support mu gihe cya maternity.

ART-MU8U6FLL-T80P.title: U Rwanda rwatoye umwanzuro wa Loni usaba maps zerekana ingano nyakuri ya Afurika
ART-MU8U6FLL-T80P.subtitle: UN General Assembly yemeje “Correct the Map” n’amajwi 164 kugira ngo cartographic representation ibe iringaniza kandi itagabanya Afurika.
ART-MU8U6FLL-T80P.summary: Ku wa 4 Nzeri, UN General Assembly yemeje resolution isaba world maps zigaragaza neza ingano y’imigabane, cyane cyane Afurika. U Rwanda ruri mu bihugu 164 byayishyigikiye, Amerika irayanga naho bimwe birifata. Initiative inenga Mercator projection kuko ikoreshwa mu navigation ariko ikagoreka relative size y’imigabane, Afurika ikagaragara nto kurusha uko iri.

ART-MU8U6G5U-VXI0.subtitle: Muri Kwita Izina ya 21, Justin Nsengiyumva yavuze ko abaturage batuye hafi y’aharinzwe bagomba kungukira ku musaruro wa conservation.
ART-MU8U6G5U-VXI0.summary: Minisitiri w’Intebe Justin Nsengiyumva yavuze ku wa 4 Nzeri muri Kwita Izina i Kinigi ko kurinda ingagi bigomba kujyana no guteza imbere communities zituriye pariki. Yibukije ko mu ntangiriro za 1980 hari mountain gorillas hafi 250 gusa muri Virunga, ariko ubu ku isi hari izirenga 1,000. Yavuze ko recovery yabaye kubera ibikorwa bihoraho bya conservation kandi abaturage bagomba kubona inyungu zabyo.

ART-MU8U6GQR-ZPX7.title: IFAD na Equity Group batangije fund ya $200m izafasha abahinzi 260,000 guhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ikirere
ART-MU8U6GQR-ZPX7.subtitle: ARCAFIM izatanga finance ku bahinzi bato n’ibigo byo mu cyaro muri East Africa kugira ngo bashore muri climate-resilient agriculture.
ART-MU8U6GQR-ZPX7.summary: IFAD na Equity Group batangije Africa Rural Climate Adaptation Finance Mechanism ya $200 million i Kigali ku ruhande rwa Africa Food Systems Forum. Mu myaka 12, iteganya kugera ku bahinzi bato hafi 260,000 n’ibigo byo mu cyaro 500 mu Rwanda, Kenya, Uganda na Tanzania. Green Climate Fund n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa bazafasha kongera access ku mafaranga ahendutse yo kwihanganira climate shocks.

ART-MU8U6UWX-7R2W.title: U Rwanda na DR Congo byemeranyije uburyo bushya bwo kugenzura ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya Washington Accords
ART-MU8U6UWX-7R2W.subtitle: Mu nama ya gatandatu ya JSCM i Geneva, impande zombi zemeje initiatives ebyiri zo gukomeza verification ku butaka.
ART-MU8U6UWX-7R2W.summary: U Rwanda na DR Congo byemeranyije mu nama ya Joint Security Coordination Mechanism yabaye ku wa 12-13 Kanama kuri US Mission i Geneva gukomeza monitoring ya Washington Accords. Ibihugu byombi bizateza imbere initiatives ebyiri zigamije kugenzura uko commitments zishyirwa mu bikorwa ku butaka. JSCM ni imwe mu mechanisms zashyizweho gufasha peace process hagati y’ibihugu byombi.

ART-MU8U6VGE-CNTR.title: Nduhungirehe avuga ko “Genocost” ari narrative igamije kugabanya uburemere bwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi
ART-MU8U6VGE-CNTR.subtitle: Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga yavuze ko concept ikoreshwa muri DRC idafite international-law basis, atanga uko u Rwanda ruyibona.
ART-MU8U6VGE-CNTR.summary: Olivier Nduhungirehe yavuze kuri The Context podcast ko narrative ya “Genocost” ya DRC ari political construct. Ibi ni position ya Minisitiri w’u Rwanda kandi itandukanye n’uko uruhande rwa DRC rusobanura iyo concept.

ART-MU8U6W16-3ZGE.title: AFC/M23 ivuga ko abantu batandatu barekuwe na Kinshasa atari abanyamuryango bayo

ART-MU8U6W16-3ZGE.summary: AFC/M23 yavuze ko abantu batandatu mu 15 barekuwe na Leta ya Congo kandi bayishyikirizwa batari ku rutonde rw’abarenga 760 yari yatanze mu biganiro bya Doha. ART-MU8U6WMA-CQZE.subtitle: Minisitiri yavuze ko DRC ikwiye gushyira mu bikorwa commitments zo muri Washington aho gutangaza protocol nshya idafite action ifatika.

Ibi ni position ya Leta y’u Rwanda kandi impande zombi zifite interpretations zitandukanye ku mikorere ya FDLR n’amasezerano.

ART-MU8U6X7Q-WC3U.title: Makolo: DR Congo igomba gusenya FDLR no gusubiza members bayo mu Rwanda
ART-MU8U6X7Q-WC3U.subtitle: Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma yavuze ko Washington Accords isaba gutandukanya FDLR na FARDC, kuyambura intwaro no repatriate abayigize.
ART-MU8U6X7Q-WC3U.summary: Yolande Makolo yavuze ko DR Congo igomba dismantle FDLR, kuyitandukanya n’ingabo zayo no gusubiza members bayo mu Rwanda nk’uko Washington Accords ibiteganya. Yongeye kuvuga position y’u Rwanda ko FDLR ibangamiye umutekano w’u Rwanda, abasivili ba Congo n’akarere k’Ibiyaga Bigari. Ni demand y’uruhande rw’u Rwanda ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano.

ART-MU8U7JCR-K4BU.title: Kuva kuri 2G kugera kuri 5G: uko buri generation ya mobile network ikora
ART-MU8U7JCR-K4BU.subtitle: Mu gihe u Rwanda ruteza imbere 4G na 5G kandi 3G ikazimwa muri Kamena 2027, inkuru isobanura differences z’ikoranabuhanga.
ART-MU8U7JCR-K4BU.summary: Leta y’u Rwanda irateganya phase-out ya 2G na 3G kugira ngo spectrum n’investment byimukire kuri 4G na 5G. 2G yibanda ku calls na SMS, 3G yazanye mobile internet, 4G ikazana high-speed data, naho 5G ikazana speed nyinshi, latency nto n’ibikoresho byinshi. 3G izahagarikwa nationwide ku wa 30 Kamena 2027, 2G ikazakurikiraho nyuma.

Kurinda suffrage ni ihame rikomeye mu mpaka z’ivugurura.

ART-MU8UD5NX-0DU7.title: Uko immunity nshya ishobora kurinda abakozi ba Komisiyo y’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu
ART-MU8UD5NX-0DU7.subtitle: Protection yaguwe ikagera ku bakozi kugira ngo badaterwa ubwoba cyangwa ngo bakurikiranwe ku bitekerezo n’ibikorwa bakoze mu nshingano zemewe.
ART-MU8UD5NX-0DU7.summary: Itegeko rishya ryaguye immunity yari isanzwe ku ba Commissioners ikagera no ku bakozi ba NCHR. Immunity igarukira ku bikorwa biri mu nshingano z’ikigo.

EVT-MUOKNXXI-6D0Z.description: A1 Iron & Steel Rwanda has been officially inaugurated in the Musanze industrial zone.

EVT-MUOKNXXK-NPT8.canonical_name: U Rwanda rurashaka uko rwagabanya gushingira ku mashanyarazi akomoka ku mazi
EVT-MUOKNXXK-NPT8.subtitle: U Rwanda rurimo gushaka uko rwagabanya gushingira ku mashanyarazi akomoka ku mazi, rugashyira imbaraga mu ngufu zituruka ku zuba, gaz methane n’izindi ngufu, mu rwego rwo gukemura ikibazo cy’ibura ry’umuriro rikunze kugaragara mu gihe cy’impeshyi.
EVT-MUOKNXXK-NPT8.description: Rwanda is looking to reduce its dependence on hydropower and increase the contribution of solar power, Lake Kivu methane gas and other energy sources to address electricity shortages that become more visible during the dry season.

EVT-MUOKNXXM-HI31.canonical_name: Abahinzi ba kawa batangiye kurandura ibiti byatewe ku bw'Abakoloni
EVT-MUOKNXXM-HI31.subtitle: Ibiti bya kawa Miliyoni 26 bimaze imyaka 30 harimo n’ibimaze imyaka isaga ijana byo hirya no hino mu Gihugu byatangiye kurimburwa no gusimbuzwa ingemwe nshya mu rwego rwo kongera umusaruro w’ikawa mu bwinshi no mu bwiza.
EVT-MUOKNXXM-HI31.description: Rwanda has begun replacing an estimated 26 million ageing coffee trees in an effort to increase both the quantity and quality of production.

EVT-MUOKNXXP-P623.canonical_name: Uruzinduko rwa Perezida Kagame muri Oman rushobora gufungurira Abanyarwanda amasoko mashya
EVT-MUOKNXXP-P623.subtitle: Perezida Kagame yagiriye uru ruzinduko muri Oman guhera ku wa 7 kugera ku wa 8 Nzeri 2026, ku butumire bwa Sultan Haitham bin Tarik wa Oman.
EVT-MUOKNXXP-P623.description: President Paul Kagame made an official visit to Oman on September 7–8, 2026 at the invitation of Sultan Haitham bin Tarik.

EVT-MUOKNXXS-2SM9.canonical_name: Kwagura umuhanda Prince House – Masaka bizatwara arenga Miliyari ijana Frws
EVT-MUOKNXXS-2SM9.subtitle: Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yatangiye ku mugaragaro imirimo yo kuvugurura no kwagura umuhanda Prince House–Giporoso–Masaka, umushinga wa kilometero 10.3 uzatwara miliyari zirenga 130 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda.
EVT-MUOKNXXS-2SM9.description: The Rwandan government has officially launched the rehabilitation and widening of the 10.3-kilometre Prince House–Giporoso–Masaka road in Kigali.

EVT-MUOKNXXU-X8A1.canonical_name: Perezida Kagame yatangiye uruzinduko rw'iminsi ibiri muri Oman
EVT-MUOKNXXU-X8A1.subtitle: Yakiriwe mu Mujyi wa Salalah n’Umuyobozi w’Ikirenga wa Oman, Sultan Haitham bin Tariq Al Said, bagirana ibiganiro byihariye ku kwagura umubano hagati y’u Rwanda na Oman.
EVT-MUOKNXXU-X8A1.description: President Paul Kagame began a two-day visit to Oman, where he was received in Salalah by Sultan Haitham bin Tariq Al Said.

EVT-MUOKNXXX-BXYC.canonical_name: BK Group yungutse Miliyari 56.4Frw mu gice cya mbere cya 2026
EVT-MUOKNXXX-BXYC.subtitle: Iyi nyungu ibonetse mu gihe ubukungu bw’u Rwanda bukomeje kwiyongera ku muvuduko wo hejuru, ariko nanone hakigaragara izamuka rikomeye ry’ibiciro.
EVT-MUOKNXXX-BXYC.description: BK Group reported a profit of Rwf56.4 billion for the first half of 2026, as Rwanda’s economy continued to grow rapidly while inflation accelerated.

EVT-MUOKNXY0-HPS5.canonical_name: Prof Muganga Raymond yagizwe umuyobozi wa Rwanda FDA asimbuye ukurikiranyweho ibibazo by'inzoga z'inkorano
EVT-MUOKNXY0-HPS5.subtitle: Muganga yazamuwe mu ntera kuko yari asanzwe ari umukozi wa Rwanda FDA ari Head of Laboratory services.
EVT-MUOKNXY0-HPS5.description: Professor Raymond Muganga has been appointed to lead the Rwanda Food and Drugs Authority (Rwanda FDA).

EVT-MUOKNXY4-G242.canonical_name: Njye si ndi mu ntambara y’indimi, Kuvuga Igifaransa ntibivuze kwanga Icyongereza - Louise Mushikiwabo
EVT-MUOKNXY4-G242.subtitle: Umunyamabanga Mukuru w'Umuryango w'Ibihugu bikoresha Igifaransa (OIF), Louise Mushikiwabo, yavuze ko Abanyafurika bavuga Igifaransa badakwiye gufata Icyongereza nk’umwanzi w’Igifaransa, ahubwo ko kumenya indimi nyinshi bikwiye gufatwa nk’amahirwe yo kurushaho kwagura ubumenyi n’ubushobozi.
EVT-MUOKNXY4-G242.description: Louise Mushikiwabo, Secretary-General of the International Organisation of La Francophonie (OIF), says French-speaking Africans should not treat English as an enemy of French and that multilingualism should instead be seen as an opportunity to expand knowledge and capability.

EVT-MUOKNYIW-XP8D.canonical_name: Charles Munyaneza yagizwe Umuyobozi w'Ikigo Gishinzwe Igororamuco
EVT-MUOKNYIW-XP8D.subtitle: Ni ibyatangajwe mu Byemezo by'Inama y'Abaminisitiri yateranye kuri uyu 18 Nzeri muri Village Urugwiro.
EVT-MUOKNYIW-XP8D.description: Rwanda’s Cabinet appointed Charles Munyaneza to lead the Rwanda Correctional Service at a meeting held at Village Urugwiro on September 18.

EVT-MUOKNYJ0-XK3X.canonical_name: Banki ya Kigali na IFAD basinyanye amasezerano y'inkunga izafasha iterambere ry'abahinzi bato
EVT-MUOKNYJ0-XK3X.subtitle: Aya masezerano agamije korohereza imiryango y’abahinzi kubona serivisi z’imari, bityo bikazamura umusaruro, ubushobozi bwo guhangana n’ingaruka zitandukanye ndetse n’iterambere rirambye kandi ridaheza mu rwego rw’ubuhinzi.
EVT-MUOKNYJ0-XK3X.description: Bank of Kigali (BK) and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) have signed an agreement intended to improve access to finance for Rwanda’s smallholder farmers and farmer organizations.

EVT-MUOKNYJ3-5DQM.canonical_name: Afurika itakaza hafi miliyari 90 z’amadolari buri mwaka kubera amafaranga atemewe
EVT-MUOKNYJ3-5DQM.subtitle: Perezida wa Sena y’u Rwanda, Dr.

EVT-MUOKNYJ7-S4Y2.canonical_name: Hakenewe miliyari 100 z’amadolari yafasha ishoramari mu buhinzi kugera ku bahinzi bato
EVT-MUOKNYJ7-S4Y2.subtitle: Ibi byagarutsweho kuri uyu wa Kabiri, ku munsi wa mbere w’Inama Nyafurika yiga ku kwihaza mu biribwa, AFS Forum 2026, mu biganiro byahuje abahanga, abafite aho bahuriye na serivisi z'imari n'iterambere, abashoramari, ibigo by’imari n’abakora muri gahunda z’ubuhinzi, bagaragaje ko kubona imari ari imwe mu mbogamizi zikomeye zikomeje kubangamira ubuhinzi muri Afurika.
EVT-MUOKNYJ7-S4Y2.description: Participants at the opening day of the 2026 Africa Food Systems Forum identified access to finance as one of the largest constraints on agricultural development.

EVT-MUOKNYJB-BHY1.canonical_name: Ubushinwa bwahaye u Rwanda ishusho y’uko rwakwiyubakira AI Nyarwanda
EVT-MUOKNYJB-BHY1.subtitle: Ubushinwa bwagaragaje uburyo u Rwanda rushobora kuva ku gukoresha gusa ubwenge buhangano (AI) bwakozwe n’abandi, rukagera ku kubaka ikoranabuhanga ryarwo rushingiye ku makuru y’u Rwanda, abahanga barwo n’ibikorwaremezo byarwo.
EVT-MUOKNYJB-BHY1.description: Chinese technology representatives have outlined how Rwanda could move beyond using AI systems developed elsewhere and build capabilities based on its own data, experts and infrastructure.

EVT-MUOKNYJF-0RWA.canonical_name: Dore ifunguro ryafasha ugeze mu zabukuru gusazana imbaduko
EVT-MUOKNYJF-0RWA.subtitle: Umuntu ugeze mu zabukuru, cyane cyane uri hagati y’imyaka 60 na 90 kandi udafite ubundi burwayi bumusaba imirire yihariye, asabwa kugira indyo itandukanye kandi yuzuye, irimo imboga, imbuto, ibinyampeke, ibinyamisogwe, ibikomoka ku matungo ndetse n’amavuta meza, mu rugero rukwiye.
EVT-MUOKNYJF-0RWA.description: Older adults, particularly people between about 60 and 90 who do not have medical conditions requiring a special diet, should eat a varied and balanced combination of vegetables, fruit, grains, legumes, animal-source foods and healthy fats, according to nutrition specialist Innocent Ndikubwayo of Burehe Health Centre in Rulindo District.

EVT-MUOKNYJJ-UKJ1.subtitle: Nitabiriye inama ya ‘Africa Mindset Reset Forum’, ndetse n'inama ya ‘Nuclear Energy Innovation Summit for Africa’, ndetse vuba aha muri ‘Africa Food Systems Forum 2026.’ Ikibazo kimwe cyakomeje kugaruka mu bitekerezo byanjye, "Kuki Kigali?” Igisubizo kiri mu ruhurirane rw’ibintu bitandukanye birimo ibikorwa remezo byo ku rwego mpuzamahanga, umutekano, koroherezwa kugera kuri serivisi nziza kandi zitangwa kinyamwuga, ndetse n’ubushobozi bumaze kwigaragaza bwo kwakira no gutunganya inama n’ibikorwa mpuzamahanga bikomeye bibera mu Rwanda.
EVT-MUOKNYJJ-UKJ1.description: Kigali’s growing appeal as a major African conference destination reflects a combination of international-standard infrastructure, security, professional services, accessibility and a proven record of hosting large events, the article argues.

EVT-MUOKNYJM-T94G.canonical_name: Mu Bugesera bahawe ikigo, bagira ngo ni icy'urubyiruko gusa...inkuru ya Imbuto Hub
EVT-MUOKNYJM-T94G.subtitle: Mu kigo cya Imbuto Hub Bugesera, gikorerwamo ibikorwa bitandukanye harimo isomero rusange, kwiga imyuga, na siporo zinyuranye ku bana batoya n’urubyiruko, harimo imikino njyarugamba nka karate, umupira w’amaguru, kubyina imbyino gakondo, umukino w’amaboko (Volley Ball), n’ibindi.
EVT-MUOKNYJM-T94G.description: Imbuto Hub in Bugesera hosts a public library, vocational training and sports for children and young people, including football, volleyball, karate and traditional dance.

EVT-MUOKNYJQ-NQ8X.canonical_name: BK Pro League: Rayon Sports yatangiye shampiyona inganya, Mukura itsindwa na Police FC (Amafoto)
EVT-MUOKNYJQ-NQ8X.subtitle: Kuri uyu wa Kane hakinwe imikino ibiriya BK Pro League hakinwa umunsi wa gatatu, Rayon Sports inganyiriza na Sunrise FC I Kigali, Police FC itsindira Mukura VS i Huye.
EVT-MUOKNYJQ-NQ8X.description: Two BK Pro League fixtures were played on the third matchday, with Rayon Sports drawing against Sunrise FC in Kigali while Police FC defeated Mukura VS in Huye.

EVT-MUOKNYJU-P5I7.canonical_name: Ingufu zisubira zagaragajwe nk’inkingi y’ubuhinzi buhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe
EVT-MUOKNYJU-P5I7.subtitle: Impuguke n’Abayobozi mu by’Ubuhinzi barutse mu bihugu bya Afurika no hirya no hino ku isi, babigarutseho mu Ihuroro ryabo rirmo kwiga kwita no kongera ibiribwa muri Afurika mu kiswe “Africa Food Systems Forum, 2026” ririmo kubera i Kigali kuva ku wa 31Kanama-4 Nzeri, 2026.
EVT-MUOKNYJU-P5I7.description: Agricultural experts and officials at the 2026 Africa Food Systems Forum in Kigali highlighted renewable energy as an important foundation for agriculture that can withstand climate change.

EVT-MUOKNYJY-R26V.canonical_name: Mucike kuri Kanyanga n’izindi nzoga zitujuje ubuziranenge – Minisitiri Habimana Dominique
EVT-MUOKNYJY-R26V.subtitle: Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu, Habimana Dominique, yasabye abaturage bo mu Murenge wa Rwimiyaga mu Karere ka Nyagatare, gucika burundu ku nzoga ya Kanyanga n’izindi nzoga zitujuje ubuziranenge, kuko zangiza ubuzima bw’abazinywa kandi zikagira uruhare mu guhungabanya umutekano.
EVT-MUOKNYJY-R26V.description: Local Government Minister Dominique Habimana has urged residents of Rwimiyaga Sector in Nyagatare District to stop consuming or bringing in Kanyanga and other alcoholic drinks that do not meet safety standards.

EVT-MUOKNYK3-018B.canonical_name: Uko ikoranabuhanga rishobora gufungurira urubyiruko rutari mu mashuri amahirwe yo kwiga
EVT-MUOKNYK3-018B.subtitle: Ikiganiro EdTechMondays gitambuka kuri KT Radio kuri uyu wa mbere Tariki 31 Kanama 2026 kiragaruka ku buryo ikoranabuhanga rishobora gufasha abacikirije amashuri gukomeza kwiyungura ubumenyi.
EVT-MUOKNYK3-018B.description: The August 31, 2026 edition of EdTech Mondays Rwanda on KT Radio focuses on how technology can create new learning pathways for young people who have left school or are outside formal education.

EVT-MUOKNYK7-PG7O.canonical_name: U Rwanda rwakiriye imfunguzo z'ibitaro bya Masaka
EVT-MUOKNYK7-PG7O.subtitle: Ni ibitaro byakiriwe n’ubuyobozi bukuru bwa Ministeri y’Ubuzima kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 28 Kanama 2026, ku bufatanya na Ambasade y’u Bushinwa mu Rwanda.
EVT-MUOKNYK7-PG7O.description: Rwanda’s Ministry of Health formally received the expanded Masaka Hospital from the Chinese project partners on August 28, 2026.

EVT-MUOKNYKB-Z6ZL.canonical_name: Urwego rw’imari rw’u Rwanda ruracyafite ubushobozi bwo guhangana n’ibihungabanya ubukungu — BNR
EVT-MUOKNYKB-Z6ZL.subtitle: Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda (BNR) yatangaje ko urwego rw’imari rw’u Rwanda rukomeje kugira umutekano n’ubudahangarwa, nubwo ruhura n’ibibazo bishobora kugira ingaruka ku bukungu, birimo izamuka ry’ibiciro ku isoko mpuzamahanga, umutekano muke ukomeje mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati n’izamuka ry’ifaranga.
EVT-MUOKNYKB-Z6ZL.description: The National Bank of Rwanda (BNR) says the country’s financial system remained stable and resilient at the end of June 2026 despite risks including higher global prices, instability in the Middle East and domestic inflation.

EVT-MUOKNYKF-K41V.canonical_name: Banki Nkuru y'u Rwanda yazamuye urwunguko fatizo rugera ku 8.75%
EVT-MUOKNYKF-K41V.subtitle: Banki Nkuru y'u Rwanda (BNR) yazamuye urwunguko rwayo ruva ku 8,25% rwari rwashyizweho mu mezi atatu ashize (Gicurasi uyu mwaka), irushyira ku 8,75% mu rwego rwo guhangana n’izamuka ry’ibiciro ku masoko rikomeje kwiyongera no kurinda agaciro k’ifaranga.
EVT-MUOKNYKF-K41V.description: The National Bank of Rwanda (BNR) has raised its policy rate from 8.25% to 8.75% in response to persistent inflation and pressure on the value of the currency.

EVT-MUOKNYKK-R7DH.canonical_name: Umunyamakuru Andrew Mwenda asanga Afurika itazatera imbere ishingiye ku bucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro gusa
EVT-MUOKNYKK-R7DH.subtitle: Umunyamakuru akaba n’umusesenguzi wo muri Uganda, Andrew Mwenda, yavuze ko Afurika ikwiye guhindura imyumvire yayo ku mutungo kamere wayo, kuko ikibazo cy’umugabane atari ukubura amabuye y’agaciro menshi ahubwo ari uko udafite ubushobozi buhagije bwo kuyabyazamo ibicuruzwa bifite agaciro kanini.
EVT-MUOKNYKK-R7DH.description: Ugandan journalist and analyst Andrew Mwenda told the Africa Mindset Reset Forum in Kigali on August 26, 2026 that Africa’s development challenge is not simply the amount of minerals beneath the ground but the human capital and technology needed to turn resources into high-value products.

EVT-MUOKNYKQ-4KUQ.canonical_name: Mu myaka 10 iri imbere Basketball izaba itanga imirimo ibihumbi 650 muri Afurika - Clare Akamanzi
EVT-MUOKNYKQ-4KUQ.subtitle: Akamanzi yabigarutseho mu kiganiro yatanze muri Africa Mindset Reset Forum irimo kubera i Kigali kuva tariki 25-26 Kanama, agaragaza ko siporo ishobora gutanga akazi, guteza imbere ubukerarugendo, ubwikorezi, itangazamakuru, kwakira abantu n’ibindi bikorwa by’ubucuruzi.
EVT-MUOKNYKQ-4KUQ.description: Clare Akamanzi told the Africa Mindset Reset Forum in Kigali that sport should be treated as an economic asset connecting employment, tourism, transport, media, hospitality, marketing and other commercial activity.

EVT-MUOKNYKU-BOPQ.canonical_name: U Rwanda rwakiriye Abanyarwanda barenga 400 batahutse bava muri RDC
EVT-MUOKNYKU-BOPQ.subtitle: Leta y’u Rwanda yakiriye Abanyarwanda barenga 400 baturutse mu Burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC), biganjemo abagore n’abana, n’abandi bakuze bamazeyo imyaka irenga 30.
EVT-MUOKNYKU-BOPQ.description: Rwanda received 406 nationals from 125 families returning from eastern DR Congo through the La Corniche border in Rubavu on August 26, 2026.

EVT-MUOKNYL1-5O0A.canonical_name: Meta yemeye kwishyura miliyari 18 z’amadolari kubera ibirego by’uko imbuga zayo zibata abana
EVT-MUOKNYL1-5O0A.subtitle: Mu masezerano y’urubanza, Meta yemeye kwishyura kugeza kuri miliyari 16.7 z’amadolari.
EVT-MUOKNYL1-5O0A.description: According to the article, Meta has agreed to pay up to $16.7 billion to settle litigation alleging that its platforms were designed in ways that could encourage excessive use by children and teenagers.

EVT-MUOKNYL6-0Z4J.canonical_name: Aliko Dangote yashimiwe uruhare rwe mu guteza imbere Afurika
EVT-MUOKNYL6-0Z4J.subtitle: Gatare yabigarutseho mu Ihuriro ry’Iminsi 2 ryiga ku mpinduka Afurika ikwiye gukora kugira ngo ishobore gutera imbere (Africa Mindset Reset Forum) ririmo kubera i Kigali kuva ejo tariki 25-26 Kanama, aho yavuze ko Dangote n’Umuryango we bagira uruhare mu gukusanya abayobozi n’abanyabwenge bakomeye bo muri Afurika kugira ngo baganire ku bibazo byugarije uyu mugabane n’ibisubizo byabyo.
EVT-MUOKNYL6-0Z4J.description: At the Africa Mindset Reset Forum in Kigali, a representative of the African School of Governance (ASG) praised Nigerian businessman Aliko Dangote for helping bring together African leaders and thinkers to discuss the continent’s development challenges and possible solutions.

EVT-MUOKNYLD-QD4O.canonical_name: Iterambere ry'u Rwanda rigomba kujyana n'iry'Akarere kose - Perezida Kagame
EVT-MUOKNYLD-QD4O.subtitle: Perezida Paul Kagame yavuze ko iterambere ry’u Rwanda ritagira igisobanuro gihagije mu gihe ibindi bihugu byo mu karere no ku mugabane wa Afurika bitarimo gutera imbere, ashimangira ko u Rwanda rutagomba kwibona nk’Igihugu cyigenga ku zindi mpinduka za Afurika.
EVT-MUOKNYLD-QD4O.description: President Paul Kagame said on August 24 that Rwanda’s development would have limited meaning if neighbouring countries and the wider African continent were not progressing as well.

EVT-MUOKNYLI-0728.canonical_name: U Rwanda rwabonye itike ya 1/4 mu gikombe cy’Afurika
EVT-MUOKNYLI-0728.subtitle: Ni umukino wabaye kuri uyu wa gatandatu taliki ya 19 Nzeri mu gihugu cya Tunisia ahakomeje kubera imikino y’igikombe cy’Afurika cya volleyball aho ubu u Rwanda rwamaze kwerekeza mu cyiciro gikurikira.
EVT-MUOKNYLI-0728.description: Rwanda’s national volleyball team has qualified for the quarterfinals of the African championship being held in Tunisia.

EVT-MUOKNYLP-Z262.canonical_name: BK Pro League: Al Merrikh SC yatangiye shampiyona ihagamwa n'Amagaju FC
EVT-MUOKNYLP-Z262.subtitle: ‎Ikipe y'Amagaju FC yanganyije na Al Merrikh SC 0-0 mu mukino w’umunsi wa Gatatu wa BK Pro League 2026/27 wabereye kuri Stade ya Kamena kuri uyu wa Gatanu, tariki ya 18 Nzeri 2026. ‎ ‎Al Merrikh SC yatangiye umukino isatira cyane, ariko umunyezamu wa Amagaju FC, Nicholas Sebwato, akuramo imipira ibiri yari kuvamo ibitego mu minota 10 ya mbere mu gihe kandi m gice cya mbere yanakuyemo umupira ukomeye yatewe na Dauda Ba. ‎ ‎Amagaju FC yagerageje gusatira binyuze kuruhande rwa Iradukunda Daniel na Karihungu Nganizi, ariko kubona inzira mu bwugarizi bwa Al Merrikh SC biragorana, maze igice cya mbere kirangira amakipe yombi anganya 0-0. ‎ ‎Mu gice cya kabiri, Amagaju FC yashyizemo Solomon Gloire, umukino urushaho gufunguka.
EVT-MUOKNYLP-Z262.description: Amagaju FC and Al Merrikh SC drew 0–0 in a 2026/27 BK Pro League match at Kamena Stadium on September 18, 2026.

EVT-MUOKNYLU-QM7Y.canonical_name: U Rwanda ruzahura na Gambia muri 1/8 cy’igikombe cy’Afurika
EVT-MUOKNYLU-QM7Y.subtitle: Nyuma yo gutsindwa n’ikipe y’igihugu ya Cameroon mu mukino wa nyuma mu itsinda amaseti 3-1, ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda izahura na Gambia muri 1/8.
EVT-MUOKNYLU-QM7Y.description: Rwanda will face Gambia in the round of 16 at the African volleyball championship after losing its final group match to Cameroon by three sets to one.

EVT-MUOKNYLY-U6RH.canonical_name: BK Pro League: APR FC na Al Hilal SC zatangiranye intsinzi(Amafoto)
EVT-MUOKNYLY-U6RH.subtitle: ‎Ikipe ya APR FC yatangiye imikino ya BK Pro League 2026/27 neza, itsinda Marine FC ibitego 4-2 mu mukino w’Umunsi wa Gatatu wabereye kuri Kigali Pelé Stadium kuri uyu wa Gatatu, tariki ya 16 Nzeri 2026, maze Al Hilal SC yisasira Kigali FC. ‎ Wanditse Habiyaremye Japhet Umunyamakuru
EVT-MUOKNYLY-U6RH.description: APR FC opened its 2026/27 BK Pro League campaign with a 4–2 victory over Marine FC at Kigali Pelé Stadium on September 16, 2026.

EVT-MUOKNZ5M-84PF.subtitle: Kuri uyu wa Gatatu, amakipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda, Amavubi ndetse n'abatarengeje imyaka 23 yatangiye umwiherero kuri Hoteli ya FERWAFA, yitegura imkino yo gushaka itike y'lgikombe cya Afurika 2027 mu byiciro byombi.
EVT-MUOKNZ5M-84PF.description: Rwanda’s senior national football team, Amavubi, and the U-23 side have begun training camps at the FERWAFA Hotel as they prepare for 2027 African qualification matches.

EVT-MUOKNZ5S-M4LH.canonical_name: U Rwanda rwatsinze Congo mu gikombe cy’Afurika
EVT-MUOKNZ5S-M4LH.subtitle: Ni umukino wabaye kuri uyu wa gatatu taliki ya 16 Nzeri 2026 mu nzu y’imikino ya El Menzah Sports Palace iri mu mujyi wa Tunis ahakomeje kubera iri rushanwa.
EVT-MUOKNZ5S-M4LH.description: Rwanda’s national men’s volleyball team defeated DR Congo in its second group match at the African championship on September 16, 2026 at El Menzah Sports Palace in Tunis.

EVT-MUOKNZ5X-A45K.canonical_name: BK Pro League: Kiyovu Sports yabonye intsinzi ya mbere, Gicumbi FC ikomeza kuyobora urutonde(Amafoto)
EVT-MUOKNZ5X-A45K.subtitle: Kuri uyu wa Kabiri hatangiye gukinwa umunsi gatatu wa BK Pro League 2026-2027, hakinwa imikino itatu aho Kiyovu Sports yabonye itsinzi ya mbere itsinda Bugesera naho Gicumbi FC ikomeza kuyobora urutonde nyuma yo gutsindira Etoile de l'Est FC iwayo ibitego 2-1.
EVT-MUOKNZ5X-A45K.description: Kiyovu Sports recorded their first win of the 2026/27 BK Pro League season on matchday three, while Gicumbi FC stayed top after beating Etoile de l’Est 2–1 away.

EVT-MUOKNZ62-AC01.canonical_name: Kalimpinya Queen, Isheja Sandrine begukanye imyanya y'imbere mu isiganwa ry'imodoka
EVT-MUOKNZ62-AC01.subtitle: Iri rushanwa ryateguwe n’Ishyirahamwe ry’Imikino yo Gusiganwa mu Modoka (RAC), mu rwego rwo kongera uruhare rw’abagore muri uyu mukino.
EVT-MUOKNZ62-AC01.description: A motor rally organized by the Rwanda Automobile Club (RAC) to increase women’s participation in motorsport ended with Sandrine Isheja, co-driving for Giancarlo Davite, taking first place and Queen Kalimpinya, partnered with Olivier Ngabo, finishing second.

EVT-MUOKNZ67-A9U7.canonical_name: U Rwanda ruratangira rukina na Central African Republic mu gikombe cy’Afurika
EVT-MUOKNZ67-A9U7.subtitle: Ni nyuma yaho kuri uyu wa mbere habaye tombola maze u Rwanda rukisanga mu itsinda rya kane aho rurikumwena Cameroon, DR Congo ndetse na Central African Republic.
EVT-MUOKNZ67-A9U7.description: Rwanda’s men’s national volleyball team will open its African championship campaign against the Central African Republic after being drawn in Group D with Cameroon, DR Congo and the Central African Republic.

EVT-MUOKNZ6B-QKL9.canonical_name: Como-Jannali FC yo muri Australia igiye gusura u Rwanda
EVT-MUOKNZ6B-QKL9.subtitle: Ikipe ya Como-Jannali FC yo muri Australia itegerejwe mu Rwanda kuva tariki 25 Nzeri kugeza tariki 8 Ukwakira 2026, mu rugendo rugamije guteza imbere ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku mupira w’amaguru no kwimakaza umubano hagati y’ibihugu byombi.
EVT-MUOKNZ6B-QKL9.description: Como-Jannali FC from New South Wales, Australia, is expected to visit Rwanda from September 25 to October 8, 2026 for a programme combining women’s football, cultural exchange and sports tourism.

EVT-MUOKNZ6F-DWUJ.canonical_name: Ikipe y’igihugu ya volleyball yageze muri Tuniziya
EVT-MUOKNZ6F-DWUJ.subtitle: Nyuma y’urugendo rw’amasaha 11 uvuye I kigali, ikipe y’igihugu y’abagabo mu mukino wa volleyball, yageze muri Tuniziya (Tunisia) ari naho irushanw rizabera aho yakiriwe n’abahagarariye ishyirahamwe.
EVT-MUOKNZ6F-DWUJ.description: Rwanda’s men’s national volleyball team has arrived in Tunisia after an approximately 11-hour journey from Kigali for the African championship.

EVT-MUOKNZ6M-I6M7.canonical_name: Minisitiri wa Siporo yahaye ibendera ikipe y’igihugu ya volleyball igiye mugikombe cy’Afurika
EVT-MUOKNZ6M-I6M7.subtitle: Ni umuhango wabaye kuri uyu wa gatandatu taliki ya 12 Nzeri aho Minisitiri yongeye kwibutsa aba bakinnyi ko bagomba kwitwara neza ndetse nti bibagirwe ubunyarwanda.
EVT-MUOKNZ6M-I6M7.description: Rwanda’s Sports Minister presented the national flag to the men’s volleyball team on September 12 before its departure for the African championship in Tunisia.

EVT-MUOKNZ6T-CS2V.canonical_name: Rayon Sports ikomeje mu ijonjora rya kabiri rya CAF Confederation Cup 2026-2027 (Amafoto)
EVT-MUOKNZ6T-CS2V.subtitle: Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, ikipe ya Rayon Sports yageze yakomeje mu ijonjora rya kabiri rya CAF Confederation Cup 2026-2027 nyma yo kunganyiriza 0-0 na Panthère Sportive du Nde yo muri Cameroon kuri Stade Amahoro, bisanga 1-1 bari banganyirije iwayo.
EVT-MUOKNZ6T-CS2V.description: Rayon Sports advanced to the second qualifying round of the 2026/27 CAF Confederation Cup after drawing 0–0 with Cameroon’s Panthère Sportive du Nde at Amahoro Stadium.

EVT-MUOKNZ6Y-KUOT.canonical_name: APR FC isezereye Les Aigle Du Congo yo muri Congo
EVT-MUOKNZ6Y-KUOT.subtitle: Ikipe ya APR FC yinjiye mu mukino ibizi neza ko ikipe ya Les Aigle Du Congo ifite impamba y’igitego 1 yatsindiye APR FC iwabo i Lumbashi muri Congo.
EVT-MUOKNZ6Y-KUOT.description: APR FC overturned a first-leg deficit to beat Les Aigles du Congo 3–0 at home and advance 3–1 on aggregate in CAF Champions League qualifying.

EVT-MUOKNZ74-HKD3.canonical_name: FERWAFA yasobanuye iby'ivanwa mu Mavubi U-17 kw'abarimo Bakame
EVT-MUOKNZ74-HKD3.subtitle: ‎Ishyirahamwe ry’Umupira w’Amaguru mu Rwanda (FERWAFA) ryasobanuye impamvu abatoza barimo Ndayishimiye Eric Bakame na Ndayisenga Ramadhan “Boateng” bakuwe mu ikipe y'igihugu y'abatarengeje imyaka 17, rivuga ko bagiye mu mwiherero mu rwego rwo gutanga ubufasha. ‎ Ibi byasobanuwe n'‎Umuyobozi ushinzwe Tekiniki n’Iterambere ry’Abato muri FERWAFA, Kanamugire Fidele, wavuze ko mu mategeko Komite Nyobozi atari yo itoranya umutoza w’ikipe y’igihugu ko ahubwo bisabwa n'urwego rwa tekinike maze yo ikamwemeza, nyuma yo kuvugwa ko aba batoza birukanwe na Visi Perezida wa FERWAFA, Maitre Gasarabwe Claudine. ‎ ‎Ati “Urwego rushinzwe Tekiniki (Direction Technique) ni rwo rutanga urutonde rw’abatoza bifuza, hanyuma Ubunyamabanga Bukuru bwa FERWAFA bukarushyikiriza Komite Nyobozi kugira ngo ibemeze, kuko biri mu nshingano zayo.” ‎ ‎Kanamugire yavuze ko by'umwihariko Bakame, atari ari mu batoza bari bari ku rutonde rwemejwe na Komite Nyobozi bazatoza Amavubi U-17, ahubwo yagiye mu mwiherero agiye gutanga ubufasha kuko abakinnyi bari benshi. ‎ ‎Ati "Bakame yongerewe mu mwiherero kugira ngo atange ubufasha ndetse yunguke n'ubumenyi, nyuma y’uko ibyo byifujwe na Rogerio Ramos, umutoza w’abanyezamu b’Amavubi makuru, kuko yari ari mubatoza amaze iminsi aha ubumenyi n’amahugurwa agamije kubategurira kuzaba abatoza beza b’abanyezamu mu gihe kiri imbere, kuko twari dufite abana 60, umutoza umwe w'abanyezamu ntiyari kubashobora." ‎ ‎Iyi kipe iri kwitegura imikino ya CECAFA izabera i Kigali kuva tariki ya 10 kugeza ku ya 25 Ukwakira 2026, izatozwa na Mulisa Jimmy na Kirasa Alain nk'Umwungiriza, Amir Khan nk’Umutoza w’Abanyezamu ndetse na Nshimiyimana Amdoun nk’Umutoza wongerera imbaraga abakinnyi.
EVT-MUOKNZ74-HKD3.description: The Rwanda Football Federation (FERWAFA) has explained why coaches including Eric Ndayishimiye ‘Bakame’ and Ramadhan Ndayisenga ‘Boateng’ were no longer with the U-17 national team setup.

EVT-MUOKNZ7C-08TZ.canonical_name: Amavubi yahamagaye 28 bagiye kwitegura Liberia na Cape Verde batarimo Manzi Thierry na Kwizera Olivier
EVT-MUOKNZ7C-08TZ.subtitle: Umutoza w'ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda, Stephen Constantine yahamagaye urutonde rw'agateganyo rw'abakinnyi 28 azifashisha mu mikino ibiri ifungura imikino y'amatsinda yo gushaka itike y'igikombe cya Afurika cya 2027, harimo amasura mashya ndetse n'abagarutsemo. ‎ ‎Kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 08 Nzeri 2026, binyuze ku mbuga nkoranyambaga z'ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda, Ferwafa, hatangajwe abakinnyi bagiye kwitegura imikino ibiri Amavubi azakina na Liberia na Cape Verde muri uku kwezi.
EVT-MUOKNZ7C-08TZ.description: Rwanda head coach Stephen Constantine has named a provisional 28-man squad for the opening two group matches of the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying campaign.

EVT-MUOKNZ7H-9ZPA.canonical_name: BK Pro League: Umunsi mbere usize iki mu mibare?
EVT-MUOKNZ7H-9ZPA.subtitle: Shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere mu Rwanda, BK Pro League 2026-2027 yatangiye mu mpera z'iyumweru gishize hakinwa umunsi wa mbere, maze amakipe ya Kiyovu Sports, Police FC na Kigali FC aratungurwa. ‎ ‎Imikino y'uyu munsi yatangiye kuwa 5 Nzeri 2026, hakinwa imikino itandatu mu minsi itatu gusa, hasigara imikino y'amakipe ahagarariye igihugu mu mikino Nyafurika ndetse n'ayo muri Sudani ari muri iyo mikino. ‎ ‎Umwaka w'imikino wa 2026-27 watangiye kuwa Gatandatu tariki ya 05 Nzeri, maze Amagaju FC atsinda Etoile de l'Est 2-0, Etincilles FC inganya 0-0 na Sunrise FC, Kiyovu Sports itsindwa na Gorilla FC 1-0.
EVT-MUOKNZ7H-9ZPA.description: The 2026-27 BK Pro League season opened on September 5 with six matches played in the first round.

EVT-MUOKNZ7M-IV54.canonical_name: CAF Champions League: APR FC yatsindiwe muri DR Congo umukino ubanza
EVT-MUOKNZ7M-IV54.subtitle: ‎Ikipe ya APR FC yatsinzwe na Les Aigles du Congo igitego kimwe ku busa mu mukino ubanza w’ijonjora ry’ibanze rya CAF Champions League, wabereye muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, biyisiga mu mibare yo gusoreza akazi i Kigali. ‎ ‎Uyu mukino wabaye kuri iki Cyumweru, tariki 06 Nzeri 2026, kuri Frederick Kibasa Maliba Stadium i Lubambashi, watangiye Saa Cyenda zuzuye, maze utangira utuje amakipe yombi yigana, ubona ntayishaka gukora amakosa yo kuba yatsindwa igitego. ‎ Wanditse Habiyaremye Japhet Umunyamakuru
EVT-MUOKNZ7M-IV54.description: APR FC lost 1-0 to Les Aigles du Congo in the first leg of their CAF Champions League preliminary-round tie on September 6, 2026.

EVT-MUOKNZ7S-RRFL.canonical_name: Rayon Sports yatangiye itifitiye ikizere yakuye impamba muri Cameroon
EVT-MUOKNZ7S-RRFL.subtitle: Kuri uyu wa Gatanu ikipe ya Rayon Sports yanganyirije na Panthere du Nde muri Cameroon igitego 1-1 mu mukino ubanza w’ijonjora ry’ibanze rya CAF Confederation Cup 2026-2027 yatangiye bamwe mu bakinnyi batifitiye ikizere, gusa umusaruro yabonye uyiha ikizere cyo kugera mu cyiciro gikurikira.
EVT-MUOKNZ7S-RRFL.description: Rayon Sports drew 1-1 with Panthere du Nde at Ahmadou Ahidjo Stadium in Yaounde in the first leg of their 2026-27 CAF Confederation Cup preliminary tie.

EVT-MUOKNZ7Y-LQK7.canonical_name: Volleyball: U Rwanda rwasoje ku mwanya wa kane mu gikombe cy’Afurika
EVT-MUOKNZ7Y-LQK7.subtitle: Nyuma yo kugera muri 1/2 cy’igikombe cy’Afurika, ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda nti yabashije kurenga aho kuko yasezerewe na Misiri iyitsinze amaseti 3-0 nyuma yongera gutsindwa na Cameroon nayo iyitsinze amaseti 3-0 bahatanira umwanya wa gatatu.
EVT-MUOKNZ7Y-LQK7.description: Rwanda’s women’s national volleyball team finished fourth at the African Championship after losing 3-0 to Egypt in the semifinal and then 3-0 to Cameroon in the third-place match.

EVT-MUOKNZ84-RL3P.canonical_name: Volleyball: Nyuma yo gusezererwa na Misiri, u Rwanda rurakinira umwanya wa gatatu
EVT-MUOKNZ84-RL3P.subtitle: U Rwanda rwasezerewe na Misiri Nyuma yo gutsindwa amaseti atatu ku busa mu mukino wa 1/2 wabaye kuri uyu wa kane taliki ya 3 Nzeri I Nairobi mu nzu y’imikino ya Kasarani aho ubu u rwanda rugomba guhatanira umwanya wa gatatu na Cameroon.
EVT-MUOKNZ84-RL3P.description: Rwanda’s women’s national volleyball team was eliminated by Egypt in the African Championship semifinal on September 3, 2026 at Kasarani in Nairobi, losing in straight sets.

EVT-MUOKNZ8B-G2CO.canonical_name: Ntiwavuga ko wizeye cyane kandi utazi neza ikipe - Haringingo mbere yo guhura na Panthère du Nde
EVT-MUOKNZ8B-G2CO.subtitle: Mu gihe ikipe ya Rayon Sports yitegura guhura na Panthere Sportive du Nde mu mukino w’ijonjora ry’ibanze rya CAF Confederation Cup uzabera muri Cameroon kuri uyu wa Gatanu, umutoza Haringingo yavuze ko nubwo batagira ikizere gikomeye kandi batazi neza ikipe bazakina ariko biteguye gukura yo umusaruro mwiza.
EVT-MUOKNZ8B-G2CO.description: Rayon Sports coach Haringingo said his side could not be overly confident ahead of its CAF Confederation Cup preliminary-round first leg against Panthere Sportive du Nde in Cameroon because it did not know the opponent well, but he said the team had prepared to seek a positive result.

EVT-MUOKNZ8K-XCG3.canonical_name: Volleyball: U Rwanda ruresurana na Misiri muri 1/2 cy’igikombe cy’Afurika
EVT-MUOKNZ8K-XCG3.subtitle: Ni nyuma yaho ikipe y’igihugu ya Misiri nayo ibonye itike yo gukina imikino ya 1/2 nyuma yo gutsinda ikipe y’igihugu ya Tunisia amaseti 3-0 mu mukino wa 1/4 wakinwe kuri uyu wa kabiri taliki ya mbere Nzeri.
EVT-MUOKNZ8K-XCG3.description: Rwanda’s women’s national volleyball team was set to face Egypt in the African Championship semifinals after Egypt beat Tunisia 3-0 in the quarterfinals on September 1, 2026.

EVT-MUOKNZ8T-EI2Q.canonical_name: Indwara ya H Pyroli iravurwa igakira, ariko iyo utinze kwivuza ivamo kanseri yo mu gifu
EVT-MUOKNZ8T-EI2Q.subtitle: Inzobere mu bijyanye n’ubuzima, zivuga ko iyi Kanseri isobanurwa nk’ikibyimba kigaragara kiza mu gifu, ariko kikaba atari ikibyimba gisanzwe gishobora kuvurishwa imiti isanzwe kugira ngo kivemo.
EVT-MUOKNZ8T-EI2Q.description: A gastrointestinal specialist cited in the report explained that stomach cancer can spread to nearby and distant organs and may present warning signs such as loss of appetite, weight loss, severe abdominal pain and vomiting blood.

EVT-MUOKNZ91-2KUZ.canonical_name: Umwe mu bantu 120 ashobora kugira ubumuga bw'imikurire n'imyitwarire - Autism
EVT-MUOKNZ91-2KUZ.subtitle: Yabitangaje ku wa 17 Kamena 2026 mu nama nyunguranabitekerezo yahuje Abasenateri n’abandi bayobozi mu nzego zitandukanye, igamije gusuzuma ikibazo cy’abana bafite Autism no gushaka ibisubizo bigamije kunoza ubufatanye mu kubitaho no kubafasha kwiga neza.
EVT-MUOKNZ91-2KUZ.description: A June 17, 2026 forum bringing together Rwandan senators and officials discussed how to improve support and education for children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD).

EVT-MUOKNZ97-S5RD.canonical_name: Muri Congo, abitwaje intwaro bashimuse umwana urwaye Ebola
EVT-MUOKNZ97-S5RD.subtitle: Abagabo bitwaje intwaro bateye Ikigo nderabuzima kiri hafi y’Umujyi wa Butembo mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, batwara uwo mwana wari urwaye ari kumwe na nyina.
EVT-MUOKNZ97-S5RD.description: Armed men attacked a health facility near Butembo in North Kivu, DR Congo, and abducted a child reported to have Ebola along with the child’s mother, according to the article.

EVT-MUOKNZ9G-VBKX.canonical_name: U Rwanda rugira ‘ubumuntu’ - Minisitiri w'Ubuzima muri Sudani y'Epfo
EVT-MUOKNZ9G-VBKX.subtitle: Ku wa 11 -12 Kamena 2026, nibwo Ingabo z’u Rwanda zigize Rwanbatt-1 hamwe n'abapolisi b'u Rwanda (RWA-FPU III) bari mu butumwa bw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye muri Sudani y’Epfo, batanze serivisi z’ubuvuzi ku buntu ku baturage bo mu gace ka Gudele i Juba muri Sudani y’Epfo.
EVT-MUOKNZ9G-VBKX.description: Rwandan troops from Rwanbatt-1 and police officers from RWA-FPU III serving with the United Nations mission in South Sudan provided free medical services to residents of Gudele in Juba on June 11-12, 2026.

EVT-MUOKNZ9Q-F6YZ.canonical_name: Ebola ni indwara yoroshye kwirinda, igoye cyane gukira – Minisitiri Dr. Nsanzimana
EVT-MUOKNZ9Q-F6YZ.subtitle: Iyi ndwara ngo nubwo byemejwe n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Ababimbye ryita ku Buzima (WHO/OMS), ku wa 15 Gicurasi ko ari bwo yagaragaye muri DRC, ariko ishobora kuba yarahageze mbere yaho amezi abiri, kubera ko hari hashize igihe abantu bapfa ariko batazi ikibishe, ku buryo byagiye kumenyekana yatangiye gusatira ibice bihana imbibe n’u Rwanda nk’i Goma na Bukavu aho hari n’abo yahitanye.

EVT-MUOKNZ9Z-6GW3.canonical_name: Indwara zitandura ku mwanya wa mbere mu bihitana Abanyarwanda
EVT-MUOKNZ9Z-6GW3.subtitle: Raporo y'iki kigo y'umwaka ushize, ku bijyanye n'ubuzima n'imibereho (Rwanda Vital Statistics Report 2025) igaragaza ko indwara zitandura zirimo umutima, diyabete na kanseri zihariye 49.5% by’impfu zose zabereye mu mavuriro yo mu Rwanda mu mwaka wa 2025.
EVT-MUOKNZ9Z-6GW3.description: Rwanda’s National Institute of Statistics (NISR) reported that noncommunicable diseases such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes and cancer accounted for 49.5% of deaths recorded in Rwandan health facilities in 2025.

EVT-MUOKNZVQ-DWC9.canonical_name: Guverinoma yemereye Zipline ubukode bw'ubutaka bwo kubakaho Ikibuga cya Drone i Karongi
EVT-MUOKNZVQ-DWC9.subtitle: Sosiyete ya Zipline Rwanda Ltd ni imwe mu masosiyete y’ikoranabuhanga yazanye impinduka zikomeye mu rwego rw’ubuzima mu Rwanda no muri Afurika muri rusange.
EVT-MUOKNZVQ-DWC9.description: The Rwandan government has granted Zipline Rwanda Ltd a land lease for a new drone facility in Karongi District in Western Province, according to the report.

EVT-MUOKNZVZ-JLD4.canonical_name: Nywa amazi birashira - Uko bareka kunywa itabi
EVT-MUOKNZVZ-JLD4.subtitle: Intego nyamukuru y'uyu munsi ni uguteza imbere ubuzima bwiza no kugabanya indwara n'impfu ziterwa n'itabi.
EVT-MUOKNZVZ-JLD4.description: The article outlines practical steps for quitting smoking while citing reports that about 5,500 people in Rwanda die each year from tobacco-related disease and that roughly 491,000 people were tobacco users in 2024.

EVT-MUOKNZW9-BK3I.canonical_name: Batanu bamaze gukira Ebola muri DRC
EVT-MUOKNZW9-BK3I.subtitle: Umuyobozi Mukuru wa WHO, Dr.

EVT-MUOKNZWH-FEMM.canonical_name: Kuvura gukabije kw’amaraso: Dore uburyo umutsi umwe ushobora gutera akaga umubiri wose
EVT-MUOKNZWH-FEMM.subtitle: Dr.

EVT-MUOKNZWQ-ZEN4.canonical_name: Ibyo wamenya kuri Ebola ishobora guhitana umwe muri babiri bayanduye
EVT-MUOKNZWQ-ZEN4.subtitle: Yigeze kwitwa “Ebola hemorrhagic fever”, kubera ko ishobora gutera kuva amaraso imbere no hanze y’umubiri, nubwo atari buri murwayi bibaho.
EVT-MUOKNZWQ-ZEN4.description: The article reviews Ebola as a viral disease that can cause severe illness in humans and some primates and can spread through direct contact with the blood or bodily fluids of an infected person or through handling infected animals.

EVT-MUOKNZWY-0R6J.canonical_name: DRC yashinje OMS gutangaza amakuru ya Ebola mu buryo butera urujijo
EVT-MUOKNZWY-0R6J.subtitle: Mu butumwa bwatangajwe na Patrick Muyaya, Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma ya DRC akaba na Minisitiri ushinzwe Itangazamakuru n’Itumanaho, yavuze ko amakuru yatangajwe na OMS ku bijyanye n’ubwandu bwa Ebola atajyanye n’ukuri ku rwego rwemewe n’inzego z’ubuzima za Congo.
EVT-MUOKNZWY-0R6J.description: DR Congo government spokesman and Communications Minister Patrick Muyaya challenged Ebola information released by WHO, saying some of the figures did not match numbers officially recognized by Congolese health authorities.

EVT-MUOKNZX8-8DBB.canonical_name: RDC: Guhangana na virusi ya Ebola bishobora gutwara amezi atandatu
EVT-MUOKNZX8-8DBB.subtitle: Ni icyorezo gikomeje gutera impungenge muri icyo gihugu, mu gihe umubare w’abamaze gupfa bivugwa ko kugeza ubu ari abantu 223.
EVT-MUOKNZX8-8DBB.description: DR Congo Health Minister Roger Kamba said it could take as long as six months to bring the Ebola outbreak reported in mid-May 2026 under control.

EVT-MUOKNZXJ-4QRO.canonical_name: Canada yafashe ingamba zikomeye ku bagenzi bava muri RDC na Uganda kubera Ebola
EVT-MUOKNZXJ-4QRO.subtitle: Ibiro Ntaramakuru by'Abongereza ,Reuters, byatangaje ko abaturage baturuka muri ibyo bihugu batemerewe kwinjira muri Canada mu gihe cy'iminsi 90 uhereye kuri uyu wa gatatu.
EVT-MUOKNZXJ-4QRO.description: Citing a Reuters report, the article said Canada had tightened entry and health-screening measures for travelers arriving from DR Congo and Uganda because of Ebola concerns.

EVT-MUOKNZXS-AX5D.canonical_name: Ingendo hagati ya Goma na Butembo zahagaritswe kubera Ebola
EVT-MUOKNZXS-AX5D.subtitle: Ibi bikubiye mu itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaragara n’Ibiro bya Guverineri wa Nord-Kivu ku wa 22 Gicurasi 2026.
EVT-MUOKNZXS-AX5D.description: Authorities in North Kivu, DR Congo, temporarily suspended passenger transport between Goma and Butembo as part of measures intended to reduce the risk of Ebola spreading between cities.

EVT-MUOKNZY5-PFTF.canonical_name: Abaganga ba RSSB n’aba MINISANTE ntibavuga rumwe ku bipimo by’ubumuga bukomoka ku mpanuka
EVT-MUOKNZY5-PFTF.subtitle: Izi mpaka zavutse ku wa 18 Gicurasi 2026, ubwo Komisiyo y’Abadepite y’Imibereho y’Abaturage yagezaga ku Nteko Rusange y’Abadepite raporo ku isesengura rya raporo y’igenzura ricukumbuye ryakozwe n’Urwego rw’Ubugenzuzi Bukuru bw’Imari ya Leta ku micungire y’urwego rwa pansiyo, kuva muri Nyakanga 2015 kugeza muri Werurwe 2025.
EVT-MUOKNZY5-PFTF.description: Rwandan lawmakers raised concerns about large differences between disability assessments made by Rwanda Social Security Board (RSSB) doctors and those made by other officially recognized medical professionals in work-accident cases.

EVT-MUOKNZYD-EOTE.canonical_name: Ibirori byo kwizihiza Umunsi w’Abahowe Imana bo muri Uganda byasubitswe kubera Ebola
EVT-MUOKNZYD-EOTE.subtitle: Ni icyemezo cyafashwe nyuma y’ibiganiro yagiranye n’Itsinda ryo mu Gihugu rishinzwe gukumira no kurwanya ibyorezo ndetse n’abayobozi b’amadini.
EVT-MUOKNZYD-EOTE.description: Ugandan authorities postponed annual Martyrs Day celebrations because of concerns about Ebola, according to the report.

EVT-MUOKNZYY-W07S.canonical_name: U Rwanda rwashyizeho ibitaro bya Gisirikare muri buri ntara
EVT-MUOKNZYY-W07S.subtitle: Byari bisanzwe bimenyerewe ko mu Rwanda hari ibitaro bya gisirikare bya Kanombe byonyine biri mu Karere ka Kicukiro mu Mujyi wa Kigali.
EVT-MUOKNZYY-W07S.description: The Rwanda Defence Force (RDF) says it has expanded military hospital services beyond the long-established Kanombe Military Hospital in Kigali so that specialist care can be delivered closer to residents in different regions.

EVT-MUOKNZZ9-GJTM.canonical_name: Abaganga b'Abashinwa bavuye abakozi ba Kigali Today n'imiryango yabo
EVT-MUOKNZZ9-GJTM.subtitle: Byari ibintu bidasanzwe kuko iyo wageraga muri Kigali Today wahitaga ubona hahindutse ivuriro kuko ibiro bikorerwamo byose byabaye aho gusuzumira abitabiriye iki gikorwa.
EVT-MUOKNZZ9-GJTM.description: A Chinese medical team working in Rwanda provided health checks and consultations for Kigali Today employees and their families in areas including dentistry, gynecology, orthopedics and internal medicine.

EVT-MUOKNZZI-QPDB.canonical_name: Mbere yo gushaka imibu yamaze kuba mikuru, banza uyishake ikiri amagi - RBC
EVT-MUOKNZZI-QPDB.subtitle: Yagize ati “Isuku n’isukura ni ikintu twirengagiza, tukajya gukora isuku mu bihuru ariko dusize amazi aretse mu ngo zacu.
EVT-MUOKNZZI-QPDB.description: The Rwanda Biomedical Centre (RBC) emphasized removing standing water around homes so mosquitoes can be stopped at the egg and larval stages as part of malaria prevention.

EVT-MUOKNZZT-DBP5.canonical_name: Coartem imaze imyaka irenga 15 ivura Malariya yonyine yabonye imiti mishya iyunganira
